16 Hobaho Yoshuwa yakawa yakondya kuyiteka yisi yose. Yisi ya mu matunda, ne yisi ya ha nhenenhuko ye matunda. Zisi zose za kusumuka na za kutakama, hamonga ne yisi yose ya Gosheni, sunga ko ku yisi nghavu ya kulubavu lwa kutakama, sunga ko kwi'lolo lye likolongo lya Yoludani.
17 Yisi yali yilawiliye mwi'tunda lya Halaki ku lubavu lwa kutakama behi na Edomu, sunga ko ku Baali-gadi ku lubavu lwa kusumuka, mwi'lolo lya Lebanoni mhelo ye takama ye litunda lya Helemoni.
18 Yoshuwa yakawa yali mu wihomi, yakwihoma ne watemi wa mu yisi yiyo vilo vinji du muno muno. Ninga yakawasuma wose, yakawawulaga.
19 Langa i likaya du lyono lyanoza mulamu ne wanhu wa Isilayeli, lyali lyo likaya lya Gibeyoni, i hanhu hono i Wahivi wanji wekalaga. Ne makaya ganji gose gali gakondya kusumwa mu wulugu.
20 U Muwaha Mulungu, yawanoza wawe na nhumbula nghamu, ho wehome ne Waisilayeli, ho wawulagwe no kongomezezwa lukulu, hamba kuwonelwa lusungu yaye. Na zizi zo Muwaha Mulungu yali yamulajiliza Musa.

21 Kanyhi mu vipango vivyo, vyo Yoshuwa yabitila no kuwongomeza we nghungugo ye manhu mawaha gono gacemwaga Waanaki, gono gekalaga mu yisi ye matunda, ku Hebuloni, na Debili na Anabu, sunga na mu zisi zose ze matunda za Yuda na Isilayeli. Yoshuwa yakagongomezeza lukulu manhu gago, hamonga ne makaya gawo.
22 Kwali kusina hamba Mwanaki yunji wo wose mono yasigazwa mumi mu yisi ya Isilayeli. Langa wacefu du wo wasigala ku Gaza, na ku Gati, na ku Ashidodi.

23 Yoshuwa yakayisola yisi yose, nha vyono Muwaha Mulungu yali yamulajiliza Musa. Yakawapela Waisilayeli yiwe yawo, yakawagawaniza wanhu, nha vyono lyali linha liwalo lye milango yawo, hanhu na mulango wawo. Nhondo no wulugu wukawa kumalika, ne wanhu wakawa kwikala wapolile.


Yoshuwa 12

I watemi wono wasumwa ne Waisilayeli

1 Waisilayeli, wali wakondya kuwasuma no kuyitema yisi yose ya kulubavu lwa kucilima ye likolongo lya Yoludani, ku wulawilila mwi'lolo lya Alinoni, sunga ko kwi'lolo lya Yoludani, sunga ko ku lubavu lwa kusumuka ya kwi 'tunda lya Helemoni. Na kuko, wakawasuma watemi wejete.
2 Sihoni u mutemi we Waamoli mono yali yatemile ku Heshiboni. No wutemi wakwe wali wusolile ne nusu ye yisi ya Gileyadi, ku wulawilila Aloweli, (mu mwejelele we lilolo lya Alinoni,) ne likaya lya haciligati ye lilolo lilyo, sunga ko kwi kolongo lya Yaboki, u mupaka we wana wa Amoni.
3 Yikahanguliza ne lilolo lya Yoludani, ku wulawilila kwi'lamba lya Galilaya, kulubavu lwa kutakama lwa Beti Yeshimoti, (kulubavu lwa kucilima ye Lilenga lyo Mwino) no kujendelela sunga ko ku nhenenhuko ye litunda lya Pisiga.

4 Kanyhi wakamusuma mutemi Ogu wa ku Bashani, mono yali yo wo mudumilizo we Walefayi, mono yali yatemile ku Ashitaloti na Edeleyi.
5 U wutemi wakwe, wali wusolile ne litunda lya Helemoni, na Saleka, ne Bashani yose, sunga ko ku mipaka ye Wageshuli na ye Wamakati, hamonga ne nusu ye yisi ya Gileyadi, sunga ko ku yisi yo mutemi Sihoni wa ku Heshiboni.

6 I watemi wawa wejete, wali wakondya kusumwa na Musa, hamonga ne Waisilayeli. Nayo Musa, u mwitumami wo Muwaha Mulungu, yakawapela yisi yiyo, wo mulango wa Lubeni na wa Gadi, na we nusu ya wo mulango wa Manase, ho yiwe yawo.

I watemi wono wasumwa na Yoshuwa

7 Yoshuwa ne wanhu wa Isilayeli, nawo wakawasuma watemi wose wa ku yisi ya kulubavu lwa ku mwezi ye likolongo lya Yoludani, ku wulawilila Baali-gadi mwi'lolo lya ku Lebanoni, sunga ko kwi'tunda lya Halaki, kulubavu lwa kutakama, behi na Edomu. Yoshuwa yakayigawa yisi yiyo mu we nghungugo ya Isilayeli, yiwe yawo, wayiteme.
8 No wugawane wuwu, wukasola ne zi'si za mu matunda, na mu nhenenhuko ya ku lubavu lwa kumwezi, sunga mwi'lolo lye likolongo lya Yoludani, na mu zi'si za musika ye matunda, hamonga ne zinhenenhuko za ku lubavu lwa kucilima, sunga ko ku yisi nghavu kulubavu lwa kutakama. Ne yisi yiyi, wali wo wikalo we Wahiti, ne Waamoli, ne Wakanani, ne Wapelizi, ne Wahivi, ne Wayebusi.
9 I wanhu wa Isilayeli wakawasuma i watemi wa mu makaya aga gono getyatizye: Yeliko, na Ayi, (behi na Beteli.)
10 Na Yelusalemi, Hebuloni, na
11 Yelemoti, na Lakishi,
12 Ejiloni, na Gezeli,
13 Debili, na Gedeli,
14 Holema, na Aladi,
15 Libina, na Adulamu.
16 Makeda, na Beteli,
17 Tapuwa, na Hefeli,
18 Afeka, na Lashaloni.
19 Madoni, na Hazoli,
20 Shimiloni Meloni, na Acisafu,
21 Tanaki na Megido.
22 Kedeshi na Jokineyamu (wa Kalimeli),
23 Doli (mu mwejelele we lilenga), na Gohimu, (mu Galilaya,)
24 na Tiliza. Hamonga wose waficile watemi makumi madatu na monga liwalo lyawo.


Yoshuwa 13

Yisi yikujendelela kusolwa

1 Ale baho, lono Yoshuwa yali yeza mukombi muno muno, Muwaha Mulungu yakamulonjela yakamutya, “Alu 'gwe wakombipa, ninga yikali koyili yisi mbaha yono yisigaye yono mosakwa muyisole.
2 Yisi yose ya ku Wafilisiti na ku Geshuli,
3 hamonga ne yisi yose ya Avimu, ya kulubavu lwa kutakama, Yisi yono yilawiliye mu cikolongo ca Shiholi, ha mupaka we Wamisili, sunga kulubavu lwa kusumuka, ku mupaka wa Ekiloni wono wehweseswaga vyono we Wakanani, ne watemi wahano we Wafilisiti, wekalaga ha Gaza, na Ashidodi, na Ashikeloni, na Gati na Ekiloni, hamonga ne Wavimi,
4 kulubavu lwa kutakama. Hamonga ne yisi ye Wakanani, na Meyala (yono yili kulubavu lwe Wazidoni,) sunga ku Afeki ku mupaka we Waamoli,
5 ne yisi ye Wagabali yose, ya ku Lebanoni, sunga kucilima, wulawilila Baali-gadi, yono yili kulubavu lwa kutakama ye litunda lya Helemoni, sunga ko ku Hamati Pasi.
6 Nayo yisolile ne zi'si zose za ku Sidoni, wono wekaye mu yisi ye matunda, haciligati ye matunda ga ku Lebanoni, na Miselefoti-mayimu. Ane nowawinga wanhu wawa wose, mu nghango ye Waisilayeli vyono wowa wakujendelela kwihoma nawo. Nagwe yikunojeye wuyigawe yisi kuli Waisilayeli, nha vyono nakulajiliza.
7 Alu wuyigawe yisi yiyi kuli we milango yicenda, hamonga ne nusu ya wo mulango wa Manase ho yiwe yawo, wayiteme.”

Wugawe we yisi ya kulubavu lwa kucilima ya Yoludani

8 Wo mulango wa Lubeni, na wo mulango wa Gadi, hamonga, ne we nusu nyagwe ya wo mulango wa Manase, wali wakondya kuyibocela yisi yono Musa, u mwitumami wo Muwaha Mulungu yali yawapela. Yali yili ku lubavu lwa kucilima ye likolongo lya Yoludani.
9 Yisi yawo yali yijendeleye sunga ko ku Aloweli, (mu mwejelele we lilolo lya Alinoni.) Na mwi'kaya lya haciligati ye lilolo lilyo. Kanyhi yikasola ne yisi yo wuhihi yono yilawiliye Madeba sunga ko ku Diboni.
10 Kanyhi yikajendelela sunga ko ku mupaka we Waamoni, yikasola ne makaya gose, gono yali yatemile u mutemi Sihoni we Waamoli, mono yali yayitemile Heshiboni.
11 Yikasola ne yisi ya Gileyadi sunga na mu mupaka we Wageshuli, na Wamakati ne litunda lyose lya Helemoni, ne Bashani yose, sunga ko ku Saleka.
12 Yikasola ne zisi zose zono zali mu wutemi wo mutemi Ogu, u mutemi wo mudumilizo we Walefayi, mono yali yatemile ku Ashitaloti na ku Edeleyi. Musa yali yakondya kuwasuma wose wawa, sunga yakawawinga na mu yisi.
13 Ninga, hamba nhavivyo, Waisilayeli siwawawinga wanhu wa ku Geshuli hamba Wamakati, wanhu wawa wakali wekaye mu Isilayeli sunga nalu.

14 Langa Musa si yawapela yisi, wo mulango wa Lawi, nha vyono Muwaha Mulungu yali yamulajiliza Musa. Hambi wene u wuhazi wawo, nha wali wa muli vilavywa vinyanywe vya mu cikumbicilo, vyono wamulavizyaga Muwaha Mulungu u Mulungu we Waisilayeli.

I yisi yono yapegwa Lubeni

15 Musa yali yakondya kuwapela we zi mhuga za wo mulango wa Lubeni, nusu ye yisi ho yiwe yawo.
16 Ne yisi yawo yali yibitile sunga ko ku Aloweli (Mu mwejelele we lilolo lya Alinoni) hamonga ne likaya lya haciligati ye lilolo, yisolile ne yisi yo wuhihi, yono vidomile ne Madeba.
17 Kanyhi, yikawa yisolile ne yisi ya Heshiboni, hamonga ne makaya aga gose gono gali gali mu yisi yo wuhihi. Diboni, na Bamoti-baali, Bete-baalimeyoni, na
18 Yahazi, Kedemoti, na Mefati.
19 Kiliyatayimu, na Sibima, Zeleti-shahali na mwitunda lya mwi'lolo,
20 Bete-peyoli na mu nhenenhuko ye litunda lya Pisiga na Bete-jeshimoti.
21 Yikasola ne makaya gose ga mu yisi yo wuhihi, hamonga ne yisi yose ya mu wutemi wa Sihoni mutemi we Waamoli, mono yali yatemile yisi ya Heshiboni. Musa yakamusuma, hamonga ne walongola wa ku Midiyani, na Evi, na Lekemu, na Zuli na Huli na Leba. Wose wawa, wali watemile mu yisi yo mutemi Sihoni, wakawa nha watazi wakwe.
22 Nayo u mutowa cisangu, mono yacemwaga Balamu, u mwana wa Beyoli, yali muyagwe na wawo wono wawulagwa ne Waisilayeli.
23 Ne likolongo lya Yoludani, wukawa wo mupaka wa ku lubavu lwa kumwezi, wa wo mulango wa Lubeni. Ago gali go makaya ne matumbi, gono wagawilwa we mhuga za wo mulango wa Lubeni gawe gawo weneco.

I yisi yono yapegwa Gadi

24 Musa yali yakondya kuwapela we zinhuga za wo mulango wa Gadi yisi yiwe yawo.
25 U mupaka wawo, wali wusolile na Yezeli hamonga ne makaya gose ga Gileyadi, ne nusu ye yisi ye wana wa Amoni. Mupaka wukajendelela sunga ko ku Aloweli, kulubavu lwa kucilima ya Laba.
26 Ne yisi yawo, yikajendelela wulawilila ku Heshiboni sunga ko ku Lamati-mizipe, sunga ko ku Betonimu. Na wulawilila Mahanayimu, sunga ko ku mupaka wa Debili.
27 Sunga mwi'lolo lye likolongo lya Yoludani, yikasola na Bete Halamu, na Bete-nimela na Sukoti na Zafoni, masigazwa go wutemi wa Sihoni wa ku Heshiboni. No mupaka wawo ku lubavu lwa kumwezi, wukawa likolongo lya Yoludani, no kujendelela kulubavu lwa kusumuka sunga ko ku mwejelele we lilamba lya Galilaya.
28 Ago go makaya ne vitumbi vyono wapegwa i wana wo mulango wa Gadi, ho gawe gawo.

I yisi yono wapegwa wa Manase wa ku lubavu lwa kucilima

29 Musa yali yakondya kuwapela we nusu ye mhuga ya wo mulango we wana wa Manase yisi yiwe yawo.
30 Ne yisi yawo, yali yificile sunga ku ko yisi ya Mahanayimu, yikasola ne yisi yose ya Bashani, ya mu wutemi wose wo mutemi Ogu wa ku Bashani, sunga ne matumbi gose makumi mutandatu ga ku Yayili, mu Bashani.
31 Yikasola sunga ne nusu ya Gileyadi, hamonga na Ashitaloti na Edeleyi, i makaya mawaha ga mu wutemi wa Ogu ku Bashani. Azi zose, wakapegwa hamonga ne nusu ye we mhuga yono yali ya Macili u mwana wa Manase.

32 Awu wali wo wugawe no wuhazi we yisi, wono Musa yawagawaniza yisi, yono yali yili kulubavu lwa kucilima ya Yeliko na Yoludani, lono yali yali mu yisi yo wuhihi ya Mowabu.
33 Ninga Musa siyawagawila yisi yo yose i wanhu wa mu mhuga ya Lawi. Langa yawalonjela du vyono, i wene, wuhazi wawo, wowa wuli muli vilavywa vyono vikulavywa kuli Muwaha Mulungu, u Mulungu wa Isilayeli.


Yoshuwa 14

U wugawe we yisi ya ku lubavu lwa kumwezi ya Yoludani

1 Azi zono zityatizye, zikulolosa zo wugawanizwe we yisi kuli wanhu Waisilayeli, i yisi ya Kanani ya kulubavu lwa kumwezi ye likolongo lya Yoludani, nha vyono wagawanizwa na Eleyezali u mukohani, na Yoshuwa u mwana wa Nuni, hamonga ne walongola wa mu zimhuga za mu milango ye Waisilayeli.
2 No wuhazi wawo wukatowelwa kula, kuli milango ye licenda na nusu, ya kulubavu lwa kumwezi ye likolongo lya Yoludani, nha vyono Muwaha Mulungu yali yakondya kumulajiliza Musa.
3 Musa yali yakondya kuyigawaniza yisi ya kulubavu lwa kucilima ye likolongo lya Yoludani, kuli milango ayilya i myejete ne nusu.
4 Wo mulango wa Manase (wa mu lulelo lwa Yusufu, wagawanizwa wakawa milango myejete. Wo mulango wa Manase na wo mulango wa Efulayimu.) Hamba nhavivyo, Musa siyawapela wuhazi we yisi, wo mulango wa Lawi. Langa, wapegwa makaya gono wowa kwikala mumo, hamonga ne mawimbi go wudimilo we matewa ge mitugo zawo.
5 Waisilayeli, wakagawana yisi nha vyono Muwaha Mulungu yamulajiliza Musa.

Kalebi yakupegwa yisi ya Hebuloni

6 Mwizuwa linji, wanhu wo mulango wa Yuda, wakamuziza Yoshuwa ha Giligali. Muyawo yunji mono yacemwaga Kalebi, u mwana wa Yefune, u Mukenezi, yakamulonjela Yoshuwa yakatya, “Agwe wumanyile vyono Muwaha Mulungu yamulonjela Musa u mwitumami wakwe, za kuli'ne, na gwegwe, lono cali cili ku Kadeshi Balineya.
7 Baho, ane nali ficile myaka makumi mane, lono Musa u mwitumami wo Muwaha Mulungu, yanhuma ku wulawilila ku Kadeshi-baleneya, ho nghayitandile yisi yiyi. Nghamugomolela Musa nghani ze mbeka za kuli zono naziwona mu yisi yiyi.
8 Ninga wanhu wono cabitana nawo, wakawogofya wanhu. Ninga ane nghawa mwihuwilwa kuli Muwaha Mulungu wangu.
9 Nane netuma zose zono Musa yandajiliza, holeka nayo Musa yakanyilahila yakatya, ‘Tuti i yisi yono zokanyaga zinzayo zako, nokupela gwegwe ne wanago ho wuwe wuhazi wenyu sunga cibitilila.’
10 Lanje luno! Yapuluta myaka makumi mane na mihano, wulawilila lono Muwaha Mulungu yalonjela zizi na Musa. Lono Waisilayeli wapilimaga mu nyika, na vyono Muwaha Mulungu yehuwiza, na mbeka yakondya kundima sunga, nalu nghali nili mumi. Nalu wunangaje, nafisa myaka makumi munana na mihano.
11 Ninga vyo nghali nghamile du, kotya nhavyono nali ninha ha lulongozi, lono Musa yanhumila. Nghali nghamile, hamba ku wulugu nosuma kubita, hamba kwituma mulimo wunji wowose.
12 Holeka lu, wumhelaje nane yisi ya mu matunda, yisi yono Muwaha Mulungu yanyihuwiza mwi'zuwa lililya, vyono komhela, lono ane hamonga ne, wanhu wono nali nina nawo, cakulonjelela zinghani za ku kuno, nha vyono kuko, kogali manhu mawaha gono gakucemwa Maanaki, gekaye mu makaya gono gena ne magomawakali. Na lunji Muwaha Mulungu kowa hamonga nane, nane nosuma kugawinga du, nha vyono Muwaha Mulungu yalonga.”

13 Ale baho Yoshuwa yakamulugutiza Kalebi u mwana wa Yefune. Hobaho yakamupela likaya lya Hebuloni liwe lyakwe yaliteme.
14 Sunga nalu Hebuloni yikali mu miwoko ya wo lulelo lwa Kalebi u mwana wa Yefune, Mukenezi. Vyono Kalebi yamuhulika Muwaha Mulungu u Mulungu, wa Isilayeli.
15 Hamwamulizo, Hebuloni yacemwaga likaya lya Kiliyati Aleba (Aleba yali yo muwaha muli Waanaki.) Nhondo yisi yikatula, yikawa no mulamu.


Yoshuwa 15

I yisi yono yapegwa Yuda

1 Ale, ne zimhuga za wo mulango wa Yuda, nazo zikapegwa yisi yono yali yibitile ku lubavu lwa kutakama, sunga ko kutakama ku mupaka wa Edomu, mu nyika ya Zini.
2 No mupaka wuwu wa kulubavu lwa kutakama, wali wulawiliye ku ndumilizo ye Lilenga lyo Mwino,
3 wukajendelela kulubavu lwa kutakama ku wulawilila Akelabimu, wukakola sunga ku Zini. Wukawa kujendelela sunga kulubavu lwa kutakama lwa Kadeshi Balineya, no kukolela Hezeloni, sunga ko ku Adali, sunga ko ku Kalika,
4 wukajendela sunga ko ku Azimoni, wukawa kutyatya cikolongo mu mupaka wa Misili, wukawa kujendelela sunga ko kwi'lenga lya Meditelaneya. Mupaka wawo, baho ho wadumila. Awu wali wo mupaka wa ku lubavu lwa kutakama.

5 U mupaka wawo wa ku lubavu lwa kucilima nawo, wali wulawiliye he 'lenga lyo Mwino, no kujendelela sunga ko ku ndumilizo ye likolongo lya Yoludani kono vitang'aniliye ne Lilenga lyo Mwino.

Nawo mupaka wa ku lubavu lwa kusumuka, wali wulawiliye baho,
6 nawo wukajendelela sunga ko ku Bete-hojila, no kujendelela kulubavu lwa kusumuka sunga ko ku Aleba, no kwidoma ne lilolo lya Yoludani. Hanyuma wukakolela he'bwe lya Bohani (Bohani yali yo mwana we cilume wa Lubeni.)
7 Wulawilila lilolo lya Akoli, nhunizo yayo, lilolo lyo “Wugazwe” sunga ku Debili. Hanyuma kanyhi wukadoma ku lubavu lwa kusumuka sunga Giligali, kono vidomile na Adumimu, kulubavu lwa kutakama ye lilolo. Hanyuma kanyhi wukajendelela sunga mu mivwilo ye cikolongo ca Eni shemeshi, wukajendelela sunga ku Enelogeli.
8 Mupaka wukajendelela wukakolela mwi'lolo lya Hinomu, ku lubavu lwa kutakama ye litunda, hono likaya liwaha lye Wayebusi lya Yelusalemi, lyali lizenjigwe. Hobaho mupaka wukajendelela sunga mucanyha ye litunda, ku lubavu lwa ku mwezi ye lilolo lya Hinomu, kundumilizo ye lilolo lya Lefayi kulubavu lwa kusumuka.
9 Na ku wulawilila baho, wukajendelela sunga ha mivwilo ye cikolongo ca Nefetowa, wukajendelela kanyhi sunga mu makaya gono gali gali behi ne litunda liwaha lye Efeloni. Hobaho kanyhi mupaka wukalanga ku Baala (wo wutya ku Kiliyati-yeyalimu.)
10 Na ku wulawa baho, mupaka wukapilimila ku lubavu lwa ku mwezi ya Baala, sunga mu yisi ye matunda ga Edomu. Kanyhi wukawa ku lubavu lwa kusumuka ye litunda lya Yeyalimu, (wo wutya Cesaloni) no kutenenhuka sunga ku Bete Shemeshi no kujendelela sunga ku Timina.

11 U mupaka wukajendelela kanyhi sunga mwitunda ku lubavu lwa kusumuka ya Ekiloni, wukawuya ne nyuma kanyhi, wukakolela Shikeloni he 'tunda lya Baala, sunga ku Jabineli. Nawo mupaka wukadumila he 'lenga lya Meditelaneya
12 lyono lyalajila mupaka wawo wa kulubavu lwa kumwezi. Na wuwo wali wo mupaka we yisi yono zekalaga zimhuga zo mulango wa Yuda.

Kalebi yakuyisuma Hebuloni na Debili

(Lam 1:11-15)

13 Lubavu lunji lwe yisi ya we mhuga ya Yuda, yakapegwa Kalebi u mwana wa Yefune, nha vyono Muwaha Mulungu yamulajiliza Yoshuwa. Yakapegwa likaya lya Hebuloni, likaya lyono lyali lya Aluba u sogwe wa Anaki.
14 Nayo Kalebi yakawawinjila kunze ye likaya wana wa Anaki we mhuga ya Sheshayi, na ya Ahimani na ya Talimayi.
15 Wulawa baho, yakabita kuwahoma i wanhu wose wono wekalaga ha Debili, (likaya lili lyacemwaga Kiliyati-sefeli.)
16 Kalebi yakatya, “Ane nomutoza mwanangu we cicekulu Akisa, kuli munhu mono kosuma kuyihoma no kuyiteka Kiliyati-sefeli.”
17 Nayo Otiniyeli u mwana wa Kenazi, u mwanakwawe wa Kalebi, yakalihoma likaya, yakalisola. Hobaho Kalebi yakamukombolela Otiniyeli u mwanagwe we cicekulu Akisa, wetole nayo.
18 Kukawa mwi'zuwa lye Halusi, Otiniyeli yakamufunda Akisa yalombe mugunda kuli sogwe Kalebi. Ale baho Akisa yakatenenhuka ne ndogowe yakwe sunga kuli sogwe. Kalebi yakamuwuza Akisa cono yasakaga.

19 Nayo Akisa yakamupitula sogwe yakatya, “Nghulomba wumhele wulugutizwe, wumhele ne mivwilo ye malenga. Hambi mugunda wono wumhelile, nha wuli mu yisi nghavu muno.” Hobaho Kalebi yakamupela Akisa mivwilo ya kucanyha na ya kusika.

I makaya ga Yuda

20 Awu wo wuhazi we yisi, yono i wana wo mulango wa Yuda wapegwa wayiteme.
21 I makaya ga ku lubavu lwa kutakama, gose gali gawo. Na galya gono gali gali behi no mupaka wa ku Edomu, go aga, Kabizeli, na Edeli, na Jaguli,
22 na Kina, na Dimona, na Adada,
23 na Kadeshi, na Hazoli, na Itinani,
24 na Zifu, na Telemu, na Beyaloti,
25 Hazoli-hadata. Ciliyati-hezeloni (yo Hazoli),
26 Amamu, na Shema, na Molada,
27 Hazali Gada, na Heshimoni, na Betipeleti.
28 Na Hazali Shuwali, na Belisheba, na Bisiyotiya.
29 Baala, na Iyimu, na Ezemu,
30 na Elitoladi, na Cesili, na Holema,
31 na Zikilagi, na Mademana, na Sanisana,
32 na Lebayoti, na Shilihimu, na Ayini, na Limoni, Makaya makumi mejete ne 'cenda, hamonga ne matumbi gono gali gagapilime.

33 I makaya ga mu zinhenenhuko ye matunda, gali Eshitayoli, na Zola, na Ashina,
34 na Zanowa, na Ene-ganimu, na Tapuwa, na Enamu,
35 na Yalimuti, na Adulamu, na Soko, na Azeka,
36 na Shayalayimu, na Aditayimu, na Gedela, na Gedelotayimu, Makaya yikumi na mane, hamonga ne matumbi gono gali gagapilime.

37 Kanyhi ganji gali Zenani, na Hadasha, na Migidaligadi, na
38 Dileyani, na Mizipa, na Joketeyeli,
39 na Lakishi, na Bozikati, na Ejiloni,
40 na Kaboni, na Lahimamu, na Citilishi,
41 Gedeloti, na Bete-dagoni, na Nama, na Makeda. Makaya yikumi na mutandatu, hamonga na matumbi gono gali gagapilime.

42 Kanyhi ganji, gali, Libina, na Eteli, na Ashani,
43 na Ifita, na Ashina, na Nezibu,
44 na Keyila, na Acizibu, na Malesha. Makaya yicenda, hamonga ne matumbi gono gali gagapilime.

45 Na Ekiloni hamonga ne matumbi ne vikaya,
46 hamonga ne makaya ne matumbi gono gali gali behi na Ashidodi, ku wulawilila Ekiloni sunga ko kwi'lenga lya Meditelaneya.

47 Kanyhi ganji Ashidodi na Gaza hamonga ne matumbi, ne vikaya vyono vyali vidomile no mupaka wa ku Misili, no mwejelele we lilenga lya Meditelaneya.

48 Na mu yisi ya mu matunda, gali Shamili, na Yatili, na Soko,
49 na Dana, na Kiliyati-sano, (yo Debili,)
50 na Anabu, na Ashetemo, na Animu.
51 Na Gosheni, na Holoni, na Gilo. Makaya yikumi na limonga, hamonga ne matumbi gono gali gagapilime.

52 Kanyhi ganji, gali, Alabu, na Duma, na Eshani,
53 na Yanimu, na Bete-tapuwa, na Afeka,
54 na Mumeta, na Hebuloni, na Ziyoli. Makaya yicenda, hamonga ne matumbi gono gali gagapilime.

55 Kanyhi ganji, gali, Mawoni, na Kalimeli, na Zifu, na Juta.
56 Na Yezeleli, na Yokideyamu, na Zanowa,
57 na Kayini, na Gibeya, na Timina, Makaya yikumi, hamonga ne matumbi gono gali gagapilime.

58 Kanyhi ganji, gali, Halihuli, na Betezuli, na Gedoli.
59 Na Malati, na Betanoti, na Elitekoni. Makaya mutandatu, hamonga ne matumbi gono gali gagapilime.

60 Kanyhi ganji, gali, Kiliyati Baali (yo Kiliyati Yeyalimu) na Laba. Makaya mejete, hamonga ne matumbi gono gali gagapilime.

61 Mu nyika, gali, Beti Alaba, na Midini, na Secaca.
62 Na Nibishani, ne Likaya lyo mwino, na Engedi. Makaya mutandatu, hamonga ne matumbi gono gali gagapilime.

63 Ninga i wanhu wa Yuda, si wawawinga Wayebusi wono wekalaga ha Yelusalemi. Holeka Wayebusi wajendeleye kwikalana ne wanhu wa Yuda sunga nalu.


Yoshuwa 16

I yisi yono yapegwa Efulayimu ne wana wa Manase wono wekalaga ku lubavu lwa kumwezi

1 Mupaka wa ku lubavu lwa kutakama, we yisi yono wapegwa wo lulelo lwa Yusufu, wali wulawiliye ha Yoludani, behi na Yeliko, ha mudumilizo wa kucilima we mivwilo ya ha Yeliko. Wukajendelela sunga ko ku nyika. Wukakolela ha Yeliko sunga mu yisi ye matunda ku Beteli.
2 Ku wulawilila ha Beteli, wukakolela Luzu, wukajendelela sunga wukafika ku Ataloti Adali, kono wekalaga wanghula wo kucola zilamani ze zikaya.
3 Mupaka wukawa kujendelela, wukatimila ku lubavu lwa kumwezi, ku mupaka we Wajafeleti, sunga ku mupaka we Bete Holoni ya kusika. Wukajendelela wulawilila baho, sunga ku Gezeli. Nawo wukadumiliziza he 'lenga lya Meditelaneya.

4 Hobaho i wana wa Yusufu, wo mulango wa Efulayimu, na we mhuga ya Manase wa kulubavu lwa ku mwezi, wakayibocela yisi yiyo yiwe wo wuhazi wawo.

Efulayimu

5 Ayi yali yo yisi ye zimhuga za Efulayimu. Mupaka wawo wali wukoleye Ataloti Adali, wudomile kucilima, sunga ko ku Bete Holoni ya kucanyha.
6 Na ku wulawilila baho, wukajendelela sunga he 'lenga lya Meditelaneya. Micemeta yali ku lubavu lwawo lwa kusumuka. Na ku lubavu lwa kucilima, mupaka wukapilima, wukakolela ku Tanati-shilo, ku lubavu lwa kucilima, sunga ko ku Yanowa.
7 Hanyuma wukawa kutenenhuka ku wulawilila ku Yanowa sunga ku Ataloti na Nala hanyuma wukakolela ku Yeliko, wukadumila mwi'kolongo lya Yoludani.
8 U mupaka, wukajendelela ku lubavu lwa kumwezi, ku wulawilila Tapuwa, sunga ko ku mivwilo ya Kana, no kudumiliziza he 'lenga lya Meditelaneya. Ayi yo yisi yono wapegwa we zimhuga za wo mulango wa Efulayimu ho yiwe yawo.
9 Ninga wakapegwa ne matumbi, hamonga ne vikaya vinji vyono vyali mu mipaka ya Manase.
10 Nawo wawo wo mulango wa Efulayimu, siwawawinga Wakanani wono wekalaga mu Gezeli. Holeka Wakanani wekalane ne Waefulayimu sunga nalu, langa Waefulayimu wawetumyaga Wakanani kotya wawanda.


Yoshuwa 17

1 Nusu ye yisi ya kumwezi ya Yoludani, wapegwa wacefu wa mu zimhuga zo mulango we wana wa Manase, u mwana wa Yusufu u mulongozi kulelwa. Macili u sogwe ya Gileyadi, yali mwana wa Manase u mulongozi kulelwa. Kanyhi yali yali citung'ati ku wulugu. Holeka mwene yakapegwa Gileyadi na Bashani, ku lubavu lwa kucilima lwa Yoludani yiwe yakwe.
2 Ne yisi ya ku lubavu lwa kumwezi ya Yoludani, wakapegwa zimhuga zinji zono zali zisigaye ze mhuga ya Manase, nawo wo wano, Abiyeza, Heleki, Asiliyeli, Shekemu, Hefeli, na Shemida. Awa wali wo wana wa Manase u mwana wa Yusufu. Kanyhi wene wali wo walongola mu zimhuga zawo.
3 Zelofehadi u mwana wa Hefeli, mwana wa Gileyadi, mwana wa Macili, mwana wa Manase, mwene siyalela wana we cilume yaye, langa yalela wana wose we cicekulu du. Ne matagwa gawo gogano, Mala, Nowa, Hojila, Milika, na Tiliza.
4 I wahinza wawa, wakamubitila Eleyezali u mukohani, na kuli Yoshuwa u mwana wa Nuni, na kuli walongola wose. Wakawatya, “Muwaha Mulungu, yamulajiliza Musa vyono, yacigawile nase yisi yiwe yetu, nha vyono wagawilwa i wandugu zetu we cilume.” Hobaho wakawa kupegwa yisi muling'ano ne wandugu zawo we cilume nha vyono Muwaha Mulungu yali yalajiliza.
5 Na ku soko yiyo, holeka Manase yakabocela magawo yikumi, hamonga na Gileyadi na Bashani, ku lubavu lwa kucilima lwa Yoludani,
6 lono lulelo lwakwe lwe wana we cicekulu, hamonga ne wana we cilume, wose wali wapegwa yisi. Ne yisi ya Gileyadi yikagawilwa kuli wana wono wasigala wa mu lulelo lwa Manase.

7 Yisi ya Manase, yali yikoleye wulawilila Asheli, sunga ku Micemeta, ku lubavu lwa kucilima ya Shekemu. Hobaho mupaka wukakolela lubavu lwa kutakama, wukawahanza ne wanhu wose wa Eni-tapuwa.
8 Ne yisi yono yali yipilime Tapuwa, yikawa yisi ya Manase, langa likaya lya Tapuwa, mu mupaka, likawa yikaya lya wa mu lulelo lwa Efulayimu.
9 Mupaka kanyhi wukatenenhuka sunga ku mivwilo ya Kana. Makaya ga ku lubavu lwa kutakama lwe mivwilo yono yali ya Efulayimu, hamba gawe gali gali mu yisi ya Manase. Mupaka wa Manase nawo, wukajendelela mu nhumbi yo lubavu lwa kusumuka ye cikolongo, wukadumiliziza mwi'lenga lya Meditelaneya.
10 Efulayimu yali yekaye kulubavu lwa kutakama, nayo Manase, yali yekaye ku lubavu lwa kusumuka, ne lilenga lya Meditelaneya, wali wo mupaka wawo wa ku lubavu lwa kumwezi. Asheli yali yali kusumuka ye mwezi, nayo Isakali, yekalaga ku lubavu lwe sumuka ye cilima.
11 Na mumo mu yisi ya Isakali na Asheli, mukawa mozili Belishani na Abileyamu, zono Manase yali yazitemile, hamonga ne vitumbi vyayo, hamonga na Doli, (yono yali yili mu mwejelele we lilenga.) Endoli, Tanaki, Megido, ne matumbi gono gali gagapilime.
12 Ninga hamba nhavivyo, i wo lulelo lwa Manase, siwasuma kuwawinga wanhu wono wekalaga mu makaya gago. Holeka Wakanani wakajendelela kwikala mumo.
13 Hamba Waisilayeli lono wali wakondya kuwa ne vilungo, siwawawinga Wakanani, langa wawetumyaga du milimo yawo kwe vilungo.

Efulayimu na Manase ya ku lubavu lwa kumwezi, wakulomba wonjelezwe yisi

14 Wose wa mu lulelo lwa Yusufu wakamulonjela Yoshuwa wakamutya, “Alu nhawule kucigawila yisi hanhu hamonga du, na kumbe nase ho cili wenji muno, hambi Muwaha Mulungu nha yakondya kuciluguta.”

15 Nayo Yoshuwa yakawapitula yakawatya, “Hono muli wenji, ne yisi ya mu matunda ya Efulayimu ndodo hamba si yikumukwilenyi yaye, ale lu, mubite mu yisi ye Wapelizi ne Walefayi mukatemanje mbago mwikale.”
16 Wakamupitula wakatya, yisi ya mu matunda, hamba siyocikwila yaye. Hamba nhavivyo, Wakanani wa mu malolo, wena matuka go wulugu ge vyuma, hamonga na wono wali mu Betishani na mu matumbi gono gapilime, sunga na wono wali mwi'lolo lya Yezeleli nawo nhavivyo.

17 Yoshuwa yakawatya wanhu wa mu mhuga ya Efulayimu na wa Manase wa kumwezi, “Mbeka anye muli wenji muno, kanyhi muli vilungo. Holeka motuga du kanyhi yigawo linji.
18 Yisi ye matunda yowa yenyu. Hamba yiwe nha mbago, ninga 'nye motemanga no kwitujila wikalo mumo, wulawilila ku mhelo ayino, sunga ko kumhelo nzagwe. Mowawinga Wakanani hamba wawe wena matuka go wulugu ge vyuma kanyhi wali vilungo.”


Yoshuwa 18

U wugawe we yisi yono yali yisigaye

1 Lono mhuga yose ya Isilayeli, waza kuwa wakondya kuyisuma yisi. Waketang'anila ha Shilo, wakalikoma baho Lihema lyono Lyelile.
2 Kwali kukali kozili mhuga mupunghati ze wanhu wa Isilayeli, wono wali wakali sinapegwa ligawo lye yisi yawo.
3 Hobaho Yoshuwa yakawalonjela Waisilayeli yakutya, “Alo mocela sunga nili kwinjila, no kuyitema, yisi yono Muwaha Mulungu we walezi wenyu yakondya kumupelenyi?
4 Alu, mumhelaje ta wanhu wadatu wadatu, wulawa mu milango yenyu. Nane nowategula mu yisi yiyi yose, ho wakacole lamani ye yisi yono wosaka kuyisola, ho yiwe wuhazi wawo. Hanyuma wawuye kanyhi, waze wanonjele.
5 Ne yisi yogawa muli wene mu magawo mupunghati. Wo mulango wa Yuda, awo wokwikala mu yisi yawo yo lubavu lwa kutakama. Nawo wo mulango wa Yusufu, wokwikala mu yisi ya kulubavu lwa kusumuka.
6 Ale mwandice wulolose we magawo gago mupunghati, mundetele. Nane nogatowela kula hali Muwaha Mulungu, u Mulungu wetu, i magawo gago mupunghati so nyenye.
7 Ninga hamba nhavivyo, i Walawi, siwogawilwa yigawo lyo lyose lye yisi, hamonga nanye mono musigaye. Vyono i ligawo lyawo wene, lyowa lili mu mulimo wawo wo Wukohani wo kumwitumamila Mulungu. Hamba nhavivyo wo mulango wa Gadi, na wa Lubeni hamonga ne nusu ya wo mulango wa Manase, wono wekaye kulubavu lwa kucilima, awo wose wakondya kugawilwa yisi yawo, yo lubavu lwa kucilima ye likolongo lya Yoludani. Yisi yiyilya yono wakondya kupegwa na Musa u mwitumami wo Muwaha Mulungu.”

8 Nawo wanhu wawo, lono wali weza kusaka kutuluka, ho wabite ku wucola lamani ye yisi, Yoshuwa yakawa kuwalajiliza yakutya, “Alu, mubite mukayijendele yisi yose mucole lamani, hanyuma ho mumbuyile kanyhi baha ha Shilo. Nane nomutowelenyi kula hali Muwaha Mulungu.”
9 Hobaho i wanhu wawo, wakatuluka wakayikolela yisi yose. Hanyuma wakawa kwandika wulolose wawo, nha vyono wayigawile magawo mupunghati nha vyono linha liwalo lye makaya gayo. Hanyuma wakawa kuwuya kuli Yoshuwa ku nghambi ya ku Shilo.
10 Yoshuwa yakagatowela kula hali Muwaha Mulungu i magawo gago. Hanyuma yakawa kuwawagulila we milango yose ye Waisilayeli yono yali yisigaye, mulango ne 'gawo lyawo lye yisi.

Yisi yono yapegwa Benyamini

11 Wo mulango wa Benyamini, wali wo walongozi kupegwa yisi yawo. Yisi yawo yali yili haciligati ya we milango ya Yuda na Yusufu.
12 No lubavu lwa kusumuka, u mupaka wawo wali wulawiliye ha Yoludani, wukakolela mu nhenenhuko yo lubavu lwa kusumuka ya Yeliko, na ku lubavu lwa kumwezi, wukakolela mu yisi ye matunda, sunga wukadumiliziza mu nyika ya Betaveni.
13 Kanyhi, mupaka wukatenenhucila ku lubavu lwa kutakama ya ku Luzu, (wono wacemwaga Beteli.) Hanyuma wukatimila ku Ataloti-adali, behi ne litunda, lyo lubavu lwa kutakama, ku Bete Holoni ya ku wuhihi.
14 Kanyhi mupaka wukapilimila ku lubavu lwa kumwezi ye litunda, wukalanga kulubavu lwa kutakama, wukawa kubita sunga ko ku Kiliyati Baali (yo Kiliyati Yeyalimu,) ya wo mulango wa Yuda. Awu wali wo mupaka wawo wa kulubavu lwa kumwezi.
15 Mupaka wa ku lubavu lwa kutakama, wali wulawiliye mu mwejelele wa Kiliyati Yeyalimu, wukawa kubita sunga ko ku mivwilo ye cikolongo ca Nefetowa.
16 Kanyhi wukawa kubita sunga ko ku mwalambalo we litunda lyono vyali vidomile ne lilolo lye wana wa Hinomu, ku ndumilizo ya kulubavu lwa kusumuka ye lilolo lye Walefayi. Hanyuma, wukawa kujendelela ku lubavu lwa kutakama, wukakolela mwi'lolo lye wana wa Hinomu, ku lubavu lwa kutakama ku Yebusi, sunga ko ku Enelogeli.
17 Hanyuma wukapetela ku lubavu lwa kusumuka, sunga ko ku Eneshemeshi, sunga ku Geliloti yono vyali vidomile ne cizila ca ku Adumimu. Mupaka kanyhi, wukatenenhuka sunga kwi'bwe lya Bohani (Bohani yali yo mwana wa Lubeni.)
18 Wukajendelela sunga ko ku ndumilizo yo lubavu lwa kusumuka yono vidomile ne lilolo lya Yoludani. Hanyuma wukawa kutenenhucila mwi'lolo mugati,
19 wukoleye ku lubavu lwa kusumuka ye Bete-hojila, wukadumila mwiwoko-woko lye Lilenga lyo Mwino lyono malenga ga Yoludani genjilaga ku lubavu lwa kutakama.
20 Yoludani wali wo mupaka wawo wa ku lubavu lwa kucilima. Ayi yali yo mipaka ye yisi yono wapegwa wa wo zimhuga zo wo mulango wa Benyamini, ho yiwe wuhazi wawo.
21 Ne makaya gono gali ge zimhuga zo wo mulango wa Benyamini, gali go aga, Yeliko, Beti Hojila, Emekikezizi,
22 Beti Aleba, Zemalayimu, Beteli,
23 Avimu, Pala, Ofila,
24 Cefalamoni, Ofini, na Geba. Makaya yikumi na mejete, hamonga ne matumbi gono gali gagapilime.
25 Kanyhi hamonga na Gibeyoni, na Lama, na Beyeloti,
26 Mizipa, Cefila, Moza,
27 Lekemu, Ilipeli, Talala,
28 Zela, Hayelefi, Yebusi, (hamba Yelusalemi,) na Gibeya, hamonga na Kiliyati Yeyalimu. Gose hamonga gali makaya yikumi na mane, hamonga ne matumbi gono gali gagapilime. Ayi yo yisi ye zimhuga zo wo mulango wa Benyamini, yono wapegwa yiwe wo wuhazi wawo.


Yoshuwa 19

Yisi yono yapegwa Simiyoni

1 Ligawo lye kejete lyono lyawagwa, lyali lya wo lulelo lwe zimhuga zo mulango wa Simiyoni. Yisi yawo yikawa yinjiye sunga na mu wutemi we yisi ya wo mulango wa Yuda.
2 Yikahanguliza makaya aga, Beli Sheba, Sheba, Molada,
3 Hazali Shuwali, Bala, Ezemu.
4 Elitoladi, Betuli, Holema,
5 Zikilaji, Bete-makaboti, Hazalisusa,
6 Betelebayoti na Shaluheni. Gose hamonga gali makaya yikumi na madatu, hamonga ne matumbi gono gali gagapilime.

7 Kanyhi hakawa hogali makaya ga Ayini, Limoni, Eteli na Ashani. Makaya mane hamonga ne matumbi gono gali gagapilime.
8 Yikahanguliza ne matumbi gose gono gali gagapilime makaya gago, sunga ko ku Balati-beli (wo wutya Lama) ya kutakama. Ayi yali yo yisi yono wapegwa we zimhuga zo wo mulango wa Simiyoni, yiwe wo wuhazi wawo.
9 Na vyono ligawo lye wana wa Yuda lyali yiwaha, kuciza nha vyono lyasakwaga liwe, holeka hakadumulwa lubavu lunji, wakapegwa kanyhi wo mulango wa Simiyoni.

Yisi yono yapegwa Zabuloni

10 Ligawo lye kadatu lyono lyawagwa, lyali lya wo lulelo lwa we zimhuga zo wo mulango wa Zabuloni. Ne yisi yono wagawilwa, mupaka wayo wali wuficile sunga ko ku Salidi.
11 Walawilila Salidi, wukakolela lubavu lwa kumwezi sunga Malala, wukapamiza ha Dabaheti, ku cikolongo ca ku lubavu lwa kucilima ye Yokeneyamu.
12 Na ku wulawilila ku lubavu luyagwe lwa Salidi, wukabita ku lubavu lwa kucilima sunga ko ku mupaka wa Cishiloti-taboli, hanyuma ku Debela, sunga ko ku Yafiya.
13 Wukajendelela ku lubavu lwa kucilima, sunga ko ku Gatihafeli na Etekazini. Kanyhi wukawuya ne nyuma, wukalanga ku Neya, nzila yono yibitile ku Limoni.
14 Nako ku lubavu lwa kusumuka, mupaka wukalanga ku Hanatoni, wukadumila mwi'lolo lya Ifitaheli.
15 Wukahanguliza makaya aga: Kata, Nahalali, Shimiloni, Idala na Betelehemu. Gose hamonga, gali Makaya yikumi na mejete, hamonga ne matumbi gono gali gagapilime.
16 Makaya ne matumbi gaga, gali gali mu yisi yono we zimhuga zo wo mulango wa Zabuloni, wapegwa yiwe wo wuhazi wawo.

Yisi yono yapegwa Isakali

17 Ligawo lye kane lyono lyawagwa, lyali lye zimhuga zo wo mulango wa Isakali.
18 Mupaka wawo wukawa wina makaya aga: Yezeleli, Cesuloti, Shunemu,
19 na Hafalayimu, Shiyoni, Anahalati,
20 Na Labiti, Cishiyoni, Ebezi,
21 Lemeti, Ene-ganimu, Ene-hada na Bete-pazezi.
22 Mupaka wukafika ko ku Taboli, na Shahazuma na Bete Shemeshi, wukadumiliziza ha Yoludani. Wukahanguliza makaya yikumi na mutandatu, hamonga ne matumbi gose gono gali gagapilime.
23 Makaya ne matumbi gaga, gali gali mu yisi yono we zimhuga za wo mulango wa Isakali wapegwa yiwe wo wuhazi wawo.

Yisi yono yapegwa Asheli

24 Ligawo lye hano lyono lyawagwa, lyali lye zimhuga zo wo mulango wa Asheli.
25 U mupaka wayo, wukahanguliza makaya aga: Helekati, Hali, na Beteni, Acisafu.
26 Alameleki, Amadi na Mishali, kulubavu lwa kumwezi, wukafika Kalimeli na Shiholi-libinati.
27 Na ku lubavu lwa kucilima, wukajendelela sunga ha Bete-dagoni, wukapamiza likaya lya Zabuloni ne lilolo lya Ifitaheli, mu nzila yono yidomile kusumuka, sunga ko ku Beti-emeki na Neyeli. Wukajendelela kusumuka, sunga wukafika Kabuli,
28 Ebeloni, Lehobu, Hamoni, na Kana, wukajendelela sunga ko ku Sidoni.
29 Kanyhi mupaka wawo wukapitucila ku Lama, wukafika kwi 'kaya lilya lye ligomawakali lya Tulo, kanyhi wukapitucila ku Hosa, no kudumiliziza he 'lenga lya Meditelaneya. Wukahanguliza na Mahalabi na Acizibu,
30 Uma, Afeki na Lehobu. Makaya makumi mejete na mejete, hamonga ne matumbi gose gono gali gagapilime.
31 Makaya ne matumbi gose, gali gali mu yisi yono we zimhuga zo wo mulango wa Asheli, wapegwa wuwe wo wuhazi wawo.

Yisi yono yapegwa Nafutali

32 Ligawo lyo mutandatu lyono lyawagwa, lyali lya we zimhuga zo wo mulango wa Nafutali.
33 Mupaka wayo, wukalawilila ku Helefu, sunga ku mubici wo munghola wono wali wuli ku Zananimu, sunga Adaminekebu na ku Jabineli, wukawa kujendelela sunga ko ku Lakumu, nawo wukadumiliziza mwikolongo lya Yoludani.
34 Baho kanyhi, mupaka wukapitucila ku lubavu lwa ku mwezi, sunga ko ku Azinoti-taboli, na ku wulawilila kuko, wukajendelela sunga Hukoke, wukawa kwitang'anila no mupaka wa Zabuloni ku lubavu lwa kutakama. Wukaza sunga ku yisi ya Asheli, ku lubavu lwa kumwezi, nayo Yoludani yikawa ku lubavu lwa kucilima.
35 Makaya ge magomawakali, gali aga, Zidimu, Zeli, na Hamati, Lakati, Cineleti,
36 Adama, Lama, Hazoli,
37 Kedeshi, Edeleyi, Ene-hazoli,
38 na Iloni, Migidaleli, Holema, Bete-anati, na Bete Shemeshi, makaya yikumi ne 'cenda, hamonga ne matumbi gono gali gagapilime.
39 Makaya ne matumbi gago gose, gali mu yisi yono we zimhuga zo wo mulango wa Nafutali wapegwa, wuwe wo wuhazi wawo.

Yisi yono yapegwa Dani

40 Ligawo lyo mupunghati lyono lyawagwa, lyali lya we zimhuga za wo mulango wa Dani.
41 Mupaka wayo wukahanguliza makaya aga: Zola, Ashitayoli, Ili-shemeshi,
42 Salabimu, Ayaloni, Itila
43 Eloni, Timina, Ekiloni,
44 Eleteke, Gibetoni na Balati,
45 Yehudi, Benebelake, Gatilimoni,
46 Mejakoni, na Lakoni, hamonga ne yisi yono yipilime Yopa.
47 Na lono wana wa Dani wali wayileka yisi yawo, wakabita ku Lishemu wakayihoma. Wakasuma no kuwawulaga wanhu wose wono wali wekaye mumo, wakayiteka yikawa yawo. Wakayitema, no kulikawaniza litagwa lye likaya lya Lishemu, wakalicemela Dani. Walicemela litagwa lyo sogo yawo Dani.
48 Makaya gaga ne matumbi gaga gose, gali gali mu yisi yono wo lulelo lwe zimhuga zo wo mulango wa Dani, wapegwa wuwe wo wuhazi wawo.

Wudumilize wo wugawe we yisi

49 Lono wanhu Waisilayeli, wali weza kukondya kugawana yisi, wakamugawila nayo Yoshuwa u mwana wa Nuni hanhu hanji, hawe hakwe.
50 Wakamupela Yoshuwa mwana wa Nuni likaya lyono yalisakaga, likaya lya Timunati Sela lya mwi'tunda lya Efulayimu, nha vyono Muwaha Mulungu yali yalajilize. Yakalizenga likaya, yakekala baho.

51 Mukohani Eleyezali, na Yoshuwa u mwana wa Nuni, hamonga ne walongola wose, we zimhuga za we milango yose ye Waisilayeli, vyo wayigawa yisi ku Shilo ha mulango we Lihema lyono Lyelile, mu nzila yo kutowa kula, hali Muwaha Mulungu. Na mu nzila yiyo, wakawa wakondya mulimo wuwo wo kuyigawa yisi.


Yoshuwa 20

Makaya go wutizizo

1 Hanyuma Muwaha Mulungu yakamulonjela Yoshuwa,
2 yawalonjele wana Waisilayeli yatye “Alu, muhagule makaya go wutizizo nha vyono namulajiliza Musa yamulonjelenyi.
3 Hono munhu wo wose mono komuwulaga muyagwe mhalanyuka, yasume kutiziza mumo, ho yeponye mu mawoko go munhu mono yakumulondola ho yamulipicize.
4 Ale yadahile kutiziza mwi'kaya limonga lya muli makaya gago, no kwima mwi'lango lye likaya, ha mwande ye wanyamhala, nayo kolavya nghani zono zamwijelela ha mwande ye wanyamhala. Nawo ho womukombola yenjile mwi'kaya wamupele ne hanhu ho kwikala, ho yasume kwikala mumo.
5 Na hono yu yulya munhu yamutyatye ho yamulipicize, wanhu wa mwi'kaya lilyo, walece kumukombola muwulaji kuli munhu yuyo. Langa yiwanojeye wamudime, hambi nha kawulaga mhalanyuka du, hamba si kwe 'kuwo yaye.
6 Kanyhi yajendelele kwikala mwi'kaya, sunga kolo yakuletwa hamwande ye wanhu wose, ho yaling'anizwe, sunga ku wufwe wo Mukohani Muwaha wa mu vilo vivyo. Hobaho munhu yuyo ho kokombolwa yawuye kanyhi kwawo kwi'tumbi lyakwe kono yatiza ha mwamulizo.”

7 Hobaho wakagawagula makaya go lubavu lwa kumwezi ya Yoludani. Wakagawagula makaya ga, Kedeshi ya ku Galilaya, mu yisi ye matunda ya Nafutali, na Shekemu mu yisi ye matunda ya Efulayimu, na Hebuloni mu yisi ye matunda ya Yuda.
8 Lubavu lwa kucilima lwa Yoludani mu nyika ya ku cilima ya ku Yeliko, wakagawagula makaya ga, Bezeli ya mu yisi ya Lubeni, na Lamoti ya mu Gileyadi, mu yisi ya Gadi, na Golani ya ku Bashani, mu yisi ya Manase.
9 Aga gali go makaya go wutizizo, gono gawagulwa ne wanhu wose Waisilayeli, na kuli wajenzi wose wono wali wekaye hamonga nawo. Ho munhu wo wose mono yamuwulaga muyagwe kwa mhalanyuka, yasume kutuga ha wutizizo kuli munhu mono yakumulondola kumulipiciza. Nayo yalece kuwulagwa, sunga kolo yakondya kwima calinze ha wuling'anizi.


Yoshuwa 21

Makaya ge Walawi

1 Ale, nawo i walongola we zimhuga ze Walawi, wakamubitila Eleyezali Mukohani, na Yoshuwa u mwana wa Nuni, na kuli walongola wose we zimhuga ze milango yose ye Waisilayeli.
2 Wakalongana nawo bahalya ha Shilo mu yisi ya Kanani wakawatya, “U Muwaha Mulungu yalajiliziza muli Musa, vyono, yicinojeye nase cipegwe makaya gono cowa kwikala, hamonga no wudimilo we mitugo zetu, behi ne makaya getu.”
3 Hobaho Waisilayeli, wakawapela Walawi makaya go wuhazi wawo ho wekale mumo. Wakawapela hamonga no wudimilo we mitugo zawo, wulawa mu yisi yawo, nha vyono Muwaha Mulungu yali yalajilize.

4 Ale baho, wo lulelo lwe Wakohati, wa mu mhuga ye Walawi, wali wo walongozi kupegwa makaya gawo. Nawo we zimhuga ze wana wa Haluni mukohani, wakapegwa makaya yikumi na madatu, gono galawa mu yisi ya Yuda, na ya Simiyoni na ya Benyamini.
5 Nawo wanji wono wali wakali wasigaye, wa mu mhuga ye Wakohati, nawo wakapegwa makaya yikumi, ga mu yisi yo wo mulango wa Efulayimu, na wa Dani, na ga we nusu ya Wamanase wo lubavu lwa kumwezi.

6 Nawo wana wa Gelishoni wakapegwa makaya yikumi na madatu, ga mu yisi yo wo mulango wa Isakali na ya Asheli, na ya Nafutali, na ya Wamanase wa ku lubavu lwa kucilima.

7 Nawo we zimhuga ze wana wa Melali, wakapegwa makaya yikumi na mejete ga mu yisi yo wo mulango wa Lubeni, na ya Gadi na ya Zabuloni.

8 Waisilayeli, wawagawila Walawi makaya gago, hamonga no wudimilo we mitugo zawo, mu nzila yo kutowa kula, nha vyono Muwaha Mulungu yali yalajilize muli Musa.

9 Aga go matagwa ge makaya, ga muli makaya ga mu yisi yo wo mulango wa Yuda, na wa Simiyoni, gono wapegwa,
10 i wana wa Haluni, wono wali wo we mhuga ye Wakohati, wono wali wo wana wa Lawi. Wali wo walongozi kupegwa ligawo lyawo.
11 Wakapegwa likaya lya Aleba (Aleba yali yo sogwe wa Anaki), ninga alu likucemwa Hebuloni, mu yisi ye matunda ya Yuda, hamonga ne mawimbi gono gayipilime go wudimilo we mitugo zawo.
12 Hamba nhavivyo i migunda ya mwi'kaya, hamonga ne matumbi gayo, vyali vyakondya kugawilwa Kalebi u mwana wa Yefune, wuwe wo wuhazi wakwe.

13 Nawo wana wa Haluni mukohani, wakapegwa likaya lya Hebuloni, (Hebuloni lyali limonga lya mu makaya go wutizizo) hamonga ne makaya gono gatyatizye: Libina,
14 Yatili, Eshitemowa,
15 Holoni, Debili
16 Ayini, Yuta, na Bete Shemeshi hamonga no wudimilo we mitugo zawo. Aga makaya yicenda, gali ga muli makaya ga mu yisi yo wo mulango wa Yuda na wa Simiyoni.
17 Wakawonjeleza kanyhi makaya mane, mu wulawa mu yisi yo wo mulango wa Benyamini, Gibeyoni, Geba, Anatoti na
18 Alimoni, hamonga no wudimilo.
19 Holeka gose hamonga, gakawa makaya yikumi na madatu, gono wapegwa wakohani i wana wa Haluni, hamonga no wudimilo we mitugo zawo.

20 Nawo wanji wa mu mhuga ye walawi i wana wa Kohati, wakapegwa makaya ganji gono gali gali mu yisi yono yali ya Efulayimu.
21 Wakapegwa makaya mane, nago goga: Shekemu, hamonga no wudimilo, mu yisi ye matunda ya Efulayimu, limonga lya muli makaya go wutizizo, hamonga na Gezeli,
22 na Kibizayimu na Bete Holoni, hamonga no wudimilo.
23 Kanyhi wakapegwa makaya mane mu wulawa mu yisi ya Dani, nago goga: Eleteke, na Gibetoni,
24 Ayaloni, na Gati limoni hamonga no wudimilo.
25 Na mu yisi ya Wamanase wo lubavu lwa kumwezi, nako wakapegwa makaya mejete. Tanaki na Gati-limoni hamonga no wudimilo.
26 Mhuga zizi ze wana wa Kohati, wakapegwa makaya yikumi, hamonga no wudimilo we mitugo zawo.

27 Mhuga yinji nayo ye Walawi ye wana wa Gelishoni, wapegwa makaya mejete, wulawa mu yisi ye wana wa Manase wa ku lubavu lwa kucilima, nago goga: Golani ya ku Bashani likaya lyo wutizizo, na Be-eshitela, hamonga no wudimilo we mitugo zawo.
28 Na mu wulawa mu yisi ya Isakali, nako wakapegwa makaya mane, nago goga: Cishiyoni, Dabelati,
29 na Yalemuti na Ene-ganimu, hamonga no wudimilo we mitugo zawo.
30 Na mu wulawa mu yisi ya Asheli, wakapegwa makaya mane, nago goga: Mishali, na Abidoni,
31 na Helekati na Lehobu, hamonga no wudimilo we mitugo zawo.
32 Na mu wulawa mu yisi ya Nafutali, wakapegwa makaya madatu, nago goga: Kedeshi ya ku Galilaya, likaya lyo wutizizo, hamonga no wudimilo, na Hamoti-doli, na Katani, hamonga no wudimilo wayo.
33 Mhuga zose hamonga za mu wana wa Gelishoni, zapegwa makaya yikumi na madatu, hamonga no wudimilo wayo.

34 Ne zimhuga ze Walawi zono zali zikali zisigaye ze wana wa Melali, nazo zikapegwa makaya mane mu wulawa mu yisi ya Zabuloni, nago goga: Yocineyamu, na Kalita,
35 na Dimina na Nahalali hamonga no wudimilo we mitugo zawo.
36 Mu wulawa mu yisi ya Lubeni, wakapegwa makaya mane, nago goga: Bezeli, na Yahazi,
37 Kedemoti, na Mefati, hamonga ne mawimbi gayo go wudimilo we mitugo zawo.
38 Na mu wulawa mu yisi ya Gadi, wakapegwa makaya mane, nago goga: Lamoti, ya mu Gileyadi likaya lyo wutizizo hamonga no wudimilo we mitugo zawo. Na Mahanayimu,
39 Heshiboni na Yazeli hamonga no wudimilo we mitugo zawo.
40 Ale, wose wa mu wana wa Melali, wapegwa makaya yikumi na mejete hamonga no wudimilo we mitugo zawo.

41 I Walawi wakapegwa makaya makumi mane na munana hamonga no wudimilo we mitugo zawo,
42 mu wulawa mu yisi yose yono Waisilayeli wali wapegwa nha wuhazi wawo.

Waisilayeli wakuyisola yisi no kuyitema

43 Nha vivyo, Muwaha Mulungu vyo yakawapela Waisilayeli yisi yose, yono yali yawelahiza i walezi wawo, vyono kowapela. Nawo waza kuwa wayisola no kuyitema, wakekala mumo.
44 U Muwaha Mulungu yakawapela mulamu mu yisi yiyilya yose, nha vyono yali yelahize kuli walezi wawo. Hakawa hasina mulugu wawo hamba monga, mono yasuma kuwogofya kanyhi. Hambi Muwaha Mulungu, nha yali yakondya kuwapela Waisilayeli wusume, kuli walugu wawo wose,
45 u Muwaha Mulungu yakawukamisa wihuwizo wakwe wose, wono yawehuwiza Waisilayeli, zose zikafisilizwa du nha vyono yehuwiza.


Yoshuwa 22

Yoshuwa yakuwagomola we milango yo lubavu lwa kucilima wawuye kwawo

1 Hobaho Yoshuwa yakawacemela hamonga we milango ya Lubeni, na Gadi, hamonga ne nusu yo wo mulango wa Manase wo lubavu lwa kucilima.
2 Yakawatya, “Mwakondya lu kwituma zose, zono Musa u mwitumami wo Muwaha Mulungu yamulajilizenyi mwitume, kanyhi mugakamisa ne malajilizo gangu gose.
3 Na mu vipango vivi vyose, hamba simwasuma kuwaleka wandugu zenyu Waisilayeli. Kanyhi mwali mwina no luzu luswanu, lo kugebata i malajilizo go Muwaha Mulungu, u Mulungu wenyu.
4 Alu Muwaha Mulungu wenyu yakondya kuwapela i wandugu zenyu Waisilayeli mulamu, nha vyono yawehuwiza. Alu muwuye kwenyu ku yisi yono mwayilomba mupegwe ho yiwe yenyu. I yisi yo lubavu lwa kucilima ye likolongo lya Yoludani, yono Musa u mwitumami wo Muwaha Mulungu yamupelenyi.
5 Ninga lu, mulanjilile, mwibatile lukulu lilajilizo lyono Musa yamulajilizenyi. Mumwendaje Muwaha Mulungu, u Mulungu wenyu, mwitume zo wuhile wakwe. Kanyhi mugebate ne malajilizo gakwe, mweze wehuwilwa kuli mwene, mumwitumamile kwe nhumbula yenyu yose, na kwe mitima yenyu yose.”
6 Hobaho Yoshuwa yakawalugutiza, kanyhi yakawatya, “Alu, mwaza kuwuya kwenyu akuno muli wagoli mwina ne mitugo minji, na fweza, na Zahabu, na Shaba ne cuma ne vivwalo vinji.
7 Holeka nhondo mugawane ne wandugu zenyu muli vyose vyono musolile ku wulawa kuli walugu wenyu.” Hobaho nawo wakawa kutuluka wakawa kubita kwawo.

Musa yali yakondya kuwapela yisi yo lubavu lwa kucilima ye likolongo lya Yoludani we nusu yo wo mulango wa Manase.
8 Ninga awalya wanji we nusu nzagwe, Yoshuwa yakawapela ku lubavu lwa kumwezi ya Yoludani, hamonga na we milango yinji.

9 Ale baho i wanhu wo mulango wa Lubeni na wa Gadi, ne we nusu yo wo mulango wa Manase, wo lubavu lwa kucilima ya Yoludani, wakawa kuwuya kwawo. Wakawaleka i wayawo, Waisilayeli, wono wasigala kuko ku Shilo, mu yisi ya Kanani. Wene wakawa kwinjila mu yisi yawo, yisi ya Gileyadi, yono wali wakondya kupegwa nha vyono Muwaha Mulungu yali yakondya kuwalajiliziza muli Musa.

I cikumbicilo behi na Yoludani

10 Lono we milango ya Lubeni, na Gadi na wa Manase wo lubavu lwa kucilima, wali weza kufika ha Geliloti, lono wali wakali kulubavu lwa kumwezi ya Yoludani, wakazenga cikumbicilo ciwaha muno ca kwilolela, baho behi ne likolongo.
11 I wayawo we milango yinji ye Waisilayeli, wakawa kulonga weneco wose wakutya, “Mulanje ta! Iwanhu we milango ya Lubeni, na Gadi, hamonga na we nusu yo wo mulango wa Manase wa ku lubavu lwa kucilima, wakondya kuzenga cikumbicilo, mu mupaka wa Kanani ha Geliloti, behi na Yoludani, kono lubavu lwetu!”
12 Ne Waisilayeli waza kuzihulika zizi, mhuga yose yikaza ha Shilo ho yikehome na we milango ya Lubeni na Gadi na we nusu yo wo mulango wa Manase wo lubavu lwa kucilima.

13 Hobaho Waisilayeli wakamutegula Finehasi u mwana wa Eleyezali u mukohani, kuli wanhu we milango ya Lubeni na Gadi, na Manase wo lubavu lwa kucilima ku yisi ya Gileyadi.
14 Finehasi yakabitana hamonga ne walongola wanji yikumi, wakawa monga monga ku wulawilila mu milango yose yo wo lubavu lwa kumwezi. Nawo wali wo walongola mu zimhuga na mu milango yawo.
15 Wakawa kubita ku yisi ya Gileyadi, kuli wanhu we milango ya Lubeni, na Gadi na ye wana wa Manase wa ku lubavu lwa kucilima.
16 Wakawa kuwalonjela wakutya, “Mhuga yose ye Waisilayeli, wakumuwuzenyi wakutya, socici mwetuma yisutya lyono linha lili, kuli Mulungu wa Isilayeli? Hambi nha mwamubeza Muwaha Mulungu so wizenjela nyo weneco cikumbicilo! Alu mwamugaluka!
17 Ninga mukumbucile wubi wono cetuma ku Peyoli, lono Muwaha Mulungu yakacilipiciza co wanhu wakwe ne lihuhuji, lyono lyacimala muno. Sunga nalu cikali hamba si neyeza no wubi wuwo. Wule, lisutya lililya silyakwila yaye?
18 Alu kanyhi mwagaluka no kulema kumutyatya? Na hono mumuleme Muwaha Mulungu zuwalili, u mwene nayo i mitondo, kowakolelwa yikuwo yiwaha muno wanhu wose wa Isilayeli.
19 Holeka lu, hono mukuwona vyono yisi yenyu siyikwiliye kuwuhembela mumo, ale, muze ku yisi yo Muwaha Mulungu, kono kolili Lihema lyakwe lyono Lyelile, mucilombe hanhu. Ninga mulece kumugaluka Muwaha Mulungu, hamba kucigaluka na sese, so wizenjela nyenye nyo weneco cikumbicilo cinji, sinha cikumbicilo co Muwaha Mulungu, u Mulungu wetu.
20 Kanyhi mukumbucile za Akani u mwana wa Zela, lono yalema kutyatya lilajilizo lya kuli vinhu vyo mwiko. Ne mhuga yose ya Isilayeli yikalipicizwa so lisutya lyakwe. Kanyhi Akani hamba si yafwa yali wene so lisutya lyakwe.”

21 Baho i wanhu wo mulango wa Lubeni, na wa Gadi, na wa Wamanase, wo lubavu lwa kucilima, wakawapitula i walongola wa mu zimhuga we milango ya ku lubavu lwa kumwezi wakawatya,
22 “Mono yali vilungo, yumonga du, nayo yo Mulungu! Umwene yo Muwaha Mulungu mono yali vilungo yumonga du, nayo yo Mulungu! Umwene yo Muwaha Mulungu. Kanyhi mwene yo yamanyile cono caleka ase ciketuma zizi, nalu cikusaka nanye ho mumanye zizi! Hono yiwe mbeka cagaluka, no kuwusa wihuwilo hali Muwaha Mulungu, ale mulece kucileka cijendelele kuwumipa kanyhi!
23 Na hono mbeka ciwe camubedegala Muwaha Mulungu, sunga cazenga ne cikumbicilo cetu co weneco, ho cisume kulavizya vilavywa vinyanywe, hamba kucitumamila so vilavywa vyo wusaje, na lunji vilavywa vyo mulamu, ale, mulece u Muwaha Mulungu mweneco yo yacilipicize.
24 Ninga alu vyo si nhavivyo yaye. Langa ase cizinoza zizi, hambi nha cikogopa vyono mu vilo vyono vikuza, i wana wenyu, wolowawuza i wana wetu wawe kutya, ‘Mwina cinhu ci nanye kuli Muwaha Mulungu, u Mulungu wa Isilayeli?
25 Hambi mwene nha yo yacinozeza Yoludani, wuwe wo mupaka hagati yetu na nyenye, anye nyo wo lulelo lwa Lubeni na lwa Gadi. Holeka musina yigawo lyo lyose hali Muwaha Mulungu.’ Na ku soko yiyo, holeka i wana wenyu, wali wawalemeze i wana wetu, walece kumuhemba Muwaha Mulungu.
26 Holeka cazenga cikumbicilo cici. Si vyono cali kusaka ho cilavizye vilavywa vinyanywe.
27 Langa ase canoza nhavivyo, ho wuwe wuhomelezi hagati ye wanhu wetu ne wanhu wenyu. Hamonga ne zindelo zono zokuza. Nha vyono mbeka, cikuwa kumuhemba Muwaha Mulungu, he 'Hema lyakwe lyono Lyelile, hamonga ne vilavywa vyetu vinyanywe, hamonga ne malumbo ne vilavywa vyo mulamu. Ayi cayituma du ho yiwalajile i wana wenyu wamanye, ho walece kuwalonga i wana wetu wawe kuwatya wasina cono wetuma hali Muwaha Mulungu.
28 Lihweso lyetu, lyali kulajila du, hono zizi zize zijele, i wana wetu walalonga wawe kutya, ‘Alu mulanje ta! I walezi wetu wazenga cikumbicilo cono cihwanile ne cikumbicilo co Muwaha Mulungu. Ninga si cali ca kulavizya vilavywa vinyanywe, hamba makumbiko ganji, langa cali so wuhomelezi kuli wanhu wetu na kuli wanhu wenyu.’
29 Ase, hamba si cosumila lukulu kumubedegala Muwaha Mulungu, hamba kuleka kumwitumamila, ho cizenje cikumbicilo, ciwe kulavizya vilavywa vinyanywe mumo, hamba vilavywa vyo wusaje, hamba makumbiko. Ase si cali cisume kuzenga cikumbicilo cinji, no kucileka cikumbicilo co Muwaha Mulungu, u Mulungu wetu, cono cili he 'Hema lyakwe.”

30 Ale baho, Finehasi u mukohani hamonga ne walongola walya yikumi we mhuga ya Isilayeli, wono wali we zimhuga zo lubavu lwa kumwezi, wose wakawa wahulicize vyono walongaga wanhu we milango ya Lubeni na ya Gadi na ye Wamanase wa ku lubavu lwa kucilima, nawo wakeguta zose zono walonga.
31 Baho nayo Finehasi u mwana wo Mukohani Eleyezali yakawapitula yakawatya, “Alu, mbeka camanya vyono Muwaha Mulungu yali hamonga nase. Hamba si mumusutizye Muwaha Mulungu so wituma zizi. Holeka lu, mwakondya kuwaponya i Waisilayeli mu wulipicizwe wo Muwaha Mulungu.”

32 Hobaho Finehasi hamonga ne walongola wakwe, wakawa kuwaleka wanhu we milango ya Lubeni, na ya Gadi mu yisi ya Gileyadi, wene wakawa kuwuya ku Kanani, kuli wanhu wa Isilayeli, wakawa kuwaloloseza zose.
33 Nawo wanhu wa Isilayeli wakeguta zose zono walolosezwa, wakamukumya, u Muwaha Mulungu. Hodu, siwazilonga kanyhi zo kubita kwihoma nawo, no kuyiteka yisi yono wali wekaye we milango ya Lubeni na ya Gadi na ya Wamanase wo lubavu lwa kucilima.

34 Nawo i wana wa Lubeni na wa Gadi, wakawa kutya, “I cikumbicilo cici, wo wuhomelezi wuwaha muli sese wose, nha vyono u Muwaha Mulungu, yo Mulungu.” Holeka wakacicemela litagwa lyaco Ede, (nhunizo yayo, “Wuhomelezi.”)


Yoshuwa 23

Zinghani za Yoshuwa zo wilaje wakwe

1 Vilo vinji vikapuluta, vyono Muwaha Mulungu yali yawapelile Isilayeli wucehe no mulamu, kuli walugu wawo wono wali wawapilime. Na mu vilo vivyo, Yoshuwa yali yakombipa muno muno.
2 Baho Yoshuwa yakawakonghola Waisilayeli wose, i wawaha wawo, hamonga ne walongola, ne wahakimu, hamonga na wose wono wena wulajilize muli wanhu, yakawatya, “Alu ane nakombipa muno muno.
3 Nanye mwakondya kuziwona zose zono Muwaha Mulungu, u Mulungu wenyu, yawatendela i makungugo gaga gose ku soko yenyu. Hambi u Muwaha Mulungu, u Mulungu wenyu, nha yo yamulewelenyi 'nye.
4 Nane nakondya kumugawilenyi yisi mu milango yenyu wose, yisi yono ne zinghungugo zinji zikali zikaye mumo, hamonga ne yisi ye zinghungugo zose zono nakondya kuzisuma. Ku wulawilila kwi 'kolongo lya Yoludani kulubavu lwa kucilima, sunga ko kwi'lenga lya Meditelaneya, lubavu lwa kumwezi.
5 U Muwaha Mulungu, u Mulungu wenyu, kowalavyaniza kwe vilungo hali 'nye, kanyhi kowawinga ha mwande yenyu mu nghango ya vyono mowa kucila kwinjila, no kuyitema yisi yawo. Nanye moyisola yisi yawo nha vyono Muwaha Mulungu wenyu yamwihuwizenyi.
6 Holeka mulanjilile, mwitume zose zono zandicigwe mu citabu co Wulajilize wa Musa. Mulece kuyileka nghani hamba monga.
7 Kanyhi mulece kuhangahanga ne makungugo ge wanhu wono wasigaye mumo, hamba mulece kutambula ne matagwa ge milungu yawo, hamba kwilahiziza mu matagwa gago, hamba kuyihemba milungu yiyo, hamba kuyifugamila.
8 Langa 'nye mweze wehuwilwa kuli Muwaha Mulungu, u Mulungu wenyu, nha vyono muli wehuwilwa sunga nalulu.
9 Na munghango yono mukacila kwinjila mu yisi, nayo Muwaha Mulungu vyo yakacila kugawinga ku mwande yenyu, makungugo mawaha, kanyhi gono gali vilungo, hamba hasina yunji kanyhi mono yasuma kwima hamwande yenyu.
10 No munhu yumonga wa muli nyenye, kosuma kuwawinga wanhu elufu monga. Hambi Muwaha Mulungu, u Mulungu wenyu, nha yo yakumulewelenyi, nha vyono yehuwiza.
11 Holeka mwilanjililaje, nanye mumwende Muwaha Mulungu, u Mulungu wenyu.
12 Langa hono muwuye ne nyuma, no kwilunza ne zinghungugo zono zikali zisigaye muli'nye, no kwanza kwitolanila nazo,
13 ale, mumanye manyimanyi vyono, u Muwaha Mulungu, u Mulungu wenyu, sikoziwinga kanyhi zinghungugo zizi, hamba muwe mukwinjila mu'si yawo. Langa wowa mbali hali'nye, hambi nha wowa nha mutego kuli'nye, hamba kotya yikombo. Kanyhi wowa nha mukotya, wukukuna mu migongo yenyu, hamba mamiya gono gakucinya mu meso genyu. Na zizi sizoduma, sunga kolo anye wose mwakondya kwajililila lukulu, mweza muli musina mu yisi yiyino swanu, yono Muwaha Mulungu, u Mulungu wenyu, yamupelenyi.

14 “Lanjenyi ta, alu lipango lyangu lyo kufwa lyafika. Nanye mumanyile wose mu mitima na mu myuhe yenyu, vyono hasina cinhu cinji co cose, ce ziswanu zose, zono yehuwiza Muwaha Mulungu, u Mulungu wenyu, cono cicepuce. Wihuwizo wakwe wose nha waficilicila. Hasina hamba nghani yono yicepuce.
15 Holeka nha vyono mwene u Muwaha Mulungu, u Mulungu wenyu, yasuma kuwukamisa wihuwizo wakwe wono yamwihuwizenyi, nhavivyo kanyhi vyo komufisilizizenyi izimbi zose.
16 Hono mulece kukamisa cilagane cono u Muwaha Mulungu, u Mulungu wenyu, yamulajilizenyi mucikamise. Na hono muyitumamile no kuyihemba milungu yinji, komulipicizizenyi mwi'kuwo lyakwe, nanye wose mokwajilila mbela ku wulawa mu yisi yiyi swanu, yono Muwaha Mulungu yamupelenyi.”


Yoshuwa 24

Yoshuwa yakulonga ne wanhu ha Shekemu

1 Ale, Yoshuwa yakawakonghola hamonga we milango yose ye Waisilayeli ha Shekemu. Yakawacema wanyamhala, hamonga ne walongola ne wahakimu, hamonga na wono wena wulajilize muli Waisilayeli. Wose wakawa kuza hali Muwaha Mulungu.
2 Nayo Yoshuwa yakawalonjela wanhu wose yakawatya, “Azi zo yakulonga Muwaha Mulungu, u Mulungu we Waisilayeli, yakutya, ‘Ikatali walezi wenyu wekalaga ku nhumbi nzagwe ye likolongo lya Efulata. Nawo wahembaga milungu yinji. No yumonga wa muli wawo walezi yo Tela, ne wanagwe we cilume, Abulahamu na Naholi.
3 Baho, nghamusola Abulahamu, u mulezi wenyu, ku wulawilila ku yisi ya ku nhumbi ya Efulata, nghamujendya mu yisi yose ya Kanani. Nghamupela wana wenji. Nghamupela Isaka,
4 na muli Isaka, nghamupela Yakobo na Esawu. Nghamugawila Esawu yisi ya mu matunda ya Edomu, ho wuwe wuhazi wakwe, ninga u mulezi wenyu Yakobo hamonga ne wanagwe, wakabita ku Misili.
5 Hanyuma nghamutuma Musa na Haluni, nghayiletela Misili magazo menji. Ninga 'nye nghamuwusenyi.
6 Nghawawusa ne walezi wenyu ku Misili, nawo Wamisili wakawatyatya wena ne matuka go wulugu, ne wapanda zifwalasi. Ninga lono walezi wenyu wali wafika he 'lenga lya Shamu,
7 wakalomba wutazi kuli'ne, ho niwataze. Nane nghawika citi hagati yawo ne Wamisili. Nghalinoza lilenga likahuluma mucanyha ye Wamisili, likawagubiza no kuwakapiza. Nanye mumanyile, kanyhi mwaziwona zizi zono netuma ku Misili. Mukekala mu nyika vilo vinji.
8 Hanyuma nghamuletenyi sunga mu yisi ye Waamoli, wono wekalaga ku lubavu lwa kucilima ya Yoludani. Wakamuhomenyi, ninga nghamupelenyi wusume, mukawasuma. Na mu nghango vyono mwacilaga kwinjila, vyo mwajendelelaga kuyisola yisi yawo. Nane nghawongomezeza mu miwoko yenyu.
9 Nayo Balaki u mwana wa Zipola, u mutemi wa Mowabu, yakehoma nanye, yakategula nghani kuli Balamu u mwana wa Beyoli ho yaze yamulijitenyi 'nye.
10 Ninga 'ne sinamuhuliciza Balamu, Balamu yakamulugutizenyi. Na mu nzila yiyo, nghamuponyenyi mu miwoko ya Balaki.
11 Mukalowoka Yoludani, mukafika ku Yeliko. Wanhu wa Yeliko, wakehoma nanye, nha vyono wanoza Waamoli, ne Wapelizi, ne Wakanani, ne Wahiti, ne Wagiligashi, ne Wahivi, ne Wayebusi. Ninga ane nghamupelenyi wusume muli wawa wose.
12 Na mu nghango vyono mwacilaga kwinjila, nane nghatuma manyugwi, ho gakawawinga i watemi awalya wejete we Waamoli. Ivitwalo vyenyu vye mimaje, no wupinde wenyu, hamba si mwavitumamila mulimo wo wose.

13 “ ‘Nghamupenyi 'nye yisi yono si mwali muyilimile, ne makaya gono simwazenga nyenye. Nalu, mo mwikaye mumo, mukulya zabibu zono si mwazihadika, hamonga ne Mizeyituni yono si mwayihadika.’
14 Ale, Yoshuwa yakajendelela kuwalonjela yakutya, ‘Mumogopaje Muwaha Mulungu, kanyhi mumwitumamilaje kwe cogopo na ko wihuwilwa. Muwusize lukulu milungu yose, yono wayihembaga i walezi wenyu ku Mesopotamiya na ku Misili. Langa mumwitumamilaje Muwaha Mulungu du yali wene.
15 Na hono muwe si mukusaka kumwitumamila Muwaha Mulungu, ale muhagule zuwalili, mono momwitumamila. Hamba moyitumamila i milungu yono walezi wenyu wayihembaga ku Mesopotamiya, hamba milungu ye Waamoli wono na mu yisi yawo mo mwikaye. Langa ane na wa mu nyumba yangu, comwitumamila Muwaha Mulungu.’ ”

16 Nawo wanhu wakamupitula wakatya, “Ase si colecela lukulu kumwitumamila Muwaha Mulungu, ho ciyitumamile milungu yinji!
17 U Muwaha Mulungu, u Mulungu wetu, nha yo yawawusa i walezi wetu na sese mu wuwanda ku Misili, kanyhi cikagawona ne mezino gono yalajila ku Misili. Kanyhi yakacikamisa ko kose kono cakolelaga mu makungugo.
18 Na mu nghango vyono cenjilaga mu yisi ayi, u Muwaha Mulungu, nayo vyo yawawingaga Waamoli wono wekalaga mumu. Holeka nase nhavivyo, comwitumamila Muwaha Mulungu, hambi nha yo Mulungu wetu.”

19 Yoshuwa yakawalonjela wanhu yakawatya, “Ninga simosuma kumwitumamila Muwaha Mulungu. Hambi mwene nha yo Mulungu mono yelile, kanyhi yo Mulungu wo wivu, holeka sikosuma kumunenelenyi masutya genyu, hamonga no wubi wenyu.
20 Hono mumulece no kuhemba milungu mijenzi, nayo kopituka yamulipicizenyi, kanyhi komongomezenyi, hamba yiwe ha mwamulizo yamunozezenyi ziswanu.”

21 I wanhu wakamulonjela Yoshuwa wakamutya. “Ng'o ye, ase comwitumamila Muwaha Mulungu du.”

22 Yoshuwa yakawatya, “Nyenye nyo weneco, mweza wahomelezi, mukwihomelela nyo weneco, vyono mwahagula kumwitumamila Muwaha Mulungu.”

Nawo wakatya, “Heya cikwihomelela.”
23 Nayo Yoshuwa yakawatya, “Ale, lu, wusenyi milungu mijenzi yono yili muli'nye, mumupele cogopo Muwaha Mulungu, u Mulungu we Waisilayeli.”

24 Baho i wanhu nawo wakamutya Yoshuwa, “Ase comwitumamila no kumuhulika u Muwaha Mulungu wetu.”

25 Hobaho Yoshuwa yakanoza cilagane ne wanhu mwi'zuwa lilyo baho ha Shekemu. Yakawapela malajilizo no wulajilize wavityatye.
26 Yoshuwa yakagandika i malajilizo mu citabu co wulajilize co Mulungu. Yakasola ne libwe yiwaha, yakalisimya behi no mubici wo munghola, wono wali wuli behi na hono helile ho Muwaha Mulungu.
27 Yakawalonjela wanhu wose yakawatya, “Libwe alino, lyolowa wo wuhomelezi wetu. Lizihulika zose zono Muwaha Mulungu yali kuzilonga kuli'se. Holeka lu, lyolowa wo wuhomelezi hali'nye, ho muze mulece kumukana Mulungu wenyu.”
28 Hobaho Yoshuwa yakawakombola wanhu wose, wakatuluka, wakawa kubita munhu na kwakwe mu zi'si zawo.

Lifwa lya Yoshuwa na Eleyezali

29 Hobaho zizi zaza kuwa zakondya kwitumwa, Yoshuwa mwana wa Nuni, mwitumami wo Muwaha Mulungu, yakafwa, yali yaficile myaka yigana limonga ne 'kumi.
30 Wakamuzika mu yisi yo wuhazi wakwe, ku Timunati Sela mu yisi ye matunda ya Efulayimu, ku lubavu lwa kusumuka ye litunda lya Gayashi.

31 Waisilayeli, wali wajendeleye kumwitumamila Muwaha Mulungu vilo vyose vyo wikale wa Yoshuwa, sunga na lono Yoshuwa yali yakondya kufwa, wene wali wajendeleye kwituma nhavivyo sunga na mu vilo, lono wali wakali womi, i wanyamhala, wono waziwona weneco, zose zono Muwaha Mulungu yetuma kuli Waisilayeli.

32 Ne mafupa go muwili wa Yusufu, gono Waisilayeli wagaleta ku wulawa ku Misili, wakagazika baho ha Shekemu, i hanhu hono Yakobo yali yahagulile, ku wana wa Hamoli, u sogwe wa Shekemu. Yahagula fweza yigana limonga, baho hakawa wo wuhazi we wana wa Yusufu.

33 Nayo Eleyezali u mwana wa Haluni yakafwa, yakazikwa ku Gibeya, mwi'tumbi lya mu yisi ye matunda ya Efulayimu, yono yali yagawilwa u mwanagwe Finehasi.


Walamuzi 1

Wo mulango wa Yuda na wa Simiyoni, wakumwibata Adonibezeke

1 Ale lono Yoshuwa yali yafwiza, wanhu wa Isilayeli wakamuwuza Muwaha Mulungu wakatya, “U mulangoci wa muli milango yetu, wono wolongolela ho vikehome ne Wakanani?”
2 U Muwaha Mulungu yakawapitula yakatya “Wo mulango wa Yuda wo wolongolela, hambi nha nakondya kuyiwika yisi mu miwoko yawo.”

3 Nawo wo mulango wa Yuda wakawalonjela wo mulango wa Simiyoni wandugu zawo wakawatya “Ale, cibitane hamonga na nyenye sunga ko ku yisi yono yakondya kuwagwa so sese ho cikehome ne Wakanani, hanyuma ho cobitana nanye ku yisi yono yowagwa so nyenye.”
4 Hobaho wo mulango wa Yuda na wa Simiyoni wakatulukana hamonga sunga ku wulugu. Muwaha Mulungu yakawapela wusume kuli Wakanani ne Wapelizi wakawahoma wanhu we cilume, waficile elufu yikumi, kuko ku Bezeke.
5 Wakamwagana kuko Adonibezeke wakehoma nayo, wakawahoma Wakanani ne Wapelizi no kuwawinga.
6 Adonibezeke yakatiza ninga wakamwibata wakawa kumudumula madole kululu, ga mu mawoko na ga mu magulu.
7 Adonibezeke yakatya, “Watemi makumi mupunghati wono madole kululu gawo ga mu mawoko na ga mu magulu gali madumulwe, watondolaga ndigwa hasi ye meza yangu. Alu Mulungu yanhendela nane nha vyono nawatendela wene.” Nawo wakamutegula ku Yelusalemi yakafwila kuko.

Wo mulango wa Yuda vikuyihoma na Yelusalemi na Hebuloni no kuzisuma.

8 Hobaho i wanhu we cilume wa Yuda wakayihoma Yelusalemi wakayiteka. Wakawawulaga wanhu wose no kulipembela likaya no moto.
9 Waza kukondya zizi, wakatuluka kwihoma ne Wakanani wono wekalaga mu yisi ye matunda na wa mu mwalambalo na wa mu yisi nghavu yo lubavu lwa kutakama.
10 Hanyuma, wakatuluka kanyhi wakawabitila Wakanani wono wekalaga mwi 'kaya lya Hebuloni lyono katali lyacemwaga Kiliyati-aleba. Wakazihoma zimhuga zose za Sheshayi na Ahimani na Talimayi.

Otiniyeli yakulisumiza likaya lya Debili

(Yos 15:13-19)

11 Na ku wulawilila kuko wanhu we cilume wo mulango wa Yuda wakawabitila wono wekalaga mwi'kaya lya Debili lyono lu lulya lyacemwaga Ciliyati-sefeli.
12 Baho, yunji wa muli wene mono yacemwaga Kalebi, yakatya, “Mono koyihoma no kuyisuma Ciliyati-sefeli, nomupela mwanangu we cicekulu Akisa, yawe mugolece wakwe.”
13 Nayo Otiniyeli u mwana wa Kenazi u mwanakwawe wa Kalebi, yakalihoma likaya yakaliteka. Hobaho Kalebi yakamupela Otiniyeli u mwanagwe we cicekulu Akisa ho wetole nayo.
14 Kukawa mwi'zuwa lye Halusi Otiniyeli yakamufunda Akisa ho yalombe mugunda ko sogwe. Baho Akisa, yakatima mu ndogowe yakwe Kalebi yakamuwuza Akisa cono yasakaga.
15 Akisa yakamupitula sogwe yakatya, “Nghulomba baba, wumhele wulugutwe, kanyhi no mugunda wa mu mivwilo, hambi yisi yono wamhela nha nghavu muno.” Hobaho Kalebi yakamupela Akisa mugunda wa mu mivwilo ya hacanyha na ya hasi.

Wusume wa wo mulango wa Yuda na wa Benyamini

16 I wana wa Mukeni u mukwewe wa Musa, wakabitana hamonga ne wana wa Yuda, wakulawilila Yeliko likaya lye mitende minji, sunga ko ku nyika yo lubavu lwa kutakama lwa Aradi ya ku Yuda. Kuko wakekalana ne Waamaleki.
17 Wana wa Yuda vyabitana hamonga ne wana wa Simiyoni, wakawahoma no kuwasuma Wakanani wono wekalaga mwi'kaya lya Zefati. Wakalilijita likaya no kulyongomeza wakalicemela litagwa, lya Holema.
18 Muwaha Mulungu yakawataza wo mulango wa Yuda wakayisola yisi ye matunda yikawa yawo. Wakayiteka Gaza ne mipaka yayo na Ashikeloni, ne mipaka yayo, na Ekiloni, ne mipaka yayo hamonga ne ma'si gono gali gapilime.
19 Ninga si wasuma kuwawinga i wanhu wono wekalaga mwi'lolo, hambi i wanhu wawo, nha wali wena matuka ga cuma go wulugu.
20 Nayo yisi ya Hebuloni, yakapegwa Kalebi mono yawawinga awalya we milango midatu ye zindelo za Anaki, nha vyono Musa yali yalajilize.
21 Nawo wana wa Benyamini siwawawinga i Wayebusi wono wekalaga ha Yelusalemi. Sunga na lulu i Wayebusi wajendeleye kwikalana hamonga ne wana wa Benyamini.

Wo mulango wa Efulayimu na wa Manase wakuyihoma Beteli

22 Wo mulango wa Efulayimu na wa Manase, wakatuluka kuyihoma Beteli, lu lulya wayicemaga Luzu.
23 Muwaha Mulungu yakawa hamonga nawo, wakategula watandizi kwi 'kaya.
24 Wakamuwona munhu wa cilume mono yalawililaga mwi'kaya, wakamuwuza wakatya, “Wucilajilaje nzila yo kwinjilila mwi'kaya, nase si cokutendela vibi yaye.”
25 Hobaho yakawalajila, nawo wo mulango wa Efulayimu na wa Manase wakawawulaga wose wono wekalaga mwi'kaya. Langa munhu yu yulya, hamonga ne mhuga yakwe si wawawulaga yaye.
26 U munhu yuyo yakabita sunga ko ku yisi ye Wahiti, kuko, yakazenga likaya yakalicemela litagwa lya Luzu. Lyono sunga nalu likali likucemwa Luzu.

I wanhu wono si wawingwa ne Waisilayeli mu'si

27 Wo mulango wa Manase si wawawinga i wanhu wono wekalaga mu makaya ga Bete-shani, Tanaki, Doli, Ibeleyamu, na Megido, hamonga ne vitumbi vyono vyali vili behi behi nawo. Wakanani wakajendelela kwikala mumo.
28 Na lono Waisilayeli wali wakondya kwinjipa no kutuga vilungo vyo wusume, wakawetumya Wakanani milimo yawo kwe vilungo. Ninga siwawawinga wose yaye.

29 Nawo wo mulango wa ya Efulayimu si wawawinga Wakanani wono wekalaga mwi'kaya lya Gezeli. Holeka wakajendelela kwikalana nawo du.

30 Nawo wo mulango wa Zabuloni hamba si wawawinga wakanani wono wekalaga mu makaya ga Kitiloni na Nahalole. Langa wakajendelela kwikalana nawo du ninga wawetumyaga mu milimo yawo kwe vilungo.

31 Wo mulango wa Asheli si wawawinga yaye i wanhu wono wekalaga mu makaya ga Ako, Sidoni, Alihabu, Acizibu, Heliba, Afeka na Lehobu.
32 Wo mulango wa Asheli wakajendelela kwikalana na wanyawusi Wakanani vyono nawo si wawawinga yaye.

33 Nawo wo mulango wa Nafutali si wawawinga i wanhu wono wekalaga mu makaya ga Bete-shemeshi na Bete-anati. Langa wekalanaga ne wanyawusi Wakanani. Ninga wawetumyaga milimo yawo kwe vilungo.

34 Waamoli langa, wakawawinga i wana wa Dani wakabita ku yisi ye matunda, hamba siwawakombola kanyhi ho wenjile mu yisi yo wuhihi yaye.
35 Waamoli wakajendelela kwikala mwi'tunda lya Helesi na Ayaloni, na mu Shalibimu. Ninga wo mulango wa Efulayimu (Yusufu) na wa Manase, wawasuma, kanyhi wawatumyaga mu milimo yawo kwe vilungo.

36 No mupaka we Waamoli wali wukolile mu Acilabimu, ku wulawilila ku Sela sunga ko kucanyha yayo.


Walamuzi 2

Malayika wo Muwaha Mulungu ha Bocimu

1 Lulo Malayika wo Muwaha Mulungu, yakalawilila ku Giligali yakabita ku Bocimu, yakawalonjela Waisilayeli yakawatya, “Lono namuwusenyi ku yisi ya Misili no kumuletenyi sunga ku yisi yono nawelahila i walezi wenyu. Natya, sinolobena cilagane cangu na nyenye.
2 Holeka mulece kunoza cilagane co cose ne wekazi wa mu yisi yiyi. Yinojeye muvimwagulanje vikumbicilo vyawo. Ninga mukali netuma nha vyono namulajiizenyi mwitume. Langa muketuma nha vyono mwasakaga nyenye nyo weneco!
3 Alu nghumulonjelenyi vyono nane hamba si nowawinjila lukulu wanhu wawa, lono anye mukwinjila mu yisi yawo, nawo wowa walugu wenyu nanye mogwizwa no wuhembi we milungu yawo.”

4 Na lono Malayika yali yeza kukondya kulonga zizi, wanhu wose wa Isilayeli wakanza kulila,
5 na yo soko yono yaleka hanhu bahalya hakacemelwa Bocimu. Nawo wakamulavizya kuko Muwaha Mulungu makumbiko.

U wufwe wa Yoshuwa

6 Ale baho Yoshuwa yakawa kuwelaga wanhu wa Isilayeli yakawaleka wabite wakekale mu zi'si zawo, ho waziteme ziwe zawo.
7 Wanhu wa Isilayeli wakajendelela kumwitumamila Muwaha Mulungu mu vilo vyose vyono Yoshuwa yali yakali mumi. Na mu vilo vyose vye wanyamhala wono wali wakali womi, lono Yoshuwa yali yakondya kufwa. Hambi wene nha wali wakondya kuziwona zimbaha, zono u Muwaha Mulungu yetuma kuli Isilayeli.
8 Yoshuwa u mwana wa Nuni u mwitumami wo Muwaha Mulungu, yakafwa yali yaficila myaka yigana limonga ne 'kumi.
9 Baho yakazikwa mu yisi ye ligawo lyakwe, lyono yali yapegwa mu yisi ya Timunali-helezi, mu yisi ye matunda ya Efulayimu, ku lubavu lwa kusumuka ye litunda lya Gayashi.
10 Lulelo lwawo lukawa lwafwiza. Nalo lulelo lono lwawatyatya, lukamusemwa Muwaha Mulungu, na zose zono Mulungu yawatendela wanhu wa Isilayeli.

Waisilayeli waleka kumuhemba Muwaha Mulungu

11 Hobaho i wanhu wa Isilayeli waketuma wubi hali Muwaha Mulungu, wakanza kanyhi kuyihemba Milungu ya Mabaali.
12 Wakaleka kumwitumamila Muwaha Mulungu, u Mulungu we walezi wawo, u Mulungu mono yakawawusa ku yisi ya Misili, wene wakanza kuyihemba milungu yinji, i milungu ye wanhu wono wali wawapilime. Wakayifugamila milungu yiyo, wakamunoza Muwaha Mulungu yawakolelwe yikuwo muno.
13 Wakaleka kumuhemba Muwaha Mulungu wakamwitumamila mulungu Baali na Ashitaloti.
14 Hobaho Muwaha Mulungu yakawakolelwa likuwo Waisilayeli no kuwatajila mu miwoko ye walugu wawo, ho wawahome, no kuwahiziza vinhu vyawo. Yakawapela vilungo i walugu wawo, nawo Waisilayeli wakawula vilungo vyo kwitaziza ho wawasume walugu wawo.
15 Na ko kose kono wabitaga so wihomi ne walugu wawo, Muwaha Mulungu yawalekaga hamba kuwataza yaye, nha vyono yali yakondya kuwalonjela nha vyono yali yelahiza. Holeka wakagazika muno.
16 Hobaho Muwaha Mulungu yakawapela kanyhi Waisilayeli, walongola wono wakawataza ho wawasume walugu wawo.
17 Ninga hamba nhavivyo Waisilayeli siwasuma kuwahulika walongola wawa. Waisilayeli wakaleka wihuwilo wa kuli Muwaha Mulungu, wakajendelela du kuyihemba milungu yinji. Langa i wa kuku zawo, wali wagebate malajilizo go Muwaha Mulungu. Ninga u lulelo alu lwe kejete, wakagaleka musunho i malajilizo go Muwaha Mulungu.
18 Mu vilo vyono Muwaha Mulungu yawapelaga Waisilayeli mulongola, Muwaha Mulungu yamupelaga wutazi wuwaha, yuyo mulongola, hamonga no kuwaponya wanhu kuli walugu wawo, mu vilo vyose vyo wikale wo mulongola yuyo. Kanyhi Muwaha Mulungu yawawonelaga lusungu ko soko ye mawine gawo, na so wutamiswe wawo hamonga no wiwonelwe wawo.
19 Ninga lono mulongola yakufwa du, hodu nawo walekaga kumwitumamila Muwaha Mulungu no kuziwuyila kanyhi zinzila ze katali. No kwituma u wubi wono walajila mu vipango vivyo, vyono wali wucizize muno kuciza na wo lulelo lono lupulute. Wayihembaga no kuyitumamila milungu yinji. Wakajendelela du ne metumo gawo mabi.
20 Hobaho u Muwaha Mulungu nayo, yakawa kuwakolelwa likuwo Waisilayeli, no kuwatya. “Likungugo lili lyakondya kucibena cilagane cono nawalajiliza i walezi wawo wacibate. Hambi nha si wakuhulika 'ne yaye.
21 Holeka nane sinosuma kuziwinga zinghungugo zinji zono zali zikaye mu yisi lono Yoshuwa yafwila.
22 Nozitumamila zinghungugo zizo, ho mbone hono Waisilayeli mbeka wozityatya zinzila zangu, nha vyono i walezi wawo watendaga hamba ng'o.”
23 Holeka Muwaha Mulungu yakazileka zinghungugo zizo mumo mu'si. Kanyhi hamba siyamupela na Yoshuwa wusume muli zene, hamba siyaziwinga yaye na lono Yoshuwa yali yakondya kufwa.


Walamuzi 3

Makungugo gono gasigala mu yisi

1 Hobaho Muwaha Mulungu yakazisigaza nghungugo zinji, ho yawajele Waisilayeli wono si wali wawumanyile wulugu wa ku Kanani.
2 Yakanoza nhavivi ho yazilanjize zindelo zose ze Waisilayeli kuli zo wulugu. Ko muno awalya wono wali wakali nehoma hamba kamonga mu wulugu.
3 Wono wasigazwa mu'si wali wo awalya wa mu makaya mahano ga Wafilisiti, ne Wakanani wose, Wazidoni ne Wahiti wono wekalaga mu matunda ga Lebanoni ku wulawilila mwi'tunda lya Baali-helemoni sunga mu mwejelele wa Hamati.
4 U Muwaha Mulungu yasaka yawetumamile wawo wawajele Waisilayeli ho yamanye, hono mbeka Waisilayeli wakutyatya wulajilize wakwe, nha vyono yawapela walezi wawo mu nzila ya Musa hamba ng'o.
5 Baho i Waisilayeli wakekala hamonga ne wa Kanani ne Wahiti, Waamoli ne Wapelizi ne Wahivi ne Wayebusi.
6 Waketolanila nawo no kwilunza nawo mu wuhemba milungu yawo.

Otiniyeli

7 Wanhu wa Isilayeli wakamusemwa Muwaha Mulungu wawo, waketuma wubi hali Muwaha Mulungu, wakajendelela kuhemba vihwani vya Baali na vyo mulungu we cicekulu Ashela.
8 Baho kanyhi Muwaha Mulungu yakawakolelwa likuwo Waisilayeli. Yakawatajila mu miwoko yo mutemi Kushani-lishatayimu wa ku Mesopotamiya nayo yakawasuma na kuwatema myaka munana.
9 Hobaho Waisilayeli wakamulilila Muwaha Mulungu, nayo Muwaha Mulungu yakawapela munhu mono kowaponya, litagwa lyakwe Otiniyeli u mwana wa Kenazi u mwanakwawe wa Kalebi.
10 Muhe wo Muwaha Mulungu wukamuziza Otiniyeli, nayo yakawa mulongola muli Waisilayeli. Otiniyeli yakabita ku wihomi, u Muwaha Mulungu yakamupela wusume, yakamusuma Kushani-lishatayimu u mutemi wa Mesopotamiya.
11 Ne yisi yikekala no mulamu myaka makumi mane, Otiniyeli nayo yakawa kufwa.

Ehudi

12 Wanhu wa Isilayeli waketuma wubi kanyhi hali Muwaha Mulungu. Na ku soko yiyo Muwaha Mulungu yakamupela mutemi Egeloni wa ku Mowabu vilungo kuciza Waisilayeli.
13 Baho Egeloni yakelunza ne Waamoli ne Waamaleki. Wakawahoma Waisilayeli no kuyisola Yeliko likaya lye mitende minji.
14 Waisilayeli wakamwitumamila Egeloni myaka yikumi na munana.

15 Baho kanyhi Waisilayeli wakamulilila Muwaha Mulungu nayo yakawapela munhu mono kowaponya, litagwa lyakwe Ehudi u mwana wa Gela mono yetumamilaga muwoko wo kucekulu, mono yalawa mu mulango wa Benyamini. Wanhu wa Isilayeli wakamupela vipegwa vinji Ehudi yamutegulile Egeloni u mutemi wa ku Mowabu.
16 Nayo Ehudi yaketyanila mumaje wono wali mukali kose kose wina wutali wa sentimeta kotya makumi mahano. Yakewopa mumaje wuwo mu ciwino, wukaninyinila mu cima cakwe co mugulu wo kulume kusi ye myenda yakwe.
17 Hobaho yakasola vipegwa yakawa kumutegulila mutemi Egeloni. Nayo Egeloni yali yo munhu mono yajinile muno muno.
18 Lono Ehudi yali yakondya kumupela Egeloni vipegwa, hobaho yakawalonjela i wanhu wono vyabitana wadinghuye vipegwa wawuye ku kaya.
19 Ninga mwene Ehudi yali wene du yakawuya ne nyuma behi na Giligali ha mabwe maseswe. Hanyuma yakawa kumubitila mutemi Egeloni yakamutya, “Gwe mutemi, ane nina nghani ya cinyele yono nghusaka nghulonjele.”

Hobaho u mutemi Egeloni, yakawalonjela wetumami wakwe yakawatya “Muwuce wose, mucilece cili wejete.” Hobaho wose wakawa kuwuka.
20 Lono mutemi yali yekaye yali wene mu cinyumba cakwe ca kucanyha ku golofa co kwambila lubeho. Ehudi yakamusejelela yakamutya, “Nina nghani yono Mulungu yanhumile nize nghulonjele.” U Mutemi yakenuka.
21 Hobaho Ehudi yakenjiza muwoko wakwe wo kucekulu yakawukwega mumaje ku wulawa ku cima cakwe co mugulu wo kulume, yakamuhoma mutemi mu'nda.
22 Mumaje wose wukenjila mu'nda hamonga ne cifimbo cayo, wukatoboza sunga ko ku mugongo ne mhama yo mutemi yikafunhuka yikawudindiza mumaje kusi ye 'nda. Ehudi hamba siyawukula mumaje mu'nda yo mutemi. Hambi nha wali wulawiye ko ku mugongo wukomile ho hasi.
23 Hobaho Ehudi yakayidinda ne milango yose ne makufuli, yakalawila kunze yakawa kuwuka.

24 Wetumami wo mutemi wakaza, lono Ehudi yali yakondya kuwuka wakawona milango yose midindwe wakehwesa vyono, lunji mutemi yali mumo, yali ku coloni.
25 Wakamulindiliza du sunga nhondo wakawona ne cevu. Na lono waza wona siyakuza kudigula, wakasola funguwo wakadigula cinyumba cicilya co kwambila lubeho. Baho wakamuwona muwaha wawo yagonile hasi yafwiye.

26 Ninga Ehudi yakatoloka lono wene wali wakali walindilize yadigule. Yakakolela kwi 'bwe lililya lye lipango yakatolocela ku Seyila.
27 Na lono yali yakondya kufika ku yisi ye matunda ya Efulayimu, yakayitowa ndulele, yakuwacema wanhu wa Isilayeli ho wabite ku wulugu. Yakawa kuwalonjela lono wutenenhuka ga mu matunda.
28 Yakatya, “Wose munhyatyaje! Muwaha Mulungu yakondya kumupelenyi wusume kuli walugu wenyu, Wamowabi.” Hobaho wakamutyatya Ehudi no kuyibata yisi mu malowoko gose ga Yoludani, gono wamowabu wasakaga kulowocela. Hakawa hasina hamba monga muli Wamowabi mono yasuma kulowoka.
29 Na mwi'zuwa lilyo mu wihomi wuwo, wakawawulaga wasilikale we citung'ati elufu yikumi we Wamowabi. Hasina hamba monga mono yatiga.
30 Mwi'zuwa lilyo lyo Waisilayeli wawasumila i Wamowabi. Na ku wulawilila baho, nhondo wakaceha wapolile, hamonga no mulamu, myaka makumi munana.

Shamugali

31 Shamugali mwana wa Anati, nayo yali yo mulamuzi mono yatyatya, nayo yakawaponya Waisilayeli, yakawawulaga Wafilisiti magana mutandatu, yawawulaga ne nghome yono yina cisonje, yo kutonjela zing'ombe lono zikulima.


Walamuzi 4

Debola na Balaka

1 Na lono Ehudi yali yakondya kufwa wanhu wa Isilayeli waketuma wubi kanyhi hali Muwaha Mulungu.
2 Nayo Muwaha Mulungu, yakawa kuwatajila mu miwoko ya Yabini u mutemi we Wakanani, mono yali yatemile likaya lya Hazoli. Mulongola we wasilikale wakwe yacemwaga Sisela mono yekalaga Halosheti-hagoyimu.
3 Yabini yali yena matuka ga cuma go wulugu magana yicenda. Kanyhi yali yawatemile Waisilayeli ko wukali hamonga no kuwagaza muno myaka makumi mejete. Lolulo Waisilayeli kanyhi wakamulilila Muwaha Mulungu ho yawataze.

4 Nayo Debola u mugolece wa Lapidoti yali yo muwizi, nayo yo yawetumamilaga Waisilayeli, kotya mulongola mu mapango gago.
5 Yali yazoweye kuceha ha mubici wunji wo mutende wono wali wuli hagati ya Lama na Beteli mu yisi ye matunda ya Efulayimu. Nawo Waisilayeli wamubitilaga ho yawapele mahweso gakwe.
6 Zuwa linji yakatuma wanhu wabite wamucemele Balaka u mwana wa Abinowamu mono yekalaga mwi'kaya lya Kedeshi mu yisi ya Nafutali, yakamulonjela yakamutya, “U Muwaha Mulungu u Mulungu wa Isilayeli, kakulajiliza yakutya nhavi, ‘Wusole wanhu we cilume elufu yikumi, ku wulawa mu mulango wa Nafutali, na Zabuloni, wuwategule sunga kwi'tunda lye Taboli.
7 Nane nomutuma Sisela u mulongola we wasilikale wa Yabini yaze mwihome nayo he 'kolongo lya Kishoni, mwene kowa yena ne matuka gakwe ge cuma go wulugu, hamonga ne wasilikale wakwe. Ninga ane nokupela wusume ho wumusume mwene.’ ”
8 Balaka yakamutya Debola, “Hono cibitane na gwegwe nolumba, ninga hono wulece kubitana nane, ale nane sinolumba kubita.”
