8 Na mwi'zuwa lye 'hano, wakapinjila kwinuka ho watuluce, ninga u mukwewe yakawatya, “Ng'o ye, mulece kutuluka, langa mwamule mulye zindigwa. Mulindile hadodo, sunga lizuwa liwalice. Hodu wakalya zindigwa wose hamonga.”

9 Hanyuma munhu yuyu, no mwitumami wakwe hamonga no mujitulwa wakwe, wali weza kusaka kutuluka, ninga kanyhi u mukwewe yakamutya, “Lanje ta, alu lizuwa nha lyaswa, holeka ciba mugone, hambi lizuwa nha lyogwila lulu baha, du, ne citi cokwinjila lulu baha du. Holeka ciba mugone baha kanyhi, mutuje cilejeho co kuceha. Ne mitondo mosuma kwilawa so muhinzo wenyu mubite kwenyu.”
10 Ninga u munhu yulya hamba siyasaka kanyhi kugona baho. Langa mwene hamonga no mujitulwa wakwe, wakawa kutuluka, hamonga no mwitumami, no mwitumami, ne zindogowe nyejete zono zali nhandikwe ne matandiko.
11 Nawo wali weza kufika behi na Yebusi (nha cinji yo Yelusalemi.) Lizuwa nalyo likawa lyakondya kuswa. Lulo u mwitumami yakamulonjela mutwawe yakamutya, “Nghukunena cibite cikagone he 'kaya lye Wayebusi.”
12 Ninga u mutwawe yakamutya, “Sicosuma kwinjila mwi'kaya lyono wanhu wa mumo si Waisilayeli.”
13 Langa cipulute ku mwande hadodo, cikagonele ku Gibeya ya ku Lama.
14 Hodu wakawa kupulutiza ha Yebusi wajendeleleye no muhinzo wawo. Wakafika ha Gibeya mu yisi ya wo mulango wa Benyamini, lono lizuwa lyagwilaga.
15 Hodu, wakawa kutemanuka nzila, wakawa kwinjila ho wagone baho ha Gibeya. Wakenjila mwi'kaya, ninga wakaceha mwi'wanza. Hakawa hasina hamba munhu wo wose mono yawabocela ho wenjile mu nyumba yakwe wagone.

16 Na lono wali wekaye baho, mukombi yunji yakaza yakulawa ku mugunda cinyamihe, yakuwuya ku kaya. Nayo yali mulawa ku yisi ye matunda ya Efulayimu. Ninga luno, yekalaga baho ha Gibeya. Ne wanhu wanji baho, wali wo wo mulango wa Benyamini.
17 Nayo mukombi yuyu yali yeza kuwawona wajenzi wacehile he'wanza lye likaya, yakamuwuza Mulawi yakamutya, “Alu wukulawilila hayi? Kanyhi wudomile hayi?”
18 U mulawi yakapitula yakatya, cali cili ku Betelehemu ya Yuda nalu cili mu muhinzo cidomile kwetu kutali muno muno ku yisi ye matunda ya Efulayimu. Alu hasina hamba munhu mono yacicemeye mu nyumba yakwe cituje wugono,
19 Ninga nase hamba nhavivyo cina ne mahanze so zindogowe zetu hamonga no mukate ne divayi so mujitulwa wangu na nene hamonga no mwitumami wangu. Cisina wanjile wa cinhu co cose cono cosaka.

20 U mukombi yulya yakawatya, “Ale, muze mukagone ku kaya yangu! Nane nomudimenyi. Holeka musina soko yo yose yo kugona mwi'wanza.”
21 Hobaho yakawa kuwasola yakabita nawo kwakwe, yakazilisa zindogowe zawo. Wajenzi wakwe wakezuguza magulu gawo yakawapela ne zindigwa.
22 Na lono wali wali mu wisangalaze we mitima yawo; langa ta wukaza wanhu wabi wakulawa mwi'kaya, wakayipilima kaya yo mukombi yuyu, wakawa kuyitowanga milango no kumutya mukombi yuyu, “Mulavyanizaje kononze u munhu yulya mono mwinjilane mu kaya yako. Ase cikusaka cigone nayo!”
23 Ninga mukombi yakalawaniza kunze yakawatya, “Aa! Ng'o wandugu zangu, nghumunenenyi mulece kwituma wubi wuwo wo wusenhya, hambi munhu ayu nha mujenzi wangu.
24 Alu mulanje ta! Ayu u mwanangu we cicekulu, mono yakali namanya walume, wali hamonga no mujitulwa wo munhu yuyu. Holeka nowalavyaniza wawo kuli'nye, nanye ho muwatendele nhavivyo. Muwetumamilaje nha vyono mosaka nyenye nyo weneco. Ninga mulece kwituma wubi wono winha wuwo, we cevu kuli munhu ayu!”
25 Ninga wawo wanhu, hamba siwamuhuliciza yaye. Hobaho u Mulawi yakamusola umujitulwa wakwe, yakamuwika hanze hali wene. Nawo wakagona nayo, wakamunoza vibi muno cilo cose. Hamba si wamuleka yaye sunga wusiku wukela.
26 Na lono wusiku welaga, hakali mitondo muno, u mucekulu yuyo yakabita sunga ha mulango wo munya kaya, mono mwali moyuli u mulume wakwe. Yakawa kugwa ha'deha ha mulango, yakekala baho sunga wukela.

27 Mwi'zuwa lilyo u mulume wakwe yakelawa kwinuka hakali mitondo, nayo yali yeza kudigula mulango ho yatuluce, yakamuwona mujitulwa wakwe yagonile ha mulango, ne miwoko yakwe yibate cipimbila-mulango.
28 Hobaho yakawa kumucema yakutya, “Ale winuce cibite!” Ninga mujitulwa hamba siyapitula yaye. Hodu yakawa kumujeleka cipinga, mucanyha ye ndogowe, yakawa kutuluka nayo.
29 Nayo yali yeza kufika kwawo, yakenjila mu kaya, yakasola mumaje, yakawutemasha muwili wo mujitulwa wakwe. Yakawutemasha mhonje yikumi na nyejete, yakategula mhoje monga monga, mu milango yose vyono yikumi na myejete ye Waisilayeli.
30 No munhu wo wose mono yayiwona mhonje yiyo, yakatya, “Cikali nahulika vyono calelwa nghani yono yinha yiyi! Hamba hasina nghani yono yinha yiyi, yono yejela ku wulawilila lono Waisilayeli wawucila ku yisi ya Misili sunga nalu. Holeka yicinojeye citume nghani yo yose, vyono yowa yinha, ku soko ya nghani yiyi. Alu mukuwona wule?”


Walamuzi 20

Isilayeli wakwiwikaniza so wulugu

1 Wanhu wose wa Isilayeli kulawilila Dani lubavu lwa kusumuka sunga ku Beyeli-sheba lubavu lwa kutakama sunga ko ku yisi ya Gileyadi lubavu lwa kucilima, wose wakedika kucemo lulo, wakehanguliza hamonga hali Muwaha Mulungu ku Mizipa.
2 Ne walongola wose wa mu milango yose ya Isilayeli, wali wali baho ha wihangulize wuwo we wanhu wo Mulungu, kanyhi kwali ne Wasilikale wajenda kwa migulu waficile elufu magana mane liwalo lyawo.
3 Cipango cico i wanhu wa Benyamini, wakahulika nha vyono Waisilayeli wanji wose, wali wakondya kwihanguliza ha Mizipa.

Waisilayeli wakawuza wakatya, “Mucilonjelaje ta, ku sokoci wubi wuwu witumwa?”
4 U Mulawi munghalo mujitulwa mono yali yawulagwa, yakawapitula yakatya, “Nene hamonga no mujitulwa wangu, cabita ku Gibeya mu yisi ya Benyamini ho cigone baho.
5 Nawo wanhu wa ha Gibeya wakanyiziza mu cilo mugati no kuyipilima nyumba mono nali ngonile. Wakasaka wambulaje, ninga wakamwibata mujitulwa wangu kwe vilungo, wakagona nayo sunga yakafwa.
6 Nane nghawa kuwusola muwili wakwe, nghawa kuwutemasha mhonje yikumi na nyejete, nha vyono yinha milango yikumi na myejete, ye Waisilayeli. Nghawa kuwategulila milango yose mhonje monga monga. Hambi i wanhu awa, nha wetuma nghani 'mbi ya cevu muli Isilayeli.
7 Nase wose ahano, cili Waisilayeli. Alu ho citende wule so nghani yiyi?”

8 Wanhu wose wakenucila hamonga wakatya, “Kusina yunji muli sese, mono kekalaga mwi'hema hamba mu kaya mono kopituka yawuye ku kaya kwakwe.
9 Alu conoza nhavi: Cotowa kula ho ciwawagule wanhu wono wobita wakayihome Gibeya.
10 Wanhu yikumi limonga-limoga lya mu wanhu yigana yigana lya mu Waisilayeli, wo wolavya ndigwa so wasilikale wo wulugu. Na wanji wose, wokwinuka wabite wakayilipicize Gibeya, so wubi wuwu wono wetumile mu Isilayeli.”
11 Holeka wanhu wose wa mu Isilayeli wakekonghola ko wuhile wumonga wo kulihoma likaya lya Gibeya.

12 Nawo milango yose ye Waisilayeli, wakawatuma wanhu wakolele mu yisi yose ya wo mulango wa Benyamini, wakawatya, “Alo wubici wuwu wono mwetuma?”
13 Alu muwalavyanizaje i wanhu wabi wawo, wono wayamuye nghani yiyo mu Gibeya, nase ciwawulaje, ho ciwuse wubi wuwu mu Isilayeli. Ninga wene wanhu wo mulango wa Benyamini, hamba si wayicelelela bwete nghani yiyo ye Waisilayeli wayawo.
14 Langa wene wanhu wose wa mu makaya gose ga Benyamini, wakekongholela ha Gibeya, wakawa kuwahoma Waisilayeli wayawo.
15 Wakawakonghola wasilikale elufu makumi mejete na mutandatu, ku wulawilila mu makaya gawo gose mwi'zuwa lilyo.
16 Hamonga na wawo, iwekazi wa ha Gibeya, nawo wakekonghola wanhu magana mupunghati, wono wahagulwa, wono wetumamilaga miwoko yo kucekulu. Muli wene, mwali mo wali wanghula wo kugumila mabwe ne zinhago, no kutowa luvwili hamba kwicelya yaye.
17 Nawo we milango ye Waisilayeli, yono yali yisigaye, nayo yikawakonghola wasilikale wo mulungu, waficile elufu magana mane, wono wali wejizwe muno wunghula wo wihomi.

Waisilayeli wakwihoma ne Wabenyamini

18 Waisilayeli wakasejelela hanhu ho kuhembela ha Beteli, wakawa kumuwuza Mulungu wakutya, “Gwe go Mulungu, alu wo mulangoci wono walongole kuwahoma Wabenyamini?”

Nayo Muwaha Mulungu yakawapitula yakatya, “Wo mulango wa Yuda.”

19 Hobaho Waisilayeli wakatuluka i mitondo yaco, hakali mitondo muno, wakayisimya nghambi yawo behi ne likaya lya Gibeya.
20 Wakatuluka ho wakawahome wasilikale wa Benyamini. Wakawatandalika wasilikale wawo wakema vidomile ne likaya lya Gibeya.
21 Nawo we lipuga lye wasilikale lya Benyamini wakalawila mwi'kaya, ninga na lono ne lizuwa lyali likali si naswa, wali wakondya kuwulagwa wasilikale we Waisilayeli elufu makumi mejete na nyejete liwalo lyawo.
22 Lulo Waisilayeli wakabita mu Nyumba yo wuhembelo, wakamulilila ko wukalale Muwaha Mulungu, sunga lizuwa likaswa.
23 Wakamuwuza Muwaha Mulungu wakutya, “Wule ciwuyajile kanyhi, cikehome ne wandugu zetu wa Wabenyamini?”

U Muwaha Mulungu yakawapitula yakawatya “Heya mubite.”

Lulo wasilikale we ci Isilayeli wakekamiliza mu mitima yawo, wakawa kuwatandalika wasilikale wawo bahalya du nha vyono wali wawatandalice ha lulongozi.

24 Wakanza kwitang'anila kanyhi ne lipuga lye wasilikale wa Benyamini lwe kejete.
25 Nawo wasilikale we Wabenyamini, wakalawila mwi'kaya lya Gibeya lwe kejete. Alu nhondo mwi'zuwa lilyo, wakawulagwa wasilikale wanghula we Ciisilayeli, waficile elufu yikumi na munana liwalo lyawo.
26 Lulo kanyhi wanhu wa Isilayeli wakatuluka wakabita ku Beteli, wakalila ko wukalale wuwaha muno muno hali Mulungu. Wakaceha baho hali Muwaha Mulungu hamba siwalya cinji sunga likaswa. Wakalavya hali Muwaha Mulungu cilavywa co mulamu, hamonga ne cilavywa cinyanywe.
27 Ne lisanduku lye cilagane lyo Muwaha Mulungu, lyekalaga ha Beteli mu vilo vivyo.
28 Nayo Finehasi u mwana wa Eleyezali, kanyhi yo mwizukulu wa Haluni, yali yo mulanjilizi walyo. Wanhu wakamuwuza u Muwaha Mulungu, wakatya, “Gwe go Muwaha Mulungu, wule, ciwuyajile kanyhi cikehome ne wandugu zetu Wabenyamini hamba hodu cilece?”

Nayo Muwaha Mulungu yakawapitula yakawatya, “Heya! Mubite mukawahome! Nane baho mitondo nhondo, nomupelenyi wusume wuwaha muno kuli wene.”

29 Lulo nhondo Waisilayeli wakawatandalika wasilikale wawo cinyele, wakalipilima likaya lyose lya Gibeya.
30 Na mwi'zuwa lilyo lye kadatu, vyono lyali lyo lizuwa lyo wusume. Waisilayeli wakawabitila wasilikale wa Benyamini, no kuwatandalika wasilikale wawo wakema vidomile ne likaya lya Gibeya, nha vyono wawatandalika ha mwamulizo.
31 Nawo Wabenyamini, wakalawila ho wehome, ninga Waisilayeli wakawakwejeleza Wabenyamini, sunga wakawafisa kutali ne likaya. Ninga nha vyono yali ha mwamulizo, wakanza kuwawulaga Waisilayeli wanji mwi'hala, na mu nzila yono yibitile ku Beteli. Nawo Waisilayeli wakawakwejeleza du Wabenyamini, sunga ku nzila yono yikoleye ha Gibeya. Ninga nawo Wabenyamini wakawawulaga Waisilayeli waficile nha wanhu makumi madatu nhavi.

32 Nawo Wabenyamini wakatya, “Alu cawahoma nha vyono cawahoma hamwamulizo.”

Ninga mwi'zuwa lilyo Waisilayeli wali wewikaniza wenoze nha wakutiza ha mwande ye Wabenyamini. Ho wawakwejeleze wawafise kutali ne likaya, sunga ku zinzila zimbaha.
33 Lulo lulo lipuga lye Waisilayeli wakawuka i hanhu hawo, wakatandala mu milewo ku Baali-tamali. Na wono wali wehundice mu yisi ya Gibeya, nawo wakawuka i hanhu hono wali wehundice mu mabwe behi ne likaya.
34 I Wanhu elufu yikumi wono wahagulwa muli Waisilayeli, wawo wakayihoma Gibeya, no wulugu wuwo wali wukali muno, nawo Wabenyamini hamba si wamanya yaye vyono weza kongomezwa yaye.
35 Muwaha Mulungu yakawapela Waisilayeli wusume kuli Wabenyamini. Waisilayeli wakawawulaga walugu wawo, waficile elufu makumi mejete na yigana limonga, liwalo lyawo mwi'zuwa lilyo.
36 Nawo Wabenyamini, nhondo ho wakawa kumanya vyono kumbe wasumwa.

Waisilayeli vyono wawasuma Wabenyamini

Lipuga lyose lye wasilikale we Waisilayeli, wakenoza nha wakutiza hali Wabenyamini, vyono wali wawetumbiye awalya wono wali wehundice, walipilime likaya lya Gibeya.
37 Wanhu wawo wo wakamangha mbela mbela, wakeyagala mwi'kaya lyose lya Gibeya, wakawawulaga wanhu wose mono wali wali mwi'kaya.
38 Lipuga liwaha lye wasilikale, na awalya wono wali wehundice, wali wewiciye citanjilo. Nha vyono, kolo weza kuwona lyosi yiwaha likomile wulawilila mwi'kaya,
39 baho Waisilayeli wono wali kwi'wanza lyo wulugu, ale, wapituce, ninga mu vipango vivyo, Wabenyamini wali wakondya kuwawulaga Waisilayeli makumi madatu. Holeka wakeyitya, “Heya, cawahoma nha vyono cawahoma ha mwamulizo.”
40 Lo lulo lulo naco citanjilo ce lyosi cikawa kwijela. Livunde lye lyosi likawa likukomoka kulawilila mwi'kaya. Nawo Wabenyamini wali weza kwilenga ku nyuma, wakezina kuwona likaya lyacile moto.
41 Hobaho Waisilayeli wakawa kupituka no kuwuya ne nyuma. Nawo Wabenyamini wose, wakenjilwa no woga wuwaha muno, hambi nha wakemanya vyono, alu, langa, weza kongomezwa.
42 Hodu, wakawa kutiza ha mwande ye Waisilayeli, wakawa kumanyhila mwi'hala. Ninga hamba nhavivyo, si watiga yaye. Wakebatilwa haciligati ye lipuga liwaha lye wasilikale. Ne wanhu wono walawaga mwi'kaya, nawo wakongomezwa wose.
43 Waisilayeli wakawatejela walugu wawo, wakajendelela kuwawinjiliza akuno wakuwawulaga, sunga ko ku nhuzi ya kucilima ya Gibeya.
44 Baho wakawawulaga wasilikale vitung'ati we Wabenyamini waficile elufu yikumi na munana liwalo lyawo.
45 Wanji wakapituka wakanza lumangho mwi'hala wakatiziza kwi'bwe lya Limoni. Ninga hamba nhavivyo, wawulajilwa mu nzila wanhu elufu yihano.
46 Nawo Waisilayeli wakajendelela kuwawinjiliza du, Wabenyamini wono wali wasigaye, sunga Gidomu, wakawawulaga waficile elufu makumi majete na yihano Wabenyamini liwalo lyawo, mwi'zuwa lilyo. Na wose wawa wali wo wasilikale vitung'ati.

47 Hamba nhavivyo, Wabenyamini wanji magana mutandatu, wakasuma kutiziza mwi'hala, sunga ko kwi'bwe lya Limoni, nawo wakekala baho myezi mine.
48 Waisilayeli wakawawuyila kanyhi Wabenyamini wanji, wono wali wakali wasigaye, wakawawulaga wose, we cilume, na we cicekulu, ne wana wose hamonga ne mitugo zawo zose. Wakagapembela moto ne makaya gose gono wagawona.


Walamuzi 21

Wacekulu so wo mulango wa Benyamini

1 Na lono Waisilayeli wali wakondya kwihanguliza ha Mizipa. Wakelahiza wilahize kuli Muwaha Mulungu, wakatya, “Hasina hamba munhu monga wa muli sese, mono kumukombola mwanagwe we cicekulu, yatolwe na wo mulango wa Benyamini.”
2 Hobaho Waisilayeli wakawa kubita ku Beteli no kwikala baho hali Mulungu, sunga lizuwa likaswa. Wakenula mazi gawo kwe vilungo wakulila no kukalala muno, wakutya,
3 “Gwe go Muwaha Mulungu u Mulungu wa Isilayeli, alo nhawule zizi zacijelela nhavivi lo? Nhawule wo mulango wa Benyamini 'lu, weza kwajilila mu Isilayeli.”
4 Hodu wali weza kwela i mitondo yaco hakali mitondo, wanhu wakazenga cikumbicilo baho, wakalavya cilavywa co mulamu hamonga na vilavywa vinyanywe
5 Waisilayeli wakewuza wakatya, “Wulenyi, howa holili yipuga lyo lyose muli milango ye Waisilayeli lyono silyaza ha wihangulize wa hali Muwaha Mulungu ha Mizipa?” (Hambi nha wali wekondya kwilahiza nha vyono, wo wose mono wilahize we mbeka vyono, sikobita ha Mizipa ciba yawulagwe.)
6 Wanhu wa Isilayeli wakatuga wukalale wuwaha so wandugu zawo wo mulango wa Benyamini wakatya, “Mwi'zuwa lili Isilayeli cakondya kuwajiliza i wayetu wo mulango monga wa mu milango yetu.
7 Alu cotenda wule ho cisume kuwakombola wana wetu we cicekulu watolwe ne wana wawo we cilume we Wabenyamini wono wasigaye? Hambi nha cakondya kwilahiza hali Muwaha Mulungu, nha vyono ase sicowapelela lukulu wana wetu we cicekulu watolwe nawo.”

8 Wali weza kukondya kwiwuza vyono wo mulangoci wa muli milango ya Isilayeli wono siwafika ha wihangulize wa ha Mizipa, Hobako wakamanya vyono hali hasina hamba yunji wa muli wono wekalaga ku Yebeshi ya Gileyadi mono yali yali baho.
9 Sunga na lono wawacemaga matagwa i wasilikale wose wo wulugu kwali kusina hamba yumonga mono yejela mono yalawilila ku Yabeshi ya Gileyadi.
10 Hodu hobaho mukung'ano wukawatuma Wasilikale wono wakamile kanyhi wanghula waficile elufu yikumi na vyejete. Wakawalajiliza wakatya, “Mwinuce mubite mukawawalaje wanhu wose wa ku Yabeshi ya Gileyadi, walume na we cicekulu, hamonga ne wana wose.
11 Muwawulaje we cilume wose na we cicekulu wose wono wakondya kumanya walume.”
12 Nawo wasilikale wawo wali weza kufika kuko ku Yabeshi ya Gileyadi wakawagana wana we cicekulu wono wakali namanya walume, wali waficile magana mane, hodu wakawa kuwasola no kuwategula ku nghambi ya ku Shilo, yono yali yili mu yisi ya Kanani.

13 Hobaho u mukung'ano wuwo wukategula nghani kuli Wabenyamini wono wali wali kwi'bwe lya Limoni wakewicila mulamu hamonga walece kwihoma.
14 Hodu Wabenyamini wakawa kuwuya, nawo Waisilayeli, wakawa kuwapela wahinza wa walya wono wasolwa ku Yabeshi ya Gileyadi, awalya wono siwawawulaga. Ninga hamba nhavivyo siwawakwile wose yaye.

15 I wanhu wakenjilwa no lusungu luwaha so wanhu wa Benyamini, hambi Muwaha Mulungu, nha yali yakondya kuwutemanula u wilunze wawo i milango ya Isilayeli.
16 Hobaho i walongola wa ha mukung'ano wuwo wakatya, “Nha hasina kanyhi wacekulu wono wasigaye wa mu mulango wa Benyamini. Alu ho cotenda nhawule, ho ciwapele wugolece i walume wawa wono wasigaye?
17 Hambi nha si yowa viswanu, hono Isilayeli yajilize mulango monga wa muli milango yawo yikumi na nyejete. Holeka yicinojeye, cilondole nzila kuli mulango wa Benyamini ho wulece kwajilila.
18 Ninga hamba nhavivyo, ase sicowakombolela lukulu i wana wetu we cicekulu ho wawatole. Hambi nha cakondya kwilahiza nha vyono yalijitwe munhu wo wose mono komukombolela Mubenyamini, u mwanagwe we cicekulu yamutole.”

19 Baho kanyhi wakehwesa wakatya, “Langa ta, sikukuu yo ku Shilo ya Muwaha Mulungu ya mwaka nha yasejelela.” Shilo yili lubavu lwa kusumuka ya Beteli, kutakama ya Lebona kanyhi lubavu lwe cilima lwe nzila yono yili haciligati ya Beteli na Shekemu.
20 Holeka wakawalonjela Wabenyamini wakawatya, “Muwuce mubite mukehundice mu migunda ye mizabibu,
21 muwe mulanjiliye. Na lono i wahinza wa ku Shilo wakuza kono wuvina, kono sikukuu, anye nhondo mulawile mu migunda ye mizabibu. Nanye munhu na lwakwe, yehagulile mucekulu mono yakusaka, yamupule kwa vilungo yamutegule ku yisi ya Benyamini.
22 Hono wasogo zawo, hamba walumbu zawo waze wamuwuzenyi, muwalonjele mutye, cikumunenenyi muwalekaje cikale nawo, hambi nha sicawasola kuli'nye mu nzila yo wulugu, ho wawe wagolece zetu. Nalu mbeka, vyono si nyenye mono mwacikombolela wawe wagolece zetu, holeka anye musina lisutya lyo wubena wihuwizo.”

23 Nawo Wabenyamini waketuma nhavivyo, wose yumonga yumonga, wakehagulila mucekulu, mu wulawa muli wawo wahinza, wono wali waza ha wuvina, ha sikukuu ya ha Shilo. Wakawa kuwapula, wakawa kubita nawo, wakawa kuwuya nawo ku yisi yawo, wakazenga kanyhi zikaya zawo wakekala mumo.
24 Lulo lulo wanji wa muli Waisilayeli, wono wali wakali wasigaye, nawo wakawa kuwuka, wakawa kuwuya munhu na kwakwe kuli wo mulango wakwe ne mhuga yakwe, no wuhazi wakwe.

25 Na mu vilo vivyo, mu Isilayeli, mwali mukali musina mutemi, holeka wanhu wetumaga du zono wehwesaga munhu na lwakwe.


Lutu 1

Elimeleki ne mhuga yakwe wakubita ku Mowabu

1 Baho katali, mu vilo vyono Waisilayeli wali wakali siwanawa na mutemi, kwali koyili nzala mu'si. No munhu mono yacemagwa Elimeleki, mono yali we mhuga ya Efulata, mono yekalaga Betelehemu mu Yuda,
2 yakabita hamonga no mugolece wakwe Nawomi ne wana wawo wejete Maloni na Ciliyoni, yekale mu yisi ya Mowabu. Na lono wekalaga kuko,
3 Elimeleki yakafwa, Nawomi yakalekwa yali wene hamonga ne wanagwe wejete,
4 Nawo wa Maloni na Ciliyoni wakawa kutola i wahinza we Cimowabu, Olipa na Lutu. Kotya myaka yikumi yali yeza kupuluta,
5 Maloni na Ciliyoni nawo wakawa kufwa, Nawomi yakalekwa yali wene yasina mulume hamba wana wa cilume.

Nawomi na Lutu wakuwuya ku Betelehemu

6 Hanyuma yayo, Nawomi yakahulika vyono Muwaha Mulungu yawamotya i wanhu wakwe ko kuwapela nhwanga mbaha; hobaho yakawa kwiwikaniza ho yawuce ku Mowabu hamonga ne wakwewe.
7 Wakawuka hamonga wawuye ku yisi ya Yuda. Na lono wali wali mu nzila,
8 Nawomi yakawatya wakwewe, “Nye wanangu, muwuye kwenyu, mukekale hamonga ne wanyina zenyu. Nayo Muwaha Mulungu kowa muswanu kuli'nye, nha vyono anye mwali waswanu kuli'ne na kuli wawo wono wakondya kufwa.
9 No Muwaha Mulungu yamutazenyi, mutolwe kanyhi mutuje nyumba.” Baho Nawomi yakawa kuwanonela no kuwelaga. Ninga wene wakanza kulila.
10 Wakamutya, “Ng'o! Ase langa, cobitana nagwe du kuli wanhu wako.”
11 Nawomi yakawapitula. Yakawatya, “Yinojeye muwuye kwenyu wanangu.” hawule mukusaka cibitane hamonga nane? Mukwihwesa ane, nosuma kulela kanyhi wana wanji we cilume, wono womutolenyi?
12 Holeka muwuye ku zikaya zenyu wanangu, hambi ane nha neza nili mukombi, si nosuma kutolwa kanyhi. Hamba nali nitye kowuli witumbilo, vyono hono nholwe ne cilo cici notuga wana,
13 wule, mwali muwalindile sunga wawiluce? Yiyi yimwimilenyi ho mulece kutolwa na yunji? Ng'o wanangu, mumanyile nha vyono siyosumika. Hambi Muwaha Mulungu nha kamhitucila, ane nane nghumuwonelenyi lusungu wanangu.

14 Kanyhi wene wakanza kulila. Ninga Olipa yakawa kumunonela mukwewe, yakawa kuwuya ku kaya, ninga Lutu, vikekalana no mukwewe.
15 Nayo, Nawomi yakamutya, “Lutu, lanje ta mutozi muyago, yawawuyila i wanhu wakwe, na ko mulungu wakwe. Nagwe le, muwuyane wose ku kaya.”

16 Ninga Lutu yakamupitula Nawomi, yakamutya,

“Gwe yaya! Wulece kuneneleza 'ne ho nghulece!

Wundekaje 'ne cibitane na gwegwe.

Kono kobita, nane nobita;

na kono kokwikala, nane nokwikala.

Ne wanhu wako, nane wowa wanhu wangu,

no Mulungu wako nane kowa Mulungu wangu.

17 Na ho hose hono kofwila nane ho nofwila,

no kuzikwa baho,

no Muwaha Mulungu yanhendele nhavivyo no kuciza,

langa lifwa du lyo lyolocitemanula nagwe.”

18 Nawomi yali yeza kuwona vyono Lutu yendile wabitane, hodu nayo yakawa kunyamala.
19 Wakawa kujendelela no muhinzo wose vyono wejete, sunga wakafika ku Betelehemu. Nawo lono waficililaga, mwi'kaya lya Betelehemu, likaya lyose likenjila sasamo mbaha, ne wacekulu wakalonga wakutya, “Mwene 'nye, yuyu mbeka yo Nawomi?”

20 Nayo Nawomi yakawatya, “Mulece nyhema Nawomi, langa munyhemaje nene Mala, (nhunizo yayo cinhu cono cina cisungu,) hambi u Mulungu Mudaha Vyose mono yali vilungo, nha kayinoza mikalile yangu yiwe ya wusungu sungu du.
21 Hambi lono nawukaga baha, nha nali nina vyose, ninga Muwaha Mulungu, yangomola luno nili bwete. Holeka socici munyheme nene Nawomi, lono Muwaha Mulungu Mudaha Vyose, yakondya kuning'aniza nha nili musutyi, no kumhela magayo?”
22 Nhavivi vyo Nawomi yawuya ku wulawa Mowabu hamonga na Lutu, mukwewe u Mumowabu. Wakafika mu Betelehemu, mu mwamulizo we ndudula yo wuhemba.


Lutu 2

Lutu yakwituma mu mugunda wa Bowazi

1 Nawomi yali yena nduguye mono yacemwaga Bowazi, munhu mugoli kanyhi munhu muwaha, mono yali we mhuga yo mulume wakwe Elimeleki.
2 Ale, mwi'zuwa linji, Lutu yakamulonjela Nawomi yakatya, “Lece 'ne mbite ku migunda nghehalalize wuhemba wono wakuwusigaza lono wakududula. Manyile nha vyono notuga mono komvumila nitume hamonga nayo.” Nayo Nawomi yakamupitula yakamutya, “Ale, wubite mwanangu.”
3 Lutu yakawa kubita ku migunda, yakawa yakutyatya mu nyuma ye waduduzi, no kuhalaliza wuhemba wono wasigazaga. Yikejela vyono kumbe yali yali mu mugunda wono wali wa Bowazi mono yali we mhuga ya Elimeleki.

4 Hanyuma yayo Bowazi mweneco yakaza ku mugunda ku wulawa ku Betelehemu yakawalamusa i waduduzi. Yakatya, “Muwaha Mulungu yeze muli nyenye.” Nawo wakamutya, “Muwaha Mulungu nagwe yakulugute.”
5 Bowazi yakamuwuza mulanjilizi we waduduzi yakatya, “Alu yuyu muhinza mwana nani?”
6 Mulanjilizi yakapitula yakatya, “Ayuno muhinza, mujenzi, mono yazize ku wulawa Mowabu hamonga na Nawomi.
7 Kanyitya nimulece yawatyatye mu nyuma i waduduzi, yahalaliza wuhemba. Kaswa yakwituma ku wulawa hakali mitondo, alu yacehile du hadodo mu cibanda.”

8 Baho Bowazi yakamulonjela Lutu yakatya, “Hulicize mwanangu, wulece kanyhi kwihalaliza wuhemba mu migunda yinji, langa mu mugunda wuwu du. Witumaje baha, hamonga ne wetumami wangu wawa we cicekulu,
9 na lono wukuza mono mugunda weze kwamula kulanga, wuwone kono we cicekulu wakududula. Nagwe weze wuli hamonga du ne wahinza wawa. Nane nakondya kuwalajiliza wawo we cilume walece kukugaza. Na hono wuwone nyhilu, wubite ku viya wukang'we malenga gono wanejile.”
10 Lutu yakenamya wusu wakwe ho hasi, yakamutya Bowazi, “Alo nhawule wukwigaza ku soko yangu? Hamba nhawule wendile kuwanozeza viswanu wajenzi?”
11 Nayo Bowazi yakamutya Lutu, “Ane nakondya kuzihulika zose ziswanu zono wetuma kuli mukwewo Nawomi, ku wulawa lono mulume wako yafwila. Kanyhi manyile na vyono, wawaleka u sogo no nyina yako ne yisi yako, na vyono waza kwikala muli wanhu wono wali si wuwamanyile yaye.
12 Holeka Muwaha Mulungu, u Mulungu we Waisilayeli, yakumotye so zizo zono wetuma. Kanyhi wutuje cihumbilizwa cono cimemeleceye, ku wulawa kuli yuyo Muwaha Mulungu we Waisilayeli, yuyo mono wumuzize ho yakukamise.”

13 Nayo Lutu yakamupitula Bowazi yakamutya, “Gwe muwaha, kuhonjela muno, kuli zono wunhedeye, no mwitumami wako. Hambi nha wanoza nane nihulice viswanu, vyono kulonga nane, kwa wupolo, hamba nha yiwe ane si nihwanile na yunji wa muli wetumami wako.”
14 Na mu cipango co kulya zindigwa, Bowazi yakamutya Lutu, “Wuze nagwe wusole nhonje wulilize mu divayi.” Hodu Lutu yakawa kwikala hasi hamonga ne waduduzi, nayo Bowazi yakawa kumupela mbonho zo wuhemba. Nayo Lutu yakalya sunga yakeguta, no kusigaza ndigwa zinji.
15 Nayo yali yeza kwinuka ho yabite yakahalalize wuhemba. Bowazi yakawalajiliza wetumami wakwe yakawatya, “Mumulekaje Lutu yahalale sunga na mu madulu, mulece kumwimila.
16 Hamonga na zizo, mucepule wunji ku wulawa mu madulu muwulece, nayo yetondoleze.”

17 “Nayo Lutu yakawa kujendelela no wihalalizi wakwe wo wuhemba mu mugunda, sunga likaswa. Nayo yali yeza kuwutwanga wono yahalaye, yakatuga kilo yikumi limonga.”
18 Yakawutegula wuhemba ku kaya yakamulajila mukwewe vyono yahalaye. Nayo Nawomi yakawa kumupela Lutu wukoko wono mwene Nawomi kasigaza mu ndigwa ye misi.
19 Hanyuma, Nawomi yakamuwuza Lutu yakatya, “Alo zuwali kwihi kono wuwuhalaye wuhemba wose wuwu? Hamba wali mugunda wa nani, mono wali kwihalaliza? Mulungu yamumotye munhu yuyo mono yendezwe nagwe. Nayo, Lutu yakawa kumulonjela Nawomi, nha vyono yali kuhalala mu mugunda wa munhu mono yakucemwa Bowazi.”
20 Nayo Nawomi yakatya, “Muwaha Mulungu yamumotye Bowazi!” Muwaha Mulungu mono kawukamisaga wihuwizo wakwe kuli womi na kuli wono wafwiye. Yakajendelela kanyhi kutya, “Munhu yuyo ndugu yetu, kanyhi yo munhu muyagwe na wono wena ling'ani yo wuhale.”

21 Nayo Lutu u Mumowabu yakatya, “Na yono swanu kuciza zose, kanonjela katya, neze kuhalala wuhemba mumo du mu mugunda wakwe, hamonga ne waduduzi wakwe, sunga lono walamalila ndudula.”
22 Nawomi yakamutya Lutu. “Heya mwanangu, yowa viswanu kuli'gwe wuwe kwituma hamonga ne wetumami we cicekulu wono wakwituma mu mugunda wa Bowazi. Hambi nha manyile vyono, hono wubite wukahalale mu mugunda wa munhu yunji, munya mugunda wuwo, koswa yakukugaza bwete.”
23 Nayo Lutu yakajendelela kwituma hamonga nawo no kuhalala wuhemba, sunga ndudula yose yo wuhemba yikawa yamalika. Nayo Lutu yakajendelela du kwikala no mukwewe.


Lutu 3

Lutu yakutolwa

1 Hanyuma Nawomi yakamutya Lutu, “Mwanangu, ane nghuwona vyono yowa viswanu, hono nghulondolele mulume yakutole, ho wutuje nyumba yako go mweneco.
2 Wukumbucile vyono munhu ayu Bowazi, mono mwetumanaga hamonga ne wetumami wakwe we cicekulu mu mugunda, ase ndugu yetu. Alu hulicize, cinyamihe cici, mwene kowa kwela wuhemba.
3 Holeka wihovugaje no kwibaka mafuta ge mhunjile swanu, wuvwale ne vivwalo vyako viswanu. Hanyuma wubite kuko ku cuga kono yakwelela wuhemba. Ninga mwene yalece manya vyono nagwe wuli baho, sunga kolo yamala kulya no kung'wa.
4 Wumulanjililaje hono yakubita kugona, na kolo yakondya kugona nhongo, nagwe wubite wukesosomece mu mwenda wakwe wo kwifunika ku lubavu lwa ku migulu yakwe, wuwe kugona baho. Nayo mwene kokulonjela cono wunoze.”
5 Lutu yakamupitula Nawomi yakatya, “Ale viswanu yaya, ane nokwituma zose nha vyono wunonjeye.”

6 Hobaho, Lutu yakawa kubita ku cuga no kwituma zose zono mukwewe yamulonjela.
7 Bowazi yaza kondya kulya no kung'wa yakawa na nyemo mu nhumbula yakwe. Yakawa kubita he 'lundo lyo wuhemba no kugona nhongo. Nayo Lutu yakawa kubita mholamhola, yakawa kuwugubula mwenda yakawa kwisosomeka no kugona ha magulu ga Bowazi.
8 Na mucilo mugati, Bowazi yakenuka nhinicizo, no kupituka, yakezina muno kumuwona munhu wa cicekulu yagonile baho.
9 Yakamuwuza yakatya, “Alu gwegwe nani?” Nayo Lutu yakapitula yakatya, “Gwe muwaha wangu, nene Lutu no mwitumami wako. Hambi nha yo gwegwe mono wuli ndugu ye behi, kanyhi mono wudahile kundima. Holeka nghukunena wuhalaje.”

10 Nayo Bowazi yakamutya, “Ale Muwaha Mulungu yakumotye mwanangu. Hambi nha wukulajila cogopo ciwaha ca mu mhuga yenyu, muli zono wukwituma aluno, kuciza zono wetuma kuli mukwewo Nawomi. Hamba nhavivyo, yali yinojeye wubite wukamulondole mulume muzelelo, hamba yawe mugoli hamba muciwa. Ninga agwe vyo si wunozize nhavivyo.
11 Holeka Lutu, wulece kwihwelela. Nane nokunozeza zose zono wukuhila, hambi wanhu wose wa mwi'kaya, nha wakumanyile vyono wuli mucekulu muswanu.
12 Mbeka ane nili ndugu ye behi, na kanyhi ndahile kukudima. Ninga koyali munhu yunji, we ndugu ye behi, kuciza ane.
13 Holeka wugone baha sunga wele, nane kolo wela, ho nowona hono munhu yuyo kosuma kukudima hamba ng'o. Na hono yiwe vyo yinha, ale yowa nghani swanu, na hono yilece kusumika, ale hodu. Nane nghwilahiza hali Muwaha Mulungu mumi, nha vyono nene nokudima.”

14 Hodu Lutu yakawa kugona baho ha magulu ga Bowazi. Ninga yakelawa kwinuka lono kukali kutitu titu, ho yalece kuwonwa na yunji, vyono Bowazi si yasaka munhu wo wose yamanye vyono Lutu yali yali baho.
15 Bowazi yakamutya Lutu, “Ale wulete mwenda wako wono wuvwalile wuwibate mu mawoko.” Nayo Lutu yakawa kuwibata, Bowazi yakawa kulunda kilo makumi mejete go wuhemba mu mwenda, yakawa kumutwika Lutu mu mutwe. Yakawa kubita nawo ku kaya kwawo.
16 Yali yeza kufika ku kaya, umukwewe Nawomi yakamuwuza yakutya, “Alo mwanangu, wuhemba kuwusola hayi?” Nayo Lutu yakawa kumuloloseza mukwewe zose zono Bowazi yamunozeze.
17 Kanyhi, “Kanyitya, ‘Si yowa viswanu mbuye kuli'gwe akuno sina cinji, holeka kawa kumhela no wuhemba wuwu wose kilo makumi mejete nghuletele.’ ”
18 Nayo Nawomi yakamutya, “Alu mwanangu Lutu, weze no wukangalile, sunga wuziwone zizi zose vyono zowa. Manyile vyono Bowazi sikoceha zuwali, sunga yayimale nghani yiyi.”


Lutu 4

Bowazi yakumutola Lutu

1 Bowazi yakawa kubita kwi'kaya, yakawa kwikala ha mulango we hanhu hono wetang'anililaga mu mikung'ano. Hanyuma u nduguye we behi muno wa Elimeleki, mono Bowazi yakawa yamutambula, nayo yakawa yakukola baho, nayo Bowazi yakawa kumucema, yakutya, “Gwe muyangu wuze ahano, mwendece wangu wikale hasi ta hadodo.” Yakawa kubita no kwikala.
2 Hobaho Bowazi yakasola wanhu yikumi wawaha wa mu 'kaya no kuwatya waze wehangulize wose baho. Nawo lono wali wekala,
3 mwene Bowazi yakawa kumulonjela nduguye yakatya, “Alu, Nawomi yawuya ku wulawa Mowabu, yakusaka kuguza mugunda wono wali we ndugu yetu Elimeleki,
4 nane nghwihwesa vyono, yikunojeye wuzimanye zizi. Holeka aluno hono wukuwusaka, wuwugulaje ha mwande ye wanhu awa wono wali bahano. Ninga hono wuwe si wukuwusaka, ale, wulonje, ku soko ling'ani yo kuwugula yikunojeye gwegwe wuwe mulongozi wo kuwugula, na hanyuma ho lwangu.” Nayo munhu yu yulya yakatya, “Nowugula nene.”

5 Bowazi yakamutya, “Ale viswanu! Ninga hono kuwugula mugunda wuwo ku wulawa kwa Nawomi, wumanye vyono wukumuguliliza na Lutu u mu Mowabu mufwile, no mugunda wikale mu mhuga yo munhu mono yafwiye.”
6 Nayo munhu yuyo yakapitula yakatya, “Hono yili nhavivyo, nokulecela ling'ani yangu yo kuwugula mugunda, ku soko yikwijela vyono iwanangu, si wowuhala mugunda wuwo. Holeka ciba wuwugule go mweneco.”
7 Mu vilo vye katali vye Waisilayeli, lono munhu yaguzaga, hamba kukawaniza sawo, awu wali wo moto kuli yuyo mono yaguzaga, yasolaga lilatu lyakwe, no kumupela mono yakugula, na mu nzila yiyi muli Isilayeli yalajilaga nha vyono nghani yimalika.

8 No munhu yuyo yaza kuwa yalonga na Bowazi, yakamutya, “Wugulaje gwegwe.” Hobaho yakasola lilatu lyakwe, no kumupela Bowazi.
9 Baho Bowazi yakawalonjela i wawaha na wose wono wali wali baho yakatya, “Anye wose muli wahomelezi zuwali, vyono ane nghondya kuvigula ku wulawa kuli Nawomi vinhu vyose vyono vyali vya Elimeleki hamonga na vye wanagwe Ciliyoni na Maloni.”
10 Kanyhi na mu wityatye wo moto wetu, Lutu u mu Mowabu, u mulekwa na Maloni, kowa mugolece wangu. Na mu nzila yiyi, sawo yokwikala mu mawoko ge mhuga yo munhu mono yafwiye, no wityatye wo lulelo lwe mhuga yakwe, lojendelela muli wanhu wakwe, na mwi' kaya lyakwe. Nanye yo nyenye wahomelezi muli zizi izuwali.
11 Nawo wawaha, hamonga ne wanhu wose wakatya, “Heya, ase cili wahomelezi. Nayo Muwaha Mulungu yamunoze mucekulu wako yawe nha Laheli na Leya, wono walela wana wenji kuli Yakobo, nagwe wuwe mugoli mu lulelo lwa Efulata, no kuwa munhu muwaha mu Betelehemu.
12 Ne wana wono Muwaha Mulungu kokupela agwe kuli muhinza yuyu, woyinoza mhuga yako yiwe nha mhuga ya Pelezi, mwana wa Yuda na Tamali.”

Bowazi no lulelo lwakwe

13 Hodu, Bowazi yakamusola Lutu no kumutegula ku kaya yakwe yakawa mugolece wakwe. Muwaha Mulungu yakamumotya, nayo yakadinghula nda, yakalela mwana wa cilume.
14 Nayo Lutu yakamutya Nawomi, “Yalumbwe Muwaha Mulungu mono yakupelile mwizukulu zuwali mono kokudima agwe. No muzelelo yuyu, yeze yamanyice muli Isilayeli.
15 No mukwewo yakwendile muno, kanyhi yakondya kukwitumila zinyinji kuciza wana we cilume mupunghati. Nalu yakupela mwizukulu mono koleta mikalile mipya no kukudima mu wukombi wako.”
16 Nawomi yakamusola u mwana no kumupagata, yakawa yo mukoci wakwe.

17 Nawo i wacekulu wekalani wayagwe, wakamucemela umwana litagwa lya Obedi. Nawo wakawa kuwalonjela wanhu wose nha vyono lu, u mwana we cilume kalelwa kuli Nawomi. Obedi yakawa yo sogo wa Yese mono yali sogo wa Dawudi.
18 Ayi yo mhuga yo lulelo lono lulawiliye kuli Pelezi sunga kuli Dawudi; wawo wo wana wa Pelezi.
19 Pelezi yakamulela Hezeloni, Hezeloni yakamulela Lamu,
20 Lamu yakamulela Aminadabu; Aminadabu yakamulela Nasoni,
21 Nasoni yakamulela Salimona, Salimona yakamulela Bowazi; Bowazi yakamulela Obedi;
22 Obedi yakamulela Yese; Yese yakamulela Dawudi.


1 Samwili 1

Elikana hamonga ne Mhuga yakwe ku Shilo

1 Kwali na munhu, yacemwaga Elikana, mulawa mu mhuga ya Efulayimu, munhu, yuyu yekalaga mu citumbi ca Lama, mu yisi ye matunda ya Efulayimu. Elikana yali mwana wa Yelohamu, kanyhi yakawa mwizukulu wa Elihu, yali we mhuga ya Tohu, na ku lubavu lunji, yakawa we mhuga ya Zufu.
2 Elikana yakawa na wagolece wejete, Hana na Penina. Penina yakawa yena wana, ninga Hana yakawa yasina mwana hamba monga.
3 Elikana yalawaga ku Lama yakubita ku Shilo kamonga kwa mwaka, ho yakahembe, no kumulavizya Muwaha Mulungu Mudaha vyose, makumbiko kuko ku Shilo. Ne wana wejete wa Eli, Hofuni na Finehasi, i wakohani wo Muwaha Mulungu wo wali wali kuko.
4 Na mu vilo vyose lono Elikana yalavyaga makumbiko gakwe, yamugawilaga na Penina ligawo lyakwe lye nyama, hamonga ne magawo ge wanagwe wose.
5 Hamba yawe yali yamwendile Hana muno muno, ninga yamupelaga ligawo limonga du, vyono Muwaha Mulungu si yali yamupelile wana yaye.
6 Nayo Penina yamusagalaga muno muno Hana, ho yamukalaze, vyono Muwaha Mulungu yali si yamupelile wana.
7 Ne zinghani zizo, kuli Penina, zikajendelela du mwaka na mwaka. Na mu vilo vyose, kolo wabita ku Nyumba yo Muwaha Mulungu, Penina yamusagalaga Hana no kumukalaza muno, sunga nhondo, Hana kawa kulila mahozi, kawa kwizila no kulya.
8 Nayo mulume wakwe Elikana ya kawa kumuwuza yakutya, “Hana, alu wukulilila cici? Alu nhawule wezila no kulya? Kanyhi nhawule nhondo zose, nghuwonaga wina wukalale? Wule, ane si nili muswanu kuli'gwe si nha wana we cilume yikumi?”

Hana na Eli mukohani

9 Na mwizuwa linji, lono wali wakondya kulya zindigwa mu Nyumba yo Muwaha Mulungu kuko ku Shilo, hodu, Hana yakawa kwinuka,
10 akuno yali mu wusungu wuwaha muno muno, yakalila muno lono yalombaga kuli Muwaha Mulungu. Akuno nayo Eli mukohani yekaye ha wikalo wakwe du ha mulango.
11 Nayo Hana yakehuwiza ko wilahize yakatya, “Gwe go Muwaha Mulungu we mihanga, wunangaje ane no mwitumami wako! Wulanje zo wugaye wangu, wunghumbucile! Wulecele lukulu kusemwa! Nane nghwihuwiza nha vyono, hono wumhele mwana we cilume, nane nomulavya kuli'gwe, yawe wako mu mikalile yakwe yose, na kanyhi, hamba si kocetela lukulu zimvili zakwe.”

12 Nayo Hana yakajendelela kumulomba Muwaha Mulungu du kwa cidaha citali. Nayo Eli mukohani, yakawuwona mulomo wa Hana vyono wukuvina.
13 Hambi Hana nha yalombaga si yakulavya lizi yaye, langa mulomo wakwe wo wavinaga du. Holeka Eli mukohani yali yeza kuziwona zizo, yakehwesa vyono Hana yali yagalile divayi,
14 holeka Eli yakamutya Hana, “Alu Hana, ho kogala sunga nili lu? Ale, wulecele lukulu divayi yako, kanyhi weze wuli mwiyimizi!”
15 Nayo Hana yakamupitula yakatya, “Ng'o, ye, 'gwe mukohani ane, si ngalile yaye, hamba nghali si nang'wa divayi yaye! Langa nhumbula yangu yimemile wukalale. Nane nali nili muwulombe, nghumuwicila Muwaha Mulungu wugaye wangu.
16 Holeka wulece kwihwesa nha vyono ane nili mucekulu we caka caka, aa, ng'o. Langa ane nghulomba nhavivi, vyono nhumbula yangu yili mu wukalale wuwaha muno muno.”
17 Nayo Eli mukohani, yakamutya Hana, “Ale wubite wupolile, nayo Mulungu wa Isilayeli yakupele cico cono wumulombile.”
18 Nayo Hana yakamutya Eli mukohani, “Ale, nane no mwitumami wako nghukulomba, nhondo zose neze nina wendezwe hali gwe.” Hana yali yeza kukondya kuzilonga zizo, hodu yakawa kutuluka, yakawa kubita kulya ndigwa. Na ku wulawa baho, si yatuga wukalale kanyhi.

U wulelwe wa Samwili, hamonga no wusiwanulwe wakwe

19 I mitondo yaco, Elikana hamonga na we mhuga yakwe, wakelawa kwinuka hakali mitondo muno. Nawo wali weza kukondya kumuhemba Muwaha Mulungu, hodu wakawa, kuwuya kwawo ku Lama. Nayo Elikana yakamumanya Hana mugolece wakwe. Nayo Muwaha Mulungu yakawupitula wulombe wakwe.
20 Hana yakatuga 'nda, yakalela mwana wa cilume. Yakamucemela litagwa lya Samwili, nhunizo yayo, “Nimulombile kuli Muwaha Mulungu.”
21 Lizuwa likawa lyafika lyo wubita ku Shilo, Elikana hamonga na we mhuga yakwe, ho wakamulavizye Muwaha Mulungu likumbiko lye myaka yose, lyono yali yehuwiza.
22 Ninga mu cipango cico, Hana si yasuma kubita, yakamulonjela mulume wakwe yakutya, “U mwana kolo yakondya kuleswa ane nomutegula ku Nyumba yo Muwaha Mulungu yekale kuko mu mikalile yakwe yose.”
23 Nayo Elikana yakamupitula Hana yakatya, “Ale, witume gwegwe nha vyono wukuwona viswanu. Wikalaje hono kaya, sunga kolo wakondya kumulesa. Nayo Muwaha Mulungu yafisilize wihuwizo wakwe.” Holeka Hana yakawa kwikala ha kaya, yakamosa mwana sunga yakawa kumulesa.

24 Nayo yali yeza kumulesa mwana, hodu, yakawa kumutegula ku Shilo, yakasoleleza hamonga na nzeku monga ya myaka midatu, na kilo yikumi za wusaje, hamonga no mufuko wa nyhingo wumemile divayi. Yakawa kumusola Samwili yakali mudodo du, yakawa kumutegula ku Shilo, ku Nyumba yo Muwaha Mulungu.
25 Nawo wali weza kukondya kuyiwulaga nzeku yiyo, wakamusola mwana Samwili, wakamutegula kuli Eli mukohani.
26 Nayo Hana yakamulonjela Eli mukohani yakutya, “Gwe muwaha wangu, ane nghukulomba wunenele. Mwene wunghumbuciye? Ane yo nene mucekulu yulya, mono wambona nimile bahano, nghulomba kuli Muwaha Mulungu.
27 Namulomba yamhele mwana ayu, nayo yakahulika wulombe wangu, yakawa kumhela cono namulomba.
28 Holeka nane 'lu nghumulavizya Muwaha Mulungu mwana yuyu. Nayo mwana yuyu kowa sawo yo Muwaha Mulungu du, mu vilo vyakwe vyose vyo wikale wakwe.” Wakamuhemba Muwaha Mulungu baho.


1 Samwili 2

Wulombe wa Hana

1 Nayo Hana yakalomba yakutya,

“Muwaha Mulungu kayimemya nhumbula yangu nyemo,

Nane sangalaye muno so zose zono yanhendeye!

Nane nowaseka walugu wangu

so nyemo yono nina nayo,

vyono nghuyisanglalila mhonelo yakwe!

2 “Hasina mono yelile nha vyono Mulungu yelile,

hambi nha hasina yunji, langa gwegwe du,

hamba hasina mudimi yunji

mono yehwanile no Mulungu wetu.”

3 Mulecele lukulu wulonji wenyu wo wiwoni,

munyamalile lukulu ne zinghani zenyu zo widunhumuzi,

Hambi u Muwaha Mulungu, nha yo Mulungu

mono yazimanyile zose,

Nayo kaling'anizizaga muli zono wanhu wakwituma.

4 I mapinde ge vitung'ati, gabeneka.

Ninga i wasocele wakucila kutuga vilungo.

5 I wanhu wono wali wali ciguto ha lulongozi,

alu weza kwilimiliza kuli wanji

ho watuje ndigwa,

Ninga wono wali nzala, hamba

si wodabucila lukulu.

No mugolece mugumba, alu yalela wana mupunghati.

Ninga mucekulu we wana wenji,

kalekwa yali bwete.

6 U Muwaha Mulungu kawulagaga,

kanyhi kawumifyaga,

kawategulaga wanhu ko ku yisi

ye wafu, kanyhi kawagomola.

7 Kawanozaga wanhu wanji wawa waciwa,

na wanji wawa wagoli

wanji kawanyetyaga,

na wanji kawakumyaga.

8 Kamwinulaga muciwa mu wulawa

mu manghundi

no kumminula mono yena wanjile

mu wugazice wakwe.

Kawa kuwekaza hamonga ne wawaha

kawawika i hanhu ho lukumyo.

Hambi u musinji we yinze, nha wakwe Muwaha Mulungu,

nayo yayisimya yinze mucanyha yo musinji wuwo.

9 “Kawadimaga i wanhu wakwe wehuwilwa

ninga i wanhu wetuma wubi,

wokongomezezwa mu citi

hambi nha hasina munhu, mono

kasumaga kwe vilungo vyakwe mweneco.

10 Nawo wono wesumanizaga no Muwaha Mulungu

wokongomezwa,

hambi nha kowatowa ne limuli lya ku wulanga,

Muwaha Mulungu koyiling'aniza yinze yose,

no komupela mutemi wakwe vilungo,

komupela wusume u mutemi wakwe muhagulwa.”

11 Hanyuma ya zizo, Elikana yakawa kuwuya ku kaya ku Lama, ninga muzelelo Samwili, yakasigala kuko ku Shilo, yakajendelela kumwitumamila Muwaha Mulungu mu wutonji wa Eli mukohani.

I wana we cilume wa Eli

12 Ale, i wana we cilume wa Eli, wakawa wanhu wono wali wali caka caka du, wakawa wasina cogopo hamba cidodo hali Muwaha Mulungu.
13 Kanyhi wakawa wayibedegaye muno sunga ne myoto ye wakohani mu wanhu. Hambi myoto yiyo nha yali yili nhavi. Lono munhu wo wose yalavyaga likumbiko lyakwe, u mwitumami wo mukohani, yazaga yena ne cicinyilo co kunimulila nyama mu moto, cono cina vicinyilo vidatu, na kolo nyama yatogota,
14 kawa kwinjiza cicinyilo cico mu nyungu, ne nyama yo yose yono cicinhyilo cico coyicinya no kuyilavya mumo mu nyungu, nyama yiyo yiwa yo nyama yo mukohani. Na wuwu wukawa wo moto wono wetumamilwa kuli Waisilayeli wose, wono wazaga kuko ku Shilo, ku wulavya makumbiko gawo.
15 Ninga hamonga na zizo, sunga na lono mhama yikali si nanyanywa, u mwitumami wo mukohani, yazaga kawa kumulomba u munhu mono yalavyaga likumbiko yakumutya, “Ale, wumhelaje nyama yo kumukasicila mukohani, hambi nha sikoyisaka nyama yako yono yakondya kutogoswa mu nyungu, langa kosaka yono yikali nduma.”
16 Na hono munhu yuyo yapitule yatye, “Ng'o vyo si yinojeye, langa wulece cityatye wityatye vyono winha, camule ciyinyanye yiyi mhama, hanyuma nagwe ho wusole mu nghango nha vyono wendile gwegwe.” Ninga mwitumami wo mukohani nayo yatye, “Ng'o ye, langa wumhelaje lulu baha! Na hono wuleme kumhela, hodu, ane noyisola kwe vilungo!”

17 No wubi wuwu we wana we cilume wa Eli, yikawa nghani 'mbi muno muno hali Muwaha Mulungu, vyono wagatendelaga makumbiko go Muwaha Mulungu mu wu wula cogopo.

Za Samwili, lono yali yali ku Shilo

18 Ale, Samwili yakawa kwanza kumwitumamila Muwaha Mulungu kuko ku Shilo, akuno yavwalile Efodi ya bafuta.
19 Na mu myaka yose, mwaka na mwaka, Hana u nyina wa Samwili, yazaga hamonga no mulume wakwe Elikana, ku wulavya likumbiko lyo mwaka, nayo Hana yamuletelaga Samwili Efodi yono yali yimukwiliye mwi'daha lilyo.
20 Nayo Eli mukohani, yakamulugutiza Elikana, hamonga no mugolece wakwe yakatya, “Ale, Muwaha Mulungu yakupele wana wanji kanyhi, muli mugolece yuyu, ho wahomele hali mwana yuyu Samwili mono mumulavizye Muwaha Mulungu.”

Hanyuma ya zizi, wene wakawuya kwawo ku Lama.

21 Nayo Muwaha Mulungu, mbeka yakawa kumulugitiza Hana, nayo Hana yakalela wana wanji wana we cilume wadatu, hamonga ne wana we cicekulu wejete. Nayo muzelelo Samwili, yakawilucila mu witumami wo Muwaha Mulungu du.

Za Eli mukohani, ne wanagwe we cilume

22 Nayo Eli mukohani, lono yali yakombipa muno, yakazihulika zinghani zose ze wanagwe we cilume zono wawatendelaga Waisilayeli. Kanyhi na vyono wagonaga ne wacekulu, wono wetumaga milimo ya ha mulango we Lihema lyono Lyelile.
23 Hodu, Eli mukohani, yakawa kuwawuza wawo wanagwe we cilume yakuwatya, “Alu nhawulenyi mukwituma makani gono genha gaga? Hambi wanhu wose nha wakunonjela ze makani genyu mabi gono mukwituma.
24 Alu nghumutyenyi nhavi anye wanangu, ku wulawa izuwali, mulecele lukulu kwituma kanyhi makani gono genha gago! Hambi makani ge liwala lili, gono wanhu wo Muwaha Mulungu wakugalonga, nha mabi muno, kanyhi ga cevu ciwaha!
25 Hambi nha hono munhu yamusutizye munhu muyagwe, u Muwaha Mulungu nha komutetela. Ninga hono munhu yamusutizya Muwaha Mulungu, alu nani mono komutetela?”

Ninga wene hamba si wasaka wamuhulice u sogo yawo, hambi Muwaha Mulungu nha yali yakondya kulamula yawawulaje.

26 Nayo muzelelo Samwili, yakacila kuwiluka no kutuga wendezwe kuli Muwaha Mulungu, sunga na kuli wanhu wose.

Wuwililwe wa Eli, hamonga ne mhuga yakwe

27 Ale, u munhu wo Mulungu yakamuziza Eli, yamulonjele zono yatumigwe no Mulungu, yakamulonjela Eli yakamutya, “Lono mulezi wako Haluni hamonga ne mhuga yakwe yose wali wawanda kuli mutemi we Misili, ane nelajila kuli Haluni.
28 Na mu wulawa mu zimbeyu zose ze wana wa Isilayeli, ane nghayihagula mhuga ya Haluni, wawe wo wakohani wangu, wanyitumamile ha cikumbicilo, wawe kufusa wuvumba, kanyhi wawe kuvwala Efodi hali 'ne. Kanyhi nghawapela ne ling'ani, yo kusola ligawo, mu wulawa mu makumbiko manyanywe ga mu cikumbicilo.
29 Alu nhawulenyi kanyhi mukugamelela mate, no kugabedegala makumbiko gangu, hamonga ne vilavywa vyangu, vyono nalajiliza muli wanhu wangu? Hamba so cici agwe Eli, kwikalaga wukuwakumya wanago du, kuciza ane no mweneco. Hambi nha wukuwaleceleza wakujina, so wulya zinyama zono zijinile, za muli makumbiko gono wanhu wangu wakundavizya nene?
30 Agwe Eli, mono ane no Muwaha Mulungu we Waisilayeli, nehuwiza mu vilo vyono vipulute, nha vyono i mhuga yako, hamonga na wo mulango wako, wo wonyitumamila du nha wakohani mu vilo vyose. Ninga aluno nghutya, ane si nosuma kujendelela kugakangalila kanyhi, makani gono genha gaga! Langa, nowakumya du wono wakunghumya, kanyhi nowabedegala wono wakumbedegala.
31 Ninga wuhulicize! Lipango lyokuza, lyono nowawulaga i wazelelo wose wa mu mhuga yako na wa mu mulango wako. Hawe hasina hamba monga wa mu mhuga yako, mono kokwikala mono'nze sunga yawe mukombi.
32 Nagwe kotuga magazo, no kuwuwonela ko wivu uwulugutwe wose wono nowapela wanji wa muli wa Isilayeli. Ninga wa muli mhuga yako, hasina hamba monga, mono kosuma kanyhi kwikala sunga yaze yakombipe.
33 Ninga hamba nhavivyo, nolomusigaza munhu monga wa muli wanago, yekale mumi, nayo yo kolonyitumamila mu mulimo wo wukohani. Ninga hanyuma kolobofula, yawe yasina kanyhi witumbilo. Ne wanago wanji wose wolofwila mu magazo mawaha muno.
34 Na kolo i wanago Hofuni na Finehasi, wakufwila wose mwi'zuwa limonga, ale baho langa, ho kolomanyila vyono zose zono nazilonga, mbeka zoloficilicila.
35 Nane nolomuhagula mukohani mono kowa mwihuwilwa kuli'ne, mono kosuma kwituma zose, nha vyono nomulajiliza yetume. Kanyhi nolomupela wana wono wowa kwitumama hali mutemi wangu muhagulwa wangu.
36 Kanyhi yolowa, wo wose wa muli wanago, mono kolosigala mumi mu nyumba yako, kolokuza kuli yuyo mukohani yawe kumulomba yamupele mapesa, hamba ndigwa. Kanyhi kolomba yawikwe mu mulimo wunji wo kuwetumamila wakohani ho yatuje cinji co kulya.”


1 Samwili 3

U Muwaha Mulungu, yakwilajila kuli Samwili

1 Na mu vilo vivyo, lono muzelelo Samwili, yamwitumamilaga Muwaha Mulungu, hasi yo wulanjilizi wa Eli mukohani, nghani yo Muwaha Mulungu yikawa nyhefu, no wugubulilwe nawo, wono wukulawa kuli Mulugu wukawa wa kamonga kamonga muno.
2 Ale, mwi'zuwa linji ne cilo, lono na Eli yali yeza behi no kubofula, yali yagonile mu cinyumba cakwe,
3 Samwili nayo, yali yagonile hono hali liwicigwe Lisanduku lye Cilagane mu Nyumba yo Mulungu. Na hakali mitondo muno, lono kwali kukali kutitu ne zitala zali zikali nazima,
4 Muwaha Mulungu yakamucema Samwili, nayo Samwili yakedika yakatya, “Ane nili baha.”
5 Yakatuluka lumangho yakamubitila Eli mukohani, yakamutya, “Ane naza, hambi nha hulika wukunyhema.”

Ninga Eli mukohani yakamupitula yakamutya, “Ane si nghucemile yaye, wubite wukagone.” Nayo Samwili yakawa kubita kugona.

6 Muwaha Mulungu yakamucema Samwili kanyhi. Nayo Samwili hamba si yamanya vyono, mono yakumucema, yo Muwaha Mulungu, hambi Muwaha Mulungu nha yali yakali nalongana nayo mwi'zuwa linji lyo lyose.
7 Ale, Samwili yakenuka, yakamubitila Eli mukohani kanyhi, yakamutya, “Ane naza, hambi nha hulika wukunyhema.”

Ninga Eli mukohani yakamupitula yakamutya, “Gwe mwanangu Samwili, ane singhucemile yaye, wubite wukagone.”

8 Muwaha Mulungu yakamucema Samwili kanyhi lwe kadatu. Nayo Samwili yakenuka, yakamubitila Eli mukohani, yakamutya, “Ane naza, hambi nha hulika wukunyhema.”

Nhondo baho Eli mukohani, yakezuka vyono yo Muwaha Mulungu mono yali kumucema mudodo.
9 Holeka Eli yakawa kumulonjela Samwili yakatya, “Alu wubite kanyhi wukagone, na hono wuhulice yakucema kanyhi, agwe wumupitulaje wutye, ‘Wulonje Muwaha, u mwitumami wako yakuhulika.’ ” Nayo Samwili yakawa kubita kugona.
10 Muwaha Mulungu yakaza yakema bahalya kanyhi, yakawa kucema, nha vyono yakacema halulongozi yakatya, “Samwili! Samwili!”

Nayo Samwili yakedika yakatya, “Wulonje Muwaha, u mwitumami wako yakuhulika.”
11 Muwaha Mulungu yakamulonjela yakatya, “Lanje, ta Samwili, ane nokwituma nghani muli wanhu wa Isilayeli, nghani ya kogofya, yono munhu wo wose mono koyihulika, yomucelewaza.
12 Na mwizuwa lilyo, nomufisiliziza Eli, zose zono nalonga ze kaya yakwe, ku wulawa mwamulizo sunga ko ku ndumilizo.
13 Hambi nha nakondya kumumanyiza vyono, noyilipiciza kaya yakwe cibitilila. Hambi i wanagwe we cilume nha walonga nghani zimbi kuli'ne. Nayo Eli yali yamanyile, nha vyono wetumaga zizo, ninga hamba si yasuma kuwemila yaye.
14 Holeka nane nayilahila nyumba ya Eli vyono, makumbiko ne vilavywa, si vyosuma kuwukwema wubi we nyumba ya Eli cibitilila.”

15 Nayo Samwili yakajendelela kugona, sunga wukela hakali mitondo. Hanyuma yakawa kwinuka, yakawa kuyidigula milango ye Nyumba yo Muwaha Mulungu. Ninga yakogopa kumumanyiza Eli zizo zono zimwijeleye.
16 Ninga Eli yakamucema Samwili yakatya, “Gwe Samwili mwanangu!” Nayo Samwili yakedika yakatya, “Ane nili baha.”

17 Eli yakamutya Samwili, “Alu Muwaha Mulungu kakulonjela cici? Nghukunena wulece kuhundicila nghani hamba monga. Hambi u Muwaha Mulungu nha kokulipiciza ko wukali muno muno hono wulece kundoloseza zose zono yalonjile.”
18 Ale, Samwili yakawa kumuloloseza zose, si yamuhundika nghani hamba monga yaye. Eli nayo yakamupitula yakamutya, “Hambi nha yo Muwaha Mulungu, holeka kosuma kwituma nghani yo yose yono mweneco koyiwona swanu.”
19 Nayo Samwili yakajendelela kuwiluka, no Muwaha Mulungu yali yali hamonga nayo. Muwaha Mulungu yakazifisiliza zose zono Samwili yazilonga.
20 Na ku soko yiyo, i wanhu wose wa mu yisi yose ya Isilayeli, ku wulawilila mhelo ayi sunga ku mhelo nzagwe ye yisi, wose wakamanya vyono mbeka Samwili yali muwizi wo Muwaha Mulungu.
21 Nayo Muwaha Mulungu yakajendelela kwilajila baho ha Shilo, hono yelajilila kuli Samwili no kulongana nayo. Holeka i wanhu wose wa Isilayeli, wamuhulicizaga muno Samwili muli zose zono yalongaga.


1 Samwili 4

Lisandukulu lye Cilagane likusolwa

1 Na mu vilo vivyo, Wafilisiti wakekongholela hamonga, wabite wakehome ne Waisilayeli, nawo Waisilayeli, wakawa kwiwikaniza wawahome Wafilisiti. Wene Waisilayeli wakayisimya nghambi yawo ku Ebene-zeli. Nawo Wafilisiti, wakayisimya nghambi yawo ku Afeki.
2 Ale, wakawa kwanza kuwahoma Waisilayeli, no wulugu wukawa wukali muno, nawo Wafilisiti wakawawulaga Waisilayeli, wanhu elufu yine mu wulugu wawo.
3 Nawo Waisilayeli wono wasigala wakawuya ku nghambi yawo ku Ebene-zeli, i wawaha wawo wakawa kwanza kwiwuza wakutya, “Alu mwene 'nye, nhawule Muwaha Mulungu kacileceleza cisumwe ne Wafilisiti i zuwali? Ale, lu, ciba, cibite ku Shilo cikalisole Lisanduku lye Cilagane lyo Muwaha Mulungu, cililete ku kuno, u Muwaha Mulungu ho yawe yali hamonga nase, yaciponye mu walugu wetu.”
4 Ale, wakawa kutuma wanhu ku Shilo, wakawa kulisola Lisanduku lye Cilagane co Muwaha Mulungu we Mihanga, mono kekalaga haciligati ye makelubi, wakawa kulileta kuko ku nghambi yawo. Nawo wana wa Eli wejete we cilume, Hofuni na Finehasi, vikazana ne Lisanduku lye Cilagane lyo Muwaha Mulungu kuko ku nghambi.

5 Nalyo Lisanduku lye Cilagane lyo Muwaha Mulungu, lyali lyeza kufika baho ha nghambi, hodu, wa Isilayeli wakawa kwanza kuzoza izozo yiwaha so nyemo, sunga ne yisi yikabocelela.
6 Nawo Wafilisiti wali weza kulihulika lizozo lilyo, wakawa kwiwuza weneco wose wakutya, “Alu lizozo lilyo lya cici, lyono lili ku nghambi ye Wahebelaniya? Ne nhunizo yayo nyhici?” Ninga wali weza kumanya vyono Lisanduku lye Cilagane lyo Muwaha Mulungu, lyakondya kuza, lili mu nghambi ye Wahebelaniya,
7 hodu wakenjilwa no woga wuwaha muno muno, wakatya “Alu milungu yakondya kuwaziza mu nghambi yawo! Holeka alu langa camalika wose! Hambi nha hasina nghani yinji yono yinha yiyino, yono yacijelela ku wulawa na katali!
8 Alu nani mono kosuma kuciponya wulawa mu milungu yiyo ye vilungo? Hambi nha yo milungu yono yawongomeza Wamisili mu nyika!
9 Holeka alu anye nyo Wafilisiti mweze muli vilungo, kanyhi mwihome cilume-lume, ho cilece kuwa wawanda we Wahebelaniya, nha vyono wene wali wawanda wetu. Holeka mwihome cilumelume!”
10 Nawo Wafilisiti wakawahoma Waisilayeli kwe vilungo vyawo vyose, sunga wakawasuma. Waisilayeli wakatiziza ku zikaya zawo. Na mu wulugu wuwo wukali muno, wakawulagwa wasilikale elufu makumi madatu we Waisilayeli.
11 Ne Lisanduku lye Cilagane co Muwaha Mulungu, nalyo likasolwa ne Wafilisiti, ne wana wa Eli wejete we cilume, Hofuni na Finehasi, nawo wakawulagwa nhavivyo.

Wufwe wa Eli mukohani

12 Munhu yunji mulawa mu mulango wa Benyamini, yakawa kumangha ku wulawilila kwi'wanza lyo wulugu, sunga ku Shilo, nayo yakafika kuko ku Shilo mwi'zuwa lililya du. Yakawa kuyidemulanga myenda yono yali yayivwalile, yakeyitila ne manghundi mu mutwe wakwe, ho yalajile wukalale no wusungu wono yali yena nawo.
13 Nayo Eli vyono yali yena nyhilu muno yo kuliwona Lisanduku lye Cilagane lyo Muwaha Mulungu, yali yekaye mwi'goda, hamhelo ye nzila, yakulanjilila. Nayo munhu yuyulya, yakawa kwanza kuzilonga zinghani mwi'kaya lyose. Ne wanhu wose wono wazihulika, wakawa kulila muno so woga.
14 Nayo Eli kumbe, yakalihulika lizozo lilyo, yakawa kuwuza yakutya, “Alu, 'nye, lizozo lili lina nhunizoci?” Nayo munhu yuyulya yakawa kumubitila Eli mbela mbela, yakawa kumulonjela zose nha vyono zinha.
15 (Lulo nayo Eli, yali yaficila myaka makumi yicenda na munana, ne meso gakwe gali gakondya kutukuwala, hamba si yakusuma kanyhi kuwona.)
16 Nayo munhu yuyo yakamulonjela Eli yakatya, “Ane mhonamhona mu wulugu zuwali, niwa kutiziza akuno.” Nayo Eli yakamuwuza yakatya, “Alu ma wanangu zinyhici zono ziwejeleye kuko?”

17 Nayo munhu yuyo yakamupitula yakamutya, “Waisilayeli wasumwa, kanyhi watiza ha mwande ye Wafilisiti. Na mbeka wacisumiliza vibi muno muno! Ninga hamonga na zizo, sunga ne wanago, Hofuni na Finehasi, wose wawulagwa. Ne Lisanduku lye Cilagane lyo Muwaha Mulungu, nalyo lisolwa ne Wafilisiti!”
18 Nayo munhu yuyo, yali yeza kutambula ze Lisanduku lye Cilagane lyo Muwaha Mulungu du, hobaho Eli, yakawa kugwa cinghata, mu wulawa mwigoda lyakwe lyono yali yekaliye, baho hamhelo yo mulango we likaya. Nayo yali yeza mukombi muno, kanyhi yali yo munhu mono yali yajinile muno. Holeka mu wugwe wuwo, singo yakwe yikabeneka, nayo hobaho du yakawa kufwa.

Nayo yali mulamuzi mu Waisilayeli myaka makumi mane.

Wufwe wo mugolece wa Finehasi

19 Nayo mukwewe we cicekulu wa Eli, mono yali yo mugolece wa Finehasi, mu vilo vivyo yakawa yena 'nda. Ne vilo vyakwe vyo kusawa, vikawa vyafika. Nayo yali yeza kuhulika nha vyono Lisanduku lye Cilagane lyo Muwaha Mulungu lyasolwa ne Wafilisiti, na vyono Eli u mukwewe hamonga no mulume wakwe, wose wakondya kufwa, hodu nayo hobaho du yakawa kwibatwa no wusungu wo kusawa, yakawa kusawa.
20 Na lono yali yeza behi no kufwa i wacekulu wono wamutazaga, wakamutya, “Wulece kogopa, hambi nha kolela mwana wa cilume!” Ninga mwene hamba si yapitula cinji, hamba kumulanga mwana.
21 Nayo yakamucemela mwanagwe litagwa lyakwe Ikabodi, nhunizo yayo, “Lukumyo lwo Muwaha Mulungu lwawaleka Waisilayeli.” Yakawa kutuniliza wusolwe we Lisanduku lye Cilagane co Muwaha Mulungu, hamonga no wufwe wo mulume wakwe hamonga no mukwewe Eli.
22 Yakatya, “Lukumyo lwawawucila Waisilayeli. Hambi Lisanduku lye Cilagane lyo Muwaha Mulungu nha lyasolwa.”


1 Samwili 5

Lisanduku lye Cilagane lyo Muwaha Mulungu, lili mu Wafilisiti

1 Nawo Wafilisiti wali weza kulisola Lisanduku lye Cilagane lyo Muwaha Mulungu, wakalidinghula, wakaliwusa kuko ku Ebene-zeli, wakalitegula kwi'kaya lyawo lya Ashidodi.
2 Wakaliwika mugati ye nyumba ya Dagoni, u mulungu wawo, wakaliwika ha mhelo behi na Dagoni.
3 Nawo wanhu wa Ashidodi, wali weza kusinhuka hakali mitondo muno muno mwi'zuwa lye kejete, walanje nhavi, wakawa kuwona u mulungu wawo Dagoni, yagwiye wugubama ha mwande ye Lisanduku lye Cilagane lyo Muwaha Mulungu. Ale du, wakawa kumwinula yuyo mulungu wawo Dagoni, wakawa kumusimya kanyhi hanhu hayo hono yali.
4 Ninga mwi'zuwa lye kejete wali weza kusinhuka hakali mitondo muno muno, walanje, wakawa kuwona u mulungu wawo Dagoni yagwiye kanyhi wugubama, hamwande ye Lisanduku lye Cilagane co Muwaha Mulungu. Ninga muhinzo wuwu, Dagoni yakawa yabeneka mutwe wakwe, hamonga ne maganza gose vyono mejete, vigwiye vyose ha mulango, na Dagoni yasigala ne ciwili-wili cili wene.
5 (Holeka i wakohani hamonga ne wahembi wose wa Dagoni, si wakanyagaga ha mulango wa Dagoni kuko ku Ashidodi sunga nalu.)

6 Nayo Muwaha Mulungu yakawalipiciza wanhu wawo wa ku Ashidodi ko wusungu wuwaha muno. Yakawalipiciza wene, hamonga ne wanhu wose, wono wali wapilime behi behi ne yisi yawo, mu nzila yo kuwaletela mapu mu yisi yose.
7 Nawo wali weza kuziwona zizo zono zijeye, wakawa kutya, “Mulungu we wa Isilayeli yo yakucilipiciza sese, hamonga no mulungu wetu Dagoni. Holeka nase si cosuma kulileka kanyhi Lisanduku lye Cilagane lyo Muwaha Mulungu lijendelele kwikala hono hetu.”
8 Holeka wakawa kutuma wanhu, wakawaceme watemi wose wahano we Wafilisiti wekongholele hamonga. Wakawawuza wakutya, “Nye nyo watemi, alu cilinoze nhawule Lisanduku lili lye Cilagane lyo Muwaha Mulungu we wa Isilayeli?”

Nawo watemi wakapitula wakatya, “Mulisolaje mulihamizye ku Gati.” Wakalisola wakalihamizya kwi'kaya linji lye Wafilisiti.
9 Ninga Lisanduku lilyo lyali lyeza kufiswa kuko, nayo Muwaha Mulungu, yakalilipiciza likaya lilyo nalyo ko wuhangawe wuwaha muno. Yakawatowa ne mapu, wose wa mwikaya lilyo, i wawaha ne wadodo.
10 Ale, du, nawo wakalisola Lisanduku lilyo lye Cilagane lyo Muwaha Mulungu, wakalihamizya kwi'kaya linji kanyhi lye Wafilisiti, lyono likucemwa Ekiloni. Ninga kanyhi, lyali lyeza kufika kuko, i wanhu wa mwi'kaya lilyo, nawo wakanza kulila muno muno, wakutya, “Alu mulanje, waciletela Lisanduku lye Cilagane lyo Muwaha Mulungu we Waisilayeli, ho liciwulaje nase wose!”
11 Hodu, wakawa kuwakonghola kanyhi i watemi we Wafilisiti, wakawalonjela wakatya, “Nye watemi, muligomolaje Lisanduku lye Cilagane lye Waisilayeli hanhu halyo, ho lilece kuciwulaga ase wose hamonga na we zimhuga zetu.” Ne wanhu wose wa mwikaya, wakawa kwinjilwa na mahwele mawaha muno muno, hambi Mulungu nha yakawalipiciza ko wulipicizwe wo wusungu muno muno.
12 Hambi nha sunga na wose wono si wafwa, wakatowa ne mapu. Ne wanhu wose wakawa wakulila, wakuyililila milungu yawo wakulondola wutazi.


1 Samwili 6

Wugomolwe we Lisanduku lye Cilagane lyo Muwaha Mulungu

1 Nalyo Lisanduku lye Cilagane lyo Muwaha Mulungu, lyali lyeza lyekala mu yisi ye Wafilisiti myezi mupunghati.
2 I Wafilisiti wakawacema i wakohani ne waganga, wakawawuza wakutya, “Alu 'nye, cilitendele wule Lisandukulu lye Cilagane lyo Muwaha Mulungu? Na hono cende, ciligomole kono lyalawilila, coligomole hamonga ne cinhuci?”
3 Nawo wakawapitula wakawatya, “Hono muwe mukusaka kuligomola Lisanduku lye Cilagane lyo Muwaha Mulungu we wa Isilayeli, munojeye muligomoleze hamonga ne cipegwa kuli Muwaha Mulungu, so wubi wenyu. Holeka mulanjilile, mulece kuligomola Lisanduku lye Cilagane lyo Muwaha Mulungu lisina hamba cipegwa cocose. Vyono mu nzila yiyi mo moponela, kanyhi ho momanya soko yono yilecile yakumulipicizenyi.”

4 Nawo Wafilisiti wakawuza wakatya, “Alu cilavywaci ce lisutya cono comugomolela.”

Nawo wakohani we waganga wakawapitula wakatya, “Mutegule mapu mahano ga zahabu, na ngule yihano za zahabu, vyono linha liwalo lye walongola wahano we Wafilisiti. Hambi nhe lipicizo limonga lyono mulipicizwe nyenye wose, hamonga ne walongola wenyu wahano.
5 Ale, munoze vihwani vye mapu genyu, ne vihwani vye magule genyu, vyono vihodangaga yisi yenyu. Kanyhi mumupele Muwaha Mulungu we Waisilayeli cogopo. Holeka lunji nayo koleka kumulipicizenyi nyenye, ne milungu yenyu hamonga ne yisi yenyu.
6 Alu nhawule mweza musina cihuliko, nha vyono yali yenha u mutemi Falawo wa Misili ne Wamisili, wono wali wasina cihuliko? Mukumbucile vyono Mulungu yawanoza, sunga nhondo, wakawa kuwakombola Waisilayeli wawuce mu Misili.
7 Holeka aluno, munoze mukokoteni wo kulikwega, muwikanize na ng'ombe nyejete zono zikali si zinetuma mulimo, muziwopeleze ng'ombe zizo mu mukokoteni wuwo. Ninga zinyehe zazo, muzigomoleze mwi'bululu.
8 Hanyuma mulisole Lisanduku lye Cilagane lyo Muwaha Mulungu, mulijelece mucanyha yo mukokoteni wuwo, hanyuma yayo, musole vivilya vihwani vye zahabu vyono mukumutegulila nha cilavywa so wubi wenyu, muvitajile mu cisanduku ca ha mhelo yalyo. Hanyuma ho mulilajile nzila, u mukokoteni wubite wuli wene.
9 Ninga nanye mweze mulilanjiliye hono liwe likukolela mu wulunji wo kubita ku yisi yalyo ku cikaya ca Bete-shemeshi, baho ho comanya vyono mbeka u Mulungu wa Isilayeli, yo yacileteye wongomezwe wuwu. Na hono yilece kuwa nhavivyo, naho comanya vyono kumbe Mulungu si yacitendeye zizo, langa ziyiziza zeneco du.”

10 Nawo Wafilisiti, wakazinoza zose nha vyono walonjelwa. Wakazisola ng'ombe nyejete, wakaziwopeleza mu mukokoteni, zinyehe zazo wakazidindila mwi'bululu.
11 Wakalisola Lisanduku lye Cilagane, wakalijeleka mucanyha yo mukokoteni, hamonga ne cisanduku cono wali watajiye mugati vihwani vye zahabu vye magule ne mapu.
12 Nazo zing'ombe zikawa kutuluka, zikawa kukola mu nzila yono yibitile ku Bete-shemeshi, zikawa kujendelela zisonjile ku cikaya cico, hamba si zayumbila kumhelo ye nzila yaye, langa zikawa zityatyizye nzila zigolocile akuno zikulila. Nawo i watemi wahano we Wafilisiti wali wali mu nyuma yazo wakuzityatya, sunga wakazifisa ha mupaka wa Bete-shemeshi.

13 Nawo wanhu wa Bete-shemeshi mu mapango gago, wali wali mu ndudula yo wuhemba mwi'lolo. Nawo walanje nhavi, nhinicizo, wakaliwona Lisanduku lye Cilagane. Wakasangalala muno muno.
14 Nawo mukokoteni wukawa kuza wukawa kwinjila mu mugunda wa Yoshuwa, mono yali munya baho ha Bete-shemeshi, wukawa kwima mumo behi ne libwe yiwaha. Nawo wanhu wakawusola mukokoteni, wakawusananga ngwagu, wakaziwulaga na zizo zing'ombe, wakamulavizya Muwaha Mulungu likumbiko linyanywe.
15 Nawo Walawi wakalitimya Lisanduku lye Cilagane mu mukokoteni, hamonga ne cisanduku cono cali cina vihwani vye zahabu wakavijeleka mucanyha ye libwe liwaha. Nawo wanhu wa Bete-shemeshi, wakamulavizya Muwaha Mulungu makumbiko manyanywe, hamonga ne makumbiko ganji ganji.
16 Nawo watemi wawalya wahano we Wafilisiti, wali wali baho baho du, wazilanjiliye zose zono zetumwagwa. Hanyuma nhondo, wakawa kuwuya kanyhi ku Ekiloni mwizuwa lilyo du.

17 Wafilisiti wamutegulila Muwaha Mulungu mapu mahano ga zahabu gawe vilavywa so wubi wawo, yipu limonga limonga so makaya gose, likaya lya Ashidodi, na Gaza, na Ashikeloni, na Gati, na Ekiloni.
18 Kanyhi wakasola ne zingule zi zilya yihano ze zahabu, wakazitegula mu makaya mahano gono gali ge wawaha wawalya wahano we Wafilisiti. Na mu makaya ge magomawakali, hamonga na mu vitumbi vyono vyali visina majinji. Ne libwe li lilya liwaha lya ku Bete-shemeshi lya mu mugunda wa Yoshuwa, lyono walijeleka Lisanduku lye Cilagane lyo Muwaha Mulungu, likali lili baho, ho liwe wuhomelezi wa kuli zono zejela lulo.

19 Muwaha Mulungu yakawawulaga lwa kamonga wanhu makumi mupunghati, wa Bete-shemeshi vyono walisunjilila Lisanduku lye Cilagane. Ne wanhu wakalila muno muno, vyono Muwaha Mulungu yakaleta mafwa mawaha muli wene.

Lisanduku lye Cilagane, ha Kiliyati Yeyalimu

20 Holeka i wanhu wa Bete-shemeshi wakatya, “Nani 'mbi kanyhi mono kosuma kwima hali Muwaha Mulungu yuyu, u Mulungu mono yelile? Alu hamba cimutegule hayi, ho yawuce kono kwetu?”
21 Hodu wakawa kutuma munhu yabite yakawalonjele wanhu wa ku Kiliyati Yeyalimu yatye, “Wafilisiti waligomola Lisanduku lye Cilagane co Muwaha Mulungu. Holeka muze mulisole.”


1 Samwili 7

1 Ale, wanhu wa Kiliyati Yeyalimu, wakabita wakalisola lilyo Lisanduku lye Cilagane lyo Muwaha Mulungu, wakalitegula ku kaya ya Aminadabu, mono yali yazenjile ha cigongo. Wakawa kumusiwanula Eleyezali u mwanagwe, yo yawe mulanjilizi we Lisanduku lye Cilagane lyo Muwaha Mulungu.

Samwili, yakuwa mutemi kuli Isilayeli

2 Nalyo Lisanduku lye Cilagane lyo Muwaha Mulungu, likekala vilo vinji muno muno ku Kiliyati Yeyalimu, kotya myaka makumi mejete. Na mwidaha lyose lilyo, Waisilayeli wamulombaga muno muno Muwaha Mulungu yawapele wutazi.
3 Nayo Samwili yakawalonjela Waisilayeli yakawatya, “Hono muwe mbeka mukumuwuyila Muwaha Mulungu, kwe zinhumbula zenyu zose, ale munojeye muwusize lukulu milungu yenyu yose ye cijenzi, hamonga ne vihwani vyose viseswe vye cihwani co mulungu we cicekulu Asitaloti. Mwiyilavizye lukulu nyo weneco kuli Muwaha Mulungu, mumuhembe mweneco yali wene du. Nayo komuponyenyi mu miwoko ye Wafilisiti.”
4 Hobaho i wanhu wa Isilayeli wakawa kuviwusa vihwani viseswe vya Baali, hamonga ne vihwani viseswe vya Asitaloti, wakawa kumuhemba Muwaha Mulungu yali wene.

5 Hanyuma, Samwili yakawa kuwacema Waisilayeli, wekonghole wose hamonga ku Mizipa, yakawa kuwalonjela yakutya, “Ane nomulombelenyi kuli Muwaha Mulungu kuko ku Mizipa.”
6 Wose wakawa kwihanguliziza kuko ku Mizipa. Wakanega malenga, wakagapulinhya hali Muwaha Mulungu, cikawa nha cilavywa kuli Muwaha Mulungu, kanyhi wakaleka no kulya mwi'zuwa lilyo. Wakalonga wakutya, “Ase cakondya kumusutizya Muwaha Mulungu.” (Samwili yakawa mulamuzi muli Waisilayeli baho ha Mizipa.)

7 Nawo Wafilisiti wali weza kuhulika, vyono Waisilayeli wekongholeye ha Mizipa, hodu wa walya i wawaha wahano, wakawa kwanza kuwawikaniza wanhu wawo wawahome. Nawo Waisilayeli wakazihulika zizo, wakenjilwa no woga wuwaha.
8 Wakawa kumulonjela Samwili wakatya, “Alu Samwili, wujendelele kumulomba Muwaha Mulungu, u Mulungu wetu, ho yaciponye mu miwoko ya Wafilisiti.”
9 Nayo Samwili yakasola nyana ye ngholo ndodo, yakayiwulaga, yakawa kuyilavya yikumbiko yinyanye kuli Muwaha Mulungu. Hanyuma ho yakawa kumulomba Muwaha Mulungu, yawapele wutazi Waisilayeli. Nayo Muwaha Mulungu yakawubocela wulombe wakwe.
10 Na lono Samwili yali yali mu wulavya likumbiko, Wafilisiti wakawa kuza wawahome Waisilayeli. Ninga Muwaha Mulungu yakalavya lididimo yiwaha muno mwizuwa lilyo, likawevyajiza Wafilisiti wakajililwa ne mahala, wakawa kutiza so mahwele.
11 Nawo Waisilayeli, wakawa kuwalondelela Wafilisiti mu nyuma yawo, ku wulawa baho ha Mizipa, wakawa kujendelela kuwawulaganga mumo mu nzila, sunga wakawafisa ko ku Betekali.

12 Baho Samwili yakasola yibwe, yakalisimya hagati ya Mizipa na Sheni, yakatya, “U Muwaha Mulungu kacitaza mu nzila yose.” Holeka yakalicemela litagwa lya Ebene-zeli. Nhunizo yayo Libwe lyo wutazi.
13 Hodu, Wafilisiti wakawa wasumwa, no Muwaha Mulungu yakawemila, ho walece kuyisola yisi ye Waisilayeli mu mapango gose gono Samwili yali yakali cawumi.
14 Makaya gose gono gali gasolwa ne Wafilisiti, ku wulawa Ekiloni sunga Gati, gose gakagomolwa kanyhi kuli Waisilayeli. Holeka Waisilayeli wakawa wakondya kuyituga kanyhi yisi yawo yose nha vyono yali yinha. Kanyhi hakawa na mulamu muno kuli Waisilayeli ne Waamoli.

15 Yuyo Samwili, yajendelela kuwalamula Waisilayeli, mu vilo vyakwe vyose vyo wikale wakwe.
16 Nayo mu myaka yose, yapilimaga ku Beteli, na Giligali, na Mizipa, no kuwalamula Waisilayeli mu zinghani zawo.
17 Na hanyuma kawa kuwuya kanyhi ku wikalo wakwe ku Lama, hono naho yawalamulaga Waisilayeli nhavivyo. Yakamuzenjela ne cikumbicilo Muwaha Mulungu baho ha Lama.


1 Samwili 8

I wanhu wakusaka watuje Mutemi

1 Nayo Samwili yali yeza kukombipa, yakawanoza wanagwe we cilume wawe walamuzi muli wa Waisilayeli.
2 U mwana mulongozi kulelwa yacemwaga Yoweli, no mwanakwawe yacemwaga Abiya. Nawo wakawa walamuzi ku Belisheba.
3 Ninga hamba siwatyatya zinzila zo sogo yawo yaye. Langa wene wakatyatya zinzila zawo weneco du zo wulondola mapesa. Na mu wuwe wuwo, wakawa wakubocela mafupo, holeka hamba si wasuma kulamula vyalo vye wanhu mu nzila ye ling'ani.

4 Hanyuma i walongola wose we Waisilayeli, wakekongholela hamonga, wakamubitila Samwili kuko ku Lama,
5 kamulonjela wakutya, “Alu, Samwili wakombipa, nawo wanago Yoweli na Abiya, hamba si wakuzityatya zinzila zako. Holeka cikukulomba wucisacile mutemi, ho ciwe cina mutemi mono kowa kucilamula, nha vyono genha makungugu ganji gose.”
6 Ninga Samwili hamba si yendezwa yaye no wuhile wawo wo kuwa no mutemi. Holeka yakamulomba Muwaha Mulungu,
7 nayo Muwaha Mulungu yakamupitula yakatya, “Agwe wuwahulicizaje du wanhu muli zose zono wokulonjela. Hambi nha si wakulemile agwe. Langa wakunema nene mono yo nili mutemi wawo.
8 Hambi nha ku wulawilila lono nawawusiza mu yisi ya Misili, nha wandeka, wakawa kuhemba milungu yinji. Sunga nalu wakukutendela nha vyono wanhendelaga nene nhondo zose.
9 Holeka agwe wuwahulicizaje du muli zose. Ninga hamba nhavivyo, wuwakagaje hawaha muno muno, kanyhi walolosezaje sunga na zono yuyo mutemi wawo kowatendela.”

10 Nayo Samwili yakawa kuwalonjela za muli zono wamulombaga, za muli mutemi, na za muli zose zono Muwaha Mulungu yamulonjeye.
11 Samwili yakawaloloseza za muli mutemi wawo vyono kowekaza, yakatya, “Yuyo mutemi wenyu, kowasola wana wenyu we cilume, yawanoze wasilikale. Wanji muli wene, wokwituma mu matuka gakwe go wulugu, wanji mu wusilikale we wapanda fwalasi, na wanji, wowa kumangha walongoleye ku mwande ye matuka gakwe go wulugu.
12 Na wanji kowawika wawe walongola, walanjilizi wa wasilikale elufu, monga monga, na wanji wawe walanjilizi wa wasilikale makumi mahano mahano. Kanyhi wanago we cilume wokwitumywa milimo yo kulima migunda yo mutemi, no kududula, hamonga no kunozeleza vitwalo vyakwe, hamonga ne vitumamilwa vye matuka gakwe go wulugu.
13 I wana wenyu we cicekulu nawo, kowasola yawanoze wawe wanoza mafuta gakwe ge mhunjile swanu, kanyhi wawe wo wateleci wakwe ne wanyanya mikate wakwe.
14 Yuyo mutemi wenyu, koyisola ne migunda yenyu miswanu, ne migunda yenyu ye mizabibu, hamonga na ye mizeyituni, yawagawile wetumami wakwe.
15 Kanyhi, kosola monga kwe kumi yo wuhemba wenyu, na ye zabibu zenyu, yawapele vitung'ati wakwe ne wetumami wakwe.
16 Kowasola sunga ne wetumami wenyu, ne zing'ombe zenyu zono zijinile, ne zindogowe zenyu, yazitumamile mweneco mu milimo yakwe.
17 Kanyhi, kosola monga kwe kumi ya mu matewa genyu ge zimitugo, sunga na nyenye nyo weneco mowa wawanda wakwe.
18 Ne lipango lilyo kolo likuza, nanye mololila ko wusungu muno, ku soko ya yuyo mutemi wenyu mono nyenye nyo weneco mumuhaguye. Ninga Muwaha Mulungu si kolomuhulicizenyi yaye mumo mu cililo cenyu.”

19 Ninga hamba nhavivyo, i wanhu hamba si wamuhulika Samwili yaye, langa wakatya, “Ng'o 'gwe! Ase cikusaka langa du cituje mutemi,
20 ho ciwe cinha nha vyono wenha makungugo ganji, ciwe cina nase mutemi wetu du, mono kocitema, kanyhi mono kocilongoza na mu wulugu, sunga na mu milewo yetu.”
21 Hodu nayo Samwili yakawahulika muli zose zono wazisakaga, yakawa kubita kumulonjela Muwaha Mulungu.
22 Nayo Muwaha Mulungu yakapitula yakatya, “Ale, witume nha vyono weneco wakuhila, wapelaje mutemi.” Hodu Samwili yakawa kuwalonjela wawuye ku zikaya munhu na kwakwe.


1 Samwili 9

Sawuli wakwitang'anila na Samwili

1 Kwali na munhu citung'ati kanyhi we vilungo, litagwa lyakwe Kishi, mulawa mulango wa Benyamini. Munhu yuyu, yali mwana wa Abiyeli, kanyhi yali mwizukulu wa Zeloli, Zeloli yali mwana wa Bekolati, Bekolati yali mwana wa Afiya.
2 Munhu yuyo Kishi, yali yena mwana wa cilume, litagwa lyakwe Sawuli, nayo Sawuli yali muzelelo muswanu muno mu mikalile yakwe kanyhi yali mutali ku wulawa mu mawega gakwe. Hakawa hasina hamba munhu yunji mu wa Isilayeli mono yali muswanu kuciza mwene.

3 Alu, zindogowe zinji za Kishi zikawa zajilila. Holeka yakamulonjela Sawuli yakatya, “Ale wumusolaje mwitumami monga, mubite nayo mukazilondole zindogowe.”
4 Nawo wakawa kutuluka, wakakola mu yisi ye matunda ya Efulayimu, na mu yisi ya Shalishali, ninga hamba si waziwona yaye. Hanyuma wakajendelela wakakola mu yisi ya Shayalimu, ninga zindogowe si zali zili kuko yaye. Hanyuma wakakola mu yisi ya Benyamini, ninga hamba si waziwona yaye.
5 Nawo wali weza kufika mu yisi ya Zufu, Sawuli yakamulonjela mwitumami wakwe yakatya, “Gwe, muyangu, alu ciwuye ku kaya, hambi baba nha koleka kwihwesa ze zindogowe, yawe kutuga mahwele ku soko yetu.”

6 Nayo mwitumami yakamupitula yakatya, “Alu, ta wime hadodo! Hambi mwi'kaya lilino, nha moyuli munhu wo Mulungu, kanyhi munhu we lilumbo muno muno, kalongaga ziwezaga za mbeka. Holeka, ale cimubitile, na lunji kosuma kucilonjela i hanhu hono cosuma kuziwona zindogowe zetu.”
7 Nayo Sawuli yakamuwuza yakatya, “Alu mwene, kolo camubitila, comupela cicici lo? Hambi nha cisina hamba ndigwa yo yose hamba cinhu cinji co cose cono cisigaze mu mifuko yetu. Holeka lu ho comupela cici?”

8 Mwitumami wakwe yakamupitula yakatya, “Ane mu mufuko wangu, nina cipande cidodo ca fweza, holeka nomupela cico, nayo yacilajile hanhu hono coziwona zindogowe zetu.”
9 (Sawuli nayo yakamupitula yakatya, “Ayo nghani swanu! Ale, cibite.” Hodu wakawa kwinjila mu cikaya cono yuyo munhu wo Mulungu yekalaga.)
10 Na lono wabitaga mucanyha ye citunda, mumo mu nzila waketang'anila na wahinza wanji wono wabitaga kunega malenga, nawo wakawawuza wawo wahinza wakatya, “Wulenyi, mono cikaya cici mo yuli muwoni?”
11 Hambi mu mapango gago i wawizi nha wacemwaga Wawoni, holeka mu mapango gogose gono munhu yasakaga kuwuza nghani kuli Mulungu, yatezaga, “Alenyi, cibite ko Muwoni.”

12 Nawo wahinza wakawapitula wakatya, “Heya mo yuli. Nayo kamutongolelenyi hadodo du, kuza. Na hono mujende mwiyohile, momwagana.
13 Na lono mukwinjila du mu cikaya, ale momuwona. Hambi nayo nha kaza baha du izuwali. Ne wanhu wolavya likumbiko mu cikumbicilo mwi'tunda. Ne wanhu wono walalikwe, hamba si wosuma kwanza kulya, sunga mwene yaze. Hambi nha yimunojeye yamule yalilugutize likumbiko. Na hono mwiyohe, momwagana yakali hamba si nabita kuko kwi'tunda ku wulya zindigwa.”
14 Hodu Sawuli hamonga no mwitumami wakwe, wakawa kutuluka, wakawa kubita kuko ku cikaya. Na lono wenjilaga du mu cikaya, wakamuwona nayo Samwili yakuza, vikwitang'anila nayo, yakubita i hanhu ho wuhembelo.

15 Na mwi'zuwa lye 'golo yayo, Muwaha Mulungu yali yamulonjela Samwili vyono,
16 “I mitondo, mu mapango gono genha gaga, ane nokuletela munhu yakulawa mu mulango wa Benyamini, holeka nhondo mwitile mafuta munhu yuyo, yawe mutemi muli wanhu wangu Waisilayeli. Mwene yo kowaponya mu miwoko ye Wafilisiti. Hambi nha nakondya kuwuwona wugaye we wanhu wangu. Kanyhi nakondya kucihulika ne cililo cawo, vyono wakusaka wutazi.”
17 Nayo Samwili yali yeza kumuwona Sawuli, Muwaha Mulungu yakamulonjela yakatya, “Ale, Samwili, ayu yo munhu mono nakulonjela. Mono yo kowatema wanhu wangu.”
18 Nayo Sawuli yakawa kumubitila Samwili, lono Samwili yali yeza yali behi ne lilango. Sawuli yakamuwuza Samwili yakatya, “Gwe muyangu, ndajilaje ta kono yekaye Muwoni.”

19 Nayo Samwili yakamupitula yakatya, “Ane yo nene Muwoni. Ale lu wolongolele ku mwande yangu, cibitane sunga hanhu ho wuhembelo. Nanye wose vyono muli wejete colizana zindigwa zuwali. I mitondo langa, ho nosuma kumupitulenyi mawuzo genyu gose. Hanyuma ho niwe kumukombolenyi muwuye kwenyu.
20 Kanyhi mulece kuwa na mahwele so zindogowe zenyu, zono zajilila ku wulawa vilo vidatu vyono vipulute. Hambi nha zikondya kwijela. Hambi lu nani kanyhi mono wanhu wose wa Isilayeli wamwilowaga, hono si gwegwe du, hamonga ne mhuga yo sogo.”
21 Nayo Sawuli yakamupitula yakamutya, “Ane wayiko, nili wo mulango wa Benyamini, i mhuga yono ndodo du muno muno, muli nghungugo yose ye Waisilayeli, sunga ne mhuga yangu yo mhuga ndodo muno muno muli zimhuga zose za Benyamini. Alu nhawule 'gwe wukunonjela zinghani zono zinha zizi?”

22 Ninga mwene Samwili yakawa kumusola Sawuli hamonga no mwitumami wakwe, yakawa kuwenjiza he kumbo, yakawa kuwekaza hanhu he'lumbo, hono wali wekaye wajenzi makumi madatu.
23 Ale, baho Samwili yakawa kumulonjela muteleci we zindigwa, yakumutya, “Ale, wulete yi yilya mhonje ye nyama yono nghupelile yono nghuteye wuyiwice ha mhelo.”
24 Muteleci yakawa kuyileta nyama ye cima, yakawa kuyiwika hamwande ya Sawuli. Nayo Samwili yakamutya Sawuli. “Ale, wulonje! Ayi yo mhonje ye nyama yono yali mbikwe so gwegwe. Alu wutenje wulye. Hambi nha nali nghuwiciye gwegwe, ho wuze wuyilye mu cipango cici, hamonga ne wanhu wa wano wono niwalalice.”

Ale du, nayo Sawuli yakawa kuyilya nyama yiyo mwi'zuwa lilyo, wakahanga wose na Samwili.
25 Na lono watenenhukaga wakulawa ha wuhembelo, lono wakubita ku cikaya, wakamutandicila Sawuli citanda mwi'tembe mucanyha. Nayo Sawuli yakagona baho.

Samwili, yakumwitila Sawuli mafuta, yawe mutemi

26 Wali weza kwela, hakali mitondo muno muno, Samwili yakawa kumubitila Sawuli kuko kwi'tembe, yakawa kumulonjela yakutya, “Alu wela, winukaje nghusindicize.” Ale du, Sawuli yakawa kwinuka, nayo Samwili yakawa kumusindiciza.
27 Ninga wali weza kufika ku mhelo ye kaya, baho Samwili yakamulonjela Sawuli yakatya, “Ale mulonjele mwitumami wako yabite yalongole.” Ale u mwitumami yakawa kulongola, nayo Samwili yakajendelela kutya, “Sawuli, wime ta hadodo, nghuhila nghulonjele zono Mulungu yateye.”


1 Samwili 10

1 Hobaho Samwili yakawa kusola cupa ye mafuta, yakawa kumwitila Sawuli mu mutwe, hanyuma yakawa kumunonela, yakamutya, “Muwaha Mulungu kakwitila mafuta, ho wuwe mutemi muli wanhu wakwe wa Isilayeli. Kotema muli wanhu wakwe, kanyhi kowacitila muli walugu wawo. Naco aci co citanjilo kuli'gwe, cono cikukulajila vyono Muwaha Mulungu yo yakuhaguye wuwe mutemi muli wanhu wakwe.
2 Na kolo ceza kwileka nane izuwali, agwe mokwitang'anila na wanhu we cilume wejete, behi ne citenjelo ca Laheli, ha Zeliza, mu yisi ya Benyamini. Nawo wokulonjela nha vyono zi zilya zindogowe zono mwali kuzilondola, alu zakondya kwijela. Holeka hamba no sogo si yakwihwelela ze zindogowe, langa aluno yena mahwele ku soko yako, nayo kekalaga yakuwuza du, ‘Alu nye, ho notenda wule so mwanangu?’
3 Ninga agwe wujendelele du, sunga wufice ha mubici waha Taboli. Na baho naho mokwitang'anila na wanhu wadatu we cilume, wono wowa wakubita ku Beteli kumulavizya Muwaha Mulungu likumbiko. No munhu monga muli wene, kowa yakuhwaga nyana za mhene yidatu. U muyagwe nayo, kowa yadinghuye mikate midatu. Na yunji nayo we kadatu, kowa yadinghuye mufuko wa nyhingo, wumemile divayi.
4 Nawo wokulamusa, kanyhi wokupela mikate myejete ya muli yiyo mikate yawo midatu. Nagwe nhondo wubocele.
5 Hanyuma wuwe kubita kwi Tunda lyo Mulungu ku Gibeya, kono koyili nghambi ye Wafilisiti. Kolo weza kufika he 'lango lye likaya, baho naho, mokwitang'anila na mhuga ye wawizi wakuwuya wakulawilila he'tunda ha cikumbicilo, akuno wakutowa masumbi ne zing'oma, ne zifilimbi, hamonga no musesele. Nawo wowa wakuwila.
6 Ninga nagwe u Muhe wo Muwaha Mulungu wokuziza ne vilungo, nagwe kokwilunza nawo mu wuwile, nagwe kopituka nhinicizo wuwe munhu mupya.
7 Na zizi kolo zakondya kwijela, ale witumaje nha vyono Mulungu kokutya witume.
8 Hanyuma wunongolele wubite ku Giligali, nane nokwagana kuko, nagwe kolo wafika kuko, wulavye makumbiko manyanywe, hamonga ne makumbiko go mulamu. Hanyuma wikale baho vilo mupunghati, sunga kolo neza kuza, nghulonjele kanyhi zono zinojeye witume.”
