16 Hobaho i wanhu wose wakalawila wakagaleta manhambi, wakawa kwizenjela vibanda mu matembe ge zikaya zawo, mu viwanza vyawo, na mu viwanza vye Nyumba yo Mulungu, na ha viwanza vya ha Mulango we Malenga, sunga na ha Mulango wa Efulayimu.
17 Wose wono wali wawuya ku wulawa ku wuhamywe, wakezenjela vibanda vyawo, wakekala mumo. Nghani ayi, lwali lo lulongozi kwitumwa mu vilo vya Yoshuwa u mwana wa Nuni. Wanhu wose wakasangalala muno, wakatuga nyemo mbaha.
18 Na ku wulawilila lizuwa lilongozi lono wayinoza sikukuu yiyi, wajendelela kusoma nondo zose citabu co Wulajilize sunga mwi'zuwa lyo mupunghati. Na mwi'zuwa lyo munana, hali howuli wuhembi wo kudumliziza, nha vyono Wulajilize watezaga.


Nehemiya 9

Wanhu wakunena wubi wawo

1 Mu mwezi wuwo, mwi'zuwa lye makumi mejete na yine, i wanhu wa Isilayeli wakekongholela hamonga, wakaleka kulya, ho walajile wukalale wawo so wubi wawo.
2 Wali wakondya kwisiwanula ne wanhu we makungugo ganji. Wakavwala magunila, no kwiyesela manghundi mu mitwe yawo, ciwe nha citanjilo co wukalale awo. Wakema, wakanza kunena wubi wono wali wetumile, hamonga no wubi we walezi wawo.
3 Lilajilizo lyo Muwaha Mulungu, u Mulungu wawo, likasomwa ha mwande yawo saa yidatu. Na mumapango kanyhi ga saa yidatu, wose wakema wima wakanena wubi wawo, wakamuhemba Muwaha Mulungu, u Mulungu wawo.

4 Baho hali ho hali hanhu hacanyha ho kulonjela hono hali hazenjigwe ne mabici hono Walawi wemaga mucanyha yayo. Ale Yeshuwa yakema mucanyha yayo, hamonga na Bani, na Kadimiyeli, na Shebaniya, na Buni, na Shelebiya, hamonga na Bani na Kenani. Wakalomba hamonga kwe mazi mawaha, kuli Muwaha Mulungu, u Mulungu wawo.

5 Hobaho i Walawi, Yeshuwa, Kadimiyeli, Bani, Hashebeneya, Shelebiya, Hodiya, Shebaniya, na Petahiya, wakawa kuwacemeleza wanhu waze ku wuhembi, wakatya,

“Mwime mukamile, mumulumbe Muwaha Mulungu,

u Mulungu wenyu,

Mumulumbaje cibitilila ne cibitilila!

Ale, wose walikumye litagwa lyako lyo lukumyo.

Lyono likumucile si nho wulugute wose ne lilumbo lyose.”

6 Hobaho wana wa isilayeli, wakalomba lilombo alino,

“Gwe go Muwaha Mulungu, yo

gwegwe Muwaha wuli wene,

yo gwegwe mono wawumba wulanga,

hamonga ne zinyelezi kucanyha.

Yo gwegwe mono wawumba yisi ne lilenga,

na vyose vyono vili mumo.

Yo gwegwe mono kuvipelaga vyose wumi.

Mihanga yose ya ku wulanga.

Yikufugamilaga gwegwe no kukuhemba.

7 Yo gwegwe go Muwaha Mulungu u Mulungu mono

wamuhagula Abulamu.

Wukamutonga ku wulawa ku Uli wa ku Babiloni,

wukamupela ne litagwa lya Abulahamu.

8 Wukamuwona vyono mwihuwilwa

kuli'gwe, wukawika cilagane nayo,

wukamwilahiza vyono kowapela wo lulelo lwakwe yisi ya Kanani.

Ne yisi ye Wahiti, ne Waamoli.

Ne yisi ye Wapelizi, Wayebusi,

ne Wagiligashi. Ho yiwe yisi yono

zindelo zakwe zowa kwikala.

Wakamisa wihuwizo wako.

Vyono agwe wuli mwihuwilwa.

9 “Wukawona ne walezi wetu vyono

wagazwaga ku Misili,

wukawahulika ne cililo cawo,

lono wasakaga wutazi he'lenga lya Shamu.

10 Walajila vitanjilo vyo wizine

kuli mutemi Falawo, hamonga ne walongola

wakwe, ne wanhu wa mu yisi yakwe.

Hambi 'gwe nha wukamanya vyono wawewonelaga wanhu

wako, wuketujila lukumyo lono wina nalo

sunga nalu.

11 Wukanoza wukolo mwi'lenga, so wanhu wako,

wakakola mu muhangha mukavu.

Ne Wamisili wono wawatyatyaga, wukawagubiza

mu malenga kotya yibwe, mu visolo vye lilenga.

12 Wukawatonga ku misi ne lisumbili lye livunde. Na ku cilo nako

wawamulicilaga nzila ne lisumbili lyo moto.

13 Yo gwegwe mono watima mwi'tunda lya Sinayi

ku wulawa ku wulanga,

wukalongana ne wanhu wako,

wukawapela no wuling'anizi we mbeka,

ne malajilizo maswanu.

14 Yo gwegwe mono wawalanjiza, wayibate

Sabato yako yono yelile.

Wukawapelela ne malajilizo gako

muli Musa u mwitumami wako.

15 Na lono wali wasina ndigwa, wukawapela

ndigwa ku wulawa ku wulanga.

Na lono wali wakaluka, wukawapela malenga

ku wulawa mwi'bwe.

Wukawalajiliza wakayiteme yisi,

yono wawehuwiziza vyono kowapela.

16 Ninga walezi wetu wakekumya muno,

wakawa wasina cihuliko mu mikalile yawo,

wakalema sunga no kugatyatya ne malajilizo gako.

17 Wakalema kuwa na cihuliko,

wakasemwa zose zono wetuma.

Wakasemwa sunga ne mapoto gono wetuma.

Na mu cibede cawo, wakahagula

mulongola, ho yawagomole ku yisi

ya Misili, yisi yo wuwanda.

Ninga 'gwe, wuli Mulungu wo wunenezi.

Mono wumemile wendo ne lihewa,

kanyhi si wuli mupelu kukolwa ne likuwo.

No lusungu lwako luwaha, hamba si wawaleka yaye.

18 Wakenozeza cihwani cenjedulwe ca ndama

wakatya, yali yo mulungu wawo,

mono yawawusa ku yisi ya Misili!

Wakakutovula wutovule wuwaha 'gwe

go Muwaha Mulungu.

19 Ninga 'gwe siwasuma kuwaleka mu nyika yi yilya

ku soko yo lusungu lwako luwaha,

siwawawusiza lisumbili lye livunde

lyono lyawalajilaga nzila ku misi.

Hamba lisumbili lyo moto lyono

lyawamulicilaga nzila ku cilo.

20 Ko wuswanu wako, wawalonjelaga cono wetuma.

Wukawalisa i mana, wukawapela ne

malenga go kung'wa.

21 Mu myaka makumi mane yono wene wapilimaga

mu nyika, wawapela visakwa vyawo vyose.

Sunga ne myenda yawo si yasakala, ne migulu yawo hamba

si yavimba so mawine go kujenda.

22 “Wukawapela wusume muli walugu wawo na muli

makungugo, no wutemi,

hamonga ne zi'si zono wawagawila.

Wakayisuma yisi ya Heshiboni yo mutemi Sihoni,

hamonga ne yisi ya Bashani, yono yali yo

mutemi muwaha Ogu.

23 Wukawapela wana wenji muno, wakawa wenji nhe

zinyelezi zono zikwijela ku wulanga.

Kanyhi wukawasumila no wulugu wawo,

wakekala na mu'si yilya yono wawehuwiza vyono

kowapela walezi wawo.

24 Wakayisuma ysi ya Kanani.

Nagwe wukawawusa ne wanhu wono

wekalaga mumo. Wukawapela wanhu wako vilungo,

ho wetuma nha vyono wasakaga weneco,

kuli wanhu ne watemi wa Kanani.

25 Wanhu wako wakatema ne makaya gono gali mazenjelwe

magomawakali, ne yisi yo moso, ne zikaya

zono zali zina sawo, hamonga ne masima,

ne mibici ye mizeyituni, ne mibici ye

mikalo miswanu, hamonga ne Mizabibu.

Wakalya vyose vyono wasakaga, wakajina muno,

wakendezwa ne vinhu vyose viswanu vyono wawapela.

26 “Ninga hamba nha vivyo i wanhu wako siwakuhulika yaye.

Wene wakakugaluka,

wakataga ne malajilizo gako.

Wakawawulaga sunga ne wawizi wono wawasugulaga,

no kuwalonjela wakupitucile gwegwe.

Wakakutovula kenji na kenji.

27 Na ku soko yiyo nagwe wukawaleka, wakatowa

no kutemwa ne walugu wawo.

Na mu mapango go wugaye,

wakakulomba wutazi,

nagwe wukawapitula ku wulawa ku wulanga.

Na ko lusungu lwako luwaha, wukawaletela

walongola, wono wawakomboza mu walugu wawo.

28 Ninga wali weza kutuga mulamu,

wakawuyajila ku wituma wubi kanyhi.

Nagwe kanyhi wukawaleka walugu wawo,

wakawatema. Hamba nhavivyo wali weza kunena,

no kukulilila wuwataze, wukawahulika kuko ku wulanga

no kuwataza kenji na kenji, so lusungu lwako.

29 Wukawasugula wagavumile mafundo gako,

ninga so cibede cawo, wakagalema

ne malajilizo gako,

hamba yiwe, mu wibata wulajilize wako,

yo nzila yo wumi. Ninga wene so cibede cawo wakafyula

wakalema no kukuhulika.

30 Mu myaka yose, agwe wawasugulaga ko wukangalile.

Wukawejiza wawizi, ho wawalonjele,

ninga wanhu wako wakawa wali ciziwi.

Holeka nagwe wukawaleka, wakatowa ne walugu wawo

wa mu makungugo ganji.

31 Hamba nhavivyo, so lusungu lwako luwaha

kuli wene, holeka si wawaleka hamba

kuwongomeza yaye.

Hambi 'gwe, nha yo gwegwe

Mulungu we lihewa no lusungu!

32 “Holeka 'gwe Mulungu, go Mulungu wetu,

wuwaha wako wucizize!

Mono wuli wo kogofya, kanyhi wuli we vilungo!

Mono kukamisaga ko wihuwilwa cilagane no lusungu lwako,

hamonga no wihuwizo wako.

Ku wulawa mu vilo vyono watemi wa Ashuli

waciwonelaga, sunga na lulu hose,

magayo malinga gono gakondya

kucagana! I watemi wetu ne walongola wetu,

ne Wakohani wetu, ne wawizi, ne walezi wetu,

hamonga ne wanhu wose, cili mu wugaye.

Holeka wukumbucile vyono cagaya muno!

33 Wetuma viswanu kucilipiciza,

kanyhi wuketuma ze ling'ani,

hambe nha cakunozeza wubi.

34 Walezi wetu, ne watemi wetu, ne

walongola wetu, hamonga ne wakohani,

hamba si walityatya Lilajilizo lyako,

hamonga no Wulajilize wako wono wawapela.

35 Ninga ko wuswanu wako wuwaha,

i watemi wo wawalongoza wanhu wako, lono

wekalaga mu yisi yo moso, kanyhi ngazi,

yono wawapela. Ninga wene wakalema

kukupitucila no kukutyatya.

36 Nalu ceza cili wawanda mu yisi yono

wacipela, yisi yo moso, yono yikucipela ne zindigwa.

37 Na ku soko yo wubi wetu, holeka vyose vyono

yisi yikulela, vibitaga kuli watemi wono wacipela.

Nawo wakucitema, kanyhi wakucinozeza nha

vyono wakusaka weneco, hamonga ne mitugo zetu.

Holeka cili mu wugaye wuwaha muno muno!”

Wanhu wakwilumbaniza

38 Ku soko ya zizi zose zono zakodya kucijelela, nase co wanhu wa Isilayeli, cikuwika cilagane zuwali cono cikamile, cono cokwandikwa, kanyhi cowicilwa ne vitanjilo vye walongola wetu, ne Walawi, hamonga ne wakohani.


Nehemiya 10

1 Umulongozi kutajila citanjilo, yali Nehemiya mwana wa Hakaliya, na Zedekiya, hamonga na awano wono wakutyatya.

2 I wakohani, wali awano,

Selaya, Azaliya, Yelemiya, na

3 Pashuli, Amaliya, Maliciya, na

4 Hatushi, Shebaniya, Maluki, na

5 Halimu, Malemoti, Obadiya, na

6 Danyeli, Ginetoni, Baluki, na

7 Meshulamu, Abiya, Miyamini, na

8 Maziya, Biligayi, na Shemaya.

9 I Walawi, wali awano,

Yeshuwa u mwana wa Azaniya,

Binuyi, e mhuga ya Henadadi, na

Kadimiyeli.

10 Ne wandugu zawo wono watajila citanjilo

wali awano:

Shebaniya, Hodiya, na

Kelita, Pelaya, Hanani, na

11 Mika, Lehobu, Hashabiya, na

12 Zekuli, Shelebiya, Shebaniya, na

13 Hodiya, Bani, na Beninu.

14 I walongola we wanhu, wali awano,

Paloshi, Pahati-mowabu, Elamu, na

Zatu, Bani,

15 Buni, na Azigadi, Bebayi,

16 Adoniya, na Biguvayi, Adini na

17 Ateli, Hezekiya, Azuli,

18 Hodiya, na Hashumu, Bezayi,

19 Halifu, Anatoti, na Nobayi,

20 Magupiyashi, Meshulamu, na Hezili,

21 Meshezabeli, Zadoki, na Yoduwa,

22 Pelatiya, Hanani, na Anaya,

23 Hosheya, Hananiya, na Hashubu,

24 Haloheshi, Piliha, na Shobeke,

25 Lehumu, Hashabuna, Maseya,

26 Ahiya, Hanani, Anaani,

27 Maluki, Halimu na Baana.

Wilumbanize wawo

28 Ase co wanhu wa Isilayeli, co wakohani, ne Walawi, ne walindilizi we Nyumba yo Mulungu, ne wembi we Nyumba yo Mulungu, ne wetumami wa mu Nyumba yo Mulungu, hamonga na wose wono so wibata Lilajilizo lyo Mulungu, wakesiwanula ne wanhu we makungugo ganji, wono wekalanaga nase mu yisi yetu. Hamonga ne wagolece zetu, ne wana wetu wono waficila lizika lyo kumanya no kutanga zo Wulajilize.
29 Cikwilunza hamonga ne walongola wetu mu wilahize, nha vyono cokwikala mu mikalile nha vyono Wulajilize wukucitonga. Wulajilize wono Mulungu yacipelela muli Musa mwitumami wakwe. Na vyono kanyhi cozityatya zose zono Muwaha Mulungu, u Mulungu wetu, yacilajiliza. Na vyono cogakamisa ne malajilizo gakwe, hamonga no wuhile wakwe. Na vyono, hono cilibene lilajilzo lili, hodu cilijitwe.
30 Kanyhi sicokwitolanila na wono si Wayahudi, wono cikalane nawo mu yisi yetu.
31 Kanyhi na hono wacambazize ndigwa hamba cinhu cinji mwi'zuwa lye Sabato, hamba mwi'zuwa lyono lyelile, ho waciguzize, ase sicogula yaye.

Kanyhi mu mwaka wo mupunghati sicoyilima yisi, hamba ne migawa yono wacikopile si coyidaya yaye.
32 Na mu myaka yose, cowa kulavya munhu monga gulamu yihano za fweza, ho zitumamilwe mu milimo yo wuzenji we Nyumba yo Mulungu wetu.
33 Cowa kulavya vinhu avi, so wuhembi mu Nyumba yo Mulungu, mukate wono welile, cilavywa co wusaje, ce nhondo zose, hamonga ne mitugo so cilavywa cinyanywe, ca nhondo zose, so likumbiko, ne cilavywa ce Sabato, na ce sikukuu yo mwezi mupya, na ce vilo vinji viwaha, ne zisikukuu zose zono zelile, so kuwanozeza wilamule i Waisilayeli wose, ne cinhu co cose cono cosakwa so milimo yose ya mu Nyumba yo Mulungu wetu.

34 Ase wose, ne Wakohani, hamonga ne Walawi, cowa kuhagula mu mwaka, mu nzila yo kutowa kula, ho ciyituje mhuga ya hayi yono yowa kuleta zingwagu, zo kunyanyila cilavywa cinyanywe kuli Muwaha Mulungu, u Mulungu wetu, nha vyono Wulajilize wukulolosa.

35 Cowa kuleta ne malimbuko kuli Muwaha Mulungu, mu wulawa mu zindigwa zono zolongola kupya no kududulwa, hamonga ne mikalo milongozi kupya, mu migunda yetu.

36 Cowa kuwategula i wana wetu i walongozi kulelwa, kuli wakohani wono wetumaga ku Nyumba yo Mulungu, ho cikalavye kuli Mulungu nha vyono Wulajilize wukutya. Kanyhi cowa kumulavizya Muwaha Mulungu zi ng'ombe zinongozi kulelwa, hamonga na mu zingholo zetu ne zimhene zetu.

37 Cowa kutegula mu myaka yose, no wusaje wutiwe, wo wuhemba wupya, kuli Wakohani, mu Nyumba yo Mulungu, wo kunoza mukate, hamonga ne vilavywa vinji vinji vye divayi, ne mafuta, hamonga ne mikalo ye hayo hayo. Cowa kutegula kuli Walawi, ne zi zaka zono zikulawa mu migunda yetu, ne zaka ze ndigwa yono cowa kutuga mu migunda yetu.
38 Wakohani wana wa Haluni, yiwanojeye wawalilizwe hamonga ne Walawi, lono zaka yikukongholwa, wasole monga kwe kumi ya mu zaka yono woyikonghola, wayiwice mu cinyumba co kuwika zi sawo ze Nyumba yo Mulungu, so witumami wa mu Nyumba yo Mulungu wetu.
39 I wanhu wose wa Isilayeli hamonga ne Walawi, yiwanojeye wasole i vilavywa vyose vye zaka, waviwice mu vinyumba vyono viwikwaga viwutwa vya mu Nyumba yo Mulungu. Vilavywa vyo wuhemba, vye divayi na vye mafuta. Ho viwikwe hamonga ne viya vyose vye Nyumba yo Mulungu, lono ne Wakohani wono wali mu witumami wali baho, ne walanjilizi, hamonga ne cipuga ce wembi, nawo ho wasole lobo ye zi zaka zose, wetumamile. Nase si coyileka Nyumba yo Mulungu wetu.


Nehemiya 11

Wanhu wono wekalaga mu Yelusalemi

1 Walongola wose, wakekala mu Yelusalemi, i wanhu wanji wose, wakatowa kula, ho yihagulwe mhuga monga monga, mu wulawa mu mhuga yikumi yikumi, waze wekale mwi'kaya lyono lyelile lya Yelusalemi. Na wono wosigala, wajendelele kwikala mu makaya ga mu matumbi gawo.
2 I wanhu wakawalumba muno wanhu wose, wono welavya weneco kwe nhumbula yo welecele, ho wakekale mu Yelusalemi.
3 Mu makaya ganji ne matumbi ganji, i wanhu wa Isilayeli hamonga ne wakohani ne Walawi, ne wetumami wa mu Nyumba yo Mulungu, hamonga ne wetumami, ne wetumami we wana wa Solomona, awa wose, wekalaga hanhu hawo, mu matumbi gawo.

Liwalo lye walongola, wono wekalaga mu Yelusalemi, likaya lyono lyelile, wono wali wo walongola we wanhu, wono wekalaga mu matumbi ga Yuda, lyo alino.
4 Cipuga ca wo mulango wa Yuda.

Mhuga ya Ataya, u mwana wa Uziya, u mwizukulu kwa Zekaliya. Hamonga na wanji wa muli walezi wawo, na Amaliya, na Shefatiya, na Mahalaleli, na we zindelo ze wana wa Yuda u mwana wa Pelezi.

5 Maseya u mwana wa Baluki, u mwizukulu kwa Kolihoze. Hamonga ne wanji wa muli wasogo zawo, na Hazaya, na Adaya, na Yoyalibu, hamonga na Zekaliya, na we zindelo ze wana wa Yuda u mwana wa Mushiloni.

6 Ne zindelo ze wana wa Pelezi, wali waficile wanhu magana mane na makumi mutandatu na munana, wono wekalaga mu Yelusalemi.
7 Cipuga ca wo mulango wa Benyamini. Yali Salu u mwana wa Meshulamu, u mwizukulu kwa Yowedi. Hamonga ne wanji wa muli walezi wawo, na Pedaya, na Kolaya, na Maseya, na Itiyeli, na Yeshaya.

8 Ne wana wa Gabayili na Salayi, i wandugu zawo we behi na Salu.

Mhuga yose ya wo mulango wa Benyamini, wali waficile wanhu magana yicenda na makumi mejete na munana, wono wekalaga mu Yelusalemi.
9 Na Yoeli u mwana wa Zikili, yali yo mulongola wawo. Nayo Yuda u mwana wa Hasenuwa yali yo mulongola mutazi wa mwi'kaya liwaha lya Yelusalemi.
10 I cipuga ce Wakohani, yali Yedaya u mwana wa Yoyalibu, na Yakini.
11 Selaya u mwana wa Hilikiya. U mwizukulu kwa Meshulamu. Hamonga ne walezi wawo, na Zadoki, na Melayoti, na Ahitubu, mono yali yo mukohani muwaha.
12 Liwalo lyawo, wali waficile magana munana na makumi mejete na wejete, wono wetumaga mu Nyumba yo Mulungu.

Na Adaya u mwana wa Yelohamu, u mwizukulu kwa Pelaya. Hamonga ne walezi wawo, na Amuzi, na Pashuli na Malikiya.

13 Nawo wali waficile magana mejete na makumi mane na wejete, cipuga co lulelo lulu, wono wali wo walongola wa mu zimhuga zawo. Na Amashayi u mwana wa Azaliyeli, u mwizukulu kwa Ahizayi. Ne walezi wawo, hamonga na Mashilemoti, na Imeli.
14 Wali waficile wanhu yigana limonga na makumi mejete na munana, mu mhuga yiyo, wono wetumaga kotya wasilikale. Nayo Zabudiyeli yali yo mulongola wa mu mhuga yawo.

15 Cipuga ce Walawi: Yali Shemaya u mwana wa Hashubu, u mwizukulu wa Azilikamu. Ne walezi wawo, hamonga na Hushabiya na Buni.

16 Shebetayi na Yozabadi, i Walawi, wono wali wamanyice, mu mulimo wo wulanjilizi we milimo ya kunze ye Nyumba yo Mulungu.

17 Hamonga na Mataniya u mwana wa Mika, u mwizukulu kwa Zabudi we ndelo ya Asafu. Nayo yo yali yo mutonji, we cipuga ce wembi wa mu Nyumba yo Mulungu, u wimbe wawo, wo kwimba zinyimbo zo wuhembi, na zo wulavye na zo wulumbe. Na Bakubuke yali yo mutazi wa Mataniya.

Abada u mwana wa Shamuwa, u mwizukulu kwa Galali, we ndelo ya Yedutuni.
18 Liwalo lye Walawi wose, wono wekalaga mwi'kaya lyono lyelile lya Yelusalemi, wali waficile wanhu magana mejete na makumi munana na wane.

19 Cipuga ce Walindilizi we Nyumba yo Mulungu: Yali Akubu, na Talimoni, hamonga ne wandugu zawo, nawo wali waficile wanhu yigana limonga na makumi mupunghati na wejete.

20 Wanji nawo wa mu wanhu wa Isilayeli, hamonga ne wakohani, ne Walawi, wono wasigala, wakekala hanhu hawo mu matumbi ne makaya ga Yuda.

21 Iwetumami wa mu Nyumba yo Mulungu wekala he'tumbi lye behi na Yelusalemi, lya Ofeli, nawo wetumaga hasi yo wulanjilizi wa Ziha na Gishipa.

22 Umulanjilizi we Walawi, wono wekalaga mu Yelusalemi, yali Uzi u mwana wa Bani, u mwizukulu kwa Hashabiya, ne walezi wawo, hamonga na Mataniya na Mika, nayo yali we mhuga ya Asafu, mhuga yono yali yina wutonji, no witumami wuswanu wo kwimba zi nyimbo mu Nyumba yo Mulungu mu wuhembi.

23 Wulajilize wo mutemi, wo walajilaga i mhuga ye wembi, yono yasakwaga nhondo zose wembe zinyimbo ko wilecele mwi'zuwa ne 'zuwa mu Nyumba yo Mulungu.

24 Na Petaliya u mwana wa Meshezabeli wa mu mhuga ya Zela wa mu mulango wa Yuda, yali yo wakili wo mutemi, mu zinghani zose ze wana wa Isilayeli, mwi'kulu lyo mutemi wa Pelisiya.

I wanhu wa mu makaya, ne matumbi ganji

25 Wenji wa muli wanhu, wekalaga mu matumbi ge behi ne migunda yawo. Na wono wali wo mulango wa Yuda, wekalaga ku Kiliyati-aleba, na Diboni, na Yekabuzeli, na mu vitumbi vye behi ne makaya gago.
26 Hamonga na mu makaya ga Yeshuwa, na mu Molada, na Betupeleti,
27 na ku Hazali-shuwali, na mu Beli-sheba na mu vitumbi vyono vipilime.
28 Wekalaga mwi'kaya lya Zikilaji, mu Mekona, ne vitumbi vyayo.
29 Na mu Ene-limoni, na mu Zola, na mu Yalemuti,
30 na mu Zanowa, na mu Adulamu, na mu vikaya vyono vilibehi ne matumbi gago. Wekalaga mu Lakishi behi ne migunda, na mu Azeka ne vitumbi vyayo. Wo wutya, wanhu wa Yuda, wekalaga mu yisi ya haciligati ya Beli-sheba, lubavu lwe takama ne lilolo lya Hinomu ku lubavu lwe sumuka.

31 Nawo i wanhu wo mulango wa Benyamini, wekalaga ku Geba, na ku Mikimashi, na ku Ayi, na ku Beteli, na mu vitumbi, vye behi behi ne matumbi gago.
32 Na Anatoti, Nebu, na Ananiya,
33 Hazoli, Lama, na Gitayimu,
34 Hadidi, Zebayimu, na Nebalati,
35 Lodi na Ono, na mwi'lolo lye Wanghula.

36 Wanji nawo wa mu cipuga ce Walawi, wono wekalaga mu yisi yiyo ya Yuda, wakelumbaniza ho wekalane ne wanhu wo mulango wa Benyamini.


Nehemiya 12

Liwalo lye wakohani ne Walawi

1 Ali lyo liwalo lye wakohani ne walawi, wono wawuya wulawa ku wuhamywe, hamonga ne Zelubabeli u mwana wa Sheyalitiyeli, hamonga no Mukohani Muwaha Yoshuwa.

2 Wakohani wali awa,

Selaya, Yelemiya, Ezila, Amaliya, Maluki

3 Hatushi, Shekaniya, Lehumu, na Melemoti,

4 Ido, Ginetoyi, na Abiya,

5 Miyamini, Madiya, Biliga,

6 Shemaya, na Yoyalibu, Yedaya,

7 Salu, Amoke, na Hilikiya na Yedaya.

Awa, wali wo walongola we wandugu zawo wakohani,

mu vilo vya Yoshuwa.

8 Walawi awa nawo wono watyatyizye, wali wapejigwe wulajilize wo kwimba zinyimbo zono zelile, ze lilumbo hali Mulungu. Yeshuwa, Binuyi, Kadimiyeli na Shelebiya, Yuda na Mataniya, mono yali yo mulanjilizi mu zinyimbo zo wulumbe hamonga ne wanduguze.

9 Awa nawo, wakanoza cipuga ce wembi, cono cembaga wedomile ne cipuga ce wayawo, wakwiboceza mu wimbe, Bakubukiya, na Uno, hamonga ne wandugu zawo Walawi.

Wityatye wa mu ndelo yo Mukohani Muwaha Yoshuwa

10 Yoshuwa yali yo mulezi wa Yoyakimu, Yoyakimu yakamulela Eliyashibu, na Eliyashibu yakamulela Yoyada.

11 Yoyada yakamulela Yonazani, na Yonazani yo yamulela Yaduwa.

Walongola wa mu ndelo ze Wakohani

12 Lulo hono Yoyakimu yali Mukohani Muwaha, awa wono watyatyize, wali wo walongola wa mu ndelo ze wakohani, nha vyono nhavi,

Melaya wa mu mhuga ya Selaya,

Hananiya, wa mu mhuga ya Yelemiya.

13 Meshulamu, wamu mhuga ya Ezila,

Yehohanani, wa mu mhuga ya Amaliya.

14 Yonazani, wa mu mhuga ya Maluki,

Yusufu, wa mhuga ya Shebaniya.

15 Adina, wa mu mhuga ya Halimu,

Helikayi wa mu mhuga ya Melayoti.

16 Zekaliya wa mu mhuga ya Ido,

Meshulamu wa mu mhuga ya Ginetomu.

17 Zikili, wa mu mhuga ya Abiya,

we mhuga ya Miniyamini,

Pilitayi, wa mu mhuga ya Mowadiya.

18 Shamuwa, wa mu mhuga ya Biliga,

Yehonazani, wa mhuga ya Shemaya.

19 Metanayi, wa mu mhuga ya Yoyalibu,

Uzi, wa mu mhuga ya Yedaya.

20 Kalayi, wa mu mhuga ya Salayi,

Ebeli, wa mu mhuga ya Amoke.

21 Hashabiya, wa mu mhuga ya Hilikiya

Netaneli, wa mu mhuga ya Yedaya.

Lwandiko lwe zimhuga ze Wakohani ne Walawi

22 Lwandiko lukawikwa, lwe walongola wose we mhuga ye Walawi, na ye Wakohani, mu vilo vye Wakohani Wawaha, Eliyashibu, Yoyada, na Yonazani, na Yaduwa, mu vilo vyo mutemi Daliyo wa ku Pelisiya.

23 I walongola wa mu mhuga ye Walawi, hamba nhavivyo, wali wandikwe mu citabu co wikumbucize, co wutemi, mu vilo vya Yonazani u mwizukulu wa Eliyashibu.

Wugawane we milimo ya mu Nyumba yo Mulungu

24 Ale, so mahweso ge walongola, Hashibiya, Shelebiya, Yeshuwa, Binuyi na Kadimiyeli. I Walawi wose, wakawikwa mu vipuga vipuga, wawikwaga vipuga vyejete vyejete mu wilecele, ho vimukumye no kumulumba Mulungu, mu wutyatya wutemye wo Mutemi Dawudi munhu wo Mulungu.

25 Awa wono watyatyize, nawo wali wali mu wulanjilizi we Nyumba yo Mulungu, ho walanjilile i vinyumba vyo kuwikwa viwutwa, wali wali he'lango lye Nyumba yo Mulungu, Matatiya, Bakubukiya, Obadiya na Meshulamu, Talimoni na Akubu.

26 Walongola wawa, wekela mu vilo vya Yoyakimu u mwana wa Yoshuwa, u mwizukulu kwa Yehozadaki, na mu vilo vya Nehemiya u mulongola, na mu vilo vya Ezila u mukohani, u munghula we Malajilizo.

Nehemiya yakugasiwanula majinji ge Likaya

27 Hobaho lono majinji ge likaya lya Yelusalemi gasiwanulwaga, wakaletwa i Walawi wono wali wekaye kunze ye likaya, ho wahangane ne wayawo mu sikukuu yiyo, no kwimba zinyimbo ze malumbo, ne zinyimbo ze misesele ne vidananda ne masumbi.
28 I zimhuga ze wembi ze Walawi, zikekongholela ha Yelusalemi, ku wulawa mu vikaya, ne matumbi gono gapilime Netofati.
29 Na wanji ku wulawa Betegiligali na Geba na Azimaveti.
30 Wakohani ne Walai, wakeyeza weneco, hamonga ne wanhu, ne milango, sunga ne majinji ge likaya.

31 Nghawakongholela walongola wose wa Yuda, mucanyha ye majinji, nghawagawa vipuga vyejete, nghawawika wawe walanjlizi we mapuga mejete mawaha ge wanhu, nghawalajiliza wajende mumo mucanyha ye majinji, wapilime likaya lyose, ho wamupele Mulungu yilumbo.

Lipuga lilongozi, likakola ku lubavu lo kulume, likujenda mucanyha ye lijinji, sunga ko ku mulango we Matope.
32 Hoshaya yali yali mu nyuma ye wembi, hamonga ne nusu ye walongola wa ku Yuda.
33 I wakohani awa nawo wono watyatyizye aha, wo watowaga zi ndulele, nawo wali wali mu nyuma ye lipuga: Azaliya, na Ezila, Meshulamu,
34 Yuda Benyamini na Shemaya na Yelemiya.
35 Hanyuma yakatyatya Zekaliya u mwana wa Yonazani, u mwizukulu kwa Shemaya. (Hamonga ne walezi wawo, Mataniya, Mikaya na Zakuli wa mu mhuga ya Asafu).
36 Waketyatya na wanji wa muli wanduguze, Shemaya, Azaleli, Milalayi, Gilalayi na Mayi, na Netaneli, Yuda na Hanani, awa wose, wali wadinghuye viya vyo kwimbila, vyono vyali vinha vyono yetumamilaga mutemi Dawudi, u munhu wo Mulungu. Ezila nayo u munghula, yakalilongoza lipuga lili mu wujende.
37 Wulawa ku Mulunga we Mivwilo, wakabita wakakolela mu zi ngazi zono zibitile sunga ko kwi'kaya lya Dawudi lyo wutemi. Wakakolela sunga he'kulu lyo mutemi Dawudi. Hanyuma, wakawa kuwuya, sunga ko ku Mulango we Malenga, ku lubavu lwa kucilima ye likaya.

38 Lipuga linji lya awalya wono walavyaga lilumbo, wakadoma lubavu lo kucekulu, mucanyha ye majinji. Nane, nghawatyatya, hamonga ne nusu ye lipuga lye wanhu. Cikajendelela sunga ko ku Munala wo wunyanyilo mwi'jinji ligazi.
39 Na mu wulawa baho, cikakolela ha Mulango wa Efulayimu, no Mulango wa Yeshana, no Mulango we zisomba no Munala wa Hananeli, no Munala wa Hameya, sunga ko ku Mulango we Zingholo. No wupilime wetu, wukamalicila behi no mulango we Nyumba yo Mulungu.

40 Hobaho i vipuga vyose vyejete, vyono vyapilimaga no kumupela Mulungu lilumbo, vyose vikafika ha ciwanza ce Nyumba yo Mulungu.
41 Iwalongola wono napilimana nawo nene, cali cili hamonga ne lipuga lyangu, hamonga ne Wakohani wono atowaga ndulele, Eliyakimu, Maseya na Miniyamini, Mikaya na Eliyowenayi, Zekaliya na Hananiya.
42 Waketyatya na Maseya, Shemaya na Eleyezali. Uzi na Yehohanani, Malikiya, Elamu na Ezeli. Ne wembi wono wali wena na Yelahiya, wembaga kwe mazi mawaha muno muno.

43 Mwi'zuwa lilyo, makumbiko menji gakalavywa ne wanhu wali wena nyemo mbaha, hambi Mulungu nha yo yawapela wusangalale wuwo. We cicekulu ne wana wao, wose wakelunza mu sikukuu yiyo, ne lizozo lye nyemo lyono lyali baho ha Yelusalemi, lyali yiwaha muno muno.

Vilavywa so wuhembi, mu Nyumba yo Mulungu

44 Mwi'zuwa lilyo, wanhu wakawikwa, ho wawe walanjilizi we vinyumba vyo kuwika viwutwa vya mu Nyumba yo Mulungu, mono vyawikwaga vyose, hamonga ne zaka, ne malimbuko go wuhemba, ne mikalo, i vilongozi kupya mu migunda yawo myaka yose. Walindilizi wawa, wakapegwa mulimo wo kuvikonghola mu migunda ya mu vikaya ne matumbi gono gapilime, i vilavywa vye Wakohani ne Walawi nha vyono winha wulajilize. I wanhu wose wa Yuda, wendezwa muno no witumami we Wakohani ne Walawi.
45 Vyono wali wakamise zo wunoza zi sikukuu zo wiyeze, hamonga no wityatye wunji wo wuhembi, nha vyono Mulungu yawalajliza. I wembi wa mu Nyumba yo Mulungu, hamonga ne walindilizi, nawo waketuma milimo yose, nha vyono winha wulajilize wo mutemi Dawudi, hamonga no mwanagwe Solomona.
46 Wulawilila mu vilo vyo mutemi Dawudi, no mulongola we wembi Asafu, mu vilo vye katali, i wembi wembaga zinyimbo zo lukumyo na ze lilumbo kuli Mulungu.
47 Na mu vilo vya Zelubabeli na Nehemiya, Waisilayeli wose, walavyaga nhondo zose vipegwa so wembi wa mu Nyumba yo Mulungu, hamonga ne walindilizi we Nyumba yo Mulungu. Kanyhi wanhu wakalavya vilavywa vyono vyelile kuli Walawi, nawo i Walawi wakawapela Wakohani yigawo lyono lyali liwanojeye wapegwe.


Nehemiya 13

Kwisiwanula ne wanhu wanji

1 Ale, lono wasomaga citabu co Wulajilize ca Musa, ha mwande ye wanhu wose. Wakawona mu mandiko gago hanji hono hatezaga, Muamoni hamba Mumowabu, yalecele lukulu kwihanzahanza ne wanhu wo Mulungu.
2 Zizi zikalongwa ku soko Wamowabi ne Waamoni, siwawapela wanhu wa Isilayeli, zindigwa ne malenga, lono wali wali mu muhinzo, wakulawa Misili. Kanyhi, wo wamufupa zipesa Balamu ho yawalijite Waisilayeli, ninga u Mulungu wetu, yakakawaniza wulijitwe, wukawa wulugutwe.
3 Ale, nawo wanhu wa Isilayeli, wali weza kuzihulika zo Wulajilize wuso wukusomwa, ho baho wakawatemanula i wanhu we makungugo ganji wose, wono wali wali mu mhuga yawo.

Wunozeleze wa Nehemiya

4 Umukohani Eliyashibu mono yali yo mulanjilizi we vinyumba vyo kuwika viwutwa, vya mu Nyumba yo Mulungu, vyali viyendile muno na Tobiya.
5 Holeka yamukombola Tobiya yekale mu cinyumba cimonga ciwaha, co kuwicila viwutwa vye vilavywa vyo wuhemba, na vinji vinji, ne viya vyono vyetumamilwaga mu Nyumba yo Mulungu, ne vilavywa so Wakohani, ne zaka zo wuhemba, no wuvumba ne divayi, ne mafuta vyono wapegwaga Walawi ne wembi, ne walindilizi we Nyumba yo Mulungu.
6 Na zizi lono zetumwaga, ane, nali nawuka ha Yelusalemi, ku soko mu mwaka we makumi madatu na nyejete, wa mu wuteme wakwe mutemi Alitashasita ku Babiloni, nali nojeye nimubitile kuko ku Babiloni, nghamuloloseze zo wujendelele, wono cali cina nawo u Yelusalemi. Nali neza ku kondya zizi, ne vilo lono vyali vyatelatela, hodu, mutemi yakawa kunghombola ho mbuye ku Yelusalemi.
7 Baho nali naza kufika ha Yelusalemi, nghatinuka muno kuwona vyono, Eliyashibu, yali yamukombolela Tobiya cinyumba cico mu Nyumba yo Mulungu.
8 Nghakalala muno, nghawa kuvigumilanga kunze vyombologoto vyose vya Tobiya.
9 Nghawa kulajiliza vinyumba vivyo wavyeze kanyhi, i viya vye viwutwa vya mu Nyumba yo Mulungu, ne vilavywa vyo wuhemba, hamonga no wuvumba, ho viwikwe mumo kanyhi.

10 Kanyhi, nghagana i wembi wa mu Nyumba yo Mulungu, hamonga na wanji wa mu Walawi, wawuka mu Yelusalemi, wawuya ne nyuma ku migunda yawo, vyono wanhu si wawapelaga viswanu ndigwa ne malenga.
11 Nghawakalipila i walongola, vyono wali wayileceleza Nyumba yo Mulungu yawula wanhu. Hobaho nghawagomola kanyhi ha Yelusalemi i Walawi ne wembi, nghawa kuwawika kanyhi wetume mu Nyumba yo Mulungu.
12 Hobaho i wanhu wa Isilayeli, wakawa kwanza kanyhi kulavya zaka zawo zo wuhemba ne divayi, na ze mafuta, no kuviwika mu vinyumba vye viwutwa, vya mu Nyumba yo Mulungu.
13 Nghawa kuwawika Shelemiya u mukohani, na Zadoki u munghula we Malajilizo, na Pedaya u Mulawi, wawe wo walanjilizi we vinyumba vyo kuwika viwutwa vya mu Nyumba yo Mulungu, hamonga na Hanani u mwana wa Zakuli u mwizukulu kwa Mataniya, yakawa yo mutazi wawo. Hambi awa nha namanya vyono wawa wo wanhu wehuwilwa, mu wugawila vinhu wetumami wayawo.

14 Holeka wunghumbucile 'gwe go Mulungu wangu, i metumo gangu gono netuma so Nyumba yako, na so wuhembi wayo.

15 Mu vilo vivyo, nghawawona wanhu wa ku Yuda wakuminya zabibu, ho watuje mulengu wayo mwi'zuwa lye Sabato. Wanji wakawa wadinghuye wuhemba, divayi, ne mikalo minji, mu zindogowe zawo, wa kuleta ku Yelusalemi. Nghawasugula ho walece kuguza co cose mwi'zuwa lye Sabato.
16 Ale, baho ha Yelusalemi, wekalaga wanhu wanji wono wali walawiliye ku Tulo. Nawo waletaga somba, hamonga ne vinhu viji, no kuwaguziza wanhu wetu mwi'kaya, mwizuwa lye Sabato.
17 Nghawakalipilanga kanyhi i walongola we Ciyahudi nghawatya, “Alu ta mulanje azi zo wavu zono mukwituma! Mweza kuyihodanga Sabato, ho liwe yizuwa lyono si lyelile.
18 Ayi mbeka yo soko yono yamukalaza Mulungu, sunga yakawa kuwalipiciza i walezi wenyu, lono yalyongomezeza likaya lili. Sunga nalu nanye, mukali vyo mukulyonjeleza likuwo lyo Mulungu mu mhuga ya Isilayeli, so kuyavufya Sabato.”

19 Hobaho nghalajiliza vyono, i milango yose ya mwi'kaya, yiwe kudindwa mu mwamulizo we mazuwa ge Sabato, mu mapango ge cinyamihe lono Sabato yikwanza. Kanyhi na vyono, i milango yilece kudigulwa, sunga kolo Sabato yakondya kupuluta. Nghawawika wanhu mu milango, walanjilile, cinhu co cose cilece kuhelezwa mwi'kaya mwizuwa lye Sabato.
20 Hamba nhavivyo mu nghanghulo monga hamba nyejete, i wakwawi wono waguzaga vinhu vye mawala gose, wakawa wakugona kunze ye majinji, mwi'zuwa lye jumaa.
21 Nane nghawasugula nghawatya, “Siyinojeye muwe kugona kunze ye majinji, mulindiye sunga wele. Holeka hono muwuyajile kanyhi kunoza nhavivi, nane nokwitumamila vilungo ho mulece kwijelela kuza kanyhi.” Hodu wakawa kupela hamba si waza kanyhi mwizuwa lye Sabato.
22 Nghawalajiliza i Walawi weyeze, wanze no kuyilindiliza milango, ho walyeze lizuwa lye Sabato.

Gwe go Mulungu, wunghumbucilile kanyhi na muli zizi, kanyhi wumbonele lusungu so wendo wako wuwaha.

23 Kanyhi baho, ho nghamanya nha vyono, wanji wa muli Wayahudi, wali watolile wacekulu wanya Ashidodi na we yisi ya Amoni na Mowabu.
24 Na holeka nusu ye wana wawo, walongola nonga ye Ciashidodi, wakuhanzahanza ne zinonga zinji. Hamba siwasumaga kulonga nonga yetu ye Ciyahudi.
25 Nghawakalipilanga wanhu no kuwalijita, nghawa kuwatowanga, kanyhi nghawakulanga ne zimvwili zawo. Nghawatya welahize hali Mulungu vyono, weneco hamba i wana wawo, si wolokwitolanila kanyhi na wono si Wayahudi.
26 Nghawa kutya, “Wawa wacekulu wono si Wayahudi, wo wmwambuza mutemi Solomona yakwituma wubi. Yali munhu muwaha yacizize watemi wose we zinghungugo zinji. Mulungu yakamwenda no kumuwika yawe Mutemi muli Waisilayeli wose, ninga hamba nhavivyo, yakagwila mu wubi wuwu.
27 Alu cityatye u wuwe wenyu hongo, cimubedegale Muwaha Mulungu wetu, so kuwatola wacekulu wono si Wayahudi?”

28 Yoyada yali mwana wa Eliyashibu u mukohani Muwaha, ninga mwanagwe monga, yakatola mwana we cicekulu wa Sanibalati ku wulawa ku Bete-holoni, hobaho nghamuwinga Yoyada yawuce ha Yelusalemi.

29 Wukumbucile Gwe go Mulungu, vyono i wanhu awa wakondya kuwutipiza wukohani, hamonga ne cilagane, cono walagana ne wakohani ne Walawi.

30 Hodu, nghawa kuweze wanhu, mu wulawa mu vinhu vyose vijenzi, nghawika wityatye we milimo, so Walawi ne wakohani, ho wamanye no kuwutyatya witumami wawo viswanu.
31 Nghawika ne mazuwa, go kuleta zingwagu zo kunyanyila vilavywa vinyanywe, vyono vyalavywaga mu mapango gono gali galajilizwe. Hamonga no wityatye we wanhu, ho wawe kulavya i malimbuko go wuhemba ne mikalo milongozi kupya.

Wunghumbucile Gwe go Mulungu so zizi, wumhele ne ziswanu zose.


Esita 1

Vashiti mugolece wo mutemi yakulibedegala lilajilizo lyo Mutemi Ahasuwelo

1 Mutemi Ahasuwelo mu madaha lono yali yatemile, yali yatemile yisi yigana limonga na makumi mejete na mupunghati, ku wulawilila Indiya, sunga Kushi.
2 Ne ligoda lyakwe lyo wutemi, lyali lili mwi'kaya liwaha lya Susa.
3 Na mu mwaka we kadatu wa mu wuteme wakwe, mutemi Ahasuwelo, yakanoza sikukuu mbaha, yakawalalika i wawaha ne vitung'ati wose wa mu yisi ya Pelisiya no Wumedi. Kanyhi ne wetumbilwa wose wa mu yisi yakwe, wakacemwa ho yaduwane nawo.
4 Ne sikukuu yiyi, yikasola myezi mutandatu, mutemi yakawalajila wugoli wakwe, ne zindigwa zinhambule ze citemi-temi.

5 Sikukuu yiyi yaza kuwa yamalika, kanyhi yakawanozeza sikukuu yinji, i wawaha ne wanhu wose i wagoli ne waciwa, wono wekalaga mwi'kulu lya Susa. Nayo sikukuu yiyo, yikajendelela sunga vilo mupunghati, yanozezwa mu luwa mu busitani ye likulu.
6 Kaya yiyo, yali hambwe ne mapaziya ge vitambala vye buluu ne vizelu, vyo wuguzi wukamu, gawopigwe ne vilejehe viswanu, vye liwala lidunghu na lye buluu, matumbikwe mu zinyamwidole za fweza, mu masumbili ge libwe. Ne vitanda navyo, vyali vya zahabu na fweza, vili mucanyha ye sakafu ya malumalu, mabwe madunghu ne mazelu, na ge manjano, ne matitu.
7 Ha wung'we we divayi, vyetumamilwaga vikombe vya zahabu, navyo vyose vyali visimajiye, hali hasina cono cali cihwanile ne ciyagwe. No mutemi yakawa mucemezi muno ne divayi yiyo ye citemi.
8 Ne divayi yikawa nyinji muno, sunga no mutemi yakawalajiliza wetumami wa mwi'kulu wamugawile munhu wo wose mu nghango nha vyono yakusaka kung'wa.

9 Vashiti nayo yali yanozize zindigwa ze sikukuu so we cicekulu, mu mulya mwi'kaya lyo wutemi.
10 Mwizuwa lyo mupunghati lya mu sikukuu yiyi, mutemi Ahasuwelo lono yang'wezaga, yakawa na nyemo mbaha. Baho yakawacema wetumami wakwe i wapaswe, mupunghati, wono wali wali mu mulimo, Mehumani, Bizita, Halebona, Bigita, Abagita, Zetali na Kalekasi.
11 Yakawatuma wakamulete Vashiti, yaze yavwalile no mukumbo wakwe wo wutemi. Vashiti yali mucekulu muswanu ku wulangwe. Mutemi Ahasuwelo yasakaga kuwulajila wuswanu wo mugolece wakwe kuli wawaha ne wajenzi wose.
12 Wetumami wawalya i wapaswe, wali weza kumulonjela Vashiti lilajilizo lyo mutemi Ahasuwelo, Vashiti yakalema kubita. Ne nghani yiyi yikamukalaza muno mutemi.

13 Moto wo mutemi, yali yendile kuwawuza i wetumbilwa wakwe zo wityatye no wulajilize we yisi.
14 Kenji muno yawawuzaga Kalishena, Shetali, Adimata, Talishishi Melesi, Malisena, na Memukani, i wawaha wa mu yisi ya Pelisiya na Wumedi, wono wali webate wulajilize wuwaha mu wutemi wakwe, muli wene, nani mono kumulonjela co kumutendela Vashiti.
15 Yakawawuza yakatya, “Ane no mutemi Ahasuwelo, nhuma wetumami wangu i wapaswe kuli Vashiti, wamulonjele yaze. Ninga Vashiti kabena wulajilize wangu kalema kuza! Alu wulajilize, wukutya nhawule, cono cimutendele Vashiti so cibede cakwe?”

16 Memukani yakalonga ha mwande yo mutemi ne wawaha wayagwe yakatya, “Mugolece yuyu Vashiti, siyamubedegaye du mutemi, langa kacibedegala sunga na sese wose ne wawaha wose, hamonga ne wanhu wose wa mu wutemi wako!
17 Wacekulu wose wa mu wutemi wako, hono wahulice nghani ayi yono Vashiti yetumile, nawo wokwanza kuwabedegala walume zawo. Wotya, ‘Mutemi Ahasuwelo yamulajiliza mugolece wakwe Vashiti yaze ha mwande yakwe, ninga Vashiti yalema kubita.’
18 Hono wacekulu wa mu wutemi wako wa mu Pelisiya na Wumedi, wahulice cibede ca Vashiti, hodu nawo yowa yo nongwa ku walume zawo, kanyhi wowa wena cibede nhondo zose ku walume zawo. Walume zawo nawo wowa kuwakolelwa yikuwo wagolece zawo.
19 Holeka hono wuwone viswanu, go Mulumbwe, wulavye wulajilize wukali mu wutemi wako, vyono, Vashiti yalece kanyhi kuza ha mwande yo mutemi. Lajilize mu matumbi gose ga mu yisi yako yo Pelisiya no Wumedi, no wulajilize wuwo, wuwe wono siwulakawanika yaye. Hanyuma wumulondole mugolece yunji mono mutuvu, yo yapegwe lilumbo lyo wugolece wo mutemi.
20 No wulajilize wuwu hono wuwe walongwa no kumanyika kuli wanhu wose mu wutemi wako, hodu, wagolece wose wa mu yisi yako, wowa kuwatumamila viswanu walume zawo, hambe nha mulume muciwa hamba mugoli.”

21 Mutemi Ahasuwelo hamonga ne wawaha wayagwe ne vitung'ati wose, ne wetumbilwa wose, wakendezwa ne zinghani zono yalonga Memukani. Nayo mutemi yaketuma nhavivyo.
22 Yakalitegula lilajilizo lili, mu matumbi gose ga mu wutemi wakwe, yitumbi ne milonjele yayo, na mu candicile cayo. Lilajilizo lyono lyatezaga, “Mulume wo wose, yeze yo muwaha mu kaya, no kuyanza nghani yiyi mu nonga ye wanhu wakwe.”


Esita 2

Esita yakuwa mugolece wo mutemi

1 Likuwo lyo mutemi Ahasuwelo lyaza kuwa lyamalika, yakajendelela kwihwesa metumo ga Vashiti, hamonga ne lilajilizo lyono yali yalitegula mu matumbi gose.
2 Hobaho i watazi we watemi, wono wali wali behi no mutemi Ahasuwelo, wakamutya, “Alu nhawule wulece kumulondola muhinza yunji mutuvu mono yakali namanya walume, kanyhi mono muswanu ku wulangwe.
3 Wudahile kuwategulila lilajilizo lili, wawaha wose wa mu matumbi gako gose, wawalete wahinza i waswanu, we lizika lidodo, kanyhi watuvu, waletwe baha ha Susa, nagwe wuwawice mu nyumba yako, wawe hasi yo wulanjilizi wo mwitumami wako Hagayi mupaswe, u mwitumami wa mu nyumba yako, u mulanjilizi we wetumami wako wose we cicekulu. Walanjililwe no konjelezwa wuswanu wawo, wahinza wawo ho wajendelele kupegwa vinhu ne zindigwa zo kuwonjeleza uwuswanu ku wulangwe.
4 Nagwe baho ho kokwihagulila muhinza muswanu, no mutuvu kuciza wayagwe. Nagwe komusola yawe mugolece wako, wuwe kumuleka Vashiti.” Nayo mutemi yakawona vyono lihweso lilino yiswanu, nayo yakalityatya.

5 Naho baho ha Susa, yekalaga munhu yunji mono yacemwaga Moledekayi mwana wa Yayili, yali wa mu mhuga ya Benyamini mwana wa Kishi na Shimeyi.
6 Vipango vivilya vyono mutemi Nebukadineza wa Babiloni, yamusuma mutemi Yehoyakimu wa ku Yuda, yakawa kumuteka hamonga na wenji wa muli Wayahudi, ku wulawilila Yelusalemi, ale, mumo mwipuga lilyo, na Moledekayi nayo yali yali mumo.
7 Yakawa yena na, Esita, mono yacemwaga Hadasa mu nonga ye cihebelaniya mono yali mwana wo mwihwawe Abihayili. Yali muhinza muswanu ku wulangwe, we nhenje swanu muno muno. Walezi wakwe wali weza kufwa, Moledekayi yakamusola yakekalana nayo kotya mwanagwe.
8 Umutemi yaza kuwa yalilavya lilajilizo lililya, ale, wahinza wenji wakaletwa ku Susa, nayo Esita yakawa muyagwe na wawo wono waletwa. Esita yakawikwa mwi'kaya lyo wutemi mu wulanjilizi wa Hagayi mono yali yo mulanjilizi muwaha we nyumba ye wajitulwa.
9 Hagayi yendezwa muno na Esita so futa yakwe swanu. Yakalamula kumudima viswanu Esita mu nzila yo kumonjeleza wuswanu wakwe. Yakamupela zindigwa ziswanu no wugono wuswanu. Yakamuhagulila wahinza wanji wali mupunghati wo kumulanjilila muli visakwa vyakwe vyose.

10 Lulo Moledekayi yali yamulonjeye Esita, yalece kwimanyiza nha vyono mwene Muyahudi.
11 Nayo Moledekayi yajendelaga behi ne nyumba yiyo yo wutemi ho yawone zono zikumwijelela Esita.
12 Wudimwe wuwu wo kuwonjeleza uwuswanu we wahinza wawa, wukajendelela kwa mwaka monga. Nawo wapegwaga mu myezi mutandatu, mafuta ge manemane, hanyuma kanyhi mu myezi mutandatu yinji wapegwaga mafuta go kuwunoza muwili ho wuwe wutelemeye. Waza kuzikondya zizi zose, wakawa kwanza kumutegula muhinza yumonga yumonga, vikewone no mutemi Ahasuwelo.
13 Ne cipango lono cafika co kumutegula muhinza yumonga ha mwande yo mutemi, muhinza yuyo yakombolwaga yavwale viswanu nha vyono mweneco yasakaga.
14 Wawategulaga cinyamihe, na hono wela, wategulwaga kanyhi mu nyumba yinji yo kuwonjeleza wuswanu, yono yalanjililwaga na Shashingazi umupaswe, mono yali mulanjilizi we wajitulwa wo mutemi. No muhinza hono yawe yalawa ko mutemi, hodu, siyawuyajilaga kanyhi ko mutemi sunga hono mutemi mweneco, yalamule kumusaka kanyhi yawuyajile, no mutemi mweneco yo yatambulaga litagwa lyo muhinza yuyo, holeka yabite kanyhi yawuyajile.

15 Ale, lipango likawa lyafika lyo kumutegula Esita ko mutemi, Esita umuhinza wa Abihayili u mwihwawe wa Moledekayi, mono yali yamuhagula yekaye nayo kotya mwanagwe. Esita yendezaga muno muno ku wulangwe, kuli wose wono wamulangaga. Lipango lyakwe lyaza kuwa lyafika, mwene si yasaka cinji, langa yakavwala viswanu, nha vyono yalonjelwa na Hagayi umupaswe mono yali yo muwaha we nyumba yiyo.
16 Umutemi Ahasuwelo yali yafisa myaka mupunghati ya mu wuteme wakwe. Na mu mwezi we likumi, wono wacemwaga Tebeti, Esita yakategulwa ha mwande yo mutemi Ahasuwelo mwi'kaya lyakwe lyo wutemi.
17 Mutemi Ahasuwelo yakendezwa muno muno no muhinza yuyu Esita kuciza wanji wose. Yali yavwaliye viswanu, kanyhi yendezaga ku wulangwe. Mutemi yakamuvwaliza Esita mukumbo we citemi mu mutwe. Yakawa mucekulu mutuvu wa mwi'kulu, yakahalila hanhu ha Vashiti.
18 Baho umutemi yakanoza sikukuu mbaha so kumutuga Esita. Yakawalalika i wawaha ne vitung'ati wose hamonga ne wetumami. Baho yakawapela wucehe mu milimo yose, mu wutemi wakwe wose. Mwizuwa lilyo, yakawagawila vipegwa vinji, vyono vyali vye citemi temi.

Moledekayi yakuwutaza wumi wo mutemi

19 Lulo mutemi Ahasuwelo yakamuhagula Moledekayi ho yawe mulongola kwi'tumbi linji.
20 Ninga ku lubavu lwa Esita, Moledekayi yali yajendeleye kuhundika vyono Esita Muyahudi. Moledekayi yakamulonjela Esita yayihundice nghani yiyi, kanyhi yalece kulonjela yunji wo wose, Esita yakamuhulika mu nghani yiyi, nha vyono yali yazoweye kumuhulika lono yali yakali mudodo, lono wali wekalane nayo ha lulongozi.
21 Mwipango lyono Moledekayi yali yapegwa wuwaha mwi'kaya lyo Mutemi, Bigutana na Teleshi, i wejete wa muli wetumami wapaswe wa he'kulu, wono walindilizaga ha mulango ha nyumba yo mutemi, wakakolwa ne 'kuwo wakalamula wamuwulaje mutemi Ahasuwelo cinyele.
22 Moledekayi yali yeza kuzihulika zizi, yakawa kumulonjela Esita mugolece wo mutemi, nayo Esita yakamulonjela mutemi vyono Moledekayi yo yali yazimanya zizi.
23 Kukawa no wusunjililwe mu nghani yiyi, nayo yikejela vyono ya mbeka, holeka wetumami wawa i wejete, wakatumbikwa mu mabici go kuwulajila. Ne nghani ye wanhu awa, yandikwa ha mwande yo mutemi mu citabu ce zinghani za mu wutemi, zono zinojeye zikumbucilwe.


Esita 3

Hamani yakuhila yawawulaje Wayahudi

1 Vyali vyeza kupuluta vilo vicefu, mutemi Ahasuwelo, yakamupela wuwaha munhu yunji mono yacemwaga Hamani, yakamupela wuwaha wa mu walongola wose. Hamani yakawa mulelwe na Hamedata Mwagagi.
2 Mutemi yakawalonjela iwawaha wose mu witumami wakwe, wamuhulice Hamani, wamwinamile no kumufugamila ha mwande yakwe. Na wose wakawa kwituma nha vyono walajilizwa, ninga Moledekayi yakalema kwituma zizi.
3 Wawaha wayagwe wakamuwuza Moledekayi, soko yono yikumunoza yalece kwituma wulajilize wo Mutemi.
4 Kenji muno wamusaka yetume zizi, ninga mwene siyawahulika. Yakawatya, “Ane nili Muyahudi,” holeka sinosuma kwinama no kufugama ha mwande ya Hamani. Hobaho wakamulonjela Hamani zizi, akuno wena ne mahwele hono Hamani kokwendezwa no wuwe wuwu wa Moledekayi.
5 Hamani yakakalala muno yali yeza kuhulika vyono Moledekayi yakulema kuwinamila no kumufugamila.
6 Yaza kumanya vyono kumbe Moledekayi Muyahudi, hobaho yakadumula nghani vyono yalece kumongomeza yali wene, langa ciba yawongomeze Wayahudi wose wono wali mu wutemi wose wa mu Pelisiya.

7 Mu mwaka we likumi na nyejete wo wutemi wa Ahasuwelo, mu mwezi mulongozi, wono wacemwaga Nisani, Hamani yakalajiliza yitowe kula, Pulimu, nha cinji nha vyono wayitezaga. Ho walamule lizuwa no mwezi, wono wakwitumila zizi ku Wayahudi. Wakalamula zitumwe mu mwezi we likumi na nyejete, wono wacemwaga Adali mwizuwa lye 'kumi na yidatu.

8 Hamani yakawa yamutegulila zizi Mutemi Ahasuwelo, yakatya, “Moyili nghungugo yinji yono yiyagaye mu wutemi wako mu matumbi gose. Wono wena myoto yono yisimajiye ne myoto yetu, hamba si yihwanile ne myoto ye wanhu wanji wo wose. Hamonga na zizo, siwakwenda kwibata no kwituma wulajilize wa mu yisi yako. Nane nghwitumbila vyono, sikowawonela soni ho wapegwe wulipicizwe wanhu wawa.
9 Holeka 'gwe mutemi, hono wuwe wendezwe, ale, wulavye wulajilize, i wanhu wawa wawulagwe. Na hono mbeka vyo wukutya, ane niwikanize kulavya kilo elufu, magana madatu na makumi mane za fweza, hamba kuciza, zinjizwe mu ciwutwa co wutemi ho zitumamilwe mu wudimi we yisi yiyi.”

10 Mutemi yakayiwopola nyamwidole yakwe, yono yayitumamilaga so wuwicila vitanjilo, mu malajilizo gono yasakaga getumwe mu yisi yakwe, yakamupela Hamani u mulugu we Wayahudi, u mwana wa Hamedata wa mu lulelo lwa Agagi.
11 Mutemi yakamutya Hamani, “I wanhu hamonga ne zi sawo zawo, vyose vyako, holeka wuwatendelaje nha vyono wendile gwegwe.”

12 Hobaho mwizuwa lye kumi ne 'datu lya mu mwezi mulongozi, Hamani yakawacema wandici wose wo mutemi, yakawasomela lilajilizo, nalyo likandikwa mu zinonga zose za mu yisi, na mu nzila yo wandice wono wetumamilwaga mu wutemi. Hanyuma yakawa kuzitegula kuli watemi, ne walongola wose. Yakawicila sayini ye litagwa lyo mutemi Ahasuwelo, hamonga ne citanjilo ce nyamwidole yakwe.
13 I wanhu wono watumwa, wakalisola lilajilizo lili, wakalitegula mu matumbi gose go wutemi wa Ahasuwelo. Lyali lina ne vitanjilo vyono vyalajilaga, vyono mwizuwa lye likumi ne 'datu lya mu mwezi wa Adali, Wayahudi wose wadodo ne wakombi, wacekulu ne wana, wose wanojeye wawulagwe. Yikalamulwa vyono, wose wawulagwe walece kuwonelwa lusungu. Ne zisawo zawo zose zisolwe.
14 Lilajilizo lili likeyagazwa hanhu hose calinze mu matumbi gose, ho wanhu wose wamanye no kwiwikaniza mwizuwa lilyo kolo lyeza kufika.
15 So wulajilize wo mutemi, nghani yiyi yikatandala hanhu hose mwi'kaya liwaha lya Susa. I wanhu wono watumwa, wakategula wulajilize wuwu mu matumbi gose. Mutemi Ahasuwelo, hamonga na Hamani, wakekala, wakawa wakujendelela kung'wa divayi, mu cipango cono likaya liwaha lya Susa lyali lili mu wihwelele wuwaha so lilajilizo lilyo.


Esita 4

Moledekayi yakulomba wutazi kuli Esita

1 Moledekayi yali yeza kumanya vyono zizi zose zakondya kwitumwa, yakayidemulanga myenda yakwe ko wusungu wuwaha, yakavwala magunila, yakemwajila mavu mu mutwe wakwe, yakanza kupilima mwi'kaya lya Susa, yakawa kulila muno ko wusungu wuwaha,
2 sunga yakawa kufika ha mulango muwaha wo kwinjilila mwi'kaya. Ninga siyasuma kwinjila, vyono kwali kusina wukombolwe kuli munhu mono yavwalile magunila kuhelela mwi'kaya.
3 Na ko kose kono lilajilizo lili lyali lyakondya kufika no kumanyika ne wanhu, kwali na cililo muli Wayahudi wose. Wakekapisa no kuvwala magunila no kulila ko wukalale wuwaha no kugona mu mavu.
4 Wahinza wono wamwitumamilaga Esita, hamonga ne wetumami wapaswe, wali weza kuwona vyono Moledekayi yanozaga, hobaho wakawa mulonjela Esita. Nayo Esita yakawa kuhangawa no kugazika muno. Yakasola myenda miswanu, yakamupela Moledekayi yavwale. Ninga Moledekayi yakalema kuyibocela.
5 Esita yakamucema Hataci u mwitumami wakwe, mono yali mupaswe mono yali yapejigwe no Mutemi yawe kumwitumamila milimo. Esita yakamutuma Hataci, yabite vikaduwane na Moledekayi, Moledekayi yamulonjele zose zono zijeye, na vyono zo zikuleka yakwituma nhavivi, na ku soko ci.
6 Hataci yakabita kwa Moledekayi, he'lango liwaha lyo kwinjilila mwi'kaya.
7 Moledekayi yakamuloloseza Hataci zose zono zali zamwijelela, na vyono Hamani yali yalamula kulavya sawo nyinji mu witumami wa mu wutemi wuwo, hono mutemi yalumbe kuwawulaga Wayahudi wose.
8 Moledekayi yakamupela Hataci ne baluwa ye lilajilizo lilyo lyono lyali lyalavywa mwi'kaya lya Susa, lyo kulajiliza vyono Wayahudi wose wawulagwe yakamulomba yamupele Esita, yamuloloseze na zizo zose, yamulonjele yabite kuli mutemi, yakamunene, yamulombe yawawonele lusungu Wayahudi, i wanhu wakwe Esita.
9 Hataci yakayitegula baluwa yiyo kwa Esita,
10 Esita nayo yakagomoleza wulajilize wuwu kwa Moledekayi.
11 Wulajilize wuwo watezaga, “Munhu wo wose we cilume hamba we cicekulu, mono kokwinjila mwi'wanza lyo wutemi no kumuwona mutemi, lono si yacemigwe, munhu yuyo yimunojeye yawulagwe. Wuwo wo wulajilize, ne wanhu wose wawumanyile, ku wulawilila kuli watazi wo mutemi, sunga na kuli wanhu wose wa mu zi'si zose, wazimanyile zizi. Ninga ho yili nzila monga ndodo, yono yidahile kupitula wulajilize wuwu. Nha cinji, hono mutemi yasole nghome yakwe ye zahabu, no kumusonha munhu wo wose, hodu munhu yuyo wumi wakwe wojendelela. Alu mwezi monga wapuluta ku wulawa vyono mutemi yasonha ane ne nghome yiyi.”
12 Moledekayi yaza kugabocela mahweso ga Esita, hobaho Moledekayi
13 yakamutegulila nonga yo kumusugula Esita, yakatya, “Wulece kwihwesa nha vyono agwe wuli musina mu wugazwe wuwu langa wa Wayahudi du, vyono agwe wuli mu nyumba yo mutemi.
14 Na hono agwe wunyamale hamba kunoza cinji mu nghani yiyi, ale, wumanye vyono wutazi wolawa kunji no kuwaponya Wayahudi, nawo wolopona, ninga agwe go mweneco kofwa, hamonga ne wanduguzo wose wokongomelela lukulu. Ninga hamba nhavivyo, nani 'mbi mono yamanyile, lunji yo yaleka agwe wukanozwa mu mapango nha gaga, wuwe mugolece wo Mutemi!”

15 Nayo Esita yakamupitula kanyhi Moledekayi yakamutya,
16 “Ale wubite wukawakonghole Wayahudi wose wa mwi'kaya lya Susa, mulece kulya, kanyhi munombele. Mulece kulya hamba kung'wa cinji vilo vidatu cilo ne misi. Nane hamonga ne wetumami wangu we cicekulu conoza nhavivyo. Hanyuma ane nomubitila mutemi, hamba niwe nha neza kuwukawaniza wulajilize. Hono nghufwa so yiyo, hodu lece mbite nghafwe lece yiwe nha vyono yowa.”

17 Moledekayi yakabita kwituma nha vyono yalonjelwa na Esita.


Esita 5

Esita yakuwanozeza sikukuu Hamani no Mutemi

1 Mwi'zuwa lilongozi lya Esita lyo wuleka kulya, yakavwala mwenda wakwe mutali we citemi-temi, yakawa kwinjila mu nyumba yo mutemi, yakema yalanjile ku nyumba ye ligoda lyo wutemi he'lango lye likaya.
2 Nayo mutemi yali yeza kumuwona Esita yemile hanze ye lilango, yakendezwa muno. Hobaho yakawa kuyisola nghome yakwe ye zahabu, yakawa kumusonha Esita. Nayo Esita yakapamiza cisonje ce nghome yiyo.
3 Mutemi yakamutya Esita, “Esita nhawule? Nonjelaje cono wukusaka, nane nokupela, hamba yiwe nusu yo wutemi wangu, ane nokupela du.”

4 Esita yakamutya mutemi, “Hono wuwe wukwendezwa Gwe go mutemi, nolumba muno, hono gwegwe, hamonga na Hamani, zuwali cinyamihe muwe wajenzi wangu, nozize sikukuu so nyenye.”

5 Mutemi yakamulajiza Hamani yaze mbelambela, ho wabite kotya wajenzi wa Esita. Hobaho mutemi hamonga na Hamani, wakabita ku sikukuu kwa Esita.
6 Na lono wang'wezaga divayi, Mutemi yakamuwuza Esita yakatya, “Nonjele co cose cono wukusaka nane nokupela. Nowuvumila wulombe wako, nane hamba yiwe nusu yo wutemi wangu, nokupela.”

7 Esita yakamupitula yakamutya,
8 “Gwe mutemi, hono wutemi wako wuwe wudahile kumbonela lusungu no kumhela cono nolomba, ale nane nokwendezwa muno. Ane kanyhi mitondo, nomunozezenyi sikukuu yinji, gwegwe hamonga na Hamani ho muwe wajenzi wangu kanyhi. Nane baho mitondo langa, ho nolonga cono nghusaka wumhele.”

Hamani yalamula kumuwulaga Moledekayi

9 Nayo Hamani lono yawukaga ha sikukuu ya ha Esita, yali yena nyemo muno muno. Ninga yakamuwona Moledekayi he'lango lyo kwinjilila mu nyumba yo wutemi. Hamani yaza kola behi na Moledekayi, Moledekayi si yenuka hamba kulajila cogopo kuli Hamani, nha vyono wulajilize wali wulajilize. Hamani yakatuga yikuwo no wukalale wuwaha muno ku soko ya Moledekayi.
10 Ninga hamba nhavivyo, yakajendelela du sunga yakafika ku kaya yakwe. Yakawacema wawaha wayagwe ku kaya yakwe, yakamucema no mugolece wakwe Zeleshi yaze yawe yali hamonga nawo.
11 Yakawalajila wayagwe wugoli wono yena nawo, hamonga ne wanagwe wose, na vyono mutemi yawona viswanu, yamuhagula yawe mulongola muli wawaha wose, na vyono luno yena mwelecele hali mutemi kuciza wayagwe wose.
12 Hamani yakajendelela kulonga yakutya, “Lanje, sunga nalu Esita mugolece wo mutemi kanoza sikukuu so nene no mutemi du, sunga ne mitondo yandalice kanyhi mbite hamonga no mutemi.
13 Ninga zizi zose zonghwila cici waco, lono nane vyo nghali nghumuwona ayulya Muyahudi Moledekayi yekaye he'lango lye likaya lyo wutemi.”

14 Baho mugolece wakwe hamonga ne weyendi wayagwe, wakamupela mahweso wakatya, “Nhawule si wukumunozeza mabici gono matali go kumutumbicila, mabici go wutali wa mita makumi mejete? Ne mitondo hakali mitondo muno, wumulombe mutemi ho yakukombolele Moledekayi yatumbikwe. Nagwe mitondo lono wukubita ku sikukuu, ho wubite wusangalaye.” Hamani yakawona vyono lihala lili yiswanu. Hobaho, yakawa kuhimbila mabici gago go kumutubicila Moledekayi.


Esita 6

Umutemi yakumuhumbiliza Moledekayi

1 Mu cilo cicilya, mutemi hamba si yagona nhongo yaye, hobaho yakalajiliza wawaha wose wa mu yisi yakwe, hamonga ne vitung'ati wose wa mu wutemi wakwe, wamuletele citabu ce mandiko ge zinghani zamu yisi yakwe, ho mitondo yaco wayisome ha mwande yakwe.
2 Mu wusome we zinghani zizi, zikapamiza za Moledekayi, mono yamusugula mutemi, ho yalece kuwulagwa ne wetumami walya i wejete, Bigula na Teleshi, i wetumami wapaswe, wono wali wali mu wilecele wo wulanjilizi we likaya lyo mutemi.
3 U mutemi yakawawuza yakatya, “Alu mu nghani yiyi camuhumbiliza cinhuci Moledekayi.”

Nawo wetumami wakwe wakatya, “Hasina hamba cinji cono yahumbilizwa yaye.”

4 Mutemi yakawawuza kanyhi yakatya, “Koyuli yunji kanyhi mu wetumami wangu mwi'kaya?”

Baho Hamani nayo yakawa kwinjila mu, luwa ya kunze lyo mutemi, yali yaza, ho yamulombe mutemi yamukombolele Moledekayi yakatumbikwe, hambi mabici nha gali gakondya kuhimbilwa.
5 Wetumami wakamutya Mutemi, “Hamani yali baha yalindiye ho yakuwone.”

Mutemi yakawatya, “Mumulonjele yahelele.”

6 Hamani yakawa kwinjila. Nayo mutemi yakamutya Hamani, “Hoyali munhu yunji mono nghusaka kumuhumbiliza muno muno, alu noze wule kuli munhu yuyu?”

Hamani yakehwesa mu nhumbula yakwe yakatya, “Alu nani mono mutemi yadahile kumuhumbiliza muno muno, hono si nene du?”
7 Holeka yakamupitula mutemi yakamutya,
8 “Mutemi, wulajilize mwenda muswanu we citemi temi, wuletwe so munhu yuyu, hamonga ne vivwalo vyono kuvwalaga gwegwe. Lajize no wihambo we citemi temi wuwuwicile mu Fwalasi yako.
9 Hanyuma wumusole munhu we lilumbo wa muli wetumami wako wawaha, yamuvwice munhu yuyo vivwalo vivyo, hanyuma yamupandize mu Fwalasi, yamupilimye mwi'kaya lili, akuno yakujenda yakulalika yakutya, ‘Ale, mulanje vyono mutemi yakumuhumbiliza mono yakusaka kumuhumbiliza, u munhu mono yakwendezwa nayo!’ ”

10 Lulo lulo mutemi yakamutya Hamani, “Ale mbela, wusole vivwalo vyo wutemi, hamonga ne Fwalasi, wukamupele Moledekayi u Muyahudi lilumbo lilyo. Wumunozeze zose zono wulonjile, yilece kucepuka hamba nghani monga. Komwagana mwene yali ahalya ha mulango we likaya.”

11 Hamani yakasola vivwalo hamonga ne Fwalasi yakamuvwika Moledekayi. Nayo Moledekayi yakekala mu Fwalasi. Nayo Hamani yakawa kumupilimya Moledekayi mwi'kaya akuno yakulalika yakutya, “Ale, mulanje vyono mutemi yakumuhumbiliza munhu mono yakusaka kumuhumbiliza, munhu mono yakwendezwa nayo!”

12 Moledekayi yakawuya kanyhi ha mulango we likaya. Ninga mwene Hamani yakawa kutuluka yakumangha yakubita ku kaya yakwe, akuno yawugubicize wusu wakwe ko wukalale wuwaha.
13 Yakawalonjela weyendi wayagwe hamonga na Zeleshi u mugolece wakwe, zose zono zimwijeleye. Lulo Zeleshi mugolece wakwe, hamonga ne weyendi wayagwe, wakamulonjela wakatya, “Yuyu Moledekayi mono wakondya kulemwa kuli mwene, hono yawe Muyahudi, agwe si komusumila lukulu, langa mwene yo kokusuma.”

Hamani yakuwulagwa

14 Nawo lono wali wakali wajendeleye kulonga zizi, wetumami wapaswe wa mu nyumba yo wutemi, wakaza mbelambela kumusola Hamani, yabite ku sikukuu ya kwa Esita.


Esita 7

1 Umutemi na Hamani, wakabita ku sikukuu ya kwa Esita,
2 yono yali yanozwa nghanghulo ye kejete. Na lono wajendelelaga kung'wa divayi, mutemi Ahasuwelo yakamuwuza kanyhi Esita yakatya, “Gwe Esita go mugolece wa mwi'kulu, wukusaka nghutendele wule? Nonjelaje du, nagwe kosuma kucituga cinhu cico. Nane ndahile kukupela hamba yiwe nusu yo wutemi.”

3 Mugolece wa mwi'kulu Esita, yakapitula yakatya, “Gwe go mutemi, hono wuwe wendezwe mu wutemi wako, wubocele wulombe wangu. Wulombe wangu kuli'gwe, wowu, nghukulomba njendelele kuwa mumi ndece kufwa, ne wandugu zangu nawo, walece kufwa.
4 Hambi i wanhu wangu hamonga na nene, nha caguzwa ho ciwulagwe. Yali yiwe si nghani hono cali ciguzwe mu wuwanda, aho langa, nali nyamale du, si nali nghugaze so yiyo. Sunga nalu cili behi muno kuwulagwa no kongomezwa.”

5 Mutemi Ahasuwelo yakamuwuza mugolece wa mwi'kulu Esita, yakamutya, “Nani mono kosuma kunoza nhavivyo? Munhu yuyo yali hayi?”

6 Esita yakapitula yakatya, “U mulugu wetu, na mono yakucitamisa, yo yuyu Hamani, u munhu mubi muno muno!”

Baho Hamani yakawa kumunugulila umutemi, hamonga no mugolece wa mwi'kulu Esita ko woga wuwaha muno.
7 Mutemi yakenuka akuno yakoligwe ne likuwo, yakalawila kunze mu busitani ye likaya. Hamani yakamanya vyono alu mutemi yakulondola no kwihwesa nzila yo kumulipiciziza so nghani yiyi. Hobaho Hamani nayo kono nyuma, yakawa kubita ha mwande ya Esita umugolece wa mwi'kulu, yakawa kumulomba Esita yamunenele ho yalece kuwulagwa.
8 Lulo Hamani yakegwisa ha magulu ga Esita yakulomba wunenelwe. Nayo mutemi yali yeza kuwuya mu nyumba, ku wulawa ku busitani, no kumuwona Hamani yagwiye, ha magulu ga Esita, yakazoza muno ko wukalale yakatya, “Wa! Alu Hamani yakumwibata kwa vilungo mugolece wangu ha meso gangu, ho vigone nayo mwi'kaya lyangu?” Mutemi lono yali yali mu wulonga zizi, wetumami i wapaswe, wo mutemi wakaza wakawugubiciza mutwe wa Hamani.

9 Hobaho mwitumami yumonga wa muli wawo wetumami wo mutemi, mono yacemwaga Halebona, yakatya, “Mbeka Hamani yali yakondya kuhimbila sunga ne mabici ku kaya yakwe, go kumutumbicila Moledekayi, mono yakuponya agwe go mutemi wumi wako. Ne mabici gago, gena wutali wa mita makumi mejete na nyejete!”

Mutemi yakalajiliza yakatya, “Ale, mutumbicenyi Hamani mu mabici gago.”

10 Hobaho, Hamani yakawa kutumbikwa mu mabici gago gono yali yamunozeza Moledekayi. Lulo, ne likuwo lyo mutemi nhondo, ho likawa kupola.


Esita 8

Wayahudi wakulonjelwa wehome ne walugu

1 Mwizuwa lilyo Mutemi Ahasuwelo yakazisola zi sawo za Hamani, yakamupela mugolece wa mwi'kulu Esita, Hamani mono yali mulugu we Wayahudi. Ku wulawa baho nhondo, Esita ho yakawa kumulonjela mutemi vyono wali ndugu na Moledekayi. Ku wulawa mwizuwa lilyo, nhondo Moledekayi, yakawa yena wukombolwe wo kuhelela mwi'kaya lilyo lyo mutemi.
2 Mutemi yakayiwopola nyamwidole yakwe yono yali yina ne citanjilo, yono yali yayivwalile Hamani, yakawa kumuvwika Moledekayi. Nayo Esita yakamunoza Moledekayi yawe muwaha mu sawo yose yono yali ya Hamani.

3 Lulo lulo Esita yakegwisa ha magulu go mutemi, akuno yakulila no kulomba ko mutemi ho yagawuse mahweso go wuhile wubi wa Hamani, u mwana wa mu lulelo lwa Agagi, gono yali yagehwesa yawatendele Wayahudi.
4 Mutemi yakasola nghome yakwe ye zahabu, yakumusonha Esita, baho Esita yakawa kwinuka, yakatya,
5 “Hono yiwe wendezwe 'gwe go mutemi, na hono wuwe wunyheleleye, na hono wuwe wukuwona viswanu, ale nghukulomba wuwupate wulajilize wa Hamani, ho wulece kufisilizwa. U wulajilize wono Hamani mwana wa Hamidatu wa mu lulelo lwa Agagi, wono yali yawulavya mu wutemi wako wose, wono yakusaka Wayahudi wose mu zi'si zose wongomezwe.
6 Ane ho nosuma wule, kuwukangalila wongomezwe wuwu wono weza kuwaziza wanhu wangu ne wandugu zangu wawulagwe?”

7 Mutemi Ahasuwelo yakamulonjela Esita umugolece wa mwi'kulu hamonga na Moledekayi u Muyahudi, yakawatya, “Lanjenyi ta, nha nakondya kumutumbika Hamani so mahweso gakwe mabi go kuwawulaga i Wayahudi, kanyhi ne sawo yakwe yose, nakondya kumupela Esita.”
8 Ninga lilajilizo lyono yalilavya Hamani mwi'tagwa lyo mutemi, no kuwicilwa ne citanjilo ce nyamwidole yo mutemi, si lyosuma kukawanizwa yaye. Ninga hamba nhavivyo, yikunojeye nagwe wandice kuli Wayahudi, nha vvono wukwihwesa, wandice mwi'tagwa lyangu, wutajila ne citanjilo ce nyamwidole yangu yo wutemi.

9 Zizi zikanozwa mwizuwa lye makumi mejete ne 'datu, mu mwezi we kadatu, wono wacemwaga Siwani. Moledekayi yakawacema wandici wose wo mutemi, yakawa yakuwaloloseza zinghani, nawo wakwandika. Wakazandika baluwa zizo, wakazitegula kuli wawaha wose, ne walongola wose, na kuli Wayahudi wose mu zisi yigana limonga na makumi mejete na mupunghati, za mu wutemi wose ku wulawa Indiya, sunga ko ku Kushi. Baluwa zikandikwa kuli matumbi gose yitumbi ne milonjele yawo, na mu nzila ye mandiko gawo, zinji zikandicilwa Wayahudi, nawo mu milonjele yawo, na mu nzila ye mandiko gawo, wakazandika wakawicila ne citanjilo ce nyamwidole yo wutemi.
10 Moledekayi yakawa yakondya kuzituga baluwa zono nyandikwe mwi'tagwa lyo mutemi Ahasuwelo, nayo yakawa kuziwicila ne citanjilo ce nyamwidole yo mutemi. Nazo zikategulwa ako na ako ne wanhu wono watumwa, wono wajendelaga zi fwalasi zono zamanghaga muno muno, zono zalawa mwi'bululu lyo mutemi.

11 Ne zibaluwa zizi, zalolosaga vyono mutemi yakondya kuwakombola Wayahudi wa mu makaya gose, wewikanize ho wecite weneco. Kolo wanyawusi wanji wa mu makaya ganji wakuwahungucila, no kuwahoma, ale Wayahudi wawahomaje no kuwongomezeza lukulu wawo wono wawahunguciye no kuwahoma. Wawawulajile lukulu walume ne wacekulu hamonga ne wana wawo, walece kusigaza hamba munhu monga. Hanyuma wawe kuzisola ne zisawo zawo zose.
12 No wulajilize wuwu, wali wunojeye wufisilizwe mu wutemi wose wa mu Pelisiya, mwi'zuwa lyono lyali lyawagwa, ho Wayahudi wawulagwe mu mwezi we likumi na nyejete lizuwa lye kumi ne 'datu mu mwezi wa Adali.
13 Kanyhi yali yinojeye nghani yiyi yilalikwe hanhu hose kotya wulajilize, kanyhi yimanyice kuli wanhu wose wa mu matumbi gose. Ho Wayahudi wawe no wiwikanize wo kuwalipiciza walugu wawo mwizuwa lilyo kolo likufika.
14 Nayo mutemi yali yeza kukondya kulavya wulajilize wuwo, hodu i wanhu wono watumwa, wakazipanda zi fwalasi za mwi'kulu, wakawa kutuluka lumangho muno muno. No wulajilize wuwo, wukawaficila ne wanhu wose wono wekalaga mwi'kaya liwaha lya Susa.

15 Moledekayi yakawuka mwi'kulu, yavwalile vivwalo vye citemi temi vye mawala ge buluu ne nzelu. Hamonga ne lijoho ne kofiya swanu, ye liwala lyo lugandu, hamonga no mukumbo wa zahabu. Hobaho mu zinzila zose za mwikaya lya Susa, mukawa no wusangalale na nyemo mbaha.
16 Ku lubavu lwe Wayahudi, wali wena nyemo no wusangalale, hamonga ne lihweso lyo kuwasuma walugu.
17 Na mwi'kaya lyo lyose, na mwi'tumbi lyo lyose, lyono lilajilizo lilyo lyasomwaga, Wayahudi wakawa na sikukuu hamonga no wucehe no kulya zindigwa kwa nyemo mbaha. Na so nghani yiyo, wanhu wenji wakenoza nawo Wayahudi, vyono lulo, wose wakawa wakuwogopa Wayahudi.


Esita 9

Wayahudi wakuwongomeza walugu wawo

1 Likafika lizuwa lye kumi ne 'datu lya mu mwezi wa Adali, lizuwa lyono lyali lisiwanuywe ne walugu we Wayahudi, so wufisiliza lilajilizo lyo mutemi. Lizuwa lyono iwalugu, wali wetumbiye vyono wowasumiza Wayahudi. Ninga Wayahudi wakakawaniza mahweso ge walugu wawo no kuwasuma.
2 Vipuga vyose vye Wayahudi, mu matumbi gose ga mu wutemi wuwu, wakewikaniza kwihoma no munhu wo wose mono yejelela kuwahungucila no kuwatamisa. Sunga wanhu wose wa mu matumbi gose, wakawa wakuwogopa Wayahudi, hakawa hasina hamba monga mono yejelela kuwahoma.
3 Na mbeka wawaha wa mu matumbi gose, hamonga ne walongola wawaha wa mu wutemi, wose wakema ku lubavu lwe Wayahudi no kuwataziliza. Hambi wose nha wamogopa Moledekayi.
4 Yikawa yamanyika na wose vyono Moledekayi yo yawa ne vilungo viwaha mwi'kulu, na vyono yajendelelaga kanyhi kutuga vilungo.
5 Na ku soko yiyo, Wayahudi wakanoza vyono wasakaga kuwatendela walugu wawo. Wakawahomanga ne migoha no kuwatemanga ne mimaje no kuwawulaga.

6 Mwikaya liwaha lya Susa, Wayahudi wakawawulaga wanhu magana mahano.
7 Hamonga na wawo, wakawa wali mumo ne wana yikumi wa Hamani u mulelwe na Hamedata, umulugu muwaha we Wayahudi, nha cinji, na Paleshadata, na Palifoni na Asipata,
8 na Polata na Adalia na Alidata na
9 Palemashita na Alisayi na Alidayi na Vayisata.
10 Hamba nhavivyo kwali kusina cinhu co cose cono waciteka.

11 Mwizuwa lilyo, wakamulonjela mutemi liwalo lye wanhu wono wawulagwa ha Susa.
12 Hobaho umutemi yakamulonjela Esita u mugolece wa mwi'kulu yakamutya, “Alu hono mu Susa du muli wene, Wayahudi wawulaga wanhu magana mahano, hamonga ne wana yikumi wa Hamani. Alu wukwihwesa mu matumbi ganji ma, wowa watenda wule! Hamba alu wukusaka cici kanyhi nane nghupele? Wunonjele co cose cono kosaka nane nokupela.”

13 Nayo Esita yakatya, “Go mutemi! Hono yiwe yikukwendeza mu wuwaha wako. Walekaje kanyhi Wayahudi mitondo, wetume mwi'kaya lya Susa, nha vyono wuwakomboye wetume zuwali. Kanyhi wulavye wulajilize vyono, i miwili yikumi ye wana wa Hamani, yitumbikwe mu mabici go kunyonjela.”
14 Nayo mutemi yakalajiliza zizi zose zitumwe, ne lilajilizo lili likamanyizwa mwi'kaya lya Susa. Ne miwili ye wana yikumi wa Hamani, yikatumbikwa calinze mu mabici go kunyonjela.
15 Lyaza kufika lizuwa lye likumi na yine lyo mwezi wa Adali, Wayahudi wa mwi'kaya lya Susa, wakekonghola kanyhi hamonga, wakawawulaga wanhu wanji wono wali waficile liwalo lyawo, wanhu magana madatu. Hamba nhavivyo siwasola vinhu mateka.

16 Wayahudi wono wekalaga mu matumbi ganji go wutemi, nawo wakewikaniza viswanu, no kwicita kuli walugu wawo. Wakehoma ne walugu wawo, wakawawulaga wanhu elufu makumi mupunghati na yihano, wanhu wono wali wawasulile. Hamba nhavivyo siwasola vinhu mateka.
17 Zizi zikejela mwizuwa lye kumi lya mu mwezi wa Adali. Ne mitondo yaco, mwizuwa, lye likumi na yine, hakawa hasina kanyhi wuwulaji, wakalinoza likawa yizuwa lya sikukuu du na nyemo.
18 Wayahudi wa ku Susa nawo, wakayinoza sikukuu yiyi mwizuwa lye kumi ne 'hano, vyono wali wakondya kuwongomeza i walugu wawo mwizuwa lye kumi ne 'datu, na lye kumi na yine. Ninga mwizuwa lye kumi ne 'hano, si wajendelela yaye.
19 Holeka, Wayahudi wose wono wekaye mu vitumbi vidodododo sunga lulu, wakuwa kulikumbucila lizuwa lilyo lye kumi na yine, lyo mwezi wa Adali. Vyono lyo lizuwa lyo wucehe na lye nyemo muno. Kanyhi lyo lizuwa lyo kunoza sikukuu, no kwihumbiliza kwe vipegwa munhu na muyagwe.

Sikukuu ya Pulimu (Nha cinji, yono yatowelwa kula)

20 Nayo Moledekayi yakawa yakondya kuwa ne zinghani zizi zose nyandice, holeka, yakawategulila Wayahudi wose, we matumbi ge behi no kutali mu wutemi wa Pelisiya.
21 Kuwalonjela wagebate mazuwa gago, lizuwa lye kumi na yine ne kumi ne 'hano ga mu mwezi wa Adali, gawe mazuwa go wucehe mwaka kwa mwaka.
22 Vilo vivyo vyo vyawakumbucizaga i Wayahudi, lono wekombozeza kuli walugu wawo. Mwezi wuwu wo mwezi wono wakawaniza wukalale wawo, hamonga ne cililo cawo, gakawa mazuwa ga nyemo no luseko. Wakalonjelwa, wawe kugalanjilila mazuwa gaga, ho wawe kunoza zi sikukuu, no kwihumbiliza vipegwa na ndigwa munhu na muyagwe, no kuwakumbucila waciwa.
23 Hobaho Wayahudi wakatyatya malajilizo ga Moledekayi, ne zi sikukuu zikawa kujendelela kunozwa mwaka kwa mwaka.

24 Hamani u mwana wa Hamedata wo lulelo lwa Agagi, mulugu muwaha we Wayahudi, yali yatowa Puli, (nha cinji “Kula” nha vyono wayitezaga) no kuwika lizuwa lyo kuwongomeza Wayahudi. Yali yalamula kuwafwagulila lukulu.
25 Ninga Esita yakamubitila mutemi, nayo mutemi yakalavya lilajilizo lyono lyamunoza Hamani yagazwe sunga yakafwa, u wufwe wono yali yawehweseze Wayahudi. Mwene hamonga ne wanagwe, wakatumbikwa, wakafwila mu mabici.
26 Na yiyi yo soko yono yikuleka zi sikukuu zikucemwa Pulimu mu wulawa mu nghani yiyi Puli nha cinji kutowa kula. Ku soko ye baluwa ya Moledekayi, na ku soko ya zono waziwona weneco, na ku soko ya zose zono zawejelela.
27 Nawo Wayahudi wakayinoza liwe yilajilizo kuli wene, hamonga ne wana wawo, sunga na kuli munhu wo wose mono kokwiyitya mwene Muyahudi, vyono mwipango lili, mu mwaka na mwaka, yinojeye wayinoze sikukuu yiyi, mu vilo vivi vyejete nha vyono wulajilize wa Moledekayi winha.
28 Ne vilo vivyo vye Pulimu vinojeye vikumbucilwe, ne sikukuu yiyo yiwe kunozwa muli mhuga zose ze Wayahudi wose, wono wekaye mu zisi zose na mu makaya gose, mu zindelo zawo zose mu vilo vyose vyono vikuza.

29 Hanyuma Esita u mugolece wa mwi'kulu, mwana wa Abihayili, hamonga na Moledekayi u Muyahudi, yakayandika baluwa, yono yali yina no wulajilize wakwe wose wa kuli ze sikukuu ya Pulimu, nha vyono yali yakondya Moledekayi kwandika.
30 Ne baluwa yiyo, yikawa nyandicilwe Wayahudi wose. Ne nakala yayo, yikategulwa ku zisi zose vyono yigana limonga na makumi mejete na mupunghati, ze Pelisiya. Ne zibaluwa zizo, zali zina zinghani zo mulamu na zo wudimwe.
31 Nazo zikawa zikuwalajiliza, ho webate no kuyinoza sikukuu yiyo ye vilo vye Pulimu, wene hamonga ne zindelo zawo, nha vyono wali wakondya kuwusolela moto wuwo, so wibata i vilo vyo wuleka kulya, hamonga ne vipango vye cililo. Na zizi zose zikalajilizwa na Moledekayi Muyahudi, hamonga na Esita u mugolece wo mutemi.
32 Ne lilajilizo lya Esita lyo kukangaza ze sikukuu yiyo ya Pulimu, likandikwa mu citabu.


Esita 10

U wuwaha wa Ahasuwelo hamonga na Moledekayi

1 Mutemi Ahasuwelo, yakawatoweza kodi i wanhu wono wekalaga mu zisi zose zo wutemi wakwe, hamonga na wose wono wekalaga mu vizingwa vya mwi'lenga.
2 Ne zinghani zakwe zose zimbaha na zo wizine zono yazituma, hamonga sunga no wulolose wa vyono yamupela wuwaha Moledekayi yawe muwaha we lilumbo lya hacanyha, zose zizo zandicigwe mu citabu ce zinghomo ze watemi we Wamedi na Pelisiya.
3 Hambi Moledekayi u Muyahudi, nha yo yali we kejete mu wulongola ku wulawilila ko mutemi Ahasuwelo. Nayo Moledekayi yakawa yena lilumbo yiwaha muno, kanyhi yakawa yendezwe mwipuga lyose lye Wayahudi wayagwe. Nayo yakawatendela viswanu muno wanhu wakwe, no kulonga zo mulamu kuli zo lulelo lwawo lwose.


Jobu 1

Setani yakumujela Jobu

1 Kwali na munhu litagwa lyakwe Jobu, munhu yuyu, yekalaga mu yisi ya Uzi. Munhu yuyu yali muhembi muno, kanyhi mwihuwilwa kuli Mulungu. Kanyhi yali munhu muswanu, mono si yali yendile kwituma nghani yo yose 'mbi.
2 Nayo yali yena wana mupunghati wa cilume, hamonga na wana we cicekulu wadatu.
3 Kanyhi yali yasawile ngholo zificile elufu mupunghati, na ngamiya elufu yidatu, ne litewa lye zing'ombe zificile elufu monga, hamonga na ndogowe magana mahano. Kanyhi Jobu, yali yena wetumami wenji muno, kanyhi yali yo mugoli muno yali wene ku lubavu lwa kucilima.

4 Ne wanagwe we cilume, wali wazoweye kubita kulya ndigwa mu zikaya zawo mu wilecele, munhu ne zuwa lyakwe, yakucemela wayagwe. Nawo wetang'anilaga hamonga, wawacemelaga ne walumbu zawo vyono wadatu, wawa kuhanga zindigwa hamonga nawo.
5 Na nhondo zose lono wela hakali mitondo, lono walawa mu wulye wuwo, Jobu yelawaga nhondo zose hakali mitondo, kawa kuwalavizya makumbiko wanagwe wose monga monga, ho yaweze. Nayo yakawa yakunoza nhavivyo nhondo zose, hambi nha yehwesaga vyono, lunji yumonga wa muli wanagwe, kolowa ketuma wubi mu nzila yo kumutovula Mulungu wula kumanya.

6 Ne lizuwa lyali lyeza kufika, lyono lyali linojeye i viwumbwa vya ku wulanga, vilajile hali Muwaha Mulungu, kumbe nayo Setani yali yali mu ciligati yawo.
7 Baho Mulungu yakamuwuza Setani, yakamutya, “Alu 'gwe Setani, wina mulimoci bahano?”

Nayo Setani yakamupitula yakatya, “Ane nili mu wupilime-pilime du, ako na ako mono'nze.”

8 Muwaha Mulungu yakamuwuza Setani yakamutya, “Ninga wumuwene mwitumami wangu Jobu? Hambi nha hasina munhu yunji mononze yiyi, mwihuwilwa, kanyhi munhu muswanu, mono yehwanile yuyu Jobu. Hambi Jobu nha kahembaga nene, kanyhi kelanjililaga muno, ho yalece kwituma nghani yo yose 'mbi.”

9 Nayo Setani yakapitula yakatya, “Wukwihwesa yuyo Jobu yali yasume kukuhemba, mhali yawe yasina cinji mugati yayo?
10 Hambi agwe nha kumudimaga nhondo zose, hamonga ne mhuga yakwe, hamonga na vyose vyono yena navyo. Kuyilugutizaga sunga ne milimo yakwe, kanyhi wumupelile na ng'ombe nyinji zimemile yisi yose.
11 Ninga luno, hono wuwe nha wukumuwusiza vyose vyono yena navyo, nayo hodu kokukana calinze!”

12 Muwaha Mulungu yakamutya Setani, “Ale viswanu, ne vinhu vyose vyono yena navyo, nha vili mu muwoko wako. Langa nghukulonjela vyono, wulecele lukulu kumutamisa Jobu mweneco.” Hodu hobaho Setani yakawa kuwuka hali Mulungu.

I wana wa Jobu hamonga ne sawo yakwe, vikongomezwa

13 Kukawa mwi'zuwa linji, lono wanagwe we cilume na we cicekulu, walizaga no kung'wa divayi mukaya yo muwaha wawo,
14 mwitumami yunji yakamangha, yakamuziza Jobu, yakamulonjela yakatya, “Ase cali cili mu mugunda cikulima ne zing'ombe, nazo zindogowe zikudima baho behi ne zing'ombe.
15 Waseba wawa kuza nhinicizo, wawa kuzisola zing'ombe hamonga ne zindogowe zose. Kanyhi wawa kuwawulaga ne wetumami wako wose, na yo nene du mono sigaye. Yonene du mono mhonile, ho nize nghulonjele zizo.”

16 Nayo lono yali yakali yakulolosa zizo, yakaza kanyhi mwitumami yunji, nayo yakamulonjela Jobu yakatya, “Limuli lizitowa zingholo liziwulaga zose, hamonga ne wadimi wayo. Nane yo nene du mono mhonile, ho nize nghulonjele zizo.”

17 Nayo lono yali yakali yakulolosa zizo, yakaza kanyhi mwitumami yunji, nayo yakamulonjela Jobu yakatya, “Wakalidayo waza mapuga madatu, wacihoma, wasola ne zingamiya zose, kanyhi wawawulaga ne wetumami wako wose. Nane yo nene du mono mhonile, ho nize nghulonjele zizo.”

18 Nayo yuyo lono yali yakali yakulolosa zizo, yakaza kanyhi mwitumami yunji, nayo yakamulonjela Jobu yakatya, “I wanago wose, we cilume na we cicekulu, lono wali kulya no kung'wa divayi mukaya yo muwaha wawo,
19 liza libeho yiwaha lyo mukukunzo, likulawilila ku nyika, liyikundujiza kaya, yiwagwila no kuwawulaga wose. Nane yo nene du nili wene mono mhonile, ho nize nghulonjele zizo.”

20 Hodu nhondo, Jobu yakawa kwinuka, yakawa kuwudemulanga musweko wakwe ko wusungu muno. Yakawa kuwuceta zimvili mutwe wakwe, yakawa kwigumila hasi wugubama.
21 Yakawa kutya,

“Ane nalelwa sina cinji,

kanyhi nolofwa sina cinji.

Muwaha Mulungu yo yalavya,

kanyhi Muwaha Mulungu yo yawusize,

Litagwa lyo Muwaha Mulungu lilumbwe!”

22 Na muli zizo zose zono zamwijelela, Jobu hamba si yamuhosa Mulungu yaye.


Jobu 2

Jobu yakujelwa kanyhi na Setani

1 Kukawa mwi'zuwa linji kanyhi, lono viwumbwa vya ku wulanga vyazaga ho vilajile hali Muwaha Mulungu, na Setani nayo yakaza hamonga navyo.
2 Muwaha Mulungu yakamuwuza Setani yakatya, “Gwe Setani, alu wali wuli hayi?”

Nayo Setani yakamupitula yakatya, “Ane nili mu wupilime-pilime du, ako na ako mono'nze.”

3 Muwaha Mulungu yakamuwuza Setani yakamutya, “Ninga wumuwene u mwitumami wangu Jobu? Hambi nha hasina munhu yunji mononze yiyi, mwihuwilwa, kanyhi munhu muswanu, mono yehwanile yuyu Jobu. Hambi Jobu nha kahembaga nene, kanyhi kelanjililaga muno, ho yalece kwituma nghani yo yose 'mbi. Ninga agwe wukasaka nghukombole wubite wukamutamise mbula soko. Ninga lu wulanje! Jobu yakali vyo mwihuwilwa du kuli'ne nha vyono kawezaga vilo vyose.”

4 Setani nayo yakamupitula Muwaha Mulungu yakamutya, “Heya, munhu kolavya vyose vyono yena navyo, vihomele wumi wakwe.
5 Ninga aluno, hono wumupele magazo mu muwili wakwe, manyile vyono kokukana calinze.”

6 Nayo Muwaha Mulungu yakamutya Setani, “Ale viswanu, Jobu yali mu miwoko yako, ninga langa du, wulece kumuwulaga.”

7 Hobaho Setani yakawa kuwuka hali Muwaha Mulungu, yakawa kumupela Jobu mapu mawaha muwili wose, wulawilila mu magulu sunga ko kwi ndosi.
8 Nayo Jobu yakawa kubita kwikala mu cugulu, yakasola cizaye, yakawa yakwisuwila mu mapu gakwe.
9 Ninga mugolece wakwe yakamutya, “Alu mwene agwe Jobu, hongo wukali wuli mwihuwilwa du nha vyono kuwezaga vilo vyose? Alu si yali yiwe ciba wali wumutovule Mulungu, hodu du wuwe kufwa?”

10 Ninga Jobu yakamupitula mugolece wakwe, yakamutya, “Gwe mugolece wangu, mbeka wukulonga nghani za caka du! Alu kumbe, hono Mulungu yakuciletela nghani swanu, ayo langa ciyibocelaje na nyemo. Ninga kolo yakuciletela wugaye, hongo yicinojeye cimung'ung'ulicile?” Na muli zizo zose ze magayo zono zamwijelela Jobu, ninga mwene hamba si yalonga nghani yo yose 'mbi kuli Mulungu yaye.

I wendece wa Jobu, wakumuziza

11 Nayo Jobu yali yena wendece wakwe wadatu, Elifazi munya kwi'kaya lya Temani, na Bilidadi mulawa ku yisi ya Shuwa, hamonga na Zofali, nayo munyawusi we yisi ya Nama. I wanhu wawa wali weza kuzihulika, nha vyono Jobu yali mu magazo mawaha, hodu wakawa kulagana wabite wose hamonga wakamusindamice.
12 Nawo lono wabitaga, na lono wali wakali wali cidaha, wakamuwona Jobu kwa kutali, ninga hamba si wasuma kumumanya vyono yo mweneco Jobu. Ninga wali weza kumumanya vyono yo mweneco Jobu, hobaho wakawa kwanza kulila wazozize muno, akuno wakuyidemulanga ne myenda yawo ko wusungu wuwaha muno, akuno wakwesa ne manghundi mucanyha, no kwikupila ganji mu mitwe yawo.
13 Hanyuma wakawa kubita hono hoyuli Jobu, wakawa kwikala baho hasi hamonga nayo, vilo mupunghati, cilo na misi, hamba kulongana nayo nghani yo yose, hambi nha wali wakondya kuwona vyono mbeka yali mu wusungu wuwaha muno.


Jobu 3

Jobu yakumulilila Mulungu

1 Nhondo Jobu yakawa kwanza kulonga, yakalilijita lizuwa lyono yalelelwa.
2 Jobu yakalonga yakatya,
3 Gwe go Mulungu, wulilijite lizuwa lyono nalelelwa,

hamonga ne cilo ci cilya cono nadinghulilwa 'nda!

4 Wulinoze lizuwa lilyo ciwe citi 'gwe go Mulungu.

Hamba wulecele lukulu kulikumbucila kanyhi

lizuwa lilyo, hamba wuzelu wulece kulimulicila kanyhi.

5 Wulinoze lizuwa lilyo wuwe wutitu, liwe wutitu tuku.

Wuligubice ne mavunde, lizuwa lilece kulimulika.

6 Wuciwuse cilo cico mu vilo vyo mwaka

ho cilece kuwalilwa lukulu kanyhi

7 I cilo cico cikale cili wene,

ciwe cilo cono cisina nyemo.

8 Walonjele wono walilijitaga lizuwa,

walilijite lizuwa lilyo,

wawo wono wamanyile kulitonga ne lilimu

lyono licemwaga Lewiyatani.

9 Wuzimile zinyelezi za mwi'jingu lyo wusiku,

zilece kulajila wuzelu wayo,

cilo cico cilece kuwuwona wele we hakali mitondo.

10 Wucilijite cilo cico, cono caleka ane nghalelwa

no kumbika mu wusungu ne magayo.

11 Ciba le nali fwile mu'nda ya yaya,

hamba kuwuzilila kamonga du.

12 Alu, socici nayo yaya yakamhagata?

Hamba nhawule lu yakanyosa?

13 Ninga hono baho nali nifwe,

alu baha mhali nyhehile.

14 Mhali ngonile du, kotya watemi,

hamonga ne walongola wono wagazenga

makaya ge katali go wutemi.

15 Kanyhi mhali ngonile kotya i wana we watemi,

wono wali wamemizye zikaya zawo zahabu na fweza.

16 Hamba mhali ngonile nhongo nho mwana

mono yaleligwe mwezi si wakwe.

Nha mono yalelwa i vimba, hamba kuwuwona wuzelu.

17 Namo mu vitenjelo, i wanhu wabi,

hamba si wajendelelaga kwituma nghani

zawo zimbi, na wono wakataye

so milimo yawo wakuwa kuceha.

18 Sunga ne wafungwa wose, nawo watugaga mulamu,

hamba si wahulikaga kanyhi mazi go wukali.

19 Ne wanhu wose wali baho, we lilumbo,

hamonga na wose wono si wamanyice,

ne wawanda, nhondo wakuwa welecele.

20 Alu socici wukuwaleka wanhu wawe kwikala

wali mu wugaye

Hamba socici wukuwapela wuzelu

i wanhu wono wali mu wusungu?

21 Wene walindilaga lifwa, nalyo lifwa hamba kuwaziza yaye.

Wakusulumila kufwa, si nha ciwutwa cihundice.

22 Nawo wekalaga wasina nyemo,

sunga kolo wafwa no kuzikwa.

23 Mulungu yawahundiciye zawo za ku mwande,

yawapilime mbavu zose.

24 Alu wugule wangu, wo wukuhomela wulye we zindigwa,

nane hamba si nosuma kuleka kukoloma yaye.

25 Ne nghani yono niyogopaga hamonga na yono

yinyogofyaga, vyose vikunyiziza.

26 Alu neza sina mulamu, hamba wucehe bwete,

no wugaye wangu si wukuduma yaye.


Jobu 4

Zinghani za Elifazi

(4:1–14:22)

1 Hanyuma Elifazi Mutemani yakamupitula Jobu yakatya,

Ati Jobu, hono nonje nokukalaza?

2 Hambi nha nghuwona vyono si nosuma kukangalila

niwe nyamaye twii.

3 Agwe Jobu, wuwejize wanhu wenji,

nagwe wuwatajiye vilungo we miwoko yono yitimbile.
