4 Na lono munhu yawe yekobaye mu nghani yinji,

hamba yawe yatimba kanyhi yakatala,

zinghani zako zimupelaga vilungo, kawa kwima kanyhi.

5 Alu lweza lwako lo kutuga wugaye,

nagwe lu, wazilika.

6 Agwe wali wuli muhemba Mulungu,

sunga ne mikalile yako yose,

yali yisina yilema lyo lyose.

Holeka yali yikunojeye wuwe no witumbilo

hamonga ne nhumbula yono yikamile.

7 Alu, wukumbucile ta, hono kosuma kumutuga munhu

we ling'ani, mono yatuga magayo nha gaga.

8 Nha vyono mbwene nene, wanhu wono wakulima zimbi,

no kuhadika zimbi nha mbeyu,

nawo wodudula zizo zimbi du.

9 Ninga Mulungu, kawongomezezaga mwi'kuwo lyakwe

lyo mukukunzo.

10 Ne wanhu wabi webulyaga, no kukoloma

nha simba, ninga Mulungu kazinyamazaga,

no kugabena meno gazo.

11 Nawo wakuwa nha simba zono zisina mhelembo,

zifwizaga, ne mana gazo gawa kwiyagala.

12 “Nghani yikanyiziza lwa kamonga cinyele,

nane nghayihulika wupwepwe wayo.

13 Yikawa nha wilimucilwe,

yikanyaza ne zinhongo zangu.

14 Nghacicima ko woga muno,

no muwili wangu wose,

wukenjilwa na woga wuwaha.

15 Baho cibeho cikamhuta mu wusu wangu,

ne zimvwili zangu zikanyanyamuka so woga.

16 Nghawona cinhu cinji cimile ha mwande yangu,

nane nghacinugulila muno,

ninga hamba si nasuma kucimanya cali cinhuci.

Hanyuma nghahulika lizi likulawa mu

wunyamale wuwo likutya,

17 “Hambi munhu wo wose kosuma kuwa ling'ani

hali Mulungu, hamba yawe yelile hali Muwumbi wakwe?

18 Hambi, Mulungu, nha si kawetumbilaga

sunga ne wetumami wakwe wa ku wulanga,

nha kawawonaga sunga ne wamalayika wakwe

vyono wasutyi.

19 Alu agwe, wukwihwesa nha vyono

kosuma kucitumbila ciwumbwa ce lilongo,

cinhu ce manghundi, cono cosuma kusajinhwa,

nhe lipulaputya?

20 U munhu kosuma kuwa mumi hakali mitondo,

ninga kanyhi kosuma kufwa, lono yunji si yalanjiliye

lono lizuwa likali hamba si naswa yaye.

21 Ne vinhu vyakwe vyose vyono yali yena

navyo, vikusolwa na wanji,

yakufwa, yasina mahala.


Jobu 5

1 “Gwe Jobu, ale ta wuceme, wuwone hono yunji kokwidika.

Hamba ho yuli malayika wo wose mono agwe komupitucila?

2 Holeka wumanye, vyono mahwele gawulagaga

wanhu ko wusungu,

na yowa nghani ya wulele, kanyhi cowa cinhu

ca wulele ku witumwe.

3 Nane niwawene i walele, wono wehwesaga wapolile,

ninga nane nghazilijita, musunho ko wukalale, zikaya zawo.

4 I wana wawo we cilume, si woyiwonela lukulu mhonelo,

hamba hasina munhu mono kowataza mu mahakama.

5 Nawo wono wali nzala, wolya mhwanga yo mulele

hamba wuwe wuhemba wukuwilucila mu mamivya,

nawo wanhu wono wena nyhilu,

woloyiwonela wivu sawo yakwe.

6 I zimbi si zikuwa kucindika mu manghundi,

hamba wugaye nawo, si wucindikaga mu muhangha.

7 Na yiyi yo nghani ya mbeka! U munhu keletelaga

wugaye mweneco du,

nha vyono vinyesela vyo moto,

vilawaga mu moto viwa kuzumha kucanyha.

8 “Holeka, hono ane, nali niwe yo gwegwe,

nali nimuwuyile Mulungu, nimuloloseze zangu zose.

9 Hambi ase nha si cosuma kuzimanya zimbaha

zono ketumaga

ne mapoto gakwe nha gasina ndumo.

10 Mwene katonyezaga mvula mu'si

kayitonyezaga mu mawimbi.

11 Heya, yo Mulungu du mono kawenulaga i wenenenyhezi,

no kuwasangalaza wono wakulila.

12 Kazimilaga zinzila ze wasugu,

ho walece kutuga cambuzi mu milimo yawo.

13 Kawagwizizaga we mahala mu mahweso gawo.

Ho walece kutuga cambuzi muli zose zono,

wowa kwituma.

14 Sunga na hono misi, wene wakwalabata-kwalabata

kotya nha kutitu.

15 Ninga Mulungu kawaponyaga waciwa mwifwa.

Kawatazaga mu wiwonelwe wono wena wanjile.

16 Kawapelaga witumbilo waciwa,

ninga kawanyamazaga i wabi.

17 “Langa ta, yo mumoti munhu mono Mulungu

yakumutacila. Holeka wulece kubedegala

lono yakukutacila.

18 Hambi Mulungu nha katamisaga, kanyhi no kulagula,

miwoko yakwe yikupelaga nghomele, ninga kanyhi

i miwoko yakwe yo yikukuponya.

19 Nayo vilo vyose kokuponya kali kenji mu magayo gako gose,

na mumbali ye ndumilizo, u wubi si wokupamiza.

20 Na hono lizala lize, mwene kokukamisa wikale mumi,

na mu wulugu namo, kokucitila ne lifwa.

21 Mulungu kokuponya na mu wuvilwe mose,

nayo kokuponya sunga na mu wongomezwe kolo waza.

22 Nagwe kolobedegala, no kuseka mu vipango vyo

wongomezwe hamonga ne lizala.

Hamba si kologogopa i malimu ga mu mbago.

23 Na mu mawimbi mono kowa kulima,

molowa musina mabwe,

hamba malimu ga mu mbago,

si golokugaza yaye.

24 Nagwe lulo, kolokwikala wupolile mwi'hema lyako.

Nagwe kolo wukulilanga litewa lyako lye zingholo,

koloziwona zipolile du.

25 Kolotuga wana wenji muno, wolowa wadedewaye

nhe mahanze ga mwi'dimo.

26 Kolofwa lono weza wuli mukombi kokolo,

nha kotya liso lyo wuhemba lyono ligwiye.

27 Alu 'gwe Jobu, cakondya kuyilondola-londola

nghani yiyi hamonga no kuyisunjilila muno muno.

Nayo yo nghani ya mbeka. Holeka aluno

nghukunena wuyibocele.”


Jobu 6

1 Jobu yakamupitula Elifazi yakatya,

2 yali yiwe ciba, wugazice wangu hamonga no wutamice wangu

hono vyali vipimwe mu muzani

3 vyali viwe vizito muno kuciza wuzito wo

musawawa wa mwi'lenga.

Holeka ne zinghani zangu, zilece kukupela wizine.

4 Mulungu mono yali vilungo, yakondya kunguma ne

zisonga zakwe

ne sumu yazo, yakondya kutandala mu muwili

wangu mose,

Mulungu yanhandaliciye nene wogofye wakwe.

5 Nyhenje si yililaga hono yiwe yikulya mahanze,

ne nghambaku nayo yiwezaga yinyamaye twii,

lono yikulya mahanze.

6 Hamba nani mono kasumaga kulya ndigwa

yili cisusuli yisina mwino?

Wule mu wuzelu we ligangha,

mo yili ndaso?

7 Nane hamba si niyidabuciye ndigwa ye liwala lilyo,

na vyose vyono nghuvilya, vikuhesuza mutima wangu.

8 “Alu nayo Mulungu, hamba nhawule si yakumhela

yono nghumulomba?

Hamba si yakusaka kumhitula no wulombe wangu.

9 Yali yiwe yili ciba le, hono yali yambulaje du lwa kamonga!

10 Na hono nali manye, nha vyono kosuma kumbulaga lwa kamonga,

nane nali nzumhe zumhe na nyemo.

No wusungu wangu, hamba si nali niwuhulice yaye.

Manyile vyono Mulungu Yelile,

nane nghali si namubeza muli zono kalajilizaga zose.

11 Alu nowa nina vilungo ci kanyhi,

vyono vyoleka njendelele kuwa mumi?

Alu socici lo njendelele kuwumipa

na lono neza sina witumbilo.

12 Hambi 'ne ninha yibwe? No muwili wangu nawo

hambi winha shaba?

13 Nalu, nha neza sina ne vilungo vyo kwitaziza,

hamba hasina kanyhi hanji hono notiziza

ho nhuje wutazi.

14 “Na mu wugaye wono winha wuwu,

mbeka nghusaka wendece, wono

wonhendela viswanu, hono niwe nakondya

kumuleka Mulungu hamba ng'o.

15 Ninga lu anye nyo wendece wangu,

mukunghonga-nghonga cinye vikolongo

vyono vinyalaga mwibahu

16 Vyono malenga gavyo matibulangwe,

gakutukuwazwa ne seluji.

17 Ninga seluji kolo yikutuga civuce hodu yiwa kwenjeduka,

ne vikolongo viwa kunyala.

18 Wanhu wakwajilila so wulondola malenga,

wakuyumbayumba sunga wafwila mu nyika.

19 Wanhu wokulawa Sheba na Tema wavilondola,

20 ninga witumbilo wawo wukamalicila mu

vikolongo vyono vinyalile.

21 Holeka nanye, ane nghumuwonenyi nha

vyono mwihwanile ne vikolongo vivyo kuli'ne,

mwakondya kuwuwona wugaye wono nina nawo,

nanye lu mukogopa.

22 Mwene ane nimulombenyi mumhele cinhu co cose,

hamba nimulombenyi nitya mubite mukamupele

yunji mafupo ku soko yangu,

23 hamba nimulombenyi nitya munhaze

kuli mulugu wangu, hamba kuli mono yakumbonela?

24 “Ale viswanu! Alu munyijizaje, mundajile masutya gangu

Nane nowa nyamaye du nghumuhulicizenyi.

25 Ninga mumanye vyono, zinghani zo mugoloka zo zitazaga,

ninga lu anye mukulonga nghani za wulele du.

26 Anye mukwihwesa nghani zangu za bwete kotya mbeho du.

Alu nhawule kanyhi mukumhitula zinghani zangu

ane mono nawa sina witumbilo?

27 Heya, mukuwatowela kula i wana wono wasina walezi wawo,

no kwigolifizya mu wendece wenyu!

28 Muwulangaje ta wusu wangu,

ane si nili mulambi yaye.

29 Zizo zono mulonjile,

hodu zakondya, mulece kuwa wakonji.

Kanyhi mulece kuhosa, hambi 'ne nha nili mu mbeka.

30 Ninga anye mukwihwesa ane nghulonga za wulambi,

kanyhi mukwihwesa vyono,

sinosuma kuzihosa zinghani zimbi.”


Jobu 7

1 “Mikalile yo munhu, yihwanile mulimo we

wasilikale ku wulugu.

Yinha mikalile yo munhu mono

yakwituma milimo kwe vilungo.

2 Yihwanile muwanda mono yakusulumila mubeho,

kotya mwitumami mono yalindiye musahala wakwe.

3 Myezi na myezi, nikaye du sina ndigwa

cilo na cilo vilo vyose, nikalaga nili mu wukalale du.

4 Na kolo nghugona mu citanda,

mapango hamba si gakupuluta mbela,

hodu, niwa kwipituciza-pituciza du sunga wusiku wela.

5 No muwili wangu, wumemile masomi gose,

weza wina mapele-pele gose du,

no wufila wukulawila mu zinghomele zangu.

6 Ne vilo vyangu vikupuluta visina witumbilo,

navyo vikubita mbela mbela, kuciza no munhu

muhona luheneko.

7 “Gwe go Mulungu, wukumbucile nha vyono wumi

wangu, wihwanile mbeho du.

Ne nyemo yangu nha yakondya kuduma.

8 Naluno wukusuma kumbona, na si kombonela lukulu kanyhi.

Na kolo wukunondola, ane nowa nakondya kufwa.

9 Nha vyono livunde lipemhelukaga no kwajilila,

ale nhavivyo, no munhu vyo kafwizaga,

hamba kuwuya kono'nze kanyhi.

10 Na wose wono wali wamumanyile, hodu,

wawa kumusemwela lukulu.

11 “Holeka ane hamba si nonyamala ndece kulonga yaye,

hambi nha nili mu wusungu, kanyhi ndabuce,

holeka yinojeye nonje du.

12 Alu, nhawule wukunyimila?

Hamba wukwihwesa vyono ane nili 'limu lya mwi'lenga lo?

13 Ane ngonile hasi ho nyhehe,

ho nhuje ciba mu wusungu wangu.

14 Ninga agwe wukunyogofya ne zindoto,

wukundetela wugubulilwe, hamonga no wilimucilwe

15 sunga niwa kuwona vyono ciba nali nifwe,

si nha kwikala mu muwili wuwu we magayo.

16 Nawukatala no wumi wangu,

si nghusaka hamba no kuwumipa yaye.

Holeka wundekaje, hambi vilo vyangu nha vya bwete du.

17 Alu munhu ci cici, ho wumukumye?

Ho waci waco, sunga wumwihwese mu nhumbula yako?

18 Agwe kumulanjililaga zakwe nhondo zose hakali mitondo,

hamonga no kumujela mapango gose.

19 Alu ma, sikoleka kunanga yaye cipango cidodo

nane ho sume kumela mate gangu lo?

20 Hamba nitume wubi, cono cikukutamisa ci cici,

'gwe go musepi we wanhu?

So cici lo wukusepa ho wunhowe?

Hamba'ne neza mutegulo kuli'gwe?

21 So cici si wukunenela wubi wangu,

no kumbusiza masutya gangu gono sutyaga?

Vyono alu nofwa no kuzikwa mu citenjelo

nagwe konondola ko wupiligazi,

ninga nowa nakondya kuwa nili hasina.”


Jobu 8

1 Nayo Bilidadi Mushubi yakamupitula Jobu yakatya,

2 “Alu mwene, zinghani zako zizo kozilonga sunga nili?

Zojendelela sunga nili kuwa nha mbeho mbaha?

3 Mulungu si kahodangaga wiling'ano,

hamba si yakuwa kulemwa kwituma ziswanu.

4 Ne wanago nawo, kowa wamusutizya Mulungu,

holeka nayo kawa kuwalipiciza.

5 Ninga aluno wunene kuli Mulungu mono yali vilungo.

6 Hono wuwe mbeka welile, kanyhi wuli ling'ani,

nayo Mulungu kokuza yakupele wutazi,

no kuyipela nyumba yako wumoteswe.

7 Ne sawo yako yose yono yakondya kwajilila,

yowa si cinji yaye,

hambi Mulungu nha kokupela vinhu vinji muno

kuciza na vyono wali wakondya kuvyajiliza.

8 Alu, wukumbucile mahala ga we zindelo ze katali.

Wihwese ne zimbeka zono walezi wetu wazilondolaga.

9 Kanyhi wumanye vyono mikalile yetu, ya vilo vicefu du

hamba si cimanyile cinji co cose,

cipulutaga mono'nze nho muzizi.

10 Holeka wulece wawaha we katali wakwijize

nagwe wuwahulicize azi zono wakuzilonga.

11 ‘Alu wumanye vyono, madete-lulenga,

sigotaga hono hasina malenga,

hamba hono hasina nhope.’

12 Na hono malenga ganyale,

lono gene gakali gadedewaye.

Hodu gakuwomba mbela,

si nhe mahanze ganji.

13 Nhavivyo vyo wenha i wanhu wose

wono wakumusemwa Mulungu

no witumbilo wawo wukuwa wa bwete,

vyono wakondya kumusemwa Mulungu.

14 Hambi nha wetumbiye mhuti ze nhandabuli.

15 Na hono wawe wetumbiye mhuti ze nhandabuli

wule, mbeka zosuma kuwebatiliza?

Na hono wawe wetumbiye luputi,

alu mbeka losuma kuwasikamya?

16 I wanhu wabi, wakuwa kutula nhe maselegwa mwi'zuwa,

wenha maselegwa gono gamemaga mu mugunda wose.

17 Ne milela yago, yigazingaga mabwe

yiwa kwibata zii mu mabwe gose.

18 Ninga hamba nhavivyo, kolo wagakula,

hodu, hakuwa hasina mono komanya

vyono gali gacindice mumo.

Wanji nawo wawa kuhadika mumo vyono wakusaka weneco.

19 Ale ne nyemo ye wanhu wabi nayo,

nhavivyo vyo yinha.

20 “Ninga Mulungu hamba si komuleka yaye

u munhu wakwe mwihuwilwa.

Hamba si kowapela wutazi i wanhu wabi.

21 Nayo kokumemya luseko hamonga ne lizi lye nyemo.

22 Kanyhi kowaletela cevu ciwaha muno

wose wono wakusulile.

Ne zikaya ze wanhu wabi,

si zokwijela kanyhi.”


Jobu 9

Lipitulo lya Jobu

1 Nayo Jobu yakapitula yakatya,

2 “Heya! Nane manyile vyono zose zizi zono

wukuzilonga za mbeka.

Ninga munhu kosuma wule kuwa

yali ling'ani hali Mulungu?

3 Hamba munhuci mono kosuma kwisumaniza nayo?

Hambi Mulungu, nha kosuma kuwuza mawuzo

gaficile elufu monga, gono hasina hamba

munhu monga, mono kosuma kugapitula.

4 Hambi Mulungu nha yo we mahala gose kanyhi yali vilungo,

hasina munhu hamba monga, mono kosuma

kwima ho visumanize nayo.

5 Mwene kagawusaga matunda si yagamanyize,

na mwi'kuwo lyakwe, kagongomezaga.

6 Mulungu kaletaga litulo, kawa kuyisinjisa yinze,

ne masumbili gayo, gawa kucicima.

7 Kosuma kulimila lizuwa lilece kusosomoka,

ne zinyelezi zilece kung'alala ku cilo.

8 Hasina munhu wo wose mono yamutaziliza Mulungu

kuwutandaza wulanga

no kulikanyanjila i mawimbi ge lilenga.

9 Mulungu kaziwikaga zinyelezi mu mwanya,

ne Dubu, ne Oliyoni, ne Cilimila,

hamonga ne zinyelezi za kutakama.

10 Nase hamba si cosuma kuzimanya zimbaha

zono kazitumaga,

hamonga ne mapoto gakwe menji,

gono gasina liwalo.

11 Mulungu yakukola, ninga hamba si nghumuwona yaye.

Yakupuluta ha mwande, nane hamba kumanya yaye.

12 Nayo kasolaga cono mweneco yendile,

na hasina munhu wo wose mono kosuma kumwimila yaye,

hasina hamba monga, mono kokwijelela

kuwuza nghani, yamutye, ‘Alo wukunoza cici?’

13 “Mulungu si koliwusa likuwo lyakwe,

Mwene kawongomezaga i walugu wakwe

wono wamutaza Lahabu, hamonga ne watazi wakwe.

14 Alu ane ma, nosuma nhawule kumupitula Mulungu?

15 Hamba niwe sina wusutye, ninga nghumulomba Mulungu

u muling'anizi wangu, yambonele lusungu.

16 Hamba mhali yandece nongane nayo,

si nihuwiye vyono yali yasume kuhuliciza.

17 Mwene yakundetela mukukunzo no kumhondanjiza,

no konjeleza zinghomele zangu mbula soko.

18 Hamba si yakusaka ho nehele yaye,

langa yayimemizye mikalile yangu no wusungu.

19 Alu wule, nitumamilaje vilungo hongo?

Njele kumudindimiza Mulungu?

Hamba nimutegule mu mahakama?

Ninga nani lu mono kosuma kumwibata, no

kumutegula kuko mu mahakama?

20 Ane heya sina wusutye, kanyhi nili mwihuwilwa,

ninga zinghani zangu zohosa,

sunga na zose zono nghuzilonga,

nha zikwijela vyono zikuhosa nene.

21 Hamba niwe sina wusutye,

ninga si nghwilanga nhumbula yangu,

Hambi mikalile yangu nha yitamigwe. Holeka kuli'ne

si cinji yaye, hono niwe sina wusutye, hamba

22 niwe nili musutyi, hambi Mulungu

nha kocongomeza du sese wose.

23 Na hono munhu mono yasina masutya yafwe lwa kamonga,

Mulungu yakuwa kuseka.

24 Hambi Mulungu nha yawakombolela yinze i wabi,

Kanyhi yakawabofuza meso i mahakimu

Alu, hono yawe Mulungu yo si yazituma zizo,

alu ho kowa nani kanyhi mono yazituma?

25 “Hambi vilo vyangu nha vikupuluta mbela,

hasina hamba lizuwa limonga lyono nowona ziswanu.

26 Vilo vyangu vikupuluta nha ngalawa

zono zijendaga musunho.

Vikumangha mbela nha 'ndi yono yikuswekula sungula.

27 Hamba sece, no kujela kuwusemwa wusungu wangu,

28 ninga wusungu wangu vyo wukunyiziza du

no kunhamisa.

Nane baho ho nghumanyila vyono, Mulungu

yakumbona nili musutyi.

29 Alu lono nakondya kwijela vyono nili musutyi,

ho noswa nghwigazizaci kanyhi?

30 Hambi nha hasina kanyhi sabuni ye liwala lyo lyose,

yono yosuma kunghwema wubi wangu.

31 Mulungu kongumila mu nhope

ne myenda yangu yonghoza cevu.

32 Nye! Mulungu yali yawe munhu,

nane nali nimupitule.

Cali cibitane nayo mu mahakama cikaling'anizwe

wugombane wetu.

33 Ninga lu, nha hasina munhu wo wose mono

kosuma kwima hagati yetu.

Hasina mono kosuma kuciling'aniza ane no Mulungu.

34 Gwe go Mulungu, wulece kujendelela kundipiciza!

Wumbusize wogofye wako!

35 Ane hamba si nghogopa kulonga yaye, langa nolonga du,

hambi nha niyimanyile nhumbula yangu no mweneco.”


Jobu 10

I nghani ya Jobu ye ndumilizo

1 “Hambi mikalile yiyi nha yanghataza muno.

Holeka aluno wuhulicize wung'ung'ulice wangu

wono wumemile wusungu.

2 Holeka go Mulungu, wulece kuning'aniza yaye,

Langa wundajile nghanici yono wina kuli'ne?

3 Hambi mbeka yikunojeye wuwe wusina lusungu?

Wukuwubedegala sunga no mulimo wono

wawituma gwegwe mweneco?

Hanyuma kanyhi kuwa kuwuseka wuhile we wanhu wabi?

4 Wule, wina meso ge cikulikuli?

Ma, wukuwona nha vyono wanhu wawonaga?

5 Hambi 'gwe wina wumi wa vilo vicefu

nha vyono winha wumi wetu?

Hamba myaka yako yinha myaka ye wanhu?

6 Alu nhawule wukuwuza-wuza zo wubi wangu,

no kulondola-londola zo wusutye wangu?

7 Agwe nha wumanyile vyono 'ne si nili musutyi,

kanyhi na vyono hasina munhu wo wose

mono konhaziza kuli'gwe.

8 Miwoko yako yo yamumba, no kumhela hwani yangu.

Kanyhi alu, miwoko yo yiyo yose yo yikunyongomeza.

9 Ninga wukumbucile nha vyono, wamumba ku wulawa mwi'longo,

alu ho weza kungomoleza kanyhi mu manghundi?

10 Wamupela baba wusume wo kundela'ne,

wukambilusiza munda ya yaya.

11 Wamumba muwili wangu hamonga ne mafupa,

hamonga ne matimba,

hanyuma wukamvwika nghuli ne nyama.

12 Wamhela wumi no lusungu lwako,

kanyhi wukundima no wumi wangu.

13 Ninga aluno nakondya kumanya nha vyono

kumbe mu madaha gago gose, wali wina

mahweso go kunhamisa nene.

14 Nagwe wukawa wulanjiliye, ho wuwone

hono nokwinjila mu wubi,

nagwe ho wuleme kunenela.

15 Na hono sutye du, hodu du kuligwe,

neyinjiza mu magayo, na hono nitume ziswanu,

si nghwambulila cinji yaye.

Nane memile cevu, nghuwuwona wugaye wangu du.

16 Na hono ninule mutwe wangu du,

agwe komhelemba nha simba ho wunhamise,

wukulajila metumo gako go wizine.

17 Hambi nhondo zose nha wina wuhomelezi muli'ne

ne likuwo lyako kuli'ne licilaga konjelezeka

nhondo zose, nagwe nhondo zose,

kwihwesaga nzila mhya yo kunhowela.

18 “Alu 'gwe go Mulungu, ho nhawule

wukandeka nghalelwa?

Yali yiwe ciba le, hono nali nifwe

lono munhu wo wose yakali sinambona.

19 Nali mhulutize du mu wulawa munda ya yaya,

sunga ko ku citenjelo.

Yiyo langa yali yiwe yo nghani swanu,

hambi nha yali yijele nha kotya sinawumbwa yaye.

20 Ne vilo vyangu ma, si visigaye vicefu?

Holeka nghukunena wundece.

Wundekaje nivisangalalile hadodo

i vilo vyangu vyono visigaye.

21 Hambi nha nobita mbela

hamba si nowuya kanyhi,

nghubita ku yisi yo wutitu no wukalale.

22 Yisi yo wutitu tuku, yo mubeho we lifwa,

yisi yono yili cakacaka du,

i hanhu hono wuzelu wayo, winha wutitu tuku.”


Jobu 11

Mapitulo ga Zofali

1 Hanyuma Zofali Munamati, yakamupitula Jobu yakatya,

2 “Alu wukwihwesa hasina munhu mono kusuma

kuzipitula zinghani zako zizo zo wulele?

Agwe wukwihwesa wulonga nghani nyinji,

wumunozaga munhu kawa yali ling'ani?

3 Alu mwene 'gwe Jobu, wukwihwesa nha vyono,

ase si cosuma kukupitula hongo?

Wukwihwesa zinghani zako zizo ze zinzwaji,

zocidinda milomo cilece kulonga hongo?

4 Agwe wukwiyitya vyono, zose zono wulonjile za mbeka.

Na kanyhi wukwiyitya vyono, agwe

wuli ling'ani hali Mulungu

5 Alu nane nali nombe Mulungu yakupitule!

6 Nayo yali yakulajile zo lubanzo lwe mahala,

hambi nha hozili zinji zono zicizize wumanye.

Alu Mulungu yakukulipiciza hadodo du,

si nha vyono wali wunojeye wulipicizwe.

7 “Alu 'mbi kosuma kumanya ze mabanzo go Mulungu,

hamonga no wuwaha wakwe ne vilungo vyakwe?

8 No wulanga hamba si wosuma kumwimila Mulungu yaye,

ninga kumbe wulanga ho wuli kucanyha muno kono agwe

si kosuma kuficila.

Kanyhi Mulungu yayimanyile ne yisi ye wafu

ninga agwe waco, hamba si wuyimanyile yaye.

9 U wuwaha wo Mulungu, wutandaye muno

sinhe yinze.

Kanyhi wugazi muno si nhe lilenga.

10 Na hono Mulungu yakwibate, yakusitace,

nani kanyhi mono kosuma kumwimila?

11 Mwene Mulungu yawamanyile wanhu wono wasina cambuzi,

kanyhi yakuziwona ne zimbi zono wakwituma.

12 “Ne wanhu walelelele, hamba si wotuga wizuce

hambi ndogowe ya mu mbago, nha ndogowe ya mu mbago du.

13 Holeka agwe Jobu, wuyiwikaje

nhumbula yako mu ling'ani,

wumubitile Mulungu.

14 Wuwusize lukulu wubi wose no wuwaya wose wa

mu kaya yako.

15 Hanyuma ho kosuma kwidoma ne yinze wukamile,

wusina nhumbula nyoga.

16 Ne magayo gako gose gowuka mu mahweso gako,

gokwihwana mahwazi ge malenga

gono gapulutaga hamba kukumbucilwa kanyhi yaye.

17 Ne mikalile yako nhondo yowa miswanu,

kuciza mu misi mugati

ne mikalile ye madaha go wutitu,

nhondo yong'alala nha hakali mitondo.

18 Nagwe kokwikala wupolile,

kanyhi wina no witumbilo.

Mulungu kokudima no kukupela wucehe.

19 Hamba si kowogopa kanyhi walugu wako yaye,

ne wanhu wenji wokuza walondole wutazi kuli'gwe.

20 Ninga i wanhu wabi, wowa kunasa ako na ako

kwe mahwele

nawo hamba si wotuga nzila

yo kwiponezya yaye.

Langa witumbilo wawo, wowa wufwe du.”


Jobu 12

Mapitulo ga Jobu

1 Nayo Jobu yakapitula yakatya,

2 “Heya, hamba muwe anye yo muli we mahala,

ninga mumanye vyono kolo mukufwa, mofwa hamonga

ne mahala genyu.

3 Ninga mumanye vyono nane nina mahala nhe genyu,

hamba si munyhizize cinji yaye.

No munhu wo wose du, yazimanyile zose zono mulonjile.

4 Sunga naluno i wendece wangu wakuseka 'ne,

ninga wakuseka bwete no muyawo,

nane ho nili ling'ani, kanyhi sina hamba wuhoswe,

ninga ho cili cipango cono namulomba Mulungu,

nayo yakamhitula wulombe wangu.

5 Anye mukuwona musina magayo,

holeka mukusekanga.

Mukumutowanga munhu mono

yali behi no kugwa.

6 Ninga i wahizi hamonga ne wanhu wono

wasina mulungu, awo wekalaga wapolile.

Hamba wawe mulungu wawo yali mu

vilungo vyawo weneco.

7 Hamba nhavivyo, zindeje hamonga ne vilimu,

zina nyinji zo kumwijizenyi,

8 holeka munojeye muyiwuze yinze ne lilenga

mahala gavyo.

9 Hambi vyose nha vimanyile,

vyono Muwaha Mulungu yo yaviwumba.

10 Kanyhi na vyono Mulungu yo yebate wumi

we viwumbwa vyose,

no wumi we wanhu wose wuli mu miwoko yakwe.

11 Alu nha vyono zinimi zenyu zisangalalaga

lono zikujeza ndigwa,

Ale nhavivyo ne makutu genyu

nago, gakuwa kusangalala lono gakuhulika nghani.

12 “Mahala gali mu wakombi,

ninga Mulungu yo yena mahala ne vilungo.

13 I wakombi wena wizuce

ninga Mulungu yo yena wizuce, hamonga

ne vilungo vyo kwitumila.

14 Na hono Mulungu yamwagule,

nani kanyhi mono kosuma kuzenga,

hamba nani mono kosuma kumuwopolela

mu jela, u munhu mono Mulungu yamudindiye?

15 Mazala, gazaga lono Mulungu si yatonyeze mvula,

nago mahwazi, gazaga lono Mulungu yalecile

mvula yitonye ko winji.

16 Mulungu yo yali vilungo, kanyhi yo we cisumisumi,

wose wali mu miwoko yakwe.

17 Mwene kawawusizaga mahala, iwatemi,

kawanozaga walongola wawa walele.

18 Kawawusaga watemi mu wutemi wawo

kawa kuwanoza wakuwa wafungwa.

19 Kawanenenyhezaga i wakohani

hamonga ne wanhu we vilungo.

20 Kawanyamazaga i wanhu, wono wanhu wawetumbiye,

kanyhi kagawusaga ne mahala i wakombi.

21 Kawakozaga cevu i wanhu we lilumbo,

no kuwawusiza vilungo vyawo i walongola.

22 Kamulikaga hono hatitu nhe lifwa.

23 Kagapelaga makungugo vilungo no wuwaha.

Ninga kanyhi ho kagasuma no kugongomeza.

24 Kawanozaga walongola wawo walelepa

kawa kuwaleka wewajizwe, wayegayeje wajilile.

25 Wakwalabatya kwalabatya mu citi,

wakujenda wakupebesuka nhe wagalo 'jimbi.”


Jobu 13

Lipitulo lya Jobu likujendelela

1 “Na zose zono mulonjile ane nali nakondya

kuzihulika katali.

2 Na kanyhi nizimanyile zose,

nizimanyile nha vyono muzimanyile nyenye.

Kanyhi ane si nili mudodo wenyu yaye.

3 Ane yinojeye cilongane no Mulungu,

ninga si nyenye yaye.

Nghuhila nimulonjele Mulungu zangu zose.

4 Anye lu mukusaka muwugubicize

wulele wenyu, mu nzila ye zinghani zenyu zo wulambi.

Mwehwana waganga wono si walagulaga yunji yanoje.

5 Ciba mwali munyamalile lukulu,

holeka yunji yali yehwese vyono mwina mahala!

6 Alu le, muhulicize nimulonjelenyi zangu nane.

7 Alu nhawulenyi muli walambi nhavi?

Mukwihwesa wulambi wenyu wina

cambuzi hali Mulungu?

8 Hamba mukujela kumuhijila mbejele Mulungu?

Hamba momutetela Mulungu mu mahakama?

9 Mwene nha baha hono Mulungu, yamusunjililenyi

mu zinhumbula zenyu,

mbeka kowona nghani yo yose swanu muli'nye?

Anye mukwihwesa vyono mosuma kumukonga

Mulungu, nha vyono muwakongaga wanhu?

10 Hamba muwe mwihundice mumo mu wukoci wenyu,

ninga Mulungu komutacilenyi.

11 No wuwe wakwe we vilungo, womogofyenyi.

12 Ne zimbazi zenyu za bwete, zinha mavu,

ne zinghani zenyu zose, mvuluje nhe lilongo.

13 “Alu munyamale du twii, mumhele cilejeho nane nonje,

mundekaje cinyagane co cose cono conyagana.

14 Mundekaje niyambuze wumi wangu no mweneco.

15 Hambi witumbilo wangu wose nha wawuka,

holeka hamba Mulungu yambulaje, ninaci?

Nane nobita du nghamulonjele zangu.

16 Na yiyo lunji yali yimhele wutazi,

ninga lu nha hasina munhu mubi mono

kosuma kumuwona Mulungu.

17 Alu muhulicize zono nghusaka kuzilolosa.

18 Mundekaje niyambuze no mweneco

ne zinghani zangu.

Hambi ane nha manyile no mweneco

vyono nili mu ling'ani.

19 “Alu go Mulungu, kokuza wuning'anize?

Na hono wunoze nhavivyo, ane nowa nyamaye du

twii, nindiye kufwa.

20 Ninga nghulomba nghuwuze nghani nyejete,

nagwe wunhendele, nane ho ndece

kwihundika hali'gwe, nazo zozi,

21 wulece kundipiciza hamba kunyogofya

ko woga wako.

22 “Gwe go Mulungu, wunyhemaje, nane nokwidika,

hamba wundece ane nonje, nagwe wumhitule.

23 Alu wubi wangu wo wa hayi?

Hamba zimbi za hayi zono nitumile?

Hamba wulajilizeci wono niwubenile,

wono wukuleka ane nghusitakwa?

24 Gwe go Mulungu, socici wukwihundika hali'ne?

Hamba nhawule wukunhendela nha nili mulugu?

25 Hamba wukuhila wunyongofye? Ane nha si nili

cinji yaye, langa nili'hamha du.

Alu agwe wukwihoma ne mabeleje makavu.

26 Hambi nha wukuning'aniza ko wukali muno,

kotya nha wukundipiciza so wuhodanji

wa ha wudodo wangu.

27 Wukumbopa ne manyolo migulu yangu

wunanjiliye sunga ne zinghanzo zangu

wuzimanyile sunga ne zinzayo zangu.

28 Co cikuleka lu nane nevuluga,

nawa nhe libici lyono lidodile.

Nawa nho mwenda wono wulijigwe ne makuni.”


Jobu 14

1 “Na wose cileligwe cili wasocele,

kanyhi cisina wutazi,

wose cikalaga vilo vicefu du,

kanyhi cimemile wugaye mu mikalile yetu.

2 Cikuwa kuwiluka no kunyala mbela mbela

nhe maluwa, cikupuluta nho mwenzenze.

3 Gwe go Mulungu, alu hongo kosuma kunanga,

wusitace, no kuning'aniza?

4 Hambi nha hasina ciswanu co cose

cono cosuma kulawa muli cono si ciswanu,

nha vyono munhu yenha.

5 Hambi wuwale we vilo vyakwe, nha watemezezwa lukulu,

ne myezi yo wikale wakwe.

Agwe wakondya kuviwaga, hamba si vyopitulwa yaye.

6 Wupituce, wulece kumulanga, ho yacehe,

mulekaje yayisangalalile mikalile yakwe ye magayo.

7 U mubici wono wadumulwa,

wukuwa wina witumbilo vyono wotula,

no wumi wayo wuwuwuyile kanyhi.

8 Hamba milela yayo yikale mu muhangha vilo vinji,

ne lisina lyayo liwe lyanyala,

9 ninga kolo likumwajilwa malenga,

lyotula du no kutuga mahamha.

10 Ninga munhu kolo yakondya kufwa,

hodu, yiyo yikuwa yo ndumilizo yakwe.

Na kolo yafwa, yakuwa yali kwihi kwene?

11 “Na vyono malenga ga mu makolongo galekaga kuhuluma,

ne malamba ganyalaga,

12 Ale, nhavivyo ne wanhu vyo wafwizaga

hamba kwinuka kanyhi.

Nawo hamba si wolokwinucila lukulu,

sunga wulanga wuwe hasina.

Hamba si wosuma kusinhuka yaye mu zinhongo zawo.

13 “Nane nali nende wuhundice mu yisi ye wafu,

nihundice kuko, sunga likuwo lyako liselete,

hanyuma wunhemezezye cipango co kunghumbucila.

14 Alu mwene hono munhu yawe yakondya kufwa,

ho kowumipa kanyhi?

Ninga ane nolindila sunga kono cokuziza

cipango cono cinojeye,

nolindila sunga cipango cici ce magayo cipulute.

15 Hanyuma go Mulungu ho konyhema, nane nokwidika

nagwe ho kowa watuga wendezwe nane,

ane no ciwumbwa cako.

16 Hanyuma nagwe ho kosuma kuyilanga mikalile yangu,

hamba si kosuma kanyhi kuning'aniza

ku soko yo wubi wangu.

17 Kowusemwa wubi wangu, no kuwutaga kutali,

kanyhi, konghwemela lukulu ne masutya gangu

gose gono gapulute.

18 I cipango cikuza cono matunda gologwa,

ne mabwe mawaha golovulumuka.

19 I malenga gologasakaza mabwe,

nayo mvula mbaha yolowuhulumya muhangha we'si,

nagwe go Mulungu, kolowuhodanga

witumbilo wo wumi wo munhu.

20 Wukumusumila lukulu munhu, no kumuwinjila lukulu,

wukumulanzya wusu wakwe kwi 'fwa.

21 Ne wanagwe wawa wena lilumbo, ninga mwene sikomanya,

na kolo wakuwusizwa lilumbo, mwene sikomanya yaye.

22 Baho mwene, kowa yena wusungu du wo muwili wakwe,

no wukalale wa mu nhumbula yakwe.”


Jobu 15

Zinghani ze kejete za Elifazi

(15:1–21:34)

1 “Elifazi Mutemani yakamupitula Jobu yakamutya,

2 Gwe Jobu, hambi u munhu we mahala kalongaga nghani zo wulele,

Wule, u munhu yuyo, kowa yamemile nghani za bwete du?

3 Hambi u munhu we mahala, kosuma kwitetela mu wulonga nghani zono

si zinojeye, hamba ne zinghani zono zisina cambuzi yaye.

4 Kanyhi yikwijela nha vyono, agwe hamba si wukuwucelelela u wogopo

Mulungu, kanyhi wukuwimila u wihwesa zo Mulungu.

5 Ku soko wubi wako, wukwijelela mu wulonje wako,

nagwe wukwihinda kuwugubiciza no wulonje wako wo wusugu.

6 Ninga ane Elifazi, sina wuhile wo kukuling'aniza,

hambi nha kuling'anizizwa mu zinghani zako zose

zono wuzilonjile go mweneco.

7 Alu wukwihwesa nha vyono yo gwegwe munhu

mulongozi kulelwa?

Hamba wali wakondya kulelwa lono Mulungu

yagawumbila matunda?

8 Wule! Walihulika ne lihala lye cinyele lyo Mulungu?

Hamba mahala go munhu gali muli'gwe du wuli wene?

9 Hamba ho zili zinji zo zose zono agwe wuzimanyile,

zono ase zicanjiye.

10 Ase co wayago, ceyijiza mahala ku wulawa

kuli wanhu wono wacindice zimvwi,

i wanhu wono walelwa, na lono sogo yali yakali nalelwa.

11 Mulungu yakukupela wusindamice, alu nhawule

agwe si wukuwubocela?

Ne nghani yono cikulongana nagwe ne mazi mapolo

hongo si cinji kuli'gwe.

12 Ninga agwe wukukomala no kucinugulila kwe 'kuwo.

13 Ninga wumanye, vyono wukumukolelwa likuwo Mulungu,

kanyhi no kumuhosa.

14 Alo munhu mbeka kosuma kuwa yelile hongo?

Hamba kuwa ling'ani hali Mulungu?

15 Alu nhawule Mulungu hamba si kawetumbilaga

sunga ne wamalayika wakwe,

vyono nawo nhavivyo, si welile hali mwene.

16 No munhu kang'wezaga wubi nhe malenga

na mbeka munhu iwifyo, kanyhi musocele.

17 “Holeka alu Jobu, wuhulicizaje ta zono nghukulonjela.

18 Iwanhu we mahala, wanyijiza no muyago ze zi mbeka

zono wene nawo, weyijiza kuli walezi wawo

nawo si wazihundika yaye hamba monga.

19 I wajenzi wose wakawingwa wawuce mu yisi yawo.

Hakawa hasina yunji kanyhi mono yali yawapatuse

no kuwawika kutali no Mulungu.

20 No munhu mubi mono yawewonelaga wanji,

yuyo kowa mu wusungu mu mikalile yakwe yose.

21 Ne lizozo lyo woga, lyohulikwa mu makutu gakwe,

ne wahizi womuziza mwi'pango lyono mwene

yakwiwona yapolile.

22 Kanyhi kowa yasina witumbilo vyono kowuya

ku wulawa mu wutitu.

Hambi nawo mumaje, nha wowa wumulindiye

ho wumuwulaje,

23 ne zindi nazo, zowa zilindiye

ho ziwulye muvimba wakwe.

Nayo yamanyile du, vyono citi cimulindiye.

24 Nawo wusungu, wono vihwanile no mutemi we vilungo,

wowa wumulindiye ho wumuhawanje.

25 Yiyo yo nghani yono yimulindiye munhu,

mono yakumukunjila funzi Mulungu

no kumwavufya Mono yali vilungo.

26 No munhu we liwala lilyo, yo mwiwoni kanyhi mufyuzi.

27 Kanyhi yenuye ngula yakwe kucanyha

ko wuwula cihuliko,

yakumangha vikehome no Mulungu.

28 Yuyo yo munhu mono kagatekaga makaya

no kwibata zikaya zono wanya zikaya wakondya kutiza.

Ninga wulugu, wogongomeza makaya gago

hamonga ne zikaya zayo.

29 Nayo hamba si kojendelela no wugoli wakwe cibitilila,

hasina hamba cinji cono yena naco,

cono colokwikala cibitilila.

Sunga no mwenzenze wakwe mweneco wolokwajilila.

30 Nayo hamba si kolokwilega ne citi,

kolokwihwana no mubici,

wono manhambi gayo ganyanywa no moto,

ne mahamha gayo, gawa kupemheluswa ne mbeho.

31 Na hono yawe mulele, yawe yetumbiye zimbi,

ale, i zimbi zizo, zo colowa co cipegwa cakwe.

32 Na lono cipango cakwe cowa cikali nafika,

ninga mwene kowa yakondya kunyala,

kowa yanyala nhe linhambi, hamba si kotula kanyhi.

33 Kolokwihwana nho mubici wo muzabibu, wono

wakondya kuwuswa zabibu zayo,

kanyhi nho muzeyituni, wono wukukung'unhika mahamha gayo.

34 Ne wanhu wose wono si wamogopile Mulungu,

wawo hamba si wotuga wana yaye

ne zikaya zawo zono wazizenjela mu nzila ye

mafupo, zose zolokongogwa no moto.

35 Wawo wo wanhu wono wekalaga wakuleta magaziko,

no kwituma zimbi.

Ne zinhumbula zawo zikalaga zimemile nghani zo wungwele.”


Jobu 16

I mapitulo ga Jobu

1 Jobu yakapitula yakatya.

2 “Nye wayangu, zinghani

ze liwala lilyo, ane nakondya kuzihulika katali.

Wusindamice wono mukusindamika,

ane nghuwona mukumhela wusungu du.

3 Alu mojendelela kulonga sunga nili?

Ninga yinojeye nhondo zose muwe ne nghani ye ndumilizo.

4 Na hono anye mwali muwe yo ane, nane niwe

yo nyenye, nali nonje zose zono mulonjile.

Nali sinjise mutwe wangu kwe mahala,

nimusumenyi ne zinghani zono zinha lihwazi lye malenga.

5 Nali nimusikamyenyi ko wulonje wangu,

njendelele kumusindamicenyi.

6 “Ninga lu, hamba nali nonje, wukalale wangu si wali

wutuzwe yaye,

na hono nyamale, si nghutuga wutuzwe

mu wusungu wangu.”

7 Alu wakondya kusuma go Mulungu,

hambi nha kuwaleka we mhuga yangu wose wawulagwa.

8 Nane wambopa, weza wuli mulugu wangu.

Ane nili nghuli ne mafupa.

Ne wanhu nawo so nghani yiyi,

wakondya kwihuwila vyono ane nili musutyi.

9 Yawusalangulanga muwili wangu

kanyhi yanuguliye kwe'kuwo

10 Ne wanhu wakusekanga,

wehangulize hamonga, wakunhowa makofi

mu wusu wangu.

11 Nayo Mulungu kakondya kumbika

mu miwoko ye wanhu wabi.

12 Ninga 'ne ho nekalaga mholile,

Mulungu yakanyibata mu singo yangu,

yakambenanga no kumhondanga vidodo vidodo.

Mulungu yakambika ho niwe wisumanizo wo wugume.

13 Ne wagumi nawo, wakunguma ne zisonga mbavu zose.

Zisonga zono zikuhoma no kumhela nghomele,

ninga hamba nhavivyo, mwene si yakumbonela

lusungu yaye.

14 Nayo yakumhela nghomele nyinji du,

yakuhoma nho musilikale mono yena lukwale lo lusulo.

15 “Nghalila, nghavwala magunila,

nghawa kwivwagamika mu manghundi, nalemwa.

16 Nane nalila, sunga no wusu wangu nhondo wadunghuwala,

ne meso gangu gavimba, gawicila no mubeho,

17 ninga'ne ho sina masutya go wugazi yaye,

no wulombe wangu kuli Mulungu, welile.

18 “Gwe go yinze, wulece kuhundicila i zimbi

zono netuma!

19 Ninga kuko ku wulanga, ko ko yuli u muhomelezi wangu,

mono yali ku lubavu lwangu.

20 Wendece wangu, wakumbedegala,

ninga meso gangu gakumulavizya mahozi Mulungu.

21 Holeka nghumusaka yunji yanombele kuli Mulungu,

nha vyono munhu kamulombelaga u mwendece wakwe.

22 Myaka yangu yikupuluta musunho,

nane nhyatizye nzila yono si noloyiwuyila kanyhi.”


Jobu 17

1 “No mudumo we vilo vyangu, nha wasejelela,

no wehele wangu wacepuka,

alu hasina cinji kanyhi cono cisigaliye,

langa kwinjila mu citenjelo du.

2 Nane nghuwalanga ko wusungu wuwaha muno,

wose wono wakusekanga.

3 Gwe go Mulungu, ane nili mwinenenyhezi.

Holeka wubocele zinghani zangu.

Hambi nha hasina kanyhi yunji

mono yadahile kunhaza muli zono nghulonga.

4 Hambi nha kuwahundika zinhumbula zawo,

ho walece kwizuka,

holeka wulece kuwaleka wasume'ne.

5 Cikuwona mu zimbazi ze katali, nha vyono

munhu yakuwagaluka wendece wakwe

ku soko ya pesa,

ne wanagwe wawa wali mu wugaye.

6 “Naluno nghuwona vyono, wanhu

wakwitumamila mbazi yiyi kuli'ne,

wakuza, wakufunyila mate mu wusu wangu.

7 No wusungu wangu nhondo wambofuza,

ne miwoko yangu, hamonga ne magulu gangu,

vyasisilika vyawa nha muzizi.

8 Ne wanhu wo mugoloka, wakwizina so nghani yiyi

hanyuma wakuhosa, nha kotya ane nane nihwanile ne wanhu

wono so wamogopile Mulungu.

9 Ninga we ling'ani, wocila kuwa we ling'ani.

10 Hamba waze wose, weme ha mwande yangu,

ninga si nosuma kumutuga hamba monga we mahala.

11 “Vilo vyangu vyakondya kupuluta, no wuhile wangu

wakondya kudumanjila, no witumbilo wawuka.

12 Ninga wendece wangu, watezaga cilo yo misi,

wakutya vyono wusiku wuli behi kwela,

ane ninga manyile vyono nghali nili mu wutitu.

13 No witumbilo wangu, wuli mu yisi du ye wafu,

i hanhu hono nogona mu wutitu,

14 Nane nocicema citenjelo yo baba,

ne mang'onyo gono gowa kunyilya,

nogacema yo yaya ne walumbu zangu.

15 Ale 'lu, witumbilo wangu wanda wuli hayi?

No witumbilo wangu, nani mono kowuwona?

16 Nane hamba si cobitana hamonga no witumbilo,

kolo neza kubita kuko ku yisi ye wafu.”


Jobu 18

Wulonje we kejete wa Bilidadi

1 “Bilidadi Mushuhi, yakamupitula Jobu yakamutya,

2 Alu mwene Jobu, nhawule wuli zeze,

hamba si wukwenda no kunyamala?

Ta wali wunyamale, nase cilongane nagwe.

3 Alu mwene cono coleka agwe

wuciganicize ase nha cili walele

kotya ng'ombe, cicici?

4 Hambi nha weza kwitamisa wuli wene so likuwo lyako,

wukwihwesa yisi yolekwa yili wene so likuwo lyako?

Hamba wukwihwesa vyono Mulungu kogahamya matunda

ho yakwendeze gwe?

5 “Heya, limuli lye wanhu wabi, lyozimywa,

no wuzelu walyo, hamba si wong'alala kanyhi yaye.

6 Ne tala yono yili mwi'hema lyayo, nayo yotukuwikwa.

7 Ne zinghanzo zakwe ze vilungo, zohogoha,

ne lihala lyakwe mweneco, lyomugwisa.

8 Yakujendela mu lwavu,

ne migulu yakwe yikwibatwa.

9 Kokwibatwa mu cising'anilo no mutego.

10 No mutego, muhundikwe hasi wumutejile,

mutego mutegwe mu wukolo wakwe.

11 “No wogofye wumupilime mbavu zose.

Nawo wumutyatizye kose kono yakubita.

12 Yali mugoli muno, ninga luno yali ne nzala,

magayo gamulindiye ha mhelo yakwe.

13 “Ne litamwa libi lyakondya kutandala mu

muwili wakwe wose,

lyakondya kumuhodanga miwoko ne migulu yakwe.

14 Kakondya kuwuswa na mwi'hema lyono

yekalaga yapolile.

Nalu yakukomhoswa mwi'hema lyono yetumbiye,

yategulwe vikedome no Mutemi we nghakamo,

mono yakucemwa Mutemi ‘Lifwa.’

15 Naluno wose wokwinjila mw'ihema lyakwe,

ne cibiliti cokwiyagazwa mwi'hema lyakwe.

16 Milela yakwe hamonga ne manhambi gayo, vyonyala.

17 Ne lilumbo lyakwe, nalyo lyowuka mu kaya yakwe,

sunga na mu yinze yose.

Hamba howa hasina yunji kanyhi mono kolomukumbucila.

18 Nayo kolowusizwa lukulu mu yisi ye womi,

kolowuswa mu wuzelu, yenjizwe mu wutitu.

19 Nayo si kowa na wana hamba wezukulu yaye.

20 Ne wanhu wose, ku wulawa ku lubavu lwa kumwezi,

sunga ku lubavu lwa kucilima,

wono wozihulika zizo,

wokwizina muno no kutinuswa.

21 Ale, zizo zo zowatuga i wanhu wabi.

Naho baho ho hanhu he wanhu wono si wamumanyile Mulungu.”


Jobu 19

Mapitulo ga Jobu

1 “Nayo Jobu yakapitula yakatya,

2 Alu mwene, nha mwanhimvya muno ne zinghani zenyu?

3 Nha mwasola katali nhondo mukunhovulanga du,

sunga zafika nghanghulo yikumi.

Hamba si mukuwona cevu yaye mu nzila

yenyu yono mukuhoseza'ne.

4 Alu ninga hamba ane niwe nina masutya,

anye cono cikumutamisenyi cicici?”

5 Anye mukwihwesa vyono muli waswanu si nha ane,

na holeka mukuwusola wugaye wangu

muwitumamile, ciwe co cihomelezi cangu

co kundajila vyono ane nili musutyi.

6 Alu 'nye, hongo si mukuwona vyono

zizi zose, Mulungu yo yazitumile?

Mulungu kambicila mutego ho yangwize.

7 Langa ta, nghucenga, hamba kuhulikwa,

nghulilila wutazi, ninga hasina wuling'anizwe.

8 Mulungu kakondya kuyidinda nzila,

nane hamba si nosuma yaye kupuluta.

Kawuhundika wukolo wangu mu wutitu.

9 Kakondya kumbusiza wugoli wangu wose,

no kumbusiza lilumbo lyangu.

10 Yambenanga ku wulawa mbavu zose

kawukula no witumbilo wangu nhe libici.

11 Mulungu yangholeywe likuwo,

kanyhi yena nhunduji kuli'ne

holeka yakunhendela kotya nha nili mulugu wakwe.

12 Yakundetela lipuga lye wasilikale wahome,

wahimba likweme lipilime mwi'hema lyangu.

13 Mulungu kawawika wandugu zangu wawe kutali nane,

alu neza mujenzi kuli wono wali wamanyile.

14 Iwandugu zangu hamonga ne wendece wangu,

wose wakondya kusemwa.

15 Na wose wono wali wazoweye kuza kunamusa

ha kaya yangu, wakondya kusemwa.

Sunga no mwitumami wangu we cicekulu,

aluno yakunhendela nha nili mujenzi,

Neza nha munhu mono si wamumanyile yaye.

16 Na lono nghumucema mwitumami wangu,

mwene hamba si yakwidika yaye,

sunga na lono nghumulomba du yamhele wutazi.

17 No mugolece wangu nayo, hamba si yakusuma

kuwukangalila no wehele wangu,

sunga ne wandugu zangu, nawo hamba si wakusejelela.

18 Sunga wana wadodo wakumbedegala, no

kusekanga, lono wakumbona.

19 “Ne wendece wangu muno, nawo wakunanga ko wizine,

na wose wono wali wanyendile muno, nawo wandeka.

20 Ne nghuli yangu vyetemanuka ne mafupa gangu,

nane mhona no wumi wangu du.

21 Nye nyo wendece wangu! Ta mumbonelaje lusungu ye!

Hambi muwoko wo Mulungu, nha wakondya kunhowa.

22 Ale, nhawulenyi nanye mumhele magazo,

nha vyono Mulungu yakunozeza?

Alo wusungu wuwu wono mwakondya kumhela,

ho si wukumukwilenyi yaye?

23 “Na mbeka, nali nyende yumonga wa muli nyenye,

yakumbucile zinghani zangu zose zono nonjile,

yazandice mu citabu!

24 Hamba zali ziseswe mwi'talawe,

zandikwe ziwe cikumbucizo, zikale mumo cibitilila.

25 Ninga manyile vyono Mukombozi wangu yo mumi,

Kanyhi vyono kolokwima mu manghundi gago mwi'zuwa lye ndumilizo.

26 Hamba yiwe nghuli yangu yakondya kongomezwa nhavivi,

ninga nokwima kunze ye nghuli yangu.

27 Nomuwona Mulungu nene no mweneco ne meso gangu.

Nayo hamba si kowa mujenzi hali'ne yaye.

28 Anye mukutya, ‘Ase lu cosuma kumutyatilila wule?’

29 Ho coyituga wule soko yo kumutamisiza?

Ninga nane luno nghumutyenyi, mwilanjililaje no wulipicizwe,

No lusulo lwenyu losuma kumuletelenyi lifwa!

Munojeye mumanye vyono, U Mulungu yali wene du, yo hakimu.”


Jobu 20

Wulonje we kadatu wa Zofali

1 Nayo Zofali Munamati yakapitula yakatya,

2 “Gwe Jobu, ninga ane wukunghalaza ye.

Holeka nane nopitula musunho.

3 Hambi zinghani zako zose zono wulonjile,

nha kulonjela mu cibede cako du,

ninga nane manyile vyono nokupitula.

4 Jobu, wumanyile ku wulawa katali,

vyono, lono munhu yawicilwa mono'nze,

5 u munhu mubi yali yena nyemo ya cidaha cidodo du.

6 Hamba munhu mubi yawiluce muno, no widunhumuzi wakwe wufice

ko ku wulanga, no mutwe wakwe wufice ko ku mavunde,

7 Ninga vyo koputwa nhe manghundi du,

na wose wono wali wamumanyile,

wolokwizina kolo si wakumuwona, wawe kutya, ‘Yali hayi?’

8 Kolokwajilila nhe ndoto, kotya wugubulilwe we cilo,

hamba si kolokwijelela lukulu kanyhi.

9 Kolokwajililila lukulu hamba kwijela kanyhi

i hanhu hono yekalaga,

10 i wanagwe wolozigomola zisawo

ze waciwa zono yahizaga.

11 No muwili wakwe wono wali wa wuzelelo ne vilungo,

ninga cidaha cidodo du wowa manghundi.

12 “Hamba wubi wuwe wuli muzinzi mu mulomo wakwe,

13 hamba yawe yawuhundice hasi yo lulimi lwakwe.

14 Ninga mu'nda yakwe, ndigwa yikuwa nghali muno

yihwanile vyono sumu yiwezaga.

15 No munhu mubi, kayidekaga sawo yose yono yayihiza.

Mulungu kayigomolezaga kwakwe, sunga na

yono yili mu'nda yakwe.

16 Na cono munhu mubi kamelaga, nha cihwanile sumu,

nayo yomuwulaga nha mono yalumigwe ne lizoka.

17 Hamba si kowumipa kanyhi, ho yagawone

makolongo ge mafuta,

hamba vikolongo vyono vikuhuluma mele no wuci.

18 Nayo kovileka vyose vyono yavitugutilila,

hamba si kotuga kanyhi cilejeho, co

kusangalalila sawo yakwe,

19 vyono yawewonelaga waciwa no kuwabedegala,

kanyhi yakawaboka wanji zikaya zono wali wezenjeye.

20 “Hamba nhavivyo, wusulumizi wakwe,

si wokwigushwa yaye.

21 Na lono yalizaga, hasina cono yasigazaga,

ninga aluno wumoteswe wakwe wamalika.

22 Magayo gomuziza haciligati yo winji

we vinhu vyono yena.

23 Holeka mulekaje yalye vyose vyono yakusaka mwene.

Ninga Mulungu yo kolomulipiciza

ko wukali ne likuwo lyakwe.

24 Nayo kolo yakujela kwiponya ku mumaje we cuma,

ninga kogumwa no wupinde we shaba.

25 Ne songa yowa yipuguze mu muwili wakwe,

no wung'alale we cisonje ce songa, cowa cikwiliye

sakami yakwe, no woga wowa mu nhumbula yakwe.

26 Ne vinhu vyose vyono kowa yewiciye, vyokongomezwa,

nayo mwene hamonga na we mhuga yakwe wose,

wotakamizwa no moto wono wowa si mukoleleze

ne miwoko yo munhu.

27 Wulanga wugubulaga wubi wo munhu,

nayo yisi yikuhomelela.

28 Ne sawo yakwe yose yokongomezezwa mwi

'hwazi lye likuwo lyo Mulungu.

29 Ali lye'fungu lye wanhu wabi

lye' fungu lyono Mulungu yawawiciye.”


Jobu 21

Mapitulo ga Jobu

1 Jobu yakapitula yakatya,

2 “Ale ta muhulicize nane nimulonjelenyi,

nawo wuwu wowa wo wutuzwe du wono nghuwulomba

kuli 'nye.

3 Alu, mumhelaje cilejeho nane nonje,

na lono nghali kulonga nanye, hono musace mosuma kuseka.

4 Ane nghani yangu si yili kuli wanhu yaye,

holeka nina soko yo kuwa no wukangalizi.

5 Ale, munangaje ta vyono ninha, wulenyi, yiyi si yosuma

kumunozenyi mwizine no kunyamala twii hongo?”

6 Ku soko nane kolo nghwihwesa zizi

zono zakondya kunyijelela,

mbeka nghugazika, nghucicima,

kanyhi nghwinjilwa no woga.

7 Alu nhawule mwene, Mulungu yakuwaleka i wanhu wabi

wekale womi, sunga wakombipe hamonga no wumoteswe?

8 Wakuwa wena ne wana, hamonga ne wezukulu,

wekaye wakuwadima, sunga wawiluka.

9 Hamba Mulungu si kawaletelaga magayo mu zikaya zawo,

wekalaga du wapolile, wasina woga wo wose.

10 Heya, ne zing'ombe zawo zilelaga

viswanu, zisina magaziko.

11 Ne wana wawo, nawo wakumangha-mangha no kwidawala

nhe zinyana ze zingholo.

12 Wakuvina wena ne zindonondo, hamonga ne zifulembe.

13 Wekalaga vilo vyose mu wumoti,

ninga wofwa lwa kamonga wasina wugazice.

14 I wabi wakumulonjela Mulungu yawalece wali wene,

hambi nha si wendile wawumanye wuhile wo Mulungu

mu mikalile yawo.

15 Wakwihwesa nha vyono, hasina soko yo kumwitumamila

Mulungu, hamba cambuzi co kumulomba.

16 Wene wawonaga nha vyono, vyose vyono wena navyo,

wavitugaga kwe vilungo vyawo weneco.

Ninga ane ku lwangu, hamba si nghugavumila yaye

mahweso gawo gago.

17 “Kali kalinga limuli lye wabi likuzimywa?

Hamba no wongomezwe wuwazizaga 'mbi?

Nayo Mulungu wule, kawalipicizizaga i wabi mwi'kuwo

18 lyakwe, no kuwapemhelusiza kutali nhe mawaje

mu mbeho, hamba kotya manghundi gono gakukunzwa

no mukukunzo?

19 “Anye mukutya vyono Mulungu kamulipicizaga mwana

so wubi wo sogwe.

Ninga vyo si nhavivyo, mulece Mulungu yawalipicize

weneco du wono wetumile wubi,

mulece yawalajile nha vyono yakuzinoza zizo

ku soko yo wubi wawo.

20 Muwalekaje wabi, wedinghulile weneco wulipicizwe

wawo, mulece walijeze likuwo lyo Mulungu

mono yali vilungo.

21 Nalo munhu kolo yafwa, hambi kehwesaga kanyhi

ze nyemo ye wanagwe?

22 Hambi munhu kosuma kumwijiza Mulungu mono

kaling'anizaga, sunga na wose wono wena lilumbo liwaha?

23 “Howali wanhu wanji, wono mu mikalile yawo yose,

wekalaga miwili yawo miswanu du,

yisina wunyoganyoga sunga wolofwa,

24 nawo wafwizaga wapolile wasina wugazice

ne miwili yawo miliswe viswanu.

25 Ninga wanji wawezaga wasina nyemo hamba nhavi,

wekalaga sunga wafwila mu wusungu mu zinhumbula zawo.

26 Ninga hamba nhavivyo, wose vyo wehwanile du,

wafwizaga no kuzikwa, wawa kuligwa ne mang'onyo.

27 Mulanje! Nane manyile mahweso genyu mabi

gono mukunyihweseza.

28 Hambi nha mukutya, ‘Alu kaya yakwe yili hayi yo

munhu yuyu muwaha, u munhu mono kedawalaga no wubi?’

29 Wulenyi, anye mukali naduwana ne wanhu wajenda

mihinzo? Hamba si muzimanyile zono

wazilolosaga kolo wawuya?

30 Na mwizuwa kolo Mulungu yakolwa likuwo no kulipiciza,

i wanhu wabi, wo wakuwa kulekwa nhondo zose.

31 Hasina munhu mono komuhosa u munhu mubi,

hamba kumulipiciza muli zose zono yasutizye.

32 Ninga kolo yafwa, yeza kutegulwa kuzikwa mu citenjelo,

33 wanhu wenji muno wokwilunza mu maziko gakwe,

womukanyiciza no muhangha mhola mhola

mu muwili wakwe.

34 Alu nanye yonye! Mukujela kunhuza na

nghani za bwete du!

Hambi mu mapitulo genyu, nha mumemile nghani za

wulambi du zose!”


Jobu 22

Zinghani za Elifazi

(22:1–27:23)

1 Elifazi nayo yakatya,

2 “Alu wule, kowa ko yuli munhu we mahala muno,

mono kosuma kumuletela Mulungu cambuzi?

3 Wule, metumo gako maswanu gakumupela cambuzi Mulungu?

Hamba wuswanu wako wuwo, wukumutaza ci Mulungu?

4 Alu agwe si ku soko ye cogopo cako ca kuli Mulungu,

holeka Mulungu yakukutacila no kukuling'aniza, aa ng'o.

5 Langa yakukutacila ku soko vyono witumile wubi muno,

na ku soko ye masutya gako.

6 Hambi nha wukusola mapesa ko nduguyo, so nghani ya bwete,

no kumusolela ne myenda yakwe, kumuleka yasina hamba

mwenda wono kovwala.

7 Walema kuwapela malenga wang'we wono wakataye

wukalema no kuwalisa wono wali nzala.

8 Kanyhi wuketumamila vilungo vyako ne cilejeho cono wali

wina, wukayisola yisi yose.

9 Na kanyhi si vyono walema du kuwapela wutazi

i wacekulu wafwile,

ninga kanyhi, wukawahiziza no kuwatendela vibi,

i wana wono wasina walezi wawo.

10 Na ku soko yiyo, alu makweme gakupilime mbavu zose,

no woga we nhinicizo, wukukugaza.

11 Hambi nha kwatukuwala tuku, nagwe weza si wukuwona

ne lihwazi likukugubika.

12 Ma! Mulungu, si yali ku wulanga kucanyha,

nayo yakulanjila mu zinyelezi hasi,

hamba ziwe zili kucanyha muno?

13 Nagwe wukuwuza wukutya, Hambi Mulungu kosuma

kumanya ci?

Nha yahundikwe ne mavunde, alu ho kosuma

nhawule kuciling'aniza 'se?

14 Agwe wukwihwesa nha vyono mavunde mazito,

gosuma kumwimila Mulungu ho yalece kuwona,

ninga nayo ho yakujenda ako na ako

mu mwanya wo wulanga.

15 “Alu ma! Kojendela mu nzila yono i wanhu wabi

wayikolaga nhondo zose?

16 Hambi nha wasolelezwa ne lihwazi,

na lono vilo vyawo vyali vikali si nafika.

17 Nawo wawo, wo wanhu wono wamulemaga Mulungu,

wono wali wehuwiye nha vyono, Mulungu

hamba si kusuma kuwapela wutazi wo wose yaye.

18 Kumbe Mulungu yo yawapela wumoteswe.

Holeka ane mbeka, hamba si nghusuma

kugamanya mahweso ge wanhu wabi vyono genha!

19 Iwanhu we ling'ani, wekalaga wasangalaye,

ne wanhu wono wasina wusutye, wekalaga wena nyemo,

lono wakuwawona i wabi wakulipicizwa.

20 Ne vinhu vyo munhu mubi, vihodanjikaga

no moto, nawo wuvinyanyaga sunga na vyono visigaye.

21 “Holeka agwe Jobu, yikunojeye wilamule no Mulungu,

wulece kumunoza nha mulugu wako.

Na hono mwilamule nayo, ale, nayo kokulugutiza.

22 Wubocele mejizo gakwe, wuzikamise ne zinghani zakwe

mu nhumbula yako.

23 Na mbeka, yikunojeye winenenyheze,

wumuwuyile Mulungu,

wagalecele lukulu mabi gose,

gono getumwa mu kaya yako.

24 Wuzigumilaje kutali zahabu zako,

ne zahabu yako nengu, wuyifucilize mwi'kolongo

lyono linyalile lisina malenga.

25 Hodu, wumulece Mulungu mono yali vilungo yawe yo

zahabu yako,

mwene yawe yo fweza yo wuguzi wukamu kul'gwe.

26 Wumwitumbile mwene nhondo zose,

yawe lye 'pece lye nyemo yako.

27 Nagwe lono wukumulomba, nayo kokupitula

kanyhi ho kosuma kukamisa no wilahize wono welahiza.

28 Nagwe baho nhondo, ho komoteswa mu milimo yako yose.

No wuzelu wokumulicila mu zinzila zako.

29 Hambi Mulungu nha kawanyetyaga i wedunhumuzi,

ninga kawaponyaga i wenenenyhezi.

30 Nayo mbeka, kokuponya hono wuwe wusina wusutye,

hono zono kwitumaga, ziwe zili ling'ani.”


Jobu 23

Mapitulo ga Jobu

1 Nayo Jobu yakapitula yakatya,

2 “Sunga i zuwali, nghani yangu yikali yikumhela

wusungu kuli Mulungu,

nane hamba si nosuma kunyamala wugule wangu yaye.

3 Nali nyende nimuwone, hono hoyuli,

niyimanye ne nzila yo kumuficila.

4 Nane ho ndolose zinghani zangu hali mwene,

nimulonjele ne soko yo wibombole wangu.

5 Nghuhila manye zono kolonga na vyono komhitula.

6 Ma! Mulungu, kokwisumaniza nane mu wuwaha we

vilungo vyakwe?

Aa, ng'o! Langa kohuliciza du zono nghulonga.

7 Ane nha nili ling'ani, holeka nosuma du

kuduwana no Mulungu.

Nayo kombona du vyono sina wusutye muli zose.

8 “Langa ta! Nondola kucilima, ninga Mulungu si yali kuko,

sunga na ku lubavu lwe mwezi, nako nimulondola, ninga

nako hamba si nimuwene yaye.

9 Kumbe mwene yakwituma kusumuka na kutakama,

ninga hamba nhavivyo, si nimuwene yaye.

10 Ninga hamba nhavivyo, Mulungu yazimanyile zinghanzo

zangu. Na hono yananje, kombona sina masutya.

11 Ane niyityatyaga ko wihuwilwa i nzila yakwe yono

yayihaguye, nghali hamba sinapatuka no kuyileka yaye.

12 Nane nhondo zose nitumaga zo wulajilize wo Mulungu,

nitumaga zo wuhile wakwe du.

13 Mwene si kapitukaga yaye, hamba hasina mono komwimila,

ho yalece kwituma nha vyono yendile mwene.

14 Nayo kozifisiliza zose zono yali yambiciye,

na nyinji zono zinha zizo, zose zili kwakwe,

15 nane nghucicima hali mwene.

16 Hambi Mulungu mono yali vilungo nha kayinyenyanga

nhumbula yangu.

17 Mulungu yo yakunyogofya, ninga si wutitu yaye.

Hamba wuwe wutitu wunoza 'ne ho ndece kuwona.”


Jobu 24

1 “Alu socici Mulungu yalihagula lipango lyo wuling'anizi,

lizuwa lyo wuling'anizwe, kuli wose wono wakumwitumamila?”

2 I Wanhu wendile kuteza mabwe ge mipaka,

ho weyonjelezeze yisi,

wakuhiza zingholo, wawa kuzijihila mu matewa gawo.

3 Wakusola zindogowe ze wana wono wasina walezi wawo,

no kusola nghongolo yo mucekulu mufwile, no kuyidindila,

sunga yaze yalipe mugawa wono yena nawo.

4 Wakuwemila waciwa, ho walece kutuga ling'ani yawo,

no kuwawinjiliza wono wena wanjile, wamanyhe wehundice.

5 Nawo waciwa, wawa wehwanile ndogowe za mu mbago,

wesacizaga ndigwa mu nyika.

Ninga hasina hanji hono wosuma kutuga ndigwa,

ku soko ye wana wawo.

6 Hanyuma wawa kududula mu migunda yono si yawo,

no kuhalaliza zabibu mu migunda ye wanhu wabi.

7 Na mu cilo, wagonaga wali cipwi wasina myenda,

wasina cinhu co kwifunika mu mbeho.

8 Wakutonyelwa ne mvula ya mu matunda,

wawa kwihundika mu mabwe ho wecite,

walece kutonyelwa ne mvula.

9 I wanhu wabi wakuwa kusola i wana wono wasina walezi,

wawa kuwanoza wawanda wawo,

wakuwasola ne wana wo munhu muciwa,

wakuwetumya milimo yawo, ninga hamba si

kuwalipa musahala wawo hamba kamonga yaye.

10 Na ku soko yiyo, wanhu waciwa wojenda

wasina myenda yo kuvwala,

nawo wakuwa wali nzala du na

mu mapango lono wakududula wuhemba.

11 Wakobongaga mizeyituni ho watuje mafuta,

kanyhi ne zi zabibu ho watuje divayi

ninga wene wakuwa vyo wali ne nyhilu.

12 Na mu makaya mukuwa mo wali wono wena nghomele

hamonga na wono wakulila wakufwa,

ninga Mulungu hamba si kawutondowozaga wulombe wawo.

13 “Ho wali wanhu wanji wono si wawendile

wuzelu hamba hadodo,

kono wukumulika.

14 Nayo munhu muwulaji,

yendile kwilawa hakali mitondo,

kawa kubita kumuwulaga muciwa,

na mu cilo kahizaga.

15 Nayo musenyha, kalindilaga sunga cinyamihe,

kolo wutitu-titu wenjila.

Kegubicizaga wusu wakwe,

ho yunji yalece kumumanya.

16 Nawo wahizi, wabenaga mu zinyumba ne cilo,

ninga kolo wela, wehundikaga wakogopa wuzelu.

17 Wawogopaga wuzelu ku misi,

ninga cilo si wacogopaga yaye.

18 “Ninga munhu mubi, kasolelezwaga ne lihwazi lye malenga,

no mugunda wakwe, wuwa wuli mu wulijitwe wo Mulungu,

nayo hamba si kosuma kanyhi kuwulima zabibu mugunda wuwo.

19 Nha vyono seluji yenjedukaga mwi'zuwa,

na mwi'pango lye cibahu yiwa kwajilila,

ale, nhavivyo no munhu mubi vyo kajililaga

mu yisi ye womi.

20 Na mwi'daha lilyo, hamba nyina si komukumbucila yaye.

Hambi nha kowa yaligwa ne mang'onyo,

yakondya kuhodanjika nho mubici wono wugwiye.

21 “Na zizo zomwijelela vyono kawatendelaga vibi

i wacekulu wafwile.

Hamba kuwawonela lusungu i wacekulu wagumba.

22 Ninga Mulungu nayo mu vilungo vyakwe,

kawongomezaga we vilungo.

Hambi Mulungu nha yo ketumaga,

no munhu mubi kawa kufwa.

23 Mulungu kamupelaga yekale yapolile,

ninga meso gakwe, galangaga zinzila zakwe.

24 Hambi u munhu mubi, nha kamotaga cidaha cidodo du,

ninga hanyuma yakusakala nhe mahanze,

yakuwa nhe liso lyo wuhemba lyono lyadudulwa.

25 Wule, ho yuli munhu mono kozitya zizi, si za mbeka?

Hamba ho yuli mono kosuma kutya vyono,

nghani zangu si za mbeka?


Jobu 25

Zinghani za Bilidadi

1 “Nayo Bilidadi Mushuhi yakapitula yakatya,

2 Mulungu yo we vilungo,

holeka yinojeye wose wamogope mwene.

Yo mulamuzi wa mu wutemi wa ku wulanga.

3 Wule, ho yuli munhu wo wose, mono kosuma kuwawala

wamalayika wose, wono wamwitumamilaga?

Hamba ho hali hanhu ho hose hono wuzelu

wo Mulungu si wumulikaga?

4 Hamba ho yuli yunji mono kowa ling'ani, hali Mulungu,

hamba mono yelile ha meso gakwe?

5 Wumanye nha vyono ha meso gakwe, sunga no mwezi

wose wusina wung'alale,

ne zinyelezi nazo si zelile hali mwene.

6 Alu waco, holeka munhu, mono yenha linyongololo, ling'onyo lilya?

Ho kowa yena cambuzici ha meso go Mulungu?”


Jobu 26

Mapitulo ga Jobu

1 “Ninga Jobu yakapitula yakatya,

2 Alu mwene mukumhela wutazici.

Ane no muciwa, munhu mono soceye nha nene!

3 Heya du, munonjela nghani swanu, mundajila ne mahala

genyu, ane no munhu mulele!

4 Alu mwene mukwihwesa nani lu mono kozihulika

zinghani zenyu lo?

Hamba nani mono kamupelenyi muhe wuwo

wo kulonjela zinghani zizi?”

(I vilungo vyo Mulungu)

5 Nayo Bilidadi yakapitula yakatya,

“Myuhe ya wono wafwa,

yikucicima mu malenga kusi ye'si.

6 Yisi ye wafu yili calinze hali Mulungu,

hamba ngula si zosuma kuyigubika ha meso gakwe.

7 Mulungu yo yawutandaza mwanya wa kusumuka,

yakayitumbika ne yinze mu mwanya.

8 Kanyhi yo Mulungu mweneco mono gakamemyaga

malenga mu mavunde

kanyhi kagebatilizaga ho galece kubahuka,

so wuzito we malenga gayo.

9 Kanyhi kawugubicizaga mwezi ne mavunde.

10 Katemanulaga wuzelu mu wutitu, mu nzila yo kuwika

mipaka, mucanyha ye malenga.

11 Nayo kolo yakugogofya masumbili

gono gebatilize wulanga,

hodu, gakogopa gawa kucicima ko woga wuwaha.

12 Na mu vilungo vyakwe, mo yalituziza lilenga,

na ko wunghula wakwe, yakalyongomeza lilimu

lya mu malenga lyono licemwaga ‘Lahabu.’

13 Na ko muhe wakwe du, wulanga wukela,

na ko muwoko wakwe, yaliwulaga lizoka lya

mu malenga lyono lyeponyaga.

14 Ninga awu wo wulolose wucefu du we vilungo vyakwe,

nase cihulika mapwepwe gayo.

Hamba nhavivyo, nani 'mbi mono kosuma kumanya mbeka

mbeka, zo wuwuha wo Mulungu vyono winha?”


Jobu 27

Mapitulo ga Jobu

1 Jobu yakapitula yakatya,

2 “Nane nghwilahiza mwi'tagwa lyo Mulungu, mono yali vilungo,

mono yambusiza ling'ani yangu,

no kumhela wusungu mu nhumbula yangu,

3 vyono, ane lono nghali Mulungu yamhelile wehele,

4 milomo yangu hamba si yolonga nghani yo yose 'mbi,

kanyhi no lulimi lwangu hamba si lolonga zo wulambi.

5 Nane hamba si nolonjela lukulu niwe kutya,

vyono anye mukuhosa kwe ling'ani, aa ng'o.

Langa ane nokangaza ze ling'ani yangu du, sunga

mwi'zuwa lyono nolofwila.

6 Nane nowibatiliza muno muno wiling'ano wangu

hamba si nowuleka ng'o hamba hadodo

ne ciselinji cangu hamba si cikuhosa yaye.

7 “Nawo wose wono wakuhoma no kwisumaniza nane,

yiwanojeye walipicizwe nhe wanhu wabi wono

si wali ling'ani.

8 Alu wawo wanhu wono si wamogopile Mulungu,

ho wena witumbiloci, kolo Mulungu yakuwusaka wumi wawo?

9 Na hono magayo gawagane, wukwihwesa 'mbi Mulungu

kowahulika cililo cawo?

10 Holeka yali yiwanojeye wawe wena nyhilu ye nyemo

yono Mulungu kalavyaga.

Kanyhi yali yiwanojeye wamulombe mapango gose.

11 Alu mulece nimwijizenyi zo wuwaha we

vilungo vyo Mulungu

nimulolosezenyi sunga ne mahweso go Mulungu

mono yali vilungo vyono genha.

12 Ninga hamba nhavivyo, si nghani yaye,

hambi nha mwakondya kwiwonelela nyo weneco.

Alu nhawule mukulonga nghani zo wulele?”

13 “Ale, nhavivi vyo Mulungu kawalipicizaga

i wanhu wabi, kanyhi wawulaji.

14 Wosuma kuwa na wana wenji we cilume

ninga wose wofwila ku wulugu.

Ne wana wawo walece kutuga ndigwa yono yikwiliye.

15 Na wono wosigala si wafwiye, ninga nawo wofwa ne

matamwa, sunga ne wagolece zawo wono wolekwa,

nawo hamba si wowalilila i wafu wawo.

16 Ne wanhu wabi, wadahile kuwa na fweza nyinji muno,

hamonga ne myenda minji si nhe wanhu wose.

17 Ninga munhu yunji we ling'ani,

yo koloyivwala myenda yiyo.

No munhu yunji u mwinenenyhezi,

yo koloyisola fweza yiyo.

18 I wanhu wabi, wazengaga zikaya zihwanile lipulaputya

hamba kotya cilingo co muwanda, co kwamilila migunda.

19 Na ha mudumo wawo, wogona nhe wagoli,

ninga kolo wakwinuka, wokwagana sawo yose hasina.

20 No woga wowaziza nhinicizo nhe lihwazi lye malenga.

Ne libeho lye cilo, lyowapemhelusiza kutali.

21 Nalyo libeho lya kucilima, lyowafwaguliziza

lukulu mu zikaya zawo.

22 Libeho lyolowapemhelusa lisina lusungu,

mwi'pango lyono wowa kujela kwiponya.

23 Ne libeho lilyo lyowapemhelusa, na lono wakumangha

wakutiza, lyowogofya muno ne vilungo vyalyo vyo wuwulaji.”


Jobu 28

Lukumyo kuli ze Mahala

1 “Heya, kolili yikweme lyo kuhimba fweza,

Ne hanhu ho kwenjedulila zahabu.”

2 Wanhu wahimbaga cuma mu'si hasi,

no kuyenjedula shaba ndunghu wulawa mu mabwe.

3 I wanhu wawulondolaga wutitu tuku, sunga wawuwona,

wasunjililaga sunjililaga, sunga kusi muno muno ye'si.

No kuhimba mabwe mu wutitu tuku.

4 Wakuhimba yikweme kutali no wikalo we wanhu,

i hanhu hono, hamba wanhu si wakolaga yaye.

Wanhu wakuhimba makombo masisili matali muno muno,

go kuhimbulila mabwe gago.

Wakwituma wali ciwene kuko,

wakwitundya ako na ako mu milejehe mumo mu makombo.

5 Na mu'si mumo, mo mulawaga ndigwa.

Na hasi ye'si, gademuce makalanzi,

genha nha gapiye no moto.

6 Na mu mabwe gayo, mo vili vibwe vyo wuguzi wukamu

vyono vina liwala lye dedede.

Kanyhi vina manghundi ga zahabu.

7 “Ne ndeje mhelembi, hamba si yoyimanya ne nzila yono

yibitile kuko.

Hamba liso lye limwewe, si liyiwene yaye.

8 Simba, hamba vilimu vikali, si vikolaga kuko yaye.

9 Wanhu wahimbaga mabwe makavu muno.

Wagahimbaga matunda, wagapitulanya ku wimo wayo.

10 Wahimbaga vikwelelezi mu mabwe mawaha.

Nawo wakutuga mumo mabwe go wuguzi wukamu.

11 Wahimbaga wakufisa sunga ko kusi kono kogali makolongo

no kucileta ku wuzelu cono cihundicigwe kuko.

12 “Ninga mahala, cosuma kugawona kwihi kwene?

Kanyhi hayi hene hono cosuma kwiyijiza wizuce?

13 Mahala hamba si gosuma kwijelela muli wanhu yaye,

hamba hasina munhu mono kosuma kucimanya cifo cayo.

14 Navyo visolo vye lilenga vitezaga, mahala si gali

muli'se yaye.

15 Mahala si gagulwaga kwa fweza hamba zahabu.

16 No wuswanu wose we zahabu nengu hamba vibwe vyo wuguzi

wukamu, cifo cayo si vyokwiling'anila ne cifo ce mahala.

17 Hambi mahala nha gena wuguzi wukamu muno sinha zahabu.

Kuciza ne ciya ca zahabu co kunejela malenga,

hamba cilole.

18 Cifo ce mahala, cicizize muno, si nha malijani,

hamba mabwe gono gakung'alala go wuguzi wukamu,

hamba alimasi.

19 Vibwe vyo wuguzi wukamu, hamba zahabu nengu

Hamba si kosuma kuvihwananiza ne cifo ce mahala.

20 “Mwene mahala galawaga hayi?

Nase, kwihi kwene kono cosuma kwiyijiza mahala?

21 Hasina ciwumbwa co cose cono cosuma kuhawona yaye.

Hamba ne zindeje zose du zono zikwanga mucanyha

si zosuma kuhawona yaye.

22 Hamba lifwa no wongomezwe, navyo vitezaga,

Nase zizo cizihulice du kwe makutu getu.

23 “Ninga Mulungu yali wene yo yamanyile nzila ye mahala,

kanyhi yahamanyile ne hanhu hono mahala gejelaga.

24 Hambi mwene nha yo kawonaga sunga ko ku

zimhelo ze'nze,

no kuwona zose hasi yo wulanga wose.

25 Lono Mulungu yayitemezezya mbeho vilungo vyayo,

no kuwika cijelo ce lilenga hanhu hayo.

26 Na lono yatemezya vipango vyo kutonya mvula.

No kuyiwika nzila yono gowa kukola mamuli ne madidimo.

27 Ale, baho ho yagawonela mahala no

kuwuwona wukamu wayo,

na ho baho yakawa kugakamya.

28 Nayo baho ho yakawa kumulonjela munhu yakatya,

‘Hono wusace wuwe ne mahala,

ale, yikunojeye weze ne cogopo kuli Muwaha Mulungu,

na hono wende wuwe no wizuce, ale, yikunojeye wulece

kwituma zo wubi.’ ”


Jobu 29

1 Jobu yakanza kulonga kanyhi yakatya,

2 “Woyi he! Nanda niwe nha mu myezi ye katali,

yiwe nha mu vilo vyono Mulungu yangolangolaga.

3 Lono Mulungu yali yali hamonga nane vilo vyose

yakamhela no wuzelu wakwe wumulicile mu wutitu,

4 Na mu vilo vivyo, vyali vyo vilo vyono nali motile,

no wendezwe wo Mulungu, wayidimaga kaya yangu.

5 Lulo Mulungu mono yali vilungo,

yali yali hamonga nane,

nane nali mhilimwe ne wanangu wose.

6 Zing'ombe zangu hamonga ne zimhene,

zamhelaga mele menji muno,

ne mibici yangu ye mizeyituni, yali yicindice

mu muhangha wono wina mabwe mabwe.

7 Na lono wawaha we likaya wehangulizaga,

nane nehangulizaga hamonga nawo.

8 Nawo i wazelelo lono wambonaga,

wehundikaga ha meso gangu.

Nawo wakombi wanyinucilaga kolo wakumbona,

wakulajila cogopo cawo kuli'ne.

9 Ne walongola we wanhu,

wanyamalaga kulonga kolo wambona.

10 Sunga ne wanhu wose watambule, wanyamalaga twii.

11 Ne wanhu wose wono wali wamanyile,

hamba wono wali wahulice zangu.

Wali wena nghani nyinji swanu zo kulonga,

za muli zono nene nitumile.

12 Hambi i waciwa lono wali wali mu wugaye,

nha nawatazaga,

Nawatazaga sunga ne wana wono wasina walezi wawo,

hamba ku wubito.

13 Ne wanhu wono wali wali mu wusungu wukali mu nhumbula

zawo, nawo wandugutiza.

Nghawapela wutazi wacekulu wafwile, mu wanjile wawo.

14 Netumaga ziswanu na ze ling'ani vilo vyose.

15 Nali nha meso kuli wabofu, ne magulu kuli we citewe.

16 Kuli waciwa nghawa nha nili sogo yawo

ne wajenzi nawo, nghawataza mu zinghani zawo.

17 Navibenanga vilungo vya wono si wali ling'ani,

nghawaponya na wono wagazwaga nawo.

18 “Nane nhondo zose,

nghawa nina witumbilo wo kwikala vilo vinji,

no kufwila mu kaya yangu mholile.

19 Nali ninhwanile mubici,

wono wikalaga wina malenga mu milela yayo.

Ne manhambi gayo madece so buhe.

20 Ne wanhu wose wanghumyaga,

ne vilungo vyangu hamba si vyacepuka yaye.

21 Na lono nawalonjelaga wanhu zinghani zangu,

wose wawezaga wahulicize muno,

kuli zono nghuwalonjela,

22 Nawo wawezaga wasina hamba nghani yinji,

kanyhi yo konjeleza zinghani zangu,

zawenjilaga muno mu zinhumbula zawo,

kotya mabanhi ga mvula.

23 Na wose wambocelaga nha vyono mulimi

kayibocelaga mvula mwi'fuku.

24 Nawalangaga na nyemo,

lono wali wasina witumbilo,

no wusangalavu wo wusu wangu,

wawapelaga witumbilo.

25 Nawahagulilaga nzila yawo,

nghawa muwaha wawo, nghawalongoza,

nha vyono mutemi kalongozaga wasilikale wakwe,

no kuwasindamika lono wakutuga wukatale.


Jobu 30

1 “Ninga lu, wono wali wadodo wangu, wakusekanga,

wono wasogo zawo nawabedegalaga, nghawa kuwawona

wehwanile ne mabwa gono gadimaga litewa lyangu.

2 Wali wenha nhe wanhu wono wakondya kusakala,

wasocele muno, wono si wadahile kunhaza mulimo wo wose,

3 Wali waciwa kanyhi wali nzala, wono wagugudaga milela

yono yinyalile ku cilo, mu mbago, hanhu ha ciwene.

4 Wakulaga zimboga za mu nyika wawa kulya.

Sunga ne milela yo muletemu, yono yisina ndaso.

5 Ne wanhu wose wawazozezaga wawa kuwawinjiliza,

nha vyono wanhu wawacenjelaga wahizi.

6 Wekalaga mu mhango, mu mhalika za mu mabwe mawaha.

7 Walilaga nhe malimu mu mbago,

wekongholelaga hamonga mu vititika.

8 Wo wana we walele, heya wo wana we

wanhu wono wasina litagwa,

wono wawingwa wulawa mu'si.

9 “Alu, wakuza wakusekanga, naweza yidawalilo lyawo.

10 Wakunhendela kwe'kuwo,

wene wakuwona nha wakunhendela viswanu,

wakuza wakufunyila mate mu wusu wangu.

11 Vyono Mulungu yakondya kumhela wusocele, sina wutazi,

holeka wakunyiziza ko wukali.

12 Wanhu awa, wakuhoma cidomile nawo,

kanyhi wakunghwenghweleza,

no kwinozeleza, ho wahungucile.

13 Wayihodanga nzila yangu, wakusaka wanyongomeze

na hasina munhu mono kosuma kuwemila.

14 Wakunyiziza nha wanhu wono wakukola mwi'dilisha ligazi,

wakuhungucila 'ne ho wanyongomeze.

15 Nane luno woga wuwaha wakondya kungwila,

no lukumyo lwangu lwapuluta, nha lupemheluswe ne mbeho.

No wumoteswe wangu wawembuka nhe mavunde.

16 “Alu nhondo neza kufwa, hambi wusungu wangu nha

si wukucepuka.

17 Mafupa gangu gose, nha gakutama muno ku cilo,

no wusungu wono wukubwanghula mu mafupa,

hamba si wukucepuka yaye.

18 Mulungu yanyonyile mu singo, ne kola yo musweko wangu.

Yakuyivuwanjiza ne myenda yangu, yiwuka na ku wuswanu.

19 Yanhaga kunze mu nhope, neza ninhe manghundi.

20 Gwe go Mulungu, ane nghukucemeleza, ninga hamba

si wukumhitula,

na lono nghukulomba, hamba si wukuhuliciza yaye.

21 Wukunhendela ko wukali, kanyhi wukuminjiliza

kwe vilungo vyako vyose.

22 Wukundeka, mbeho yimhemhelusize kutali,

wukunyinula no kumbika mucanyha yayo,

kuwa kungalagaza mwi'hwazi lye libeho.

23 Nane manyile nha vyono weza kundeta kwi'fwa lyangu.

I hanhu hono watemezezwa wanhu wose i womi.

24 “Alu socici wukumutowa munhu mono yakondya kuciwapa,

u munhu mono yasina co kunoza, langa kulomba lusungu du?

25 Gwe go Mulungu, wule, ane si nali kulilana na wono

wali mu wugaye,

no kuwakalalila wono wali mu wanjile?

26 Ane nalanjililaga nyemo no wuzelu, ninga nghazizwa

ne magayo no wutitu.

27 Mahwele no wusungu vyanhamisa, hambi nha nili mu

magazo vilo vyose.

28 Alu nawa njendelaga mu wutitu,

musina wuzelu we lizuwa.

Nghwima calinze mu mapuga ge wanhu,

nghulondola wutazi.

29 Ne lizi lyangu lyeza lya wukalale, kanyhi lya cinyhiwa

nhe cililo ce macewe ne nyacihema.

30 Ne nghuli yangu yatukuwala tuku, ku soko

ye mhungo yono nghutamwa

31 I katali nahulikaga mazi ge masumbi,

ninga aluno, nghuhulika mazi ga wono wakulila cililo.


Jobu 31

1 “Ane nehuwiza nha vyono si nomukomalila

lukulu meso muhinza ko kumusulumila.

2 Mwene mumanyile, nghanici yono Mulungu

mono yali vilungo kacitendelaga?

Kawalipaga wanhu yifunguci so masutya gawo?

3 Kaletaga wongomele no wuhodanjice kuli wetuma wubi wose.

4 Mulungu yazimanyile zose zono nitumaga,

no kuziwona nghanzo zangu.

5 Ane nelahiza nha vyono, si nokwitumila lukulu zimbi

hamba si nokwijelela kuwalonjela wanji zinghani zo wulambi.

6 Ale, Mulungu yanjele ne cijelo ce ling'ani,

nayo kowona vyono ane sina masutya.

7 Na hono niwe napatuka mu nzila ye ling'ani,

hamba neleceleza zimbi zikanghwega,

hamba mawoko gangu genamatila ne cinamha co wubi,

8 Hodu lece ndigwa zangu zihodanjice,

hamba wanji walye ndigwa yono hadice yose.

9 “Na hono niwe nakwegwa, nimusulumile mugolece wo muyangu,

nghawa nimulindiye nihundice ha mulango wakwe,

10 hodu, lece mugolece wangu nayo yamuvujile wugali

mulume yunji, kanyhi yagone nayo.

11 Wusocele we liwala lili, wunojeye wutuje

wulipicizwe we lifwa.

12 Wowa nho wuhodangwe no moto wono wuwiciywe

i wabeza Mulungu

wono wolovitakamiza vyangu vyose vyono nina navyo.

13 Na kolo yumonga wa muli wetumami wangu yakunghalalila,

nolomuhuliciza, nimutendele viswanu.

14 Na hono ndece kunoza nhavivyo,

alu ho nolosuma wule kumulanga Mulungu?

Nane ho nololongaci kolo Mulungu yakuza kuning'aniza ne?

15 Vyono Mulungu mono yamumba ane,

yo yamuwumba no mwitumami wangu.

16 “Ane nghali si nalema hamba kamonga, kumutaza munhu muciwa

hamba kuwaleka wacekulu wafwile wawe wekaye mu mahwele.

17 Hamba kuwaleka i wana wono wasina walezi,

wawe wali ne nzala,

lono ane nghulya nghwiguta.

18 Ninga 'ne niwalanjililaga mu mikalile yangu yose.

19 Na lono nawona yunji yali mu wanjile,

kanyhi muciwa muno,

si yakusuma hamba kwigulila myenda,

20 ane namupelaga myenda, mihonelwe wukunzeje we zingholo,

wono walawaga mu zingholo za mwi'tewa lyangu.

No munhu yuyo, kawa kunumbiliza ko mutima wakwe wose.

21 Na hono niwe nawakongaga i wana wono wasina walezi,

akuno nghwihwesa nha vyono nosuma ku calo,

22 hodu le, miwoko yangu yibenwe, yiwuswe mu mawega gangu.

23 Ninga ne vyono niwogopile wulipicize wo Mulungu,

holeka si nosumila lukulu kwituma zono zinha zizo.

24 “Ane si nali nitumbiliye lukulu wugoli,

25 hamba kwidunhumulila sawo yangu.

26 Hamba nghali si ninawuhemba wuzelu we lizuwa

hamba mwezi, mu wuswanu wayo wose.

27 Nghali hamba si napatuswa, ho nivipele cogopo mu

nzila yo kuwunonela muwoko wangu yaye.

28 No wubi we liwala lilyo, wulipicizwe wayo, lifwa,

hambi nha wukumukana Mulungu mono yali kucanyha.

29 “Nane nghali si ninawusangalalila wutamiswe we walugu

wangu, hamba lono wakwinjila mu magayo.

30 Hamba nghali si nenjila mwi'sutya lyo kuwalombela wafwe.

31 Ne wanhu wose wono wanyinhumilaga, wamanyile

nha vyono ane niwacemelaga wajenzi nhondo zose.

32 Niwacemeye sunga ne wajenda mihinzo wose mu kaya

yangu, nghali si nawaleka hamba hadodo

wagone caka mu nzila.

33 Kowali wanhu wanji,

wono wajelaga kuwuhundiciza wubi wawo,

ninga ane nghali si ninejelela

niwuhundicize wubi wangu.

34 Hamba si nghuwa kogopa zono wanhu wononga

nghali hamba si nejelela niwuhundicize wubi wangu.

35 Wule lu, ho yuli munhu mono yakuzihuliciza

zono nghulonga?

Nane nghwilahiza vyono,

zono nghulonga, zose za mbeka,

mulece Mulungu mono yali vilungo, yo yamhitule'ne.

Mhali wusonjezwe wono yakusonjeza musili wangu,

wuwe wandicigwe mu citabu, nane ho sume kuwusoma.

36 Nali niwuvwale ne nyono mu mawega gangu,

niwujelece mu mutwe wangu, niwuvwale nha mukumbo

37 Nane nali nimulonjele Mulungu zose zono netuma

akuno ninuye no mutwe wangu kucanyha ha mwande yakwe.

38 “Na hono niwe nahiza u mugunda wono nimaga,

no kuwusola kuli munghalaco,

39 na hono nayilya ne ndigwa yono yikalimwa mumo,

no kuwaleka wanghalaco wafwe ne nzala,

40 ale, wuhemba wulece kucindika, hamba shayili,

langa maselegwa go gacindice mumo, hamonga no mubici

wo mufuku.”

Ne zinghani za Jobu ho zamalicila.


Jobu 32

Zinghani za Elihu

(32:1–37:24)

1 Alu vyono Jobu yali yali ling'ani ha meso gakwe mweneco, ku soko yiyo, wawalya wanhu wadatu Elifazi, Bilidadi na Zofali, nawo siwamupitula Jobu kanyhi yaye.
2 Ninga munhu yunji mono yali yali baho litagwa lyakwe Elihu, u mwana wa Balakeli u mwana wa Buzi, we mhuga ya Lamu, yakakolwa likuwo, vyono Jobu yewonaga yali ling'ani mweneco, no kumuhosa Mulungu.
3 Kanyhi yakawakolelwa likuwo sunga na wa walya wendece wa Jobu wadatu. Vyono si wasuma kutuga nzila yo kumutaza Jobu, ne nghani yiyo, yikalajila nha vyono kotya u Mulungu yo musutyi.
4 Alu vyono Elihu yali yo mudodo muli wene wose, holeka yalindila du sunga wene wose wamale wulonje wawo.
5 Nayo yali yeza kuwona nha vyono wa walya wanhu wadatu, weza wasina kanyhi nghani zo kumulonjela Jobu, mwene yakakolwa ne likuwo muno.
6 Yakawa kwanza nayo kulonga yakatya,

“Ane heya nili mwana mudodo,

nanye muli wanhu mututu,

na ku soko yiyo, holeka nane nali kogopa

kumulonjelenyi ze mahweso gangu.

7 Niwa kwihwesa vyono, anye yo nyenye mono

munojeye mulonje, vyono nyenye mo wanhu mututu,

munojeye mwitaze mahweso genyu.

8 Ninga mumanye, vyono, wo muhe wo Mulungu du mono yali

vilungo, yo kawazizaga wanhu no kuwapela mahala.

9 Ninga si wukombi yaye, wo wuwapelaga wanhu mahala.

Hamba kuwapela wumanye wo kumanya vyono wali ling'ani.

10 Holeka luno nghumulombenyi,

muhulicize zono nghuzilonga,

mulece nimulonjelenyi nane ze mahweso gangu.

11 Ane nali hulicize du ko wukangalizi zose zono

mwali kulonga, nali nindiye du,

lono mwali kutikula-tikula zono molonga.

12 Nane nimuhulicizenyi viswanu, ninga mbona vyono, wose

mwalemwa kumupitula Jobu kuli zono yalonjile.

13 Alu ho mosuma nhawule mutye vyono mahala mwagawona?

Hambi Mulungu nha yo yali yanojeye yamupitule Jobu,

hambi anye nha mwakondya kulemwa.

14 Ninga hamba nhavivyo, Jobu yali kulongana nanye,

ninga si yali kulongana na nene yaye,

holeka sinomupitula nha vyono

anye mumupituye.

15 “Alu Jobu, wayago zinghani zawalemela,

wasina kanyhi hamba yo kukupitula.

16 Hambi nane lu, nojendelela kunyamala,

lono wene wakali wanyamaye?

Hambi nha wanyamala wasina kanyhi yono wolonga.

17 Aa, ng'o, ane langa aluno nokulonjela zono nghwihwesa,

ho nghupele lipitulo lyangu nane.

18 Hambi nha si nosuma kulindila kulonga

vyono si nosuma kuzigomoleza zinghani zangu yaye.

19 Na hono ndece kutuga cilejeho co kulonga,

mbeka nobahuka nho mufuko we nyhingo,

wono wumemile divayi mhya.

20 Nane hamba si nosuma kukangalila,

langa sunga nonje du.

21 Nane mu zinghani zizi,

hamba si nosuma kwima ku lubavu lwa yunji yaye,

hamba kwiyendeza kuli munhu wo wose.

22 Ane wiyendezi si niwumanyile yaye

na mhali nili nhavivyo u Mulungu yali yanyongomeze.


Jobu 33

1 “Alu Jobu, nghukunena, wuhulicizaje viswanu,

muli zose zono nghusaka nghulonjele.

2 Ane lu nghusaka nonje zono zili mu nhumbula yangu.

3 Ne zinghani zangu zose nozilonga na nhumbula nzelu,

nane nghulonga nghani za mbeka.

4 U muhe wo Mulungu wo wamumba no kumhela wumi.

5 Alu wumhitulaje hono kosuma, hono wina

zo kulongana nane.

6 Hambi ase wose nha cili wamonga du ha

mwande yo Mulungu,

hambi ase wose nha cawumbilwa mwi'longo.

7 Holeka wulece kunyogopa, ane si nokunoza cinji yaye.

8 Nane mu wulonje wako, nghuhulika vyono wali kulonga,

9 wukutya, ‘Ane nili ling'ani, sina wusutye,

si nahodanga cinji, hamba wubi muli 'ne musina.

10 Langa Mulungu yo kawonaga zi soko zo kuhosa'ne

yakunhendela nha nili mulugu wakwe.

11 Kagawopaga magulu gangu ne manyolo,

kazigozaga zinzila zangu zose.’

12 “Ninga'ne nghukulonjela Jobu vyono, agwe wuli musutyi.

Soko Mulungu muwaha, yacizize munhu wo wose.

13 Holeka lu, socici 'gwe wukwisumaniza nayo?

Mwene nha si kapitulaga hamba hadodo,

mang'ung'uliko go munhu.

14 Hamba yiwe Mulungu kalongaga kenji na kenji

ne wanhu wakwe,

ninga hasina hamba monga,

mono yakumuhulika zono yakulonga.

15 Na mu cilo lono wanhu wagona nhongo,

mwene kalongaga nawo mu nzila ye zindoto no wugubulilwe.

16 Kawanozaga ho wazihulice zono yakulonga,

ninga wene wogofywaga ne zinghani zakwe.

17 Mulungu kalongaga nawo, ho yawawusize wanhu wuhile wawo

wubi, no kuwawusa mu wusisi wawo.

18 Si kowaleceleza wongomezwe, langa kawaponyaga mwi'fwa.

19 Mulungu kamufundilaga munhu mu nzila ye matamwa,

no wisumanize wo wusungu wa mu muwili wakwe.

20 Nayo munhu mutamwa, nzala yakwe yifwizaga,

no mutima wakwe si wusakaga ndigwa,

hamba yiwe swanu muno.

21 No muwili wakwe wukuganda, kosuma

kuwona ne mafupa gakwe,

22 nayo kawa yali behi no kubita ku yisi ye wafu.

23 Na yumonga wa muli wamalayika maelufu wo Mulungu,

lunji kokuza yamutaze, mono kawakumbucizaga wanhu

zono ziwanojeye wetume.

24 Nayo malayika kolonga ko lusungu yatye,

‘Mumulekaje ayu!

Hambi nha si yimunojeye mwene yabite ku yisi ye wafu.

Awu wo wukombozi wo kumukomboza.’

25 No muwili wakwe wowuya ku wudodo, no

kuwa ne vilungo kanyhi.

26 Nayo nhondo kolo yakumulomba Mulungu,

nayo Mulungu komupitula, nayo komuhemba Mulungu na nyemo.

Mulungu nayo kozinoza zakwe zose ziwe mugoloka.

27 Nayo ho kolonjela mwi'puga lye wanhu yawe kutya,

‘Ane nili mubi, ninga Mulungu kambonela lusungu du,

hambe ane si netuma ze ling'ani yaye.

28 Yakondya kunghomboza, ho ndece kubita ku yisi ye wafu,

nalu nghali nili mumi.’

29 “Mulungu ketumaga zizi vilo vyose,

30 kaponyaga wumi wo munhu,

no kumupela ne nyemo mu mikalile yakwe.

31 Holeka Jobu, alu wuhulicizaje zono nghulonga,

alu wituzaje wuhulicize.

32 Ninga hono wuwe wina yinji yo kulonga,

ale lonje, nane nokuhuliciza, ku soko nyendile

kukuwala wuli ling'ani.

33 Na hono wuwe wusina yo kulonga,

ale wunyamale twii wuhulicize nane nokwijiza ze Mahala.”


Jobu 34

1 Elihu yakajendelela kulonga yakatya,

2 “Hambi anye nyo wanhu nha muli we mahala no wumanye,

Holeka luno muhulicize nane zono nghulonga,

3 Hambi likutu nha lijelaga zinghani,

Ndigwa swanu yimanyikaga lono wukuyijeza.

4 Ninga yo nghani yetu co weneco, kuhagula cono cili ling'ani.

5 Mwene Jobu yakwiyitya vyono yali ling'ani,

ninga Mulungu, yakulema kumuwala vyono yali ling'ani.”

6 Kanyhi yakutya, “Alu ho nosuma nhawule kulonga zo

wulambi, niwe kutya ane nili musutyi?

Heya natuga nghomele, ninga si nahodanga cinji yaye.”

7 Ati wayangu, muwene munhu yunji mono yenha yuyu Jobu?

Hambi nha si yakulajila cogopo hali Mulungu.

8 Yehwanile ne wetuma zimbi, kajendanaga ne wabi.

9 Hambi mwene nha yakutya, vyono hasina cambuzi co cose

mu wituma wuhile wo Mulungu.

10 “Holeka muhulicize anye nyo wanhu wo wizuce!

Mukwihwesa Mulungu mono yali vilungo, kokwituma zo wubi?

11 Mwene kawatendelaga wanhu mu nghango ye metumo gawo,

no kuwalipa mu nghango nha vyono wanojeye.

12 Na mbeka, Mulungu mono yali vilungo hamba

sikahodangaga yaye,

no wuling'anizi wakwe, wo we ling'ani kuli wanhu wose.

13 Hambi Mulungu kabocelaga vilungo ku wulawa kuli

munhu yunji wo wose 'mbi?

Hamba hoyuli yunji mono yamupela Mulungu mulimo wo

kuyidima yinze lo?

14 Na hono Mulungu yali yawuse muhe wo mwehelo,

15 Wanhu wose wali wafwe wawuye kanyhi mu mangundi.

16 “Alu muhulicizaje, hono muwe mwina mahala.

17 Alu anye hongo, mukumuhosa Mulungu we ling'ani?

Mukwihwesa vyono mwene si yendile ling'ani?

18 Mwene Mulungu kawaling'anizaga watemi

hamonga ne walongola,

lono weza wasina cambuzi, kanyhi wakwituma zo wubi.

19 Mwene si kawahijilaga mbejele i walongola,

hamba si yakuwawona wagoli wawe wo waswanu

si nhe waciwa, hambi mwene nha yo yawawumba wose.

20 No munhu kosuma kufwa nhinicizo ne cilo.

Hambi Mulungu nha kawatowaga wanhu wajilila

na we vilungo kawawulagaga.

21 “Hambi meso gakwe nha galangaga zinzila ze wanhu

22 Hasina wutitu tuku, wono wosuma kumuhundiciza

munya wubi hali Mulungu.
