23 Nghwajilila nho mubeho we cinyamihe,

kanyhi nghupemheluswa nhe zinzije.

24 Sunga ne mafugamilo gangu nhondo gatimba,

ku soko yo wuwula kulya ndigwa,

alu nhondo nasigala nghuli ne mafupa.

25 Nawa nili munhu wa kusekwa hali wanhu,

na lono wakumbona, wakumbedegala,

no kusinjisa mitwe yawo.

26 Holeka wunhaze 'gwe go Muwaha Mulungu,

go Mulungu wangu, wumhonye,

mu nghango yo lusungu lwako.

27 Wuwamanyize walugu wangu,

vyono yo gwegwe du mono kumhonyaga,

na vyono yo gwegwe du,

go Muwaha Mulungu mono witumile zizo.

28 Ale, walekaje du wene walijite,

ninga agwe wundugutize,

wawo wono wakunzumhila bwete ho wakozwe cevu,

ninga ane langa no mwitumami wako, ho sangalale.

29 Walugu wangu wavwikwe cevu,

wefunice cevu cawo weneco nhe bulanjeti.

30 Nane nomulumba Muwaha Mulungu,

kwe 'zi yiwaha, kanyhi nomukumizya,

mwipuga yiwaha lye wanhu,

31 hambi mwene nha kawatetelaga waciwa,

kanyhi kamuponyaga kuli walya,

wono wakumuling'aniza yafwe.


Zabuli 110

Muwaha Mulungu no mutemi wakwe muhagulwa

1 Muwaha Mulungu yakamutya muwaha wangu mutemi,

“Wikale ku muwoko wangu wo kulume,

sunga kolo nawanoza i walugu wako,

wawe cibawo co wusambo we migulu yako.”

2 Hambi Muwaha Mulungu nha kotandaza,

vilungo vyako wulawilila ku Sayuni,

yakutya, “Ale wuwatemaje walugu wako!”

3 Nawo wanhu wako wokwilavya weneco,

ko mutima muzelu,

mwizuwa lyo kuwahoma no kuwasuma walugu wako.

Nha vyono yinha buhe ya hakali mitondo, ale,

nhavivyo ne wazelelo wako,

nawo, vyo wolokuziza gwegwe, mu matunda gono gelile.

4 Muwaha Mulungu yelahiza,

holeka hamba si kowukawaniziza,

lukulu wuhile wakwe,

“Agwe kowa wuli mukohani cibitilila,

ku luto lo wukohani wa Melikizedeki.”

5 U Muwaha Mulungu yali lubavu lwako lo kulume,

nayo kolo yakukolwa likuwo, kowapondanjiza watemi.

6 Kogaling'aniza makungugo,

no kuwawulaga wanhu wenji muno,

kowapondanjiza i walongola hanhu,

hose mono'nze yose.

7 Na mu nzila, u mutemi kong'wa malenga,

ga mu cikolongo, holeka kokwilumba so wusume.


Zabuli 111

Kumukumya Muwaha Mulungu

1 Muwaha Mulungu yalumbwe!

Nomulumba Muwaha Mulungu,

kwe nhumbula yangu yose,

mu wihangulize we wanhu wakwe we ling'ani.

2 Metumo go Muwaha Mulungu,

nha ga wizine muno muno!

Na wose wono wakugasangalalila,

wakusaka wagamanye viswanu.

3 Hambi co cose cono ketumaga,

nha cimemile lukumyo no wutemi.

Ne ling'ani yakwe, yikalaga cibitilila.

4 Muwaha Mulungu nha kacikumbucizaga,

ze metumo gakwe go wizine,

Muwaha Mulungu muswanu, kanyhi yali lusungu.

5 Mwene kawalisaga wono wamogopile mwene,

hamba si kacisemwaga cilagane cakwe yaye.

6 Kawalajila wanhu wakwe vilungo vyakwe,

ko kuwapela zi'si ze makungugo ganji.

7 Metumo gakwe ga ling'ani, kanyhi ga mbeka.

Ne mejizo gakwe gose nha mehuwilwa nhondo zose.

8 Ne malajilizo gakwe,

gekalaga cibitilila ne cibitilila.

Nago galavizwa mu mbeka na mu wiling'ano.

9 Mwene yawakomboza wanhu wakwe,

kanyhi yakanoza cilagane nawo ce cibitilila.

Mwene yelile, kanyhi wa kogofya muno muno.

10 Holeka mu wumogopa Muwaha Mulungu,

wo musinji we mahala gose,

nawo wose wono wakugebata malajilizo gakwe,

wo wawo wono wakupegwa wizuce.

No lukumyo lwakwe lwikalaga cibitilila.


Zabuli 112

I nyemo yo munhu muswanu

1 Muwaha Mulungu yalumbwe!

Yo mumoti munhu mono yamogopile Muwaha Mulungu,

mono yakusangalalila kugebata malajilizo gakwe.

2 No lulelo lwakwe lowa ne vilungo kononze,

ne wanagwe nawo wolugutizwa.

3 Ne mhuga yakwe wowa wagoli nayo,

kowa yamotile nhondo zose.

4 Wuzelu wuwamulicilaga mu wutitu,

i wanhu waswanu, heya,

wanhu wono wali lusungu,

hambi Muwaha Mulungu,

nha yali lusungu kanyhi mupolo,

kanyhi yali ling'ani.

5 Yo mumoti u munhu mucemezi,

mono kakopeshaga hamba kusaka cambuzi,

mono ketumilaga milimo yakwe mu ling'ani.

6 Nayo we ling'ani hamba si kosumwa yaye,

langa kokumbucilwa nhondo zose.

7 Na hono yaganwe na nghani 'mbi,

hamba si kokogopa yaye,

hambi nhumbula yakwe nha yikamile,

kanyhi yimwitumbilaga Muwaha Mulungu.

8 Yakuwa yasina mahwele,

hamba si yakogopa yaye,

hambi nha yamanyiye lukulu,

vyono walugu wakwe wosumwa.

9 Kalavyaga ko wuswanu, kawapelaga bwete waciwa,

no wuswanu wakwe, wikalaga cibitilila.

No munhu we liwala lilyo, kolumbwa cibitilila.

10 Ninga i wabi waziwonaga zizo wawa kusimba,

wawa kugwezula meno gawo, ko lusulo no kwajilila,

witumbilo wawo, hodu wahodanjika.


Zabuli 113

Kumukumya Mulungu so waswanu wakwe

1 Muwaha Mulungu yalumbwe!

Anye nyo wetumami wo Muwaha Mulungu,

likumyenyi litagwa lyo Muwaha Mulungu!

2 Litagwa lyakwe lyeze kukumywa,

ku wulawa lulu, sunga ko ku cibitilila.

3 Litagwa lyo Muwaha Mulungu,

lijendelele kukumywa,

ku wulawa kucilima, sunga ko kumwezi!

4 Hambi Muwaha Mulungu,

nha yo yatemile makungugo gose,

no lukumyo lwakwe luli kucanyha yo wulanga wose.

5 Hambi nani kanyhi, mono kowa yehwanile,

no Muwaha Mulungu, u Mulungu wetu?

Mwene nha yekaye mwigoda lyo wutemi kucanyha,

6 hamba nhavivyo,

kekalaga yalanjile za hono hasi, heya,

kazilangaga wulanga ne yinze.

7 Mwene kamwinulizaga muciwa,

ku wulawa mu manghundi.

Kanyhi kamunyasulizaga muciwa,

ku wulawa mu wosocele wakwe,

8 hanyuma kawa kumwikaza,

hamonga ne wawaha, heya,

hamonga ne wawaha we wanhu wakwe.

9 Mwene kanyhi kamupelaga,

lilumbo mucekulu mono si kalelaga,

kamusangalazaga ko kumupela wana.

Muwaha Mulungu yalumbwe!


Zabuli 114

Lwimbo lwe Pasaka

1 Lono Isilayeli yawucila ku Misili,

i wana wa Yakobo,

lono wawucila mu yisi yo wujenzi,

2 Yuda wukawa wikalo wono

welile wo Mulungu,

Isilayeli yakawa sawo yakwe mweneco Mulungu.

3 Lilenga lya Shamu lyaziwona zizo,

likawa kutiza,

likolongo lya Yoludani nalyo,

likaleka kuhuluma!

4 Ne matunda nago,

gakazumhazumha nha nduwilu,

vigongo navyo,

vikazumhazumha nhe zinyana ze zingholo.

5 Alu 'gwe go lilenga,

ho yikawa wule, nagwe wukatiza?

Nagwe, go likolongo lya Yoludani,

nhawule lo nagwe wukaleka kuhuluma?

6 Nanye mo matunda, nhawulenyi

mukawa kuzumhazumha nha nduwilu?

Nanye ma mo vigongo,

nhawulenyi mukawa kuzumhazumha,

nhe zinyana ze zingholo?

7 Holeka 'lu agwe go yinze,

wucicime hali Muwaha Mulungu,

heya, hali Mulungu wa Yakobo,

8 mono kalipamizaga du litalawe,

nalyo liwa yilamba lya malenga,

ne mabwe makavu gawa mivwilo ya malenga.


Zabuli 115

Mulungu yumonga du we mbeka

1 Kuli'gwe go Muwaha Mulungu wuli wene,

yo si sese,

langa yo gwegwe du wuli wene,

mono wunojeye lukumyo,

ku soko yo lusungu lwako,

no wihuwilwa wako.

2 Ku sokoci makungugo gakuciwuza gakutya,

“Alu Mulungu wenyu yali hayi?”

3 Mulungu wetu'se, yali ku wulanga,

nayo mwene ketumaga zose,

nha vyono yendile mweneco.

4 I milungu yawo nha ya fweza na zahabu du,

yono yinozigwe ne miwoko ye wanhu.

5 Yina milomo, ninga hamba si yikulonga bwete,

yina meso, ninga hamba si yikuwona yaye,

6 sunga ne makutu yina nago,

ninga hamba si yikuhulika ng'o,

ne zimhula zose yina nazo,

ninga hamba si yihevyaga,

munungho wa cinji co cose yaye,

7 'gwe, sunga ne miwoko yose yina nayo,

ninga si yisumaga hamba no kwalabata bwete du,

ati sunga ne magulu gose yina nago,

ninga hamba si yikusuma kujenda yaye.

Si yikusumila lukulu hamba kulavya yizi du kose.

8 Holeka na wose wono wayitumbilaga milungu yiyo,

nawo wehwanile nha yeneco, heya,

sunga na wose wono wayihuwiye milungu yiyo.

9 Nye nyo Isilayeli,

mwitumbilenyi Muwaha Mulungu,

mwene yo mutazi wenyu,

kanyhi yo ngula yenyu.

10 Nanye mo wana wa Haluni,

mwitumbilenyi Muwaha Mulungu,

mwene yo mutazi wenyu,

kanyhi yo ngula yenyu.

11 Anye nanye mono mumogopile Muwaha Mulungu,

mwitumbilenyi Muwaha Mulungu mwene,

yo mutazi wenyu, kanyhi yo ngula yenyu.

12 Mwene Muwaha Mulungu, yacikumbuciye du,

kanyhi kocilugutiza, kowalugutiza Waisilayeli,

kowalugutiza wana wa Haluni.

13 Mulungu kowalugutiza wose wono wamogopile,

kowalugutiza wawaha sunga ne wadodo.

14 Muwaha Mulungu yacile kumonjelezenyi wana,

anye mo weneco, sunga ne wana wenyu!

15 Ale, Muwaha Mulungu yamulugutizenyi,

mono yawumba wulanga ne yinze.

16 Wulanga wose, yo sawo yo Muwaha Mulungu,

langa yinze, yakawapela wanhu.

17 Kanyhi wafu, si wamukumyaga Muwaha Mulungu,

hamba wo wose yulya, mono yakondya kubita ku yisi ye wafu,

18 Langa sese du mono cili womi,

yo comukumya Muwaha Mulungu,

ku wulawilila lulu baha,

sunga ku cibitilila.

Muwaha Mulungu yalumbwe!


Zabuli 116

Lilumbo lyo munhu ku soko yo wuponywa mwi'fwa

1 Ane nimwendile Muwaha Mulungu,

hambi nha kahulikaga,

hambi nha kahuliciza cililo co wulombe wangu.

2 Mwene nha kahulicizaga lono nghumulilila.

3 Zimbali ze lifwa zali zimhilime,

no wogofywe we citenjelo wukanyibata,

nghawa no wugazice hamonga no wukalale.

4 Holeka nghamulilila Muwaha Mulungu nghatya,

“Gwe go Muwaha Mulungu, nghunena wumhonye!”

5 Muwaha Mulungu yo munghala wuswanu wose,

no wihuwilwa, Mulungu wetu,

yo Mulungu wo lusungu.

6 Muwaha Mulungu kawakamisaga,

wono wasina wutazi,

hambi nha lono nali nili mu mbali,

mwene yamhonya.

7 Holeka go nhumbula yangu, wutule muli'ne,

hambi Muwaha Mulungu nha kanhendela ziswanu.

8 Kamhonya mwi'fwa, kagapata ne mahozi gangu,

yakawa kundima ho ndece kanyhi kugwa mu musutye.

9 Holeka nane lu,

nowa kujenda hali Muwaha Mulungu,

mu yisi ye wanhu womi.

10 Nghawa nihuwiye du,

sunga lono nalongaga nghutya,

“Alu langa ane, nhondo neza kwajilila.”

11 Nhondo sunga nghawa kulonga ko woga nghutya,

“Mbeka wanhu hamba si wehuwilwa yaye.”

12 Alu nomugomolela ci cici Muwaha Mulungu,

ku soko ye ziswanu zose zono yanhendeye?

13 Nomulavizya Muwaha Mulungu cilavywa ca divayi,

nimulumbe ku soko ye mhonelo yono yamhonizye.

14 Nomufisiliziza Muwaha Mulungu vipingo vyangu,

ha mwande ye likungugo lyakwe lyose.

15 Muwaha Mulungu kawukalalilaga muno muno,

wufwe wa wono wali ling'ani,

16 Gwe go Muwaha Mulungu, ane nili mwitumami wako,

nili mwitumami wako du nha vyono yenha yaya.

Nagwe wukanoza nghawa mwelecele.

17 Holeka nane lu,

nokulavizya likumbiko lyo wulumbe,

kanyhi nowa nghogopile muno muno.

18 Nane nokufisiliziza zose,

zono nehuwiza, go Muwaha Mulungu,

ha mwande ye likungugo lyako lyose,

19 kuko ku Yelusalemi mu Nyumba yako.

Muwaha Mulungu yalumbwe!


Zabuli 117

Kumukumya Mulungu

1 Nye nyo nghungugo zose,

mukumyenyi Muwaha Mulungu!

Nanye nyo wanhu wose mukumyenyi!

2 Hambi lusungu lwakwe kuli'se nha lwinji muno,

no wihuwilwa wakwe nawo, wikalaga cibitilila!

Muwaha Mulungu yalumbwe!


Zabuli 118

Lilombo lyo wulumbe so wusume

1 Mulumbenyi Muwaha Mulungu,

hambi nha muswanu.

No lusungu lwakwe nha lwikalaga cibitilila.

2 Wanhu wa Isilayeli walonje watye,

“Lusungu lwakwe lwikalaga cibitilila.”

3 Nawo Wakohani wo Mulungu walonje watye,

“Lusungu lwakwe lwikalaga cibitilila.”

4 Na wose wono wamogopilo Muwaha Mulungu,

nawo walonje watye,

“Lusungu lwakwe lwikalaga cibitilila.”

5 Nane mu wugaye wangu,

nghamulilila Muwaha Mulungu,

nayo yakahulika, yakamhonya.

6 Muwaha Mulungu, yali hamonga nane,

holeka nane si nghogopa cinji co cose,

hambi munhu konoza cici?

7 Muwaha Mulungu yali hamonga nane,

nayo yo yakunhaza,

holeka nowawona walugu wangu wakusumwa.

8 Yili ciba kumwitumbila Muwaha Mulungu,

sinha kumwitumbila munhu.

9 Yili ciba kumwitumbila Muwaha Mulungu,

sinha kuwetumbila walongola we yinze yiyi.

10 Walugu wenji wali wamhilime,

ninga nghawapondanjiziza wose,

mwi'tagwa lyo Muwaha Mulungu.

11 Wali wamhilime mbavu zose,

ninga nane nghawapondanjiza wose,

kwe vilungo vyo Muwaha Mulungu.

12 Wakahungucila ko winji kotya nzuci,

ninga wakatakamila wose,

nhe cititika mu moto,

nane nghawapondanjiza wose,

kwe vilungo vyo Muwaha Mulungu.

13 Wakanzumhila, sunga nghawa nili behi,

no kusumwa nawo,

ninga Muwaha Mulungu yakanhaza.

14 Mbeka Muwaha Mulungu,

yo kamhelaga vilungo no wusume,

yo mweneco du mono yamhonizye.

15 Ale, hulicizenyi ta mazi,

ge nyemo no wusume gono gakulawa,

mu mahema ge wanhu wo Mulungu, gakutya,

“Vilungo vyo Muwaha Mulungu,

vyo vitumile zizi!

16 Vilungo vyo Muwaha Mulungu,

vyo viletile wusume wo wulugu,

Vilungo vyo Muwaha Mulungu yali wene,

vyo vitumile zizi!”

17 Ane si nofwa yaye, langa nowumipa,

nane nozanza ze metumo mawaha,

go Muwaha Mulungu.

18 Muwaha Mulungu kandipiciza muno muno,

ninga si yandeceleze nifwe.

19 Ndigulilenyi milango ye Nyumba yo Mulungu,

nane nokwinjila, nimulumbe Muwaha Mulungu!

20 Awu wo mulango wo Muwaha Mulungu,

wono wadahile kuwukolela we ling'ani.

21 Gwe go Muwaha Mulungu,

nghukulumba vyono wuhulicize,

hambi nha yo gwegwe du mono wumheye wusume.

22 Libwe lyono walilema wazenji,

lyo lyeza yibwe liwaha lyo musinji.

23 Nayo Muwaha Mulungu,

yo yetumile nghani yiyino,

nayo yo nghani yo wizine muno muno kuli'se.

24 Ali lyo lizuwa lyo wusume wo Muwaha Mulungu,

holeka cisecelele kanyhi cisangalale.

25 Wuciponye, 'gwe go Muwaha Mulungu wuciponye!

Gwe go Muwaha Mulungu cikukunena wucipele wumoteswe!

26 Yalugutwe yuyo mono yakuziza,

mwi'tagwa lyo Muwaha Mulungu!

Nase cikumulombelenyi wumoteswe,

ku wulawa mu Nyumba yo Muwaha Mulungu.

27 Muwaha Mulungu, yo Mulungu du yali wene,

nayo kacimulicilaga mu wuswanu.

Holeka ale mwibataje manhambi,

mu miwoko yenyu, musangalale,

mujendele hamonga sunga ko ku cikumbicilo.

28 Agwe yo gwegwe Mulungu wangu,

nane nghukulumba,

kanyhi nokwanza zo wuwaha wako.

29 Mulumbenyi Muwaha Mulungu,

hambi nha muswanu,

no lusungu lwakwe nha lwikalaga cibitilila.


Zabuli 119

Wulajilize wo Muwaha Mulungu

1 Wamoti wono wena mikalile,

yono yisina masutya,

wono webate wulajilize wo Muwaha Mulungu.

2 Wamoti wono wetumaga zo wuhile wo Mulungu,

wono wamuhulicile kwe zinhumbula zawo zose,

3 wono si wetumaga zo wubi yaye,

langa wene watyatyaga,

zo wutonji wakwe nhondo zose.

4 Gwe go Muwaha Mulungu,

wacijiza ze mejizo gako,

ho cigebate ko wihuwilwa muno.

5 Yali yiwe yili ciba le,

hono mikalile yangu yali yisikame,

mu wibata zo wutonji wako!

6 Na hono mbeka nigakamise malajilizo gako,

mbeka si nokozwa cevu yaye.

7 Nane nokukumya kwe nhumbula ye cogopo,

hono niyijize ze ning'aniza yako ye ling'ani.

8 Ane nowutyatya du wutonji wako,

holeka wulece kundeka nili wene yaye.

Cihuliko ca kuli zo wulajilize wo Muwaha Mulungu

9 Alu muzelelo kosuma nhawule,

kuyinozeleza mikalile yakwe?

Langa mu wibata malajilizo gako du.

10 Nghusimbilila muno nghuhulice,

kwe nhumbula yangu yose,

holeka nagwe wulece kundeceleza,

mbene malajilizo gako.

11 Nibate lilajilizo lyako,

mu nhumbula yangu,

ho ndece kukusutizya.

12 Lukumyo lweze kuli'gwe go Muwaha Mulungu!

Wunyijize ze nzila yako.

13 Nane nozanza kwe'zi yiwaha muno,

ze malajilizo gako gose gono wawika.

14 Nane sangalaye muno,

so wutyatya zo wuhile wako,

si nho kuwa no wugoli winji.

15 Nihwesaga du ze mejizo gako,

no kugakamisa malajilizo gako.

16 Nghuwusangalalila muno wutonji wako,

holeka si nolisemwa yaye lilajilizo lyako.

Nyemo yono yili mu wulajilize wo Muwaha Mulungu

17 Wumotyaje 'ne no mwitumami wako,

ho niwe mumi, no kulikamisa lilajilizo lyako.

18 Wunuguze meso gangu,

ho niziwone zo wizine wa mu wulajilize wako.

19 Ane nha nili mukola nzila du mono'nze,

holeka wulece kuhundicila zo wulajilize wako.

20 Nhumbula yangu yitamice muno,

so wusulumila nhondo zose,

kumanya zo wulajilize wako.

21 Agwe nha kuwakalipilaga,

i wanhu wedunhumuzi,

holeka walijitwe wose,

wono wakugabedegala malajilizo gako.

22 Wumbusize maligo gawo,

hamonga no wubedegalwe hambi 'ne,

nha niwibate muno wuhile wako.

23 Sunga ne wawaha nawo wena wuhile wubi kuli'ne,

ninga hamba nhavivyo, ane no mwitumami wako,

nojendelela kwihwesa zo wutonji wako du.

24 Hambi i mejizo gako nha yo nyemo yangu'ne.

Kanyhi go gamhelaga wutonji wuswanu muno.

Wutonji wo wibata wulajilize wo Muwaha Mulungu

25 Nghugalangala hasi mu manghundi nasumwa,

holeka wumhelaje kanyhi wumi,

nha vyono wehuwiza.

26 Nha nakondya kunena kuli zono nasutya,

nagwe wukahulika,

holeka wunyijize zo wutonji wako.

27 Wunyijize nzila yo wibate we malajilizo gako,

nane nozihwesa ze metumo gako go wizine.

28 Alu wusungu nha wanhulila muno so wukalale,

wumhelaje kanyhi vilungo, nha vyono wehuwiza.

29 Wumbusize nzila yo wajilile,

wunyijize ko wupolo ze malajilizo gako.

30 Ane nahagula nzila yo wiling'ano,

kanyhi nibate ne ning'aniza yako.

31 Gwe go Muwaha Mulungu,

ane nigebate du mejizo gako,

holeka wulece kundeceleza nghozwe cevu!

32 Nane nojendela mu nzila ye malajilizo gako,

hambi agwe nha kocila kumhela wizuce.

Lilombo so wizuce

33 Gwe go Muwaha Mulungu,

wunyijize zo wutonji wako,

nane nowukamisiza lukulu vilo vyose.

34 Wumanyize malajilizo gako,

nane ho sume kugebata,

kanyhi nigebate kwe nhumbula yangu yose.

35 Wunhonje nigebate malajilizo gako,

hambi mumo nha mo nghutujila nyemo.

36 Wumhele nyhilu yo kugebatila malajilizo gako,

ninga yilece kuwa so wutuga cambuzi yaye.

37 Wumbusize wuwe wo kuzityatya,

zinghani zo wulele,

wunhonje ho sume kuwumipa.

38 Wufisilizize ane no mwitumami wako,

wihuwizo wako,

wihuwizo wono kuwapelaga wose wono wakogopile.

39 Wumhonye ne matovulo gono nghugogopa,

hambi ning'aniza yako nha swanu muno!

40 Nyendile muno nigebate mejizo gako,

holeka wumhele wumi,

hambi 'gwe nha wuli ling'ani.

Kuwitumbila wulajilize wo Muwaha Mulungu

41 Gwe go Muwaha Mulungu,

nghukunena lusungu lwako lunyizize,

wumhonye nha vyono wehuwiza.

42 Nane nhondo ho nosuma,

kuwapitula wawo wono wakundiganga,

hambi 'ne nha niyihuwiye nghani yako.

43 Wunhaze niwe kuyilonga i mbeka yako,

nhondo zose, hambi witumbilo wangu,

nha wuli mu ning'aniza yako du.

44 Nane nowukamisa wulajilize wako nhondo zose,

cibitilila ne cibitilila.

45 Kanyhi nokwikala nili mwelecele nhondo zose,

hambi nha nigakamise mejizo gako.

46 Kanyhi nowanziza watemi ze malajilizo gako,

hamba si nowona cevu yaye.

47 Ne nyemo yangu yose,

yili mu wibata malajilizo gako,

hambi nha nigendile muno muno.

48 Nigogopile kanyhi nigendile malajilizo gako,

nane nowa kuzihwesa muno ze mejizo gako.

Witumbilo wa muli wulajilize wo Muwaha Mulungu

49 Ale, wukumbucile wihuwizo wako,

wono wanyihuwiza ane no mwitumami wako,

wihuwizo wono wumheye witumbilo.

50 Hamba na mu wugaye wangu, nghatuzwa,

hambi wihuwizo wako nha wukamhela wumi.

51 I wedunhumuzi, wambedegalaga nhondo zose,

ninga hamba nhavivyo,

ane si niwubedegalaga wulajilize wako yaye.

52 Nane nizikumbucilaga ze ning'aniza zako,

zo wulawa katali 'gwe go Muwaha Mulungu,

nane nghutuga wutuzwe wuwaha muno.

53 Nane nghukolwa muno ne likuwo,

lono nghuwawona i wabi,

wakubena malajilizo gako.

54 Nane lono nili kuno ku wujenzi,

zinyimbo zangu zose,

nghwimba ze malajilizo gako du.

55 Na mu cilo namo,

nghukumbucilaga gwe gwe go Muwaha Mulungu,

akuno nghwihwesa ze malajilizo gako du.

56 Nane natuga wulugutwe wuwaha,

vyono nigakamise malajilizo gako.

Wuhidimbazi kuli zo wulajilize wo Muwaha Mulungu

57 Gwe go Muwaha Mulungu,

agwe yo gwegwe du mono nghusaka,

Nane nghwihuwiza vyono nokwibata,

wulajilize wako.

58 Holeka nghukunena kwe nhumbula yose,

wumbonele lusungu,

nha vyono wehuwiza gwegwe!

59 Nayihwesa mijendele yangu,

holeka nihuwiza nizityatye ze mejizo gako.

60 Nane hamba si nocela yaye,

ku wutyatya malajilizo gako,

61 hamba yiwe mitego ye wabi yindadilize,

ninga ane si nowusemwela lukulu wulajilize wako.

62 Nane ninukaga mu cilo mugati,

niwa kukukumya ku soko ye ning'aniza yako

ye ling'ani.

63 Nane nili mwendece kuli wose,

wono wakogopile gwegwe,

kanyhi na kuli wose wono webate ze mejizo gako.

64 Gwe go Muwaha Mulungu,

yinze nha yimemile zo lusungu lwako,

holeka wunyijize zo wutonji wako.

Wunojele wuwaha wo wulajilize wo Muwaha Mulungu

65 Gwe go Muwaha Mulungu,

kunhendela viswanu ane no mwitumami wako,

nha vyono wehuwiza gwegwe.

66 Holeka wumhele mahala no wizuce,

hambi 'ne nha nihuwiye malajilizo gako.

67 Lono wali wukali nandipiciza,

netumaga zimbi,

ninga aluno, noyikamisa nghani yako.

68 Agwe nha wuli muswanu,

kanyhi wuli lusungu,

wunyijize zo wutonji wako.

69 Iwedunhumuzi wakumbalalila zinghani zo wulambi,

ninga ane nghamisize du ze mejizo gako.

70 Zinhumbula zawo zimemile wulele du,

ninga ane nghuwusangalalila wulajilize wako.

71 U wulipicizwe wangu wali viswanu kuli'ne,

hambi nha wunoza niyijize zo wutonji wako.

72 Hambi wulajilize wono wawuwika,

nha wuswanu muno wucizize zisawo zose za mono'nze.

Wiling'ano wo wulajilize wo Muwaha Mulungu

73 Gwegwe go mweneco yo wamumba kwe miwoko yako,

ale, wumhele mahala,

niyijize ze malajilizo gako.

74 Nawo wono wakogopile,

wombona kanyhi wosangalala,

ku soko vyono ane niyitumbiye nghani yako.

75 Nane manyile vyono wuling'anize wako,

wo we ling'ani 'gwe go Muwaha Mulungu,

na vyono kanyhi kundipiciza,

vyono 'gwe wuli mwihuwilwa.

76 Lusungu lwako lo lukusinyhimika 'ne,

nha vyono wanyihuwiziza ane no mwitumami wako.

77 Wumbonele lusungu ho nikale mumi,

hambi lilajilizo lyako,

nha yo nyemo yangu'ne.

78 Iwedunhumuzi wakozwe cevu,

hambi nha wambalalila nghani zo wulambi,

ninga ane nozihwesa ze mejizo gako du.

79 Nawo wose wono wakogopile, waze kuli'ne,

ho wazimanye ze mejizo gako.

80 Nane nizityatizye lukulu zo wutonji wako,

ho nize ndece kukozwa cevu.

Kulomba wukombozwe

81 Alu nhondo ane natimba 'gwe go Muwaha Mulungu,

nghulindilize wuze wumhonye,

no witumbilo wangu wose,

nha wuli mu nghani yako du.

82 Ne meso gangu nha gakatala,

so wulanjilila cono wehuwiza,

sunga neza kuwuza nghutya,

“Alo ho kokuza nili wusindamice?”

83 Hambi nha nezinga,

nawa nha mufuko wa nyhingo mugumilwe mu lyosi,

ninga hamba nhavivyo,

nghali si ninawusemwa wutonji wako.

84 Alu ho nolindila sunga nili lo?

Hamba kowalipiciza nili lo wono wakungaza?

85 Iwedunhumuzi wahimbila yikombo,

ho wangwizize mumo,

wawo wo wanhu wono si waliceleleye,

lilajilizo lyako,

86 Malajilizo gako gose nha mehuwilwa,

wanhu wakungaza bwete mbula soko,

holeka wunhaze!

87 Wali weza wali behi no kunyongomeza, ninga ane,

hamba si nobezeza lukulu mejizo gako.

88 Wumhonezye mu nghango yo lusungu lwako,

ho nigakamisize lukulu malajilizo gako.

Wihuwilo wa mu wulajilize wo Muwaha Mulungu

89 Gwe go Muwaha Mulungu,

nghani yako yikalaga cibitilila,

yikalaga yisikame ku wulanga.

90 No wihuwilwa wako wikalaga mu zindelo zose,

nagwe wuyisimizye yinze hanhu hayo,

nayo hamba si yilawuka.

91 Ne viwumbwa vyose vili baha,

sunga nalu ku soko ye lilajilizo lyako gwegwe,

hambi vinhu vyose nha wetumami wako gwegwe.

92 Na hono lilajilizo lyako,

lyali liwe yo si ndawililo ye nyemo yangu,

mhali nakondya kongomela ku soko yo wugaye wangu.

93 Holeka nane hamba si nogalecela lukulu mejizo gako,

hambi nha mo kumhelelaga wumi wangu.

94 Hambi 'ne nha nili wako, holeka wumhonye,

hambi nha hidimbaye muno mu wibata mejizo gako.

95 I wabi nawo wakusepa ho wambulaje,

ninga ane nghwihwesa ze mejizo gako du.

96 Nakondya kuwumanya mudumo wo wukwilanicile,

ninga malajilizo gako gasina mudumo.

Kuwenda wulajilize wo Muwaha Mulungu

97 Nendile muno lilajilizo lyako!

Kanyhi nghulihwesa misi yose!

98 Lilajilizo lyako,

ane nilityatyaga nhondo zose,

nalyo likumhela mahala menji,

kuciza i walugu wangu.

99 Nane nina wizuce muno,

kuciza ne wejizi wangu wose,

vyono 'ne nghwihwesa muno ze mejizo gako du.

100 Nane niwacizize wizuce sunga ne wakombi wose,

ku soko vyono nigebate mejizo gako.

101 Nane nghwiyimila muno,

ho ndece kutyatya mijendele yo yose mibi,

ho sume kuyibata nghani yako du.

102 Nghali hamba si ninawubedegala yaye,

wijize wako,

hambi nha yo gwegwe du yo wuli mwijizi wangu.

103 Ne mejizo gako nha maswanu muno kuli'ne,

gali muzinzi gacizize sunga no wuci.

104 Na ku soko yo wijize wako,

ane nghutuga wizuce,

holeka niyisulile mikalile yose mibi.

Wuzelu we lilajilizo lyo Muwaha Mulungu

105 Nghani yako yo tala yono yikunhonga,

no wuzelu wono wukumulicila nzila yangu.

106 Nane nilahiza no kukangaza mu wilahize wangu,

vyono nogakamisa mejizo gako ge ling'ani

107 Gwe go Muwaha Mulungu, ane nghugazika muno,

holeka wumhele wumi nha vyono wehuwiza.

108 Gwe go Muwaha Mulungu,

wubocele wulombe wo wulumbe wangu,

kanyhi wunyijize ze ning'aniza yako.

109 Wikale wangu nha wuli mu mbali nhondo zose,

ninga hamba si nghulisemwa lilajilizo lyako yaye.

110 Iwabi wanhejile mitego,

ninga ane hamba si nogabedegala yaye mejizo gako.

111 I mejizo gako wo wuhazi wangu nhondo zose,

heya, kanyhi yo nyemo ye nhumbula yangu.

112 Holeka nane nina wuhile mu nhumbula yangu,

wo wutyatya zo wutonji wako cibitilila.

Wudimi wono wuli mu wulajilize wo Muwaha Mulungu

113 Nane niwasulile wanhu wono si wakwendile,

Ninga nilyendile lilajilizo lyako.

114 Agwe yo gwegwe wihundiko wangu ne ngula yangu,

nane niyitumbiye nghani yako.

115 Mbucilenyi 'nye nyo wanhu wabi,

nane ho nigebate malajilizo go Mulungu wangu.

116 Ale, wumhele vilungo nha vyono wehuwiza,

nane ho niwe mumi,

wulece kundeceleza nghozwe cevu mu witumbilo wangu.

117 Wunyegamize, nane nopona,

nane ho niwe ne cihuliko,

kuli zo wutonji wako nhondo zose.

118 Kuwalemaga wose wono wabedegalaga,

zo wutonji wako no wungwele wawo, nha wa bwete du.

119 Wukuwawusa wabi wose we'nze nha takataka,

holeka ane niwendile wutonji wako.

120 Ane nghucicima so wogopa gwegwe,

memile woga, ku soko ye ning'aniza yako.

Cihuliko kuli zo wulajilize wo Muwaha Mulungu

121 Nituma nghani swanu kanyhi ze ling'ani,

holeka wulece kundeka mu miwoko ye walugu wangu.

122 Wunyihuwizaje vyono konhaza,

ane no mwitumami wako,

i wewoni walece kunyiwonela.

123 Meso gangu nha gakatala,

so wulanjilila mhonelo yako,

no wufisilize we nghani yako ye ling'ani.

124 Wunhendele mu nghango yo lusungu lwako,

ane no mwitumami wako,

wunyijize zo wutonji wako.

125 Ane no mwitumami wako,

wumhele wizuce ho manye mejizo gako.

126 I cipango cafika go Muwaha Mulungu witume,

hambi wanhu nha wakuwubena wulajilize wako.

127 Holeka, nigendile muno malajilizo gako,

kuciza zahabu, heya,

zahabu yono yilenguywe.

128 Holeka nghugatyatya i mejizo gako gose,

kanyhi si niyendile nzila yo wajilile.

Wusaka kuwuhulika wulajilize wo Muwaha Mulungu

129 Mejizo gako ga wizine,

holeka nigebate ne nhumbula yangu yose.

130 Wulolose we mejizo gako, wuletaga wuzelu,

kanyhi wuwapelaga wumanye wono si wamanyile cinji.

131 Ane nghweheleka akuno nyahame no mulomo wangu,

hambi nha nina nyhilu ye malajilizo gako.

132 Wunanje, wumbonele lusungu,

nha vyono kuwatendelaga wono wakwendile.

133 Wusikamye zi nghanzo zangu nha vyono wehuwiza,

kanyhi wulece kundeceleza wubi wuteme muli'ne.

134 Wumhonye mu wutendelwa vibi,

ne wanhu nane ho nigebate mejizo gako.

135 Wumulicile zo wuwe wako,

wunyijize zo wutonji wako.

136 Meso gangu gakuhuluma mahozi nhe kolongo,

ku soko vyono wanhu si wakuwukamisa wulajilize wako.

Ling'ani yo wulajilize wo Muwaha Mulungu

137 Gwe Muwaha Mulungu, wuli mwihuwilwa,

ne zining'aniza zako zo ze mbeka.

138 No wulajilize wako,

wono wawuwika wo we mbeka ne ling'ani.

139 Holeka nghukolwa likuwo,

ku soko walugu wangu,

si wakucelelela zo wulajilize wako.

140 No wihuwizo wako wo we mbeka,

nane no mwitumami wako niwendile.

141 Ninga 'ne vyono nili mudodo,

holeka mbedegaywe, hamba nhavivyo,

ane si nghusemwa ze mejizo gako yaye.

142 Ling'ani yako yo ye ling'ani cibitilila,

no wulajilize wako wo we mbeka.

143 Wugazice no wukalale vyanyagana,

ninga hamba nhavivyo,

malajilizo gako gamhelaga wusangalale.

144 No wuhomelezi wako,

wo we ling'ani nhondo zose,

wumhele wizuce, nane ho nowumipa.

Kulomba wukombozwe

145 Gwe go Muwaha Mulungu,

nghukulilila kwe nhumbula yangu yose.

Wumhitule, nane nokwibata ze mejizo gako.

146 Nghukunena wumhonye,

nane ho niwutyatye wutonji wako.

147 Mhinjilaga hakali mitondo muno muno,

nghulomba wutazi wako,

nokwitumbilila lukulu zinghani zako.

148 Nikalaga meso cilo cose,

ho nihwese ze mejizo gako.

149 Gwe go Muwaha Mulungu, wuhulice ko wendo wako,

wundajile zo lusungu lwako, wumhonye.

150 I wanhu wabi wono wonhajila mu magazo,

nha wasejelela,

i wanhu wono si webataga zo wulajilize wako.

151 Ninga agwe go Muwaha Mulungu, wuli behi nane,

ne malajilizo gako gose, go ge mbeka.

152 Nane nakondya kwiyijiza,

ku wulawa katali ze mejizo gako,

nagwe yo gwegwe du,

mono wagawika gekale cibitilila.

Kulomba wutazi

153 Wulanje ze magazo gangu, wumhonye,

hambi ne nha si semigwe zo wulajilize wako.

154 Wunhetele kanyhi wunghomboze,

wumhonye nha vyono wehuwiza.

155 Iwabi hamba si woponywa yaye,

hambi nha si wakuzicelelela zo wutonji wako.

156 Lusungu lwako nha luwaha 'gwe,

go Muwaha Mulungu,

holeka wundajile zo lusungu lwako wumhonye.

157 Hambi i walugu wangu,

na wono wakumhela magazo, nha wenji,

ninga ane si nolecela lukulu,

kutyatya zo wulajilize wako.

158 Na lono nghuwawona wawo i wagaluci,

mutima wangu hamba si wukwendezwa nawo,

hambi nha si wakugebata malajilizo gako.

159 Gwe go Muwaha Mulungu, lanje ta,

vyono nigendile mejizo gako!

Holeka wumhonye mu nghango,

yo lusungu lwako lo wendo.

160 Zinghani zako zose yo mbeka,

ne zining'aniza zako ze ling'ani,

zose za cibitilila.

Wusiwanulilwa ku wulajilize wo Muwaha Mulungu

161 I wawaha nawo wamhela magazo du mbula soko,

ninga ane niwogopile wulajilize wako,

kwe nhumbula yangu yose.

162 Nane sangalaye so wihuwizo wako,

nihwana no munhu mono yawene,

cinhu co wuguzi wukamu muno muno.

163 Ane si nizendile hamba hadodo,

zinghani zo wulambi-lambi,

langa'ne niwendile wulajilize wako du.

164 Nane nghulumbaga nghanghulo mupunghati,

mwi'zuwa limonga,

ku soko ye zining'aniza zako ze ling'ani.

165 Wose wono wawendile wulajilize wako,

wena mulamu wono wukwilaniciye muno muno,

na hasina cinji kanyhi cono cowagwisa.

166 Gwe go Muwaha Mulungu, nghulindiye wumhonye,

nane nghwituma nha vyono genha malajilizo gako.

167 Ane nigebate mejizo gako,

kanyhi nigendile kwe nhumbula yangu yose.

168 Nigakamise malajilizo gako,

hamonga ne mejizo gako,

nagwe nha wuziwene calinze zose zono nitumaga.

Kulomba wutazi

169 Gwe go Muwaha Mulungu,

cililo cangu cikuzize!

Wumhele wizuce mu nghango yo wihuwizo wako.

170 Wulombe wangu wukuzize,

wumhonye nha vyono wehuwiza.

171 Nane nowa kukulumba nhondo zose,

hambi nha wukunyijiza zo wutonji wako.

172 Nowa kwimba ze nghani yako,

hambi malajilizo gako gose,

nha go ge ling'ani.

173 Holeka weze wiwikanize,

nhondo zose kunhaza,

hambi nha nigebate mejizo gako.

174 Nanjiliye muno wumhonye 'gwe

go Muwaha Mulungu,

hambi wulajilize wako,

nha wo wusangalale wangu.

175 Mhelaje wuwumipe, nane ho nghulumbe,

kanyhi ne zining'aniza zako zinhaze.

176 Nghuyumba-yumba, nha ngholo yono yajiliye,

holeka wuze wunondole ane no mwitumami wako,

hambi nha si nigasemwaga malajilizo gako.


Zabuli 120

Kulomba wutazi

1 Lono nali nili mu wugazice,

namucemeleza Muwaha Mulungu, nayo yakahulika.

2 Gwe go Muwaha Mulungu,

wumhonye kuli wanhu wakonji kanyhi walambi.

3 Anye nyo wanhu walambi,

mwene mopegwa cinhuci no Mulungu?

Hamba Mulungu komulipicizenyi vye wule,

mumo mu wulambi wenyu?

4 Mbeka komulipicizenyi,

kwe zisonga zinghali ze wasilikale,

kanyhi na kwe makala go moto!

5 Sunga no wikala muli'nye, wambuce du,

hambi nha winha wikala mu Mesheki,

hamba kotya nha wikala mu wanhu wa Kedali.

6 Ku wulawa katali,

nekalana ne wanhu wono si wendile mulamu yaye!

7 Ane nili wo mulamu,

lono nghulonga zo mulamu,

wene wakusaka wulugu.


Zabuli 121

Muwaha Mulungu yo mukamisi wetu

1 Ninuye meso gangu nanjile mu matunda,

wutazi wangu wolawa hayi?

2 Wutazi wangu wolawa kuli Muwaha Mulungu,

mono yawumba wulanga ne yinze.

3 Nayo hamba si kokuleka wugwe,

hambi mudimi wako nha si kasinzilaga yaye.

4 Mudimi wa Isilayeli,

si kasinzilaga hamba kugona kose.

5 Muwaha Mulungu yo mukamisi wako,

yali behi nagwe ho yakudime.

6 Ne lizuwa hamba si lyokutamisa yaye mu misi,

hamba no mwezi nawo ku cilo.

7 Muwaha Mulungu kokukamisa muli zimbali

zose, nagwe kowa wupolile du.

8 Muwaha Mulungu kokukamisa mu wulawile wako

na mu winjile wako ku wulawa lulu,

sunga ko ku cibitilila.


Zabuli 122

Lukumyo kuli Yelusalemi

1 Nasangalala waza kunonjela wakutya,

“Ale cibite ku kaya yo Muwaha Mulungu.”

2 Alu ase cakondya kufika,

nalu cimile ha milango ya Yelusalemi!

3 Gwe Yelusalemi, go likaya lyono

lizenjigwe wuzengwe wuswanu muno,

kanyhi wukamile!

4 Ale, mumo mo makungugo gakuza, heya,

makungugo ga Isilayeli,

gakuza gawe kumulumba Muwaha Mulungu,

nha vyono yalajiliza.

5 Na mumo mo mogali mahakama go,

kuwaling'aniziza wanhu mu ling'ani,

i mahakama ge nyumba ye citemi ya Dawudi.

6 Holeka muyilombele Yelusalemi mulamu,

“Nawo wose wono wakwendile, wamoteswe.

7 Mwi'kumbo lyako, muweze no mulamu,

na ku zinyumba zako kuweze kupolile!”

8 Ku soko ye wayangu hamonga ne wandugu zangu,

holeka nghulomba mulamu wuweze muli gwegwe,

agwe go Yelusalemi!

9 Na ku soko ye nyumba yo Muwaha Mulungu wetu,

holeka nghukulombela wutuje wumoteswe!


Zabuli 123

Wulombe so wuwonelwa lusungu

1 Nghulanjiliye go Muwaha Mulungu,

agwe mono wikaye kuko ku wulanga kucanyha.

2 Nha vyono wetumami wamwitumbilaga muwaha wawo,

na vyono kanyhi u mwitumami we cicekulu,

kamwitumbilaga mucekulu munya kaya.

Ale, nase nhavivyo vyo cikwitumbiye gwegwe,

'gwe go Muwaha Mulungu, go Mulungu wetu,

sunga wukuciwonela lusungu.

3 Wuciwonele lusungu 'gwe go Muwaha Mulungu,

wuciwonele lusungu,

hambi nha cabedegalwa muno muno.

4 Cabedegalwa muno muno, ko muno ne wagoli,

nhondo 'nye, cabedegalwa si, ne wedunhumuzi.


Zabuli 124

Mulungu yo mukamisi we wanhu wakwe

1 “Mhali Muwaha Mulungu yali yalece,

kuwa ku lubavu lwetu,

2 Go Isilayeli wulonje wutye, Muwaha Mulungu,

yali yalece kuwa ku lubavu lwetu,

mu cidaha cicilya cono cahungucilwa ne wanhu,

3 mhali wacimele cili womi lululya,

lono wali wacikolelwa makuwo.

4 Baho langa mhali cisolelezwe,

ne lihwazi lye malenga,

Likolongo lyali lizigubicize nhumbula zetu,

5 ne malenga menji,

go mukukunzo gali gacigubicize!”

6 Ninga Muwaha Mulungu yalumbwe,

mono si yacileceleza,

i walugu wetu wacongomeze.

7 Alu capona nha vyono ndeje yisukulaga,

mu mutego we wapelembi mutego wubeneka,

nase capona.

8 Wutazi wetu wulawaga kuli Muwaha Mulungu,

mono yawumba wulanga ne yinze.


Zabuli 125

Wucitilwe we wanhu wo Mulungu

1 Wono wamwitumbiye Muwaha Mulungu,

wehwanile ne litunda lya Sayuni,

lyono si lisinjisikaga yaye,

langa lisikame vilo vyose.

2 Nha vyono Yelusalemi yipilimwe ne matunda,

ale, no Muwaha Mulungu nayo,

vyo yawapilime wanhu wakwe,

ku wulawa lulu, sunga ko ku cibitilila.

3 Hambi nha si kowaleka i wabi,

ho wateme yisi ya we ling'ani,

ku soko hono wateme,

wowambuza weling'ani nawo wetume wubi.

4 Gwe go Muwaha Mulungu,

weze muswanu kuli wanhu waswanu,

kuli walya du wono webate malajilizo gako.

5 Ninga lono wukuwalipiciza i wanhu wabi,

ale wulipicize sunga,

na wono si wakutyatya zo wutonji wako.

Mulamu weze kuli Isilayeli!


Zabuli 126

Kulomba wukombozwe

1 U Muwaha Mulungu, lono yacigomolela,

kanyhi ku Yelusalemi,

cali nha wanhu wono wali mu ndoto!

2 Baho cikagwa mu seko, cikemba ko wusangalale.

Sunga ne wanhu we makungugo ganji wakawa kutya,

“Muwaha Mulungu mbeka, kawatendela zimbaha!”

3 Na mbeka Muwaha Mulungu yacitendela mezino

mawaha, sunga na sese co weneco,

cikasangalala muno muno.

4 Gwe go Muwaha Mulungu,

cikukunena kanyhi wucimotese,

nha vyono vikolongo vihulumilaga malenga,

mu malolo gono ganyalile.

5 Wono wakuhadika zimbeyu zawo,

wakulila mahozi, wolodudula wasangalaye!

6 Wono wakubita ku wuhadici akuno wakulila,

wowuya wasangalaye wadinghuye ne ndudula yawo.


Zabuli 127

Lukumyo so wuswanu wo Mulungu

1 Muwaha Mulungu hono yalece kuyizenga kaya,

wono wakuyizenga wakwigaza bwete.

Muwaha Mulungu hono yalece kulidima likaya,

wono wakulilindiliza, wokwikala meso bwete.

2 Mulimo wenyu wa bwete.

Mwilawaga kwinuka hakali mitondo,

no kucela kugona, no kulya ndigwa ye lituguti.

Hambi Mulungu nha kawapelaga vyose,

wono yawendile lono wali mu nhongo.

3 I wana co cipegwa,

cono Muwaha Mulungu kacipelaga nawo,

co cipegwa cakwe kuli 'se.

4 Wehwanile nhe zisonga zono musilikale yebate,

vyo wenha wawo wana wono munhu kawatugaga,

lono yakali muzelelo.

5 Holeka mumoti munhu,

mono yamemizye songa nyinji,

hambi nha si kosumilwa lukulu,

kolo yakusitakwa,

no mulugu wakwe mu mahakama.


Zabuli 128

Cihumbilizwa kuli mono yamogopilo Muwaha Mulungu

1 Wamoti wose wono wamogopilo Muwaha Mulungu,

wono wakugatyatya malajilizo gakwe.

2 I milimo yako, yo yokutujila ne visakwa vyako,

kanyhi kowona nyemo no wumoteswe,

3 No mugolece wako, kowa yehwanile mu zabibu,

wono wukulela muno, mu kaya yako,

ne wanago wowa wehwanile vinhambi,

vyo mu zabibu vyono vikutula,

woyipilima meza yako yo wulilo.

4 Heya, nhavivyo vyo komoteswa munhu,

mono yamogopilo Muwaha Mulungu.

5 U Muwaha Mulungu, yakulugute ku wulawa ku Sayuni!

Nagwe wuwuwone wumoteswe wa Yelusalemi,

mu vilo vyose vyo wikale wako.

6 Heya, wikale sunga wuwawone wana we wanago!

Mulamu weze kuli Isilayeli!


Zabuli 129

Lilombo ku soko ye walugu wa Isilayeli

1 Isilayeli yakutya, “Walugu wangu,

wakuwa kungaza kali kenji,

ku wulawilila wuzelelo wangu!”

2 “Heya mbeka, i walugu wangu,

wangazaga wulawilila wuzelelo wangu,

ninga hamba si wasumiza yaye.

3 Wandelemulanga mu mugongo wangu,

wakawunoza nha mugunda wa kulimwa.

4 Ninga Muwaha Mulungu yo we ling'ani,

kamhonya mu wulawa mu wuwanda.”

5 Holeka wasumilwe lukulu kanyhi wakozwe cevu,

wagomolwe ku nyuma,

wawo wose wono walisulile likaya lya Sayuni.

6 Kanyhi wose wehwane mahanze,

gono gali mwi'tembe lye kaya,

gono ganyalaga na lono gakali,

hamba si natalimha,

7 hasina hamba yunji mono kogakongholeza,

yagawope mu madulu madulu.

8 Na hasina hamba yunji wo wose,

mono kokolela baho behi mono kosuma kutya,

“Muwaha Mulungu yamulugutizenyi!

Cikumulugutizizenyi mwi'tagwa lyo Muwaha Mulungu!”


Zabuli 130

Kulomba wutazi

1 Gwe go Muwaha Mulungu,

mu wukatale wangu ane nghukulilila.

2 Holeka go Muwaha, wuhulice cililo cangu,

wuhulicize wulombe wangu wunhaze.

3 Gwe go Muwaha Mulungu,

hono wali wuwe kukumbucilaga zo wubi wetu,

nani 'mbi mono yali yavumilwe nagwe?

4 Ninga 'gwe, kucinenelaga wubi wetu,

ho cikwitumamile kwe cogopo.

5 Niwulindiye wutazi wo Muwaha Mulungu,

na mu nghani yakwe nitumbiye.

6 Nimulindiye Muwaha Mulungu,

kuciza walindilizi vyono walanjililaga,

wele wa hakali mitondo, heya,

kuciza walindilizi wa hakali mitondo.

7 Gwe Isilayeli, wumwitumbile Muwaha Mulungu,

hambi mwene nha yena lusungu,

yewikanize nhondo zose ho yacikomboze.

8 Heya, kowakomboza wanhu wakwe Isilayeli,

mu wulawa mu wubi wawo wose.


Zabuli 131

Wulombe wo witumbilo wo winenenyhezi

1 Gwe go Muwaha Mulungu,

ane nakondya kuwuleka widunhumuzi wangu,

nawuleka sunga no wiwoni wangu wose.

Alu, hamba si nghwisacila mawaha,

hamba zo wizine zono zikufutila.

2 Langa 'ne nhulile twii, kanyhi nina no mulamu,

mu nhumbula yangu, nha vyono mwana ketuzaga,

mu mhambaga yo nyina, nhavivyo ne nhumbula yangu,

vyo yitulile muli'ne.

3 Gwe Isilayeli wumwitumbile Muwaha Mulungu,

ku wulawa lulu, sunga ko ku cibitilila.


Zabuli 132

Lukumyo lwe Nyumba yo Mulungu

1 Gwe go Muwaha Mulungu, mukumbucile Dawudi,

wukumbucile magazo gose gono yagatuga.

2 Kanyhi 'gwe go Muwaha Mulungu,

wukumbucile sunga no wihuwizo wono yakwihuwiza,

no wilahize wono yakwilahiziza,

agwe go Mudaha Vyose, go Mulungu wa Yakobo,

3 nha vyono yatya si kokwinjila mu kaya,

hamba kugona mu citanda cakwe,

4 vyono si kosaka yagone nhongo,

hamba kusinzila,

5 sunga kolo yakondya kukuzenjela,

wikalo wako agwe go Mudaha Vyose,

go Muwaha Mulungu wa Yakobo!

6 Nase cazihulika kuko ku Efulata,

ze Lisanduku lye Cilagane,

cikalyagana mu mawimbi ga ku Yeyalimu.

7 “Heya, alenyi ku kaya yo Mulungu,

cikahembe he 'goda lyakwe lyo wutemi!”

8 Wuze ku Nyumba yako ne Lisanduku lye Cilagane,

'gwe go Muwaha Mulungu,

ciwe co citanjilo ce vilungo vyako,

nagwe wukekale kuko cibitilila.

9 Ne wakohani wako waweze ling'ani nhondo zose,

ne wehuwilwa wako, nawo, watowe nyhenze zo wusangalale!

10 Na ku soko ya Dawudi mwitumami wako,

go Muwaha Mulungu,

holeka wulece kumulema yuyo mutemi wako,

mono wamuhagula.

11 Hambi nha yo gwegwe mono wamwihuwiza Dawudi,

wihuwizo wono wukangaye,

wono si kowubena yaye, lono watya,

“Nomutemya yumonga wa muli wanago yawe mutemi,

nayo kotema agwe kolo wakondya kufwa.

12 Na hono wanago wasume kwibata cilagane cangu du,

hamonga no kukamisa malajilizo gangu,

gono nawalajiliza, ale ne wana wawo nawo,

nhavivilya wojendelela kuwuhala wutemi wako,

vilo vyose.”

13 Muwaha Mulungu yalihagula likaya lya Sayuni,

yakasaka wuwe wo wikalo wakwe, yakatya,

14 “Ahano langa, ho wowa wo wikalo wangu,

cibitilila, ho hanhu hono notema.

15 Nane nolipela likaya lya Sayuni,

visakwa vyalyo vyose,

kanyhi nowegutya zindigwa iwaciwa wayo.

16 Ne wakohani wayo nawo,

nowamotya mu milimo yawo,

ne wehuwilwa wayo nawo,

wotowa nyhenze zo wusangalale.

17 Na mumo namo, mo nomunozeza yumonga,

wa mu wana wa Dawudi, yawe mutemi mu waha,

kanyhi nowusikamya wutemi,

wo mutemi wangu muhagulwa.

18 Nane nowakoza cevu walugu wakwe,

ninga wutemi wakwe womoteswa muno muno.”


Zabuli 133

Lukumyo kuli wendo wo wundugu

1 Lanje ta vyono yo nghani swanu muno,

kanyhi yono yikwendeza,

hono we zindugu wawe wekalane hamonga ko wumonga.

2 Wakuwa wehwanile mafuta go wuguzi wukamu,

gono gakuhuluma mu mutwe na mu ndevu za Haluni,

gakuhulumila sunga mo mu singo,

mu vivwalo vyakwe vyo wukohani.

3 Gakwihwana buhe ya mwi'tunda lya Helimoni,

yono yigwizaga mu matunda ga Sayuni.

Baho ho hanhu hono Muwaha Mulungu,

yehehuwiziziza u wulugute wakwe.

Heya, wumi we cibitilila.


Zabuli 134

Lucemo lo kumukumya Mulungu

1 Ale nzonyi mumulumbe Muwaha Mulungu,

anye nyo wetumami wakwe wose,

anye wose mono mumwitumamilaga,

ne cilo mu Nyumba yakwe.

2 Mwinule miwoko yenyu,

muyilanzye kono koyili Nyumba yo Mulungu,

mumukumye Muwaha Mulungu!

3 Nayo Muwaha Mulungu,

mono yawumba wulanga ne yinze,

yamulugutizenyi ku wulawa ku Sayuni,


Zabuli 135

Lwimbo lo lukumyo

1 Muwaha Mulungu yalumbwe!

Likumyenyi litagwa lyakwe,

anye nyo wetumami wo Muwaha Mulungu,

2 anye mono mwimaga mu Nyumba yo Muwaha Mulungu,

mu Nyumba yo Mulungu wetu.

3 Mukumyenyi Muwaha Mulungu, hambi nha muswanu,

mulimbile litagwa lyakwe zo lukumyo,

hambi nha vyo yinojeye.

4 Muwaha Mulungu yakehagulila Yakobo,

yawe munhu wakwe, ne wanhu wa Isilayeli,

wawe sawo yakwe mweneco.

5 Manyiye lukulu vyono,

Muwaha Mulungu yo muwaha yacizize,

u Muwaha Mulungu wetu,

yo Yalawiliciye mu milungu yose.

6 Mwene Muwaha Mulungu wetu,

kanozaga nha vyono yendile mweneco,

ku wulanga, hamba mono'nze,

hamba mwi'lenga, sunga na mu visolo vyayo.

7 Mwene kagaletaga mavunde,

ku wulawa ku mhelo ye yinze,

kayiletaga mvula mbaha mu nzila ye mamuli,

kanyhi kayiletaga mbeho mbaha muno,

ku wulawa ha wikalo wayo.

8 Yawawulaga i wana walongozi kulelwa wose,

ku Misili, i wana we wanhu,

sunga ne mana ge zinimu nhavivyo.

9 Nayo yakanoza mapoto,

ne vitanjilo kuli'gwe go Misili,

kuli Falawo hamonga ne wetumami wakwe wose.

10 Yakagongomeza makungugo menji,

yakawawulaga sunga,

ne watemi, wono wali wali vilungo,

11 Sihoni, mutemi we Waamoli,

na Ogu mutemi wa Bashani,

sunga ne watemi wose wa mu Kanani.

12 Yasola zisi zawo, yakawapela wanhu wakwe,

yawapela Isilayeli wuwe wuhazi wawo.

13 Gwe go Muwaha Mulungu,

litagwa lyako lyowa kukumbucilwa cibitilila,

nagwe kokumbucilwa ne wanhu we zindelo zose.

14 Hambi Muwaha Mulungu,

nha kowatetela wanhu wakwe,

kanyhi kowa no lusungu kuli wetumami wakwe.

15 I milungu ye makungugo,

nha milungu ya fweza na zahabu,

minozwe ne miwoko ye wanhu.

16 Yina milomo, ninga hamba si yikulonga yaye,

yina ne meso, ninga hamba si yikuwona ng'o.

17 Ne makutu yina nago,

ninga hamba si yikuhulika bwete,

hamba kwehela kose, si yehelaga yaye.

18 Holeka wose wono wayinoza,

na wose wono wakuyitumbila,

wokwihwana ne milungu yiyo!

19 Nye nyo wanhu wa Isilayeli,

mukumyenyi Muwaha Mulungu!

Nanye mo wakohani, mo lulelo lwa Haluni,

mukumyenyi Muwaha Mulungu!

20 Nanye mo Walawi,

mukumyenyi Muwaha Mulungu!

Sunga nanye mono mumogopile,

Muwaha Mulungu, mukumyenyi!

21 Muwaha Mulungu yakumywe mu Sayuni,

yakumywe sunga na mu wikalo wakwe ku Yelusalemi.

Muwaha Mulungu yalumbwe!


Zabuli 136

Lwimbo lo wulumbe

1 Mumulumbe Muwaha Mulungu,

hambi nha muswanu, hambi lusungu lwakwe,

nha lwikalaga cibitilila.

2 Mumulumbe Mulungu,

mono Yalawiliciye mu milungu yose,

hambi lusungu lwakwe,

nha lwikalaga cibitilila.

3 Mumulumbe Muwaha Mulungu,

mono yacizize wawaha wose,

hambi lusungu lwakwe,

nha lwikalaga cibitilila.

4 Yo mweneco yali wene du,

mono ketumaga mapoto mawaha,

hambi lusungu lwakwe,

nha lwikalaga cibitilila.

5 Yawuwumba wulanga ko wizuce wakwe mweneco,

hambi lusungu lwakwe, nha lwikalaga cibitilila.

6 Yayitandaza yisi,

mucanyha ye visolo vye malenga,

hambi lusungu lwakwe, nha lwikalaga cibitilila.

7 Yawumba lizuwa, no mwezi, hamonga ne zinyelezi,

hambi lusungu lwakwe, nha lwikalaga cibitilila.

8 Lizuwa liteme mu misi, hambi lusungu lwakwe,

nha lwikalaga cibitilila.

9 Mwezi ne zinyelezi ziteme ku cilo,

hambi lusungu lwakwe,

nha lwikalaga cibitilila.

10 Yawawulaga i wana wose,

we Wamisili iwalongozi kulelwa,

hambi lusungu lwakwe, nha lwikalaga cibitilila.

11 Yakawawusa wanhu wa Isilayeli ku Misili,

hambi lusungu lwakwe, nha lwikalaga cibitilila,

12 ko muwoko wakwe we vilungo,

hamonga no wuwaha wakwe,

hambi lusungu lwakwe,

nha lwikalaga cibitilila.

13 Yalitemanula lilenga lya Shamu,

hambi lusungu lwakwe,

nha lwikalaga cibitilila,

14 yakawakoza mumo wanhu wa Isilayeli,

hambi lusungu lwakwe, nha lwikalaga cibitilila.

15 Ninga yakawongomezeza mumo Falawo,

hamonga ne wasilikale wakwe,

hambi lusungu lwakwe, nha lwikalaga cibitilila.

16 Yawatonga wanhu wakwe mu nyika,

hambi lusungu lwakwe, nha lwikalaga cibitilila.

17 Yawawulaga watemi we vilungo,

hambi lusungu lwakwe, nha lwikalaga cibitilila.

18 Yawawulaga watemi we lilumbo,

hambi lusungu lwakwe, nha lwikalaga cibitilila.

19 Yakamuwulaga sunga na Sihoni,

u mutemi we Waamoli, hambi lusungu lwakwe,

nha lwikalaga cibitilila,

20 sunga na Ogu nhavivyo nayo,

u mutemi wa Bashani, hambi lusungu lwakwe,

nha lwikalaga cibitilila.

21 Yakazisola zisi zawo, yakawapela wanhu wakwe,

hambi lusungu lwakwe, nha lwikalaga cibitilila,

22 ho ziwe sawo ya Isilayeli u mwitumami wakwe,

hambi lusungu lwakwe, nha lwikalaga cibitilila.

23 Mwene yacikumbucila mwidaha lyo wusocele wetu,

hambi lusungu lwakwe nha lwikalaga cibitilila,

24 yakaciponya kuli walugu wetu,

hambi lusungu lwakwe, nha lwikalaga cibitilila.

25 Mwene kavilisaga ndigwa viwumbwa vyumi vyose,

hambi lusungu lwakwe nha lwikalaga cibitilila.

26 Mumulumbe Mulungu wa ku wulanga,

hambi lusungu lwakwe, nha lwikalaga cibitilila.


Zabuli 137

Cililo ce Waisilayeli ku yisi yo wujenzi

1 Cikekala mu zi nyenje ze makolongo ga Babiloni,

cikawa kulila, lono cali cayikumbucila Sayuni.

2 Sunga cikagatumbika ne masumbi getu,

mu mibici ya mu yisi yiyo.

3 Kuko nawo wono waciteka, wakawa kusaka ciwembile,

wawo wono wacigazaga,

wakasaka ciwasangalaze, wakutya,

“Mucimbile ta, lwimbo lwa Sayuni!”

4 Alu mwene, ho cokwimba nhawule lwimbo,

lo kumukumya Muwaha Mulungu,

akuno ho cili mu yisi yo wujenzi?

5 Gwe go Yelusalemi,

hono mbeka ane nghusemwe, ciba le hodu,

ndece hamba kutowa ne lisumbi kanyhi!

6 Hono ndece kukukumbucila gwegwe go Yelusalemi,

na hono ndece kukwihwesa agwe go nyemo yangu.

7 Gwe go Muwaha Mulungu,

wulece kuzisemwa yaye zono wazituma Waedomu,

lono Yelusalemi yasolelwa ne walugu,

wukumbucile vyono watya,

“Yimwagulenyi Yelusalemi!

Sunga ne mabwe go musinji gose!”

8 Nagwe go Babiloni kokongomezwa.

Kanyhi yo mumoti munhu mono kokulipiciza,

nha vyono wacitendela 'se!

9 Mono kowasola wanago,

no kuwapondanjizanga mwi'talawe!


Zabuli 138

Lilombo lyo wulumbe

1 Gwe go Muwaha Mulungu,

nghukulumba kwe nhumbula yangu yose,

nane nokwimba zo lukumyo lwako hali milungu.

2 Nane nohemba niyidomile Nyumba yako yono yelile,

kanyhi nokulumba ku soko yo lusungu lwako,

hamonga no wihuwilwa wako.

Hambi nha kulajila vyono litagwa lyako,

hamonga ne malajilizo gako, vyo vilawiliciye.

3 Nane lono nakulilila, nagwe wukahulika,

kanyhi wukasikamya kwe vilungo vyako.

4 Gwe go Muwaha Mulungu,

i watemi wose wa kono'nze nha wokukumya gwegwe,

hambi nha wakondya kuzihulika zo wihuwizo wako.

5 Nawo wokwimba zo lukumyo lwe metumo gako,

'gwe go Muwaha Mulungu,

ku soko yo wuwaha wo lukumyo lwako.

6 Gwe go Muwaha Mulungu,

hamba wuwe wuli kucanyha muno,

ninga wukuwalanga ko wuswanu i wasocele,

ne wewoni wose, si wosuma kwihundika ha meso gako.

7 Na lono wugaye winji wumhilime, agwe kundimaga,

kuwemilaga walugu wangu mu makuwo gawo,

kanyhi wukuwa kumhonya kwe vilungo vyako.

8 Gwe go Muwaha Mulungu,

kozifisiliza zose zono wehuwiza.

No lusungu lwako 'gwe go Muwaha Mulungu,

nha lwikalaga cibitilila.

Wuyikondeleze milimo yako yono wayanza.


Zabuli 139

Wumanye wo Mulungu no wukamisi wakwe

1 Gwe go Muwaha Mulungu, agwe wamhima,

wakondya kumanya sunga,

zono zili mu nhumbula yangu.

2 Agwe wuzimanyile zose zono nitumaga,

kanyhi wugamanyile sunga,

ne mahweso gangu gose.

3 Kanyhi wukondizye kumbona,

lono nili mu mulimo, hamba hono nyhehile,

wuyimanyile nyipiganza yangu yose.

4 Sunga na lono nghali,

sinalonga cinji co cose,

agwe wakondya kuzimanya zi nyhici zono nolonga.

5 Hambi 'gwe nha wumhilime mbavu zose,

kanyhi kundimaga kwe vilungo vyako.

6 Hambi wumanye wako,

nha wunyhizize mahala gangu,

wumanye wuwo wuli kucanyha muno,

hamba si nosuma kuwuficila.

7 Alu notiziza hayi, ho niwe kutali nagwe?

Hamba nhizize hayi, kono kowa wuli kusina 'gwe?

8 Na hono nitye, ta nhizize ku wulanga,

agwe wuli baho,

na hono nitye, ta nhizize ku yisi ye wafu,

nako agwe wuli kuko du,

9 hamba nitye, nguluce sunga,

kono lisosomocelaga lizuwa,

hamba mbite nghekale kutali muno,

ku lubavu lwa kumwezi.

10 Kuko nako, nha vyo konyagana du,

kowa wuli kuko, ho wusume kunhaza.

11 Na hamba nali sace wutitu wungubize,

no wuzelu wono wumhilime ciwe cilo.

12 Hamba nhavivyo cilo nha si cinji kuli'gwe,

ne cilo kuli'gwe nha yinha misi du,

hambi wutitu no wuzelu nha co cimonga du kuli'gwe.

13 Hambi nha yo gwegwe,

mono wamumba muwili ne nhumbula,

wamumbila mu'nda ya yaya.

14 Nane nghukulumba muno, hambi,

nha wunojeye wupegwe cogopo,

hambi metumo gako nha ga wizine muno,

nane nigamanyiye lukulu mu nhumbula yangu.

15 Na lono mafupa gangu gawumbwaga,

no kulunzizwa mu'nda ya yaya,

na lono nawilucilaga mumo cinyele,

agwe wali wumanyile vyono nili mumo,

16 hambi 'gwe nha wali wumbwene,

na lono nali nghali nalelwa.

Sunga ne vilo vyangu vyose,

wukavyandika mu citabu cako,

lono kwali kukali kusina hamba cinji.

17 Gwe go Mulungu,

mbeka kukamu kumanya ze mahweso gako,

nago si gasumikaga hamba ku wuwalwe kose.

18 Na hono nali nitye nigawale,

gali gawe menji kuciza no musawawa,

Hambi nha lono nghusinhuka du,

nghali nili hamonga nagwe.

19 Yali yiwe yili ciba le go Mulungu,

hono wali wuwawulaje wawo i wabi!

Yali yiwe yili ciba,

wawulaji wawo hono wali wambucile.

20 Hambi nha wakukulonga agwe makani mabi,

kanyhi wakulilonga litagwa lyako makani ga cevu!

21 Gwe go Muwaha Mulungu,

ane niwasulile mbeka,

i wanhu wono si wakwendile,

kanyhi niwabedegaye muno muno,

wono si wakuhulice gwegwe!

22 Holeka niwasuliye lukulu.

No kuwanoza nha walugu wangu.

23 Wulondole mu nhumbula yangu 'gwe go Mulungu,

ho wumanye vyono ninha, wumhime,

wugamanye mahweso gangu.

24 Wunanje hono nina nghani yo yose,

'mbi mu nhumbula yangu,

wunhonje mu nzila ye cibitilila.


Zabuli 140

Kulomba wudimi wo Mulungu

1 Gwe go Muwaha Mulungu,

wumhonye kuli wanhu wabi,

wunyhitile kuli wanhu wawulaji.

2 Hambi wanhu we liwala lilyo,

nha wehwesaga zimbi du nhondo zose,

kanyhi wekalaga wali ciwuma-wuma du nhondo zose.

3 Wena nimi nghali,

zihwanile nha sumu ye zinzoka.

Ne zinghani zawo zihwanile,

ne sumu ye lizoka li nyamwilu.

4 Gwe go Muwaha Mulungu,

wunyhitile kuli vilungo vyo mubi,

kanyhi wunyhitile sunga na kuli wawulaji,

wono wena wuhile wo kunyajiliza.

5 I wedunhumuzi wanhega ne mitego yawo,

watandaze milejehe nha nyavu,

kanyhi wahundice mitego yawo,

mu nzila ho wangwize.

6 Nane nghamulonjela Muwaha Mulungu nghatya,

“Agwe yo gwegwe go Mulungu wangu du.”

Holeka wuhulicize lizi lyo wulombe wangu, 'gwe

go Muwaha Mulungu wunhaze.

7 Gwe go Muwaha Mulungu,

go vilungo vye mhonelo yangu,

kunyhitila mu vilo vyo wulugu.

8 Gwe go Muwaha Mulungu,

wulece kuwapela i wabi visakwa vyawo,

kanyhi wulece kuwamotya mu wuhile wawo wubi,

9 Wulece kuwapela wusume walugu wangu,

ne zimbali zawo ziwawuyile weneco!

10 Ne makala go moto gawagwile,

wagwilizwe mu makombo, walece kulawila kanyhi.

11 I wabalalizi si wosuma kwikala mono'nze,

no wubi wuwagane i wawulaji,

no kuwongomeza lwa kamonga!

12 Nane manyiye lukulu,

vyono Muwaha Mulungu komudima musocele,

kanyhi koyitetela ne ling'ani yo muciwa.

13 Mbeka wono wali ling'ani wokulumba muno,

kanyhi wokwikalana na gwegwe.


Zabuli 141

Wulombe we cinya Mihe

1 Gwe go Muwaha Mulungu,

nghukucemeleza wuze wumhonye mbela!

Wuhulicize lizi lyangu kolo nghukucemeleza!

2 No wulombe wangu wukuficile nha wuvumba,

sunga no winule we mawoko gangu,

wuweze nhe likumbiko lya mwi'daha lye cinya mihe.

3 Gwe go Muwaha Mulungu wuwudime lulimi lwangu,

wuwice mulindilizi ha mulomo wangu.

4 Wunyhitile kuli zo wituma zimbi,

ndece kwilunza no wajilile wa wetuma zo wavu,

kanyhi ndecele lukulu kuhanga nawo,

mu zindigwa za mu zi sikukuu zawo.

5 Na ku soko ye cambuzi cangu,

nokwenda munhu u muswanu,

yafundile mu nzila yo kunhowa ninga,

si nokwendela lukulu i wabi wanghumye,

hambi 'ne nha nikalaga nghulomba,

ku soko ye metumo gawo mabi.

6 Ninga i wawaha wawo,

kolo wapondwapondwa mwi'talawe baho,

langa ho womanyila,

vyono wulonje wangu wali wa mbeka.

7 Nha vyono vinha vidumulwa-dumulwa vye zingwagu,

ne mafupa gawo gowa geyagaye,

ha mulango we citenjelo.

8 Ninga'ne nghwihuwiye gwegwe du,

go Muwaha Mulungu,

agwe yo gwegwe go wutizizo wangu,

holeka wulece kundeka nili wene.

9 Nghukunena wunyhitile,

kuli mitego yono wanhejile,

wumhonye kuli zi nonga zawo,

zono wakunhega wawo i wanhu wabi.

10 I wabi wegwize weneco mu mitego yawo,

lono ane nghukola mholile.

Kulomba wutazi.


Zabuli 142

1 Nghumucemeleza Muwaha Mulungu yanhaze,

nghumunena akuno nghulila.

2 Nghumuwicila wulilanzice wangu,

nghumuloloseza zo wugazice wangu wose.

3 Lono nili behi kukatala mu nhumbula,

mwene yazimanyile zose ze mijendele yangu.

Nawo walugu wanhejeze no mutego.

4 Na lono nghulanga ako na ako,

si nghumuwona hamba munhu wo wose,

mono komhela wutazi,

hamba ne hanhu ho kutiziza, hose sina,

hamba munhu yumonga bwete hasina,

mono yakumbona nha vyono nane nili munhu.

5 Holeka nane nghukucemeleza agwe,

go Muwaha Mulungu wunhaze.

Hambi nha yo gwegwe du,

go wutizizo wangu,

yo gwegwe du mono wina vyose,

vyono nghuhila mu mikalile yangu.

6 Holeka wuhulice wucemeleze wangu wunhaze,

hambi nha natimba muno,

wumhonye kuli walugu wangu,

hambi nha wali vilungo wanyhizize.

7 Wumbusize magaziko gono gali muli'ne nane,

ho nghulumbile mu wihangulize, wa we ling'ani,

hambi 'gwe nha kunhendela ziswanu.


Zabuli 143

Kulomba wutazi

1 Gwe go Muwaha Mulungu, wuhulice wulombe wangu!

Ku soko ye ling'ani yako,

holeka wuhulice wulombe wangu!

Kanyhi wumhitule ku soko yo wihuwilwa wako.

2 Kanyhi wulece kuning'aniza ane no mwitumami wako,

hambi hali'gwe nha hasina mono yali ling'ani,

hamba yumonga bwete.

3 Hambi mulugu nha kanhyatilila,

kasumila lukulu.

Kawa kunyinjiza hanhu ha citi,

niwa nhe wanhu wono wafwa katali.

4 Holeka na mu nhumbula nakatala,

sunga nalu fwiye yitenene ku soko yo woga.

5 Nalu nghukumbucila ze vilo vyono vyapuluta,

nghwihwesa muli zose zono wazinoza,

nghwihwesa ze metumo gako gose.

6 Nane nghwaliye maganza gangu nghulomba,

nghukaluciye muno,

nehwana yisi nghavu yono yisina malenga.

7 Gwe go Muwaha Mulungu wumhitule mbela,

hambi nha natimba muno mu nhumbula yangu.

Wulece kuwa kutali nane,

ho ndece kwihwana na awalya,

wono wakubita ku yisi ye wafu.

8 Wumanyize zo lusungu lwako nhondo zose,

hakali mitondo,

hambi ane nha nghwitumbiye gwegwe du.

Wuhulice wulombe wangu,

wundajile ne nzila yono noyityatya,

9 Gwe go Muwaha Mulungu, ane nghutiziza kuli'gwe,

wumhonye kuli walugu wangu.

10 Wunyijize ho sume kwituma zo wuhile wako,

hambi nha yo gwegwe go Mulungu wangu!

Na so wuswanu wako,

wunhonje mu nzila yono yigolocile.

11 Gwe go Muwaha Mulungu,

wunghamise ho niwe mholile nha vyono wehuwiza,

ale wumhonye mu wugaye ku soko yo wuswanu wako.

12 Na ku soko yo lusungu lwako kuli'ne,

wuwawulagaje walugu wangu,

wuwongomeze wose wono wakunhendela zimbi,

hambi ne nha nili mwitumami wako.


Zabuli 144

Mutemi yakumulumba Mulungu so wusume

1 Muwaha Mulungu yalumbwe,

mono yo mukamisi wangu,

kanyhi yo mhonelo yangu,

mono kanyijizaga'ne zo wihomi,

kanyhi kambikanizaga kuli zo wulugu.

2 Mwene yo mudimi wangu mwihuwilwa,

kanyhi yo kanyhitilaga muli zose,

kanyhi yo muponyi wangu.

Mwene yo mudimi wangu mono nimwitumbiye,

Mwene kagasumilizaga makungugo,

no kugawika hasi yangu.

3 Gwe go Muwaha Mulungu,

alo munhu co cici sunga wumukumbucile?

Hamba munhu co cici,

sunga wuwe kwikalaga wukumwihwesa?

4 Hambi munhu nha yehwanile mbeho,

yono yikuputa du,

sunga ne vilo vyakwe,

vihwanile mubeho wono wupulutaga du.

5 Gwe go Muwaha Mulungu, wudemule wulanga wutime!

Wugapamize matunda, nago golavya lyosi!

6 Wugumile limuli liweyagaze, lete zisonga zako,

wuwahangavye watize!

7 Wuze sunga ho hasi ku wulawa ku wulanga,

wumbuse amuno mu malenga menji,

wumhonye mu vilungo vye wajenzi,

8 wono walongaga zo wulambi nhondo zose,

kanyhi wendile kuhomelela,

no kwilahiza kuli zo wulambi.

9 Gwe go Mulungu, ane nokwimbila lwimbo lupya,

kanyhi nokutowela ndonondo nghwimbile lukumyo.

10 Agwe mono kuwapelaga watemi wusume,

no kumuponya Dawudi mwitumami wako!

11 Wumhonye kuli walugu wangu wawulaji,

wumhonye mu vilungo vye wajenzi,

wono wekalaga wakulonga zo wulambi nhondo zose,

kanyhi wendile kuhomelela no kwilahiza zo wulambi.

12 Ne wana wetu we cilume nawo,

waweze nhe vilimwa vyono vikuwiluka viswanu,

mu wuzelelo wawo, ne wana wetu we cicekulu nawo,

waweze nhe masumbili ga mu zi nhuzi,

gono makakate viswanu muno, mwi'kulu lyo mutemi.

13 Ne madongha getu nago,

gamemywe nhwanga ye mawala gose,

ne zingholo zetu nazo mu migunda yetu,

zilele kali maelufu na maelufu.

14 Nazo zing'ombe zetu,

zeze zina miwili miswanu.

Kanyhi zili vilungo, ho zilele viswanu,

kanyhi halece kuwa na cililo,

co wugazwe mu wikalo wetu.

15 Limotile likungugo lyono,

lyakondya kupegwa zizo!

Wamotile iwanhu wono u Muwaha Mulungu,

yo Mulungu wawo!


Zabuli 145

Lwimbo lo lukumyo

1 Gwe go Mulungu, ane nozanza zo wuwaha wako,

go mutemi wangu, nolikumya litagwa lyako,

nhondo zose cibitilila.

2 Nowa kukulumba nhondo zose,

nolikumya litagwa lyako nhondo zose cibitilila.

3 Muwaha Mulungu yo muwaha mono,

yanojeye kukumywa muno,

no wuwaha wakwe wucizize wumanye wose,

4 Ne zindelo na ndelo,

zojendelela kukumya ze metumo gako,

gono wetuma, no kwanza ze metumo gako mawaha.

5 Zojendelela kuzilonga,

zo wuwaha wo lukumyo lwako,

nane nojendelela kuzihwesa,

ze metumo gako go wizine.

6 Kanyhi wanhu wozilonga,

ze metumo gako go wogofye,

nane nokwanza zo wuwaha wako.

7 Wokwanza zo lukumyo lo winji wo wuswanu wako,

hamonga no kwimba kuli zo wiling'ano wako.

8 Muwaha Mulungu yo munya nheto no lusungu,

mwene si kakolwaga ne likuwo mbela,

yena lusungu luwaha.

9 Muwaha Mulungu, yo muswanu kuli wanhu wose,

kanyhi yali lusungu kuli viwumbwa vyakwe vyose.

10 Gwe go Muwaha Mulungu,

viwumbwa vyako vyose vyokulumba,

ne wanhu wako wehuwilwa nawo wokukumya.

11 Kanyhi wokwanza,

zo lukumyo lo wutemi wako,

no kwanza ze vilungo vyako.

12 Ho wasume kuwamanyiza wanhu,

ze metumo gako mawaha,

hamonga no lukumyo lo wutemi wako.

13 No wutemi wako, wo wutemi we cibitilila,

no wulajilize wako, nha wikalaga cibitilila.

U Muwaha Mulungu nha mwihuwilwa,

mu wihuwizo wakwe,

kanyhi yali lusungu mu nyituma yakwe.

14 Muwaha Mulungu kawatazaga wose,

wono wali mu wugaye,

kanyhi kawenulaga wose wono wagwiye.

15 Viwumbwa vyose vikulanjiliye gwegwe du,

nagwe kuvipelelaga ndigwa mu vipango vyayo.

16 Nagwe kuvipelaga vyose vyono vikwiliye,

mu nghango ye visakwa vyayo.

17 Muwaha Mulungu,

yo yali ling'ani mu zinzila zakwe zose,

kanyhi mwene muswanu muli milimo yakwe yose.

18 Muwaha Mulungu yali behi,

na wose wono wakumucemeleza,

kuli wose wono wakumucemeleza,

kwe nhumbula yo winenenyhezi.

19 Muwaha Mulungu,

kawapelaga visakwa vyawo wose wono wamogopile.

Kacihulikaga cililo cawo no kuwaponya.

20 Muwaha Mulungu kawadimaga wose wono wamwendile,

ninga i wabi, kowongomeza wose.

21 Nokwanza zo lukumyo lo Muwaha Mulungu,

ne viwumbwa vyose,

vilikumye litagwa lyakwe lyono lyelile,

ku wulawa lulu, sunga cibitilila.


Zabuli 146

Lukumyo kuli Mulungu Mukombozi

1 Mumulumbe Muwaha Mulungu!

Gwe go nhumbula yangu,

wumulumbe Muwaha Mulungu!

2 Nomulumba Muwaha Mulungu,

mu vilo vyo wikale wangu wose,

nomwimbila Mulungu wangu,

vilo vyose vyono nghali mumi.

3 Mulece kuwetumbila wawaha,

hambi muli wanhu nha musina mhonelo.

4 Hambi nha kolo wakufwa, wakugawuyila manghundi,

kanyhi na mwizuwa lilyo mahweso gawo gakwajilila.

5 Holeka yo mumoti mono yakumunoza Mulungu wa Yakobo,

kuwa yo mutazi wakwe, no witumbilo wakwe,

wukuwa wuli muli Muwaha Mulungu wakwe,

6 mono yawumba wulanga ne yinze, ne lilenga,

sunga na vyose vyono vili mumo.

Mwene kawukamisaga wihuwizo wakwe cibitilila.

7 Mono yakuwanozeza ling'ani wono wakugazwa,

kanyhi yakuwapela ndigwa wono wali nzala,

Muwaha Mulungu kawawopolelaga,

wono wadindiywe mu jela,

8 kanyhi Muwaha Mulungu,

kawanuguzaga meso wono wabofuye.

Muwaha Mulungu kawenulaga wono wagwiye,

Muwaha Mulungu yawendile wono wali ling'ani.

9 Muwaha Mulungu kawadimaga wajenzi,

wono wekaye mu yisi yetu,

kanyhi kawatazaga wacekulu wafwile hamonga,

ne wana wono wasina walezi,

ninga nzila ye wabi, mwene kayibidyangaga.

10 Muwaha Mulungu yatemile cibitilila,

Mulungu wako 'gwe go Sayuni,

yo mutemi muli zindelo zose.

Mumulumbe Muwaha Mulungu!


Zabuli 147

Kumukumya Mulungu u Mudaha Vyose

1 Mumulumbe Muwaha Mulungu!

Hambi nha viswanu,

kumwimbila Mulungu wetu ze lilumbo, heya,

viswanu kanyhi vyo yinojeye muno kumulumba.

2 Muwaha Mulungu,

yakulizenga likaya lya Yelusalemi,

yakuwakongholeza wapolile Waisilayeli,

wono wali weyagazwa.

3 Yakuwaponya wono wadejepe zinhumbula,

no kuziwopa zinghomele zawo.

4 Mwene kaziwalaga zinyelezi,

no kuzicemela zose matagwa.

5 Muwaha Mulungu wetu,

yo Muwaha mono yalawiliciye,

kanyhi yo we vilungo muno.

No wizuce wakwe wusina ndumo.

6 Muwaha Mulungu kawasimyaga

i wenenenyhezi ninga i wedunhumuzi,

kawagwisaga.

7 Ale, mwimbilenyi Muwaha Mulungu,

zi nyimbo zo wulumbe,

mutowelenyi ndonondo Mulungu wetu!

8 Mwene kawugubicizaga wulanga ne mavunde,

kawa kuyinozelezeza yinze mvula,

hamonga no kucindya mahanze mu matunda.

9 Mwene kazipelaga zi nimu ndigwa yazo,

sunga ne mana ge mahowe lono gakulila.

10 Mwene langa si yakuwa kwendezwa,

ne vilungo vye zifwalasi,

hamba si kasangalalilaga wutung'ati,

we wasilikale,

11 langa mwene kendezwaga,

ne wanhu wono wamogopile,

wanhu wono wetumbilaga lusungu lwakwe.

12 Gwe Yelusalemi,

wumulumbaje Muwaha Mulungu!

Wumulumbe Mulungu wako, 'gwe go Sayuni!

13 Hambi nha kayikamyaga milango yako,

kanyhi kawalugutiza ne wanhu wako.

14 Kawika mulamu mu mipaka yako

kanyhi yakukwigutya no wuhemba wuswanu muno.

15 Mwene kayilajilizaga yinze, ne nghani yakwe

yifisilizwaga musunho muno muno.

16 Kanyhi kalavyaga seluji

yiwa nha wuhamba,

kayanzazaga buhe kotya nha mavu.

17 Kaletaga mvula ye mabwe,

na hasina munhu mono

kosuma kuyikangalila mbeho yayo!

18 No kulavya wulajilize,

malenga gawa kwenjeduka.

Kaletaga mbeho mbaha,

malenga gawa kuhuluma.

19 Nayo Muwaha Mulungu kawamanyizaga,

i wanhu wakwe ze nghani yakwe,

nayo Isilayeli, zo wutonji wakwe

hamonga ne ning'aniza yakwe.

20 Ninga hamba si yawanozeza,

makungugo ganji zono zinha zizi,

holeka makungugo ganji,

hamba si wazimanyile ze malajilizo gakwe.

Mumulumbe Muwaha Mulungu!


Zabuli 148

Yinze yose yimulumbo Mulungu

1 Mumulumbe Muwaha Mulungu!

Ale, mumulumbe Muwaha Mulungu,

wulawa ku wulanga,

mumulumbe anye mono mwikaye ku canyha.

2 Mumulumbe nanye nyo wamalayika wakwe,

mumulumbe nanye nyo lipuga lyose lya ku wulanga.

3 Mumulumbe nanye nyo mwezi ne lizuwa,

Mumulumbe nanye nyo zinyelezi,

zose zono zikung'alala.

4 Mumulumbe nanye nyo wulanga ku canyha,

sunga ne malenga gono gali ku canyha yo wulanga.

5 Litagwa lyo Muwaha Mulungu linojeye lilumbwe muno,

hambi mwene nha yo yalajiliza na vyose vikawumbwa.

6 Nayo yakavimya hanhu hayo sunga cibitilila,

navyo hamba si vyosuma kumubedegala yaye.

7 Mumulumbe Muwaha Mulungu wulawa kono'nze,

nanye nyo visolo vye lilenga,

hamonga ne mazoka gayo.

8 Mumulumbe nanye nyo moto,

ne mvula ye mabwe hamonga ne seluji,

hamonga nagwe go mbeho yo mukukunzo,

mono wibate wulajilize wakwe.

9 Mumulumbe nanye nyo matunda ne vigongo,

sunga nanye nyo mibici,

ye mikalo hamonga ne mbago yose!

10 Mumulumbe nanye nyo vilimu vya mu mbago,

sunga nanye nyo mitugo yose,

sunga nanye nyo viwumbwa vyono vitambalaga hasi,

hamonga ne zindeje zose!

11 Mumulumbe nanye nyo watemi,

we'nze hamonga ne wanhu wose walongola,

ne walamuzi wose we'nze.

12 Mumulumbe nanye nyo wazelelo ne wahinza,

nyo wakombi hamonga ne wana wadodo!

13 Mulilumbe litagwa lyo Muwaha Mulungu,

anye nyo wanhu wose hambi litagwa lyakwe,

nha lilawiliciye, no lukumyo lwakwe,

lucizize kono'nze na ku wulanga.

14 Yawapela vilungo i wanhu wakwe,

wose ho wamulumbe mwene,

ne wana wa Isilayeli wono yawendile.

Mumulumbe Muwaha Mulungu!


Zabuli 149

Lwimbo lo lukumyo

1 Mumulumbe Muwaha Mulungu!

Mumwimbile Muwaha Mulungu lwimbo lupya,

mumukumizye mu mhuga ye wanhu we ling'ani!

2 Wusangalale, 'gwe Isilayeli,

hambi mwene nha yo muwumbi wako,

nanye nyo wekala ku Sayuni, sangalalenyi,

hambi mwene nha yo mutemi wenyu.

3 Mulikumizye litagwa lyakwe,

mu wuvina, mumwimbile kwe zing'oma ne masumbi.

4 Nayo Muwaha Mulungu,

nha kendezwa ne wanhu wakwe,

kawapelaga i wapolo wusume.

5 Nawo i wehuwilwa, wasecelelele mu lukumyo,

wasangalale cilo cose sunga wele.

6 Nhondo zose weze kwanza,

zo lukumyo luwaha lo Mulungu,

akuno webate ne mimaje mikali,

kose kose mu miwoko yawo,

7 ho wasume kuwalipiciza we makungugo,

no wulipicizwe we wanhu,

8 wawawope watemi wawo ne manyolo,

wawawope ne walongola wawo ne manyolo ge cuma,

9 wawalipicize we makungugo,

nha vyono Mulungu yalajiliza.

Na wuwo wo wusume we wanhu wo Mulungu.

Mumulumbe Muwaha Mulungu!


Zabuli 150

Muwaha Mulungu yalumbwe

1 Mumulumbe Muwaha Mulungu!

Mumulumbile Mulungu mu Nyumba yakwe!

Mumulumbe ku soko yo wutemi wakwe ku wulanga!

2 Mumulumbe ku soko ye metumo gakwe,

ge vilungo gono yetumile,

mumulumbe ku soko yo lukumyo lwakwe luwaha.

3 Mumulumbe kwe lizi lye ndulele,

mumulumbe kwe masumbi ne zindonondo!

4 Mumulumbe kwe zing'oma no wuvina,

mumulumbe kwe zifilimbi ne zindonondo!

5 Mumulumbe ne visesele vye mazi mawaha,

mumulumbe ne visesele vilizi muno muno.

6 Ale, viwumbwa vyose vyumi,

vimulumbe Muwaha Mulungu!

Mumulumbe Muwaha Mulungu!


Zimbazi 1

Zimbazi

1 Azi zo zimbazi za Solomona u mwana wa Dawudi, u mutemi wa Isilayeli.
2 Zo mbazi zono zosuma kukutaza wumanye mahala, no kutuga wulanjizwe wuswanu, no kumanya zinonga zono zina nhunizo muno muno.
3 Nazo zokwijiza nha vyono kosuma kwikala kwa mahala, no kuwa mwihuwilwa, kanyhi wuli ling'ani, hamonga no wuswanu.
4 Zokunoza wuwuce mu wulele, wuwe munhu mono kosuma kuwejiza wazelelo, ho wawe no wumanye.
5 Ne zimbazi zizi, zosuma konjeleza wumanye kuli wanhu we mahala, no kuwapela wutonji wa mu wumanye wawo,
6 ho wasume kuzimanya muno zinhunizo za mugati muno, ze zimbazi, hamonga ne vidalicizo vye wanhu wawo we mahala.

Mejizo kuli wazelelo

7 I cogopo co Muwaha Mulungu, wo wusimyo wo wumanye. Ninga i walele wabedegalaga mahala ne mafundo.

8 Mwanangu, wuhulice mafundo gono sogo

no nyina yako wakwijizaga wulece kugaleka.

9 Hambi mafundo gawo nha gokupela nyikala swanu.

Gowa nha mukumbo we lihewa,

mu mutwe wako,

hamba nho mukufu wa mu singo yako.

10 Mwanangu, wanyo wubi hono wakukwejeleze ko wusugu,

wulece kulumbila lukulu.

11 Hono watye,

“Ale cibitane cikamulondole munhu cimuwulaje!

Cibitane cikawahome wanhu wono wasina masutya,

wuwe nha wo mwidawalo wetu!

12 Nha vyono yinha, cowamela wakali womi nhe yisi ye wafu.

Kotya wakugwila mwi'kweme.

13 Nase cozilondola sawo zose ze wagoli,

ciwe kuzimemya zikaya zetu na vyono cowa caviteka!

14 Holeka wuze cilunze nase,

nase cogawana vinhu vyose vyono covihiza.”

15 Ninga 'ne nghukutya nhavi agwe mwanangu,

vyono, wulecele lukulu kwilunza ne wanhu we liwala lilyo,

hamba wulece kuwatyatya.

16 Hambi wene nha si walindilaga kuwituma zimbi,

nhondo zose wekalaga wewikanize so wuwulaji du.

17 Kanyhi wumanye vyono,

si viswanu kuyitega ndeje no lwavu,

lono nayo yikunuguliye yikukuwona,

18 hambi wanhu we liwala lilyo,

nha wategaga mutego,

kanyhi wawa kwigwiza weneco,

mu mutego wono wokwiwulaga wali wene.

19 Kanyhi, wumanye vyono wuhizi,

wusakaga wumi wo muhizi.

Ne nghani yiyi, yikuwa kumwijelela munhu wo wose,

mono kekalilaga muli zo wuwulaji.

Mahala gakucema

20 Alu wuhulicize!

Mahala gakucemeleza mu zinzila na mu zi sokoni,

21 gakucemeleza gehindile,

sunga na mu malango ge likaya,

sunga ne hanhu ho hose,

hono wanhu wendile kwihanguliza hamonga.

22 Gakucemeleza gakutya,

“Nye nyo wanhu walele!

Alu ho mojendelela kwikala muli walele sunga nili?

Alu si mosuma kwiyijiza hamba hadodo lo?

23 Ale lu, muhulicize lono nghumutacilenyi.

Hambi 'ne nha nghumulanjizenyi viswanu,

no kumugubulilenyi ze mahala gangu.

24 Nasola katali nghumucemelezenyi,

nghumusacenyi ho munyizize,

ninga nanye hamba kuhulika yaye.

25 Mwakondya kuwubedegala wulanjize wangu wose,

hamba si mwendile ne mafundo gangu.

26 Ninga nanye kolo mwenjila mu magazo,

nane nomusekanjenyi muno muno.

Kanyhi nomwizwajizenyi kolo zimbi zikumwaganenyi.

27 Kolo magazo gago gakumuzizenyi nho mukukunzo,

gawe kumuletelenyi libeho lyo wugaye,

nanye lono mowa muli mu wusungu no wukalale.

28 Ale baho nanye, ho mulagalondolela mahala,

ninga nane hamba si nolomutondowozenyi ng'o.

Nanye molonondola hanhu hose,

ninga hamba si molombona yaye.

29 Hambi nha mwawusula wumanye,

hamba kusaka nhondo zose kumuhulika Muwaha Mulungu yaye.

30 Kanyhi hamba si mwasacila lukulu kugabocela mafundo gangu,

hamba kugatununhicila bwete.

31 Holeka luno, zomwaganenyi zono ziwanojeye,

ne metumo genyu gomupelenyi mhungo.

32 Holeka i wanhu walele,

wofwila mu wulele wawo,

hambi nha si wakusaka mahala.

Vyono i wanhu wono wasina mahala,

nha wakuwa kongomezwa no wuwula mahala wawo.

33 Ninga munhu wo wose mono kohuliciza'ne,

yuyo kokwikala yapolile,

kowa mutulano,

hamba kowa yasina soko yo kogopa cinji co cose yaye.”


Zimbazi 2

Cambuzi ce Mahala

1 Gwe mwanangu, wiyijizaje zono nghukulonjela,

kanyhi wulece kuzisemwa zono nghulonjela witume.

2 Hulicize kuli ze mahala, wuzimanye.

3 Heya, wulombe wutuje wumanye,

no kuwucemeleza wizuce.

4 Wulondole wuhidimbaye,

nha vyono wali wuyilondole fweza,

hamba sawo yono hundikwe.

5 Na hono wulondole wuhidimbaye,

kosuma kuyimanya nhunizo ye cogopo co Muwaha Mulungu,

nagwe baho, ho kosuma kuzimanya za kuli Mulungu.

6 Hambi nha yo Muwaha Mulungu du,

mono kawapelaga wanhu mahala,

na muli mwene, mo vilawaga wumanye wose no wizuce.

7 Kanyhi mwene, yo kalavyaga wutazi no wucitilwe,

kuli wose we ling'ani, ne wanhu wehuwilwa.

8 Kanyhi, yo mweneco du mono kawacitilaga wose,

wono wawatendelaga wayawo ko wukali,

no kuwadima wose wono welavizye kuli mwene.

9 Holeka, hono wuhulicize 'ne,

baho ho komanyila zono zili mugoloka,

na ze ling'ani, kanyhi swanu.

Kanyhi kosuma kuzimanya zono zikunojeye witume.

10 Kowa wina mahala,

no wizuce wako wokupela wusangalale mu mutima wako.

11 Wizuce wako no wumanye wako,

vyokukamisa

12 no kukwimila, ho wulece kwituma zimbi yaye.

Navyo vyokutemanula ne wanhu wono wendile makani-kani,

kuli zono walongaga

13 i wanhu wono wakondya kuyileka mikalile ye ling'ani,

no kwikala mu citi co wubi,

14 wanhu wono wendezwaga mu wituma zimbi,

wono wasangalilaga mu zimbi,

15 wanhu wono wayisina mbeka,

wono si wosuma hamba kwitumbilwa yaye.

16 Kosuma kumwilega mucekulu musenyha,

mono yakujela kukupepeleza kwe zinghani zakwe ndece,

17 mono si mwihuwilwa na kuli mulume wakwe mwenco,

mono kanyhi, yakusemwa no wilahize wakwe.

18 Na hono wubite ku kaya yakwe,

ale, wumanye nha vyono,

wutyatizye nzila ye lifwa.

Na hono wubite, nha cinji,

wukuyisejelela yisi ye wafu.

19 Hambi nha hasina munhu mono yabita kumulamusa,

mono kanyhi yawuya.

Hambi nha si kowuyajila kanyhi mu nzila yo wumi.

20 Holeka agwe, yikunojeye wutyatye musambo we wanhu waswanu,

wono wekaye mu mikalile ye ling'ani.

21 Hambi i wanhu we ling'ani,

kanyhi wono wakwilaniciye,

nha wokwikala mu yisi yetu yiyi.

22 Langa i wabi, Mulungu kolowawusiza lukulu mu yisi,

yawakulanje i wanyo wubi,

nha vyono wavikulaga vilimwa mu muhangha.


Zimbazi 3

Mafundo kuli wazelelo

1 Gwe mwanangu, wulece kuzisemwa zono nghukwijiza.

Kanyhi weze kuzikumbucila nhondo zose zono nghukulajiliza witume.

2 Ne mafundo gangu,

gokupela wumoteswe vilo vinji hamonga no mu mikalile yako.

3 Weze wuli mwihuwilwa,

kanyhi wuli cihuliko.

Wuwuwopeleze wihuwilwa ne cihuliko mu singo yako,

wuvyandice mu nhumbula yako mugati.

4 Nagwe hono witume zizo,

u Mulungu hamonga ne wanhu wokwendezwa nagwe.

5 Wumwitumbile Muwaha Mulungu kwe nhumbula yako yose.

Wulece kwiyitumbila mahala gako go mweneco.

6 Wumukumbucile Muwaha Mulungu,

muli zose zono wukwituma,

nayo kokutonga mu nzila yono yinojeye.

7 Ninga wulecele lukulu kwihwesa nha vyono,

agwe wuli we mahala go mweneco,

langa agwe weze ne cihuliko kuli Muwaha Mulungu du,

kanyhi wulemele lukulu kwituma zimbi.

8 Na hono wuwe ne cihuliko kuli Muwaha Mulungu,

ale, yowa nha miti miswanu,

yono yokuponya zinghomele zako no kukucepulila wusungu wako.

9 Wumulumbe Muwaha Mulungu,

mu nzila yo kumulavizya vilimwa viswanu vyono wuvitujile mu mugunda wako.

10 Hobaho nago madongha gako,

gomemywa wuhemba,

kanyhi kowa na divayi nyinji yono yokufutila na ha wuwiko wayo.

11 Mwanangu, kolo Muwaha Mulungu yakukufunda,

wulece kugabedegala mafundo gakwe,

langa wugabocele.

12 Hambi Muwaha Mulungu,

nha kawafundaga wose wono yawendile,

nha vyono sogo yo munhu kamufundaga mwanagwe mono yamwendile.

13 Yo mumoti munhu mono kawonaga mahala,

no munhu mono katugaga wizuce.

14 Hambi nha mo mocili cambuzi ciwaha muno si nhe cambuzi ca mu fweza.

Kanyhi mocili cambuzi ciwaha muno si nhe zahabu.

15 Mahala, mbeka gena sawilo mbaha muno,

si nhe vibwe vyo wuguzi wukamu,

na hasina cinhu cinji co cose,

cono kocisaka cono kosuma kwihwananiza ne mahala.

16 Mahala gakupelaga vilo vinji vyo kwikala mumi mu mikalile yako,

hamonga no wugoli ne lilumbo.

17 Mahala gokupela nyemo mu mikalile yako hamonga no mulamu.

18 Na wose wono wena mahala,

wena nyemo.

Ne mahala gowapela wumi.

19 Muwaha Mulungu yayiwumba yinze,

kwe mahala gakwe.

Na ko wizuce wakwe,

yakawusimya wulanga.

20 Kanyhi mahala gakwe go gaganoza makolongo gahulume,

ne mavunde nago gayitonyeze mvula mono 'si.

21 Holeka agwe mwanangu,

wukamise mahala hamonga no wizuce.

Wulece kuvileceleza vikutije.

22 Hambi nha vyo vyokupela wumi,

no wendezwe,

hamonga ne mikalile ye nyemo.

23 Nagwe kowa kujenda wupolile mu zinzila zako,

hamba si kokwikobala yaye.

24 Kanyhi kowa wusina woga wo wose,

lono wukwinjila kugona mu citanda cako.

Heya ku cilo kogona nhongo zono zili muzinzi.

25 Hamba si kosuma kugacelelela magayo gono gokuziza nhinicizo,

hamba mukukunzo we wabi kolo wukukuziza.

26 Hambi Muwaha Mulungu nha kokukamisa.

Hamba si kokuleka yaye wugwile mu mutego.

27 Holeka agwe,

weze kuwatendela ziswanu wono wena wanjile,

mu nghango vyono kosuma.

28 Kanyhi wulecele lukulu kumutya muyago,

yalindile sunga mitondo yaco,

hono kumbe nagwe wali wusume kumupela wutazi lwa kamonga du.

29 Kanyhi wulece kumuwicila muyago cikobazo ho wumutamise,

hambi yuyo muyago,

nha mwikalene behi,

kanyhi mwene yakwitumbiye gwegwe.

30 Kanyhi wulece kwisumaniza no muyago mbula soko,

lono nayo hamba si yakunozize yinji 'mbi.

31 Wulece kuwawonela wivu,

i wanhu wagazi,

hamba wulece kuwega mu metumo gawo.

32 Hambi Muwaha Mulungu,

nha yawasulile i wanhu wetuma zimbi,

langa i weling'ani,

mwene yali hamonga nawo.

33 Muwaha Mulungu kazilijitizaga zikaya ze wanhu wabi,

ninga zikaya ze weling'ani,

mwene kazimotyaga.

34 Kanyhi mwene si kawasakaga i wanhu wedunhumuzi,

langa kawapelaga lihewa i weneneyhezi.

35 Iwe mahala wotuga lukumyo,

ninga walele, wokozwa cevu.


Zimbazi 4

Cambuzi ce mahala

1 Nye wanangu, muhulicize zono sogo yenyu yakumufundenyi.

Mugebate,

mafundo gakwe ho mowa no wizuce.

2 Hambi 'ne zono nghumwijizenyi,

nha nghani swanu,

holeka muzikumbucile zose.

3 Hambi ane nha nali mwana kuli sogo yangu.

Mudodo mwendece we ciwene mwa yaya.

4 Baba yafundaga yatezaga,

“Ale, wukumbucile kuli zono nghukulonjela,

wulece kuzisemwa.

Weze kwituma nha vyono nghukulajiliza,

nagwe holeka kowumipa.

5 Wutuje mahala,

hamonga no wizuce! Wulecele lukulu kusemwa,

hamba kuzibedegala zinghani zangu.

6 Wulece kumuleka mahala,

nayo kokukamisa.

Wumwende, nayo kokucitila,

wikale wupolile.

7 Kutuga mahala yo nghani mbaha yono yicizize,

yono yikunojeye wuyitume.

Heya, hamonga ne zisawo zako zose,

ninga wunojeye witujile mahala.

8 Wende mahala,

nayo kokupela lilumbo.

Wumwibatilize,

nayo kokuletela lukumyo.

9 Nayo kowa wo mukumbo wo lukumyo mu mutwe wako.”

10 Gwe mwanangu, wuhulicizaje,

wuzikamisizaje lukulu zose zono nghukulonjela,

nagwe holeka kokwikala vilo vinji mono'nze.

11 Ane nakondya kukwijiza mahala,

hamonga ne nzila swanu yono koyikola mu mikalile yako.

12 Kanyhi hasina cinji co cose cono cokwimila mu zinzila zako,

hono wuwe kujenda kwe mahala,

na kanyhi hamba si kokwikobala yaye lono wukumangha.

13 Nhondo zose weze wibate zono weyijiza,

hambi mejizo gako,

nha wo wumi wako,

holeka wugalanjililaje galece kukutiga.

14 Wulece kwinjila mu zinzila wetuma zimbi.

Wulecele lukulu kuyityatya misambo ye wanhu wabi,

15 Wulece kwituma zizo,

wuwucile lukulu mu zimbi!

Wuzilemaje zimbi,

wilegaje mu zimbi.

16 Nawo i wanhu wabi,

hamba si wagonaga nhongo sunga langa wetume zimbi du.

Wagonaga meso,

sunga watamise munhu yunji.

17 Nago metumo mabi kuli wene yo ndigwa yawo, hamonga.

No wukali, nawo kuli wene,

vihwanile no wugali ne malenga go kung'wa.

18 Nayo nzila yono wakolaga wanhu we ling'ani,

yihwanile wuzelu we lizuwa lono likusosomoka,

nalyo liwa kujendelela kutuga wuzelu muno sunga kolo welelecela.

19 Ninga nzila ye wanhu wabi,

yina wutitu, yihwanile cilo.

Nawo wakwikobaza hamba kumanya cono ciwakobaze yaye.

20 Holeka agwe mwanangu,

wukamise zono nghulonga,

wuzihulice zinghani zangu.

21 Wulece kuzileceleza zikutije,

wuzikumbucilaje,

wuzikamise mu nhumbula yako.

22 Nazo zomupela wumi hamonga ne vilungo vyo muwili

munhu wo wose mono yakuzizuka.

23 Holeka wuyikamise nhumbula yako,

hambi mumo nha mo yilawaga mivwilo yo wumi.

24 Wulece kulonga wulambi.

Wilegaje muli zinghani zo wulambi,

hamonga ne zinghani ze liwanjilila.

25 Meso gako,

galanje ku mwande du,

hamonga no witumbilo,

wulece kwikoza cevu.

26 Weze wuli mulanjilizi muno,

muli zose zono wukwituma,

wukumanya vyono,

zono wukwituma zose swanu.

27 Wilegaje mu zimbi,

meso gako galanje ku mwande du.

Hamba nghanzo yako monga du,

yilece kupatuka mu nzila.


Zimbazi 5

Suguzi kuli zo wusenyha

1 Gwe mwanangu,

wukamise no kuzihulika ze mahala gangu no wizuce.

2 Nagwe ho komanya nzila ze nyikala ye cogopo,

ne zinghani zako zokulajila vyono kumbe wina mahala.

3 Hambi milomo yo mugolece wo munhu yunji,

nha yiwezaga yili muzinzi nho wuci,

ne nonela yakwe,

yiteleye yinhe mafuta,

4 ninga kolo zose zakondya,

hodu mwene kawa kukuleka,

wina wusungu ne mawine.
