nane nokulajila i wanhu wono wena wukalale.

3 Hono wuwe wendile mahala,

mbeka sogo kokwendezwa nagwe.

Kanyhi yo nghani ya wulele,

yo munhu kwitumamila sawo kuli wacekulu wasenyha.

4 Na hono mutemi yawe yali mu ling'ani,

sunga ne likungugo lyowa lili vilungo.

Ninga hono yawe mwenda sawo,

koyongomeza yisi yakwe.

5 Na hono wuwe wuli mwiyendezi kuli wendece wako,

wukwitega mutego go mweneco.

6 Ne wanhu wabi, weyigwizaga mu wubi wawo.

Akuno i wanhu we ling'ani, wasangalaye kanyhi welecele.

7 Nayo munhu we ling'ani yazimanyile

zono zimunojeye yawatendele waciwa.

Ninga i wanhu wabi, si wazimanyaga zizo.

8 Ne wanhu wono si webedegazi

wasagahazaga wuma mwi'kaya.

Ninga i wanhu we mahala, wapozaga makuwo.

9 No munhu we mahala, hono yamusitace mulele,

u mulele kowa kuseka du,

kanyhi kowa yazozize du akuno yakuliga.

10 I wanhu wono wendile wuwulaji,

wamusulaga u munhu we ling'ani.

Ninga we ling'ani wowucitila wumi wo munhu we liwala lilyo.

11 Ne wanhu walele, welajilaga makuwo gawo calinze.

Ninga we mahala, wali ngola, akuno wena no wiyimizi.

12 Na hono mutemi yawe muhulicila zo wulambi,

ne wetumami wakwe wose wowa walambi.

13 U muciwa no mugazi, wose yo nghologo monga,

u Muwaha Mulungu nha yawapela meso wose vyono wejete.

14 No mutemi mono kawaling'anizaga viswanu waciwa,

kotema vilo vinji muno.

15 Kutacila hamonga no kufunda,

co cinhu ciswanu kuli wana.

No mwana hono yalece kutendelwa zizo,

komukoza cevu nyina ku soko yakwe.

16 Na hono i wanhu wabi wawe wo watemi,

no wusutye wonjelezekaga.

Ninga we ling'ani wokwikala walanjiliye wufwe we wanhu wawo.

17 Wumufundaje mwanago,

nagwe kokwilumbila muli mwene.

Nayo hamba si kokukoza cevu yaye.

18 Ne likungugo hono lilece kuwa no wutonji wo Mulungu,

liwezaga yikungugo lyono lisina wulajilize.

Yo mumoti munhu mono yebate lilajilizo lyo Mulungu.

19 Si kosuma kumufunda mwitumami na nghani du,

ku soko hamba yawe yakukwizuka zono wukumulonjela,

ninga si kohulika.

20 Ciba kumwitumbila u munhu mulele,

si nha kumwitumbila u munhu mono kelonganjilaga du,

wu wula kwamula kwihwesa.

21 Na hono wumuzoweleze mwitumami wako,

ku wulawa wudodo wakwe,

wuwe kumupela du cono yakusaka,

mwi'zuwa linji,

kolo kwisolela du mweneco vinhu vyako.

22 Ne wanhu wono wena makuwo ge mbela mbela,

waletaga wuma hamonga ne mazozo.

23 Ne wanhu wedunhumuzi, wosuma kukuletela lifwa.

Ninga hono wuwe mwinenenyhezi, wokupela lilumbo.

24 Nayo u muyagwe no muhizi, kesuzaga wumi wakwe.

Na hono yalonje ze mbeka mu mahakama,

kotuga wulipicizwe.

Nayo hono yalece kwituma nhavivyo,

Mulungu komulijita.

25 Nawo woga wo kuwogopa wanhu, wuletaga mutego.

Ninga hono wumwitumbile Muwaha Mulungu,

kowa wupolile.

26 Ne wanhu wose wasakaga watuje wendezwe kuli mutemi.

Ninga kosuma kutuga ling'ani kuli Muwaha Mulungu du yali wene.

27 I wanhu we ling'ani, wawasulaga i wabi,

nawo i wanhu wabi, wawasulaga i wanhu we ling'ani.


Zimbazi 30

Zinghani za Aguli

1 Azi zo nghani zono yazibocela Aguli u mwana

wa Yake, yakutya, “U Mulungu yakondya kundeka,

u Mulungu yakondya kundeka.

Neza sina wutazi wo wose.

2 Nane luno, nehwana lilimu, si nha munhu.

Naluno, neza sina wizuce wono wunojeye munhu yawe yena nawo.

3 Nghali neyijiza ze mahala,

hamba sinizimanyile zinghani zo Mulungu yaye.

4 Alo nani 'mbi mono yagatema mahala ga ku wulanga?

Hamba nani mono yasuma kuyifumbata mbeho

mu muwoko wakwe?

Hamba mono yasuma kugavunga malenga mu citema?

Hamba mono yawika mipaka ye yinze nani?

Alo yo nani mwene, hono wumumanyile?

Ne litagwa lyo mwanagwe nani?

5 “Ninga Mulungu kawukamisaga wihuwizo wakwe

wono kawihuwizaga.

Mwene yehwanile ngula,

kuli wose wono walondolaga wucitilwe kuli mwene.

6 Wulece konjeleza zinghani zakwe, mwene kokuleka,

no kukuwona vyono wuli mulambi.”

Mbazi zinji kanyhi

7 Gwe go Mulungu,

ane nghukulomba wumhele nghani nyejete lono nghali mumi.

8 Wumbusize kutali ne zinghani ze bwete na zo wulambi.

Na kanyhi wulece kumhela wuciwa hamba wugoli.

Ninga hamba nhavivyo,

nghulomba wumhele ndigwa yono yinghwiliye.

9 Ku soko hono niwe nina ndigwa nyinji,

ndahile kutya “Muwaha Mulungu yo nani?”

Ninga kanyhi hono niwe nili muciwa,

nohiza no kulitoyula litagwa lyakwe.

10 Wulece kumubalalila bwete u mwitumami,

kuli muwaha wakwe.

Vyono hono wunoze nhavivyo,

agwe kolijitwa no kutuga magayo so nghani yiyo.

11 Kanyhi ko wali wanhu,

wono walijitaga wasogo zawo,

no kuwakununghalila i wanyina zawo.

12 Ko wali wanhu wanji, wono wewonaga wazelu,

ninga kumbe wene ho watipiye du ne makwe gawo.

13 Ko wali wanhu wanji, wono wewonaga waswanu,

Lanje ta, vyono wakwidunhumula weneco!

14 Ko wali wanhu wanji, wono wawewonelaga waciwa,

na wono wena wanjile, no kuwasolela vinhu vyawo,

wakwitujila ndigwa yawo mu nzila yiyo.

15 Ling'onyo lya mu malenga, lyono lyonghaga sakami,

lina wana we cicekulu wejete.

Na wose vyono wejete,

wakucemwa, “Wumhelaje.”

Na ho vili vinhu vine vyono si vigutaga yaye,

16 I yinze ye wafu,

Mucekulu mugumba,

Muhangha mukavu wono wukusaka mvula.

No moto wono si wusumikaga kuzimywa.

17 No munhu mono kamusekangaga sogwe,

hamba mono yakumubedegala nyina mu wukombi wakwe,

munhu yuyo yanojeye yaligwe ne zi 'ndi,

hamba meso gakwe gakopozolwe ne mahowe.

18 Kanyhi, hovili vinhu vidatu hamba vine vye cinyele kuli'ne,

vyono hamba si nivimanyile yaye, navyo vyovi:

19 Wuguluce we 'ndi mu mwanya,

wujende we lizoka mwi'talawe,

na vyono ngalawa yisumaga kuyiwona nzila yayo mwi'lenga.

Na vyono wiyende wo mulume no muhinza wuwezaga.

20 Na yiyi yo nzila yono mucekulu

mono si mwihuwilwa kayitumamilaga.

Mwene kolo yasenyha, kawa kwihovuga,

hanyuma kawa kutya,

“Ninga ane, hamba si nitumile nghani yinji 'mbi yaye.”

21 Na kozili nghani yine

zono yinze si yosuma kuzidinghula nazo zozi:

22 U muwanda hono yawe mutemi,

U munhu mulele, hono yawe yakwizize ndigwa.

23 No mucekulu mono yasuligwe, hono yatolwe.

No mwitumami we cicekulu,

hono yamupeme mugolece munya kaya.

24 Na mono yinze,

mo vili viwumbwa vine

vyono vina miwili midodo muno muno,

ninga vina mahala menji.

25 Sungusungu, vyo viwumbwa vidodo,

ninga vikuwa kusuma kwiwicila ciwutwa ca ndigwa mu cibahu.

26 Mhimbi, nazo zisina vilungo,

ninga zikuwa kwinozeza wikalo wazo mu matalawe.

27 Nzije, nazo zisina mutemi,

ninga zitulukaga ziwumbatiye hamonga du.

28 Nyhodo nazo ndodo,

kosuma hamba kuyifumbata monga mwi'ganza,

ninga zikalaga mu makulu.

29 Kanyhi, ho vili vinhu vine, vyono vyendezaga,

hono wukuvilanga vikujenda, navyo vyovi:

30 Simba, lyono lina vilungo kuciza malimu gose,

lyono silyogopaga cinji.

31 Mvulati ne zinzogolo,

zono zijendaga zikwitogola.

Ne watemi lono wali ha mwande ye wanhu wawo.

32 Na hono nagwe wali wenjila mu wulele wo widunhumuzi,

ale, wiyihengaje!

33 Hono wugasuce mele, kotuga tilazi,

hono wumutowe yunji mu mhula,

mafununghula golawila,

ninga honowulisagahize likuwo,

kokwiyinjiza mu mbali.


Zimbazi 31

Wulanjizwe kuli Mutemi

1 Azi zo nghani zono mutemi Lamuyeli yafundwa no nyina, yatya,

2 “Agwe yo gwegwe du mwanangu we cilume monga,

mono namulomba kuli Mulungu,

nayo yakamhela.

Alu magu, hamba nghulonjele nityeci?

3 Ninga 'ne nghukutya vyono,

wulecele lukulu kumalila vilungo vyako vyose mu wusenyha,

ne sawo yako yose mu wacekulu,

hambi zizo nha zawahodangaga sunga ne watemi.

4 Holeka wuhulicize gwe mwanangu Lamuyeli,

i watemi si wanojeye wawe wagalo

'jimbi, hamba kuwa no wusulumizi wo wugalo 'jimbi.

5 Ku soko hono wawe wagala wujimbi,

hobaho hamba si wakukumbucila kanyhi zo wulajilize,

kanyhi hamba si wakucelelela ze ling'ani ye wanhu.

6 “Holeka, wugalo 'jimbi,

wuwanojeye wanhu wono wakufwa,

na wono wali mu wukalale.

7 Wawo langa wo wanojeye wang'we,

ho wasemwe zo wuciwa wawo,

no wukalale wawo.

8 Wulonje zo wuling'anize,

so wono si wosuma kwilonjela weneco.

Wuwataze wono wasina wutazi,

ho watuje ling'ani yawo.

9 Holeka, wulonje ku soko yawo zinghani zawo,

kanyhi weze wuli muling'anizi we ling'ani.

No kuwatendela ze ling'ani i waciwa na wono wanjiye.”

U mugolece muswanu mono yakwiliye

10 Na mbeka kukamu kumutuga mugolece mono yakwiliye! Hambi nha yena wuguzi wukamu muno si nha vibwe vyo wuguzi wukamu!
11 Nayo mugolece we liwala lilyo, sunga no mulume wakwe, kawezaga yamwitumbiye. Kanyhi hamba si kolo ciwapa yaye.

12 Na mu myaka yose yo wikalane wawo, hasina

hambe 'zuwa lyono mugolece yamukalaza mulume wakwe.

13 Langa mwene vilo vyose, kekalaga yakunoza myenda

yo wukunzeje we zingholo, hamonga na ye bafuta.

14 Kanyhi kakongholaga ndigwa ako na ako,

yakuyileta mu kaya, kanozaga nhe wasuluza

wa mu ngalawa yo wukwawi.

15 Na kanyhi kelawaga kwinuka hakali mitondo muno

muno, ho yawikanize ndigwa so we mhuga yakwe,

hamonga no kumugawila u mwitumami wakwe we cicekulu,

milimo yono kokwituma.

16 Kalondolaga mugunda, kawa kuwugula ne zipesa

zono yali yakwawa, hanyuma kawa kuhadika zabibu.

17 Kanyhi muhidimbazi muno mu milimo,

yali vilungo kanyhi mwitumi.

18 Nayo kawezaga yamanyile ne vifo vye vinhu vyose

vyono kanozaga.

Nayo ketumaga milimo sunga lizuwa ligwila.

19 Mwene kabotaga mweneco kwe miwoko yakwe,

no kuhona myenda yakwe kwe miwoko yakwe.

20 Kanyhi kawawonelaga lusungu i waciwa

na wono wali mu wanjile.

21 Na mu madaha ge cinyuli, mwene hamba si

kehwelelaga yaye, hambi we mhuga yakwe wose,

nha wena myenda yono yowapela civuce.

22 Kahonaga mweneco ne mitote yo kutandika mucanyha

ye vitanda, kanyhi, kavwalaga myenda yo lugandu.

23 No mulume wakwe, yo munhu we lilumbo.

Kanyhi yo yumonga wa muli walongola mu'si.

24 Kanyhi kahonaga myenda ne misipi, kawa

kuwaguziza i wasuluza.

25 Yo mucekulu mono yali vilungo, kanyhi yena

lilumbo, hamba si kehwelelaga za mu vilo vyono vikuza.

26 Kanyhi, yendile kulonga ko wupolo zinghani ze mahala.

27 Kanyhi mwene kekalaga yakwipiganza, yakuwalondolela

visakwa we mhuga yakwe.

28 Ne wana nawo, wendezwaga muno, nayo mulume wakwe,

kamulumbaga muno.

29 Mulume wakwe katezaga, “I wacekulu wenji,

mbeka wagolece waswanu, ninga agwe

wuwacizize wawo wose.”

30 Nawo wuhijila mbejele, wina zo wukoci,

nawo wuswanu wo wulangwe, wa bwete.

Ninga mucekulu mono kamogopaga Muwaha Mulungu,

yuyo langa, kotuga lilumbo.

31 Wumulumbaje mugolece wako, muli zose zono

yakwituma. Nayo, holeka kotuga lukumyo hali wanhu wose.


Muganuzi 1

I mikalile ya mono'nze, yo nghani ya bwete du.

1 Azi zo nghani zo muganuzi, u mwana wa Dawudi, mono yali mutemi ku Yelusalemi.

2 Yo nghani ya bwete du, yo nghani ya bwete du,

nghukulonjela mbeka ane no muganuzi!

Vinhu vyose, yo nghani ya bwete du!

3 Munhu kamotaga ci cici mu wipiganze wakwe wose wa mono'nze?

4 Ndelo na ndelo zipulutaga,

na ndelo zinji kanyhi zikuza,

ninga yinze, yene yikalaga cibitilila.

5 Lizuwa nalyo lisosomokaga,

kanyhi lizuwa liswezaga,

likubita musunho muno hanhu hono lilawaga.

6 Nayo mbeho yiputaga wulawilila lubavu lwe takama,

yiwa kuputa kanyhi no lubavu lwe sumuka,

yiputaga kali kenji du,

akuno yikupilima-pilima no kuwuyajila kukolela

mu wukolo wayo we nhondo zose.

7 Ne makolongo gose nago gahulumililaga kwi'lenga,

ninga 'lanje, lilenga si limemaga yaye hamba hadodo,

nago makolongo, kuko kono gahulumililaga,

kanyhi kuko ko galawililaga.

8 Ne zinghani zose, ziletaga mukatalo du,

mukatalo muwaha si wakulonga.

Meso getu nago, si gegutaga yaye no kulanga,

ne makutu getu nago,

hamba si gegutaga yaye no kuhuliciza.

9 Na zono zejela katali,

zo zizo du zono zokwijela kanyhi na lulu,

na zono zetumwa katali,

zo zizo du zono zokwitumwa kanyhi na lulu,

mono'nze musina nghani mhya, hamba monga.

10 I wanhu watezaga, “Lanje, ayi nghani mhya,”

kumbe nghani yiyo,

yali yili baho du ku wulawa katali,

na lono cali cikali nalelwa.

11 Na mbeka, hasina munhu mono kozikumbucila ze katali,

hamba mono kozikumbucila zono zikuza.

Ku wulawa lulu na mu vilo vyono vikuza.

Zono yaziwona Muganuzi

12 Ane no Muganuzi, nali nili mutemi we Waisilayeli, kuko ku Yelusalemi.
13 Nane nghapiligala muno kuzilondola-londola kwe mahala, no kuzisunjilila muno muno zose zono zikwitumwa mono'nze yiyi. Nawo wuwu wo mulimo muwaha, wono Mulungu yawapela wanhu.
14 Nane nghukulonjela, naziwona zose zono zikwitumwa mono'nze yiyi vyono, yo nghani ya bwete du, kanyhi wo wigaze du wono wusina cambuzi.

15 Naco cono cipetizye,

si cosuma kugoloswa,

naco cono cili hasina,

si cosuma kuwalwa.

16 Holeka mu wihwese wangu nghawa kutya, “Netujila mahala menji muno, kuciza wose wono wanongolela kuwa watemi mu Yelusalemi. Heya, alu nakondya kumanya nhunizo ye mahala co cici.”
17 Nghapiligala muno muno ho sume kumanya wisimajile we mahala, no lukwale, no wulele. Ninga nghamanya vyono, wunoza nhavivyo, wo wigaze we bwete du, wono wusina cambuzi co cose.

18 Hambi nha mu nghango yono kocila kuwa na mahala menji,

yo nghango yiyo du kanyhi,

yono kocila kwipela u wu wula mulamu mu nhumbula yako,

na mu nghango yono wukucila kuwa no wumanye winji,

ale yo nhavivyo kanyhi vyo kocila kwiyonjelezeza wukalale mu nhumbula yako.


Muganuzi 2

1 Holeka nghehwesa mu nhumbula yangu nghatya, “Leka ta niyinjize muli ze cinyemo-nyemo, ho sume kwisangalaza.” Ninga hamba nhavivyo, nghamanya vyono yiyo nayo, yo nghani ya bwete du.
2 Baho ho namanyila vyono, luseko nha lukwale du, na vyono nazo ze cinyemo-nyemo, kumbe zisina cambuzi co cose.
3 Nane naza kuwa nehwesa muno, hodu nghalamula nisangalaze mahala gangu ne divayi, ninga akuno ho nghali nghudindimizwa no wuhile wangu wo wutuga mahala. Kanyhi nghalamula vyono ciba cityatye ne wanhu walele, ho sume kuwona hono yiyo yo nzila swanu ye wanhu, ya mu mikalile yawo micefu ya baha hono'nze.

4 Netuma metumo mawaha, hambi nha nezenjela makaya, kanyhi nghelimila ne migunda ya zabibu.
5 Nghenozeza sunga ne busitani, hamonga ne viwanza, nghahadika mumo mibici ye mikalo ye mawala gose.
6 Nghahimba sunga ne malamba ge malenga, so wumwajilila malenga mibici yiyo.
7 Nghegulila sunga ne wawanda we cilume na we cicekulu, na wanji wakalelelwa mu kaya yangu. Nali nina sawo nyinji muno muno, matewa ge zing'ombe sunga ne zingholo nyinji muno, kuciza munhu wo wose mono yanongolela kwikala no kutema mu Yelusalemi.
8 Nane nghewutila mapesa menji muno, hamonga na zahabu nyinji, mu wulawa mu viwutwa vyo wutemi, vya mu zisi zono nali nizitemile. Sunga walume ne wacekulu, wose wakasangalaza so nyimbo zawo, nane nghetujila wacekulu wose wajitulwa waswanu, wono mulume wo wose, yali yawasulumile, wono nene no mweneco nasulumila kuwa nawo.
9 Nghawa mutambule muno muno kuciza wose wono wanongolela kwikala mu Yelusalemi, sunga ne mahala gangu nago, gakanojela muno muno.
10 Na co cose cono nacisaka, nacituga musunho muno. Hamba si neyimila muli ze nyemo yo yose yilya. Nane nghavisangalalila vyose vyono netuma. Nayo yiyo, yikawa wo musahala wangu so mulimo wono netuma.
11 Hanyuma nghawa kwamula kwihwesa muli zose zono nali netuma, na vyono nazituma ko wuhidimbazi wuwaha muno muno. Nghamanya vyono zose zizo kumbe zali nghani ya bwete, kotya wisumanize ne mbeho, musina cambuzi co cose mono'nze.

12 Hobaho nghawa kwihwesa nhunizo yo kuwa munhu we mahala, hamba kuwa wuli munhu mono si yaceleleye, hamba kuwa wuli mulele. Hambi mutemi nha kosuma kunoza du zono yanozaga mutemi mono yamulongolela.
13 Baho nghamanya vyono, kumbe kuwa na mahala, kuswanu si nho wulele, nha vyono winha wuzelu wuswanu wucizize citi.
14 Hambi munhu we mahala nha yena meso, nayo yamanyile na kono yakubita, ninga munhu mulele, kajendelaga mu wutitu du, hamba kumanya na kono yakubita. Ninga hamba nhavivyo kanyhi, nghamanya vyono kumbe, u munhu we mahala, hamonga no munhu mulele, wose mudumo wawo wo wumonga du.
15 Hobaho nghehwesa nghatya,

“Kumbe, zono zomwagana u munhu mulele, zo zizo du zono zonyagana na nene no mweneco. Alu co ca hayi 'mbi, co kuwa ne mahala gose gagano?” Ale, nghehwesa kanyhi ngheyipitula nili wene nghatya, “Ayi nayo mbeka, yo nghani ya bwete du.”
16 Hambi mbeka nha hasina munhu wo wose mono kamukumbucilaga we mahala, hamba mono kamukumbucilaga mulele. Hambi mu vilo vyono vikuza, wose nha wosemelwa lukulu. Hambi u munhu we mahala nha kafwizaga, sunga na ayulya munhu mulele, nayo kafwizaga!
17 Baho, hodu nghawa kuyisula i mikalile ya mono'nze, vyono zose zono zikwitumwa mono'nze, mbeka zamhela magaziko mawaha. Nazo zose zo nghani za bwete du, kumbe wo wigaze we bwete du, wono wusina cambuzi co cose.

18 Nane mbeka nghayisula ne milimo yangu yose yono netumaga baha mono'nze, hambi nha namanya vyono, nane, yowa yinojeye nimulecele munhu mono konhyatya mu wutemi.
19 Hambi nani kanyhi, mono komanya vyono yuyo mono kotema kowa munhu we mahala, hamba kowa mulele? Ninga hamba yiwe nhavivyo, mwene kotema muli zose zono netuma mu mahala gangu baha mono'nze. Ninga hamba yiwe nhavivyo, azo zose nha nghani ya bwete du.
20 Ale, naza kwihwesa kanyhi muli zose zono netuma mononze, mbeka nghawa kudobanya du.
21 Hambi munhu, nha ketumaga milimo, yakwitumila mahala, ko wizuce hamonga no wunghula wakwe wose, ninga kali kenji kamulecelaga munhu yunji mono yakutyatya, yuyo yo kawa kuzimota ze mana go mulimo, wono si yawulavizya nhuguti yaye. Yiyo nayo, mbeka yo nghani ya bwete du, kanyhi yo nghani yono 'mbi muno muno.
22 Mwene munhu kamotaga ci cici ca mu wuhidimbazi wo wipiganze wakwe wose mono'nze, hamonga ne mawine, no mukatalo vyono yatuga?
23 Hambi mikalile yakwe yose, nha yimemile magayo du, sunga no witume wakwe wukuwa nha nghani ya bwete, hambi nha sunga na mu cilo mose, mahala gakwe si gatulaga yaye! Zizo nazo go muyangu, yo nghani ya bwete du.

24 Gwe, hasina yinji swanu yono yimukwiliye munhu, langa hono si kulya no kung'wa, hamonga no kuwusangalalila mulimo wakwe. Yiyi nayo nghuwona vyono yilawaga kuli Mulungu,
25 vyono hono wulece kupegwa no Mulungu, si kosuma kuwa na ndigwa hamba si kosuma kusangalala yaye.

26 Hambi Mulungu nha kamupelaga mahala munhu mono yamwendile mweneco, hamonga no wizuce ne nyemo. Ninga u munhu mubi, Mulungu kamupelaga mulimo wo kududula no kulundilila du, hanyuma Mulungu kawa kumupela munhu yunji mono yakumwendeza. Ninga 'gwe, zizo zose nazo, nha nghani ya bwete du, kanyhi wo wigaze we bwete du, wono wusina cambuzi co cose.


Muganuzi 3

Mulungu yavipanjiye vyose, cinhu na cipango cayo

1 Nghani zose zono zikwijela mono'nze,

Mulungu yazipanjiye vipango vyayo.

2 Mulungu yapanjile cipango co kulelwa ne cipango co kufwa,

cipango co kuhadika, ne cipango co kududula,

3 cipango co kuwulaga, ne cipango co kuponya,

cipango co kumwagula, ne cipango co kuzenga,

4 cipango co kulila, ne cipango co kuseka,

cipango co kukalala, ne cipango co kuvina,

5 cipango co kwiyagaza mabwe,

ne cipango co kugakongholeza,

cipango co kwikumbatila,

ne cipango co kuleka kwikumbatila,

6 cipango co kulondola, ne cipango co kwajiliza,

cipango co kukamisa, ne cipango co kutaga,

7 cipango co kudemula, ne cipango co kuhona,

cipango co kunyamala, ne cipango co kulonga,

8 cipango co kwenda, ne cipango co kusula,

cipango co wulugu, ne cipango co mulamu.

9 Alu munhu kamotaga cici ca mu wihidimbaze wakwe?
10 Ane nawuwona vyono mulimo mukamu muno, wono Mulungu yamupela munhu.
11 Hambi Mulungu nha yavinoza vyose viwe viswanu, cinhu ne cipango cayo. Mulungu yamupelile munhu wuhile wo kumanyila za ku mwande, ninga si yamupela wuwe wo kusuma kumanya i metumo gose go Mulungu.
12 Nane manyile vyono ku lubavu lo munhu, koyili nghani monga du yono yomukwila, nha cinji, kusangalala, no kwituma ziswanu mu vilo vyose vyo wikale wakwe.
13 Ase wose, yicinojeye cilye no kung'wa, cisangalalile ziswanu ze milimo yetu. Hambi aci nha cipegwa co Mulungu.

14 Nane manyile vyono nghani yo yose yono Mulungu kayinozaga yikalaga cibitilila. No munhu si kosumila lukulu kuyonjeleza cinji hamba kuyicepula cinji yaye, hambi Mulungu nha yazinoza zose ziwe nha vyono zinha, i wanhu ho wamogope mwene.
15 Naco cono cikwijela kwi zuwali, nha cali cili baho du ku wulawa katali, na cono cokwijela hanyuma, nha cali cili baho du na katali. Nayo Mulungu kanozaga cinhu cijele mu vidaha hayo hayo, ninga cene cinhu co ci cilya du.

U wu wula wiling'ano mono'nze

16 Hamonga na zizo, nakondya kucimanya cinhu cinji kanyhi mononze, vyono i hanhu hono wulanjiliye vyono kowona i mbeka ne ling'ani, kumbe 'lu wavu wo wutemile.
17 Nane mu nhumbula yangu nghawa kutya, “Ale hodu, si nghani yaye! Hambi Mulungu nha yo kowaling'aniza we ling'ani sunga ne wabi nha vivyo, hambi nha yakondya kuwikaniza cipango cono cinojeye kuli vinhu vyose, na kuli vyose vyono vikwijela.”
18 Holeka nghawa kutya mu nhumbula yangu, “Mulungu yo kawajelaga wanhu wose, ho yawalajile nha vyono wene, wehwanile malimu du.”
19 Hambi u mudumo wo munhu no mudumo we malimu, nha wo wumonga du. Hambi munhu nha kafwizaga nha vyono lilimu nalyo lifwizaga. Na vyose vyehelaga nhavivyo. Holeka munhu si yalicizize lilimu cinji co cose yaye. Vyose kuli munhu na kwi'limu, yo nghani ya bwete du.
20 Wose wafwizaga no kuwuya kono walawa. Wose walawa mu manghundi, na wose wowuya kanyhi mu manghundi.
21 Hambi nani mono yamanyile vyono mbeka umuhe wo munhu wubitaga kucanyha, no muhe we lilimu wudodomelaga kusi yo muhangha?
22 Baho ho namanyila vyono, hasina nghani yono swanu kuciza yono munhu kosuma kuyinoza, langa hono si kusangalalila ziswanu ze milimo yakwe. Nayo Mulungu vyo yamuwiciye munhu nhavivyo. Alu nani 'mbi mono kosuma kumumanyiza munhu, zono zomutuga kumwande kolo yafwa?


Muganuzi 4

1 Hanyuma nghawona wiwonelwe wose wono wukwitumwa kono'nze. Ne wanhu wono wakwiwonelwa, wakulila mahozi, nawo wasina hamba yunji mono yakuwatuza, wasina munhu hamba yumonga mono kowataza, vyono wono wakuwewonela nha wali vilungo wawacizize wene.
2 Holeka nghawa kuwawonela wivu i wafu wono wakondya kubita i hanhu hono si walawuya akuno kanyhi, hambi wene nha wali ciba si nha wono wakali womi.
3 Ninga awalya wono wakali nalelwa no kuziwona zimbi zose zono zikwitumwa mono'nze, wawo nawo wali ciba si nha wono wafwa, hamba wono wakali womi.

4 Kanyhi ngheyijiza vyono kumbe wuhidimbazi wose wo munhu, hamonga no wunghula wakwe wose wa mu witume wakwe, vilawililaga mu wiwonela wivu munhu na muyagwe. Ninga yiyo nayo yo nghani ya bwete du, hambi nha yinha wikataze we bwete du.

5 Kanyhi yo nghani ya wulele du,

yo munhu kwikala hamba si wukwituma cinji,

hanyuma kuwa kufwa ne nzala.

6 Co ciba wuwe na cinhu cidodo du,

akuno wina no mulamu mu nhumbula,

si nha kwigaza na nghani nyinji,

hambi nha yinha wikataze we bwete du.

7 Kanyhi nghawona nghani yinji mono'nze yono yili bwete du.
8 Namuwona munhu yunji mono yasina mwana hamba nduguye, hamba nhavivyo, mwene si kalekaga kwituma milimo, kanyhi mwene hamba si yakuwa kuca ne sawo yakwe, hamba si ketuzaga akuno yakwiwuza yakutya, “Ale mwene, nghumwitumamila nani mwene mono yakunyambuza nghwikapisa sunga ndece kusangalala mu ziswanu?” Ayo mbeka yo nghani ya bwete du kanyhi yo nzila'mbi ye nyikala.

9 Kanyhi yili ciba hono muwe wejete, si nha kuwa wuli wene. Hambi i wejete nha wotuga cihumbilizwa ca mu mulimo wawo.
10 Na hono yunji yagwe, ale, yuyo muyagwe komwinula. Ninga woyi he kuli mono yali wene kolo yeza kugwa! Hambi yuyo nha kowa yasina munhu mono komwinula!
11 Vyo nhavivyo kanyhi, hono wejete wagone hamonga, wosuma kwipela civuce, ninga munhu hono yawe yali wene, alu ho kosuma nhawule kwipela civuce yali wene?
12 Na kanyhi, munhu hono yawe yali wene, nha kusumwa no mulugu, ninga hono wawe wanhu wejete, womwimila mulugu no kumusuma. Kanyhi wumanye vyono, hono milejehe midatu yibotelezwe hamonga, si kupelu yaye kuyidumula lwa kamonga.

13 Yali ciba muzelelo muciwa we mahala, yuyo yamucizize mutemi mukombi kanyhi mulele, mono si yendile kubocela mafundo maswanu.
14 Ku soko kuli mwene hamba yawe yali yalawiliye mu jela, nalu yatema, hamba yawe yali yaleleywe mu wuciwa, nalu yawa mutemi, ayo si nghani yaye.
15 Nane nghehwesa kuli ze wanhu wose wono wekaye kono'nze, nghamanya vyono muli wene, moyuli muzelelo mono kosuma kutema hanhu ho mutemi mukombi.

16 Liwalo lye wanhu lyali lisina mudumo, ninga mwene yakawatema wose. Ninga hamba nhavivyo, awalya wono wakulelwa, si wosuma kumwenda yaye. Ninga mbeka yiyo nayo, yo nghani ya bwete du, kanyhi wo wigaze we bwete du, wono wusina hamba cambuzi co cose.


Muganuzi 5

Wulece kwihuwiza musunho

1 Ale wiyilanjililaje, wulece kwinjila caka mu Nyumba yo Mulungu. Yowa ciba kuli'gwe hono winjile mu Nyumba yo Mulungu ho wuhulicize viswanu no kwiyijiza, si nha kulavya cilavywa nha vyono wanozaga wanhu walele, wanhu wono si wamanyile kuzitemanula ziswanu ne zimbi.
2 Kanyhi weze kwamula kwihwesa lono wukali si nalonga cinji, hamba wulece kuwa wuli mupelu ku wihuwiza co cose kuli Mulungu, hambi Mulungu nha yali ku wulanga nagwe wuli mono'nze. Holeka wulece kulonga nghani nyinji nha vyono yikunojeye.

3 Hambi nha munghango ye mahwele gako,

vyo nhavivyo vyo kolota ne zindoto zimbi,

na vyo yinha kanyhi,

munghango ya mu wulonji wako we zinghani zi nyinji,

yikuwa kupelu ku wulonga mumo ne zinghani zo wulele.

4 Holeka hono wihuwize kuli Mulungu, ale, wuwufisilizaje mbela wihuwizo wako. Hambi mwene Mulungu nha si kendezwaga ne wanhu walele. Holeka yikunojeye wufisilize cono wihuwize.
5 Hambi nha yowa ciba kuli'gwe hono wulece kwihuwiza cinji, si nha kwihuwiza, hamba kufisiliza yaye wihuwizo wako.
6 Kanyhi wulece kuzileceleza zinghani zako zikutegule mu wusutye, hanyuma kanyhi wuwe kumulonjela u mwitumami wo Mulungu wukutya, “Wayiko, si nozize ne nyono yaye.” Alu ho socici wukusaka kumunoza Mulungu yakukolelwe likuwo? Hamba socici wumunoze Mulungu yayihodanje milimo yako?
7 Ninga wumanye vyono, mu wulota ndoto nyinji, ayo si nghani yaye. Langa mu wulonga nghani nyinji, amo langa mo wuli wajilile. Ninga nghani mbaha, wumogope Mulungu wako.

Mikalile ya mono'nze yo nghani ya bwete du

8 Na kanyhi wulece kwizina, hono wuwone mu yisi, wanhu waciwa wakwiwonelwa, hamba si wakunozezwa ling'ani ne walongola we yisi, kuli zono zinojeye watendelwe. Ninga wumanye vyono, munhu wo wose we lilumbo liwaha mu yisi, mono yakuwewonela i wasocele, yuyo nayo yali hasi yo muwaha yunji, na muli wawo wose vyono wejete, ho yuli muwaha yunji kanyhi mono yawacizize wene.
9 Ninga hamba nhavivyo, yowa ciba hono mutemi yepiganzize mu mulimo wo kulima, hambi nha co cambuzi ce wanyawusi wose.

10 Kanyhi wumanye vyono, mono yendile mapesa, yuyo hamba si kokwigushwa na mapesa yaye hamba yatye, hambi yiyo nayo, nha nghani ya bwete du.
11 Na munghango yo wonjelezece we sawo, ale, yo nhavivyo na wanya kulya nawo, vyo wonjelezekaga, nayo munya sawo, wukwihwesa yakuwa kukwizwa na cici, mu sawo yiyo? Mwene langa mulimo wakwe kuyilanga du sawo yakwe.
12 Mbeka nghukulonjela vyono, zinhongo zo mwituma mulimo, hamba yalye yegute, hamba yekale si yegute, ninga ku cilo kagonaga nhongo swanu muno. Ninga mugoli, ayo kekalaga yehweleye du nhondo zose, hambi winjipe we sawo yakwe nha wumugazaga du cilo cose.

13 Kanyhi nakondya kuyiwona nghani yinji 'mbi muno muno mono'nze, yono munhu keyiwicilaga, sawo yono hanyuma yayo, hamba si yomutaza cinji co cose.
14 Na hanji zimbali zijelaga, nayo kawa kuyajiliza sawo yiyilya yose, hamba kusigalilwa na cinhu cinji, cono na lunji, yali yamupele hamba mwanagwe.
15 Na vyo yinha, hambi munhu nha vyono yaza mononze yali cipwi yasina cinji co cose, mu wulawa mu'nda yo nyina, ale, vyo nhavivyo vyo kolowuya kanyhi yali cipwi kuko kono yalawilila. Hamba si kosuma kusoleleza na cinji co cose ca mu nhuguti yakwe.
16 Nayo nghani yiyi yo 'mbi du muno muno. Ati du kowuya nha vyono yaza. Na mbeka yegazaga du na nghani ya bwete.
17 Nayo ho yakekala mu citi no wukalale, na mu wugazice, hamonga na mu matamwa ne likuwo mu mikalile yakwe yose ya mono'nze.

18 Alu azi ane zo nakondya kuziwona, vyono kumbe, nghani swanu yono yomukwila munhu yoyi, kulya, kung'wa hamonga no kusangalalila mana gono yetujiye mu nhuguti yakwe mu milimo yono yakwituma bahano hono'nze, mu vilo vivyo vicefu du vya mu wikale wakwe, vyono Mulungu yamupeye, hambi nha vyo yawicilwa no Mulungu.
19 Holeka hono yawe Mulungu yamupeye munhu wugoli ne sawo, kanyhi yawe yamupelile ne cilejeho co kuvitumamila no kuvisangalalila vivyo, ale, yimunojeye munhu yuyo yalumbe, kanyhi yavimotaje vivyo vyono yetujiye mu nhuguti yakwe mweneco. Hambi avyo nha cipegwa du cilawa kuli Mulungu.
20 Na vyono Mulungu yo yamukomboye yawe no wusangalale, holeka munhu si kosuma kuwa na mahwele mu mikalile yakwe yiyi ye vilo vicefu.


Muganuzi 6

1 Nayiwona kanyhi nghani yinji 'mbi mono yinze, kanyhi yo nghani nzito muno kuli wanhu.
2 Mulungu kamupelaga munhu wugoli, sawo, hamonga ne lilumbo, ho yalece kwanjila cinji co cose cono yakucisaka, ninga si kamupelaga wusume wo kuvisangalalila vinhu vivyo, langa mujenzi yo kovilya. Yiyi nayo yo nghani ya bwete du, kanyhi yo nghani 'mbi.
3 Munhu yadahile kuwa na wana yigana limonga, hamonga no wikale mononze myaka minji. Ninga hono munhu yuyo yalece kuyisangalalila mikalile yakwe, hamba kuzikwa mu citenjelo kwe lilumbo kose, mbeka, u mwana mono yaleligwe yafwiye, kowa yali ciba, si nha munhu yuyo.
4 Hambi u mwana mono yafwiye, nha si kamotaga cinji co cose so wulelwe wakwe, langa mwene kajililaga du mu citi, hodu, wawa kumusemwa.
5 Hamonga na zizo, u mwana we liwala lilyo, si yawuwene no wuzelu we lizuwa yaye, hamba kusuma kuwumanya wumi vyono winha.
6 Ninga hamba nhavivyo u mwana yuyo, yakutuga wucehe wono ayulya munhu si kowutujila lukulu, hamba yekale sunga yamale myaka elufu nyejete. Hambi wose nha wobita hanhu hamonga du.

7 Hambi munhu nha katugutilaga so wusaka ndigwa du, ninga lu, hamba si kegutaga yaye.
8 Alu, wule, wukwihwesa vyono u munhu we mahala, kowa yali ciba hongo, si nha yulya u munhu mulele? Ma, u munhu muciwa, katugaga cambuzici, hono yawe yamanyile vyono yimunojeye yekale, mu mikalile yakwe?
9 Mbeka yiyo yo nghani ya bwete du, kanyhi wo wigaze we bwete wono wusina cambuzi co cose. Ciba weze wuceye na cono wina naco, si nha kugazika nhondo zose, ne masulumizi go wusulumila kutuga vinhu vinji.

10 Ninga wumanye vyono, vyose vyono vikwijela, vyawikwa ku wulawa katali na katali, u wuwe wo munhu nha wumanyice, kanyhi cimanyiye lukulu vyono u musocele, si kosuma kwisumaniza no munhu we vilungo.
11 Kanyhi wumanye vyono, u wuwanji, wusina cambuzi hamba hadodo, hambi nha si wusumaga kumunyasuliza munhu.
12 Hambi nani lo mono yazimanyile zono zomukwila munhu, mu mikalile yiyi micefu, yono yisina hamba cambuzi co cose, i mikalile yono yipulutaga du nha mwenzenze? Hamba nani lo mono yali mono'nze yiyi, mono yazimanyile zono zomwagana munhu, kolo yakondya kufwa?


Muganuzi 7

I mafundo ga mu mikalile

1 Lilumbo liswanu lili ciba,

si nhe mafuta gono gena mhunjile swanu go wuguzi wukamu.

Kanyhi lizuwa lyo kufwa lili ciba si nhe lizuwa lyo kulelelwa.

2 Ciba kubita ku cililo, si nho kubita ku sikukuu,

kanyhi i womi yiwanojeye wakumbucile vyono,

lifwa licilindiye sese wose.

3 Kanyhi wukalale wuli ciba, si nho luseko,

hambi nhumbula nha yitugaga cambuzi ku soko yo wukalale wa ha wusu.

4 I nhumbula ya we mahala yizitununhicilaga zinyumba za wono wafwiliywe.

Ninga nhumbula yo munhu mulele,

yene yihwesaga zo wumote du.

5 Yo nghani swanu kuhuliciza mafundo ga we mahala,

si nha kuzihuliciza zinyimbo ze wanhu walele.

6 Hambi luseko lo munhu mulele,

nha lwihwanile no mulilo we mamivya,

lono gakutakamila mu moto.

Yiyo nayo yo nghani ya bwete du.

7 Nayo munhu we mahala,

hono yamusolele munhu yunji cinhu cakwe ko kumwiwonela,

yakwituma nghani ya wulele.

Nawo wubocela mafupo,

wubofuzaga mahala.

8 No mudumilizo we nghani, wuli ciba,

si nha ku mwamulizo wayo,

nayo munhu mukangalizi,

yuyo yo muswanu, si nho munhu mwidunhumuzi.

9 Holeka wulece kuwa mupelu ku wukolwa likuwo,

hambi likuwo nha wo wuwe we wanhu walele.

10 Kanyhi, wulece kuwuza wuwe kutya,

“Alo nhawule i vilo vye katali vyali viswanu,

si nhe vilo vya lulu?”

Wumanye vyono liwuzo lyono linha lilino,

si lilawaga mu mahala yaye.

11 Nago mahala, makamu muno gehwanile no wuhazi,

holeka yo nghani mbaha yono yinojeye kuli wanhu wose wono wakali womi.

12 Holeka, wudimwa ne mahala,

wihwanile no wudimwa ne mapesa, hambi mahala,

nha gamukamisaga mono yena nago.

13 Wihwesaje ta ze metumo go Mulungu,

wukwihwesa nani 'mbi mono kosuma kugolosa cono yacipetizye Mulungu?

14 Holeka mu vilo vyono wukali watuga vinji, ale, weze wina wusangalale, na mu vilo vyo wugaye navyo, ale wihwesaje nghani yiyi, vyono, u wutuga vinji, no wugaye, vyose vilawaga kuli Mulungu, ninga munhu si kosuma kumanya za hanyuma zono zikuza.

15 Na mu mikalile yangu yo wuciwa, nakondya kuziwona nghani zose, vyono kumbe u munhu we ling'ani, nayo kafwizaga du hamba yawe yali ling'ani, ninga u munhu mubi kajendelelaga kuwumipa du hamba yawe mubi.
16 Holeka, wulece kuciziliza kuwa we ling'ani, hamba wulece kuwa we mahala muno! Alo socici wiyongomeze go mweneco?
17 Ninga kanyhi, wulece kuwa wuli munhu mubi kuciza, hamba wulece kuwa wuli mulele! Socici lo wufwe lono vilo vyako vikali?
18 Holeka yikunojeye wulece kuciziliza muli vivyo vinhu vyejete. Hambi mono yamogopile Mulungu, nha si kosuma kugwizwa na nghani yo yose muli zizo.

19 Nago mahala gamupelaga vilungo munhu we mahala, kuciza wanhu yikumi, wono watemile mwi'kaya.
20 Na mbeka, hasina munhu wo wose mono'nze mono yali ling'ani, mono ketumaga ziswanu du nhondo zose, hamba kwituma wubi yaye.

21 Kanyhi wulece kuwa kwihwesa vyono, nghani zose za mbeka zono walongaga wanhu, hambi nha kosuma kuhulika vyono mwitumami wako kakuliga,
22 nagwe komanya go mweneco vyono nagwe kuwaligaga wanhu kali kenji.

Kulomba mahala

23 Nane nghazipima kwe mahala zizo zose, hanyuma nghawa kwihwesa mu nhumbula yangu nghatya, “Alu mwene nghusaka niwe munhu we mahala, hongo!” Ninga lu mahala, nha gali kutali muno nane.
24 Alu mwene, munhu kosuma kumanya nhawule nhunizo yo wikala mumi? Mbeka nghani yiyi nzito, kanyhi nghamu muno muno kuli'se.
25 Ninga hamba nhavivyo, nghahidimbala muno mu wumanye, no kulanga-langa, sunga no kulondola muno mahala, hamonga ne nhunizo ya zono zili baha, kanyhi ho sume kumanya u wubi wo wulele vyono winha, u wulele wo wu wula mahala.

26 Kanyhi ho yili nghani yinji yono nghayiwona, nghani yono 'mbi muno muno kuciza lifwa, yo nghani yo mucekulu, mono nhumbula yakwe, yikuwa kugwiza nha mutego hamba lwavu, ne miwoko yakwe yihwanile manyolo. Ninga munhu mono yamogopile Mulungu, yakuwa kumwilega u mucekulu we liwala lilyo. Ninga u munhu mubi, ayo ketegulizaga du ho yagwizwe nayo.
27 Azi zo nghukulonjela ane no Muganuzi, vyono zo naziwona lono nazilondelelaga hadodo hadodo.
28 Nane nghahidimbala muno kali kenji ho nizimanye zizo, ninga hamba si nasuma yaye. Mu wanhu walume elufu monga, nghasuma kumuwona mulume monga du mono yanojeye lilumbo, ninga muli wacekulu wose we liwalo nha lilyo, si nasuma kumuwona mucekulu hamba monga mono yanojeye lilumbo.
29 Alu kanyhi ko yili nghani yinji monga, yono nakondya kuyimanya, nayo yoyi, vyono Mulungu yaciwumba cili waswanu kanyhi cili wedodofyi, ninga sese co weneco, ciketajila mu mahodango.


Muganuzi 8

1 Alo nani mbi mono yehwanile na we mahala?

Hamba nani mono yadahile kuwulolosa wuwe weneco,

we vinhu vyono vinha?

Hambi mahala go munhu, nha gang'alazaga wusu wakwe,

no kugawusa manghunya-nghunya ga mu wusu wakwe.

Weze ne cihuliko kuli mutemi

2 Nane nghukulonjela nghutya, Weze wuli cihuliko kuli zose zono mutemi yakuzilajiliza, ku soko yo wilahize wako wa kuli Mulungu.
3 Wulece kuwuka musunho hali mutemi, hamba wulece kujendelela kwituma zono si zikwendeza, hambi mutemi, nha kanozaga nha vyono yendile mweneco.
4 Nalyo lilajilizo lyo mutemi, nha yo nghani ye ndumilizo, nani kanyhi 'mbi mono kosuma kumuwuza yawe kutya, alu wukunoza nhawule.
5 Nayo mono kakamisaga malajilizo, yuyo kekalaga yapolile du, nayo munhu we mahala, kamanyaga vyono ko lili lizuwa lyo wulipicizwe.
6 Heya, hambi nha ho wuli wuling'anizwe we vinhu vyose, holeka munhu, mbeka yena mahodango mawaha,
7 hambi nha si yacimanyile cicici cono cokwijela hanyuma yayo. Alo nani 'mbi mono kosuma kumumanyiza zono zolokwijela ha nyuma?
8 Hambi nha hasina munhu wo wose mono kosuma kuyibatiliza nhumbula yakwe ho yalece kufwa, hamba hasina munhu wo wose mono kosuma kwiyimila ho yalece kufwa. Wumanye vyono, mwipango lyo wulugu, hasina mono kosuma kulekwa, ale, nhavivyo no wubi nawo, si womuponya u munhu mubi.

I wabi, na we ling'ani

9 Na mu wulondole-londole wangu, nghaziwona zizi zose zono zikwitumwa bahano hono yinze, vyono, hono munhu yawe yena vilungo, hodu kovitumamila vilungo vivyo ko kumwiwonela no kumutamisa munhu muyagwe.
10 Na kanyhi niwawene ne wanhu wabi vyono wakuzikwa, i wanhu wono wali wazoweye kwinjila no kulawila mu Nyumba yo Mulungu, hamonga no kukumywa muno mwi'kaya mono wetumilaga zo wavu wawo. Ninga yiyo nayo nghani ya bwete du.
11 Alu na vyono wubi si wulipicizwaga musunho, holeka zinhumbula ze wanhu, zihidimbalilaga mu wituma zimbi du.
12 Wuwalangaje ta wanyo wubi, vyono wetumaga zimbi kali cigana, ninga hamba nhavivyo, vyo wajendeleye du kuwumipa. Ninga ane manyiye lukulu vyono, i nyemo yiwalindiye wono wamogopile Mulungu, ku soko ye cogopo cawo,
13 ninga kuli wabi, ako kusina nyemo hamba hadodo. Wawo wene, wopuluta nha mwenzenze, si wosuma kuwuponya wumi wawo, hambi nha si wamogopile Mulungu yaye.
14 Kanyhi hoyili nghani yinji 'mbi yono nakondya kuyiwona baha hono yinze, vyono i wanhu waswanu, wakuwa kutendelwa zimbi, zono ziwanojeye i wanhu wabi wo watendelwe, nawo i wabi wakutendelwa ziswanu, zono ziwanojeye i i wanhu waswanu, wo watendelwe. Nane nghatya, ayi mbeka yo nghani ya bwete du.

15 Ninga ane nihuwiye vyono, u munhu yanojeye yawe yali mu wumote muno, vyono ahano hono yinze, hasina cinji ciswanu cono cicizize kulya no kung'wa, hamonga no kwiyendeza. Azi zo munhu kosuma kuzituma mu wipiganze wakwe we milimo, mu vilo vyo wikale wakwe wa baha hono yinze, vyono Mulungu komupela.
16 Na lono najelaga kuhidimbala muno, ho sume kumanya mahala, hamonga no kwiyijiza zono zikwitumwa mono'nze, nghatanga vyono kosuma kugona meso bwete,
17 hamba kusuma kuzimanya zo Mulungu. Hamba wuhidimbale muno muno gwee, si kosumila lukulu kuzimanya yaye. Wanhu we mahala, wadahile kwiyitya wene wazimanyile, ninga i mbeka kumbe, ho si wamanyile cinji yaye.


Muganuzi 9

1 Nane nghehwesa muli zizo zose, nghawona vyono, kumbe Mulungu du yali wene, yo katongaga ze metumo gose ga we mahala hamonga na ga we ling'ani, hamba wuwe wendo hamba wuwe lusulo, wanhu si wamanyile yaye. Hamba hasina munhu wo wose mono kosuma kuzimanya zono zomwijelela hanyuma,
2 hambi i we ling'ani ne wabi, waswanu ne wavu, watelevu na wono wetipize, wono wakumbikaga na wono si wakumbikaga, wose wawo mudumo wawo monga du. Hambi u muswanu, nha vihwanile du no mubi, nayo mono yakwilahiza, si visimajiye yaye na mono si yakwilahiza.
3 Nayo ayi yo nghani yono 'mbi muno muli zose zono zili mononze, vyono, wose wena mudumo monga du. Kanyhi na vyono wanhu mu mikalile yawo yose, wekalaga wamemile wavu no wulele mu zinhumbula zawo, na hanyuma yayo wawa kufwa.
4 Ninga kuli mono yakali vili hamonga ne womi, ayo yakali yena witumbilo, hambi nha wo wutya, “Ilibwa lyono lili nyumi nha lili ciba, si nha lisimba lyono lifwiye.”
5 Hambi wono wakali womi, nha wamanyaga vyono wofwa, ninga wono wafwiye, si wamanyaga cinji co cose. Hambi nha wasina cipegwa cinji kanyhi, langa wene wakondya du kusemelwa lukulu.
6 U wendo wawo no lusulo lwawo, sunga ne masulumizi gawo, vyose vivyo vyajililana hamonga nawo, na hodu du, hamba si wowa ne'fungu lyo lyose kanyhi mono'nze.

7 Holeka, wubite wukalye ndigwa yako ko wusangalale, wukang'we ne divayi yako ne nhumbula yono wusangalaye, hambi Mulungu nha yakondya kuyilumbiliza milimo yako.
8 Ale wivwikaje viswanu, wibace ne mafuta mu mutwe wako.
9 Wuyisangalalile mikalile yako hamonga no mugolece wako mono wumwendile muno, mu vilo vyose vyo wikale wako wono wusina cambuzi, wono Mulungu yakupelile baha hono'nze. Hambi yiyino, nha yo wapegwa mu wikale wako wa mu milimo yako ya bahano hono'nze.
10 Nghani yo yose yono wendile kuyituma, wuyitumaje kwe vilungo vyako vyose, hambi ku yisi ye wafu kono kobita, nha kusina milimo, hamba lihweso lyo lyose, hamba wumanye, hamba mahala bwete.

Zimbali zizaga nhinicizo

11 Kanyhi nakondya kuciwona cinhu cinji mono'nze, vyono i wanhu wamanyhi muno, hamba si wawasumaga wayawo mu midawalo yo kwitiga lumangho. Nawo we vilungo, hamba si wasumaga wulugu, nawo we mahala, hamba si watugaga ndigwa. Nawo wono wena wizuce, hamba si wagolipaga yaye, nawo wanghula, hamba si wapegwaga lilumbo lya hacanyha yaye. Ne lyuwa liwazizaga wose du.
12 Hamba yunji si yamanyile lizuwa lono lipango lyakwe lyomuficila. Nha vyono zisomba zikuwa kwibatwa no lwavu wula kumanya, nha vyono kanyhi zindeje nazo, zikuwa kugwila mu mitego nhinicizo, ale, ne wanhu nawo, vyo wenjilaga mu zimbali nhavivyo lono si walanjiliye.

13 Ho yili nghani yinji kanyhi yono nayiwona, yono yikulajila viswanu vyono, kumbe mahala mono'nze, gakwiliye muno muno.
14 Kwali na cikaya cinji cidodo vivi, cono cina wekazi waco wacefu. Ale yakaza mutemi yunji we vilungo, yakacipilima cikaya cico, yakewikaniza yacihome.
15 Na mu cikaya cico, mwali moyuli yunji, munhu we mahala, ninga muciwa muno, mono ku so mahala gakwe, yasuma kuciponya cikaya cico. Ninga hamba nhavivyo, hasina hamba munhu monga mono hanyuma yasuma kumukumbucila u muciwa yuyo.
16 Ku soko yiyo, holeka nane nghutya nhavi, “Mbeka kumbe mahala gacizize vilungo, hamba yiwe mahala go muciwa si gatondowozwa, ne zinghani zakwe hamba kuhulicizwa yaye.

17 Ninga yili ciba wuzihulicize zinghani zo wutule za we mahala,

si nha kuhuliciza mazozo go mutemi mu wihangulize we wanhu walele.

18 Holeka ku wuwa ne mahala, kuswanu muno,

kucizize u witumbila vitwalo.

Ninga hamba nhavivyo,

u munhu mubi yumonga,

kahodangaga nyinji ziswanu.”


Muganuzi 10

1 Mahazi gono gafwiye,

gatajilaga munungho mubi mu mafuta ge mhunjile swanu,

ale, no wulele wudodo nawo,

wuhodangaga mahala ne lilumbo.

2 U munhu we mahala,

nhumbula yakwe yimutongaga ku wituma zo mugoloka,

ninga u mulele, nhumbula yakwe yimwajilizaga.

3 Nayo mulele, hamba yawe yakolile mu nzila,

yamanyice du, hambi nha kalonjelaga wanhu wose,

vyono mwene mulele.

4 Holeka hono mulongola yakukolelwe likuwo,

wulece kwizila, weze manya vyono,

masutya mawaha gapatilwaga mu wutuvu.

5 Kanyhi ho wuli wubi wunji wono nakondya kuwuwona mono'nze, u wubi wono wukuletwa ne walongola,
6 Vyono ati milimo yo wulongola wakupegwa i wanhu walele, nawo i wagoli, wakusola vilejeho vya hasi.
7 Kanyhi niwawene wetumami wakujendela mu zifwalasi, ninga i wawaha we lilumbo, wakujenda kwa migulu nha wetumami.

8 Na hono wuhimbe yikweme,

kogwila go mweneco mumo,

na hono wumwagule lijinji,

ale, lizoka lyokuluma.

9 Na lono wukuhimbula mabwe,

wumanye vyono gokutamisa,

na lono wukutenya ngwagu,

naho wumanye vyono zimbali nazo zokwagana.

10 Hono witumile nhemo nduje yono si nole,

yosaka witumile vilungo muno,

ninga mu witumamila mahala,

munhu katugaga cambuzi.

11 Ne lizoka hono lilume lono likali nakulugwa,

hodu u mukulujizi hamba si kosakwa kanyhi.

12 Izinghani za we mahala,

zimupelaga cambuzi mono yakuzilonga,

ninga u munhu mulele,

keyongomezaga mweneco ko wulonje wakwe.

13 Hambi u mulele, nha kelonganjicilaga nghani zo wulele,

no wulonje wakwe,

kawumalililaga mu ciwula mahala wakwe.

14 U mulele, kalonganjikaga nghani nyinji muno muno.

Ninga hasina munhu mono yazimanyile zono zolowa hanyuma,

hamba hasina mono kosuma kucimanyiza,

zono zolowa hanyuma kolo cafwiza.

15 Umulele yakuwa kukatazwa no mulimo wakwe mweneco,

sunga kawa kwajililwa ne nzila yo kuwuyila ku kaya yakwe.

16 Woyi, hee, kuli'gwe, go yisi,

hono mulongola wako yawe yakali muzelelo,

ne walongola wako hono wanoze sikukuu hakali mitondo!

17 Agwe go yisi, kowa wuli ciba,

hono mulongola wako yawe yena wuwe wono wukamile.

Na hono walongola wako wanoze sikukuu mwi'pango lyono linojeye,

ho wetujile vilungo,

ninga si ko wugale yaye.

18 Nalyo litembe, lidodomelaga ku soko yo wudoba wo munhu,

ne nyumba nayo,

yisululaga ku soko yo wu wula kutondowozwa.

19 Ndigwa nyinji, yiletaga wusangalale, nayo divayi,

yisangalazaga mikalile.

Nago mapesa go gaziletaga zizo zose.

20 Wulecele lukulu kumulijita mono yatemile hamba mu nhumbula yako,

wulece kumulijita mugoli,

hamba mu cinyumba cako co kugona,

ku soko sunga ne zindeje nha zolihulika lizi lyako,

naco ciwumbwa cono cigulukaga,

nha cozanza zinghani zako.


Muganuzi 11

Vyono kanozaga u munhu we mahala

1 Wujele lyuwa lyako, wunoze wusuluza,

wugumile ndigwa yako mu malenga,

nagwe kotuga cambuzi mu vilo vicefu!

2 Wagawile wanhu zisawo zako,

hambi nha si wumanyile yimbi yono yokwagana mono'nze.

3 Mavunde kolo gamema malenga,

mvula yitonyaga, ne libici nalyo,

hono ligwile kutakama hamba kusumuka,

baho hono lyogwila, ho lyokwikala du.

4 Nayo mono kalindilaga sunga mbeho yitule ho yahadice,

yuyo hamba si kohadika yaye,

nayo mono kalindilaga sunga mavunde gawuce,

yuyo si kodudula cinji.

5 Nagwe si wumanyile na vyono mida yinjilaga, hamba no wumi vyono wukuwa kwanza mumo mu'nda yo mucekulu mono yena muda. Holeka yo nhavivyo kanyhi vyo si kosuma kugamanya metumo go Mulungu, mono kazinozaga zose.
6 Holeka lono wukuhadika mbeyu zako, wuhadice mwi'pango lye hakali mitondo na mwi'pango lye cinyamihe nhavivilya, hambi nha si wumanyile za hayi zono zokota, hono za hakali mitondo, hamba ze cinyamihe, hamba lunji zose.

7 Heya, wuzelu wuswanu muno, no ku wulanga lizuwa nako, kwendezaga meso.
8 Holeka, munhu hono yawe yena myaka minji yo wikale wakwe, yimunojeye yayisangalalile myaka yiyo yose, akuno yakukumbucila vyono, i vilo vibi, navyo vinji nhavivyo, na kanyhi, vyono zose zono zokwijela zowa za bwete du.

Mafundo kuli wazelelo

9 Gwe go muzelelo wusangalalile wudodo wako, nhumbula yako yiwusangalalile wuzelelo wako, witume nghani yo yose yono wendile kwituma, wutyatye wuhile we nhumbula yako, ninga akuno wukumbucile vyono Mulungu kokuling'aniza, mu nghango ya zizo zose.
10 Wulece kuwa na mahwele, langa wutuzaje du mutima wako, weze wuli mwiyimizi, ho wulece kwinjila mu zimbali. Weze kukumbucila vyono si kojendelela kuwa wuli mudodo du vilo vyose.


Muganuzi 12

1 Wumukumbucilaje Muwumbi wako mu vilo vyo wuzelelo wako, lono i vilo vibi vikali si vinaza yaye, hamba lono yikali si yinaza yono kolotya nhavi, “Aa, vinhu avi vyose hamba si vikunyendeza kanyhi yaye.”

2 Holeka wuzitumaje zizino lono lizuwa likali natukuwazwa,

hamonga no wuzelu, no mwezi,

sunga ne zinyelezi zose,

na lono mavunde gakali sinagubika kanyhi,

lono mvula yikali yawuka.

3 Mwi'pango lono i miwoko yako yono yakukamisaga, yolocicima, ne migulu yako yono yili vilungo, nayo yolowa yisina vilungo. Ne meno gako, nago golowa gasina vilungo vyo kutafunyila ndigwa yako, ne meso gako nago golowa si gakuwona viswanu.
4 Nago i makutu gako si gakuhulika i mazozo ga mu zinzila. Hamba si kolohulika bwete ne lizozo lye masine yo kusaga, hamba mulilo we masumbi yaye, hambe mazozo ge zindeje, si golokusinhusa yaye mu zinhongo.
5 Mwi'pango lono wanhu wowa wena woga, no wogofywe wotagalila mu zinzila zose. Sunga no wujendanje wose ako na ako wowa wukamu muno muno. Mwi'pango lono kowa wakombipa, watuga 'mvwi zose, lono kolowa kweza kukamu muno kuli'gwe kujenda, lono no wusulumizi wako wose wowa wakondya kuwuka.

Wumanye nha vyono cikubita ku wikalo we cibitilila, na holowa cililo ciwaha mu zinzila.
6 Baho langa, u luputi lwe fweza ho lolodumucila, ne tala ye zahabu nayo, baho ho yilatulicilaa. Ne liguludumu nalyo lyo kukwejela malenga mwi'sima lyolobeneka, ne njilo ye malenga yilatulika.
7 Ale, mwi'pango lilyo, nagwe go munhu mono wuli manghundi, muwili wako nagwe, ho wulawuyila mu manghundi kono walawilila, no muhe wako nawo, womuwuyila Mulungu mono yacipela.
8 Yo nghani ya bwete du, yo nghani ya bwete du, ane nghukulonjela mbeka no Muganuzi! Vinhu vyose vyono wukuviwona, mbeka yo nghani ya bwete du.

Ze ndumilizo

9 Nayo Muganuzi ku soko ye mahala gakwe, yakajendelela kuwejiza wanhu zo wumanye wakwe. Yakazihwesa muno mu nhumbula yakwe, yakazilondola-londola no kuyimanya imbeka yazo. Hanyuma yakawa kuziloloseza mu wumanye wakwe.
10 Nayo Muganuzi yakehidimbaza muno yatuje zinghani zono zikwendeza, nayo yakawa kuzandika mu nghango yo wunghula wakwe, zinghani zose zono zili mbeka.
11 Nazo zinghani ze wanhu we mahala, zihwanile zinghome zono zina visonje, zono wadimi wazitumamilaga kuzitonga zingholo. Ne zimbazi zono zikonghoywe no kuwikwa hamonga, zizo zikalaga zikamile kotya zimambo zono nghomanhilwe hasi. Hambi nha zalawa kuli Mulungu u mudimi yumonga wa sese wose.

12 Ninga hamonga na zizo, 'gwe mwanangu, nghukunena wilanjililaje! Weze kumanya vyono u wandici we vitabu, wusina ndumo, no wusoma muno nawo, wuletaga wukatale wuwaha wo muwili.
13 Hamonga na zizo zose, ho yili nghani monga kanyhi ye ndumilizo, nayo yoyi, “Mogopaje Mulungu, kanyhi wibate ne malajilizo gakwe.” Yiyi yo nghani mbaha muno, yo yaleka munhu yakawumbwa ho yayitume.
14 Hambi Mulungu nha koloyiling'aniza milimo yetu yose, hamonga ne metumo getu gose, gono cetumilaga mu cinyele, hono gawe maswanu hamba gawe mabi.


Lwimbo Luswanu muno 1

1 Awu wo Lwimbo luswanu muno lwa Solomona.

Lwimbo lulongozi

Zinghani za we cicekulu

2 Kunonela, kunonela no mulomo wako,

no wikumbatile wako, mbeka,

wuswanu wucizize divayi.

3 Ne manukato gako, gakununyhila viswanu,

ne litagwa lyako, yiswanu linha manukato.

Holeka ne wacekulu wakukwenda.

4 Wusolaje, nase cimanyhe cibitane nagwe,

weze mutemi wangu, wunyinjize mu nyumba yako.

Cosangalalana hamonga,

cing'we muno divayi, no kuzwila mu wikumbatile.

Heya yo ling'ani wacekulu wose wakwende!

5 Nye wacekulu wa Yelusalemi, ane no muyenyu heya,

nili mutitu, kanyhi nili muswanu,

nili mutitu, nihwanile ne mahema ga Kedali,

kanyhi, nili muswanu nhe mabupa ge myenda,

ga mwi'kulu lya Solomona.

6 Ninga mulece kuhenahena vyono nili mutitu tuku,

hambi lizuwa nha lya nyanya.

Nawo wandugu zangu wasimbila,

wambika niwe mulindilizi we migunda ye mizabibu,

nghawa sina hamba cilejeho co kuwulanjilila no

mugunda wangu no mweneco.

7 Gwe go mwendece wangu, wunonjelaje ta,

alo hayi lo, hono kodimila litewa lyako?

Na hayi hono zosuma ne misi?

Alu nhawule niswe nghukulondola mu matewa

ge wadimi wanji?

Zinghani za we cilume

8 Hono wuwe si wuhamanyile hanhu,

agwe go muswanu muli wacekulu wayago,

ale wubite wulityatye litewa,

wuhawone i hanhu ha wudimilo we zimhene zako,

behi ne zinghambi ze wadimi.

9 Gwe go mwendece wangu,

nghukwihwananiza ne fwalasi zinume za mu magali ga Falawo.

10 Sunga ne zimvwili zako zikwijela swanu muno,

zinojile mucanyha ye zinzagasa zako,

lono zikuninyina mo mu singo,

nha vibwe vyo wuguzi wukamu.

11 Ninga ase, cokunozeza mukufu wa zahabu,

wono wina wihambo wa fweza.

Zinghani za we cicekulu

12 Mutemi wangu yali yagonile mwi'goda lyakwe, ne mbeho,

yikamemywa ne mhunjile ye manukato gangu.

13 Mwendece wangu yenha mufuko wa manemane,

lono yanyegamiye mu mhambaga mu vitombo vyangu.

14 Mwendece wangu yenha viluwa vya mu mbago,

vyono vibonholaga mu mizabibu ya Engedi.

Zinghani za we cilume

15 Gwe mwendece wangu, nye wuli muswanu si,

ne meso gako gakulembula nha meso ge nghunda, so wendo!

Zinghani za we cicekulu

16 Lanje, mwendece wangu vyono wuli muswanu,

kanyhi wunyendeze muno.

Na mu mahanze madece, wowa wo wugono wetu.

17 Ne mibici ye mihagata, yowa yo micici ye kaya yetu,

ne mabici ganji, gowa go mahapa getu.


Lwimbo Luswanu muno 2

1 Nane nili 'luwa lya mu yisi ya Shaloni,

nili 'luwa lya mu malolo.

Zinghani za we cilume

2 Nha vyono linha liluwa lyono lili mu mamivya,

ale nhavivyo no mwendece wangu mu ciligati ye wacekulu.

Zinghani za we cicekulu

3 Nha vyono winha mubici wo muyembe,

wono wuli ha ciligati ye mabici ga mu mbago,

Nhavivyo no mwendece wangu nayo, vyo yenha,

mu ciligati ye walume wanji.

Nane nali nyende niwe nikaye ha mubeho wayo,

ne mikalo yayo, yili muzinzi lono nghuyijeza.

4 Yakandeta, sunga ko ku nyumba yakwe yo kulila zindigwa.

Yakanyinulila cipepela co wendo.

5 Yakangomolela kanyhi vilungo vyangu,

mu wulya zabibu nghavu,

yakamhela vilungo so kulya mikalo,

hambi nha naganda muno, ku soko yo wusungu,

6 No muwoko wakwe wo kucekulu yawuwicile

hasi yo mutwe wangu.

Yanghumbatiye no muwoko wakwe wo kulume.

7 Holeka anye nyo wacekulu wa mu Yelusalemi,

nha vyono zinha nzimba hamba sawada, za mu mbago,

mulece kuwusagahaza hamba kuwusinhusa wendo

sunga kolo wukuwona viswanu wenezo.

Lwimbo lwe Kejete

Zinghani za we cicekulu

8 Nane nghulihulika lizi lyo mwendece wangu,

yakunyiziza yakumangha, yakolile mu matunda,

no kuzumhazumha mu vigongo.

9 Nayo mwendece wangu,

yehwanile nzimba, yenha sawada.

Lanje, yemile ku mhilimo ye lijinji,

yasunjiliye mwi'dilisha,

yakulanjila mu nghalama.

10 Hanyuma mwendece wangu, yakunonjela yakutya,

Zinghani za we cilume

Ale winuce wuze, 'gwe go mwendece wangu,

go muswanu wangu, wuze cibite.

11 Alu wulanje, cinyuli capuluta,

ne mvula nayo yawuka.

12 Ne maluwa geza kubonhola mwi'hala.

Holeka aci co cidaha co kwimba,

ne zinyimbo ze zinziwa, cikuzihulika mwi'hala.

13 Lanje, ne zinghuyu nazo zeza kupya,

nayo mizabibu yikulavya maluwa.

Holeka wuze 'gwe go mwendece wangu,

go muswanu wangu, wuze cibite.

14 Hambi nha wihwanile ngungulima, yono

yihundikaga mu mapalika ga mu mabwe mawaha.

Ta wundekaje nghulanje wusu wako vyono wunojeze,

nilihulice ne lizi lyako,

lyono likunhamisa mu nhumbula yangu.

15 Wuzibataje zinyhewe,

ko muno zinyhewe zono zikali ndodo,

lono zikali sinahodanga migunda yetu ye mizabibu,

lono mizabibu yanza kulavya maluwa.

Zinghani za we cicekulu

16 Mwendece wangu, yo wangu, nane nili wakwe.

Kalilisaga litewa lyakwe mu maluwa.

17 Sunga kolo wela hakali mitondo lono cibeho cikuputa,

no wutitu wukuwuka.

Holeka wumhitucilaje 'gwe go muswanu wangu

wuwe nha nzimba hamba sawada za mu

matunda ga Beteli.


Lwimbo Luswanu muno 3

1 Na mu vilo vyose ne cilo,

lono ngonile mu citanda cangu.

Nimulotaga du yuyo mono nimwendile.

Nghawa kumulondola muno,

ninga hamba si nghumuwona yaye,

2 Nghawa kutuluka,

nghabita kujendajenda mu zinzila mwi'kaya.

Hodu nghawa kutya, “Alu nokwinuka mhilime mwi'kaya,

nghole mu zinzila zayo zose, sunga na mu vibalangu,

nimulondole mwendece wangu, muswanu wangu.

Ninga nghamulondola hamba kumuwona ng'o.”

3 Nawo i walindilizi wono wapilimaga mwi'kaya,

kumbe wakambona.

Nane nghawawuza nghawatya, “Nye wayangu,

mbonelenyi baha ta mwendece wangu?”

4 Ninga nali neza kwileka nawo du,

lo lulolulo nghawa kumuwona.

Hodu, nghawa kumwibatilila,

hamba si namulecela kanyhi,

nghawa kumutegula sunga ko ku kaya kwa yaya,

kugati ye cumba cono nalelelwa.

5 Holeka anye nyo wacekulu wa mu Yelusalemi,

nha vyono zinha nzimba hamba sawada za mu mbago.

Mulece kuwusaga haza

hamba kuwusinhusa wendo sunga kolo wukuwona viswanu weneco.

Lwimbo lwe Kadatu

Zinghani za we cicekulu

6 Alo cicici cono cikuza cikulawilila ku nyika,

cihwanile lisumbili lye lyosi,

cono cina mhunjile swanu yo wuvumba,

hamonga ne manemane,

no wuvumba wono wukuwa kuguzwa ne wasuluza?

7 Lanje, Solomona yakuza,

wamudinghuliye mwi'goda lyakwe lyo wutemi,

ne wasilikale vitung'ati wa mu Isilayeli,

wono waficile makumi mutandatu liwalo lyawo,

wamupilime wakumudima.

8 Nawo wose webate mimaje mu miwoko yawo,

wewikanize ku wulewane.

9 Nayo mutemi Solomona,

wamudinghuliye mwi'goda lyakwe lyo wutemi,

linozigwe no mubici muswanu.

10 Ne masumbili gayo, gali ga fweza,

na mucanyha yalyo, lyali yigubice no mwenda,

wono wali mubakwe wihambo wa zahabu.

I mito yayo nayo,

yali yina folonya ze citambala ce liwala lyo lugandu,

yono yahonwa ko wendezwe we wacekulu wa Yelusalemi.

11 Nye nyo wacekulu wa mu Sayuni,

muze ta, mumuwone mutemi Solomona.

Mwene yavwalile mukumbo,

wono nyina yamuvwika mu mutwe wakwe,

mwi'zuwa lye halusi yakwe.

Mwi'zuwa lyakwe lye nyemo no wusangalale.


Lwimbo Luswanu muno 4

Zinghani za we cilume

1 Gwe mwendece wangu, ku wulangwe,

nye wuli muswanu si!

Lanje ne meso gako vyono gakulembula nha ga nziwa,

kusi ye citambala cako, cono wigubice mu wusu.

Ne zimvwili zako zinha litewa lya mhene,

zono zigonaga mu mwalambalo we litunda lya Gileyadi.

2 Ne meno gako mazelu swee, kotya litewa lya ngholo,

zono zakondya kucenyenhwa no kuhovugwa,

kanyhi zono hasina hamba monga yono yajiliye,

zikujenda zitunjile nyejete nyejete.

3 Milomo yako yinha luputi ludunghu,

nayo yendezaga viswanu lono wukulonga.

Zinghatu zako, zikung'alala kusi ye citambala,

cono wigubice mu wusu wako.

4 Nayo singo yako,

yihwanile nho munala wa Dawudi yinyolocile kanyhi yiteleye,

yina no mukufu,

wono wehwana nha ngula elufu monga, nhumbice ziyipilime.

5 Ne vitombo vyako vyejete, vinha kotya nyana nyejete

za nzimba, zono zikudima mu maluwa.

6 Ale, nane nokwikala mumo du mwi'tunda

lyono lina manemane, mwi'tunda lyo wuvumba,

sunga wele, mbeho yipute ya hakali mitondo,

no wutitu wuwe wawuka.

7 Gwe mwendece wangu, nye wuli muswanu si!

Musina hamba nghani 'mbi muli'gwe.

8 Ale, cibitane nane ku wulawa mu matunda ga Lebanoni,

'gwe go bibi halusi wangu,

cibitane wose ku wulawa Lebanoni.

Wutime wuwuce kuko mwi'tunda lya Amana,

ku wulawa mwi'tunda lya Senili na mwi'tunda lya Helimoni,

mono zikalaga zisimba ne zisuwi.

9 Wulanje we meso gako, 'gwe go mwendece wangu,

go bibi halusi wangu,

hamonga no mukufu wono wuvwalile mu singo,

ane no muyago, wakondya kuyihiza nhumbula yangu.

10 Gwe go mwendece wangu, go bibi halusi wangu,

u wendo wako, wukusangalaza muno.

I mbeka, wendo wako, wucizize wuswanu we divayi.

Ne mhunjile ye mafuta gako,

mbeka yicizize wuvumba we mawala gose.

11 No muzinzi wo wuci, wuli mu milomo yako

'gwe go mwendece wangu,

no lulimi lwako lwaweza mele no wuci kuli'ne.

Ne vivwalo vyako,

vina mhunjile yose nho wuvumba wa ku Lebanoni.

12 Mwendece wangu, bibi halusi wangu, yo busitani hundikwe.

Busitani yono sitilwe no mululu,

co cikolongo ce ciwene.

13 Ne mibici baho yikutula.

Yikuwiluka nhe mibici ye mikomamanga,

yono yilelaga mikalo miswanu.

Nayo yina ne mafuta go wulenzi,

go wuguzi wukamu, si vimalikaga kuko.

14 Vye lanji ye manjano, no mucayicayi,

no mudalasini, hamba wuvumba we mawala gose.

Wugutika no wudi, vyose vicindikaga kuko,

hamonga ne mibici yose ye mhunjile swanu.

15 Visima viyimwajilaga busitani malenga,

hamonga ne mivwilo ye malenga.

Ne vikolongo vya mu matunda ga Lebanoni,

vyono vikuhuluma musunho.

Zinghani za we cicekulu

16 Ale, wusinhuce go mbeho ya kusumuka,

nagwe go mbeho ya kutakama,

wuze wupute mu busitani yangu, mhunjile yayo yipemuce.

No mwendece wangu, ho yaze mu busitani,

yalye mikalo miswanu.


Lwimbo Luswanu muno 5

Zinghani za we cilume

1 Nenjila mu busitani yangu, 'gwe go mwendece wangu,

go bibi halusi wangu.

Nghuhepa wugutika hamonga ne mhunjile ye manemane.

Nghulya no wuci wangu, hamonga ne lilala lyo wuci.

Nghung'wa ne divayi yangu, hamonga ne mele.

Zinghani za we cicekulu wenji

Aa! Nye nyo wendece wetu, heya mulye, mung'we,

sunga nyenye weneco nhondo muwe mwagala wendo!

Lwimbo lwe Kane

Zinghani za we cicekulu

2 Lono nali ngonile, nhumbula yangu yali yili meso.

Na mumo mu nhongo,

nali kumulota mwendece wangu yakukong'onha ha mulango.

Zinghani za we cilume

Ale, wundigulile ninjile, 'gwe go mwendece wangu,

agwe go wuswanu we nhumbula yangu, go ngungulima yangu.

Hambi mutwe wangu nha wadodowekwa ne buhe,

ne zimvwili zangu zitonyelwa ne mahalavu ge cilo.

Zinghani za we cicekulu

3 Alu mwendece wangu,

ane nha nakondya kwiwopola ne myenda yangu,

alu ho ninuce kanyhi niyivwale?

Ane nali nakondya kwizuguza ne magulu gangu,

alu ho ninuce niyitipize kanyhi?

4 Ninga mwene mwendece wangu, yakawibata mulango,

nane nhumbula yangu yikatamika muno so mwene,

vyono yali yasejelela ha mulango.

5 Hobaho, nane nghawa kwiwikaniza ho nghamudigulile

mulango yenjile.

Miwoko yangu lulo yikawa yina mhunjile swanu yo wugutika,

ne vidole vyangu vyasululaga mhunjile swanu yo 'gutika,

lono nebataga cidindilo co mulango.

6 Hobaho, nghawa kumudigulila mulango mwendece wangu,

ninga kumbe yali yakondya kuwuka, yabita.

Hee! Mwene! Nane ho nali nyendile kulihulika lizi lyakwe.

Hodu, nghawa kwanza kumulondola,

ninga hamba si namuwona yaye.

Nghamucemeleza, ninga hamba si yedika yaye.

7 Nawo walindilizi wono wapilimaga mwi'kaya,

kumbe wakambona,

wakanhowanga no kumhela zinghomele.

Nawo walindilizi wono wagalanjililaga majinji ge likaya,

wakayidemulanga kofiya yangu.

8 Ale, ta, munonjelaje anye nyo wacekulu wa mu Yelusalemi,

hono muwe mumuwona mwendece wangu,

mumulonjele nha vyono, ane nghuzilika so wendo.

Zinghani za we cicekulu wenji

9 Gwe go mucekulu muswanu muli wacekulu,

alu mulume yuyo, yena cicici co wizine,

holeka nase yiwe yicinojeye cikulonjele?

Zinghani za we cicekulu

10 Nye wayangu,

u mwendece wangu yena wusu wono wukwendeza,

kanyhi yali vilungo, ne vilungo vyakwe,

vyokwinjila wanhu elufu yikumi.

11 No wusu wakwe winha shaba,

kanyhi wutelemeye muno,

yena mvwili za cilende zitambalaye,

kanyhi nhitu tuku nhe lihowe.

12 Ne meso gakwe maswanu,

genha ga nziwa zono zili ha cikolongo cono cikuhuluma.

Kotya nha nziwa zono zakondya kwihovuga mu mele,

alu zimile ha cikolongo.

13 Zinghatu zakwe nazo, zendeze muno,

zinhe busitani swanu muno

yono yimemile mboga hamonga ne hati yayo.

Nayo milomo yakwe,

yihwanile maluwa mamwajilwe mhunjile swanu.

14 Ne miwoko yakwe, ta miswanu 'nye,

kavwalaga nyamwidole ze vibwe vyo wuguzi wukamu.

U muwili wakwe nhondo,

wutelemeye winhe zimbali ze zinhembo,

zono zina ne vibwe vyo wulembo wo wuguzi wukamu.

15 Ayi migulu yakwe,

yinha zisumbili ze'bwe lyono likung'alala viswanu

zono ziwicigwe mucanyha ye misinji ye zi zahabu.

Yo munhu mutambule, yenhe matunda ga Lebanoni,

hamonga ne mibici yayo ye mihagata.

16 No mulomo wakwe, lono wukuwunonela, nye muswanu si!

Ne zinghani zakwe zose, zinyendezaga muno.

Holeka anye nyo wacekulu wa mu Yelusalemi,

nhavivi vyo yenha u mwendece wangu.


Lwimbo Luswanu muno 6

Zinghani za we cicekulu wenji

1 Gwe go mucekulu muswanu muli wacekulu,

alo mwendece wako kowa kabita hayi?

Wucilonjelaje ta, nzila yono yakolile yuyo mwendece wako,

nase ho cikutaze kumulondola.

Zinghani za we cicekulu

2 Mwendece wangu kabita ku busitani yakwe,

hono yicindice mibici ye manukato.

Yakulilisa litewa lyakwe mu busitani,

akuno yakuhepa ne maluwa.

3 Mwendece wangu, yo wangu, nane nili wakwe,

kalilisaga litewa lyakwe mu maluwa.

Lwimbo lwe Hano

Zinghani za we cilume

4 Gwe mwendece wangu,

mbeka wuli muswanu winha Yelusalemi,

wunojeze nhe likaya lya Tiliza,

wina lilumbo nhe makaya gaga mawaha.

5 Wupituse meso gako, wulece kunanga,

hambi nha wukunghwega muno.

Ne zimvwili zako swanu, zinha litewa lya mhene,

zono zigonile mu mwalambalo we litunda lya Gileyadi.

6 Ne meno gako mazelu swee,

kotya litewa lya ngholo zono zakondya kuhovugwa.

Kanyhi zono hasina hamba monga yono yajiliye.

Zikujenda zitunjile nyejete nyejete.

7 Ne zinghatu zako,

zikung'alala kusi ye citambala cono wigubice mu wusu wako.

8 Mulece mutemi yawe ne wagolece makumi mutandatu,

hamonga ne wajitulwa makumi munana,

ne wahinza si wakuwala!

9 Ninga ane, nyendile mucekulu monga du,

nayo mbeka yanojeze yenha nziwa.

Nayo yo mwana we cicekulu yumonga du kuli nyina,

kanyhi yo mwana mwendece muno kuli nyina.

Ne wacekulu wose kolo wakumulanga, wakumukumya,

nawo wagolece zo mutemi hamonga ne wajitulwa,

wose wakumwimbila zinyimbo zo lukumyo.

10 Alo yo nani yuyu mono yakulanga,

wulanje wakwe winha hakali mitondo.

Muswanu muno, kanyhi yena wusu wono wusangalaye,

yakung'alala nhe lizuwa hamba mwezi.

11 Nane nghabita mu busitani ye milozi,

ho nanje wusipuce wa mwi'lolo

ho mbone hono mizabibu yakondya kutula mahamha,

ne mikomamanga nayo hono yilavizye maluwa.

12 Alu'ne, nhondo nghucicima,

hambi nha wamhela cisukwa ciwaha muno mu nhumbula yangu,

so wendo, nha vyono kawezaga u mujendya lituka lyo wulugu,

haciligati yo wulugu.

Zinghani za we cicekulu wenji

13 Ale, wuvine! Wuvine 'gwe yaya,

go muhinza wa ku Shulamu.

Nase ho ciwe cikulanjiliye vyono wukuvina.

Zinghani za we cicekulu

Alu nye, nhawule mukusaka muwe munanjiliye,

lono'ne nghuvina, haciligati ye micilili

ya wono wananjiliye?


Lwimbo Luswanu muno 7

Zinghani za we cilume

1 Agwe mbeka, wuli muhinza wa mbuko!

Lanje, ta, migulu yako vyono miswanu,

lono wuvwalile malatu.

No wipalinje we vima vyako,

wihwanile vibwe vyo wuguzi wukamu,

mulimo wo munhu mulula.

2 Ne ciduwo cako, cinha bakuli

yono si yanjizaga divayi, yono yina mhunjile swanu.

Ne'nda yako nayo, yihwanile ne lilundo lyo wuhemba

lyono lipilimwe ne maluwa.

3 Navyo vitombo vyako, vihwanile nzimba nyejete

ze ma mhasa, kanyhi nha sawada nyejete.

4 Nayo singo yako,

yihwanile nho munala we zimbali ze zinhembo.

Meso gako nago,

gehwanile vilamba vya mwi'kaya lya Heshiboni,

vyono vili behi no mulango we likaya lilyo.

Nayo mhula yako vyono yikwendeza!

Nayo yihwanile no munala wa Lebanoni,

wono vidomile na Damesiki.

5 Nawo mutwe wako wuli ha ka canyha nhe litunda lya Kalimeli.

No wusuce we zimvwili zako,

wukung'alala kotya mwenda wa halili.

No wuswanu wayo,

mbeka wosuma kumukwega sunga no mutemi.

6 Gwe, mwene wuli muswanu ta, na mbeka ku wulangwe,

wuli muswanu muno, kanyhi wukwendeza muno,

no wendo wako, wukusangalaza muno.

7 Wuswanu wako wihwanile no mubici wo mutende.

Ne vitombo vyako vimile kotya vivunda vya nhende.

8 Nane nobita kucanyha yo mutende

nghahepe mikalo yayo.

Ne vitombo vyako kuli'ne, vihwanile

nhe vivunda vya zabibu,

no mwehelo wako nawo, wina mhunjile swanu,

nhe mhunjile ye mikalo.

9 No wunonele wako, winha divayi swanu muno.

Zinghani za we cicekulu

Ale hono nhavivyo, wuyilekaje le divayi

yimuhulumile mwendece wangu,

yimuhulumile mhola mhola mu mulomo wakwe na mu meno gakwe.

10 Ane nili wakwe mwendece wangu,

nayo kanyilowaga muno.

11 Ale, wuze 'gwe mwendece wangu, cibite kwi'wimbi,

cikagone kuko mu vitumbi.

12 Nase, nhondo cilawe hakali mitondo muno muno,

cikayilanje mizabibu,

ciyiwone hono yiwe yawiluka,

na hono maluwa gawe gabonhola,

na hono mikomamanga nayo yiwe yalavya maluwa.

Kuko langa ko cokwikumbatilila.

13 Nagwe ho koyiwonela mhunjile swanu yo mubici we mhunjile,

ne mikalo yose yono yikwendeza,

yili behi no mulango wetu.

Gwe go mwendece wangu,

ane nghuwiciye mikalo mipya ne mihuma,

na ye mawala gose.


Lwimbo Luswanu muno 8

1 Nane nali nyende, mhali wali wuwe wuli lumbu lyangu,

mono wongha matombo ga yaya.

Nha cinji, kolo cikwitang'anila mu nzila,

ho sume kukunonela ko welecele,

hamba munhu yunji kucelelela yaye.

2 Nane nali nghusole nghutegule sunga ko ku kaya ya yaya,

kuko ko wali wunyijizize wendo vyono winha.

Nane nali nghung'wese divayi yono yikoleye,

divayi yo mukomamanga wangu.

3 No muwoko wako wo kucekulu wuwe hasi yo mutwe wangu,

no muwoko wako wo kulume wuwe wunghumbatiye.

4 Holeka anye nyo wacekulu wa mu Yelusalemi,

nha vyono zinha nzimba hamba sawada za mu mbago,

mulece kuwusagahaza hamba kuwusinhusa wendo,

sunga kolo wukuwona viswanu weneco.

Lwimbo lo Mutandatu

Zinghani za we cicekulu wenji

5 Alo yuyo nani mono yakuza yakulawilila ku nyika,

yakujenda weyibate miwoko no mwendece wakwe?

Zinghani za we cicekulu

Nha nakusinhusa he'sina lyo muyembe,

i hanhu hono walelelwa.

6 Wumbice nha mutozo mu nhumbula yako,

nha citanjilo mu muwoko wako.

Hambi wendo nha wina vilungo kotya lifwa,

no wivu nawo, wukali kotya citenjelo.

No wukolele wayo, winha wukolele wo moto,

wunyanyaga nho moto mukali.

7 Malenga menji, si gosuma kuwuzimya wendo,

hamba makolongo, si gosuma kuwudodomeza yaye.

Holeka, hamba munhu yatye yalavye sawo yakwe yose

yawugule wendo, mbeka, kokwipela wubedegalwe bwete.

Zinghani za we cilume kuli lumbu lyawo

8 Ase cina lumbu lyetu mono yakali mudodo,

yakali hamba si nota ne vitombo yaye.

Alu, cimunozezeci yuyo u lumbu lyetu,

hono muzelelo yaze yasace kumupogoza?

9 Mwene yali yawe lyo yijinji,

cali cimuzenjele, cimupilimye no munala wa fweza.

Na hono yali yawe wo mulango,

cali cimucitile ne zimbawo zo muhagata.

Zinghani za we cicekulu

10 Ane nha nili 'jinji ne vitombo vyangu, yo minala yalyo.

No mwendece wangu,

yamanyile manyi manyi nha vyono,

hono nili hamonga nayo,

nghutuga wucehe hamonga no mulamu.

Zinghani za we cilume

11 Solomona yali na mugunda wakwe we mizabibu kuko ku Baali-hamoni.

Hakawa ne walimi,

wono wakawazima mugunda wuwo kulawa kuli mwene,

ho wawe kulavya munhu fweza elufu monga so mikalo yayo.

12 Mugunda we mizabibu, wo mugunda wangu nene.

Agwe Solomona, wusole fweza elufu monga,

nawo walimi, wasole magana mejete lye 'gawo lyawo.

13 Leka ta, nilihulicize lizi lyako go mwendece wangu ku wulawa mu busitani,

nawo wayangu wakuhila walihulice lizi lyako lono wukulonga.

Zinghani za we cicekulu

14 Gwe, wuze si, go mwendece wangu,

mono wihwanile nzimba hamba sawada,

zono zili mu matunda kono mibici

ye mhunjile swanu yilimwaga.


Isaya 1

1 Citabu cici cina wulolose we zinghani zono Mulungu yamugubulila Isaya u mwana wa Amozi, mu vilo vya Uziya, na Yotamu, na Ahazi, na Hezekiya, lono wali watemi wa Yuda na Yelusalemi.

Mulungu yakuwakalipila wanhu wakwe

2 U Muwaha Mulungu yakutya,

“Muhulicize ta nimulonjelenyi anye nyo wulanga ne yinze!

Yo nene mono nawalisa i wana,

kanyhi nghawawilusa, ninga alu,

wakondya kumbedegala.

3 Hamba ne zing'ombe,

nha zimumanyile mono yazisawile,

ne zindogowe nazo,

zimanyile manyi manyi hanhu hono mutwa wawo kazidimilaga.

Ninga woyi hee!

I wanhu wangu Waisilayeli si wamanyile yaye,

hamba kwizuka du bwete.”

4 Holeka, alu mokongomezwa,

anye nyo likungugo lyono lina wubi,

anye nyo wanhu wono mwendile mafupo,

kanyhi muli wabi!

Ninga mumanye nha vyono,

u wubi wenyu wuwo,

womukulunhyenyi hasi!

Hambi anye nha mwamulema Muwaha Mulungu,

u Mulungu mono yelile we Waisilayeli.

Mwakondya kumupitucila mugongo.

5 Ninga lu, ho so cici mukujendelela kumubedegala?

Ane nghuwona, mukali mwendile mucile kulipicizwa.

Alu mutwe wako Isilayeli,

wakondya kutuga mazeya gose,

nhumbula yako nayo,

hamonga no mutima wako,

vyose vyatimba.

6 Na ku wulawa ku zinzayo ze magulu gako,

sunga ko ku mutwe, musina vilungo,

langa mozili nghomele du, ne madali,

ne malonda gono gawolile,

gono si maminywe,

hamba kuwopwa na bandeji,

hamba kudejefywa ne mafuta yaye.

7 Ne yisi yenyu yaweza yitongo,

ne makaya genyu gatakamizwa no moto.

Ne wajenzi wayisola yisi yenyu ha meso genyu,

no kuyongomeza,

hamonga na vyose vyono vili mumo.

8 Nalu likaya lya Yelusalemi du lili wene, lyo lisigaye,

nalyo lyasigala nhe kaya lyono lipilimwe ne walugu,

lyono lyeza lisina hamba wutazi,

lyeza nha cilingo co mugunda we mizabibu kanyhi nha cilingo

cono cili mu mugunda we matanga mugati.

9 Na hono Muwaha Mulungu u Mudaha vyose,

u Mulungu we Mihanga yali yalece kusigaza mumo wanhu wanji womi,

mbeka, mhali Yelusalemi yongomezezwe lukulu,

nha vyono Sodoma na Gomola zongomezwa.

10 Nagwe Yelusalemi,

i walongola wako hamonga ne wanhu wako,

wose nha wabi wehwana ne wanhu wa Sodoma na Gomola.

Alu muhulicize zono Muwaha Mulungu yakumulonjelenyi.

Muteje likutu kuli zono Mulungu wetu yakumwijizenyi.

11 Yakutya nhavi, “Alu mwene, anye mukwihwesa vyono 'ne,

nghugasaka gago makumbiko genyu,

gono mukundavizya?

Ane nha nakondya kucilwa ne vilavywa vyenyu vinyanywe vye zi nduwilu,

vyono mukundavizya nha makumbiko,

hamonga ne mhama ye zimitugo zenyu zono zijinile.

Nakondya kuyikatala sunga ne sakami ye zing'ombe,

hamba ye zingholo, hamba ye zimhene.

12 Mwene nayo yo nani,

mono yakamutyenyi vyono mweze kundetela vivyo vyose,

lono mukuza kuhemba 'ne?

Hamba mu Nyumba yangu?

13 Holeka yo nghani ya bwete du,

yo kujendelela kundavizya vilavywa vyenyu.

Hambi ane nha si nghwendezwa kanyhi,

ne mhunjile yo wuvumba wono mukufusa.

Hamba ne zi sikukuu zenyu ze Ndawo yo Mwezi,

ne zi Sabato, hamba no wihangulize wenyu wo wuhembi,

ane hamba si nozivumila yaye,

hambi nha zakondya kuwifywa no wubi wenyu.

14 Nane hamba si nghuzisacila lukulu,

zi sikukuu zenyu ze Ndawo yo Mwezi,

na ze vilo vyono vyelile.

Hambi nha zeza nha mutegulo du kuli'ne,

wono si nosuma kuwudinghula yaye.

15 “Na lono mowa kunyasula miwoko yenyu kucanyha mu wulombe,

hamba si nomutondowozenyi yaye.

Hamba mulombe muhidimbaye,

si nomuhulicizenyi ng'o,

hambi miwoko yenyu,

nha yimemile wuwulaji wose.

16 Holeka alu, mwizuguze, mwiyeze,

muwusize lukulu hali'ne,

u wubi wono mukwituma,

mulece kwituma vibi,

17 mwiyijize ku wituma ziswanu.

Mwitume zo wiling'ano,

muwataze wono wakwiwonelwa,

muwapele ze ling'ani i wana wono wasina walezi,

muwataze i wacekulu wafwile mu zinghani zawo.”

18 Alu Muwaha Mulungu yakutya nhavi,

“Ale, muze cilongane cizimale.

Vyono hamba masutya genyu gawe madunghu ninga

ane nomukwemenyi muwe wazelu swee nha seluji.

Hamba gawe madunghu kasu,

gowa mazelu swee, nho wukunzeje we ngholo nzelu.

19 Na hono muhulice 'ne,

nanye molya vinhu viswanu vyono vikulawa mu'si.

20 Ninga hono muleme no kufyula,

mbeka mofwa wose mukongojele.

Ane yo nene Muwaha Mulungu, mono nizilonjile zizi.”

I likaya lyo wubi

21 Ati, ta, mulanje!

Likaya lyono lyali yihuwilwa,

alu lyeza yikaya lyo wusenyha!

Na kumbe mu mapango ganji,

ho lyali limemile wanhu we ling'ani.

Ninga lu mulanje, lyekala ne wanhu wawulaji du.

22 Gwe Yelusalemi, mwene wumanyile,

ha mwamulizo vyono wejelaga winha fweza,

ninga aluno, woyi, yeza nghani ya bwete du.

Wali winha divayi swanu muno,

ninga aluno weza winha malenga du.

23 Ne walongola wako weza wagaluci,

nalu wakondya kwiyenda ne wahizi,

alu weza wabocelaga vipegwa hamonga ne mafupo.

Wakondya kuleka no kuwataza,

i wana wono wasina walezi, mu zinghani zawo,

hamba kuwahuliciza bwete i wacekulu wafwile mu zinghani zawo.

24 Nalu muhulicize zono yakulonga u Muwaha Mulungu u Mudaha vyose,

u Mulungu wa Isilayeli yakutya,

“Alu, nowalipiciza walugu wangu,

nawo si wongaza kanyhi.

25 Nomunozezenyi anye nghani swanu,

nomwezenyi mu wavu wenyu wose,

nomuwusizenyi zimbi zose.

26 Nane no mupelenyi walongola,

hamonga ne wanyamhala wenyu,

nha vyono mwali mwina nawo baho ha mwamulizo.

Na hanyuma nhondo, Yelusalemi ho yocemwa,

likaya lyo wiling'ano, likaya lihuwilwa.”

27 Alu, vyono Muwaha Mulungu mwihuwilwa,

holeka koliponya likaya lya Yelusalemi,

hamonga na wose wono wali mumo wono wonena wubi wawo.

28 Ninga kowongomeza i wasutyi wose,

hamonga ne wabezi, wono wakumubeza mwene.

Kanyhi kolowawulaga wose,

wono wakumulema mwene.

29 Nanye molokalala muno,

vyono mwahembaga mabici,

hamonga ne zi busitani zisiwanulwe.

30 Nanye molonyala nho mubici wo munghola wono wunyalile,

kanyhi kotya nha busitani yono si yimwajilwaga malenga.

31 Nawo i wanhu we vilungo,

wolokongomezwa no wubi wawo weneco,

nha vyono mabeleje gakuwa kwaka mu moto.

Na hasina munhu mono kolowemila mu wongomele wuwo.


Isaya 2

Mulamu we cibitilila

(Mik 4:1-3)

1 Azi zo nghani zono Mulungu yamulonjela Isaya u mwana wa Amozi, za kuli Yuda na Yelusalemi.

2 Mu vilo vyono vikuza litunda lyono lizenjigwe

Nyumba yo Mulungu,

lyolosikamya mucanyha ye matunda

lyolokwinulwa kuciza vigongo vyose,

ne makungugo gose golokuza kuli lyene,

3 nawo wanhu wolowa kutya,

“Alenyi cibite kwi'tunda ku Nyumba yo Mulungu,

ku Nyumba yo Mulungu we Waisilayeli.

Mwene nayo kocijiza zono yakuhila ase cizitume.

Nase cojendela mu zinzila zakwe zono kohagula mwene.

Hambi wulajilize wo Muwaha Mulungu,

nha wulawaga ku Yelusalemi

kalongaga ne wanhu wakwe ku wulawa ku Sayuni.”

4 Kololamula zo wiwanganile we makungugo mawaha.

Nawo wolotyana mimaje yawo yiwe masili,

ne migoha yawo yiwe mimaje yo kududulila.

Ne makungugo hamba si golokwihoma yaye,

hamba kwiwikaniza so wihomi kanyhi.

5 Holeka anye nyo wana wa Yakobo,

kenhenyi cijendele mu wuzelu wono Muwaha Mulungu yakucipela.

Widunhumuzi wose wolokogomezwa

6 Gwe go Mulungu, hongo wakondya kuwaleka wanhu wako du,

i wana wana Yakobo!

Vyono yisi yawo luno,

yakondya kumema myoto yono yilawile kucilima,

hamonga no wutowa visangu nhe Wafilisiti.

Wanhu wako watyatya myoto ye cijenzi.

7 Ne yisi yawo kumbe ho yimemile fweza na zahabu,

ne viwutwa vyawo si vimalikaga yaye.

Ne yisi yawo yimemile fwalasi,

ne matuka gawo go wulugu menji muno hamba si gakuwala yaye.

8 Ninga kanyhi yisi yawo yimemile vihwani vye milungu,

nawo wakuvihemba vinhu vyono wenozeza weneco kwe miwoko yawo.

9 Ninga 'gwe walekaje!

Hambi wose nha wolonyetwa, no kukozwa cevu.

Holeka go Muwaha Mulungu, wulece kuwanenela!

10 Ninga lizuwa lyolokuza,

lono wolowa kwinjila mu mapango,

na mu mapalika ge mabwe mawaha ga mu matunda,

wanji wolowa kuhimba mina wenjile,

ho weponye ne likuwo lyo Muwaha Mulungu,

wakujela kwihundika ha vilungo vyakwe no lukumyo lwakwe!

11 Kanyhi lizuwa likuza,

lono wiwoni wo munhu wolomalika,

no widunhumuzi wo munhu wolokongomezwa.

No Muwaha Mulungu du, yo kolopegwa lukumyo yali wene.

12 Na mwizuwa lilyo Muwaha Mulungu u Mudaha vyose,

u Mulngu we Mihanga,

kolowanyetya wose we vilungo,

na wose i wewoni, hamonga ne wevuni wose.

13 Koloyibenanjiza ne mibici yose mitali ye mihagata yono yili ku Lebanoni,

sunga ne mibici yose ye minghola, yono yili mu yisi ya Bashani.

14 Ne matunda gose matali, ne vigongo vyose,

mwene kolo gakumulanga hawe wuhihi,

15 hamonga ne minala yose mitali ne magomawakali gayo.

16 Kolozidodomeza mu malenga zingalawa zimbaha kanyhi swanu.

17 No wiwoni wo munhu,

baho langa ho wulamalicila,

no widunhumuzi nawo,

baho ho wolokogomezezwa lukulu.

18 Avi navyo i vihwani, nhondo ho vyolokwajililila lukulu.

No Muwaha Mulungu du, u Mudaha vyose,

yo kolopegwa lukumyo yali wene.

19 Wanhu wolotiza,

wawe kwinjila mu mapango na mu mabwe mawaha ga mu matunda,

na wanji wolohimba mina hasi,

wenjile ho weponye ne likuwo lyo Muwaha Mulungu,

wakujela kwihundika ha vilungo vyakwe no lukumyo lwakwe,

lono mwene yeza kuza kuyisinjisa yinze.

20 Ne lizuwa lilyo lilawa kuza,

i wanhu wologagumilila mafuto ne mabudibudi,

vihwani vyawo vye zahabu na vye zifweza,

vyono wali wenozeze, ho wavihembe.

21 No Muwaha Mulungu kolo yakuza,

kuloyicicimya yinze, i wanhu wolotiza,

wawe kwinjila mu mapango na mu mapalika ge mabwe mawaha ga mu matunda,

na wanji wolowa kuhimba mina hasi wenjile,

ho weponye ne likuwo lyo Muwaha Mulungu,

wakujela kwihundika ha vilungo vyakwe,

no lukumyo lwakwe.

22 Mulecele lukulu kumwitumbila munhu mono wumi wakwe wudumaga nha wehele.

Hambi nha si yakwiliye cinji?


Isaya 3

Wutilibulwe wa mu Yelusalemi

1 Lanje ta! Muwaha Mulungu,

u Muwaha Mulungu u Mudaha vyose,

u Mulungu we mihanga,

yakuwawusiza vinhu vyose vyono wetumbiye Yelusalemi na Yuda.

Kowawusiza zindigwa ne malenga gawo,

2 hamonga ne wanhu we nghakamo,

ne wasilikale wawo vitung'ati,

ne mahakimu wawo, ne wawizi wawo,

ne watowa cisangu wawo,

ne walongola wawo we selikali,

3 ne wasilikale wo wulugu,

ne walongola wawo, ne wanyamhala wawo,

hamonga ne waganga wose we cihalahala.

4 Muwaha Mulungu kolowawika wadodo wo wawe watemi wawo heya,

i wana wagalika wo wolowatema.

5 Nawo wanhu wolowa kwigaza munhu no muyagwe.

I wadodo wolowabedegala wawaha,

nawo wono wabedegaywe,

hamba si wolowapela cogopo wono wena lilumbo.

6 Na mu vilo vivyo, wanhu we mhuga monga,

wolomuhagula yumonga wa muli wene,

wawe kumutya, “Agwe muyetu wina mwenda wo kuvwala,

holeka ase cakuwika wuwe mulongola wetu mu vilo vivi vye magazo.”

7 Ninga nayo kolowapitula yawe kutya,

“Nye, ane nalema!

Hambi'ne nha si nosuma kumutazenyi cinji.

Ku kaya yangu, nha kusina ndigwa yo yose,

hamba vivwalo.

Holeka mulece kumbika niwe mulongola wenyu!”

8 Heya, mbeka, Yelusalemi yongomezwa!

Nayo Yuda yikuvulumuka!

Ku soko vyono mu zinghani zawo na mu metumo gawo,

wamubedegalaga Muwaha Mulungu,

no kumutovula calinze.

9 No wuhijila-mbejele wawo,

wukuwa kuwahomelela weneco.

Sunga no wubi wawo, nha wuli calinze,

nha vyono wanhu wa Sodoma wetuma.

Holeka wokongomezwa,

no wongomezwe wuwo, weletela weneco.

10 Ninga wanhu we ling'ani, wolowa wasangalaye,

ne zinghani zose, zolowa swanu du kuli wene.

Nawo, wolosangalalila kuli ze metumo gawo.

11 Ninga woyi he, kuli wanhu wabi,

hambi nha wolopegwa wulipicizwe,

nha vyono wene nawo wawatendelaga vibi wayawo.

12 Nawo wanhu wangu wokwigalilwa ne wana,

ne wacekulu wo wolowatema.

Nye nyo wanhu wangu,

i walongola wenyu wakumwajilizenyi,
