31 Holeka nane ku soko yiyo,

nowalilila i wanhu wose wa Mowabu hamonga ne wanhu wa Kili-helesi.

32 Kanyhi nowalilila sunga ne wanhu wa Sibuma,

kuciza ne wanhu wa ku Yazeli.

Nagwe 'gwe 'kaya lya Sibuma,

nha wihwanile no muzabibu wono manhambi gayo,

gatandaye, gatambuce ne nhumbi ye Lilenga lyo Mwino,

gaficile sunga ko ku Yazeli.

Ninga aluno i mikalo yenyu ye cibahu,

hamonga ne zabibu zenyu,

vyose vyakondya kuhodanjika.

33 No wusangalale,

hamonga ne nyemo ya mu yisi yo moso ya Mowabu,

vyose vyakondya kuwuka.

Nane nakondya kuyidumya divayi ya mu makobonjelo.

Na hasina kanyhi munhu wo wose,

mono kosuma kuyinoza divayi na nyemo mbaha.

34 “Nawo i wanhu wa ku Heshiboni, na wa ku Eleyale wolowa wakulila, ne cililo cawo, colohulikwa sunga ko ku Yahazi. Sunga ne wanhu wa ku Zowali, nawo wolohulika, sunga ko ku Holonayimu, na ku Egilati-shelishiya. Sunga ne cikolongo ca ku Nimulimu cakondya kunyala.
35 Kanyhi nolowemila i wanhu wa Mowabu walece kulavya vilavywa vyawo vinyanywe, mu hanhu hawo hono wahembelaga, hamonga ne makumbiko gono wayilavizyaga milungu yawo. Vyo nghutya, ane no Muwaha Mulungu.

36 “Holeka nhumbula yangu yikutamika muno ku soko ya Mowabu, hamonga ne wanhu wa ku Kili-helesi, nho munhu mono yakutowa lwimbo lwe maziko mu fuluti. Hambi i vinhu vyose vyono wali wena navyo, nha vyakondya kwajilila.
37 Nawo wose wakondya kuziceta zimvwili za mu mitwe yawo, waceta sunga ne zindevu zawo. Ne miwoko yawo yose wetemanjile. Na mu viwino vyawo wose wavwalile magunila.
38 Ne cililo citandaye hanhu hose du mu matembe mucanyha, mu zikaya zose za Mowabu, sunga na mu zinzila zose. Hambi 'ne, nha nayitulanga Mowabu, yawa nha nyungu nhulanje, yono hamba yunji wo wose si koyenda kanyhi.
39 Na mbeka Mowabu, yakondya kubenanjika! Holeka mulile! Hambi Mowabu nha yakozwa cevu. Nalu yawa matongo du, sunga ne makungugo gose gono gayipilime, alu geza kuyisekanga. Vyo nghutya, ane no Muwaha Mulungu.”

Mowabu yisina hono yokwiponezya

40 U Muwaha Mulungu yehuwiza nha vyono,

likungugo lyolokuza, nalyo lyologuluka nha 'ndi,

no kugoloza mabawa gayo mucanyha ya Mowabu.

41 Ne makaya gayo hamonga ne magomawakali gayo golosolwa.

Na mwi'zuwa lilyo i wasilikale wa Mowabu,

wolokwinjilwa na woga wuwaha,

nho mucekulu mono yali mu nghunga yo lusawo.

42 Nayo Mowabu yolokongomezezwa lukulu yilece kuwa nghungugo kanyhi,

ku soko yo wuwula cihuliko ca kuli 'ne.

43 Holeka woga, ne makweme, hamonga ne mitego,

viwalindiye i wanhu wa Mowabu.

Vyo nghutya, ane Muwaha Mulungu.

44 No munhu wo wose mono kolojela yeponye so woga,

yuyo kologwila mu makweme,

nayo mono kolojela yewuse mu makweme,

nayo yuyo, kologwila mu mitego.

Hambi u Muwaha Mulungu,

nha yakondya kuliwaga lizuwa lyo wongomele wa Mowabu.

45 Nawo i watizizi, wono wasina vilungo,

wolojela kulondola wutazi ku Heshiboni,

likaya lyono u mutemi Sihoni yali yalitemile,

ninga luno, lili mu malambi go moto.

No moto wuwo wakondya kuzikongojeza zinhuzi za Mowabu

hamonga ne vizuli vye matunda matali,

ge wanhu wa Mowabu, wono wendile wulugu.

46 Woyi hee kuli'nye nyo wanhu wa Mowabu!

Nyo wanhu mono mwamuhembaga Cemoshi,

alu mongomezwa.

Ne wana wawo we cilume hamonga na we cicekulu,

wose wasolwa nha wafungwa.

47 Ninga hamba nhavivyo, u Muwaha Mulungu,

koloyimotya kanyhi Mowabu mu vilo vyono vikuza.

Na zizi zose,

zo Muwaha Mulungu yalonga nha vyono si zoleka kuyiziza Mowabu.


Yelemiya 49

U wuling'anizi wo Muwaha Mulungu, kuli yisi ya Amoni

1 Azi zo nghani zono u Muwaha Mulungu yakuyilonjela yisi ya Amoni yakutya,

“Alo i wanhu wa Isilayeli wali hayi lo?

Heza hasina hamba munhu monga mono yakuyitetela yisi yawo lo?

Alu nhawule wakuwaleka i wanhu wono wamuhembaga Moleki

wakuyisola yisi ya wo mulango wa Gadi no kwikala mumo?

2 Ninga cipango cikuza cono nilawanoza i wanhu we likaya lya Laba,

wahulice nyhinyinho yo wulugu,

nayo yolosigala matongo du,

sunga ne vitumbi vyayo vyose,

vyolokongojezezwa lukulu.

Hanyuma Isilayeli, woloyisola kanyhi yisi yawo,

mu wulawa mu miwoko ya wono wali wayiboka.

3 Nanye nyo wanhu wa ku Heshiboni mulile!

Mweze kulila mukutya,

Ayi yakondya kongomezwa!

Nanye nyo wacekulu wa ku Laba, mulile!

Mwivwikaje magunila muwe kulila,

akuno mukumangha ako na ako.

Hambi u mulungu wenyu Moleki,

nha kolosolwa yategulwe ku wuhamywe,

hamonga ne wakohani wakwe ne wawaha wayo.

4 Alu mwene mukwidunhumulila ci anye nyo wanhu mono si muli wehuwilwa?

Kumbe ne vilungo vyose ho musina.

Alu nhawule mwiyitumbiye nyenye nyo weneco,

no kwihwesa nha vyono hasina yunji wo wose mono kokuza yamuhomenyi?

5 Ninga 'ne, nomogofyenyi ku wulawa mbavu zose.

Nanye wose motiza,

mowa kumangha munhu yakwiponya no wumi wakwe.

Na holowa hasina munhu wo wose,

mono kolosuma kulikongholeza hamonga kanyhi,

lipuga lyako lye wasilikale wo wulugu.”

6 “Ninga hanyuma yayo,

ho noloyimotya kanyhi yisi ya Amoni.

Vyo nghutya, ane no Muwaha Mulungu.”

U wuling'anizi wo Muwaha Mulungu kuli yisi ya Edomu

7 Azi zo nghani zono u Muwaha Mulungu we mihanga,

yakuzilonga kuli yisi ya Edomu, yakutya nhavi,

“I wanhu wa Edomu,

alo wakondya kwajiliza zinghani zawo zo wutonji lo?

Ne watonji wawo nhondo,

weza si wakuwalonjela lo zono ziwanojeye wetume?

Ne mahala gawo gose nhondo gakondya kwajilila lo?

8 Holeka anye nyo wanhu wa Dedani,

aluno mutize, muwuye ku nyuma, mwihundice!

Hambi nha nghuwongomeza luno i wana wa Esawu,

vyono lipango lyangu lyakondya kufika lyo kuwongomezeza.

9 Nawo wanhu lono wakuhepa zi zabibu,

wasigazaga zinji mu mizabibu,

nawo wahizi kolo wakuza mu madaha ge cilo,

nawo wasolaga du zono wendile weneco.

10 Ninga ane nakondya kuluwusiza lukulu lulelo lwa Esawu,

ne hanhu hakwe he cinyele, ane nihanzalika,

ho walece kwihundika kanyhi.

Ne wanhu wose wa Edomu, wokongomezwa.

Hasina hamba munhu monga wa muli wene mono kosigala.

11 Wuwalece wanago wono wasina walezi,

nane nowakamisa.

Ne wacekulu wafwile, wose nowadima nene.”

12 “Sunga na wose wono wali si wanojeye waling'anizwe, nawo wocing'wela du cikombe cico co wuling'anizwe. Hamba wukwihwesa nha vyono kolekwa wulece kutuga wuling'anizwe lo? Ng'o yaye, langa kocing'wa du cikombe cico co wuling'anizwe.
13 Nane nha nakondya kwilahiza nha vyono likaya lya Bozila, lyolowa yikaya lyo wogofye, kanyhi lyolowa nyika. Nawo wanhu wololisekanga muno, no kulitumamila litagwa lyayo nha wulijite. Ne vitumbi vyayo vyose vyono vilipilime, vyolowa matongo cibitilila. Vyo nghutya, ane no Muwaha Mulungu.”

14 Nane nghatya,

“Gwe go Edomu,

ane nhuga nghani ku wulawa kuli Muwaha Mulungu,

yakutya nha vyono yakondya kugalonjela

makungugo gahangulize wasilikale wo wulugu,

gewikanize, gaze gakuhome.

15 Nayo Muwaha Mulungu kokuwusiza lukumyo lwako,

na howa hasina yunji kanyhi mono kokupela cogopo yaye.

16 Hambi u widunhumuzi wako nha wakukonga.

Naluno, heza hasina kanyhi hamba munhu wo wose mono yakukogopa yaye,

nha vyono agwe wukwihwesa.

Agwe mono wikaye mu zimhalika ze mabwe,

mu cizuli ce litunda,

hamba wunoze linhuli lyako kucanyha muno kotya numba vyono yinozaga,

ninga u Muwaha Mulungu vyo kokutimya du ku wulawa kuko.

Vyo yakutya, u Muwaha Mulungu.”

17 U Muwaha Mulungu yakutya nhavi, “U wuhodanjice wono woyiziza Edomu, wowa wuhodanjice wo kogofya muno. No munhu wo wose mono kowa kukola baho, kowa kutinuswa no kutuga woga.
18 Ne nghani yiyo, yokwijela ku Edomu, nha vyono zejela ku Sodoma na Gomola, lono zongomezezwa hamonga ne vikaya vyono vyali vili behi behi nazo. Na holowa hasina hamba munhu wo wose mono kolokwikala mumo kanyhi. Vyo nghutya ane no Muwaha Mulungu.
19 Nane nolokuza niwanoze Waedomu wayitize nhinicizo yisi yawo, nha vyono simba yiswelepukaga nhinicizo, yikulawa mu mibici yono yititile muno, ya mu mwalambalo we likolongo lya Yoludani, mu wudimilo wono si wunyalaga. No mulongola mono nomuhagula nene, yuyo yo kololitema likungugo. Hambi nani lo mono yenha nene? Hamba nani lo mono konhemezezya madaha? Hamba mutemici mono kokwisumaniza nane?
20 Alu, muhulicize ta, i mahweso gono nghusaka niwatendele i wanhu wa mwi'kaya lya Temani. Sunga ne wana wawo wolokwejenhwa, ne wanhu wose wolokwinjilwa no woga.
21 Na kolo Edomu yakondya kugwa, yisi yolocicimila lizi lyo wugwe wuyo, ne cililo cayo colohulikwa kutali sunga ko ku Agaba.
22 Nawo walugu woloyihoma Bozila kotya numba yiguluce, akuno yigolose ne mabawa gayo. Na mwizuwa lilyo, i wasilikale wa Edomu, wolokwinjilwa no woga wuwaha muno, nho mucekulu mono yali mu nghunga yo lusawo.”

U wuling'anizi wo Muwaha Mulungu, kuli yisi ya Damesiki

23 Ayi nayo yo nghani yo Muwaha Mulungu,

yono yakuyilonjela yisi ya Damesiki, yakutya nhavi,

“Nawo wanhu wa mu makaya ga Hamati na Alipadi,

wenjilwa na woga, kanyhi wakugazika muno,

ku soko wahulika nghani 'mbi.

Mahwele menji nhe lilenga, gawaziza,

alu weza wasina hamba wucehe yaye.

24 Nawo i wanhu wa Damesiki, watimbile,

nawo wakondya kutiza so woga.

Nalu wali mu wukalale no wusungu,

kotya mucekulu mono yali mu nghuga yo lusawo.

25 Ne likaya lyawo lyono lyali likumucile,

lyono lyali limemile nyemo, alu lyakondya kulekwa.

26 Na mwizuwa lilyo, i wazelelo wayo,

wolowulajilwa mu zinzila za mwi'kaya,

ne wasilikale wayo wolokongomezwa wose.

27 Nane nologapembela moto,

i majinji ga Damesiki,

nologakongojeza ne makaya gose go wutemi,

go mutemi Benihadadi.

Vyo nghutya, ane no Muwaha Mulungu we Mihanga.”

U wuling'anizi wo Muwaha Mulungu kuli we mhuga ya Kedali hamonga ne Likaya lya Hazoli.

28 Ayi yo nghani yono Muwaha Mulungu yakuwalonjela we mhuga ya Kedali, hamonga ne zi'si zose zono zali zili mu wutemi we likaya lya Hazoli, zono Nebukadineza u mutemi wa Babiloni yazihoma no kuzisuma, yakutya nhavi,

“Ale, muwahomaje wanhu wa Kedali,

muyongomeze mbeyu ye wanhu wa kucilima!

29 Mugasole mahema gawo ne matewa gawo ge mitugo,

ne mabupa ge myenda ge mahema gawo,

hamonga ne vinhu vyawo vyose vyono vili mu mahema gawo.

Musole ne zingamiya zawo.

Muwalonjele wanhu muwatye,

‘Woga wuli mbavu zose.’

30 “Nye nyo wanhu wa Hazoli,

ane no Muwaha Mulungu, nghumusugulenyi,

nha vyono munojeye mumanyhe,

mutize, mubite mukehundice.

Hambi Nebukadineza mutemi wa Babiloni,

nha yakumupinjilenyi, yakutya,

31 “Ale, muze!

Cowahoma wanhu wose wono wakwiwona

nha wali mutulano kanyhi wapolile!

Ninga ne likaya lyawo ho lisina milango hamba kufuli,

kanyhi lisina hamba wulanjilizi wo wose.

32 “Muzisolaje ne zingamiya zawo,

hamonga ne mitugo zawo zose!

Nane noweyagaziza mbavu zose

i wanhu wono wadumulaga zimvwili zawo ziwa fupi.

Nowaletela magazo mbavu zose.

33 Nayo Hazoli yonozwa yiwe nyika cibitilila,

hawe hanhu ha wikalo we macewe.

Na holowa hasina munhu wo wose kanyhi,

mono kolokwikala mumo.

Vyo nghutya, ane no Muwaha Mulungu.”

U wuling'anizi wo Muwaha Mulungu kuli yisi ya Elamu

34 Mu mwamulizo wo wutemi wa Zedekiya u mutemi wa Yuda, u Muwaha Mulungu we mihanga, yakanonjela zinghani ze yisi ya Elamu.
35 Yanonjela yakutya nhavi, “Nowawulaga wanhu wose i wanghula wono wakwitumamila wupinde, wono wakuyipela Elamu vilungo.
36 Noleta mbeho yiyipute Elamu, ku wulawa mbavu zose, niweyagazize wanhu wayo mbavu zose, nawo weyagale watizize mu ma'si gose, hawe hasina hamba yisi monga yono si wotiziza.
37 Kanyhi nowanoza wanhu wa Elamu, wawe no woga kuli walugu wawo wono wakuwalondola wawawulaje. Nane nowongomezeza mwi'kuwo lyangu liwaha wanhu wa Elamu. Nowatuma mapuga ge wasilikale, waze wawongomezeze lukulu.
38 Nowongomezeza lukulu, i watemi wawo, hamonga ne walongola wawo, niwe kuliwika baho ne ligoda lyangu lyo wutemi.
39 Ninga hanyuma, ho nolowamotya kanyhi i wanhu wa Elamu. Vyo nghutya ane no Muwaha Mulungu.”


Yelemiya 50

U wusolwe we yisi ya Babiloni

1 Ayi nayo, yo nghani yono u Muwaha Mulungu yanonjela, ya kuli ze likaya lya Babiloni, hamonga ne wanhu wayo, yakatya nhavi,

2 “Muyanzaje nghani yiyi mu makungugo!

Muyiganule!

Mwinule cipepela, ganulenyi!

Mulece kuyihundika!

Mulonje mutye, ‘Babiloni yisolwa!’

Beli yikozwa cevu!

U mulungu wayo Maliduki, katulanjika!

Ne vihwani viseswe vya Babiloni vyakozwa cevu,

ne vihwani vyawo vye liwifyo vyono wavihembaga,

alu vyabenanjika.

3 “Ne likungugo lyono likulawilila kusumuka, lyakondya kuza liyihome Babiloni, liyilece yawa nha nyika. Nazo zinimu zotiza mumo, na holowa hasina hamba munhu monga mono kolokwikala mumo.”

U wuwuye wa Isilayeli

4 U Muwaha Mulungu yakutya nhavi, “Ne vilo vivyo kolo vyeza kuza, wanhu wa Isilayeli hamonga ne wanhu wa Yuda, wolokuza wakulila, wakunondola ane no Mulungu wawo.
5 Nawo woloyiwuza nzila yono yibitile ku Sayuni, nawo woloyityatya. Wolonoza cilagane ce cibitilila, cono hamba si wolocibena kanyhi yaye.”

6 “I wanhu wangu wehwanile zingholo zono u mudimi wazo yazajiliza mu matunda. Nalu wakuyega-yega nhe zingholo, wakwitananhiza mu matunda, wakondya kusemwa no kwawo kwihi.
7 Nawo wakuhomwa no munhu wo wose du mono wanhu wose wono yakuwawona. I walugu wawo, nawo wakutya, ‘Hambi wene nha wamusutizya Muwaha Mulungu, holeka nase, zizi zono cikuwatendela, hamba si cikusutya yaye. Hambi i walezi wawo nha wali wamwitumbiye Muwaha Mulungu, holeka nawo yali yiwanojeye kuwa wehuwilwa kuli mwene.’ ”

8 “Nye nyo wanhu wa Isilayeli, ale mutize muwuce kuko ku Babiloni! Muwuce mumo! Mweze nyenye walongozi kuwuka!
9 Hambi 'ne nha nokonghola lipuga lye makungugo gono gali vilungo, ku wulawa ku lubavu lwa kusumuka, waze wayihome Babiloni. Nawo wokuza wayihome yisi, wayisume. Ne wanhu wawo, wo wanghula muno mu wupelembi, na mu wuguma zisonga, si wasutyaga wulunji mu wugume wawo.
10 Nayo Babiloni yolosolwa no kutekwa. Nawo wono woloyiteka, wolovisola vinhu vyose vyono wolosaka weneco. Vyo nghutya, ane no Muwaha Mulungu.”

U wugwe wa Babiloni

11 U Muwaha Mulungu yakutya nhavi,

“Anye nyo wanhu wa Babiloni,

anye mwawateka wanhu wangu.

Nalu mwina nyemo no wusangalale,

mukujenda mwihwanile ng'ombe yono yikufijiha wuhemba,

hamba kotya nha fwalasi yono yikulila.

12 Ninga, likaya lyenyu liwaha,

lyonyetywa no kukozwa cevu.

Nayo Babiloni,

yolowa yo ya kunyuma muno muno si nhe makungugo gose.

Yolonyala, yiwe nyika yono yisina malenga.

13 Na ku soko ye likuwo lyangu,

hasina hamba munhu monga mono kolokwikala mu Babiloni,

langa yokwikala matongo du.

Ne wanhu wose wono wowa kukola mumo,

wolowa kutinuswa no kwizina.”

14 “Nanye nyo wanhu wo wupinde,

ale mwiwikanizaje muyipilime Babiloni mbavu zose.

Muyigumaje Babiloni ne zisonga zenyu zose,

hambi nha wetuma wubi hali 'ne,

ane no Muwaha Mulungu.

15 Ale, mumuhomaje, akuno mukumuzozeza mbavu zose ze likaya!

Alu, Babiloni yakondya kupilimwa mbavu zose.

Ne majinji gayo gose gakondya kukumulwa no kugwiswa hasi.

Nane nghwilipiciza cilipicizo kuli Wababiloni.

Holeka mwilipicizaje cilipicizo cenyu muli wene.

Muwatendele nawo nha vyono nawo wawatendelaga wanji.

16 Mulece kuleceleza hamba mbeyu zihadikwe kanyhi mu yisi yiyo,

hamba ndudula yo yose.

Ne wajenzi wose wono wekalaga mumo kolo wakuwuwona wulugu,

hodu nawo wokogopa wawe kuwuya ku zikwawo.”

U wuwuye we wanhu wa Isilayeli

17 U Muwaha Mulungu yakutya nhavi, “I wanhu wa Isilayeli, wenha zingholo zono zawingwa ne simba, no kwiyagazwa ako na ako. Hambi ha lulongozi, nha wakahomwa no mutemi wa Ashuli, hanyuma yayo kanyhi, wakahomwa na Nebukadineza, u mutemi wa Babiloni, yakawabenanga mafupa gawo.
18 Holeka ku soko ya zizo, ane no Muwaha Mulungu we mihanga, ane no Mulungu wa Isilayeli, nomulipiciza u mutemi Nebukadineza hamonga ne yisi yakwe, nha vyono namulipiciza u mutemi wa Ashuli.
19 Hanyuma niwagomole wanhu wa Isilayeli ku yisi yawo. Nawo kolo wafika kuko, wowa kulya zindigwa za mwi'tunda lya Kalimeli, hamonga na za mu yisi ya Bashani. Nawo wowa kulya ndigwa yo yose du yono wosaka, yono yikulawa mu ma'si ga Efulayimu na Gileyadi.
20 Na kolo vilo vivyo vikuza, holowa hasina wubi wo wose kanyhi, wono wolowa kwitumwa na Isilayeli, hamba mabi go gose mu Yuda. Hambi nha nolowanenela wanhu wose wono nolowasigaza. Vyo nghutya, ane no Muwaha Mulungu.”

U wuling'anizi wo Mulungu, kuli yisi ya Babiloni

21 U Muwaha Mulungu yakutya nhavi,

“Ale, muwahomaje wanhu wa Melatayimu na wa ku Pekodi.

Muwawulaje no kuwongomezeza lukulu.

Muzinozaje zose nha vyono nghumulajilizenyi nene.

Vyo nghutya, ane no Muwaha Mulungu.

22 Ne mazozo go wulugu gakuhulikwa mu'si.

Ho wuli wongomezwe wuwaha muno.

23 Babiloni yayipondanjiza yisi ne nyondo no kuyibenanjiza.

Ninga luno, nyondo yiyo nayo yakondya kubenanjika!

Sunga ne makungugo gose gatinuswa,

ku soko ya zono zakondya kuyagana yisi yiyo.

24 Agwe Babiloni, wali kwihoma nane,

nalu nane nakwibata mu mutego wono nali nghutejile,

ninga agwe si wali wuzimanyile zizo.

25 Nane luno,

nakondya kuhadigula i hanhu hono nali niviwicile vitwalo vyangu.

Nane navisola kwe likuwo lyangu.

Hambi 'ne no Muwaha Mulungu, we mihanga,

nha nina mulimo wo kuvitumamila mu yisi ya Babiloni.

26 Muyihomaje yisi mbavu zose,

mugabene ne madongha gono yiwicilaga wuhemba wayo!

Kanyhi muvitekaje ne vinhu vinji muno kotya nhe lundo lyo wuhemba!

Muyongomeze yisi yose!

Mulecele lukulu kusigaza hamba cinhu co cose mumo!

27 Muwawulaje ne wasilikale wayo wose!

Muwongomezeze lukulu!

Woyi hee, kuli nye, nyo wanhu wa Babiloni!

Hambi lizuwa nha lyakondya kuza lyo kumuling'anizenyi nanye.”

28 (Ne wanhu wono wakutiza kuko ku Babiloni, no kuza ku Yelusalemi, wawo wo walalonga zose, nha vyono u Muwaha Mulungu u Mulungu wetu yakwilipiciza cilipicizo ku soko ya zono Babiloni yetuma mu Nyumba yiyi yo Mulungu.)

29 “Walonjele i wanhu wo wupinde, wewikanize, wayihome Babiloni. Muwategule wanhu wose wono wamanyile kuwitumamila wupinde ne zisonga. Mulipilime likaya, kanyhi mulanjilile, mulece kumuleceleza yunji wo wose yatije. Mulilipicize ku soko ya zose zono lyetuma. Kanyhi mulitendele nha vyono lyene lyawatendela wanji. Hambi nha lyazinozaga zizo zose ko widunhumuzi hali 'ne, ane mono nelile wa Isilayeli.
30 Holeka ku soko yiyo, i wazelelo wakwe wose wowulajilwa mu zinzila za mwi'kaya. Ne wasilikale wakwe wose, wokongomezezwa lukulu mwi'zuwa lilyo. Vyo nghutya, ane no Muwaha Mulungu.”

31 “Agwe Babiloni, mbeka wumemile widunhumuzi wose.

Holeka nane no Muwaha Mulungu we mihanga,

nili mulugu wako!

Alu nane lizuwa lyakondya kuza lyo kukulipiciza nagwe.

32 Ne likungugo lyako lyo widunhumuzi,

lyokobala no kugwa.

Na howa hasina hamba munhu monga mono kokutaziza yaye.

Nogapembela moto makaya gako gose,

ne vinhu vyose vyono vili mugati yayo,

vyokongomezezwa lukulu.”

33 U Muwaha Mulungu yakutya nhavi, “I wanhu wa Isilayeli ne wanhu wa Yuda, wakwiwonelwa muno. Na wose wono wakuwateka, hodu wakuwebata nzii, hamba si wakuwalecela yaye.
34 Ninga mono kowaponya, yali vilungo muno, ne litagwa lyakwe yakucemwa u Muwaha Mulungu, we mihanga. Mweneco du yo kowakalalila no kuyiletela yisi mulamu. Ninga gowa magayo kuli wanhu wa Babiloni.”

35 U Muwaha Mulungu yakutya nhavi,

“Lifwa kuli Babiloni!

Lifwa kuli wanhu wayo,

hamonga ne watemi, ne wanhu wayo we mahala.

36 Lifwa kuli wawizi wayo walambi,

nawo walelepa muno nye!

Lifwa kuli wasilikale wayo,

nawo wenjilwa no woga muno!

37 Mongomeze zifwalasi zawo hamonga ne magali gawo go wulugu!

Lifwa kuli wasilikale wawo wo kulipwa,

nawo ho watimba muno!

Mongomeze sunga ne viwutwa vyawo,

muvitece no kuvisola.

38 Muwaletele nzala mu yisi yawo muganyaze ne makolongo gayo.

Babiloni yo yisi yono yina vihwani vyo kogofya muno,

na vivyo vyo vyawapuvya wanhu.

39 “Na ku soko yiyo, holeka Babiloni, wowa wikalo we masetani ne myuhe myavu, hamonga ne zindeje zinyavufywe. Langa wanhu, hamba si wolokwikalila lukulu kanyhi kuko cibitilila.
40 Ne nghani yiyo yokwijela ku Babiloni, nha vyono zejela ku Sodoma na Gomola, lono nazongomezeza, hamonga ne vikaya vyono vyali vili behi behi nazo. Na holowa hasina hamba munhu wo wose, mono kolokwikala mumo kanyhi. Vyo nghutya ane, no Muwaha Mulungu.

41 “Nawo wanhu wakuza wakulawilila ku yisi yo lubavu lwa kusumuka,

likungugo lyono lili vilungo muno,

sunga ne watemi wenji wakwiwikaniza so wulugu.

42 Nawo wakondya kusola sunga ne vitwalo vyawo

vyo wupinde hamonga ne mimaje.

Nawo wakali muno,

kanyhi wasina hamba no lusungu yaye,

nawo wakukoloma nhe ngholomo ye lilenga,

lono wakuzimasya zifwalasi zawo.

Nawo wewikanize du, wayihome Babiloni.

43 Nayo u mutemi wa Babiloni yakuzihulika zizi,

ne miwoko yakwe yafwa yitenene.

Ne magayo, gakondya kumwibata,

genha go wusungu wo mucekulu mono yali mu nghunga yo lusawo.

44 “Nane nolokuza niwanoze Wababiloni wayitize yisi yawo nhinicizo, nha vyono simba liswelepukaga nhinicizo, likulawa mu mibici yono yititile muno, ya mu mwalambalo we likolongo lya Yoludani, mu wudimilo wono si wunyalaga. Nane no Muwaha Mulungu, nowawinga nhinicizo i wanhu wakwe wawuce muli mwene. Nolomuwika mulongola mono nolomuhagula nene no mweneco. Hambi nani lo mono yenha nene? Nani lo mono kosuma kusitaka? Hamba mudimici mono kosima kunyimila?
45 Alu, muhulicize ta, i mahweso gono nghulihweseza likaya lya Babiloni, hamonga na zono nghusaka niwatendele wanhu wayo. Sunga ne wana wawo wolokwejenhwa, ne wanhu wose wolokwinjilwa no woga.
46 Na kolo Babiloni yakondya kugwa, yisi yolocicimila lizi lyo wugwe wuwo, ne cililo cayo colohulikwa kutali, sunga ko ku nghungugo zinji.”


Yelemiya 51

U wuling'anizi wunji kanyhi, kuli Babiloni

1 U Muwaha Mulungu yakutya nhavi,

“Noleta libeho lyo wuhodanje,

mu yisi ya Babiloni, na muli wanhu wayo.

2 Nawategula wanhu wajenzi,

wayongomeze Babiloni,

nhe libeho likuputa mawaje go 'hemba.

Na kolo lizuwa lilyo lyo wuhodanje likuza,

wawo wajenzi woloyihoma Babiloni ku wulawa mbavu zose,

wayilece yili bwete.

3 Hamba si wowaleceleza i wasilikale

wa Babiloni watuje cilejeho co kuguma zisonga zawo,

hamba kuvwala vivwalo vyawo vye cuma.

Kanyhi si wosigaza muzelelo hamba monga.

Langa wolyongomeza du lipuga lyose!

4 Wowapela nghomele mbaha,

nawo wowa kufwila du mu zinzila ze makaya gawo.

5 Ane no Muwaha Mulungu we mihanga,

nghali hamba si nawaleka Isilayeli na Yuda yaye,

hamba wawe wene wetuma wubi hali 'ne,

ane Mono nelile wa Isilayeli.

6 Mutize wulawa mu Babiloni!

Munhu yeponye nhumbula yakwe!

Mulece kutamisizwa lukulu so wubi wa Babiloni.

Hambi nha go madaha gangu luno,

go kwilipiciza cilipicizo cangu kuli wene,

nha vyono yiwanojeye.

7 Babiloni, yali nha cikombe ca zahabu mu muwoko wangu,

cono cawang'wesaga i wanhu wose wa mono'nze sunga wagala.

Nago makungugo, gakaying'wa divayi yiyo,

gakagala, sunga ne mahala gawo gakajilila.

8 Woyi hee! Babiloni yigwa no kongomela!

Ale, muyilililaje!

Alu mulondole miti yo kuzilagulila zinghomele zayo,

nha lunji konoga.

9 Nawo iwajenzi wono wekalaga mumo mu Babiloni,

wakutya nhavi.

Nase cajela muno kuyitaza Babiloni,

ninga cikawa cacela.

Holeka luno, yicinojeye hodu ciyilece,

ciwuce ciwuye ku zikwetu.

Hambi u Mulungu nha yakondya kuyilipiciziza Babiloni

mu vilungo vyakwe vyose, no kuyongomezeza lukulu.”

10 U Muwaha Mulungu yakutya nhavi,

“I wanhu wangu wakwicemeleza wakutya nhavi,

‘U Muwaha Mulungu yakondya kulajila zo wiling'ano wetu.

Holeka aluno, cibitenyi cikawalonjele i wanhu wa mu Yelusalemi,

zono u Muwaha Mulungu,

u Mulungu wetu yetumile.’ ”

11 U Muwaha Mulungu kawasagahiza i watemi wa Mediya, hambi nha yakusaka yayongomeze Babiloni. Na yiyo yo nzila yono kokwitumamila ho yayilipicize Babiloni, ku soko vyono wene wayihodanga Nyumba yakwe.

Nawo i walongola we milewo,

wakulajiliza wakutya, “Ale!

Nolenyi zisonga zenyu!

Muwikanize ne zingula zenyu!

12 Mwinule bendela mucanyha ye majinji ga Babiloni.

Muwice wulindilizi we vilungo!

Muwice walindilizi!

Muwice wanhu wono wowa kugoza.”

Hambi u Muwaha Mulungu,

nha yakondya kwituma zinghani zono yalonga,

nha vyono kowatendela wanhu wa Babiloni.

13 Alu, mulanje ta, yisi yono yina makolongo menji,

hamonga no wugoli wuwaha,

ninga cipango cayo cakondya kuza, co mudumo wayo.

14 U Muwaha Mulungu we mihanga,

kelahiza ko mutima wakwe,

nha vyono kotuma wanhu wenji,

waze wayihome Babiloni,

nawo wowa wenji nhe mawumbi ge zinzije.

Nawo wowa kwimba so wusume.

U lwimbo lo kumukumya Mulungu

15 U Muwaha Mulungu yayiwumba yinze kwe vilungo vyakwe,

yayinoza yisi kwe mahala gakwe,

yakawutandika no wulanga.

16 Na ko wulajilize wakwe,

malenga ga mu wulanga gadidimaga,

kanyhi kagakongholaga mavunde ku wulawa ku zimhelo ze 'nze.

Kaganozaga mamuli gawa kumulika mu mvula,

kanyhi kayiletaga mbeho ku wulawa mu wuwiko wayo.

17 Na muli zizo zose,

i wanhu wawonaga nha wulele du,

kanyhi wasina mahweso.

Nawo wono wasesaga vihwani, wakozwa cevu,

hambi i milungu yono wayinozaga,

nha milungu ya wulambi du,

kanyhi musina wehele muli yene.

18 Holeka yisina cambuzi du hamba cidodo,

yinojeye yibedegalwe.

Ninga u Muwaha Mulungu kolo yeza kuza,

koyongomeza yose.

19 U Mulungu wa Yakobo nha si yehwanile yene,

hambi mwene, nha yo yaviwumba vinhu vyose,

kanyhi yo mweneco mono yayihaga nghungugo ya Isilayeli

wawe wanhu wakwe mweneco.

Ne litagwa lyakwe mwene,

yo Muwaha Mulungu we mihanga.

I nyondo yo Muwaha Mulungu

20 U Muwaha Mulungu yakutya nhavi,

“Agwe Babiloni, yo gwegwe mono wuli nyondo yangu,

kanyhi yo gwegwe mono wuli citwalo cangu co wulugu.

Nane nghakwitumamila, ho wugabenanjize makungugo,

hamonga no wutemi wayo.

21 No kuzibenanjiza zifwalasi,

hamonga na wono wakuzipanda,

no kubenanjiza matuka go wulugu,

hamonga na wono wakugajendya,

22 no kuwawulaga i walume ne wacekulu,

no kuwawulaga i wanhu mututu, ne wana wadodo,

no kuwawulaga i wazelelo ne wahinza,

23 no kuwawulaga i wadimi hamonga ne mitugo zawo,

no kuwawulaga i walimi hamonga ne zifwalasi zawo,

no kuwabenanjizanga i watemi,

hamonga ne wetumami wawo wawaha.”

U wulipicizwe wa Babiloni

24 U Muwaha Mulungu yakutya nhavi, “Ninga nane luno, nomulipa Babiloni hamonga ne wanhu wayo, muli zimbi zose zono wetuma mu Yelusalemi.

25 “Hambi agwe Babiloni, nha wehwana nhe litunda,

lyono likuyongomeza yinze yose.

Ninga wumanye, nha vyono,

ane no Muwaha Mulungu, nili mulugu wako.

Nokwibata, nghugalagaze ho hasi,

nghulece wuvutuce ne mavu.

26 Sunga ne mabwe gono golowa mu wongomele wako,

si golosuma kwitumamilwa kanyhi mu wuzenjelwe.

Nagwe kolowa nha nyika cibitilila.

Vyo nghutya, ane no Muwaha Mulungu.

27 “Mwinule bendela hacanyha so wihomi!

Mutowe ne ndulele, i makungugo ho gahulice!

Mugawikanize makungugo so wulugu, wayihome Babiloni!

Muwalonjele sunga ne watemi wa Alalati na Mini,

hamonga na Ashikenazi, wose wenjile mu milewo.

Mulete zifwalasi, ziwe nyinji muno nhe matewa ge zinzije.

28 Mugawikanize makungugo so wulugu,

wayihome Babiloni.

Mutume wanhu wabite wakawalonjele sunga ne watemi wa Mediya,

hamonga ne walongola wawo,

ne wetumami wawo,

ne wanhu wose wa mu zi'si za mu wutemi wawo.

29 Sunga ne yisi yose yikucicima,

ku soko u Muwaha Mulungu,

yeza kuzifisiliza zono yazilonga,

yayinoze Babiloni yiwe nyika,

yiwe yisina hamba munhu mono kokwikala mumo.

30 Ne wasilikale wa Babiloni,

nha wakondya kusimya milewo,

nalu wenjila mu magomawakali gawo.

Alu wasina vilungo kanyhi,

weza wenha wacekulu.

Ne milango yose ye likaya, nha yabeneka,

ne zikaya zikukongojela mu moto.

31 Vipuga vya wanhu,

wakumangha wakubita kumulonjela mutemi wa Babiloni,

nha vyono likaya lyakwe lyakondya kubenwa mbavu zose.

32 Ne walugu wakondya kuliteka likolongo,

lyono lidumuye mwi'kaya, kanyhi na vyono,

sunga ne magomawakali gose,

gakondya kupembelwa moto.

Ne wasilikale wose wa Babiloni,

wakondya kwinjilwa no woga.

33 Ne walugu wowasuma musunho,

wawakanyaje nho 'hemba mu cuga.

Vyo nghutya, ane no Muwaha Mulungu,

we Mihanga, u Mulungu wa Isilayeli.”

34 U mutemi Nebukadineza wa Babiloni,

kalihodanga likaya lya Yelusalemi

no kulinoza liwa nha ciya cono cili bwete,

liwa nha limeligwe na nzoka.

Yakasola vyose vyono yasakaga mwene,

na vyono vyasigala, yakavitaga kutali.

35 Nawo i wanhu wa ku Yelusalemi wotya nhavi,

“Leka ta, Babiloni nayo yiwone wusungu,

ku soko yo wubi wono yacitendela!

‘Leka ta, Babiloni nayo yilipicizwe,

ku soko ye magazo gono cagaya!’ ”

U Muwaha Mulungu kowaponya Isilayeli

36 U Muwaha Mulungu yakuwalonjela i wanhu wa Yelusalemi,

yakutya nhavi,

“Lanje ta, ane nohijila i zako,

nane nowalipiciza cilipicizo i walugu wako,

ku soko ye zinghani zono wakutendela.

Nowunyaza no muvwilo we malenga ga Babiloni,

hamonga ne makolongo gayo.

37 Nayo yisi yiyo, yolowa malundo du ga matongo,

holowa wikalo wa malimu.

Holowa hanhu hono hakogofya muno,

hasina hamba munhu mono kolokwikala mumo.

Na wose wono wowa kuziwona zizo,

mbeka wotuga woga muno muno.

38 Nawo Wababiloni, wokoloma nha simba,

wokoloma nha mana ga simba.

39 Hono wawe wenjilwa no wukali,

nane nowanozeza ndigwa yawo,

nowang'wesa, wagale, wasangalale.

Hanyuma wawe kugona nhongo ze cibitilila,

hamba si wolokwinuka kanyhi.

40 Nowasola niwategule wakawulagwe nha ngholo,

hamba mhene, hamba nyana za ngholo.

Vyo nghutya, ane no Muwaha Mulungu.”

U wugwe wa Babiloni

41 Nayo u Muwaha Mulungu,

yakulonga za kuli Babiloni, yakutya nhavi,

“Alu mulanje ta,

likaya lyono lyali lina lukumyo mono'nze yose,

alu lyakondya kusolwa!

Babiloni yeza wambuce muli makungugo, nhawule!

42 Lilenga lifika mu Babiloni,

nayo yifunikwa so winji we mawingo gayo.

43 Ne makaya gayo geza gakogofya,

gehwana ne nyika yono yisina malenga,

hono hasina munhu wowose mono yekaye mumo,

hamba mono yakukola mumo kanyhi.

44 Nane nomulipiciza Beli, u mulungu wa Babiloni.

Nane nomunoza yalavyanize milungu yose yono yayihiza.

Ne makungugo si gomuhemba kanyhi yaye.”

“Majinji ga Babiloni gakondya kugwa.

45 Nawo i wanhu wa Isilayeli wakondya kutiza!

Nye nyo wanhu wangu, mutize,

mwiponye nhumbula zenyu ne likuwo lyangu likali.

46 Ninga mulece kutukuwika mitima yenyu,

hamba kuwa no woga kuli zinghani zono mukuzihulika mu'si.

Hambi mapwepwe nha si goleka kuza,

mwaka na lupwepwe lwayo lono lwisimile.

Hanji lupwepwe lwe mawulaji mu'si,

hamonga no wihomi wo mutemi no mutemi muyagwe.

47 Ninga hamba nhavivyo,

lizuwa lyolokuza lyono nolonoza wuling'anizi ne vihwani vya Babiloni.

Ne yisi yose yolokozwa cevu muno muno.

Ne wanhu wayo wose wolowulagwa.

48 Ne vinhu vyose vyono vili mono'si na vyono vili ku wulanga,

vyolosecelela muno muno,

kolo Babiloni yikugwiswa ne wanhu wono wakulawa

ku lubavu lwa kusumuka kuza kuyongomeza.

49 Hambi Babiloni nha yo yambuza lifwa lye wanhu wenji mono'nze yose.

Holeka luno nayo Babiloni,

yogwa ku soko vyono yambuza Waisilayeli wenji wakafwa.

Vyo nghutya, ane no Muwaha Mulungu.”

I nghani yo Mulungu kuli Waisilayeli wono wali ku Babiloni

50 U Muwaha Mulungu yakuwalonjela

wanhu wakwe wono wali ku Babiloni, yakutya nhavi,

“Nanye, vyono mwakondya kupona mwi'fwa,

alu mutuluce mubite!

Mulece kanyhi kulindila!

Hamba muwe muli kutali muno na ku zikwenyu,

ninga 'nye munyitumbile nene du,

ane no Muwaha Mulungu wenyu.

Kanyhi muyikumbucilaje na Yelusalemi.

51 Ninga 'nye mukutya ti, ‘Oo!

Ase nha cikozwa cevu, kanyhi cikuwona soni,

kanyhi cikwiwona nha cisina wutazi wo wose,

hambi i wajenzi nha wenjila hono helile mu Nyumba yo Mulungu.’

52 Ninga ane nghutya,

lizuwa lyokuza lono nane noviling'aniza vihwani vyose vya mu Babiloni,

nawo wono watuga nghomele wololila mu'si yose.

53 Nayo Babiloni, hamba yali yinyasuce ko ku wulanga,

yikazenje magomawakali ge vilungo kuko.

Hamba nhavivyo, vyo nali niwatume wanhu kuko,

wabite wakayongomeze du.

Vyo nghutya, ane no Muwaha Mulungu.”

U wongomezwe wunji kanyhi, we yisi ya Babiloni

54 U Muwaha Mulungu yakutya nhavi,

“Alu, muhulicize mazi ge cililo, gono

gakulawa ku Babiloni,

so wongomele wuwaha we'si.

55 Ane nghuyongomeza Babiloni,

nghusaka niyinyamaze du twii.

Ne mapuga ge wasilikale, wakwinjila lumangho,

wenha mawingo gono gakukoloma

no kuhoma, akuno wazozize muno.

56 Walugu nha waza ho wayongomeze Babiloni,

ne wasilikale wayo wakutekwa,

ne mapinde gawo gakubeneka.

Hambi ane nha yo nene Mulungu, mono niwulipicizaga wubi.

Nane noyitendela Babiloni nha vyono yene yinojeye.

57 Nowanoza i watemi wayo wang'we, wagale,

hamonga ne wanhu we mahala, ne walongola,

ne wasilikale wose.

Nawo wogona nhongo ze cibitilila,

hamba si wolokwinucila lukulu.

Vyo nghutya ane no Mutemi,

ane mono nili Muwaha Mulungu, we mihanga.

58 Ne majinji ge likaya lye vilungo Babiloni,

golokumulwa gagwiswe ho hasi.

Ne milango yayo mitali,

nayo yolopembelwa moto yikongojele.

Ne milimo yose ye makungugo, yo nghani ya bwete du,

hambi u wuhidimbazi wawo nha wuli mu malambi go moto.

Vyo nghutya, ane no Muwaha Mulungu.”

I nghani ya Yelemiya, yikutegulwa ku Babiloni

59 U munhu mono vyali vili behi muno no mutemi Zedekiya, yali Selaya u mwana wa Neliya, kanyhi yo mwizukulu wa Maseya. Ale, mu mwaka we kane, wo wutemi wa Zedekiya mu Yuda, Selaya yabitaga ku Babiloni hamonga no mutemi Zedekiya. Nane nghamupela malajilizo.
60 Nghandika mu citabu zinghani zose zo wongomezwe wono woyiziza Babiloni, hamonga ne zinghani zose za Babiloni.
61 Nghamulonjela Selaya nghamutya, “Kolo weza kufika kuko ku Babiloni, wuzisomaje kwe 'zi yiwaha ha mwande ye wanhu wose, zinghani zizi zose zono zandicigwe mumu.
62 Hanyuma wuwe kulomba wukutya, ‘Gwe go Muwaha Mulungu, yo gwegwe watya nha vyono, kolohongomeza hanhu bahano, ho halece kuwa na cinhu co cose cumi, cono cokwikala mumo, hamba munhu hamba nimu, nayo yisi yowa nyika cibitilila.’
63 Nagwe Selaya kolo wakondya kuzisoma hali wanhu, zose zono zili mu citabu cici, nhondo wuciwopelezaje ne libwe, wucigumile mwi'kolongo lya Efulata,
64 akuno wukutya, ‘Nhavivi vyo yotagwa Babiloni, nayo yolododomela, hamba si yolokwibuka kanyhi, ku soko yo wongomele wono u Muwaha Mulungu koyongomezeza.’ ” Ne zinghani zo muwizi Yelemiya, bahano ho zidumiye.


Yelemiya 52

U wugwe wa Yelusalemi

(2Wat 24:18–25:7)

1 Zedekiya yali yaficile myaka makumi mejete na wumonga, lono yatemela mu yisi ya Yuda. Nayo yakatema na mu Yelusalemi myaka yikumi na wumonga. No nyina yacemwaga Hamutali, yali mwana we cicekulu wa Yelemiya, mono yekalaga mwi'kaya lya Libuna.
2 Ninga u mutemi Zedekiya, yetuma wubi hali Muwaha Mulungu, nha vyono u mutemi Yehoyakimu yetuma.
3 Nayo u Muwaha Mulungu, yakawakolelwa muno likuwo i wanhu wa Yelusalemi na Yuda, hobaho yakawa kuwawusa walece kuwa ha mwande ye meso gakwe.

Zedekiya yakalemela lukulu kumuhulika Nebukadineza u mutemi wa Babiloni.
4 Ku soko yiyo, Nebukadineza nayo yakawa kuza hamonga ne wasilikale wakwe, wakawa kuyihoma Yelusalemi mwi'zuwa lye likumi, lya mu mwezi we likumi, wa mu mwaka we likumi, wo wuteme wa Zedekiya. Nawo wali weza kuza, wakasita nghambi yawo kunze ye likaya, hanyuma wakawa kuzenga majinji, gakalipilima likaya mbavu zose.
5 Nawo wakawa kulikaliza likaya, walipilime du, sunga mu mwaka we likumi na monga wo wuteme wa Zedekiya.
6 Na mwi'zuwa lye licenda, lya mu mwezi we kane, wa mu mwaka wuwo, lono wanhu wa mwi'kaya wali webatwa ne nzala mbaha, hambi nha wali weza wasina ndigwa hamba ndodo,
7 ale baho, lijinji likabenwa, ne wanhu wose wo wulugu wakatiza, wakawuka mwi'kaya ne cilo. Hamba wawe Wababiloni wali walipilime likaya, ninga wene wakatiza, wakakolela mu nzila yo mulango wono wali haciligati ye majinji mejete, behi ne busitani yo mutemi, wakatyatya nzila yono yibitile kwi'lolo lya Yoludani.
8 Ninga hamba nhavivyo, i wasilikale we Cibabiloni, wakamuwinga mutemi Zedekiya, sunga wakamwibatila mu mawimbi, behi ne yisi ya Yeliko. Ninga i wasilikale wakwe wose, wakatiza wakamuleka yali wene.
9 Hobaho Zedekiya yakawa kusolwa, yakawa kutegulwa kuli mutemi Nebukadineza, na mwi'daha lilyo, mwene Nebukadineza, yali yali mwi'kaya lya Libula mu yisi ya Hamati. Nayo Nebukadineza yakawa kulavya wuling'anizi muli Zedekiya.
10 Mutemi Nebukadineza, yakawawulaga wana wa Zedekiya, yakawawulajila ha meso go sogo yawo, kuko ku Libula. Yakawawulaga sunga ne wawaha wose wa Yuda.
11 Hanyuma ya zizo, yakawa kumusola Zedekiya, yakawa kumukopozola meso gakwe, yakawa kumuwopa ne manyolo, yakawa kumutegula ku Babiloni. Yakamutajila mujela, nayo Zedekiya yekala mumo mu jela ku Babiloni sunga yakafwila mumo.

Wongomele we Nyumba yo Mulungu

(2Wat 25:8-17)

12 Na mwi'zuwa lye likumi, lya mu mwezi we 'hano wa mu mwaka we likumi ne 'cenda, wo mutemi Nebukadineza, u mutemi wa Babiloni, yakaza Nebuzaladani u muwaha we wasilikale i walindilizi wo mutemi wa Babiloni, yakenjila ku Yelusalemi.
13 Yakayipembela moto Nyumba yo Mulungu, hamonga ne kaya ye likulu, hamonga ne zikaya zose ze wawaha wa mu Yelusalemi.
14 Nawo i wasilikale wakwe, wakagakumula majinji ge likaya.
15 Nayo Nebuzaladani, yakawakonghola i wanhu wose wono wali wakali wasigaye mwi'kaya, hamonga ne wazenji wanghula, hamonga na wono wamanyhila ko mutemi wa Babiloni. Wose wawa, yakawategula ku Babiloni.
16 Ninga hamba nhavivyo, yawasigaza mumo mu Yuda, i wanhu waciwa muno, wono wali wasina sawo yo yose. Yakawenjiza mu milimo yo kuyikamisa migunda ye mizabibu no kuyilimila.

17 Wababiloni, wakagasola masumbili ge shaba, gono gali gali mu Nyumba yo Mulungu, ne mikokoteni yono yali yili mumo mu Nyumba yo Mulungu, hamonga ne litanji lye shaba lye malenga, wakavibenanga vikawa vidodo vidodo, wakawa kuvitegula vyose ku Babiloni.
18 Wakasola ne zikoleyo, ne viya vyono wetumamilaga so kuwusiza mavu mu cikumbicilo, hamonga ne viya vyose vyono wetumamilaga so kukoleleza zitala, ne zibakuli zono wambilaga sakami ye zimitugo ze makumbiko, ne zibakuli zono wetumamilaga kufusiza wuvumba, hamonga ne viya vyose vye shaba, vyono wetumamilaga mu wuhembi, mu Nyumba yo Mulungu.
19 Wakavisola vinhu vyose du, vye zahabu hamba fweza, hamonga sunga ne vibakuli vidodo-dodo vyose, hamonga ne visahani vyono wetumamilaga so kupalila makala go moto. Hamonga ne zibakuli zono wambilaga sakami ye zi mitugo ze makumbiko, ne viya vyo kuwusiza mavu, ne viwicilo vye zitala, ne visahani vyo kufusiza wuvumba, hamonga ne zibakuli zono wetumamilaga so vilavywa vye divayi.
20 Hamonga ne vinhu vyose vye shaba, vyono mutemi Solomona yavinoza, so Nyumba yo Mulungu, nha cinji, i masumbili mejete ge shaba, ne mikokoteni, ne litanji liwaha, hamonga ne zing'ombe yikumi na nyejete ze shaba, zono zali njelekwe litanji lilyo mucanyha yazo. Ne viya vivyo vyose vye shaba, vyali vinji muno muno, vyono si vyasumika kumanyika no wuzito wayo.
21 Ne masumbili gago mejete, limonga lyali lina wutali wa mita munana, no wukangazi wayo wali wa mita yihano na lobo.
22 Masumbili gago gali gena mitwe ya shaba. Ne masumbili gago gose, limonga lyali lina mutwe wa shaba, kucanyha yalyo, no wutali wo mutwe monga wali mita nyejete na sentimita makumi mejete, hamonga no wutande wo lwavu lwe makomamanga mucanyha yo mutwe wayo mbavu zose, na vyose vyali vya shaba.
23 Na mu wutande wo lwavu wa mu masumbili gose, mwali muwiciligwe makomamanga yigana limonga limonga. Ne makomamanga makumi cenda na mutandatu ga muli gaga, ago gejelaga calinze ku wulawa hasi.

I wanhu wa Yuda wakusolwa, no kutegulwa ku Babiloni

(2Wat 25:18-21, 27-30)

24 Hamonga na zizo, yuyo Nebuzaladani, u muwaha we wasilikale walindilizi, yakawasola nha wafungwa, Selaya u mukohani muwaha, na Zefaniya u mukohani mutazi, hamonga na wanji wadatu, i wetumami wawaha wa mu Nyumba yo Mulungu.
25 Kanyhi na mu wulawa mumo mwi'kaya, yakamusola muwaha yumonga mono yali muwaha we wasilikale, hamonga na wanji wahano, wono wali wo watazi wo mutemi, wono wali wakali wasigaye mwi'kaya, hamonga no muwaha mutazi yunji we kejete we wasilikale, mono yali yo mukamisa zinghani zose zo wulugu, hamonga na wanhu wanji makumi mutandatu we lilumbo.
26 Yuyo Nebuzaladani, yakawasola, yakawategula kuli Nebukadineza mutemi wa Babiloni, mono mwi'pango lilyo, yali yali ku Libula,
27 mu yisi ya Hamati. Nayo mutemi Nebukadineza, yakawabocela, yakawatowanga, yakawawulaga wose.

Hanyuma i wanhu wa Yuda, wakasolwa, wakahamywa mu yisi yawo,
28 liwalo lye wanhu wono Nebukadineza yawasola wafungwa lyo lino. Mu mwaka wo mupunghati, wa mu wuteme wakwe, yasola wanhu elufu yidatu na makumi mejete na wadatu.
29 Mu mwaka we likumi na munana, wa mu wuteme wakwe, yasola wanhu magana munana na makumi madatu na wejete, mu wulawa mu Yelusalemi.
30 Mu mwaka we makumi mejete ne 'datu, wa mu wuteme wakwe, yasola wanhu magana mupunghati na makumi mane na wahano. Ne wanhu wawo, wasolwa na Nebuzaladani no kutegulwa ku Babiloni. Ne liwalo lyawo, wali waficile wanhu elufu yine na magana mutandatu, wose hamonga.

31 Na mu mwaka wono Evilimelodaki yatemela mu Babiloni, yakamuwonela lusungu Yehoyakimu u mutemi wa Yuda, hodu yakawa kumuwopolela, yakawuka mu jela. Na zizi zejela mwi'zuwa lye makumi mejete ne hano, lya mu mwezi we likumi na nyejete, wa mu mwaka we makumi madatu na mupunghati, ku wulawa mu wuhamywe wakwe.
32 Mwene Evilimelodaki yakamutendela viswanu muno Yehoyakimu u mutemi wa Yuda yakamupela lilumbo yiwaha muno si nhe watemi wayagwe wose wono vyali vili hamonga nayo, kuko ku wuhamywe ku Babiloni.
33 Hobaho, Yehoyakimu nhondo, yakawa kukombolwa yabite yakawanize myenda ya mu jela, yavwale myenda yakwe, kanyhi yakawa kuhanga kulya ndigwa, hamonga no mutemi mu vilo vyose vyo wikale wakwe.
34 Na mu vilo vyose vyo wikale wakwe, vyono vyali vikali visigaye, yapegwaga wutazi no mutemi wono wamutazaga mu visakwa vyakwe vye nhondo zose, sunga lizuwa lyono yafwila.


I Cililo 1

Wukalale wa Yelusalemi

1 Lanje lu, likaya lili lya Yelusalemi vyono lyekala yiciwa,

ninga ho lyali limemile

wanhu wenji muno muno.

Nalyo lyali lina

ne lilumbo yiwaha mono yinze yose,

ninga alu mulanje,

lyehwana no mucekulu mufwile.

Na mu makaya gose,

lyene lyali nho mwana we cicekulu wo mutemi.

Ninga alu lyakondya kusolwa no kutegulwa ku wuwanda.

2 Alu Yelusalemi kekalaga yakulila cilo cose,

ne mahozi gakuhuluma mu meso.

Ne wendece wakwe wose we katali,

wakondya kumuleka, hasina hamba monga mono yakumutuza.

Na wono vyali vilunzize nayo, alu wamugaluka,

wose weza walugu wakwe.

3 Nawo wanhu wa Yuda, weza wawanda lu,

wono wasina wutazi wo wose.

Hambi lu nha wakondya kuhamywa ku zikaya zawo.

Weza wekala mu zi'si zinji,

wasina hamba welecele wo wose.

Wapilimwe ne walugu mbavu zose,

wasina hamba nzila yo kwiponezya.

4 Nalu hasina hamba munhu monga kanyhi,

mono kosuma kubita kuhemba ku Nyumba yo Mulungu

mu vilo vye zi sikukuu.

Ne wahinza wose wono wembaga,

alu wali mu wugaye,

nawo wakohani wakugula du.

Ne milango ye likaya, yeza mu wambuce,

nayo Sayuni yili mu wusungu wuwaha muno.

5 Ne walugu wa Yelusalemi wakondya kuyisuma

no kuyibata mu vilungo vyawo.

Nayo Muwaha Mulungu yayileka yinjile mu magazo,

ku soko yo wubi wayo winji.

Ne wanagwe nawo, wakondya kusolwa no kutegulwa kutali.

6 No lukumyo lwa Yelusalemi,

aluno lwaweza cinhu cono capuluta katali.

Ne walongola wayo wehwana ne zinzimba zono zigandile so nzala,

Nalu wakondya kubita wasina vilungo,

wakuhwagwa kumwande ya wono wakuwatyatya mu nyuma yawo.

7 Na mu wutamiswe wuwo,

alu Yelusalemi yikukumbucila zo lukumyo lwayo lwe katali.

Na lono yagwizaga mu miwoko ye walugu,

hali hasina hamba munya kumutaziza.

Ne walugu wakwe wakasecelela muno so wugwe wakwe.

8 No lukumyo lwa Yelusalemi lwakondya kuwuka,

alu yeza yali cipwi, yebatwe ne cevu.

Nalu yakugula yehundicize wusu wakwe, yakuwona soni.

Yelusalemi yetipiza mweneco so wubi wakwe.

9 No wubi wakwe wijeye calinze,

ninga mwene yakwilajila nha kotya si yali muli zizo yaye.

Holeka ku soko yiyo, no wugwe wakwe wa mbuko,

hamba hasina mono kosuma kumusindamika yaye.

Ne walugu wakwe wamusuma,

nalu mwene yakumulilila Muwaha Mulungu yamuwonele lusungu.

10 Ne walugu wakwe wakamuhiziza sawo yakwe yose.

Nayo yakawawona ne meso gakwe mweneco,

vyono wakwinjila mu Nyumba yo Mulungu,

mono Muwaha Mulungu yali yawalemeze

we makungugo walece kwinjila.

11 Nawo wanhu wakwe wose wakugula, wakulondola ndigwa.

Wakukawa vinhu vyawo na ndigwa, ho walece kufwa.

Holeka likaya likulila likutya,

“Gwe go Muwaha Mulungu wunghumbucile,

wugalanje magayo gangu.

12 “Alu Yelusalemi yikumulilila munhu wo wose mono yakupuluta, yikutya,

‘Ta muwone! Hasina hamba yunji

mono yatuga magayo mawaha gono genha gaga nha vyono ane ninha.’

Magayo gono Muwaha Mulungu yamheleye mwi'kuwo lyakwe.

13 “Kagumila moto ku wulawa kucanyha,

moto wono wukunyanya muli'ne.

Kanhega no mutego, kangwisa ho hasi.

Nalu yakondya kundeka nili wene, nili mu wusungu wuwaha.

14 “No wubi wangu wose mwene yawuwene,

kanyhi kawuwopeleza wose hamonga,

kawutumbika mu singo yangu.

Nane nghuwula vilungo, ku soko yo wuzito wayo.

Muwaha Mulungu kanyinjiza mu miwoko ye walugu wangu,

nane niwa sina wo kunhaza.

15 “Hambi Muwaha Mulungu

nha kawanoza vitung'ati wangu wawe si cinji kuli'ne.

Hambi nha katuma wasilikale wawongomeza wazelelo wangu.

Muwaha Mulungu kawakanyanjiza wanhu wangu,

nha vyono wakobongaga zabibu mu ciya co kuminyila.

16 “Na yo soko yono yikuleka meso gangu gakulawa mahozi.

Hasina hamba monga mono konhuza,

hamba kusikamya.

Hambi walugu wangu nha wakondya kusuma 'ne,

ne wanhu wangu wasina hamba cono ciwasigaliye.

17 “Nane ngoloye mawoko gangu,

ninga hasina hamba monga mono yakumhela wutazi.

Hambi Muwaha Mulungu

nha kandetela walugu ku wulawa mbavu zose.

Nawo wakunhendela nha cinhu cono citipiye.

18 “Ninga Muwaha Mulungu yo we ling'ani,

hambi nha yo nene mono si nali kwenda kumuhulika.

Holeka muhulicizaje anye wanhu wose,

muwuwone wugaye wangu.

Hambi i wazelelo wangu hamonga ne wacekulu,

nha wakondya kusolwa no kutegulwa kutali.

19 “Nane nghawacema wono cali cilunzize nawo,

ho waze wamhele wutazi,

ninga wakalema kuza.

I wakohani ne walongola,

wose wakafwila mwi'kaya,

lono walondolaga ndigwa, walece kufwa.

20 “Alu 'gwe go Muwaha Mulungu,

wulangaje ta wusungu

wono nina nawo mu nhumbula yangu!

Ne nhumbula yangu nha yatulilwa muno no wukalale,

ku soko yo wubi wangu.

Alu mu zinzila, mweza mowuli wuwulaji,

na mu milango namo, molili yifwa.

21 “Alu wulanje vyono, sunga na mu wugule wangu,

hasina hamba monga mono yakumhela wutuzwe.

Nawo walugu wangu wasangalaye,

vyono agwe kundetela wugaye wono winha wuwu.

Holeka lize mbela lizuwa lyako lyono wehuwiza,

liwanoze walugu wangu,

nawo wenjile mu magayo,

wagaye nha vyono ane nghugaya.

22 “Wuwaling'anize so wubi wawo wose.

Wuwalipicize nawo,

nha vyono wundipicize nene so wubi wangu.

Nghugula ko wusungu muno,

ne nhumbula yangu yizilice.”


I Cililo 2

Muwaha Mulungu yakuyilipiciza Yelusalemi

1 Nayo Muwaha Mulungu, yayifunika

Sayuni no wutitu mwi'kuwo lyakwe.

No lukumyo lwayo lwa ku wulanga, yaluhodanjila lukulu,

Na mwi'zuwa lye likuwo lyakwe,

yayileka sunga ne Nyumba yakwe.

2 Muwaha Mulungu yavyongomeza vitumbi vyose vya Yuda,

hamba kuviwonela lusungu yaye.

Yakumulanga ne magomawakali gose gono gayicitilaga yisi.

Yawaletela cevu ciwaha i watemi,

hamonga no wutemi wawo.

3 Na mwi'kuwo lyakwe, yavidumulanga vilungo vya Isilayeli.

Yalema kucipela wutazi, lono walugu waciziza.

Yacitakamiza nha vyono moto wutakamizaga vyose.

4 Yacilunga ne zisonga zakwe nha mulugu,

yawawulaga wose, wono wali wendeze ha meso getu.

Nase amuno mono Yelusalemi,

cikaliwona likuwo lyakwe vyono likwaka.

5 Muwaha Mulungu, yawahodanga Waisilayeli nha mulugu.

Yagaleka magomawakali gayo ne hanhu hayo vihodangwe.

Yawaletela wanhu wa Yuda wusungu wono si wolomalika.

6 Kayikumulanga Nyumba yo Mulungu,

yono cenjilaga cikumuhemba.

Yaciwusiza ne vilo vyetu vye zi sikukuu na vye zi Sabato.

I watemi hamonga ne wakohani,

wose wawuwona wukali we likuwo lyakwe.

7 U Muwaha Mulungu yakondya kucilema cikumbicilo cakwe,

no kuyileka Nyumba yakwe yono yelile.

Kakondya kuwaleka walugu wagakumulanje majinji gayo gose.

Wakuzoza na nyemo yo wusume, i hanhu hono katali,

cenjilaga cikuhemba na nyemo.

8 Muwaha Mulungu yali yasimbiliye,

vyono majinji ga Sayuni ganojeye gakumulangwe du.

Yakamula kuwalanga,

ho yawaletele wuhodanjice wono wuwakwiliye.

Majinji hamonga ne minala yayo, vyose vigwiye,

nalu gawa matongo.

9 Nayo milango yayo, mifucizwe mu malowanjila,

ne makomeyo gayo gose gabenanjice.

U mutemi hamonga ne wanhu wakwe,

wose wali ku wuhamywe.

Alu nhondo, hamba Wulajilize weza si wukwijizwa yaye,

ne wawizi nawo hamba si wakutuga wugubulilwe

ku wulawa kuli Muwaha Mulungu.

10 Nawo i wanhu wakombi wa mu Yelusalemi,

wekaye wanyamaye twii,

akuno weyitiye manghundi mu mitwe yawo, wavwalile magunila.

Nawo i wahinza, wenamizye mitwe yawo hasi.

11 Woyi, he! Nhondo ne meso gangu, gapaya so cililo,

ne nhumbula yangu nayo, yili mu wusungu wuwaha.

No wusungu wanhamisa muno,

ku soko yo wuhodanjice we wanhu wangu.

Naluno i wana wadodo hamonga ne wagalika,

wakuzilika du mu zinzila ze likaya.

12 Wakulilila wanyina zawo, so nzala ne nyhilu ye malenga.

Alu wakugwanga du mu zinzila,

wenha wanhu wono wena nghomele.

Hanyuma hodu,

wawa kufwila mu mawoko ge wanyina zawo mhola mhola.

13 Woyi he gwe Yelusalemi! Go mwendece wangu Yelusalemi!

Alu waco ho nolonga cici kanyhi?

Ho nosuma wule kukusindamika?

Hambi nha hasina munhu hamba monga,

mono yatamiswa nha vivi.

Hambi magayo gako nha gasina mupaka nhe lilenga.

Hasina hamba witumbilo kanyhi.

14 Sunga ne wawizi wako nawo,

weza wasina cinji cono wokulonjela,

langa zo wulambi-lambi du.

No wuganule wawo wukukongaga du,

hamba si wukuwa kukulajila zo wubi wako.

Na mu nzila yiyo, wakukunoza agwe,

ho wiwone nha vyono wusina soko yo kunena.

15 Ne wanhu wono wakupuluta wakolile mwi'kaya,

wakukulanga ko wubedegale,

wawa kusinjisa ne mitwe yawo akuno wakugaseka matongo ga Yelusalemi,

wakutya, “Mwene 'nye, mbeka lili lyo likaya liswanu,

lyono lyali likumuce mu yinze yose?”

16 Ne walugu wako wose,

alu wakukwizwajiza no kukunugulila ko lusulo,

akuno wakuyibobotola ne milomo yawo,

no kukubedula wakutya,

“Hee!

Cilihodanga si!

Ali lyo lizuwa lyono cali cililanjiliye muno!”

17 Alu Muwaha Mulungu,

nhondo ketuma zono yali yazitemizye kuzituma.

Kacihodanga yasina lusungu nha vyono yacilonjela.

Kawapela walugu wetu wusume,

kawapela wusangalale so wutamiswe wetu.

18 Gwe Yelusalemi,

wugalece majinji gako gamulilile Muwaha Mulungu!

Galekaje mahozi gako gasulule misi ne cilo.

Wisakaze ne cililo, hamonga no wusungu!

19 Na mu cilo cose,

weze kwinuka kali kenji wukumulilila Muwaha Mulungu,

wumujidile mutima wako nha malenga u Muwaha Mulungu,

wumulombe yawawonele lusungu wanago.

I wanago wono wakufwa ne nzala mu zinzila zose!

20 Gwe go Muwaha Mulungu, wuwalanje wawo ta,

wono wukuwatamisa, wo wa nani wene?

Alu wulanje vyono sunga ne wacekulu nhondo,

weza kulya ne miwili ye wana wawo wono wawendile!

Sunga ne wakohani hamonga ne wawizi,

nawo nhondo weza kuwulajilwa mu Nyumba yako mugati!

21 Alu i wadodo ne wakombi,

wose nha wagwiye wafwiye mu zinzila.

I wazelelo hamonga ne wacekulu,

wose wakondya kuwulagwa ne mimaje ye walugu.

Kuwawulajila mwi'zuwa lye likuwo lyako,

wusina hamba lusungu.

22 Wukawalalika walugu wangu ku sikukuu,

ho woga wangu wijele mbavu zose.

Hasina hamba mono kolopona mwi'zuwa lilyo lye likuwo lyako.

Hambi nha wawawulaga wanangu wono nawawilusa no kuwenda.


I Cililo 3

Wulipicizwe no Wunene no Witumbilo

1 Ane yo nene mono newonelela no mweneco,

u wulipicizwe wo Mulungu vyono winha.

2 Yanyinjiza mu wutitu muno muno.

3 Yanhowanga kali kenji muno ko wukali.

4 Yandeka muwili wangu wugandile kanyhi wutimbile,

yagabenanga ne mafupa gangu.

5 Yandindila mu jela yo wukalale ne cevu.

6 Yambika nikale mu wutitu we lifwa wono wikalaga.

7 Yambopa ne manyolo,

nalu nawa nili muwopwe sina hamba witumbilo wo kupona yaye.

8 Nane nghulilila wutazi,

ninga Mulungu si yakusaka kuhuliciza ng'o.

9 Nane nghupebesuka-pebesuka lono nghujenda,

hambi majinji ge mabwe,

nha ganhejeye mu zinzila zose kose kono nghubita.

10 Yanhejela nha dubu, kanzumhila kotya simba.

11 Kanghundujiziza ha mhelo ye nzila,

kanhemasha nha nili nyama,

kawa kundeka baho.

12 Kawutawika wupinde wakwe,

kanoza ane yo niwe munhu wo kulungwa ne zisonga zakwe.

13 Kanguma,

ne zisonga zakwe zinjila mu muwili wangu.

14 Ne wanhu wakusekanga misi yose,

nawa nili munhu wo kuzwajizwa kuli wene wose.

15 Nayo kamhela magayo mawaha,

yiwe yo ndigwa yangu, ne malenga go kung'wa.

16 Kanghuluza wusu wangu hasi,

kagabena ne meno gangu mu masakalawe.

17 Nane lu nakondya no kuvisemwa na vyono vinha,

u wumoteswe, no mulamu, hamonga no wusangalale.

18 No wikala nili mumi, weza wudodo.

No witumbilo wangu wa kuli Muwaha Mulungu, wawuka.

19 Na kolo nghwihwesa zo wusungu wangu,

na vyono kanyhi neza sina kaya,

yikuwa nha sumu nghali kuli'ne.

20 Nane nikalaga nghuzihweza zizo,

ne nhumbula yangu yina wukalale wuwaha.

21 Ninga kanyhi witumbilo wangu wukuza,

kolo nghuzikumbucila zinghani azino zono zikutya,

22 U lusungu no wendo wo Muwaha Mulungu,

si vidumaga yaye.

23 Vikalaga vyo vipya du nhondo zose,

nha vyono yinha hakali mitondo lono lizuwa likusosomoka,

wihuwilwa wakwe wo wuwaha muno muno.

24 Holeka ane, Muwaha Mulungu lyo lifungu lyangu.

Nane nimwitumbiye mweneco du.

25 U Muwaha Mulungu,

muswanu kuli wose wono wakumwitumbila.

26 Holeka yowa nghani swanu kuli'se cimulindile

ko wukangalizi, yaciponye.

27 Kanyhi yicinojeye ciyijize wukangalizi

wuwu lono cikali wadodo.

28 Na lono cenjila mu magayo,

yicinojeye cikale cibembo cili wene,

ciwe cinyamaye ko wukangalile.

29 Yicinojeye ciyilavye mu nzila yo kumwinamila,

hambi nha ko kowuli witumbilo kuli mwene.

30 Hamba hono citowe, hamba kutovulwa,

yicinojeye ciwe kuzibocela zose du.

31 Hambi Muwaha Mulungu wetu, nha yali lusungu,

hamba si kocileka cibitilila.

32 Hanji yadahile kuciletela wukalale,

ninga wendo wakwe kuli'se wo we mbeka,

kanyhi wuli vilungo.

33 Kanyhi mwene,

si kendezwaga yaye yaciletele wukalale no wusungu.

34 Nayo Muwaha Mulungu,

yamanyile lono zinhumbula zetu ziwopigwe mu jela,

zikupondangwa.

35 Kanyhi yamanyile na lono cikuzilema ze ling'ani

zono yacipela.

36 Ne ling'ani lono si yikwitumwa mu mahakama,

mwene yamanyile du.

37 U wuhile wo Muwaha Mulungu du,

wo wunojeye wuwe kwitumwa nhondo zose.

38 I ziswanu ne zimbi,

zose zili mu wulajilize wakwe.

39 Alu mwene nhawule cendile kung'ung'ulika,

lono cikulipicizwa ku soko yo wubi wetu?

40 Ninga aluno, yicinojeye ciyihenje mu mikalile yetu,

cimuwuyile Muwaha Mulungu wetu.

41 Cimwinulile Mulungu zinhumbula zetu ku wulanga,

cimulombe.

42 “Ase mbeka cetuma wubi no kukuleka,

ninga nagwe go Muwaha Mulungu,

hamba si wacinenela.

43 “Wacityatya wukaciwulaga,

hambi lusungu lwako nha lwali lwihundice mwi'kuwo lyako.

44 No wulombe wetu hamba si wakuficila yaye

ku soko ye livunde lizito lyono walicita.

45 Wacinoza ciwe cili manghundi, mono yinze.

46 “Nalu cikutovulwa no kuzwajizwa ne walugu wetu wose.

47 Ceza cili mu magayo hamonga no wongomele,

cikaye mu zi mbali no woga.

48 Ne meso gangu, gakuhuluma makolongo ge mahozi,

ku soko yo wongomele we wanhu wangu.

49 “Ne mahozi gangu,

gojendelela du kuhuluma nhe cikolongo.

50 Sunga lono Muwaha Mulungu,

kolo yakulanga hasi ku wulawa ku wulanga yaciwone.

51 Ne nhumbula yangu, yikalaye muno,

lono nghuziwona zono zawejelela wacekulu wa mwi'kaya.

52 “Walugu wangu wakangwiza

mu mutego mbula soko yo kusulila.

53 Wakangumila mwi'kombo vyo nili mumi,

hanyuma wakawa kubidusiza libwe,

no kuwudinda mulango we likombo.

54 Ne malenga gakawa kwanza kuhulumila mumo mwi'kombo,

nghawona vyono lifwa lyasejelela.

55 “Nane nghakulilila go Muwaha Mulungu lono

nili mumo mwi'kombo.

56 Nane nali neza kukulomba wuhulice cililo cangu,

nagwe wukahulika.

57 Wukamhitula, wukanonjela vyono wulece kogopa.

58 “Wukaza wukamhonya 'gwe go Muwaha Mulungu wangu,

wukawuponya wumi wangu.

59 Holeka wuning'anize nghani yangu,

hambi nha wuzimanyile zimbi zono zetumwa kuli'ne.

60 Hambi agwe nha wumanyile,

vyono walugu wangu wasulile,

na vyono wakwihehemeza ku soko yangu.

61 “Hambi nha kuwahulikaga vyono wakunhovula

'gwe go Muwaha Mulungu,

kanyhi wumanyile no wihehemeze wawo wose.

62 Misi yose walongaga zangu du,

no kwilumbaniza zo wuhile wawo wubi kuli'ne.

63 Na ku wulawilila hakali mitondo sunga lyoswa,

wekalaga wakusekanga du.

64 “Gwe Muwaha Mulungu,

wuwalipicize mu nghango ye metumo gawo.

65 Wuwalijite, kanyhi wuwapele no wukamu we zinhumbula.

66 Wuwapelembe, wuwapatile lukulu mono yinze!”


I Cililo 4

Yelusalemi lono yakondya kugwa

1 Wung'alale we zahabu yetu hamba si wejela,

ne mabwe gono gali mazenjele Nyumba yo Mulungu,

gakeyagala caka mu zinzila.

2 Ne wazelelo wa Sayuni,

wali wo we cifo cikamu nha zahabu,

ninga luno, wakutendelwa nha viya vye lilongo.

3 Sunga ne macewe nha gakuwa kosa mana gayo.

Ninga wanhu wangu weza wakali,

wenha nyacihema ya mu nyika.

4 Wakuwaleka wana wawo wagalika wakufwa ne nzala,

hamonga ne nyhilu ye malenga.

Wana nawo wakwilombeleza ndigwa,

yono hasina hamba mono kosuma kuwapela.

5 Sunga ne wanhu wono walizaga ndigwa swanu,

wose nha wafwila mu zinzila ku soko ye nzala.

Na wono wekalaga wamotile,

alu wakugaya so wulondola ndigwa.

6 Ne wanhu wangu watuga wulipicizwe wuwaha muno

si nhe wanhu wa Sodoma,

wono wepamila ne lifwa lye nhinicizo mu muwoko wo Mulungu.

7 Ne wawaha wetu wali waswanu kanyhi wazelu wenha seluji,

wali vilungo, wahidimbazi ku milimo,

kanyhi wena miwili miswanu yono yijinile.

8 Alu lanje, wagonile mu zinzila du,

hamba kumanyika na munhu yaye,

wakondya kufwa, no wusu wawo watukuwala,

ne zinghuli zawo zanyala nha ngwagu,

zinyaliliye ne mafupa gawo.

9 Na wono wafwila mu wulugu nha wali ciba,

si nha wono wakafwa munyuma yayo,

wono wafwizaga mhola mhola so nzala,

wono wali wasina ndigwa yo kulya.

10 Ne magayo gono gawaziza wanhu wangu,

galeta wogofye wuwaha muno.

Hambi i wacekulu wono wali wawendile muno wana wawo,

nha wakawateleka wana wawo, ho watuje ndigwa yo kulya.

11 Muwaha Mulungu yakalifisiliza likuwo lyakwe liwaha,

yakayipembela moto Sayuni,

yikapya yikakongojela ho hasi.

12 Hali hasina hamba munhu monga,

hamba na muli walongola we makungugo majenzi,

mono yali yehuwiye vyono wulugu wosuma

kwinjila mu milango ya Yelusalemi.

13 Heya, zizi zejela, ku soko wawizi wawo wetuma wubi,

ne wakohani nawo wakasutya, no kwambuza lifwa,

kuli wanhu wono wasina masutya.

14 Ne walongola wawo,

wakawa kuyumba-yumba du mu zinzila wenha wabofu.

Na ku soko yiyo wakekwizanga sakami,

mu nghango yono sunga yunji si yasuma kuwapamiza.

15 Sunga ne wanhu, wakawa kuwawinga wakutya,

“Bitenyi ako!

Hambi nha mweyavufya!

Holeka muwuce,

mulece hamba kucipamiza'se!”

Hodu, nawo wakawa kutuluka,

wakabita ako na ako mu makungugo ganji,

ninga hakawa hasina hamba yunji kuko,

mono yawabocela yaye.

16 Nayo Muwaha Mulungu, hamba si yawatununhicila yaye,

Nhondo ho yakacila kuweyagaza.

Hamba si yawakumbucila yaye i wakohani wetu,

hamonga ne walongola.

17 Nase cikalanjilila, lunji cotuga wutazi,

ninga calanjilila sunga cikakatala,

hamba kuwutuga yaye.

Cikajela kanyhi kulindila,

lunji cotuga wutazi ku wulawa mwi'kungugo linji,

ninga hamba si cawutuga yaye.

18 Nawo walugu wetu, vyo wali wacilanjiliye du,

hamba si casuma no kujenda-jenda ako na ako mu zinzila.

Ne vilo vyetu vikawa vyamalika, no mudumo wetu wafika.

19 Nawo wono wacilondaga mu nyuma,

wali wali musunho muno kuciza numba ya mu mwanya.

Wakacityatya mu matunda, wakacisola,

wakacitegula ku nyika.

20 Wakamusola u Wehele wo wumi wetu,

u Mutemi, mono Muwaha Mulungu yamuhagula.

U munhu mono cali cimwitumbiye,

nha vyono yo kocitaza muli walugu wetu.

21 Ale, musece du, no kusangalala mu nghango yenyu,

anye nyo wanhu wa Edomu na Uzi.

Ninga mumanye nha vyono,

nanye magazo gakumuzizenyi nhavivyo,

nanye molopuwa,

muwe jenda cipwi mukoligwe ne cevu.

22 Alu Sayuni yakondya kulipicizwa so wubi wayo.

Holeka Muwaha Mulungu,

hamba si kucileka cijendelele kuwa mu wuhamywe yaye.

Langa agwe Edomu, u Muwaha Mulungu kokulipiciza du,

kanyhi kowanzalika no wubi wako.


I Cililo 5

Kulomba lusungu

1 Gwe go Muwaha Mulungu, wukumbucile zono zacagana,

wucilanje, wuciwone ne cevu cetu.

2 Hambi zisawo zetu zose,

nha zeza zili mu miwoko ye wajenzi.

Kanyhi wawo wajenzi, wo wekaye na mu zikaya zetu.

3 Ne wasogo zetu wose,

nha wakondya kuwulagwa ne walugu wetu.

Ne wanyina zetu wekala wafwile.

4 Alu lanje, ne malenga gose go kung'wa, cikugula,

sunga ne zingwagu zose cikugula.

5 Wacimasha duu, kotya cili madogowe hamba ngamiya,

sunga nhondo cakatala.

Ninga hamba nhavivyo, si wakucileka ciceheze yaye.

6 Na lono ciwe cikusaka ndigwa zono zicikwiliye,

sunga cibite du cikelombeleze ku Misili, hamba ku Siliya.

7 Walezi wetu, heya wasutya, ninga aluno wakondya kufwa,

ninga ase luno, ceza kugaya ku soko yo wubi wawo.

8 Nalu citemigwe ne wanhu wawanda,

na hasina mono kociponya mu miwoko yawo.

9 Ne wawulaji wakukoloma mu nyika.

Nase cikuwa kuwusuza wumi wetu,

lono cikubita kulondola ndigwa.

10 Ne nzala nayo yacinoza zinghuli zetu zawawuka

ne zimhungo,

sunga ne miwili yetu nayo, yeza yili moto kotya mafigwa.

11 Ne wagolece zetu nawo, wakwibatwa ne walume,

no kugona nawo kwe vilungo mwi'tunda lya Sayuni,

na mu vitumbi vyose vya Yuda.

Ne wana wetu we cicekulu,

nawo wakudindimizwa ho wagone ne walume kwe vilungo.

12 I walongola wetu nawo, wakwibatwa, wakunyongwa.

I wakombi wetu, si wakupegwa cogopo yaye.

13 Nawo i wazelelo wetu,

wakudindimizwa wakuzule wuhemba mu matuli nha wawanda.

Nawo i wana wetu wadodo we cilume,

wapebesukaga-pebesukaga so wudinghula

mitegulo mizito ye zingwagu.

14 I wakombi nawo,

wapela ku wubita kwikala mu milango ye likaya.

I wazelelo nawo, wapela ku wubita ku ng'oma.

15 I nyemo ya mu zinhumbula zetu, yaduma.

Ne midawalo yetu yapituka cawa cililo.

16 Hasina cinji cono cisigaye,

muli vyose vyono celumbilaga.

Heya cetuma wubi, nalu congomezwa.

17 Holeka zinhumbula zetu zizilice.

Na ku soko ya zizo, ne meso getu si gakuwona viswanu.

18 Hambi litunda lye Sayuni nha lyalekwa lyekala lili wene,

ne macewe gakupilima-pilima mu matongo galyo.

19 Ninga agwe go Muwaha Mulungu,

yo gwegwe du wuli mutemi cibitilila,

nagwe kotema sunga ko ku ndumo ye yinze.

20 Alu nha wacileka sunga vilo vyeza vinji muno?

Alo hamba si kocikumbucila kanyhi ng'o?

21 Cikukulomba wucigomole kuli'gwe,

'gwe go Muwaha Mulungu,

cikunena wucigomole!

Wucigomolele kanyhi lukumyo lwetu lwe katali.

22 Hamba hodu wacilemela lukulu cibitilila?

Alu kocikolelwa likuwo lyako sunga nili lo?


Ezekiyeli 1

Wugubulilwe wulongozi kuli Ezekiyeli, kulawa kuli Mulungu

(1:1–7:27)

Ligoda lyo Mulungu lyo wutemi

1 Ane mukohani Ezekiyeli mono nili mwana wa Buzi, nekalaga hamonga ne Wayahudi i wahamywa, he kolongo lya Kebali, mu yisi ya Babiloni. Ale, mwi'zuwa lye 'hano lya mu mwezi we kane, wa mu mwaka we makumi madatu, wulanga wukagubuka, nghagubulilwa no Mulungu.
2 (No mwaka wuwo, wali wo mwaka we 'hano ku wulawa lono mutemi Yehoyakimu yategulilwa ku wuhamywe.)
3 Na lono nali nili ha nyenje ye likolongo lya Kebali, kuko ku Babiloni, nghahulika u Muwaha Mulungu yakulonga nane, ne vilungo vyakwe vikanyiziza.

4 Langa ta, nghawona libeho lyo mukukunzo likuza likulawilila ku lubavu lwe sumuka. No wubulile wo moto, wabulilaga mwi'vunde yiwaha, sunga no wulanga wose wukawa wudunghu mbavu zose. No wubulile wuwo wono wabulilaga, wukawa wukung'alala kotya nha shaba.
5 Na mugati ye libeho lilyo, yikaza hwani ye viwumbwa vyumi vine, vina futa yo munhu.
6 Na vyose vyono vine, vyali vina wusu wuli hane ne mabawa mane mane.
7 Ne magulu gavyo gali gagolocile, ne zinzayo ze magulu gavyo, zali nhe zinzayo ze magulu ge zing'ombe. Nazo zang'alalaga nha shaba nghusulwe muno.
8 Hamonga na zizo, kanyhi vyose vyono vine, vyali vina miwoko mine mine hasi ye mabawa gavyo, mabawa gose vyono mane.
9 Navyo viwumbwa vyose, vyali vigatandakuye mabawa gavyo, vigapamize cimonga ne ciyagwe. Na lono vyajendaga, vikawa vikujendana hamonga du akuno viyipamize ne mabawa gavyo, kanyhi hamba si vyapitukaga yaye lono vyajendaga.
10 Navyo viwumbwa vivyo vyose vyono vine, vyali vina wusu wuli hane, wono wisimajiye-simajiye. Ku mwande yayo vyali vina hwani ya wusu wa munhu, no lubavu lo kulume, vyali vina hwani yo wusu wa simba, no lubavu lo kucekulu, hwani yo wusu wa ng'ombe, na ku migongo yavyo, vyali vina hwani yo wusu wa 'ndi.
11 Ne mabawa gavyo, gali matandakule gepamize, ciwumbwa ne libawa lye ciyagwe cono vihegame naco. Agalya i mabawa ganji mejete mejete, vyali vigubucize miwili yavyo.
12 Navyo vyose vyali vilanjile mbavu zose vyono yine. Na ku soko yiyo, vyasumaga kubita ku lubavu lo lose kono u muhe wahilaga vibite, navyo ko vyabitaga, hamba kuwa na soko yo kupituka yaye.

13 Na muli viwumbwa vivyo vyumi, mwali mocili cinhu cinji cono cejelaga cihwanile mamuli, cono camulikaga ako na ako. No moto nawo wakaga no kulavya mamuli.
14 Navyo i viwumbwa vyumi, vyamanghaga ako na ako no kuwuya kotya limuli.
15 Nane lono nali nghali nivilanjile vilimu vivyo vyumi, nghawona maguludumu mane gapamize hasi mu muhangha, ha mhelo ye viwumbwa vivyo cimonga cimonga, nha cinji ciwumbwa ne guludumu lyaco.
16 Ne maguludumu gose, gali gehwanile, gang'alalaga nhe libwe lyo wuguzi wukamu muno. Nago maguludumu gose vyono mane, gali gena hwani monga, no wijele wo wunoze wago wali wihwanile, liguludumu mugati ye liguludumu liyagwe,
17 Maguludumu ho gasume kubiduka no kubita ko kose mu malanga gose vyono mane.
18 Ne migo ye maguludumu gago, yali yimemile meso gose.
19 Ne mapango go gose lono viwumbwa vivyo vyumi vyatulukaga, maguludumu gago nago, vyatulukanaga hamonga ne viwumbwa vivyo. Na lono viwumbwa vivyo vyumi vyagulukaga, ne maguludumu nago gagulukaga nhavivyo.
20 Na lono i viwumbwa vivyo vyumi vyabitaga hanhu ho hose hono vyasakaga kubita, ne maguludumu nago gakanoza nhavivyo du, hambi i viwumbwa vivyo vyumi, nha vyo vyagalongozaga i maguludumu gago.
21 Holeka ku soko yiyo, i maguludumu ganozaga nha vyono viwumbwa vyanozaga, hono viwumbwa vivyo vyumi vituluce, nago maguludumu gatulukaga, na hono viwumbwa vime, nago maguludumu gemaga, na hono viwumbwa viguluce mucanyha, nago maguludumu gagulukaga nhavivyo.

22 Na mucanyha ye mitwe ye viwumbwa vivyo vyumi, mwali na hwani ya mwanya, yihwanile liwala lye libwe lyono linha lilole lyo kogofya.
23 Na hasi yo mwanya, vikawa kwima viwumbwa vivyo vyumi, akuno vigoloye ne mabawa gavyo mejete mejete gepamize cimonga ne 'bawa lye ciyagwe, akuno vigubice miwili yavyo, ne mabawa ganji ga galya i mejete mejete gono gasigaye.
24 Hanyuma nghahulika cihumbi ce mabawa gavyo lono vyagulukaga, cikawa cihwanile ne lizi lye lilenga, cihwanile nhe cihumbi ce wasilikale wenji wo wulugu, cihwanile ne lizi lyo Mulungu u Mudaha Vyose. Navyo vyali vyeza kutima hasi, vikagatenya mabawa gavyo,
25 ninga hamba nhavivyo lizi likajendelela kuhulikwa mu wulawa mu mwanya wono wali ha mitwe yavyo.

26 Na mucanyha yo mwanya wa mu mitwe yavyo, hali na cinhu cono cejelaga nhe 'goda lya nhojo, yinozwe ne vibwe vyo wuguzi wukamu vye liwala lye dedede. Na mwi'goda lilyo lye nhojo, cali cikaye cinji cihwanile futa ya munhu.
27 Nghawona yiyo futa yo munhu yikung'alala kotya shaba, mugati yo moto. Yikawa kung'alala muno hanhu hose, no
28 wung'alale we mawala gose gono yali yina, wali wihwanile ne mawala ge licilalyambwa. Na wuwu wali wo wijele we nhojo wono walajilaga nha vyono Muwaha Mulungu yali baho.

Mulungu yakumucema Ezekiyeli yawe muwizi

Nane nali neza kuziwona zizi, nghagwa wugubama. Hanyuma nghahulika lizi lyo Muwaha Mulungu likunonjela likutya,


Ezekiyeli 2

1 “Gwe go munhu, ta winuce, hambi 'ne nha nghusaka kulongana nagwe.”
2 Na lono lizi lyali likali likulongana nane, hobaho muhe wo Mulungu yakenjila muli'ne, yakanyimya wima. Hanyuma kanyhi nghahulika lizi lijendeleye likutya,
3 “Gwe go munhu, ane nghukutuma kuli wanhu wa Isilayeli. Hambi nha wambedegala no kundeka, kanyhi vyo wakali wakumbedegala du, nha vyono wali wambedegaye i walezi wawo.
4 Wasina cihuliko, hamba si wanyogopile 'ne yaye. Holeka nane nghukutuma wubite wukawamanyize vyono ane no Muwaha Mulungu nghuwalonjela.
5 Hono wakuhulice hamba ng'o, ninga wowa wakondya kumanya vyono muwizi kawaziza.

6 “Ninga agwe go munhu, wulecele lukulu kuwogopa hamba kuzogopa zinghani zawo. Ninga wumanye nha vyono hamba mabijili ne mamivya gakuhome nagwe kowa nha mono wikaye hono ho zili zi'nje. Ninga 'gwe weze wukamile, wulecele lukulu kuwogopa i wabedegazi wawo, hamba kuzogopa nghani zawo.
7 Nagwe kowalonjela zose zono nokulonjela, hono wakuhulice hamba wabeze, ninga agwe wuwalonjele du. Hambi wene nha wali cibede muno.

8 “Ninga agwe go munhu, wuhulice ta zono nghukulonjela. Nagwe wulanjilile, wulece kuwa wuli mubezi nhe wanhu wawo. Ale, wahame mulomo wako, wulye cono nokupela.”
9 Hobaho nghawona muwoko wugoleywe, na langa ta, wibate citabu cipalinje.
10 U muwoko wuwo, wukawa kucitandakula citabu cico cipalinje, nane nghawona cali cina mandiko mbavu zose. I cililo co wusungu cali candicigwe mumo hamonga no wugule!


Ezekiyeli 3

1 Mulungu yakatya, “Gwe go munhu, ale wulye citabu cici, hanyuma ho wubite wukalongane ne wanhu wa Isilayeli.”
2 Hobaho nghahama mulomo wangu, nayo yakawa kundisa i citabu cico.
3 Hanyuma kanyhi yakatya, “Gwe go munhu, wulye citabu cico cono nghukupela, wucimemye mu mulomo wako.” Nane nghawa kucilya, naco cikawa cili muzinzi muno mu mulomo wangu nha wuci.

4 Hanyuma kanyhi Mulungu yakanonjela yakatya, “Gwe go munhu, wubite kuli wanhu wa Isilayeli wukawalonjele zose zono nghulonjeye.
5 Nane hamba si nghukutuma kuli wanhu wono wakulonga milonjele mijenzi ng'o, langa nghukutuma kuli Waisilayeli.
6 Na hono nali nghutume, kuli makungugo gono gena milonjele mikamu, yono nagwe si wuyimanyile yaye awo langa wali wakuhulice zono wukuwalonjela.
7 Ninga muli wanhu wa Isilayeli, howa hasina hamba yumonga mono kokuhulika yaye. Kanyhi hamba na nene siwosuma kuhulika yaye. Hambi wose nha wasina cihuliko, kanyhi wali cibede.
8 Ninga nane nokunoza nagwe wuwe wusina cihuliko kuli wene, kanyhi wuwe wuli nghakamo nha vyono wene wenha.
9 Kanyhi nokunoza wuwe wusikame nhe 'bwe, kanyhi wuwe wukangaye nhe alimasi. Holeka wulece kuwogopa wawo i wanhu wabedegazi.”

10 Mulungu yakajendelela kunonjela kanyhi yakatya, “Gwe go munhu, zinghani zangu zose zono nghulonjeye wuzikumbucilaje, kanyhi wuzibate mu nhumbula yako.
11 Hanyuma wuwabitile wayago wono wahamywa, wuwalonjele zono nghuwalonjela ane no Muwaha Mulungu. Nawo hono wakuhulice hamba walece kukuhulika, ayo yowe yo nghani yawo.”

12 Hobaho u muhe wo Mulungu wukanyinula, nane nghahulika kunyuma yangu, wukolome wa yizi yiwaha likulonga likutya. “Nhojo yo Muwaha Mulungu, yilumbizwe ku wulanga kucanyha!”
13 Hanyuma, nghahulika cihumbi ciwaha ce mabawa ge viwumbwa vyumi, lono vyepumunhaga mu mwanya, hamonga ne lizozo lye maguludumu. Lizozo lilyo, likawa nhe lizozo lye litulo.
14 No muhe wo Muwaha Mulungu, wukanyiziza kwe vilungo viwaha wukanyasula. Na lono muhe wakwe wanyasulila kwe vilungo, nghahulika wusungu muno sunga nghakolwa ne likuwo.
15 Hodu nghawa kubita ku Teli-abibu, ha nhumbi ye likolongo lya Kebali, hono wekalaga i wahamywa, nghekala baho vilo mupunghati, akuno memile no wizine wa kuli zono naziwona no kuzihulika.

Muwaha Mulungu yakumuwika Ezekiyeli yawe mulindilizi

(Eze 33:1-9)

16 Vyali vyeza kupuluta vilo mupunghati, u Muwaha Mulungu yakalonga nane kanyhi yakatya,
17 “Gwe go munhu, ane nghukuwika wuwe mulindilizi we nghungugo ya Isilayeli. Nagwe wubite wukawalonjele ze suguzi zangu zose zono nghulonjeye.
18 Nane lono nghumulonjela u munhu mubi vyono kofwa so wubi wakwe, nagwe hono wulece kumusugula yayipitule mijendele yakwe ho yeponye, ale, u munhu yuyo mbeka kofwa so wubi wakwe. Ninga nane nokuwala gwegwe vyono nagwe wuli musutyi, yo gwegwe mono wumwambuze yafwe.

19 “Ninga hono wumusugule munhu mubi nayo ho yalece kuwunena wubi wakwe, ale, munhu yuyo, kofwila mu wubi wakwe, nagwe kokwiponya wumi wako, kowa wusina wuhoswe yaye.

20 “Na hono munu we ling'ani yetume zo wubi, nane hono mbice cikobazo hali mwene nagwe hono wuwe si wumusugye yaye, ale munhu yuyo kofwa. Kofwa kusoko yo wubi wakwe. Nane hamba si nozikumbucila yaye ne ziswanu zono yazituma. Ninga nane nokuwala 'gwe, vyono wuli musutyi, hambi nha yo gwegwe mono wumwambuze yafwe.
21 Na hono wumusugule munhu muswanu vyono yalece kwituma zo wubi, nayo yakuhulice, no kuleka kwituma zo wubi, ale, yuyo kowumipa, nagwe kokwiponya wumi wako, hamba kowa wusina wuhoswe yaye.”

Ezekiyeli yakuwa yali cibwibwi

22 Vilungo vyo Muwaha Mulungu vikanyiziza, nghahulika yakunonjela yakutya, “Ale, Ezekiyeli, winuce wubite kwi'lolo, nane nokulonjela kuko zono nghusaka nghulonjele.”
23 Ale, nane nghawa kubita kuko kwi'lolo. Na kuko nghaluwona lukumyo lo Muwaha Mulungu, nha vyono naluwona halulongozi ha nyenje ye likolongo lya Kebali. Nane nghawa kugwa hasi wugubama,
24 Ninga u muhe wo Mulungu wukanyiziza wukanyinula no kunyimya wima. Nayo Muwaha Mulungu yakanyitya, “Gwe Ezekiyeli, alu wuwuye ku kaya yako, wubite wukedindile mu nyumba.
25 Nagwe go munhu, wokuwopa ne milejehe, nagwe hamba si kosuma kanyhi kulawila kunze kuli wanhu.
26 Nane nolunamatiza lulimi lwako mu malaka gako ho wuwe cibwibwi, ho wulece kusuma kuwasugula i wanhu wawa i wabedegazi.
27 Na hanyuma kolo nghulonga nagwe, no kuludohola lulimi lwako kanyhi, ho wusume kulonga, ale baho nhondo ho kowalonjela zono ane no Muwaha Mulungu nghuwalonjela. Na lulo wanji wa muli wene wohulika, ninga wanji wozibedegala zinghani zako, hambi nha wanhu we nghungugo yono yisina cihuliko yaye.”


Ezekiyeli 4

Ezekiyeli yakunoza cihwanicizo co wupilimwe wa Yelusalemi

1 U Muwaha Mulungu yakatya, “Gwe go munhu, wusole litofali wuliwice ha mwande yako, hanyuma wulikwale cihwani ce likaya lya Yelusalemi mucanyha yalyo.
2 Hanyuma wulinozeze cihwani co wupilimwe walyo, wuwicile ne makweme galipilime, wuliwicile ne majinji ne zinghambi ze wasilikale, wuliwicile ne matinde go kulimwagulila likaya, mbavu zose.
3 Hanyuma kanyhi, wusole siniya ya cuma, wuyisimye yiwe nhe 'jinji lya cuma haciligati yako ne likaya. Nagwe wulidome likaya. Nalyo likaya lyowa nha lyakondya kupilimwa no wulugu, nagwe kowa yo gwegwe mono walipilima no kulihoma. Na cici cowa co citanjilo kuli nghungugo ya Isilayeli.

4 “Hanyuma wuwe kugona hasi, wugoneye muwoko wako wo kucekulu, nane nokudinghuza uwubi wose we nghungugo ya Isilayeli. Nagwe kowa wuli baho du wuli mu wusungu ku soko yo wubi wawo, sunga vipulute vilo magana madatu na makumi 'cenda.
5 Hambi nha nakondya kukutemezezya'gwe lizuwa limonga limonga liwe nha wo mwaka monga monga, sunga lono wulipicizwe wawo wulamalicila.
6 Nagwe kolo wazikondya zizo, wipitucizaje kanyhi, wugonele ku lubavu lo kulume vilo makumi mane, so wubi wa Yuda. Nayo yowa nhavivilya du, lizuwa limonga limonga, lyowa nha wo mwaka monga monga wo wulipicizwe wawo.

7 “Nagwe kogadomya meso gako gawe gawulanjile wupilimwe we likaya lya Yelusalemi. Hanyuma wuliyunzize likaya muwoko wako, wuwe kuliwilila.
8 Nane nokuwopa no lubano, ho wulece kusuma kupituka-pituka wulanje ako na ako, sunga wuvifisilize vilo vye milewo yako.

9 “Alu, wusole ngano ndodo, ne shayili, ne zinandala, ne zifwili, no wuhemba, hamonga no muhoni. Vivyo vyose, wuvihanze mu ciya cimonga, winozeze mukate. Na yiyo yowa yo ndigwa yako mu vilo vivyo vyose vye magana madatu na makumi'cenda, lono kowa wukali wugoneye ku lubavu lwako lo kucekulu.
10 Nagwe yowa yikunojeye wulye cipimo ca wuzito wa gulamu magana mejete na makumi madatu du, zo mukate wuwo mwi'zuwa limonga. Nawo wuzito wuwo wa gulamu zizo, wokukwila, nagwe kowa wigute sunga i mitondo yaco.
11 Kanyhi yowa yikunojeye wuwe kung'wa malenga macefu macefu du, nha cinji, weze kung'wa vikombe vyejete du mwi'zuwa limonga.
12 Kanyhi yikunojeye wusole mavi go munhu gono makavu, wupembele moto wono kowukasicila mukate wuwo. Hanyuma wuwe kuwulila ha meso ge wanhu wose.”

13 U Muwaha Mulungu yakatya, “Ne nghani yiyo yo yikulajila vyono Waisilayeli wowa kulya zindigwa zono nyavufywe, kolo neza kuweyagaziza mu zi'si zi njenzi.”

14 Ninga nane nghamutya, “Gwe go Muwaha Mulungu, ng'o, ye! Hambi 'ne ku wulawa katali nha nghali sineyavufya hamba hadodo. Kanyhi ku wulawa wudodo wangu sunga nalu, nghali sinalya yaye, nyama ya nimu yo yose yono yifwiliye, hamba yono yiwulagwe ne malimu ga mu mbago. Hamba nghali sinalya ndigwa yo yose yono nyavufywe.”
15 Nayo Mulungu yakamhitula yakatya, “Ale, viswanu, na hono yili nhavivyo, hodu, nokuleka witumamile matope ge ng'ombe si 'nhe mavi go munhu, wunyanyile mukate wako wuwo.”
16 Kanyhi yakatya, “Gwe go munhu, ane nolicepula ligawo lye zindigwa lya mu Yelusalemi. Ne wanhu wono wali mumo, wologazika muno no kwihwelela, vyono lulo, ndigwa yono wolowa kulya, hamonga ne malenga gono wolowa kung'wa, vyose vyolowa kwamula kupimwa mu cijelo, hanyuma ho wawa kuvitumamila.
17 Na mu mapango gago, i wanhu wa Isilayeli wolowa na wanjile wuwaha muno wa ndigwa, hamonga ne malenga. Na ku soko yiyo, wologanda muno ku soko yo wubi wawo.”


Ezekiyeli 5

Ezekiyeli yakuziceta zimvwili zakwe

1 U Muwaha Mulungu yakatya, “Gwe go munhu, wusole mumaje mukali, wuzicete zindevu zako hamonga ne zimvwili zako. Na kolo waziceta, wuzisole wuzipime wuzito wayo, hanyuma wuzitemanule mafungu madatu.
2 Wusole lifungu limonga, wuziticimize mu moto, wuziticimizize mwi'kaya mugati, lono milewo yamalika. Hanyuma kanyhi wulisole lifungu linji, nazo wuzidumulanje no mumaje wako, akuno wukujenda, lono wukuwuka mwi'kaya. Ne lifungu lyono lisigaye, nazo wuzigumile mucanyha ziyagale mu mbeho, nane nozityatilila no mumaje wangu.
3 Ninga hamba nhavivyo, wusigaze mvwili nyhefu, wuziwope mwi'cindo lye myenda yako.
4 Hanyuma yayo kanyhi, wusole mvwili nyhefu za muli zizo, wuzigumile mu moto wuzilece zitakamile. No moto wolowa muli zene, wutandale mwi'kungugo lyose lya Isilayeli.”

5 Muwaha Mulungu yakatya, “Langa, ta, ali lyo likaya lya Yelusalemi, lyono naliwika haciligati ye yinze, hamonga ne ma'si ganji gose gono galipilime.
6 Ninga Yelusalemi yagabedegala malajilizo gangu, nokwilajila vyono yene yo 'mbi muno si nhe ma'si ganji gono galipilime. Hambi Yelusalemi nha yalema kuwibata malajilizo gangu, hamonga no wulajilize wangu.
7 Holeka anye wa mwi'kaya lya Yelusalemi, alu muhulicize zono nghulonga, ane no Muwaha Mulungu. Alu vyono mwakondya kugabedegala malajilizo gangu, hamba kuwibata yaye no wulajilize wangu, alu, mweyambalila nyenye nyo weneco, mweyinjiza mu magayo, si nhe makungugo go gose gono gamupilimenyi. Hambi nha mwayityatya myoto ye makungugo ganji.
8 Holeka luno ane no Muwaha Mulungu, nghumulonjelenyi vyono, ane nawa nili mulugu wenyu. Nomulipicizenyi ko wulipicizwe wono i wanhu we makungugo gose wowuwona calinze.
9 Ku soko aluno mukwituma zinghani zose zono si zikunyendeza. Holeka nane noyilipiciza muno Yelusalemi mu nghango yono nghali nayitendela ne lizuwa linji, mu nghango yono si nilayitendela kanyhi yaye.
10 Na mu ndipicizwa yiyo, iwalezi wa mu Yelusalemi, wololya i wana wawo, nawo wana wololya walezi wawo. Nolomulipicizenyi no kumwiyagazizenyi mu malanga gose, kanyhi holowa hasina hamba yunji mono yalasigala mumi.

11 “Holeka ane vyono nili Mulungu mumi, azi zo nghani zo nghutya. Hambi 'nye nha mwayavufya Nyumba yangu ku soko ye zimbi zenyu, hamonga ne zinghani ze cevu zono mukwituma. Holeka nane nomulecenyi hamba si nomuwonelenyi lusungu yaye.
12 Lifungu lilongozi lye wanhu wako, wofwila mwi'kaya so matamwa na so nzala, lifungu lye kejete, awo wolowulajilwa kunze ye likaya no mumaje, nawo we lifungu lye kadatu lye ndumilizo, noloweyagaziza mwi'beho liwaha, hanyuma nowatyatilila no mumaje wangu.

13 “Nanye baho ho mololiwonela nhondo likuwo lyangu hamonga no wukali wangu, sunga lono nolowa nayimala nhunduji yangu nene no mweneco. Na kolo zizi zejela, baho nanye nhondo, ho molomanyila vyono ane no Muwaha Mulungu yo nene mono nonjile zizo kuli 'nye, vyono ngholigwe likuwo muno so wula wihuwilwa wenyu.
14 No munhu wo wose wa mu nghungugo zose wono wamupilimenyi, mono kowa kukola baho, kolowa musecenyi.

15 “Na Kolo nasimba no kukolwa likuwo no kumulipicizenyi, i makungugo gose gono gamupilimenyi, golokwibatwa no woga wuwaha muno. Wolomulanjenyi nha muli wanhu we 'wifyo, kanyhi wolomulijenyi.
16 Nane noloyicepula ndigwa yenyu yiwe nyhefu, nzala yimwaganenyi. Nanye molotamiswa muno ne nzala, molowa nha mukugumwa ne zisonga zinghali muno, zono zikumongomezenyi.
17 Nane nolomugumililenyi nzala mbaha, hamonga ne malimu ga mu mbago gawawulaje wana wenyu. Kanyhi nolomugumililenyi matamwa, ne mafwa, hamonga no wulugu wumuwulajenyi muno. Nene no Muwaha Mulungu nalonga.”


Ezekiyeli 6

U Muwaha Mulungu yakuwuhosa wuhembi we vihwani

1 Muwaha Mulungu yakanonjela yakatya,
