7 Vyono wene wali si wehuwilwa hali Muwaha Mulungu, sunga ne wana wawo wali si wakwe yaye. Holeka nalu wene hamonga ne'si yawo, wokongomezwa musunho.

Wulugu wa Isilayeli na Yuda

8 Mutowe ndulele yo wulugu mu Gibeya! Ne zifuluti mu Lama! Nanye kuko ku Betaveni, mucenje so wulugu! Nanye mo wanhu wa Benyamini, mwinjile mu wihomi!
9 Lizuwa lyo wulipicizwe likuza, na Isilayeli yokongomezwa. Anye nyo Waisilayeli, zizi mbeka zokwijela!
10 Muwaha Mulungu yakutya, “Ane ngholigwe yikuwo ku soko wawaha wa Yuda, wenjila mu mipaka ya Isilayeli, no kuyihiza yisi yawo.” Holeka nane nowetila likuwo lyangu kotya malenga.
11 Isilayeli yakugaya so wiwonelwe, hambi nha yakondya kwajiliza yisi yono yali ling'ani yakwe, vyono mwene yabita kulondola wutazi, kuli wono si wosuma kumupela wutazi wo wose.
12 Holeka nane noleta wuhodanje kuli Isilayeli, no wongomezwe muli wanhu wa Yuda.

13 “Nayo Isilayeli yali yeza kuwona vyono yatamwa, nayo Yuda yali yeza kuziwona zinghomele zakwe, hodu Isilayeli yakawa kubita ku yisi ya Siliya kulondola wutazi kuli wutemi wuwaha, ninga hamba nhavivyo, nayo hamba si kosuma kuwaponya, hamba kuzinoja zinghomele zawo.
14 Nane nowahungucila wanhu wa Isilayeli na Yuda kotya simba. Nowahawanga no kuwaleka baho. Na lono nowa nakondya kuwasola, hasina munhu yunji kanyhi mono kusuma kuwaponya.

15 “Nane nowaleka wanhu wangu wagaye mu nghango yo wubi wawo, sunga waze wanondole 'ne. Na mumo lunji mu wugaye wawo, mo wolosuma kunondola wahidimbaye sunga wambone.”


Hoseya 6

Wunene wo wukoci, we wanhu

1 Wanhu wakutya, “Alenyi ciwuye kuli Muwaha Mulungu! Mwene yacitamisa yakondya, ninga yamanyile vyono kociponya! Yacipela zinghomele, ninga kociponya zinghomele zetu.
2 Na mu vilo vyejete hamba vidatu, kocinula, nase cokwikala womi hali mwene.
3 Alenyi cimumanye Muwaha Mulungu. Mwene kokuza kuli'se lono wela hakali mitondo muno, nayo kokuza kuli'se kotya mvula ye mhinga yono yidedewazaga yisi.”
4 Ninga Muwaha Mulungu yakutya, “Isilayeli na Yuda, alo nghanici yono nomutendelenyi? Wendo wenyu kuli'ne wawuka musunho nha vyono nghungulyosi lye hakali mitondo, kotya buhe, yono siyitinyaga kunyala.
5 Ayi yo soko yono yaleka nghamutumilenyi wawizi wangu, hamonga no luganuzi lo wuling'anizwe, no wongomezwe kuli'nye. Na yono nghusaka kuli'nye yoyi.
6 Ane nghusaka wendo wenyu we mbeka kuli'ne, hamba si nghusaka makumbiko genyu ge zimitugo. Kanyhi ane nghuwona yili ciba hono wanhu wangu wamanye 'ne si nho kundavizya vilavywa vinyanywe.

7 “Ninga wene weza nha Adamu, wacibena cilagane cono calagana nane.
8 Gileyadi, lye 'kaya lyono limemile wanhu wabi ne wawulaji.
9 Ne wakohani wenha litewa lye wahizi wono watejeye munhu wamwibate. Wakwituma zo wuwulaji, sunga ko ku hanhu hono helile ku Shekemu. Kanyhi wakwituma wubi wuwo ne nyono du.
10 Kanyhi niyiwene nghani 'mbi yo wogofye muli Isilayeli, wanhu wangu wetajila mu wavu weneco, so wuhemba vihwani.

11 “Nanye kuli'nye anye nyo wanhu wa Yuda, nakondya kuwika lipango lyo kumulipicizenyi, ku soko ya zizo zono mukwituma.


Hoseya 7

1 “Mu madaha gono nghuhila kuwaponya wanhu wangu Isilayeli no kuwanoza wamoteswe kanyhi, ninga zono nghusuma kuwona muli wene, wo wavu wawo no wubi wono wakwituma. Wakwiyihiziza weneco wose, wakubena mu zikaya no kuhiza, wakuwahiziza wanhu mu zinzila.
2 Hamba siwakwihwesa mu zinhumbula zawo, vyono nowukumbucila wubi wuwu wose, no wubi wawo wuwapilime, hamba si wihundice ho ndece kusuma kuwuwona.”

Wilumbanize wo kuyinozeza zimbi kaya yo wutemi

3 Muwaha Mulungu yakutya, “Wanhu wamukonga mutemi ne wawaha wakwe, ko wuhile wawo wo wubi.
4 Wene wose wakoci, kanyhi hamba si wehuwilwa. Ne likuwo lyawo, likwaka nha moto mu mafigwa, wono si mufwanghane, sunga muteleci kolo yakondya kuwutiwa wusaje we cisase, na kolo wakondya kutumba, ho wutelekwe.
5 Mwi'zuwa lye sikukuu yo wukumbucile wo wuwikwa mwi'goda mutemi, wakamunoza mutemi hamonga ne wawaha wakwe, wakang'wa muno divayi sunga wakagala.
6 Na mbeka wuhile wawo wubi, wukoleye nha moto mu mafigwa. Ne likuwo lyawo lifunghaga, na ko muno ku cilo, na kolo wela, lyakaga nha malambi ga moto.

7 “Mu moto we likuwo lyawo wakawawulaga walongola wawo. Ne watemi wawo wakawa kuwulagwa yumonga yumonga, ninga hasina hamba monga mono yakulomba wutazi kuli'ne.”

Isilayeli ne makungugo

8 Muwaha Mulungu yakutya, “Waisilayeli weza kotya mukate wono si mupitulwe. Wene wetumbiye makungugo gono gawapilime.
9 Hamba si wakumanya vyono witumbilo wawo wuwo wa muli wajenzi, wakondya kuwahiziza vilungo vyawo. Na vyono vilo vyawo viwale, ninga wene hamba si wakumanya yaye.
10 No wiwoni we Waisilayeli wukuwahomelela weneco, ninga muli zizo zose zono zejela, hamba siwasuma kumbuyila ane no Muwaha Mulungu, u Mulungu wawo.
11 Isilayeli yakuyumbayumba ako na ako kotya nziwa ndele, wanhu wakwe ha lulongozi wakasaka wutazi kuli Misili, na aluno kanyhi wakumanyhila ku Siliya.
12 Ninga ane notandaza lwavu ho niwagwize kotya ndeje za mucanyha. Kanyhi nowalipiciza ku soko yo wubi wono wetumile.

13 “Woyi he nye! Hambi nha wandeka 'ne, kanyhi wambedegala. Ninga walekaje, wokongomezwa du. Nali nyendile niwaponye, ninga wuhembi wono wakuhemba 'ne, wo wuhembi wo wulambi.
14 Hambi nha si wakusuma kulomba kuli 'ne kwe nhumbula yo winenenyhezi yaye, langa wakwigwisa no kwigalagaza hasi nha vyono wanozaga wono si wamumanyile Mulungu. Na lono wakulomba so wuhemba ne divayi, wakwisalanga-salanga mu miwili no kwipela nghomele nha wono si wamumanyile Mulungu. Nhondo hamba watye, wo wubedegazici waco wuwu.
15 Ninga hamba yiwe yo nene mono nawafunda, nghawakamya ne vilungo, hamba nhavivyo wene vyo wakunyihweseza zimbi du.
16 Vyo wakali du wakuwuya ne nyuma wakundeka, wakumutyatya mulungu wo wulambi, mono yasina vilungo. Waweza si wehuwilwa hamba hadodo, waweza nha wupinde wono si wukwiliye cinji. Hambi walongola wawo, nha wakulonga ko wivuni, ninga walekaje, wolofwa cifo cibi muno, sunga ne Wamisili wolowaseka.”


Hoseya 8

Mulungu yakuwalemeza Waisilayeli walece kuhemba vihwani

1 Muwaha Mulungu yakutya, “Towe ndulele lizi lye citanjilo! Hambi walugu nha wakuzumha hasi, nha numba, mu'si yangu! Wanhu wangu wabena icilagane cono nalagana nawo, wabedegala no wulajilize wangu.
2 Hamba wawe wakunyhema no kunyitya ane nili Mulungu wawo, no kwiyitya wene wanhu wangu, na vyono wamanyile 'ne,
3 ninga wazilema ziswanu. Na ku soko ya zizo, i walugu wawo wowatyatilila.

4 “Wanhu wangu wakwihagulila watemi, ninga wakwituma zizi wali wene. Wakwiwicila wawaha hamba kwilumbaniza nane ng'o, wakusola fweza zawo na zahabu, wawa kunoza vihwani so wongomele wawo weneco.
5 Ane si nghucisacila lukulu cihwani ce ndama ye zahabu, yono wakuhemba wanhu we likaya lya Samaliya. Ngholigwe ne likuwo muno muno ku soko yawo. Alu mwene wojendelela sunga nili ho waze walece wuhemba vihwani vyawo?
6 No munhu munghula mu Waisilayeli, yo munoza cihwani. Ninga yiyo ndama ye zahabu, yono wakuyihemba kuko ku Samaliya, yolobenanjizwa-benanjizwa tici-tici.
7 Ku soko vyono wakuhadika mbeho, holeka wolodudula mukukunzo! Migunda yo wuhemba siyolopisa hamba siyolosuma kulavya ndudula yo yose. Na hamba yize yilavye, iwajenzi wo woloyilya wayimale.
8 Waisilayeli weza wenha makungugo ganji, wono si wakwiliye cinji, weza wenha ciya cono cisakaye.
9 Wena nhumbula nghamu nha ye nyhenje. Waisilayeli wakujendela mu zinzila zawo weneco. Wakondya kubita kulondola wutazi kuli Wasiliya, no kugalipa i makungugo ganji ho gawadime kuli walugu.
10 Holeka luno ane nowakonghola hamonga, ho niwalipicize. Nawo wokwinyongola ko wusungu musunho, lono mutemi wa Siliya yakuwatendela ko wukali.

11 “Na mu nghango yono Waisilayeli wasuma kuzenga vikumbicilo vinji muno, yo nghango yiyo du kanyhi, yo wakacila kuhonjeleza i hanhu ho kwitumila zo wubi!
12 Hambi ane nha nawandicila wanhu mafundo gangu menji sigakuwala, ninga wene wakagalema no kugawona nha cinhu cipya, kanyhi cijenzi.
13 Wakundavivya makumbiko ge zinyama, no kulya weneco kanyhi zinyama zizo ze makumbiko. Ninga ane no Muwaha Mulungu singhwendezwa nawo. Naluno nowukumbucila wubi wawo, no kuwalipiciziza mu wubi wawo, nowagomola kanyhi sunga ko ku Misili!
14 I Waisilayeli, wazenga makaya go wutemi, ninga wamusemwa u Muwumbi wawo. Nawo wanhu wa Yuda, wazenga makaya gono gena magomawakali. Ninga nane notegula moto wono woganyanya no kugagwisa hasi makaya go wutemi hamonga ne makaya gawo.”


Hoseya 9

Hoseya yakulonga zo wulipicizwe we Waisilayeli

1 Nye nyo Waisilayeli, mulece kusangalalila zi sikukuu zenyu nhe makungugo ganji, mwapituka mwamuleka Mulungu wenyu, mweza si muli wehuwilwa kanyhi kuli Mwene. Hambi nha mweyiguza nyo weneco mu yisi yose kuli mulungu Baali kotya muli wasenyha, mukenda zo wuhemba wono mwehwesa vyono go malipo genyu!
2 Ninga mumanye vyono mu vilo vicefu du mowa musina wuhemba wono wukondizye, hamba mafuta ge zeyituni, kanyhi howa hasina hamba divayi bwete.
3 Ne Waisilayeli siwokwikala mu'si yo Muwaha Mulungu, langa wowuya ku Misili, nawo wowa kulya ndigwa yono si swanu kuko ku Ashuli.
4 Hamba siwomulavizya Muwaha Mulungu vilavywa vye divayi mumo mu zi'si zo wujenzi. Ne zindigwa zawo zolomwavufya munhu wo wose mono kolozilya, kotya nhe ndigwa ye nghunguza yo wumala lifwa. Nayo yokwitumamilwa so wigusha weneco du. Ninga hamba cinji si cokwila kumulavizya Muwaha Mulungu mu Nyumba yakwe yo wuhembelo.
5 Ninga cipango cilawa kufika ce sikukuu yo kumulavizya cogopo Muwaha Mulungu, wolonoza nhawule?
6 Wuhodanjice kolo wakondya kuza, ne wanhu wakwiyagala, wabite ku Siliya. Ne Wamisili wolowakonghola hamonga wazikwe ku Memufisi! Ne viwutwa vyawo vye fweza, hamonga ne hanhu hono zikaya zawo zali nzenje ha mwamulizo, holocindika mabalwe ne mamivya.

7 Ninga cipango co wulipicizwe cakondya kuza, icipango cono wanhu wolozituga zono ziwanojeye. Kolo zizi zikwijela, Isilayeli wolozimanya, nawo wololonga watye, “Muwizi ayu yapuwile! Munhu ayu mono yakutongwa no Mulungu yena lukwale.” Anye nyo wanhu, musulile 'ne ku soko yo winji wo wubi wenyu.
8 Ninga Mulungu yanhuma ane nha muwizi, ho niwakaje wanhu wakwe Waisilayeli. Ninga ho hose hono nghubita, anye mukujela kunhega kotya ndeje. Sunga na mu Nyumba yo Mulungu yo wuhembelo, i wanhu wayo, wo walugu wo muwizi.
9 Weyihodanga muno ku soko yo wubi wono wetuma lono wali wali ku Gibeya. Ninga Mulungu kowukumbucila wubi wawo, nayo kowalipiciza ku soko yo wubi wawo.

U wubi we Waisilayeli, hamonga ne cambuzi cayo

10 Muwaha Mulungu yakutya, “Ha mwamulizo lono namwaganila Isilayeli, yikawa nha mbwene zabibu zono zikuwilucila mu nyika. Na lono nawawonela walezi wawo ha mwamulizo, nali nha mbwene mikalo yo mukuyu, yono yipiliye mu cipango cayo. Ninga wali weza kuza kwi'tunda lya Peyoli, wakawa kwanza kumuhemba Baali. Ninga kanyhi hadodo bwete, wakawa kuyisemuna yiyo milungu yono wali wayendile.
11 Nalo lukumyo lwa Isilayeli lologuluka kotya ndeje, na kolowa kusina wana wanji wono wololelwa kuli wene, kolowa kusina wacekulu wono wolodinghula 'nda, hamba wana wono wolodinghulwa 'nda.
12 Hamba waze watuje wana, ane nolowawulaga. Sinolomuleka hamba yunji yekale mumi. Na lono niwe nawaleka wanhu awa, mbeka nghani 'mbi yolowagana.”
13 Gwe Muwaha Mulungu, nghusuma kuwawona wana wawo vyono wakusepwa no kuwulagwa.
14 Alu nghulombe cinhuci cono wuwatendele wanhu wawa? Wanozaje wacekulu zawo wawe wagumba ne matombo gawo galece kulavya mele!

Wuling'anize wo Mulungu kuli Isilayeli

15 Muwaha Mulungu yakutya, “Metumo gawo gose mabi, ganziza ku Giligali. Baho nane ho nanziza kuwasula. Na ku soko yo wubi wono wetuma, nane nowawusa mu'si yangu. Hamba sinowenda kanyhi yaye. Hambi nha sunga ne walongola wawo wose, wakondya kumbedegala.
16 Waisilayeli wehwana mubici wono wunyalile milela yayo, wono si wukulela mikalo kanyhi. Holeka wowa wasina wana, na hono wawatuje, ane nowawulaga i wana wono wendigwe muno nawo.”

U muwizi yakulonga ze Waisilayeli

17 Mulungu mono ane nghumwitumamila, kowalema wanhu wakwe, vyono siwakumuhulika mwene. Nawo wowa wanhu wono wowa kupilima-pilima mu makungugo.


Hoseya 10

1 Waisilayeli wali wenha kotya nha muzabibu wono wulelile zabibu nyinji muno. Mu nghango yo wumoteswe wawo, yikawa yo nghango yo wonjeleze wo kuzenga vikumbicilo vinji. Na mu nghango yo wulezi we yisi yawo vyono wali winha, ale, yo nghango yo wuswanu we masumbili ge mabwe maswanu gono wanoza, gono wahembaga.
2 Ne wanhu wono nhumbula zawo nghoci, alu wogaya so wubi wawo. Mulungu kovibenanga vikumbicilo vyawo, no kugahodanga ne masumbili gawo.
3 Wanhu wawo siwotinya kutya, “Alu cisina mutemi, ku soko vyono sicikumogopa Muwaha Mulungu. Ninga hamba nhavivyo, u mutemi kocitumilaci?”
4 Wakulonga nghani zono zisina nhunizo, no kwihuwiza wihuwizo wo wulambi, no kwituma nghani zono zisina cambuzi. Ne ling'ani, yeza si ling'ani, yikuwiluka kotya mabalwe gono gena sumu mu mugunda wono wakondya kulimwa.

5 Ne wanhu wono wekaye mwi'kaya lya Samaliya, wotuga woga no kulila so wajilize we ndama ye zahabu ya ku Beteli. Wene hamonga ne wakohani wono wacitumamilaga cihwani cico, wolocililila muno. Wololila walaza kuwa wawusizwa nhojo yawo yo lukumyo.
6 Ne cihwani cico ce ndama, colosolwa sunga ko ku Ashuli, ciwe kodi kuli wutemi wa Ashuli. Nayo Isilayeli yolokolwa cevu no kuwona soni so nghani yayo yeneco.
7 No mutemi wayo kolosolwa kotya lifulo mucanyha ye malenga.
8 Na mucanyha ye cigongo ca Aveni, hono Waisilayeli wakuhemba vihwani, naho holokongomezwa. Mamivya ne mabalwe, vyolowiluka mu makumbicilo gawo. Ne wanhu wologalonjela matunda wawe kutya, “Mucihundikaje!” Ne vigongo wakutya, “Mucigubikaje!”

Muwaha Mulungu yakulonga zo wuling'anizi kuli Isilayeli

9 Muwaha Mulungu yakutya, “Waisilayeli siwakuleka kuwituma wubi kuli'ne, ku wulawa mu cipango co wubi wawo wa ku Gibeya. Holeka wulugu wolowagana ku wulawa ku Gibeya.
10 Nowebata wanhu awa wanya wubi niwalipicize. Ne makungugo golokwihanguliza hamonga ho gehome nawo, wololipicizwa so wubi wawo vyono winji.

11 “Nayo Isilayeli yenha ndama yono yakondya kwijizwa, yono yendile kutowa wuhemba, ninga nghwihwesa vyono, ciba niyiwicile lubano mu singo yayo swanu, ho niyitonje yisume kwituma mulimo muwaha. Nomunoza Yuda yawe yo mukwega lisili, nayo Isilayeli yawe yo mutulanga malowanjila mu nyuma yo muyagwe.”
12 Nane nghutya, “Muyilime yisi mhya, so nyenye nyo weneco, muhadice ling'ani no kududula wendo no wulugutwe wono wolawa mu wuhembi wenyu wa kuli'ne. Alu co cipango cenyu co kumbuyila, ane no Muwaha Mulungu wenyu, nane nokuza nimumwajilenyi wulugutwe wangu.”
13 Ninga anye mwahadika wavu, no kududula nhwanga yayo. Alu mwakondya kulya mikalo yono yikulawilila mu wulambi wenyu. Ku soko vyono mwali mwitumbiye matuka genyu go wulugu, ne wasilikale wenyu vyono wenji.
14 Holeka wulugu wolowaziza i wanhu wenyu, ne magomawakali genyu golokongomezwa. Yolowa nhe vilo vyo mutemi Shalimani, vyono yalyongomeza likaya lya Betalibeli ko wulugu. Wanyina za munhu, hamonga ne wana wawo, wakatowa sunga wakafwa.
15 “Azi zo zilejela kuli'nye wanhu wa Beteli, ku soko yo wubi wenyu wono mwetuma. No wihomi wulawa kwanza, mutemi wa Isilayeli kolowulagwa.”


Hoseya 11

Wendo wo Muwaha Mulungu kuli wanhu wakwe wono wamulema

1 Muwaha Mulungu yakutya,

“Lono Isilayeli yali mudodo, nali nimwendile,

nghamucema mwanangu yawuce ku Misili.

2 Ninga nha vyono nacila kumucema,

nayo vyo yakacila kundeka no kutyatya zakwe.

I wanhu wangu wakawalavizya makumbiko Mabaali,

wakafusiza wuvumba ivihwani.

3 Ninga ane yonene mono nawafunda Isilayeli wajende.

Nawadinghula wanhu wangu mu mawoko gangu,

ninga wene hamba siwamanya vyono ane

nawaponya, no kuwadima.

4 Nane nghawakwega ko wuhile wangu na ko wendo wangu.

Nghawasola no kuwakamisa kwe vilungo vyangu.

Nghenama no kuwalisa.

5 “Ninga wene wakalema kumbuyila, holeka yiwanojeye wawuye ku Misili, nayo Mwashuli yo kowatema.
6 No wulugu wolokwinjila mu makaya gawo, no kugabenanga i malango ge likaya lyawo, wulugu wolowongomeza.”
7 Wene wakucila kuwuya ne nyuma. Ninga wololila ku soko yo lubano lono luli muli wene, hamba hasina munhu mono kololuwusa muli wene.

8 “Nosuma nhawule kukuleka 'gwe Isilayeli?

Nosuma wule kukutaga?

Hamba si nosumila lukulu kukongomeza,

nha vyono nayongomeza Adima.

Hamba kukunozeza nha vyono nayinoza Zeboyimu?

Nhumbula yangu siyonghombola ho nitume zizo!

Hambi wendo wangu kuli'gwe, nha wuwaha muno.

9 Holeka si nomulipicizizenyi mwi'kuwo lyangu ng'o.

Hamba sinoyongomeza Isilayeli kanyhi.

Hambi 'ne nha nili Mulungu, hamba si nili munhu yaye.

Ane yonene Mono Yelile, mono nili hamonga nanye.

Hamba sinomuzizenyi mwi'kuwo lyangu yaye,

ho nimongomezenyi.

10 “Wanhu wangu wolonhyatya kolo nghukoloma nha simba kuli walugu wawo. Wolonyiziza musunho ku wulawa ku lubavu lwa kumwezi.
11 Wolokuza ku wulawa Misili, wolokuza musunho nha ndeje, na ku wulawa ku Ashuli, wolokuza nha nziwa. Nane nolowagomola ku zikaya zawo kanyhi. Vyo nghutya ane no Muwaha Mulungu.”

Isilayeli na Yuda wakuhoswa

12 Muwaha Mulungu yakutya, “Waisilayeli wamhilima hamonga no wulambi no wukonji. Ne wanhu wa Yuda nawo, wakali wakunema 'ne no Mulungu mwihuwilwa, Mono Yelile.


Hoseya 12

1 “Nghani zose zono Waisilayeli wakwituma, cilawa hakali mitondo, sunga cinyamihe, zisina cambuzi, kanyhi za wuhodanji du. Wukoci hamonga ne metumo go wu wula lusungu, gakonjelezeka muno muli wene. Wakulagana ne wanhu wa Ashuli no kusuluza hamonga ne Wamisili.”
2 Nayo Muwaha Mulungu, yena nghani yono yakuhila kuleta kuli wanhu wa Yuda, na kanyhi kowalipiciza Waisilayeli, ku soko ye metumo ge wanhu wayo. Mwene kolowalipa so wubi wawo wono wetuma.
3 U sogo yawo Yakobo yesumaniza no muwahawe Esawu, lono wose wejete wali wakali mu'nda ye nyinawo. Na lono Yakobo yali yeza wiluka, yakesumaniza no Mulungu.
4 Yakesumaniza na Malayika, yakasuma, yakalila no kulomba wulugutwe. Mulungu yakaza kuli sogo yetu Yakobo, no kulonga nayo lono yali yali ku Beteli.
5 Ayu yali yo Muwaha Mulungu we mihanga, Muwaha Mulungu lye 'tagwa lyono linojeye wanhu wamuhembe.
6 Holeka anye nyo lulelo lwa Yakobo, mwitumbilenyi Mulungu wenyu, kanyhi mumuwuyile mwene. Mweze ne cihuliko, kanyhi mweze muli ling'ani, akuno mumulindiye Mulungu ko wukangalizi, nhondo zose.

Nghani zinji zo wuling'anizi

7 Muwaha Mulungu yakutya, “I Waisilayeli, si wehuwilwa, wenhwanile Wakanani, wendile kuwahiziza wanhu wono wakuza kugula, mu nzila yo witumamila mizani yo wulambi.”
8 Akuno wakutya, “Ase cili wagoli, citujila sawo nyinji, cina lyuwa lyetu. Hamba hasina munhu mono kocihosa so wutuga wugoli wuwu mu nzila yo wupujila.”
9 Ninga 'ne yo nene Muwaha Mulungu, u Mulungu mono namulongozenyi ku wulawa Misili. Nomwikazenyi kanyhi mu mahema nha vyono mwali lono namuzizenyi mu nyika.

10 “Nalonga ne wawizi no kuwapela wugubulilwe winji, na mu nzila ye wawizi, nawakaga wanhu wangu.
11 Ninga hamba nhavivyo, ku Gileyadi, vyo wakali du wakuhemba vihwani, ninga wono wakuvihemba, wolofwa. Ne zindama zono wakuzilavya makumbiko mu Giligali, hamonga ne makumbicilo gawo, golowa masumbili ge mabwe mwi'hala.”

12 No mulezi wetu Yakobo, yatiziza ku Mesopotamiya, ho yatuje mugolece kuko. Yaketuma mulimo wo kudima zingholo kuli munhu yunji.
13 Nayo Muwaha Mulungu yakatuma muwizi yawaponye wanhu wa Isilayeli ku wulawa mu wuwanda ku Misili, ho yawadime.
14 Waisilayeli wamukoza Muwaha Mulungu yikuwo yiwaha, na yali yiwanojeye wufwe so masutya gawo. No Muwaha Mulungu kolowalipiciza so cevu cono wamuletela.


Hoseya 13

Wuling'anizi we ndumilizo kuli Isilayeli

1 Vipango vyono vyapuluta, lono wo mulango wa Efulayimu walongaga, ninga we milango yinji ya Isilayeli wogopa, wakawa wamulanjile Efulayimu. Ninga wanhu wetuma wubi so kumuhemba Baali, na ku soko yiyo, wofwa.
2 Sunga nalu wakucila kwituma wubi, wakwinozeza vihwani ho wavihembe. Wakwinozeza vihwani vya fweza, vinozwe ne miwoko ye wanhu kwe mahala gawo weneco. Nawo wakutya, “Ale muvilavizyaje makumbiko!” Alu wanhu ho wovinonela wule vihwani vivyo, i vihwani vyono vine futa ye zindama!
3 Holeka wanhu awa wokwajilila nhe nghungulyosi lya hakali mitondo, nhe buhe yono yikunyala musunho. Wowa kotya mawaje gono gapemheluswaga ne civulavumbi mu cuga. Kanyhi kotya lyosi lyono likulawa ha mafigwa.
4 Muwaha Mulungu yakutya, “Ane yo nene Muwaha Mulungu wenyu, mono namuwusenyi Misili. Musina Mulungu yunji langa nene du.” Ane yo nene du mono nili muponyi wenyu.
5 Nane nghamudimenyi mu yisi nghavu ya mu nyika.
6 Ninga lono mwali mweza kwinjila mu yisi swanu, yono mukulya no kwiguta, hodu imitima yenyu yikekumya no kusemwa 'ne.
7 Holeka ku soko yiyo, nane nomuhungucilenyi nha simba. Nolambalala hasi, nimutejezenyi nha suwi mu zinzila zenyu.
8 Nane nomuhungucilenyi nhe dubu lyono litajile wana wayo, kanyhi nomudemulanjenyi. Nomuhawanjenyi kotya simba, no kumudemulanjenyi vidodo vidodo kotya nimu ya mu mbago.

9 “Nane nomongomezenyi anye nyo Waisilayeli! Nayo nani mono kosuma kumutazenyi?
10 Mukalomba mutemi ne walongola, ninga woliponya nhawule likungugo?
11 Nane nghamupelelenyi watemi mwi'kuwo lyangu, ninga kanyhi niwawusiza mu wukali wangu.

12 “Wubi wa Isilayeli ne masutya gakwe, vyose vyandikwe no kuwikwa ciwutwa.
13 Isilayeli yena cilejeho co kwikala mumi. Ninga yo nghani yo wulele kuwihwesa havivi, hambi nha yenha mugalika mono yali mu cidaha co kulelwa, ninga kawa kulemelela mu'nda yo nyina.
14 Nane hamba si nowaponya wanhu we liwala lili, mu yinze ye lifwa, hamba kuwaponya mu vilungo vye lifwa. Agwe go lifwa, wulete lihuhuji lyako! Nagwe go yinze ye lifwa, wulete magazo gako! Nane hamba si nowawonela lusungu yaye wanhu wawa.
15 Nayo Isilayeli, hamba yawe yaficile nhe mabalwe, ane noleta mbeho ya kucilima kulawa mu nyika yono yili moto, nayo yonyaza mivwilo yawo ye malenga, hamonga ne masima. Nayo yolovipemhelusa vinhu vyose vyono vikwendeza.
16 Nayo Samaliya yinojeye yilipicizwe, ku soko yo kundeka 'ne. Ne wanhu wakwe wolofwa ku wulugu, ne wana wawo wagalika, wolowa kubamilizwa hasi, ne wacekulu wono wena mida, awo nawo wolotumbulwa.”


Hoseya 14

Wulombe wa Hoseya kuli Isilayeli

1 Ale, muwuyilenyi Muwaha Mulungu wenyu, anye nyo wanhu wa Isilayeli. Wubi wenyu wo waleka mukekobala no kugwa.
2 Muwuyilenyi Muwaha Mulungu, no wulombe awu wuwe co cilavywa cenyu kuli mwene. “Gwe Muwaha Mulungu, wucinenelaje wubi wetu wose, kanyhi wubocele wulombe wetu nase cokukumya agwe nha vyono cehuwiza.
3 Hambi Ashuli nha sikociponya yaye, hamba fwalasi zo wulugu sizosuma kucitaza. Hamba sicolotya kanyhi kuli vihwani vyetu vye milungu, vyono vyene yo Mulungu wetu. Gwe Muwaha Mulungu, wulajile lusungu kuli wawo wono wasina ku wubito.”

Muwaha Mulungu yakwihuwiza mikalile mipya kuli Isilayeli

4 Muwaha Mulungu yakutya,

“Nane nowagomola wanhu wangu wawuye kuli'ne

nowenda kwe nhumbula yangu yose,

hamba sinolowakolelwa likuwo kanyhi.

5 Nane nowa nha mvula mu'si nghavu kuli Waisilayeli.

Nawo wosanula nhe 'luwa,

kanyhi wohimbiza muno milela hasi,

kotya mibici ya Lebanoni.

6 Nawo wokwikala no kujendelela kuwiluka wupya,

no wuswanu wawo,

wowa nho wuswanu we mizeyituni.

Nawo wowa na mhunjile,

yinhe miyelezi ya Lebanoni.

7 Na kanyhi wokwikala hasi yo wudimwe wangu,

kanyhi wotula nha ngano.

Nawo wowa na mhunjile swanu,

nhe divayi ya Lebanoni.

8 Waisilayeli,

wowa wasina kanyhi cinji co kwituma kuli vihwani,

nolowupitula no wulombe wawo

no kuwadima nolowacitiza

no mubeho kotya mubici wono wudedewaye.

Hambi nha yo nene mono nili mwamulizo

wo wulugutwe wawo wose.”

Ze ndumilizo

9 Nghulomba, wono wena wizuce, wazitanje zizi zono zandicigwe baha, no kuziwika mu zinhumbula zawo. Nzila zo Muwaha Mulungu zo ze ling'ani, ne wanhu we ling'ani, wo wakuzityatya. Ninga wanyo wubi, wakukobala no kugwa, ku soko vyono siwaziceleleye yaye.


Yoweli 1

1 Ayi yo nghani yo Muwaha Mulungu yono yamuziza Yoweli Mwana wa Petuweli.

Wanhu wakulila so wuhodangwe we migunda

2 Hulicizenyi ta, anye nyo wakombi,

sunga nanye wose mono mwi'kaye mu'si ya Yuda,

muhulicize.

Wulenyi hono mukulanga,

zono zinha zizi zowa zejela 'mbi mu vilo vyenyu

hamba lunji mu vilo vye walezi wenyu?

3 Ale, muwalonjelaje zizi, wana wenyu,

nawo wana wenyu wawalonjele wana wawo,

i wana wawo nawo,

wawalonjele lulelo lono lukuza.

4 Matewa na matewa

ge zinzije genjila mu migunda yetu,

galya vilimwa vyetu,

na cono litewa lye zinzije,

lisigaze, litewa lye mbilazi likulya,

na cono litewa lye mbilazi lisigaze,

litewa lye mang'ungu likulya,

na cono litewa lye mang'ungu lisigaze,

litewa lye mapanzi likulya.

5 Holeka nanye nyo wang'wela,

mwenzeluce mulile muno muno,

mulile ku soko ye divayi mhya,

anye wose mono mung'wezaga divayi.

Hambi zabibu zono muyinozezaga divayi mhya,

nha zakondya kuhodangwa ne zinzije.

6 Hambi litewa lye zinzije nha linjila mu'si yetu,

kanyhi lili vilungo,

nzije nyinji muno sizikusumika

hamba kuwuwalwe.

Zina meno makali kotya meno ga simba

ne majego gono genha ga simba nyhekulu.

7 Zahodanga sunga ne mizabibu yetu,

zakondya kulya ne mikuyu yetu,

zayikubulanga ne mabada gayo gose,

ne manhambi gayo geza mazelu swee.

8 Anye nyo wanhu,

mulile nho mwana munyacipale,

mono yafwilwa no munhu mono yali hila kutolwa nayo.

9 Hambi vilavywa vyo wusaje hamba vye divayi,

vyo kulavya mu Nyumba yo Mulungu,

nha vyeza vili hasina lu.

Iwakohani nawo wakulila ku soko

i vilavywa vyo kumulavizya Muwaha Mulungu,

alu vyeza vili hasina.

10 Hambi migunda nha yeza yisina cinji.

Yisi nayo, yikulila ku soko wuhemba nha wahodangwa,

sunga ne divayi yawula,

ne mafuta geza sigakwijela.

11 Ale, mukolwe cevu anye nyo walima migunda,

nanye nyo walindilizi we migunda ye mizabibu,

mulile ku soko yo wuhemba ne shayili,

heya, hambi vilimwa vyose nha vyahodangwa.

12 Hambi mizabibu nayo sunga

ne mikuyu nha yakondya kunyala.

Sunga ne mibici yose

ye mikalo yakondya kunyala.

Sunga ne wanhu wose nhondo,

weza wasina hamba nyemo bwete.

13 Ale, muvwale magunila, mulile,

anye nyo wakohani

mono mwitumaga ha cikumbicilo!

Mubite mu Nyumba

yo Mulungu mukalile cilo cose!

Hambi nha heza hasina vilavywa

vyo wuhemba ne divayi,

vyono momulavizya Mulungu wenyu

mu Nyumba yakwe.

14 Mwiyezeze mu nzila yo wuleka kulya,

mucemeleze wanhu waze ku wuhembi,

muwakongholaje walongola,

hamonga ne wanhu wose we yisi ya Yuda,

wenjile mu Nyumba yo Muwaha Mulungu wenyu,

mumulilile Mulungu.

15 Woyi he nye!

Hambi lizuwa lyo Muwaha Mulungu,

nha lyasejelela,

lizuwa lyono Muwaha Mulungu

u Mudaha Vyose kololeta wongomele!

16 Alu, ceza cisina witumbilo kanyhi,

vyono vilimwa vyetu vyose vyakondya kuhodangwa.

Sunga ne nyemo yose yeza yili musina

mu Nyumba yo Mulungu wetu.

17 Hambi imbeyu nayo

nha yahodanjicila mu muhangha mukavu,

imadongha nago galekwa gasina hamba cinji,

zinyumba zo wuwiko we madongha,

nazo zamwaguka.

Hambi wuhemba nha wanyala.

18 Ne zing'ombe nazo zikulila ku soko yiyo,

hambi nha kweza kusina wudimo wazo,

ne matewa ge zingholo nago gakugaya du.

19 Ane nghukulilila agwe go Muwaha Mulungu,

ku soko yo wudimo hamonga ne mibici,

vyono vyanyala kotya nha vitakamizwe no moto.

20 Sunga ne zinimu za mu mbago nazo nha zikukulilila,

ku soko ye malamba ne makolongo gono ganyala.


Yoweli 2

Nzije zikuwa co citanjilo ce suguzi co wuze we Lizuwa lyo Muwaha Mulungu

1 Towenyi ndulele ye citanjilo mu Sayuni,

mwi'tunda lyono lyelile lyo Muwaha Mulungu.

Wanhu wose mono mwikaye mu Yuda, mucicime.

Hambi lizuwa lyo Muwaha Mulungu nha likuza,

kanyhi lyasejelela.

2 Nalyo kanyhi lyolowa yizuwa lya citi no wukalale,

yizuwa lye mavunde no wutitu tuku.

Hambi litewa yiwaha lye zinzije,

nha lyologubika matunda kotya citi.

Cikali hamba si nejela cinhu cono cinha vivi,

mu vilo vyono vyapuluta,

hamba mu vilo vyono vikuza si cilejela yaye.

3 Litewa lili lye zinzije zikulya vilimwa kotya

moto wukutakamiza mahanze,

ku mwande yazo,

yisi yihwanile Busitani ya Adeni,

ninga ku nyuma yazo,

yihwanile kotya nyika yono yihodanjice.

Hasina hamba cinji cono gasigaze.

4 Wijele we zinzije zizo,

zikwijela zihwanile Fwalasi,

kanyhi zikumangha kotya Fwalasi zo wulugu.

5 Na lono zikuguluka musunho mu vizuli vye matunda,

cihumbi cazo cihwanile mituka yono yikubita ku wulugu,

misindo yazo no mulilo we cihumbi cazo,

kotya mahanze makavu

gono gakutakamila mu moto.

Zipanjile kotya wasilikale

wono wewikanize kubita ku wulugu.

6 Na vyono zikucila kusejelela behi,

wusu we wanhu wose wukusininghala so woga.

7 Zikwinjila kotya wasilikale wo wulugu,

zikutambala mu majinji kotya we citung'ati,

zose zidomile kumwande,

hamba sizikuleka wulunji wazo hamba hadodo.

8 Zikukola mu nzila yono nyagwe yikolile,

sunga na mu magomawakali gawo,

zene zikubita zikupuluta du,

hamba hasina cinji cono cosuma kuzimila yaye.

9 Zikwinjila musunho muno mwi'kaya,

zikumangha mu majinji gawo

sunga na mu matembe ge zikaya,

kanyhi zikwinjilila mu madilisha nha wahizi.

10 Sunga ne yisi nayo yikucicima,

no wulanga nawo wukusinjisika,

ne lizuwa nalyo no mwezi vyatukuwala,

sunga ne zinyelezi, hamba sizikusana yaye.

11 Hambi Muwaha Mulungu

nha yakuwalajiliza lipuga

lye wasilikale wakwe kwe'zi yiwaha,

nalyo lipuga lyono limuhulicile,

wo wenji muno, kanyhi wali vilungo.

Wugayeci wono wolowa,

mwi'zuwa lilyo lyo Muwaha Mulungu!

Nani 'mbi mono kolokangalila?

Lucemo lo wunene

12 Alu Muwaha Mulungu yakutya,

“Munene mu zinhumbula zenyu mumhitucile nene,

ko wuleka kulya, no wulila muno.

13 Kanyhi muwulajilaje winenenyhezi wa

mu zinhumbula zenyu ko wukalale wenyu.

Hambi wudemulanga vivwalo vyenyu,

nha si wukwiliye cinji yaye.”

Mumupitucile Muwaha Mulungu,

hambi mwene nha yo yena nheto no lusungu.

Sikakolagwa ne likuwo mbela,

mwene nhondo zose,

yewikanize kunenela du,

hamba si kulipiciza yaye.

14 Na lunji Muwaha Mulungu wenyu,

komukumbucilenyi no kukawaniza lihweso lyakwe,

no kumulugutizenyi,

hamonga no kumonjelezezenyi vilimwa vyenyu.

Nanye ho mosuma kumulavivya vilavywa

vyo wusaje ne divayi.

15 Holeka mutowe ndulele mwi'tunda lya Sayuni,

muwalajilize wanhu walece kulya cinji,

wekongholele wose hamonga!

16 Muwakongholaje wanhu hamonga,

muwawikanize so wihangulize wono welile.

Muwaletaje ne wakombi,

hamonga ne wana,

ne wana wagalika wose,

hamonga na bwana halusi

na bibi halusi walece nyumba yawo,

waze wose.

17 Nawo wakohani,

hamonga ne wetumami

wono wakumwitumamila Muwaha Mulungu,

haciligati ye cikumbicilo

no mulango we Nyumba yo Mulungu,

yiwanojeye walile no kulomba muno muno, watye,

“Gwe go Muwaha Mulungu,

weze no lusungu kuli wanhu wako,

wulece kugaleceleza makungugo ganji gacibedegale,

hamba kucisekanga kose, wawe kutya,

‘Alu yali hayi Mulungu wenyu?’ ”

Mulungu koyigomolela yisi lulelo

18 Hobaho Muwaha Mulungu

yakayiwonela nghalazi yisi yakwe,

no kuwawonela lusungu wanhu wakwe.

19 Muwaha Mulungu yakawapitula yakawatya,

“Alu nomupelenyi wuhemba,

ne divayi, ne mafuta,

nanye momoteswa,

sunga ne makungugo

ganji sigomubedegalenyi kanyhi yaye.

20 Noliwusa litewa lye zinzije

lyono lyaza ku wulawa kusumuka.

Noziwinjila ku nyika,

nago matewa ga ku mwande,

nogategula ko kwi'lenga lyo mwino,

nago ga mu nyuma ko kwi'lenga lya Meditelaneya.

Nazo zofwila mumo, ne miwili yazo,

yolavya munungho mumo mwi'lenga.

Nozihodanga ku soko ya zose

zono zamutendelenyi.

21 “Nanye mo migunda,

mulece kogopa langa musangalale,

kanyhi mweze ne nyemo,

so zose zono Muwaha Mulungu yamutendelenyi.

22 Nyo vilimu nanye nhavivyo,

mulece kogopa,

hambi wudimo wenyu nha wasipuka,

ne mibici nayo yikulela mikalo yayo,

hamonga ne mikuyu,

ne mizabibu yose, alu vyenjipa muno.

23 “Holeka muweze ne nyemo

anye wanhu wa Sayuni,

musangalalile

zono Muwaha Mulungu wenyu yamutendelenyi.

Hambi mwene nha kamupelenyi mvula

ye lifuku yono yikwiliye,

kanyhi komutonyezezenyi

ne mvula ye mhinga

na ye mafuso ku soko yenyu,

nhe vilo vyono vipulute.

24 Ne vyuga vyenyu vyomema wuhemba,

ne matuli go kukobonjela,

gokwiguta divayi ne mafuta.

25 Nomugomolelenyi

kanyhi vilimwa vyenyu,

vyono vyajilila mu myaka yono zinzije zalya.

Hambi nha yo nene

mono nalituma litewa lye zinzije kuli'nye.

26 Holeka nanye mowa na vinji vyo kulya,

kanyhi mokwiguta.

Nanye momukumya Muwaha Mulungu,

u Mulungu wenyu,

mono yetuma mapoto ku soko yenyu,

nanye nyo wanhu wangu

hamba simobedegalilwa lukulu kanyhi.

27 Holeka Isilayeli,

momanya vyono ane nili hamonga nanye,

kanyhi vyono yo nene Muwaha Mulungu wenyu,

hasina Mulungu yunji kanyhi.

Nanye nyo wanhu wangu,

hamba simobedegalilwa lukulu kanyhi.

Lizuwa lyo Muwaha Mulungu

28 “Yolowa hanyuma yayo,

nolokwita zo muhe wangu muli wanhu wose,

wana wenyu we cilume

na we cicekulu wolowila ze nghani yangu,

ne wakombi wenyu wololota ndoto,

ne wazelelo wenyu nawo wolowona wugubulilwe.

29 Mu vilo vivyo,

nolokwita zo muhe wangu,

mu wetumami wangu we cilume na we cicekulu.

30 “Nane nololajila citanjilo

ce lizuwa lilyo ku wulanga,

na kono'nze kolowa sakami

no moto ne mavunde ge nghungulyosi.

31 Lizuwa yolotukuwala,

no mwezi nawo wolopituka wuwe mudunghu nha sakami,

lono likali sinafika lizuwa

lyo kogofya lyo Muwaha Mulungu.

32 Kanyhi munhu wo wose

mono kololomba wutazi kuli Muwaha Mulungu,

yuyo yo kolopona.

Nha vyono Muwaha Mulungu yalonga yakatya,

Wenji wa mu Yelusalemi wolopona,

na wono nawahagula wolokwikala wapolile.”


Yoweli 3

Mulungu kologaling'aniza makungugo

1 Muwaha Mulungu yakutya,

“Mu vilo vivyo,

nolowugomola wumoteswe wa Yuda na Yelusalemi.

2 Nane nologakonghola makungugo gose,

nigategule sunga ko kwi'lolo lyono likucemwa,

“U Muwaha Mulungu Yakuling'aniza.

Nane nolowaling'aniza

i makungugo gago ku soko ye metumo gawo gose

gono wawatendela wanhu wangu Isilayeli.

Ku soko waweyagaziza Isilayeli mu ma'si go wujenzi,

no kuyigawa Isilayeli yisi yangu.

3 Nawo wakawagawa

wanhu wangu mu nzila yo kuwatowela kula,

ho yejele mono kosuma kuwasola wafungwa.

Wakawaguza wana we cilume

na we cicekulu ku wuwanda

ho wetujile sawo yo kuwapela wasenyha,

hamonga no kugula divayi wang'we.

4 “Alo nanye nyo Tulo na Sidoni, hamonga ne zi'si zose ze Wafilisiti, mukusaka mwitume nghanici kuli'ne? Hono muwe mukusaka kwituma nghani yinji yo yose kuli'ne, ale, ko kwenyu, ninga nane nomugomolelenyi nanye musunho zo wulipicizwe wenyu.
5 Hambi nha mwesolela nyo weneco fweza ne zahabu, ne vinhu vyangu viswanu, no kuvinjiza mu zinyumba zo wuhembelo wenyu.
6 Mukawasola wanhu wa Yuda na Yelusalemi, mukawategula kutali ne yisi yawo, mukawaguza ku Wagiliki.
7 Alu nane neza kubita kuwasola kuko kono anye mwawaguza, nane nomutendelenyi zose, nha vyono nanye mwawatendela wene.
8 Nane nowaleka wana wenyu we cilume na we cicekulu, waguzwe kuli wanhu wa Yuda, ne wanhu wa Yuda nawo wowaguza kutali ku wanhu wa Sheba, hambi ane no Muwaha Mulungu nha vyo nghutya.

9 “Muwalonjelaje makungugo gose mutye,

‘Mwiwikanizaje so wulugu,

muwacemaje we citung'ati wenyu,

mukonghole wasilikale wose wabite ku wulugu!

10 Mutyane masili genyu gawe mimaje,

ne zihengo zenyu ziwe migoha,

sunga na wono wasoceye

nawo wose wabite ku wulugu.

11 Ale musunhe muze,

anye nyo makungugo gose

mono muli mu mbavu zose,

mwihangulizize mwi'lolo.’ ”

Gwe Muwaha Mulungu,

wutegule vitung'ati wako vikehome.

12 “Makungugo gewikanizaje,

gaze mwi'lolo lyono likucemwa,

U Muwaha Mulungu Yakuling'aniza,

ane no Muwaha Mulungu kuko

ko nogaling'aniza makungugo

ga mu zimbavu zose.

13 Hambi wene nha wabi muno,

holeka wuwatemangaje wuwagwise hasi

nha wuhemba mwi'pango lye ndudula,

wuwakobonje nha zabibu

vyono zikuwa kukobongwa mwi'tuli lyokukobonjela,

sunga ne divayi yiwa kulawila.”

14 Mapuga na mapuga wali mwi'lolo

lyo wuling'anizizwe.

Na vyo yolowa mwi'zuwa lilyo

lyo Muwaha Mulungu,

nalyo likuza hamba si lyocela yaye.

15 Mwi'zuwa lilyo,

mwezi ne lizuwa vyolotukuwala,

ne zinyelezi si zolong'alala yaye.

Mulungu kowalugutiza wanhu wakwe

16 Muwaha Mulungu yakulonga

ne lizi yiwaha ku wulawa mwi'tunda lya Sayuni,

ne lizi lyakwe likudidima

ku wulawa mu Yelusalemi,

sunga ne yisi hamonga

no wulanga navyo vikucicima,

ninga mwene Muwaha Mulungu yo kowadima.

17 “Nagwe go Isilayeli baho ho kolomanyila

vyono ane yo nene Muwaha Mulungu wako.

Nikaye mu Sayuni mwi'tunda lyangu lyono lyelile.

Nayo Yelusalemi yowa likaya lyangu lyono lyelile,

hamba wajenzi si wolisuma yaye.

18 “Mu vilo vivyo,

matunda golomema mizabibu yose,

ne zing'ombe nazo,

zolowa ziyagaye mu matunda gose,

kanyhi kolowa na malenga menji

ku soko ye vikolongo vya Yuda.

Ne cikolongo colohuluma ku wulawilila

mu kaya yo Muwaha Mulungu,

sunga ne lilolo lya Shitimu nalyo,

lyolowa lina malenga menji.

19 “Misili yolowa nyika nghavu,

na Edomu yolohodangwa no wongomezwe,

vyono wayihoma yisi ya Yuda,

no kuwawulaga wanhu wono wasina masutya.

20 Holeka nane nowalipiciza wawo wono wawawulaga,

hamba sinowawonela lusungu yaye,

ku soko ye lisutya lyawo lilyo.

Ninga Yuda na Yelusalemi wokwikala cibitilila.

21 Nane nowalipiciza wono wawawulaga

i wanhu wa Yuda hamba

si nowalecela yaye i wasutyi.

Nane ane no Muwaha Mulungu,

nikaye mu Sayuni.”


Amosi 1

U muwizi Amosi

1 Azi zo nghani za Amosi, u mudimi munya kwi kaya lya Tekowa. Myaka myejete lono litulo lya mu'si lyali likali si naza, mu vilo vya Uziya lono yali mutemi wa Yuda, na lono Yelobowamu mwana wa Yowashi yali mutemi wa Isilayeli.
2 Amosi yakatya, “Muwaha Mulungu yakukoloma kuwulawa kwitunda lya Sayuni, ne lizi lyakwe wulawa ku Yelusalemi. No wudimo weza musina, ne lihanze mwitunda lye kalimeli lyanyala.”

Wuling'anizi wo Mulungu kuli makaya gono gali gali behi behi na Isilayeli

Damesiki

3 Muwaha Mulungu yakutya, “Wanhu wa Damesiki wetuma wubi kali kenji, na ku soko yiyo nane nowalipiciza. Hambi nha wawatendela vibi no kuwatamisa muno muno wanhu wa Gileyadi.
4 Holeka nane nolipembela moto likaya lyo wutemi, lyono mutemi Hazayeli yazenga, kanyhi nogakongoga makaya go mutemi Benehadadi.
5 Nogabenanjiza ne malango ge likaya lya Damesiki no kuwawusa wono wekaye mwi'lolo lya Aveni, hamonga no mutemi wa Betedeni. Ne wanhu wa Siliya, wolosolwa nha wafungwa sunga ko ku yisi ya Kili.”

Filisiti

6 Muwaha Mulungu yakutya, “Iwanhu wa Gaza, wetuma wubi muno muno. Na ku soko yiyo, nane nowalipiciza wene. Ku soko wene wayisola nghungugo yose, no kuwahamizizya kuli wanhu wa Edomu wawe wawanda.
7 Holeka notegula moto nigatakamize majinji ge likaya lye Gaza no kugatakamiza makaya gayo.
8 Nowawusa wono wekaye mu makaya ga Ashidodi na Ashikeloni, hamonga ne watemi wawo. Kanyhi nolilipiciza likaya lya Ekiloni, ne wafilisiti wose wono wasigala, wofwa.”

Tulo

9 Muwaha Mulungu yakutya, “Iwanhu wa Tulo, nawo wetuma wubi kali kenji. Na ku soko yiyo, nane nowalipiciza. Hambi nha wayisola nghungugo yose no kuyihamizizya ku yisi ya Edomu wawe wawanda, hamba siwacikumbucila ne cilagane ce ndugu cono wacinoza.
10 Holeka nane notegula moto mu majinji ge likaya lya Tulo, no kugatakamiza makaya gayo.”

Edomu

11 Muwaha Mulungu yakutya, “Wanhu wa Edomu, wetuma wubi kali kenji. Na ku soko yiyo, nane nowalipiciza. Hambi nha wawatendela vibi wandugu zawo, Waisilayeli, hamba kulajila lusungu yaye. Ne likuwo lyawo, likawa vyo lijendeleye du lisina wumalice yaye.
12 Holeka nane notegula moto mwi'kaya lya Temani, no kugatakamiza makaya ga Bozila.”

Amoni

13 Muwaha yakutya, “Wanhu wa Amoni, wetuma wubi kali kenji, na ku soko yiyo, nane nowalipiciza. Hambi mu wulugu wawo, nha wawatumbulaga i wacekulu we mida, so wusaka kugazimhya mipaka ye zi'si zawo.
14 Holeka nane notegula moto mu majinji ge Likaya lya Laba no kugatakamiza zikaya, makaya gayo. Na kolowa kolili izozo mwi'zuwa lilyo lya wulugu, no wihomi wolowa wuwaha, kotya mukukunzo we livulavumbi.
15 U mutemi we Amoni hamonga ne wawaha, wolohamywa no kutegulwa kutali.”


Amosi 2

Mowabu

1 Muwaha yakutya, “Wanhu wa Mowabu, wetuma wubi kali kenji, na ku soko yiyo, nane nowalipiciza. Hambi nha si wali na cogopo kuli mafupa go mutemi wa Edomu, wene kwa kuganyanya wagatakamiza sunga gakawa mavu.
2 Nane notegula moto mu yisi ya Mowabu, no kugatakamiza makaya ga keliyoti. Ne wanhu wa Mowabu wolofwa ku soko ye nyhinyinho ne lizozo lyo wulugu lono wasilikale wolowa wakuzoza, hamonga ne mazi ge zindulele.
3 Nane nolomuwulaga mutemi wa Mowabu, hamonga ne walongola wose we yisi.”

Yuda

4 Muwaha yakutya, “Wanhu wa Yuda, wetuma wubi kali kenji na ku soko yiyo, nane nowalipiciza. Hambi nha wehepa mafundo gangu, hamba siwebate ne malajilizo gangu. Hambi nha wakondya kwajiliza so wutyatye milungu yo wulambi yono wasogo zawo wayitumila.”
5 Holeka nane notegula moto kuli Yuda, no kuganyanya makaya ga Yelusalemi.

Uling'anizi wo Mulungu kuli Isilayeli

6 Muwaha yakutya, “Wanhu wa Isilayeli, wetuma wubi kali kenji nane ku soko yiyo, nowalipiciza. Wawaguza ku wuwanda iwanhu wehuwilwa wono siwasuma kulipa migawa yawo, i wanhu waciwa wono si wali wasumile kulipa hamba uguzi wa malatu.”
7 Wakuwewonela wanhu wono wasoceye, na wono wasina wutazi, no kumwivyajiza nzila muciwa. U munhu no sogwe, wose wakuhanga kugona no muhinza yumonga muwanda no kulyavufya litagwa lyangu lyono lyelile.
8 Ne hanhu ho hose hono wakuhembela, wakuyigonela myenda yono wayisolile kulawa kuli waciwa, yono wayipinjice so migawa yawo. Mu wuhembelo wo Mulungu wawo wakung'wa divayi yono wayisolile kulawa kuli wawo wono wawadayaga mapesa.
9 “Holeka, 'nye nyo wanhu wangu, ku soko yenyu, yo yaleka nane nghawongomeza lukulu Waamoli, wanhu wono wali watali kotya mibici ye mihagata, kanyhi we vilungo kotya mibici ye minghola.
10 Nane nghamuwusenyi mu yisi ye Misili, nghamutonjenyi mu nyika myaka makumi mane, kanyhi nghawa kumupelenyi ne yisi ya Waamoli yiwe yisi yenyu.
11 Nghawahagula muli wana wenyu, wanji wawe wawizi, na muli wanhu wenyu iwazelelo, wanji wawe wanazili. Wulenyi, azi si zili mbeka, anye nyo wanhu wa Isilayeli? Ane no Muwaha Mulungu vyo nghutya.
12 Ninga nye mwawanoza wanazili wang'we divayi, no kuwalajiliza i wawizi, walece kulonga zinghani zangu.
13 Holeka 'lu nane, nomusindanjilenyi ho hasi, nanye motulilwa nho mukokoteni wono wudinghuye wuhemba.
14 Hamba no munhu mumanyhi sikolotiga yaye, no munhu we vilungo kolowula, vilungo vyakwe, no musilikale sikolosuma kuponya wumi wakwe.
15 No munhu mugumi we zisonga, sikolokwima, no mumanyhi nayo sikolotiza, ne wanhu wa mu zifwalasi siwolotiga hamonga no wumi wawo.
16 Mwi'zuwa lilyo, sunga ne wasilikale we nhumbula ye cilume-lume, wolotaga vitwalo vyawo vyo wulugu, no kutiza.” Muwaha Mulungu vyo yakutya.


Amosi 3

1 Muhulicizenyi nghani ayi, anye nyo wanhu wa Isilayeli yono Muwaha Mulungu yayilonga kuli'nye, anye nyo we likungugo lyose lyono yaliwusa ku Misili yakatya,
2 “Muli makungugo gose ga mono yinze, ane nghamumanyenyi nyenye no kumukamisenyi. Na yiyi yo yikuleka no wubi wenyu wukuwa wakogofya. Holeka nane yinojeye nimulipicizenyi so masutya genyu.”

Mulimo wo muwizi

3 Alu 'mbi wanhu wejete wosuma kujendana hamonga muhinzo lono siwalagane?
4 Hambi simba yikolomaga bwete du mu mbago, lono si yitujile mhelembo? Hamba nyana ye simba yikolomaga mu mwina wayo, lono si yibate cinji?
5 Hamba ndeje yigwilaga 'mbi mu cidoga, lono cidoga cisina cikocezo? No mutego nawo ma, wutegukaga 'mbi lono siwuteguywe na cinji?
6 Hamba ndulele yo wulugu ma, yotowa mu kaya, wanhu walece kogopa? Hamba nghani 'mbi ma, yosuma kwinjila mwi'kaya lono Muwaha Mulungu si yayitemizye?
7 U Muwaha siketumaga cinji co cose lono siyawagubuliye wetumami wakwe wawizi.
8 Lono simba yikukoloma, nani 'mbi mono si kebatwaga no woga? Na lono Muwaha yakulonga, alo nani mono kosuma kuleka kuyiganula inghani yakwe?

Wongomezwe wa Samaliya

9 Muwalonjele wawo wono wekaye mu makaya go wutemi, ge Misili na Ashidodi, muwatye, “Mwihangulize hamonga mu matunda gono gayipilime Samaliya nanye mowona wusagahale hamonga no wubi wono wukwitumwa mumo.”
10 Muwaha yakutya, “Wanhu awa, wakumevya mu zinhumba zawo vinhu vyo wuhizi no wuwulaji, hamba siwakumanya vyono yiwanojeye wawe wehuwila.
11 Holeka walugu woyipilima yisi yawo, no kugahodanga magomawakali gawo, no kuwaboka makaya gawo.”
12 Muwaha Mulungu yakutya, “Nha vyono mudimi kakugaga magulu mejete, hamba yikutu lye ngholo yono yaligwa ne simba, nhavivyo vyo wosigala wacefu du muli wanhu wa Samaliya, wono wakugona mu vitanda vye cinyemo-nyemo.
13 Alu muhulicize, mukawakaje wo lulelo lwa Yakobo zo yakutya, Muwaha Mulungu u Mulungu we Mihanga.
14 Mwi'zuwa lyono nolowalipiciziza wanhu wa Isilayeli so wubi wawo, nolovihodanga vikumbicilo vya Beteli. Ne zinhuzi zose ze cikumbicilo vyose zolobenangwa no kuga hasi.
15 Nane nolozihodanga zinyumba ze madaha ge cinyuli na ze madaha ge livuce. Ne zinyumba zo wihambo we meno ge zinhembo, zolokongomezwa ne zikaya zose zimbaha, zolohodanjicila lukulu.”


Amosi 4

1 Hulicizenyi zizi, anye nyo wacekulu wa Samaliya, mono mujinaga nhe zing'ombe za Bashani, mono mukuwatendela vibi wono wasoceye, no kuwewonela i waciwa, no kusaka walume zenyu wamupelenyi wujimbi we mawala gose mung'we.
2 Nha vyono Muwaha Mulungu mono yelile, yelahiza yakatya, “Lizuwa lyolokuza lono nolomukwejenyi ne ndobogo, na wose muli nyenye molowa nha somba mu cilowelo.
3 Nanye molokwegwa sunga behi na hono hamwaguywe mwi'jinji no kutagwa kunze.”

Waisilayeli walemegwa kwiyijiza

4 U Muwaha Mulungu yakutya, “Nye nyo Waisilayeli, ale, mubite hanhu hono helile mu Beteli muketume wubi, hono muwe munojeye! Mubite sunga sunga ko ku Giligali, muketume zo wubi mu nghango yono mukusaka nyenye nyo weneco. Kanyhi mujendelele ku wuleta nhondo zose hakali mitondo mitugo zenyu so likumbiko. Kanyhi nhondo zose mwi'zuwa lye kadatu, mweze kulavya zaka.
5 Mujendelele no kulavya mikate yenyu yo wulumbize kuli Mulungu, no kwilumbila mu vilavya vyono vizize ko winji vyono mukuleta! Ayi yo nghani yono anye mwendile kwituma.

6 “Nane yo nene mono naleta nzala mu makaya genyu gose, ninga hamba simwambuyila yaye.
7 Nane nghayimila mvula yilece kuvitonyela vilimwa vyenyu lono vilimwa vyayisakaga muno. Nghayitonyeza mvula mwi'kaya ali, na linji nghalizumha. Mvula yikatonya mu mugunda awu, ninga mugunda muyagwe wono vihegame, wukanyala.
8 Wanhu wakasocela so nyhilu, wanhu we makaya ganji wakabita mwi'kaya linji lyono wakwihwesa wotuga malenga, ninga hamba kuko kwali kusina gono gakukondya ku wung'we. Hamba nhavivyo si mwambuyila yaye.

9 “Nghayileta mbeho, yivinyaze vilimwa vyenyu. Ne zinzije zikalya migunda yenyu yose ne mizabibu, mikuyu yenyu hamonga ne mizeyituni. Ninga hamba simwambuyila yaye.
10 Nghamuletelenyi lihuhuji kotya nha lyono nategula ku Misili. Nghawawulaga i wazelelo wenyu ku wulugu, no kuzisola zifwalasi zenyu. Nghamevya munungho we mivimba ye wanhu wono wafwiye mu zimhula zenyu, mu zinghambi zenyu. Ninga hamba simwambuyila yaye.

11 “Nghawahodanga wanji muli'nye, nha vyono nayihodanga Sodoma na Gomola. Wawo wono wasigala muli'nye, wakawa nha cibici cinyanywe, cono ciponile ku wulawa mu moto. Ninga hamba simwambuyila yaye.” Vyo yakutya Muwaha Mulungu.
12 “Holeka anye nyo Waisilayeli, nane nomulipicizenyi. Holeka vyono nomunozezenyi zizi, ale nanye, mwiwikanizaje kuwitang'anila no wuling'anizi wangu!”
13 Mulungu yo yanoza matunda no kuwumba mbeho. Mwene kaganozaga mahweso gakwe, gamanyice kuli munhu. Kakawanizaga misi ciwa cilo, no kuhakanyaga hono henuce mu yinze. Ali lyo litagwa lyakwe, Muwaha Mulungu mono yali vilungo!


Amosi 5

Cililo ca Amosi

1 Muhulicize anye nyo Waisilayeli, lwimbo lwe maziko, lono nghumwimbilenyi!

2 U Mwana we cicekulu wa Isilayeli yakondya kugwa. Hamba sikokwinuka kanyhi! Yakondya kulekwa yagwiye hasi, Hasina hamba mono yakumwinusa.

3 Holeka Muwaha Mulungu yakutya, “Iikaya lya mu Isilayeli, lyotegula wasilikale elufu monga, ninga wowuya igana limonga du. Ne likaya linji nalyo, lyotegula wasililale yigana limonga, ninga wowuya yikumi limonga du.”
4 Muwaha Mulungu yakuwalonjela Waisilayeli, yakutya, “Muze kuli'ne, nanye mowumipa.
5 Mulece kubita kanyhi kuhemba ku Belisheba. Hamba mulece kujela kunondola ku Beteli. Hambi Beteli nha yolokwambuka bwete. Hamba mulece kubita ku Giligali, hambi wanhu wayo nha wolosolwa wategulwe ku wuwanda.”

6 Mumubitilaje Muwaha Mulungu, nanye mowumipa. Ninga hono mwikale simumubitiye, mwene komukongojezenyi ne likuwo lyakwe nha moto nyo Waisilayeli. Moto wolowanyanya ne wanhu wa Beteli, hasina hamba yunji mono kolosuma kuwuzimya.
7 Woyi he kuli'nye. Anye mono muyikawaniza ling'ani no kuwawusiza wanhu ling'ani yawo!

8 Muwaha Mulungu mono yanoza zinyelezi ne cilimila ne mwacinghunghu. Kapitusaga citi ciwa wuzelu, ne misi ciwa cilo. Kacemaga malenga ga mwi'lenga no kugamwaga kunze mu yisi litagwa lyakwe Muwaha Mulungu.
9 Kaletaga wuhodanjice muli wawaha, na muli wanhu wawo we vilungo.

10 Anye wanhu mumusulile mono kawatacilaga wono si wali ling'ani, mono kulongaga mbeka yose ha mahakama.
11 Mukuwatema i waciwa no kuwahiziza wuhemba wawo. Na ku soko yiyo nanye simokwikala mu zikaya ziswanu zono muzenjile ne mabwe maswanu, hamba kung'wa divayi yono yikulawa mu zizabibu zenyu ziswanu zono mulimile.
12 Hambi nane nha manyile vyono wubi wenyu wukogofya hamonga ne masutya genyu vyono menji, gono muwituma. No kuwewonela wanhu we ling'ani. Mukubocela mafupo, no kwimila i ling'ani ye waciwa, yono wakuyituga mu mahakama.
13 Holeka, u wukanganizi wa mu vidaha vye zimbali, yo nghani swanu muno ku witume.
14 Munoze wuhile wenyu, wuwe kwituma zono zili ling'ani, hamba si zimbi yaye, holeka mokwikala womi. No Muwaha Mulungu we mihanga, kowa hamonga nanye nha vyono mwihuwiye, vyono, mwene yali baho.
15 Musule zimbi, mwende ziswanu no kwituma ze ling'ani mu mahakama. Nha lunji Muwaha Mulungu we mihanga kowa no lusungu kuli wanhu we likungugo lili, wono wakali wasigaye womi.

16 Holeka Muwaha Mulungu we mihanga yakutya, “Kolowa kocili cililo co wusungu, mu zinzila za mwi'kaya. Na wono wakulima, wolocemwa waze wamulilile mono yafwiye, hamonga na wawo wono wakulipwa ho walile citalo.
17 Kolowa na cililo mu migunda yose ye mizabibu. Azi zose zolokwijela ku soko, ane nghuza nimuling'anizenyi.” Vyo yakutya Muwaha Mulungu.
18 Wolowa wogofye wuwaha kuli'nye mono mukusulumila lizuwa lyo Muwaha Mulungu! Kolowa kowuli wuswanuci kuli'nye mwi'zuwa lilyo? Hambi kuli'nye nha lyolowa lizuwa lye citi, hamba si lya wuzelu yaye.
19 Yolowa nha munhu mono yakumangha yakutiza simba, no kwitang'anila ne dubu! Hamba yolowa nha munhu mono yakwinjila mukaya, no kwegamika muwoko mwijinji, nzoka yiwa muluma!
20 Lizuwa lyo Muwaha Mulungu, lyololeta citi hamba si wuzelu yaye. Lyolowa yizuwa lya wutitu wuwaha, lyono lisina hamba wuzelu bwete.
21 Muwaha Mulungu yakutya, “Ane singhwendezwa ne zi sikukuu zenyu zo wuhembi, hamba sinosuma kuzikangalila yaye!
22 Hamba mundavizye vilavywa vinyanye na vyo 'saje, ane sinovibocela yaye, sinozibocela hamba ne zimitugo zenyu zono zijinile zono mukundavizya.
23 Mulece kunzozeza 'ne, ne zinyimbo zenyu, nane singhusaka kuwuhuliciza hamba no mulilo we masumbi genyu.
24 Langa muwulece wiling'ano wuhulume kotya muvwilo, ne ling'ani kotya likolongo lyono silinyalaga.
25 Anye nyo Waisilayeli, ane sinasaka makumbiko ne vilavywa vyenyu, lono nawalongoza mu nyika mu myaka makumi mane.
26 Alu ninga vyono mwavihemba ivihwani vye milungu vya Sakuti, mulungu wo mutemi wenyu, no mulungu wa Kayiwani, mulungu we nyelezi, molosoleleza vihwani vivyo,
27 kolo neza kumutegulenyi ku wuwanda, ku nhumbi ya Damesiki,” vyo yakutya Muwaha Mulungu, mono litagwa lyakwe, Mulungu we Mihanga.


Amosi 6

Wongomele we Waisilayeli

1 Yolowa nghani ya kogofya muno, kuli 'nye mono mwina mikalile miswanu nhavi mu Siyoni, na kuli nye mono mukwihwesa nha mwikaye mupolile mu Samaliya, anye mo wanhu wawaha mu nghungugo mbaha ya Isilayeli, anye mono wanhu wa Isilayeli wakuwa kumuzizenyi wakulondola wutazi kuli'nye!
2 Mubite mulanje ta mwikaya lya Kaline. Hamba mwi'kaya liwaha lya Hamati, sunga ko kwi'kaya lya Gati, mu yisi ye Wafilisiti. Wulenyi, wena cinji cono cicizize wutemi wa Yuda na Isilayeli? Hamba yisi yawo, wuwaha wayo wucicize yisi yenyu?
3 Anye mono si mukwenda kuvumila vyono lizuwa libi lyokuza, ninga zizo zono mukwituma, zo zikulisejeleza behi lizuwa lilyo.
4 Magu, 'mba yolowa wogofyeci kuli'nye, mono mukugona mu vitanda vyenyu vye cinyemo-nyemo vyono vihambigwe ne meno ga nhembo, akuno mukulya zisikukuu ze zinyama ze zing'ombe, hamonga na ze zingholo za mwi'tewa!
5 Anye mono mwendile kutula zinyimbo, nha vyono Dawudi yanoza, no kwimba hamonga ne mazi ge masumbi.
6 Anye mono mukung'wela divayi mu zibakuli, hamonga no kwibaka mafuta ge mhunjile swanu muno muno, hamba simukulila so wongomezwe we Waisilayeli.
7 Holeka mowa walongozi kubita ku wuhamywe. Ne zisikukuu zenyu, hamonga ne indigwa ze cinyemo-nyemo, vyose vyoloduma.

8 Muwaha Mulungu we mihanga yo yacipelile wulajilize wo wukagwe, yakutya, “Nane siniwendile widunhumuzi we wanhu wa Isilayeli. Kanyhi nizibedegaye muno ne zikaya zawo ze cinyemo-nyemo. Holeka nowapela walugu wawo likaya lyawo liwaha hamonga ne vinhu vyose vyono vili mumo.”
9 Nahono hawe ho wali wanhu yikumi wono wasigaye mu mhuga, nawo wolofwa.
10 Na munya ndugu wo munhu mono yafwiye, hamonga no mwimilizi we maziko, kolo wakuwulavya muwili wa malehemu kunze ye kaya ho wakawuzice, wolokwamula waceme, kuli mono yakali yasigaye mukaya wawe kutya, “Wule ko yuli munhu yunji mono yakali yasigaye hamonga nagwe mumo mu kaya?” Ne lizi lyopitula litye, “Aa! Ng'o.” Nayo munya ndugu kotya, “Hodu wanyamale twii! Hambi nha yicinojeye cilanjilile cilece kulitambula litagwa lyo Muwaha Mulungu.”

11 Lono Muwaha Mulungu yakulavya lilajilizo, zinyumba zimbaha ne zindodo obenanjika tici tici.
12 Wule! Zifwalasi zomangha mu canyha ye matalawe? Ma! Wanhu walimaga ne zing'ombe mwi'lenga? Ninga anye mwayipitula ling'ani, yawa sumu, ne mbeka nayo yawa yisutya.
13 Anye mono mukwilumba so wibata likaya lya Lodeba, mukwilumba mukutya, “Ase cali cili vilungo, lanje vyono cikasuma kulisola likaya lya Kalinayimu.”
14 Ninga Muwaha Mulungu we mihanga mweneco yakutya, “Anye nyo Waisilayeli, ane nowaleta wasilikale we likungugo lye cijenzi, wayisole yisi yenyu, nawo womugazenyi wulawa ku Hamati ku winjililo wa kusumuka, sunga ko ku cikolongo ca Alaba, mhelo ya kutakama.”


Amosi 7

Wulajilwe we ning'aniza

Wulajilwe wulongozi: zinzije

1 Nane nghatuga wulajilwe ku wulawa kuli Muwaha Mulungu. Muli zizo, nghamuwona yakuwumba yitewa lya nzije lono u mulimo wo kutema mahanze go mutemi, go kulisa zing'ombe zakwe wali wakondya, ne lihanze lyali lyanza kuwiluka kanyhi.
2 Mu wulajilwe wuwo, nghawona nzije zikulya vinhu vyose vyono videdewaye mu'si. Nane hanyuma nghatya, “Gwe Muwaha Mulungu nghukunena, uwanenelaje wanhu wako! Alu wanhu wako ho wowumipa vye wule? Hambi nha wacefu, kanyhi wasoceye!”
3 Hodu Muwaha Mulungu yakakawaniza nghani yiyo no kutya. “Azi zono wuziwene, hodu sizokwijela yaye.”

Wulajilwe we kejete: Moto

4 Nane nghatuga wulajilwe wunji kanyhi, ku wulawa kuli Muwaha Mulungu. Muli wuwo, nghamuwona mwene yakwiwikaniza yawongomeze wanhu wakwe ko moto. No moto wuwo wukalinyanya lilenga liwaha ku'si ye'si, kanyhi wukawa kwanza uyinyanya ne yisi.
5 Nane nghatya, “Gwe Muwaha Mulungu! Nghukunena wuwanenelaje wanhu wako! Alu wanhu wako u lulelo lwa Yakobo ho wowumipa vye wule?” Hambi nha wacefu kanyhi wasoceye!
6 Hodu Muwaha Mulungu yakakawaniza kanyhi nghani yiyo no kutya, “Nghani yiyi nayo, hodu si yowa yaye.”

Wulajilwe we kadatu: Cipimilo

7 Nane nghatuga wulajilwe wunji kanyhi, ku wulawa kuli Muwaha Mulungu. Muli wuwo, nghamuwona mwene Mulungu, yali yemile behi ne lijinji, lyono lyali lizenjigwe ko wutazi we cipimilo, ne cipimilo cali cili mu muwoko wakwe.
8 Hodu Muwaha Mulungu yakambuza yakatya, “Amosi, wukuwona cici?” Nane nghamupitula nghatya, “Nghuwona cipimilo.” Nayo yakanyitya, “Ane nghwitumamila cipimilo cici, kulajila vyono wanhu wangu wenha lijinji lyono si ligoloce libinuce, yono lili kunze yo mucilili. Holeka nane sinokawaniza yaye wuhile wangu kanyhi, wo kusaka kuwongomeza wene.
9 Ne hanhu hono lulelo lwa Isaka wahembelaga, naho holo kongomezwa. Ne hanhu hose hono helile ha Isilayeli, holekwa matongo du. Nane noloyidumya ne mhuga yo mutemi Yelobowamu.”

Amosi na Amaziya

10 Amaziya u mukohani wa Beteli, yakamutegulila zinghani Yelobowamu, u mutemi wa Isilayeli, yakutya, “Amosi yakutajila nghani za wusonjezi muli wanhu wa Isilayeli. No wulonje wakwe wohodanga yisi.
11 Hambi mwene nha yakulonga yakutya, ‘Yelobowamu kolofwila ku wulugu, ne wanhu wa Isilayeli wolosolwa ku wulawa ku yisi yawo, wategulwe kutali nha wawopwe.’ ”
12 Nayo Amaziya yakamulonjela Amosi yakatya, “Gwe go muwizi, hodu zakondya, alu, wuwuye ko ku Yuda, wukaganule luganuzi lwako kuko. Nawo wokulisa so mulimo wuwo.
13 Ninga wulece kuwila kanyhi ahano hono Beteli. Hambi aha, nha ho hanhu hono mutemi kahembelaga ho ha wuhembelo we likungugo.”

14 Amosi yakapitula yakamutya Amaziya, “Ane si nili muwizi we, liwala lye wawizi wono wakuwila ho walipwe. Ane nili mudima mitugo kanyhi nili mulanjilizi we mikuyu.
15 Ninga Muwaha Mulungu, yasola ane ku wulawa mu mulimo wangu wo wudimi, no kunhuma nize kuwila kuli wanhu wakwe Isilayeli.
16 Holeka alu, wuhulicize vyono Muwaha Mulungu yakutya. Agwe wukunyitya vyono ndece kulavya wuwizi hamba kuganula kuli Waisilayeli.
17 Holeka lu agwe Amaziya. Muwaha Mulungu yakutya kuli'gwe, ‘U mugolece wako, kowa musenyha mumuno mwikaya lili, ne wanago nawo walume ne wacekulu, wolowulagwa ku wulugu. Ne yisi yako nayo, yologawilwa wanji. Nagwe go mweneco, kolofwila mu yisi yo wavufywe. Ne Waisilayeli, mbeka wolosolwa no kuwuswa mu yisi yawo, wategulwe ku yisi yo wujenzi.’ ”


Amosi 8

Wulajilwe we kane: Nhoto ye mikalo

1 Kanyhi nghalajilwa ku wulawa kuli Muwaha Mulungu we mihanga. Muli wuwo nghawona nhoto yono yina mikalo.
2 Muwaha Mulungu yakambuza yakatya, “Amosi, wukuwona cici?” Nane nghamupitula nghatya, “Nghuwona nhoto ye mikalo.” Muwaha Mulungu yakanyitya, “U mudumo we wanhu wangu Isilayeli, wakondya kuza. Nane sinokawaniza yaye wuhile wangu wo kuwongomeza wene.
3 Na mwi'zuwa lilyo zinyimbo za mu kaya yo wutemi, zolowa vililo vyo wusungu wuwaha. Ne miwili ye wanhu wono wafwiye, yolowa yiyagaye caka hanhu hose. Hamba lizozo si lilahulikwa yaye.”

Mulungu koyongomeza Isilayeli

4 Muhulicize zizi anye mono mukuwewonela i waciwa, no kujela kuwongomeza i waciwa wa mu'si.
5 Mukutya nyo weneco, “Colindila sunga kolo vyapuluta i vilo vye ndawo yo mwezi, ho cosuma kuguza vilimwa vyetu. Alu sabato yomalika nili nase ho cisume kwanza kuguza kanyhi? Hambi baho nha colosuma kuguza na kumhelo, mu nzila yo kwitumila vipimo vyo wulambi, no kuvipitula vipimilo, ho ciwahizize wanyo kugula.
6 Na baho ho colosuma kuguza ngano yono si swanu ko wuguzi wuwaha. Nase comutuga munhu muciwa, mono sikosuma kulipa mugawa wakwe, hamba kulipa wuguzi we vilatu bwete, nase baho comugula yawe muwanda.”
7 Muwaha Mulungu we Waisilayeli yelahiza yakutya, “Hamba sinosemwa i metumo gawo mabi.
8 Na ku soko yiyo, holeka yisi yocicima, ne wanhu wose wa mu'si yose, wowa mu wugaye. Ne yisi yose yolosinjisika; yolokwibuka no kung'welela, nhe likolongo lye Nile ku Misili.
9 I cipango cikuza lono nilanoza lizuwa ligwile, lono yikali misi. Ne yisi yolotukuwala mwi'zuwa lilyo. Nene, no Muwaha Mulungu vyo nghutya.
10 Nolopitula zi sikukuu zenyu ziwe wukalale, ne zinyimbo zenyu ze nyemo ziwe cililo no wusungu. Nolomunozenyi munyonyole mitwe yenyu, no kuvwala magunila. Nanye molowa nha walezi wono wakulila so mwana wawo monga we cilume. Ne lizuwa lilyo, lyolowa lya wusungu sunga ko ku mudumo wayo.

11 “Ne cipango cikuza lono nilaleta nzala mu'si, wanhu wolowa na nzala, ninga si nzala ya ndigwa, kanyhi wolowa na nyhilu, ninga si nyhilu ya malenga. Langa wolowa na nzala ne nyhilu so nghani yono yikulawa kuli Muwaha Mulungu. Nane yo nene no Muwaha Mulungu mono nghutya.
12 Ne wanhu wolopilima-pilima, ku wulawa kwi'lenga alino sunga ko kwilenga alino, na kanyhi, ku wulawa lubavu lwa kusumuka, sunga ko ku lubavu lwa kucilima, wolomangha no kubita ako na ako wakuyilondola nghani yo Muwaha Mulungu, ninga hamba siwalayituga ng'o.
13 Mwi'zuwa lilyo wazelelo ne wahinza waswanu, wolozilika so nyhilu.
14 Na wono welahilaga vihwani vye milungu vye Samaliya, wono watezaga, ‘Ko mulungu wako Dani,’ hamba, ‘Ko mulungu wa Belisheba!’ Wanhu wawo wologwa, na hamba si wolokwinuka kanyhi yaye.”


Amosi 9

Wuling'anizi wo Muwaha Mulungu

1 Nane namuwona Muwaha Mulungu yemile ha cikumbicilo. Yakanyitya, “Wutowe mu midumo ye masumbili gono gawukamizye wuhembelo, ne likumbo lyose lyosinjisika. Nagwe wugabenanjize no kugaleka gawagwile wanhu mu mitwe ye wanhu. Ne wanhu wono wasigaye ku wulugu ane nolowawulaga no mumaje. Hasina hamba munhu monga mono yalatiga, hamba yumonga mono yalapona muli wene.
2 Hamba wahimbe nzila zawo hasi, sunga zifice ko ku yinze ye wafu. Ane nowebata du. Hamba wabite ko ku wulanga, ane nowatimya hasi.
3 Hamba nha wehundice ku cizuli ce litunda lya Kalimeli, ane nowalondola sunga niwebate. Hono wehundice mu visolo vye lilenga, nolilajiliza lilimu liwaha lya mwilenga liwalume.
4 Na hono wasolwe wawopwe ne walugu wawo, nowalonjela wawo walugu wawo wawawulaje. Nane hamba si nowataza yaye, anga ndumuye nghani niwongomeze du.”

5 Muwaha Mulungu we mihanga kayipamizaga yisi,

nayo yinze yiwa kucicima,

na wose wono wekaye mumo wolila.

Ne yinze yose yolokwibuka no kug'welela kotya

nhe likolongo lye Nile ku Misili.

6 Muwaha Mulungu kazengaga wikalo wakwe ku wulanga,

no kuwika misinji yo mwanya mono'si.

Mwene kacemaga malenga

ge lilenga no kugakupa mu'si,

Muwaha Mulungu, lye 'tagwa lyakwe!

7 Muwaha Mulungu yakutya, “Nye nyo Waisilayeli, ane nghuwehwesa wanhu wa Etiyopiya, nha vyono nghumwihwesenyi nyenye. Ane nawatonga Wafilisiti, ku wulawa ku Kilete, nawo Waashuli, ku wulawa ku Kili, nha vyono namutonjenyi 'nye ku wulawa ku Misili.
8 Nane yo nene Muwaha Mulungu, mono nghuwulanga wutemi wa Isilayeli, wono wina wubi, nane nowongomezeza lukulu mono yinze. Ninga hamba nhavivyo si nolongomeza lulelo lose lwa Yakobo.

9 “Langa nolavya wulajilize no kuwapemenha wanhu wa Isilayeli, nha vyono wapemenhaga wuhemba mu luheneko. Nowapemenha wene, ku wulawa mu makungugo, no kuwawusa wose wono wasina cambuzi.
10 Na wanyo wubi wa muli wanhu wangu, wolowulagwa ku wulugu, na wose wono wakutya, ‘Mulungu sikoleka zimbi zicagane.’ ”

Mhonelo yono yowaziza Waisilayeli

11 Muwaha Mulungu yakutya, “Lizuwa likuza lyono ane nolowusimya wutemi wa Dawudi, wono winha kaya yono yigwiye so wongomezwe. Nolonozeleza majinji gose gono gamwaguka, no kugasimya kanyhi. Noloyizenga no kuyinoza yiwe nha vyono yali katali.
12 Holeka wanhu wa Isilayeli, wolowatema i wanhu wono wali wasigaye mu yisi ya Edomu, na wa muli makungugo gose wono ku wulawa ha mwamulizo wali wangu.” Vyo yakutya Muwaha mono kolozinoza zizi zijele.
13 Muwaha Mulungu yakutya,

“Ivilo vikuza.

Lono vilimwa vilawiluka musunho kuciza

mu nghango yono vyowa vyisumice ku wududule

ne zizabibu zolowiluka mbela mbela kuciza

mu nghango yono divayi yikusuma kunozwa,

ne matunda golosuluza divayi swanu,

ne vigongo vyose vyolosipa divayi.

14 Nane nolowagomola

wanhu wangu sunga ko ku yisi yawo.

Wolozenga makaya gawo

gono gahodangwa no kwikala mumo,

wolopanha migunda ye mizabibu

no kung'wa divayi wolopanha migunda

no kulya vilimwa vyono walimile.

15 Nane nolowagomola no kuwawika wanhu wangu, mu'si yono nawapela,

hamba si wolowuswa kanyhi yaye.”

Muwaha Mulungu,

u Mulungu wenyu, vyo yakutya.


Obadiya 1

1 Awuno wo wugubulilwe wa Obadiya, wa zono Muwaha Mulungu yazilonga kuli likungugo lya Edomu.

Muwaha Mulungu koyilipiciza Edomu

U Muwaha Mulungu yamutegula mutumwa wakwe

kuli makungugo,

nase cayihulika i nghani yakwe,

yakutya, “Ale, wiwikanizaje!

Cibite cikayihome Edomu!”

2 Nayo Muwaha Mulungu yakutya kuli Edomu,

“Ane nokunoza wuwe wusina vilungo,

na wose wokusekanga.

3 Hambi wiwoni wako nha wakukonga,

mono wikaye mwi'kaya liwaha

lyono lipilimwe ne magomawakali ge mabwe,

wikalo wako wono wuli mucanyha ye matunda,

holeka go mweneco wukutya,

‘Nani 'mbi mono kosuma kunhimya hasi?’

4 Hamba wuwunoze wikalo wako

wuwe kucanyha nhe nhuli lye 'ndi,

ho yijele kotya nha wuli hamonga ne zinyelezi,

ninga hamba nhavivyo,

ane nokutimya du ho hasi.

5 “Ne wahizi lono wakuza ne cilo,

wasolaga vyono wendile weneco,

na lono wanhu wakududula zabibu,

wasigazaga nyhefu zo kuhalaliza.

Ninga i walugu wako wakondya kugongomezeza lukulu.

6 Nanye wo lulelo lwa Esawu,

zisawo zenyu zakondya kuhizwa.

7 I wanhu wono mwalagana,

wamukongajenyi, alu lanje,

wakondya kumuwusenyi mu wulawa mu yisi yenyu.

Wo wanhu wono mwekalanaga nawo viswanu,

ninga luno wamusumajenyi.

Wawo wono mwali mwiyendile,

mukulizana hamonga nawo,

alu wamuwicilajenyi mutego,

nawo wakumulonjenyi wakutya,

‘Alu vilungo vili hayi vyono wali wena navyo?’

8 Na mwi'zuwa lyono noloyilipiciziza Edomu,

nolowahodanga i wanhu wawo we citung'ati,

kanyhi nololuwusiza lukulu no wizuce wawo.

9 Ne wanhu vitung'ati wo wulugu

wono wali ku Temani,

wolokogofywa muno muno,

ne wasilikale wose wono wali mu Edomu,

wolowulagwa.”

Soko yono yoleka Edomu yilipicizwe

10 “Kolipicizwa agwe Edomu,

ku soko vyono wali wuli muhizi,

kanyhi wukawawulaga sunga ne wanduguzo,

i wana wa Yakobo,

holeka nagwe luno kohodangwa

no kuwembulilwa lukulu cibitilila.

11 Na mwi'zuwa lilyo,

agwe wali wimile ha mhelo,

lono walugu wabenela i malango gawo.

Na gwegwe wali wuli yumonga na wawo wajenzi,

wono wayipumha sawo ya Yelusalemi,

no kugawana weneco wose.

12 Holeka si wali wunojeye wuwasece

i wanduguzo wono wali mu Yuda

ku soko yo wugaye wawo.

Hamba kuwa no wusangalale

mwi'zuwa lyawo lyo wugaye.

Hamba kuwasekanga ku soko yo wugaye wawo.

13 Hamba si yali yikunojeye

winjile mwi'kaya lye wanhu wangu,

wuwasimanjile mu magayo gawo,

no kusola zo wugoli wawo mwi'zuwa

lyo wongomezwe wawo.

14 Hamba si yali yikunojeye wime

ha nzila malekano,

ho wuwebate wawo wono wakuhila kutiza.

Hamba si yali yikunojeye wuwawice

mu miwoko ye walugu,

mwi'zuwa lyo wongomezwe wawo.”

Mulungu kologaling'aniza i makungugo

15 “Lizuwa lyasejelela lyono ane,

no Muwaha Mulungu nologaling'aniza makungugo gose.

Nagwe Edomu zizo zono wetuma,

zo zizo zono kolonozezwa

na gwegwe nhavivilya.

Nagwe zolokuwuyila zizilya du

zono wawanozeza wanji.”

16 Wanhu wangu wakang'wa cikombe

co wusungu wo wuling'anizwe,

mucanyha ye litunda lyangu lyono lyelile.

Ninga imakungugo gose gono gapilime,

golong'wa cikombe co wusungu

cono cicizize co wuling'anizwe,

wolocing'wa wose no kwajililila lukulu.

Wusume we Waisilayeli

17 “Ninga mwi'tunda lya Sayuni,

wanji wolopona.

Na ho baho,

holowa hanhu hono helile.

Ne wanhu wa Yakobo wolokwikala mu yisi,

yisi yono yo ling'ani yawo.

18 Wanhu wa Yakobo ne wanhu wa Yusufu,

wolowa nha moto,

wolowahodanga wanhu wa Esawu kotya

nha moto wono wukutakamiza lisici.

Nawo wo lulelo lwa Esawu,

hasina hamba monga mono yalasigala.

Ane no Muwaha Mulungu vyo nghutya.

19 “Wanhu wa ku Yuda ya kutakama,

woloyisola Edomu,

nawo wono wololawa

ku lubavu lwa kumwezi mu vitunda,

woloyisola yisi ye Wafilisiti.

Nawo Waisilayeli woloyitema

yisi ya Efulayimu ne yisi ya Samaliya,

i wanhu wa Benyamini nawo,

woloyisola Gileyadi.

20 Ne lipuga lya wono wasolwa wakahamywa

ku wulawa Isilayeli ya kusumuka,

nawo wolowuya no kuyitema Foyinike,

sunga ko kusumuka kutali,

ku Zelefati.

Na wono wahamywa ku wulawa Yelusalemi,

wawo wono wali Sefaladi,

wologasola makaya ga Yuda ya kutakama.

21 Wanhu wo wusume wa Yelusalemi,

woloyihoma Edomu no kuyitema.

No Muwaha Mulungu mweneco,

kolowa yo mutemi.”


Yona 1

Yona yakujela kumutiza Muwaha Mulungu

1 Lizuwa linji, nghani yo Muwaha Mulungu, yikamuziza Yona mwana wa Amitayi.

2 Yikutya, “Wubite ku Ninawi, kwi'kaya alilya liwaha, wukalilonjele nha vyono, nakondya kuwumanya u wubi we wanhu wayo vyono winha.”
3 Ninga Yona yakatuluka, ho yamutize Muwaha Mulungu. Yakabita ko ku Yopa, na kuko yakagana ngalawa yono yabitaga ku Talishishi. Yakalipa mu nghango ye nawuli yo kubitila, ho yabitane nawo ku Talishishi, i hanhu hono kosuma kuwa kutali no Muwaha Mulungu.
4 Ninga Muwaha Mulungu yakaleta mbeho yo mukukunzo mwi'lenga, no mukukunzo wukawa muwaha muno, sunga ne ngalawa yikasaka no kupanduka.
5 Hobaho wanye ngalawa nawo wakogopa, na wose wakanza kulila munhu na lwakwe kuli mulungu wakwe mweneco, ho watuje wutazi. Wakawa kuyigumila mwi'lenga sawo yono wali wena nayo, ho wayipelumhye ngalawa, watuje wutazi wo kupona mu mbali yono yali yili ha mwande yawo. Na mwi'daha lilyo, mwene Yona yali yagonile nhongo du mu cumba ca kusi ye ngalawa.

6 Nayo muwaha we ngalawa yakamwagana kuko, yakamutya, “Alu 'gwe Yona, nhawule wugonile? Winukaje wumulombe Mulungu wako yacitaze, lunji kociwonela lusungu cilece kwajilila.”

7 Wono wali wali mu ngalawa, wakalongana weneco wose wakutya, “Muze cipugule, cimumanye mono yakucambuza cinjile mu mbali yiyi.” Wali weza pugula, mhugu yikamugwila Yona.
8 Baho wakamutya, “Gwe Yona, wucilonjelaje ta! Alu nani mono cimuhosaje mu nghani yiyi? Na kanyhi agwe wukunozaci bahano? Na kanyhi wukulawilila 'sici? Ne yisi yako yisici? Na wuli munhu we nghungugoci?”

9 Nayo Yona yakawatya, “Ane nili Muhebelaniya. Ane nimuhembaga Muwaha Mulungu, u Mulungu wa ku wulanga, mono yanoza yisi nghavu ne lilenga.”
10 Yona yakawalonjela vyono yakutiza hali Muwaha Mulungu.

Ne wanhu wose wono wali wali mu ngalawa wakogopa muno, wakamutya, “Alu yo nghanici waco yiyi yono witumile?”
11 Ne mawingo gakacila muno kuyumba cipango cose ku soko ye libeho, nawo wakamuwuza wakatya, “Alu cikutendele wule ho lilenga litule?”

12 Yona yakawatya, “Mungumilaje mwi'lenga, nalyo lilenga lyotula. Hambi nha manyile vyono lisutya lyangu nene, lyo likuleka mukwinjila mu mbali yiyi yo wuyumvywe ne mbeho yiyi.”

13 Ninga wene mu hanhu ho kumugumila Yona mwi'lenga, wakajela kuyikwejela ngalawa ku mhwani, ninga wakafutigwa. Hambi lilenga nha lyali lyacila kuwayumvya, hamba siwatuga yaye ha wutizizo.
14 Baho wakamulomba Muwaha Mulungu wakatya, “Gwe Muwaha Mulungu cikukulomba, wulece kuciwulaga ku soko yo munhu ayu Yona, mono ceza kumuwulaga! Hambi 'gwe Muwaha Mulungu nha kunozaga nha vyono gwegwe wendile, na vyose nha vyako.”
15 Hobaho wakamusola Yona, wakamugumila mwi'lenga, nalyo lilenga hobaho likawa kutula.
16 Na ku soko ya zizo, wanhu wono wali wali mu ngalawa, wakamogopa u Muwaha Mulungu muno muno. Wakamulavizya Muwaha Mulungu likumbiko, wakawa kuwika ne cipingo co kumwitumamila.

17 Nayo Muwaha Mulungu yakalilajiliza lisomba liwaha likamumela Yona, na Yona yakekala munda ye lisomba vilo vidatu misi ne cilo.


Yona 2

Wulombe wa Yona

1 Yona yakamulomba Muwaha Mulungu wakwe,

ku wulawa mugati ye lilenga mu'nda ye lisomba,

2 yakatya, “Mu magayo gangu,

'gwe Muwaha Mulungu,

ane nghakucema, nagwe wukamhitula.

Na ku wulawa mugati ku yinze ye wafu,

ane nghakulilila so wutazi,

nagwe wukahulika.

3 Hambi 'gwe nha wanhajila

mu cisolo mwi'lenga mugati,

hanhu hono malenga gamhilime mbavu zose,

ne mawingo gako ge vilungo

no wuyumba-yumbe wose,

wukukola mucanyha yangu.

4 Ane nghwihwesa

nha vyono nakondya kuwuka

ku wulawa ha mwande yako,

hamba sinosuma yaye kuwuwona

no wuhembelo wako kanyhi.

5 Malenga nha gangubika,

sunga no kwehela kose,

hamba si nghusuma yaye,

ne lilenga lyakondya kumhilima,

sunga ne malungwi gayo,

gandawiliza mu mutwe wangu.”

6 Ane nadodomela sunga hasi ye matunda,

sunga ku yisi ye wafu,

yono i milango yayo midindwe cibitilila.

“Ninga agwe, go Muwaha Mulungu wangu,

wambusa nili mumi ku wulawa

mu visolo mono nikaye.

7 Ne nhumbula yangu yali yeza kuzilika,

ane nghakulomba gwegwe go Muwaha Mulungu,

nagwe wukahulika mu wulawa mu Nyumba yako.

8 Nawo wono wakuyihemba milungu

ye vihwani yono yisina cambuzi,

wakondya kuwuleka u wihuwilwa wawo kuli'gwe.

9 Ninga ane nokwimbila gwegwe lwimbo lo lukumyo,

nokulavizya ne likumbiko,

kanyhi nokwituma nha vyono nehuwiza.

Hambi mhonelo nha yikulawa kuli Muwaha Mulungu!”

10 Hobaho u Muwaha Mulungu yakalilajiliza

lisomba likamudece Yona,

nalyo likawa kubita kumudeka mu yisi nghavu.


Yona 3

Yona yakutyatya wulajlize wo Muwaha Mulungu

1 Baho kanyhi, Muwaha Mulungu yakalonga na Yona.
2 Yakamutya, “Ale wubite ku Ninawi, kwi'kaya alilya liwaha, wukawalonjele i wanhu zinghani zono nghupeye.”
3 Lulo nhondo, Yona yakamuhulika u Muwaha Mulungu, yakawa kubita ku Ninawi. Likaya lyali yiwaha muno muno, yajenda mugati yalyo vilo vidatu.
4 Yona yali yeza kwinjila mwi'kaya, muhinzo we zuwa limonga, yakanza kuwalonjela yakutya, “Kolo vikupuluta vilo makumi mane, Ninawi yokongomezwa!”

5 Nawo i wanhu wa Ninawi wakehuwila i nghani yo Mulungu. Holeka wakawa kulamula nha vyono wanhu wose walece kulya, ne wanhu wose, ku wulawa wanhu mututu, sunga ne wadodo wose wavwale magunila, ho walajile nha vyono wakondya kunena.

6 Nayo mutemi wa Ninawi, yali yeza kuzihulika zizo, yakenuka ku wulawa mwi'goda lyakwe lyo wutemi, yakavula vivwalo vyakwe, yakawa kuvwala magunila, yakawa kwikala hasi mu mavu.
7 Yakawa kwanza nghani kuli wanhu wose wa Ninawi, yakutya, “Awu wo wulajilize wono wukulawa kuli mutemi na kuli wanyamhala wakwe, nha vyono, ‘Munhu wo wose yalece kulya cinji, wanhu wose sunga ne zing'ombe zose, ne zingholo, zilece kulya hamba kung'wa malenga yaye.’
8 Wanhu wose yiwanojeye wavwale magunila, sunga ne mitugo nazo nhavivyo. Kanyhi yiwanojeye wose munhu na lwakwe, yalombe ko winenenyhezi kuli Mulungu, no kupituka no kuleka metumo gakwe mabi.
9 Nha lunji Mulungu kowukawaniza wuhile wakwe, lunji kolileka likuwo lyakwe, nase ho cilece kufwa!”

10 Nayo Muwaha Mulungu yakawona vyono wanozize, na vyono waleka ze metumo gawo mabi. Hobaho nayo yakawa kuwukawaniza wuhile wakwe wo kuwalipiciza, holeka si yawalipiciza nha vyono yali yehwesize.


Yona 4

Yona yakuwukolelwa likuwo lusungu lo Mulungu

1 Ninga Yona siyayisangalalila nghani yiyo, yakawa kukolwa ne likuwo.
2 Yakawa kulomba yakutya, “Muwaha Mulungu, nghani ayi, si yo nghani yono nalonga lono nali nghali nawuka mu yisi yangu, nha vyono azi zo kokwituma? Kanyhi co caleka nghawa kutiziza ku Talishishi!” Hambi nha nali manyile vyono agwe wumemile lihewa, kanyhi wuli Mulungu wo lusungu, kanyhi si kusimbaga mbela, na nhondo zose agwe wiwikanize kuwukawaniza wuhile wako no kuleka kulipiciza.
3 Holeka 'gwe Muwaha Mulungu, wundekaje ane nifwe. Hambi nha viswanu nifwe si nha kwikala mumi.

4 Muwaha Mulungu yakamupitula Yona yakamutya, “Alu mwene wukwihwesa vyono, hono wukukolwa likuwo wukunoza viswanu?”
5 Yona yakawa kutuluka, yakawa kubita ku lubavu lwe cilima ye likaya, yakawa kwikala hasi. Yakenozeza cibanda, yakekala mu mubeho wayo, akuno yalindiye cono cokwijela ku Ninawi.
6 Lo lulolulo nayo Muwaha Mulungu yakacindya cilimwa, naco cikawiluka cikawa kumucita Yona, cikamupela Yona mubeho. Na ku soko yiyo Yona yakatuga wusangalale so wuwo mubeho. Lulo Yona yakendezwa no kusecelela muno so cilimwa cico.
7 Ninga lizuwa lye kejete, Mulungu yakategula ying'onyo he sina lye cilimwa likawa kucidumula cilimwa, naco cikawa kunyala.
8 Yikawa lizuwa lyali lyeza kuwalika, Mulungu yakawa kutegula mbeho ya kucilima yono yina livuce liwaha muno, na Yona yakawa kuzilika so wukali we lizuwa, lyono lyali lyamutowa muno mu mutwe wakwe. Holeka yakawona ciba hono yafwe. Yakawa kutya, “Ciba hono nifwe si nha kwikala mumi.”

9 Ninga Muwaha Mulungu yakamutya, “Alo nhawule wukucikalalila cilimwa?” Yona yakapitula yakatya, “Heya, ane nina soko yono yikuleka nghukolwa likuwo, sunga nifwe!”

10 U Muwaha Mulungu yakamulonjela yakamutya, “Cilimwa aci ciwiluka mu cilo cimonga, no kunyala kanyhi mu cilo ciyagwe, nagwe hamba siwitumile cinji muli cene, hamba kuciwilusa yaye, ninga kumbe wukuciwonela lusungu!
11 Ma, si viswanu kuli'ne kuyiwonela lusungu Ninawi likaya alilya liwaha mono mowali wanhu wacizize elufu yigana limonga na makumi mejete, wono si wakusuma kumanya zimbi ne ziswanu, hamonga ne zimitugo nyinji!”


Mika 1

1 Ayi yo nghani yo Muwaha Mulungu yono yamuziza Mika, mono yali munya Molesheti mu vilo vya Yotamu, na Ahazi na Hezekiya i watemi wa Yuda. Muwaha Mulungu yamugubulila Mika zizi zose za muli Samaliya na Yelusalemi.

U Muwaha Mulungu yakuza kuling'aniza

2 Ale muhulicize zizi anye nyo makungugo gose; muhulice zizi wose mono mwikaye mono'nze!

Muwaha Mulungu,

komuhomelelenyi, muhulicize!

Yakulonga ku wulawa mu Nyumba yakwe

yo wuhembelo ku wulanga.

3 Hambi Muwaha Mulungu

nha yakuza yakulawilila hono helile hakwe,

kokuza hasi,

kanyhi kojenda mu vizuli vye matunda.

4 Ne matunda gokwenjeduka hali mwene,

kotya lihula vyono lyenjedukaga mu moto,

gohulumila mu malolo,

kotya malenga gakuhuluma gakulawa mu cigongo.

5 Azi zose zokwijela, ku soko ye wanhu wa Isilayeli, wono wetuma wubi no kumuleka Muwaha Mulungu. Alu nani 'mbi mono kohoswa ku soko ye lisutya lya Isilayeli? Hono si Samaliya du! Hamba nani mono yena lisutya lyo kuhemba vihwani mu'si ya Yuda? Hono si Yelusalemi!
6 Muwaha Mulungu yakutya, “Holeka ku soko yiyo, nane noyinoza Samaliya, yiwe nha matongo go wongomezwe, mu yisi ye lihala, i hanhu hono hakuwa kupanhwa mizabibu. Nogagwisa makaya, ne mabwe gayo nogataga mwi'lolo, noyileka misinji yayo yili bwete.
7 Ne vihwani vyawo viseswe, vyose vyobenanjizwa-benanjizwa. Ne vinhu vyawo vyose vyono wavitujila mu nzila zo wusenyha, vyohodangwa no moto, ne vihwani vyose, novinoza viwe visina cambuzi. Hambi Samaliya, nha yavitujila vivi vyose, mu zinzila zo wusenyha. Holeka walugu wakwe wovisola, no kuvitegula hanhu hanji, nawo wavitumamile nhavivyo mu zinzila zo wusenyha.”

U muwizi yakuzililila Yelusalemi na Yuda

8 Mika yakatya, “Ku soko ya zizo, ane nolila muno muno, ndajile wusungu wono nina. Nojenda kwa magulu sina malatu, kanyhi nili cipwi, nowa kubweka nha nyhewe, kanyhi nolila nha nyacihema.
9 Hambi zinghomele za Samaliya, nha si zolonoga yaye, na Yuda nayo nhavivyo, yakondya kuficilwa no wugaye, heya, wugaye wakondya kufika sunga mo mu milango, hono wekaye wanhu wangu ku Yelusalemi.”

10 Mulece kuwalonjela walugu wetu wono wali ku Gati, zo wusumwe wetu, kanyhi mulece kuwaleka wawone vyono mukulila. Wanhu wa ku Bete-leyafula, mulajile nha vyono mwina wusungu, mu nzila yo wigalagaze mu manghundi!
11 Anye nyo wanhu wa Shafila, mubite ku wuhamywe, muli cipwi, ne cevu. Na wawo wono wekaye mu Zanani, walecele lukulu kulawila mwi'kaya lyawo. Kolo mukuhulika wanhu wa Betizeli wakulila, ale momanya nha vyono kusina wutizizo kuko.
12 I wanhu wono wekaye Maloti nha wakulondola wutazi, hambi Muwaha Mulungu nha yaleta magazo ko ku Yelusalemi.
13 Anye wanhu mono mwikaye Lakishi, muwopeleze zifwalasi mu magali go wulugu. Anye mono mwawutyatya wubi wa Isilayeli, kanyhi mukayambuza Yelusalemi yitume wubi.
14 Holeka 'lu wanhu wa Yuda, welagaje mu makaya ga Molesheti-gati. Hambi watemi wa Isilayeli, nha si wotuga wutazi ku wulawa mwi'kaya lya Akizibu.

15 Nanye nyo wanhu wa Malesha, Muwaha Mulungu komuwicenyi mu miwoko yo mulugu, mono kolitema likaya lyenyu. Ne watemi wa Isilayeli, wobita kwihundika mu mapango ga Adulamu.
16 Anye nyo wanhu mono mwikaye Yuda, mucete zimvwili, mulile, ku soko ye wana wono muwendile. Mwinozezaje nyo weneco mihalu kotya 'ndi, hambi wana wenyu nha wohamywa no kutegulwa kutali na nyenye.


Mika 2

Mika na wono wakwisumaniza nayo

1 Woyi he, kuli wono wagonaga meso wakwihwesa zo wavu! Na lono wela hakali mitondo, kolo wakutuga cilejeho du, hodu wawa kwituma zizo zo wavu zono wali wazipanjile, hambi nha zili mu vilungo vyawo.
2 Na lono wawe wakusaka migunda, hodu, wakuyisola kwa vilungo, na lono wakusaka zinyumba, nazo wakuzisola, hasina mhuga yo yose, hamba sawo, yono yisigaye yipolile.

3 Holeka Muwaha Mulungu yakutya, “Nghwihwesa nimuletelenyi magazo, gono si mosuma kupona, langa mokwiwona mwenjila du mu wugaye, wono womunozenyi mulece kwilumba kanyhi hamba hadodo.
4 Ne vilo vivyo, kolo vikuza, wanhu wolosimulila ze mikalile yenyu yo wugaye, ciwe colecezo, nawo wawe kwimba no lwimbo aluno lwe cililo, lono lukulajila zono zamutujenyi, wawe kutya,

‘Cakondya kuhodanjilwa lukulu!

Muwaha Mulungu yakondya kuyisola yisi yetu,

no kuwapela wono wacinozize mateka.’ ”

5 Holeka i vilo vilawa kuza, vyo kugomolwa yisi kuli wanhu wo Muwaha Mulungu, kolowa kusina kanyhi yunji, mono kolowa yena lifungu muli'nye.

Wono wakwisumaniza no muwizi

6 Nawo wanhu wakunganulila wakutya, “Wulece kuganula hali'se. Wulece kuganula muli zizi zose. Hambi Mulungu nha si kocikoza cevu.
7 Wukwihwesa lo, vyono wanhu wa Isilayeli wali mu wulijitwe? Hamba Muwaha Mulungu yawutaga wukangalile wakwe? Hamba mbeka kokwituma zizi? Hamba mwene lo, si kalongaga ko wupolo kuli wose wono wakwituma ze ling'ani?”
