8 Nayo Muwaha Mulungu yakupitula yakutya, “Mukuwahoma wanhu wangu nha walugu. Lono wakulawa ku wulugu, wakuwuya ku zikaya, wakwihwesa vyono luno wapolile, ninga kumbe anye mukwihundika mu nzila, ho muwahizize i makoti gawo gono wavwalile mucanyha.
9 Mukuwataga i wagolece we wanhu wangu, kudeha ye zinyumba zawo zono wazendile, kanyhi mukuwaboka i wana wawo wo wulugutwe wangu cibitilila.
10 Muwuce mubite, hambi ahano nha hasina kanyhi wuceho. Hambi u wubi wenyu, nha wahaletela wufwe hanhu baha, hamonga no wongomezwe.

11 “Wanhu awa, wakusaka muwizi mono yamemile wulambi no wukonji, mono yakutya ‘Nowila, divayi no wujimbi vilawile ko winji ku soko yenyu.’

12 “Ninga ane nomukongholenyi kanyhi hamonga, anye nyo wanhu wa Isilayeli, mono musigaye. Nomukongholelenyi hamonga, kotya ngholo zono zikuwuya kwi'bululu. Kotya wudimo wono wumemile ngholo, ne yisi yenyu vyo yowa yimemile wanhu wenji muno.”

13 Nayo Mulungu kowadigulila nzila, no kuwalongolela, wawuce mu wulawa mu yisi yo wujenzi. Wogabenanjiza malango ge likaya no kubita wapolile. No mutemi wawo, u Muwaha Mulungu mweneco, yo kolowatonga.


Mika 3

Mika yakuwahomelela i walongola wa Isilayeli wubi wawo

1 Ale muhulicize, anye nyo walongola wa Isilayeli! Yinojeye kuli'nye muyimanye ling'ani,
2 ninga 'lu 'nye muzisulile ziswanu, langa mwendile izimbi. Mukuyihinza nyhuli ye wanhu wangu akuno wali nyumi, no kuyitema nyama mu mafupa gawo.
3 Kanyhi mukuwalya nyama wanhu wangu, mukuyihinza nghuli yawo, no kugabenanga mafupa gawo, no kuwaguza wene, nha nyama nhelekwe mu nyungu.
4 Hambi icipango nha cikuza, cono anye nanye molomulilila Muwaha Mulungu, ninga mwene si kolomupitulenyi yaye, hamba si kolowuhuliciza no wulombe wenyu, ku soko 'nye mwetuma zimbi.

5 Wanhu wangu nha wakukongwa ne wawizi wo wulambi, wono wakuwehuwiziza vyono wokwikala wapolile, wawo wono wakuwalipa, na wono siwakwituma zizo, wakuwakajiziza wulugu. Ninga kuli wawizi wawa, u Muwaha Mulungu yakuwatya.
6 “Anye nyo wawizi, lizuwa lyenyu lili behi malika, nalyo lizuwa lyeza kumuswelenyi. Hambi nha mwawajiliza wanhu wangu, holeka hamba simowa no wugubulilwe wunji wo wose, hamba simosuma kuwila kanyhi cinji co cose.”
7 Na wawo wono wakuwila zono zikuza, wolokolwa cevu ku soko yo wuwizi wawo wo wulambi, nawo wose wolonyetywa, hambi Muwaha Mulungu nha si kolowapitula yaye.

8 Ninga ane, Muwaha Mulungu kamhela vilungo vyo muhe wakwe, hamonga no wusume, no wuling'anizi, kamhela 'ne vilungo, ho niwalonjele Isilayeli u wubi wawo vyono winha.
9 Ale muhulicizaje anye nyo watemi wa Isilayeli, na anye wose mono muyisulile ling'ani, no kuyipitulanya imbeka liwa yisutya.
10 Anye mono mukuzenga likaya lyo Mulungu Yelusalemi, mucanyha ye misinji yo wuwulaji no wuwula ling'ani.
11 Nawo i walongola, wakulitema likaya kwe mafupo, nawo wakohani, wakuwejiza wanhu Wulajilize ho watuje musahala, nawo wawizi, wakulonga zo wugubulilwe wawo ho walipwe mapesa. Nawo wawa wose wakwiyitya ti, vyono Muwaha Mulungu yali hamonga nawo. Kanyhi wakutya, “Hasina zimbi zono zocagana, hambi Muwaha Mulungu nha yali hamonga nase.”

12 Holeka ku soko yenyu, Sayuni yololimwa nha mugunda, nayo Yelusalemi, yolowa yilundo lya matongo, ne litunda lye Nyumba yo Mulungu, lyolowa mbago.


Mika 4

Muwaha Mulungu kowatema wanhu wose ko mulamu

1 Mu vilo vyono vikuza,

litunda lyono Nyumba yo Mulungu yizenjigwe,

lyolokwinulwa muno hali mayagwe gose,

ne cizuli calyo colowa cipulute matunda gose.

Ne wanhu we makungugo gose, wololibitila.

2 Ne wanhu wayo wolotya,

“Alenyi cibite kwi'tunda lyo Muwaha Mulungu,

ku Nyumba yo Mulungu wa Isilayeli mwene

yo kocifunda ase zono yakuhila cizitume.

Nase cojendela mu zinzila

zono mwene yazihagula.

Hambi i mejizo go Muwaha Mulungu,

nha galawaga ku Yelusalemi,

kanyhi yakulonga ne wanhu wakwe

ku wulawa ku Sayuni.”

3 Nayo kologalamula makungugo,

muli makungugo ge vilungo,

gono gali behi na gono gali kutali.

Nawo wolotyana mimaje yawo yiwe masili,

ne migoha yawo yiwe hengo zo kutemanjila.

Ne makungugo,

si golokwihoma yaye,

hamba kwiwikaniza

hamba kwiyijiza kanyhi zo wulugu.

4 No munhu wo wose kolokwikala yapolile,

yena ne nyemo mu migunda yakwe

ye mizabibu ne mikuyu,

hasina munhu yunji mono kolomogofya.

Muwaha Mulungu we Mihanga yo yehuwize zizi.

5 Likungugo ne kungugo lihembaga no kogopa u mulungu walyo, ninga mu vilo vivyo, colomuhemba no kumogopa Muwaha Mulungu wetu cibitilila na cibitilila.

Isilayeli wolowuya ku wulawa ku wuhamywe

6 Muwaha Mulungu yakutya, “Ivilo vikuza, lono nolowakonghola hamonga wanhu wangu wono nawalipiciza, wakagazwa ku wuhamywe.
7 Wakawa wakusenzegula, kanyhi wali kutali no kwawo. Ninga hamba nhavivyo nowanozeza mwamulizo mupya wawo wono wasigala, nawo wowa likungugo yiwaha lye vilungo. Nane notema hali wene mwi'tunda lya Sayuni, ku wulawa mu vilo vivyo sunga cibitilila.”

8 Nagwe go Yelusalemi, i hanhu hono Mulungu yo mudimi, mono kawalanjililaga wanhu wakwe, kolowa kanyhi likaya yiwaha lyo wutemi wono wali wako.
9 Alu so cici wukulila kwe 'zi yiwaha? Hamba so cici wukuwona wusungu nho mucekulu mono yali mu nghunga yo lusawo? Ku soko vyono wusina mutemi, ne watazi wako wono wakutazaga zinghani, wose wakondya kufwa?
10 Muwone wusungu mwinyongole anye wanhu wa Yelusalemi, nho mucekulu mono yali mu lusawo, hambi aluno nha mowuka mwi'kaya, mubite mukekale mwi'hala. Kanyhi mowa munojeye mubite ku Babiloni, ninga kuko ko Muwaha Mulungu kolomuponyezyenyi ku wulawa kuli walugu wenyu.
11 Hambi makungugo menji nha gekonghoye ho gamuhomenyi. Gakutya, “Yelusalemi yinojeye wuhodangwe! Nase coliwona likaya lili lyawa yitongo!”
12 Ninga hamba nhavivyo, i makungugo gaga, sigamanyile zono Muwaha Mulungu yakwihwesa. Hamba si gakumanya vyono, mwene yagahangulize hamonga ho yagalipicize, nha vyono wawulundaga wuhemba mu cuga wawa kuwutowa.
13 Muwaha Mulungu yakutya, “Anye nyo wanhu wa Yelusalemi, ale, mubite mukawalipicize walugu wenyu, nane nomunozenyi muwe ne vilungo nhe nghambaku, yono yina mahembe ga cuma ne mabangho ga shaba. Nanye mogahoma makungugo menji no kugasumiza, ne sawo yawo yose yono wayituga kwe vilungo, ayo mondavizya nene, ane no Muwaha Mulungu we yinze yose.”


Mika 5

1 Anye nyo wanhu wa Yelusalemi, mwikongholaje so wihomi! Hambi nha cakondya kupilimwa! Nawo wamuhoma u mulongola wa Isilayeli!

Mulungu yakwihuwiza vyono, Mutemi kolawa ku Betelehemu

2 Muwaha Mulungu yakutya, “Agwe Betelehemu Efulata, agwe yo gwegwe wuli cikaya cidodo mu Yuda, ninga nomuhagula yunji ku wulawa muli'gwe mono kowa mutemi wa Isilayeli, mono wulawo wakwe wo we katali na katali.”
3 Holeka Muwaha Mulungu, kowaleka wanhu wakwe kuli walugu wawo, sunga mu cipango cono mucekulu kolelela mwana we cilume. Ale baho i wanhu wono wowa wakali wasigaye ku wuhamywe, ho wolokwilunza kanyhi ne wanhu wawo weneco.
4 Nayo yalaza kuza, kolowatema wanhu wakwe, kwe vilungo vyono vikulawa kuli Muwaha Mulungu, hamonga ne nhojo yo Muwaha Mulungu mweneco. Ne wanhu wakwe, wolokwikala wapolile, hambi wanhu wose wa kono'nze, nha wolowuvumila u wuwaha wakwe, nayo yo kololeta mulamu.

Wukombozwe no wulipicizwe

5 Hono Waashuli waze wayisole yisi yetu no kugabena magomawakali getu, nase cowategula watemi wetu we vilungo wakawahome.
6 Nawo wolowasuma Waashuli mu yisi ya Nimulodi ko wukali wo mumaje, nawo wolociponya mu miwoko ye Waashuli, kolo wakwinjila no kuyihoma yisi yetu.
7 Ne wanhu wa Isilayeli wono wasigaye, wolowa nhe buhe yono yikulawa kuli Muwaha Mulungu so makungugo menji, kotya mahalavu ga mvula, mu migunda ye vilimwa vyono vikuwiluka. No witumbilo wawo, wolowa kuli Mulungu hamba si kuli munhu yaye.
8 Nawo wo lulelo lwa Yakobo wono wolowa wakali wasigaye mumo mu makungugo, wolowa nha simba yono yili mu mbago mu wupelembi, hamba mu wudimilo, yikwagana zingholo no kuzizumhila no kuzihawanga, hawa hasina hamba no witumbilo wo kupona yaye,
9 Isilayeli kolowasuma walugu wakwe, no kuwahodanjila lukulu wose.

10 Muwaha Mulungu yakutya, “Mu vilo vivyo, noloziwusiza lukulu zifwalasi zenyu, no kuyihodanga mituka yenyu yo wulugu.”
11 Kanyhi nologahodanga makaya ga mu yisi yenyu, no kugagwisa hasi magomawakali genyu gose.
12 Noloziwusiza lukulu zimhiji zono muzitumbiye, nimulecenyi musina kanyhi no mutowa cisangu.
13 Nolovihodanga ne vihwani vyenyu, hamonga ne masumbili genyu ge mabwe gono mugasiwanuye, nanye si molovihembela lukulu kanyhi, i vinhu vyono mwinozeze nyenye nyo mweneco.
14 Nolovigwisa hasi vihwani vyo mulungu we cicekulu Ashela mu'si yenyu, no kugahodanga makaya genyu.
15 Nane nologalipiciziza mwi'kuwo lyangu liwaha, makungugo gose gono gasina cihuliko kuli'ne.


Mika 6

Wulalame wo muwizi

1 Ale muhulicize calo co Muwaha Mulungu kuli Isilayeli. Ale winuce 'gwe Muwaha Mulungu wulete calo cako. Matunda ne vitunda vihulice zizo zono wukulonga.
2 Anye nyo matunda, nanye nyo misinji ye cibitilila ye yinze, muhulicize calo co Muwaha Mulungu kuli'nye, Muwaha Mulungu yena calo kuli wanhu wakwe, mwene yakubita kuyileta nghani yo kwilolosa kuli Isilayeli.
3 Muwaha Mulungu yakulonga yakutya, anye nyo wanhu wangu, ane namutendelenyi ci? Hamba nawa nili mutegulo kuli'nye so nghani ci? Ale ta mumhitulaje.
4 Ane nghamusolenyi no kumuwusenyi ku wulawa ku yisi ya Misili, no kumuponyenyi ku wulawa mu wuwanda. Nghawatuma Musa, na Haluni, na Milyamu, ho wamutonjenyi ku wulawa kuko.
5 Anye nyo wanhu wangu, mukumbucile zizo zono Balaki u mutemi wa Mowabu, yali yewikanize ho yamutendelenyi 'nye, na vyono Balamu mwana wa Beyoli yamupitula. Kanyhi mukumbucile zono zejela, lono mwali muli mu nzila, ku wulawa ku nghambi ya Shitimu sunga ku Giligali. Holeka momanya zono nghamutendelenyi ho nimuponyenyi 'nye.

I liwuzo lye wanhu

6 Cinhuci cono nomutegulila Muwaha Mulungu, u Mulungu wa ku wulanga, lono nghuza kumuhemba? Hamba sole nzeku swanu yono yina mwaka monga, nimulavizye nha cilavywa cinyanywe hali mwene?
7 Muwaha Mulungu kokwendezwa hono nimutegulile matewa na matewa ge zingholo, hamba makolongo elufu na elufu ge mafuta ge mizeyituni, yono si yidumaga? Hamba nimulavizye mwanangu mulongozi kulelwa, ho ndipile wubi wangu?

Lipitulo lyo muwizi

8 Aa ng'o, hambi Muwaha Mulungu nha yacilonjela ziswanu zono zinojeye hali mwene, zono yakuhila kuli'se, nha zozi, Citume zono zili ling'ani, cilajile wendo kuli mwene, no kujenda ko winenenyhezi hamonga no Muwaha Mulungu wetu.
9 Hambi nha go mahala, mu wumogopa Muwaha Mulungu. Mwene yakucema mwi'kaya yakutya, “Muhulicize anye nyo wanhu wa Yuda, mono mwikongholeye mwi'kaya!
10 Mu zikaya ze wanhu wabi, movili viwutwa vyono wavitujiye mu zinzila zimbi. Hamby nha wakwitumamila vipimo vyo wukonji vyono ane si nivyendile.
11 Alu nowanenela nhawule wanhu wono wakwitumamila vipimo ne mizani yo wukonji?
12 Wanhu wako i wagoli, wakuwegalila waciwa, na muli nyenye, wose muli walambi.
13 Holeka nane nakondya kwiwikaniza so wongomezwe wenyu no wuhodangwe wenyu ku soko yo wubi wenyu.
14 Nanye molya, ninga simokwiguta yaye, langa mokwikala vyo mudabuce du. Na mu luhamo lwenyu, si mosuma kusola cinji citelevu, na cono mocisoleleza citelevu, ane nocihodanga mu wulugu.
15 Molohadika zimbeyu, ninga simolodudula cinji yaye. Molominya mafuta ge mizeyituni, ninga si mologetumamila yaye. Kanyhi molonoza ne divayi, ninga hamba si moloying'wa ng'o.
16 Na zizi zolomuzizenyi ku soko vyono mwagatyatya metumo mabi go mutemi Omuli, na go mwanagwe mutemi Ahabu. Vyono mukujendela mu zinghani zawo, holeka nane nomutegulenyi sunga ko ku wongomezwe, ne wanhu wose womubedegalenyi, no kumwitumilenyi vyono wakuhila.”


Mika 7

U wulalame wo muwizi

1 Woyi hee! Hambi ane nha neza nha munhu mono yadabuce, mono yagana musina mikalo yono yisigazwe mu mibici, hamba zabibu mu manhambi ge mizabibu. Hambi zabibu zose hamonga ne mikalo yo mukuyu, nha vyakondya kuhepwa.
2 Hasina munhu mwihuwilwa mono yasigaye mu'si, hamba munhu mono yali cihuliko hali Muwaha Mulungu. Munhu wo wose kalondolaga cilejeho ho yetume zo wuwulaji. Munhu wo wose kamupelembaga nduguye ho yamugwize.
3 Wose wanghula muno ku wituma zo wavu. Wanhu wawaha hamonga ne mahakimu, wakulomba mafupo. Nayo u munhu muwaha yakuwalonjela zono yakuhila mu nhumbula yakwe nawo wawa kwilumbaniza nayo.
4 Sunga no munhu muswanu muli wene, yakuwa yasina cambuzi nhe maselegwa.

Ninga lizuwa lyakondya kuza, lyono Mulungu kowalipiciza wanhu, nha vyono yawasugula mu nzila ye walindilizi wawo ne wawizi wakwe, ku wulawa katali. Alu weza wali mu mahwele.
5 Wulece kumwihuwila mwikalani muyago, hamba kumwitumbila mono mwiyendile nayo. Wilanjililaje muli zono wukulonga, hamba yiwe kuli mugolece wako.
6 Na mu vilo vivyo, i wana wolowa kuwatendela wasogo zawo nha wanhu wono wasina mahala, nawo i wana we cicekulu, wakwiwanganila ne wanyina zawo. Ne wahinza wono watoligwe, nawo wakugombana ne wakwe zawo we cicekulu. Hambi i walugu wo munhu, nha wo wawo wa mu kaya yakwe mweneco.
7 Ninga 'ne, nomulanjilila Muwaha Mulungu, nomulindila Mulungu, mono komhonya 'ne. Nayo Mulungu wangu kohulika 'ne.

Witumbilo no wulombe we wanhu

8 Ne walugu wetu wowa wasina soko yo kucisimanga. Heya, hamba ciwe cagwa, ninga cokwinuka kanyhi. Alu cili mu wutitu, ninga Muwaha Mulungu kociletela kanyhi wuzelu.
9 Ase cetuma zo wubi hali Muwaha Mulungu, holeka aluno yicinojeye cilikangalile kwa cipango likuwo lyakwe. Ninga ku ndumilizo kocitaza no kucipela ling'ani kuli ze masutya gono cali citumile. Mwene kocilavya, kociwika ku wuzelu, holeka cowa cili womi, nase cimuwone na vyono yakuciponya.
10 Nawo walugu wetu, woloziwona zizi wakolwe cevu. Ne walugu wanji wolocilonga wawe kutya, “Alu yali hayi u Muwaha Mulungu, u Mulungu wenyu?” Nase colowawona wakondya kusumwa, wakukanyanjilwa hasi nhe madabaga, mu zinzila za mwi'kaya.

11 Nye nyo wanhu mono mwikaye mu Yelusalemi, I cipango co kuzenga kanyhi majinji ge likaya cikuza. Na mu cipango cico i mipaka ye yisi yenyu yologazimhywa.
12 Ne wanhu wenyu wolomuwuyilenyi ku wulawa mhelo zose, wolokuza ku wulawa kucilima ku Ashuli, na ku wulawa kutakama ku Misili, ku wulawa mu mipaka ye likolongo lya Efulata, ku wulawa kwi'lenga sunga mu matunda go kutali.
13 Ninga yisi yolowa nyika, ku soko yo wubi we wanhu wono wekaye mumo.

U wulombe

14 Gwe Muwaha Mulungu, weze mudimi kuli wanhu wako, iwanhu wono wawahagula. Hamba wawe wekaye kutali mwi'bago. Ninga yisi yose yono yiwapilime yina moso muno. Walekaje wabite wakaliswe ku Bashani na ku Gileyadi nha vyono wanoza mu vilo vye katali.

15 Gwe go Muwaha Mulungu, witumaje mapoto ku soko yetu, nha vyono wetuma mu vilo vyono waciwusiza ku yisi ya Misili.
16 Ne makungugo goziwona zizi, gawe kogopa no kuviwonela soni vilungo vyawo, na ku so woga, hamba si wolonga cinji kanyhi, langa wodinda makutu gawo.
17 Nawo wolowa kutambala hasi nha nzoka. Wokuza ku wulawa mu makaya gawo ge magomawakali, akuno wakucicima wena no woga. Wowuya kuli Muwaha Mulungu u Mulungu wetu, akuno wena no woga kuli mwene.

18 Gwe Muwaha Mulungu, hasina mulungu yunji mono yehwanile gwegwe, hambi 'gwe nha kuwanenelaga u wubi wawo wanhu wako wono wasigala, hamba si kwikalaga ne likuwo cibitilila. Ninga kuwezaga ne nyemo, ho wulajile lusungu lwako kuli'se.
19 Kowa no lusungu kanyhi kuli'se nhe vilo vyono vyapuluta. Kanyhi kowusambanjila wubi wetu hasi ye magulu gako, no kuwutaga wubi wetu ku visolo vye lilenga!
20 Agwe kolajila wihuwilwa wako no lusungu lwako kuli wanhu wako, mu lulelo lwa Abulahamu na Yakobo, nha vyono wawehuwiziza i walezi wetu ku wulawa mu vilo vye katali.


Nahumu 1

1 Ayi yo nghani kuli Ninawi,

nha vyono yagubulilwa Nahumu

mono yali munya Elikoshi.

Likuwo lyo Muwaha Mulungu kuli Ninawi

2 U Muwaha Mulungu sikowakangalila

wono wakwisumaniza nayo,

langa kawalipicizaga wose

wono wakumupinga-pinga,

na mwi'kuwo lyakwe,

mwene mo kawalipicizizaga.

3 Langa mwene Muwaha Mulungu,

sikakolwaga ne likuwo mbela,

ninga yali vilungo,

hamba sikalekaga kuwulipiciza wubi.

Ho hose hono Muwaha Mulungu yakukola,

cijelaga civulavumbi.

Ne mavunde,

go manghundi gono galawaga mu magulu gakwe.

4 Nayo kalilajilizaga lilenga,

nalyo liwa kunyala,

kanyhi kanyazaga ne makolongo.

Sunga ne migunda

yono yili ku Bashani yiwa kunyala,

ne litunda lya Kalimeli nalyo,

liwa ne liwala nha lye mahanze gono ganyalile,

ne maluwa ga ku Lebanoni gawa kuwomba.

5 Ne matunda gawa kucicima

ha mwande yo Muwaha Mulungu,

ne vigongo vyayo viwa kwenjeduka

ha mwande yakwe.

Nayo Muwaha Mulungu,

kolo yakwilajila,

yisi yiwa kusinjisika,

yinze hamonga ne wanhu wose wawa kucicima.

6 Nani mwene mono kosuma kupona,

kolo mwene yakukolwa likuwo?

Hamba nani mono kolosuma kusigala

mu wogofye we likuwo lyakwe?

Yakwita lilambi lye likuwo lyakwe,

ne matalawe gakubiduka

mu manghundi ha mwande yakwe.

7 U Muwaha Mulungu muswanu,

kawadimaga wanhu wakwe

mu cipango co wugaye;

kawakamisaga wose wono wakumuwuyila mwene.

8 Langa mwene kawongomezezaga lukulu walugu wakwe,

nhe 'hwazi lyono likuhuluma.

Nawo wono wakwisumaniza nayo,

kawafisaga sunga ko ku wufwe wawo.

9 Alu mukwihwesa cici muli Muwaha Mulungu?

Mwene komuhodanjenyi.

Hamba hasina yunji kanyhi mono kokwidoma nayo.

10 Nanye mo wagalo 'jimbi,

molotakamizwa nhe mamivya

gono gedawilize ne mahanze makavu.

11 Ku wulawa kuli'gwe Ninawi, yakaza munhu mono yali yamemile wuhile wo wubi, mono yakwihwesa vibi kuli Muwaha Mulungu.
12 Azi zo yakulonga u Muwaha Mulungu kuli wanhu wakwe Waisilayeli yakutya, “Hamba yiwe Waashuli wali vilungo kanyhi wenji, ninga wene wohodangwa no kuwusizwa lukulu. Heya nyo wanhu wangu, nghamunozenyi mugaye, ninga sinomutendelenyi kanyhi nhavivi.
13 Nane aluno novidumya i vilungo vye Waashuli kuli'nye, kanyhi noyidumula ne minyolo yono muwopeywe.”
14 Azi zo Muwaha Mulungu yalamuye kuli Waashuli, “Si wolowa na lulelo kanyhi lono lolocemwa mwi'tagwa lyawo. Novihodanga vihwani vyono vili mu wuhembelo we milungu yawo. Kanyhi nghuwikaniza citenjelo ku soko ye Waashuli, hambi nha si yiwanojeye wekale womi.”

15 Lanje, u muganuzi yakuza yakulawa mucanyha ye matunda, hamonga no luganuzi Luswanu, mono yakwanza zo mulamu. Mwene yali mu nzila yakwe ho yanze zo wusume. Nanye nyo wanhu wa Yuda, mwibate zi sikukuu, kanyhi mumufisilizize Mulungu vyono mwamwihuwiziza. Hambi i wabi, nha si wolokwinjila kanyhi no kuyihoma yisi yenyu. Hambi nha wakondya kuwusizwa lukulu!


Nahumu 2

U wugwe wa Ninawi

1 Gwe Ninawi, alu weza wuli mu wuhomwe!

Ne vilungo vyono vyokubenanjiza vyakondya kuza.

Holeka 'lu wulidimaje likaya lyako!

Wuzilanjilile ne zinzila zako!

Wiwikanize so wihomi!

Wime wukamile!

2 (U Muwaha Mulungu kolugomola lukumyo lwa Isilayeli nha vyono lwali, lono walugu wali wakali nawateka.)

3 I wasilikale walugu, wadinghuye ngula ndunghu,

kanyhi wavwalile myenda midunghu,

wakwiwikaniza wamuhomenyi!

Ne mituka yawo yo wulugu,

yikulipuka nha moto.

Ne zifwalasi zawo, zikuzumha-zumha muno.

4 Ne mituka yawo yo wulugu,

yikumangha mangha musunho mu zinzila,

yikumangha ako na ako mu zinhuzi ze likaya.

Kanyhi yikwaka kotya toci,

no kwijela musunho kotya mamuli.

5 Yakuwakumbucila

wanhu wakwe we lilumbo,

wakwikobala mu njenda yawo

lono wakwiyoha.

Nawo wanya kuwahoma,

wakumanyhila musunho mu majinji,

no kuwikaniza zi ngula,

so kwicita no wulugu.

6 Ne milango ya kwi'kolongo, yadiguka,

nalyo likaya lyo wutemi limemile wogofye.

7 Likaya lyekala lili bwete,

i wanhu wayo wakondya kusolwa mateka,

ne wetumami wakwe we cicekulu wakulila kotya

mazi ga nghunda,

no kwitowa-towa mu zimhambaga so wusungu.

8 Wanhu wakumangha musunho

ku wulawa Ninawi nhe malenga

gono gakulawa mwi'lamba lyono lyaponghola.

Ne lizi likucemeleza likutya,

“Mwime! Mwime!”

Ninga hasina hamba yunji

mono yakwilenga ku nyuma.

9 Musole ngaluzi ze zifweza!

Solenyi ngaluzi ze zahabu!

Hambi likaya nha limemile viwutwa!

10 Ninawi yahodangwa nha vyono yali yinojeye,

alu yekala nyhiwa.

Ne zinhumbula ze wanhu wayo,

zenjilwa no woga,

ne mafugamilo gawo gakucicima,

ne vilungo vyeza musina,

no wusu wawo wawomba so woga.

11 Alu lili hayi likaya,

lyono lyali linha wikalo wa simba,

ne hanhu hono wana we simba wakuliswa,

i hanhu hono simba nume

ne simba nyhekulu zobita,

hamba zinyana zayo hono zowa zikaye zipolile?

12 Simba yawulaga mapelembo gayo,

yalupulanga mhonje mhonje

so wagolece wakwe na so wanagwe.

Yamemya nyama ye mapelembo gayo mu wikalo wayo.

13 Muwaha Mulungu we Mihanga yakutya, “Ane nili mulugu wako, nane nogakongoga matuka gako go wulugu. Ne wasilikale wako wolowulagwa ku wulugu, nane novisola vinhu vyose vyono wavisola ku wulawa kuli wanhu wanji. Ne mazi ge wetumami wako, hamba sigolohulikwa kanyhi yaye.”


Nahumu 3

1 Woyi hee likaya lyono limemile wuwulaji,

limemile wulambi no wugoli

wono lisawiye mu nzila yo wuhizi!

2 Muhulice ta,

mazozo ge mililo ye mizipo,

ne mazozo ge maguludumu,

hamonga ne zifwalasi

zono zikubita zikumangha muno muno,

hamonga ne nyhinyinho ye matuka go wulugu!

3 Iwajendela zifwalasi wakubita lumangho,

ne mimaje yawo ne migoha yawo yikung'alala!

Mivimba yilundile malundo mawaha,

ne miwili ya wono wafwiye yisina hamba yiwalo,

wanhu wakwikobala mucanyha ye mivimba!

4 Ninawi u musenyha yakondya kulipicizwa.

Hambi nha yakwendezwa no wuwulaji,

mono yakugakwega makungugo

no kugatajila mu wuwanda.

5 U Muwaha Mulungu we Mihanga yakutya,

“Ane nokwisumaniza nagwe go Ninawi!

Kanyhi nokuvula ne myenda wikale cipwi,

ne makungugo gakuwone vyono wuli cipwi,

ne matemi gakuwonele mu cevu cako.

6 Nane nokunoza wuwe cinhu

cono cibedegaywe,

kanyhi wuwe wuli cinhu cavu,

ne wanhu wokulanga ko woga.

7 Na wose wono wokuwona,

wotiza, akuno wakutya,

‘Ninawi yili mu wuhodangwe!

Alu nani 'mbi mono koyiwonela lusungu?

Hamba nani lo mono kosuma kuyisindamika?’ ”

8 Ninawi, alo agwe wuli mutelevu kuciza Tebesi likaya liwaha lya Misili? Lyono lipilimwe ne makolongo ho galicitile nhe 'jinji. Ne likolongo lya Nile, likawa yo ngula yalyo.
9 Yakazitema Kushi na Misili, hakawa hasina mupaka mu wutemi wakwe. Na Libiya nayo vikawa vihulice.
10 Ninga wanhu wa No-amoni, wategulwa kutali ku wuwanda. Na mu zinhuzi zose ze zinzila, wana wawo watowangwaga sunga wafwa. Ne walongola wawo wose wasolwa, akuno wawopwe ne manyolo, wakawa kugawana wanya kuwateka.
11 Ninawi, nagwe kogala sunga mahala gajilile! Kanyhi kojela kwiponya ku wulawa kuli walugu wako.
12 Ne magomawakali gako gose, gowa nha mikuyu yono yina mana gono gapiye. Agwe wuyisinjisaje mibici du, kowona mana gakugwila mu mulomo wako!
13 Hambi wasilikale wako wo wulugu, nha weza nha wacekulu, ne yisi yako yeza yisina mulindilizi ha mwande ye walugu wako. No moto wogahodanga macuma gono wugapinjice mu malango ge likaya lyako.
14 Holeka muwikanize malenga menji, mwiwikanize so wulugu wono wukuza. Kanyhi musikamye ne magomawakali genyu! Mutiwe lilongo, muwumbe matofali, ho muwe ne matofali gono mawumbile lukulu.
15 Ninga, hamba wunoze vyono konoza, vyo kokongogwa du mu moto sunga wufwe, hamba kowulagwa ku wulugu. Nagwe kowusizwa lukulu nhe vilimwa vyono vilijigwe ne zinzije.

Mwali monjelezeka mweza muli wenji nhe zinzije!
16 Wukawonjeleza ne wakwawi wako wawe wenji, kuciza zinyelezi za ku wulanga! Ninga 'lu, wakondya kubita, nhe zinzije zono zitandakulaga mabawa no kuguluka.
17 I walongola wako wenha matewa ge zinzije zono zicehile mu majinji mwi'zuwa lye mbeho nghali. Ninga lizuwa kolo likuwalika, zikuguluka no kubita, hamba hasina yunji mono yakumanya na kono zibitile!
18 Gwe go mutemi wa Ashuli, walanjilizi wako wakondya kufwa, ne wawaha wako we lilumbo wagona cibitilila! Wanhu wako weyagaye mu matunda, hasina hamba munhu mono kowagomola kanyhi ku zi kwawo.
19 Kusina kanyhi hamba miti yono yowupoza wusungu wako, ne zinghomele zako sizikusumika hamba kuwunoje yaye. Na wose wono wohulika zo wuhodangwe wako, mbeka wotowa maganza gawo so nyemo. Hambi nani mono yelega no wukali wako wono wusina ndumilizo?


Habakuki 1

1 Ayi yo nghani yono Muwaha Mulungu yamugubulila muwizi Habakuki.

Habakuki si yakwendezwa no wuhizi

2 Gwe go Muwaha Mulungu, alu nondole wutazi kuli'gwe sunga nili nagwe ho wuhulice. Hamba cokulilila sunga nili ho wuciponye mu wukali we wanhu wabi?
3 Alu nhawule wukunoza 'ne nigawone magayo gono genha gaga? Hamba kosuma nhawule kujendelela ku wulanga wubi wono winha wuwu? Hambi wuhodangwe, ne vilungo, nha vyose vimhilime nene, kanyhi ko wuli wuma no wugombane hanhu hose.
4 No wulajilize weza wusina vilungo kanyhi, sunga ne ling'ani yeza yili musina. I wanhu wabi wakuwapilima we ling'ani, holeka no wuling'anizi weza wusina vilungo.

Lipitulo lyo Muwaha Mulungu

5 U Muwaha Mulungu yakalonga kuli wanhu wakwe yakutya, “Mugalangaje makungugo gono gamupilimenyi, nanye mokwizina kuli zono moziwona. Nane nokwituma nghani yono si mokwihuwilila lukulu kolo mweza kuyihulika.
6 Nane nghuwanoza Wababiloni wawe ne vilungo kanyhi wakali, kanyhi wali nghakamo. Nawo wokola haciligati ye yinze, no kutema zi'si zi'si.
7 Kanyhi wowogofya wanhu no woga wuwaha, no wulajilize wowa wuli mu wiwoni wawo weneco.

8 “Ne zifwalasi zawo zowa zikumangha mbela mbela zicizize masuwi, kanyhi nghali, zicizize ne maminzi gono gadabuce. Ne wajendela zifwalasi wawo, wokuza wakuzimasha ku wulawa ma'si go kutali, fwalasi zawo zikwipalila hasi. Zikukola musunho muno muno kotya numba vyono yibataga mapelembo gayo.
9 Ne wasilikale wawo, wena vilungo vyo wusume, ne wanhu wose wakuwogopa kolo wakuwasejelela behi. Ne mateka wono wowateka, wowa wenji nha musawawa.
10 Wowabedegala watemi no kuwaseka i wawaha. Hamba hasina igomawakali lyono lyosuma kuwemila, hambi nha wolilundila muhangha likaya no kulisola.
11 I wanhu wawa wono i vilungo vyawo yo mulungu wawo, wopuluta musunho nha mbeho, hanyuma wawe kubita.”

Habakuki yakulajila wu wula kwendezwa wakwe kanyhi hali Muwaha Mulungu

12 Muwaha Mulungu ku wulawa mwamulizo yo gwegwe Mulungu, agwe yo wuli Mulungu wangu, mono welile na we cibitilila, Muwaha Mulungu wangu no mudimi wangu. Alu wawahagula i Wababiloni no kuwanoza wawe ne vilungo, ho wasume kucilipiciza ase.
13 Ninga socici wukusuma kwima kuli wanhu awa wakoci, kanyhi wabi? Ne meso gako nha gelile, ku wulanga zo wubi, hamba si kosuma kwima ku lubavu lwe wanhu wetuma zimbi. Alu socici wunyamaye lono wakuwahodanga wanhu wono wali ling'ani si nha wene?
14 Hamba wukusuma nhawule kuwatendela wanhu nha somba, hamba kotya litewa lye mang'onyo, gono gasina wulajilize wono wukugalongoza?
15 Wababiloni wakuwagwiza wanhu na ndobogo, nha kotya somba. Hanyuma wawa kuwakwejenha hasi mu zinyavu no kuzoza so nyemo mu wibatwe wawo!
16 Sunga wakuzihemba zinyavu zawo, no kuzilavizya makumbiko, vyono zinyavu zawo zikuwapela iviswanu vyose.
17 Alu wule, wojendelela kwitumamila mimaje yawo cibitilila, no kujendelela kugahodanga makungugo wu wula lusungu?


Habakuki 2

Lipitulo lyo Muwaha Mulungu kuli Habakuki

1 Nobita mucanyha yo munala wangu, nindile mbone zono Muwaha Mulungu kononjela, ho nonje kanyhi, mbone lipitulo lyono komhela muli zizo zono singhuzenda.

Mulungu yakumupitula Habakuki

2 Nayo Muwaha Mulungu yakamhela lipitulo ali yakatya, “Ale, wandice calinze mu vibawo zono nghukugubulila, ho zisume kusomeka calinze.
3 Wuzandikaje, hambi cipango nha cikali cono zizo zowela. Ninga cipango cikuza mbela, na zono nghukulajila zokuza. Ne cipango cico cokwijela nha cikucela ku wuze, ninga agwe weze wulindiye du, naco cokuza, hamba si cotinya yaye.
4 ‘I wabi wose si wokwikala womi yaye, langa we ling'ani, wo wokwikala womi, hambi nha wehuwilwa kuli Mulungu.’ ”

Wongomezwe kuli wono si weling'ani

5 Hamonga na zizo, divayi yajilizaga, no munhu mwidunhumuzi, si kekalaga vilo vinji. Mwene yewikanize kuwamela wanhu wanji nha vyono yinha yisi ye wafu. Holeka nayo si kegutaga yaye nha vyono linha lifwa, mwene kekongholelaga i makungugo gose, hamonga ne wanhu wose wawa nha sawo yakwe.
6 Ninga iwanhu wono wakuwasuma, nawo wolowazwajiza wono wawasumize, kanyhi wolowabedegala. Wolotya, “Mwavisolaga vyono si vyali vyenyu, ninga 'lu woyi hee kuli'nye! Hamba mojendelela wule 'lu kanyhi, mu wugoli wono mwetujila mu nzila yo kuwadaya kwa vilungo wono wali wakopile kuli'nye ho wamulipenyi?”
7 Ninga na lono mowa mukali namanya, wawo wono mwawasolela vinhu vyawo, nawo wolomuzizenyi nhinicizo welipicize. I walugu wolomuzizenyi no kumogofyenyi. Kanyhi wolomubocenyi ne sawo yenyu kwe vilungo!
8 Anye mwawaboka wanhu we makungugo menji sawo zawo, ninga aluno wawo nawo wono wasigaye, womubocenyi nanye zisawo zenyu, ku soko yo wuwulaji wono mwetuma, na ku soko ye mawonezi genyu kuli wanhu we yinze ne makaya gawo.

9 Woyi hee kuli nye! Mono mwazigolifya zimhuga zenyu ne sawo yono muyibocile kwe vilungo, akuno mukuzinoza zikaya zenyu ziwe zipolile zisina mbali!
10 Na mu nzila yiyo, mukunoza vibi, hambi nha mweletela cevu mu zikaya zenyu, namo mu wuhomanga makungugo menji, mweyongomeza muli wene.
11 Alu sunga ne mabwe ga mwi'jinji, gakulila so nyenye, no mucici nawo wukupitula.
12 Woyi hee kuli'nye! Mwalisimya likaya ko wavu, mukalizenga ko wuwulaji.
13 Ne makungugo gono mwagatema, gakawa nha gekataze no mulimo wa bwete, ne mazengo gose gono wali wazenga, gakaticimila no moto. No Muwaha Mulungu we Mihanga yo yetuma zizo.
14 Ninga yinze yolowa yimemile wumanye wo lukumyo lo Mulungu nha vyono lilenga limemile malenga.

15 Woyi hee kuli'nye! Anye mono mwi'kuwo lyenyu, mukawanoza wayenyu wabedegalwe no kuwakoza cevu, kanyhi mukawanoza wakawa kupebesuka-pebesuka nha wanhu wono wagalile wujimbi.
16 Ninga zizo zomuwuyilenyi nyo weneco, ne wanhu si womupelenyi cogopo yaye, nanye momema cevu ciwaha. Nanye nyo weneco mologala wujimbi no kupebesuka-pebesuka. Nayo Muwaha Mulungu kolomung'wesenyi cikombe co wulipicizwe nyenye nyo weneco. Ne cogopo cenyu colopituka ciwe cevu.
17 Nha vyono mwayitemanga mbago ya ku Lebanoni, nanye 'lu vyo motemangwa nhavivyo. Kanyhi nha vyono mwaviwulaga vilimu, nanye vilimu vyomogofyenyi. Na zizi zokwijela ku soko yo wuwulaji wono mwetuma, na ku soko yo wongomeze we wanhu wa mono'nze hamonga ne makaya gayo.

18 Hambi cihwani cina cambuzici? Nha cinhu du cono cinozigwe no munhu, kanyhi hamba si cosuma kukulonjela cinji co cose, langa wulambi du. Hamba hasina nghani yono cico cihwani, cimutendelaga munya kucisesa ho cisume kwitumbilwa, hambi cihwani, nha si mulungu, hamba si cosuma no kulonga yaye!
19 Woyi hee kuli 'nye! Mono mulilonjelaga libici mukutya, “Usinhuce!” Hamba kwi'bwe lyono si likulonga mukutya, “Winuce!” Alo mukwihwesa vyono cihwani cosuma kumugubulilenyi nghani yo yose lo? Heya, cidahile kuwa cihiliwe ne fweza hamonga ne zahabu, ninga hamba nhavivyo vyo cisina wumi du.

20 U Muwaha Mulungu yali mu Nyumba yakwe yono Yelile, holeka wanhu wose wa mono'nze, yiwanojeye watule hali mwene.


Habakuki 3

Lilombo lya Habakuki

1 Awu wo wulombe wo muwizi Habakuki,

2 Gwe Muwaha Mulungu,

ane hulika zono wetuma,

nane nhuga woga wuwaha.

Ale, alu'kanyhi mu vilo vyetu,

witumaje metumo mawaha gono wagetuma lulo.

Na lono wuli mwi'kuwo lyako,

ninga weze no lusungu.

3 Mulungu yakuza kanyhi ku wulawa Edomu,

Mulungu mono yelile yakuza

ku wulawa ku matunda ge Palani.

Lukumyo lwakwe lugubice wulanga,

ne yisi yamemile lukumyo lwakwe.

4 Kazaga hamonga no wuzelu we limuli,

no wuzelu wubulilaga

ku wulawa mu muwoko wakwe,

baho ho vihundikwe vilungo vyakwe.

5 Mwene kalongozaga wutamwa

ku mwande yakwe,

kanyhi kalilajilizaga lifwa lize mu nyuma yayo.

6 Hono yakwima,

yisi yikusinjisika,

na mu wulanje wakwe,

makungugo gakucicima.

Ne matunda ge cibitilila gakubeneka.

Ne vigongo vye cibitilila vikudodomela hasi,

vigongo vyono mwene yakolaga mu vilo vye katali.

7 Ane nghawona wanhu wa Kushani wali

mu magayo ne wanhu wa Midiyani wakucicima.

8 Alo Muwaha Mulungu kwali

ko gali makolongo gono gakaleka agwe wukolwe 'kuwo?

Hamba kwali ko lili lilenga

lyono likukozize agwe likuwo?

Agwe wajendelaga mucanyha ye mavunde,

mavunde gali yo mituka yako yo wulugu,

lono wawaletela wanhu wako wusume.

9 Ale wiwikanize wuwitumamile wupinde wako,

ho wuwe wiwikanize

ku wugumila zisonga zako.

Ne mamuli gako gakuyidemula yisi.

10 Ne matunda nago,

kolo gakukuwona, gakucicima,

ne malenga nago,

gakumwajika ku wulawa ku wulanga,

ne malenga gono gali hasi ye'si,

gakukoloma hawaha.

11 Na mu wung'alale

wo wugumile we zisonga zako,

no wung'alale wo wuzelu we migoha yako,

lizuwa no mwezi vyene

vyo vimile du ha wikalo wavyo.

12 Na mwi'kuwo lyako wukakola mu yisi,

na mu wukali wako,

wukawapondanjiza makungugo.

13 Wukabita kuwaponya wanhu wako,

no kumuponya mutemi wako

mono wamuhagula.

Wukawagwisa hasi walongola we wabi,

wukawapondanjiza i watyatyi wakwe.

14 Ne zisonga zako,

zikamuguma musilikale mulongola

we wasilikale wakwe wo wulugu,

lono wakuza nhe 'wingo yiwaha

ho waciyagaze 'se,

wakucisimanga nhe wanhu

wono wakuwewonela

i waciwa mu nzila ye cinyele.

15 Walikanyanjiza lilenga ne zifwalasi zako,

sunga ne malenga gakatumba.

16 Nane nghuzihulika zizi zose,

kuno nghucicima,

no mulomo wangu wuleceye wukucicima so woga.

No muwili wangu wose wanyong'onyela,

sunga ne magulu gangu nhondo,

gakucicima lono nimile.

Ninga ne, nolindila du nhulile,

sunga lizuwa lize

lyono Mulungu kolowalipiciza wose

wono wakuwa kucihoma.

17 Ninga hamba mikuyu yilece kubonhola maluwa,

ne zizabibu yilece kulela zabibu,

hamba mizeyituni nayo yiwe si yikujela, zeyituni,

nayo migunda yiwe si yikulavya wuhemba,

hamba ne zingholo nazo ziwe zose zafwiza,

ne mabululu ge zimitugo geza gali bwete.

18 Ane nosangalala no kusecelela

vyono Muwaha Mulungu yo muponyi wangu.

19 U Muwaha Mulungu yo kamhelaga 'ne vilungo.

Kayinozaga migulu yangu yiwa nhe migulu ye nzela,

kanyhi kamhelaga vilungo

vyo kukolela mu canyha ye matunda.


Zefaniya 1

1 Ayi yo nghani yono Muwaha Mulungu yamupela Zefaniya, u mwana wa Kushi, mwana wa Gedaliya, mwana wa Amaliya, mwana wa Hezekiya, mu vilo vya Yosiya Mwana wa Amoni mutemi wa Yuda.

Lizuwa lyo Muwaha Mulungu lyo wuling'anize

2 Muwaha Mulungu yakatya, “Ane novihodanga vinhu vyose vyono vili mono'nze,
3 nowongomeza wanhu wose hamonga ne zinimu, ne zindeje ne zisomba. Ne wabi nowongomezeza lukulu. Kanyhi nowongomeza wanhu wose, hamba hasina cinhu cumi co cose cono colosigala. Ane no Muwaha Mulungu vyo nghutya.
4 Nowalipiciza wanhu wa Yelusalemi, sunga na wose wono wali mu yisi ya Yuda. Nowuhodanga wityatye wono wupulute wo kuhemba Baali, hamba hasina yunji kanyhi, mono kolowakumbucila wakohani wa Baali wono wamwitumamilaga.
5 Kanyhi nomuwusiza lukulu munhu wo wose, mono kabitaga mwi'tembe mucanyha, kawa kuvihemba lizuwa no mwezi sunga ne zinyelezi. Kanyhi nowawusiza lukulu wose wono wahembaga nene, no kwilahiza vyono wena cihuliko kuli'ne, na kuno kanyhi, ho wakwilahiza kuli mulungu Moleki.
6 Kanyhi nowawusiza lukulu na wawo wono wawuya ne nyuma hamba si wakunhyatya'ne kanyhi. Wawo wono si wakuza kuli'ne hamba si wendile kuwulondola wutonji wangu niwatonje.”

7 Lizuwa lyo Muwaha Mulungu lili behi, lizuwa lyono Mulungu kolokwikala no kulavya wuling'anize. Holeka wikalaje wutule hali Muwaha Mulungu. Hambi Muwaha Mulungu, nha yakwiwikaniza yawalavye yikumbiko wanhu wakwe, nayo yakondya kuwahagula wono yawalalice.
8 Na mwi'zuwa lilyo lyo wuwulagwe, nolowalipiciza i wawaha we lilumbo, hamonga ne wana we watemi, sunga na wose wono wakwibata myoto ye cijenzi.
9 Kanyhi nolowalipiciza wose wono wakuhemba nhe wanhu wono si wamumanyile Mulungu, hamonga na wono wahizaga no kuwulaga, ho wazimemye ngaluzi zinyumba ze wawaha wawo.
10 Mwi'zuwa lilyo yakutya Muwaha Mulungu, “Molohulika mazi ge cililo mu Yelusalemi, ha Mulango we Somba. Kanyhi molohulika cililo ciwaha mwi'tumbi lye kejete lye likaya, hamonga ne lizozo yiwaha mu matunda.”
11 Mulile mwikunguze kolo mukuzihulika zizi, anye mono mwikaye mu mhelo ye likaya, hambi wasuluza wose nha wowa wakondya kufwa!

12 “Mu cipango cico nolosola tala niyimulice Yelusalemi, niyiwone vyono yinha. Kanyhi nolowapezya iwanhu wewoni, wono weyitumbilaga weneco, wono wakwiyitya, ‘U Muwaha Mulungu, si konoza ziswanu hamba si konoza zimbi.’
13 U wugoli wawo wolosolwa, ne zikaya zawo zolohodangwa. Hamba si wolosumila lukulu kanyhi, kwikala mu zikaya zawo zono wakuzenga, hamba kung'wa divayi mu wulawa mu migunda yawo ye zabibu yono walimile.”
14 Lizuwa liwaha lyo Muwaha Mulungu, lili behi kuza, likuza mbela mbela! Ne lizuwa lilyo lyolowa yizuwa lyo wusungu, hamba ne wasilikale we vilungo wololila so wuwula witumbilo!
15 Lyolowa yizuwa lyo wutamiswe, yizuwa lyo wugaye no wambuce, yizuwa lyo wongomezwe, yizuwa lye citi na lye nghungulyosi, wutitu ne mavunde,
16 lizuwa lyono limemile mazi ge zindulele zo wulugu, ne cililo co wihome we wasilikale, wakwinjila mu makaya na mu minala mitali muno.
17 Muwaha Mulungu yakutya, “Ane noleta wugaye muli wanhu, ne wanhu wose wowa kujenda nha wali cibofu. Hambi nha wose wasutizye kuli'ne. Holeka sakami yawo yokwitika nha malenga, ne mivimba ye miwili yawo yolowa minji mu'si.”
18 Na mwi'zuwa lyono Muwaha Mulungu kololajila likuwo lyakwe, fweza ne zahabu zawo zose, hamba si zolowaponya yaye, hambi i yinze yose, nha yolowa yakondya kutakamizwa no moto we likuwo lyakwe. Hambi nha kolowadumya wanhu wose wono wekaye mono'nze, ko mudumyo wo wogofye wuwaha.


Zefaniya 2

Wulombe so wunene

1 Anye nyo likungugo lyono lisina cevu, ale mwikongholelaje hamonga,
2 lono mukali nawinjilwa kutali, kotya mawaje gono gapemheluswe ne mbeho, na lono likuwo lyo Muwaha Mulungu, lyono lihwanile moto likali si namuzizenyi, lizuwa lyono kololajila wukali wakwe.
3 Mumupitucilaje Muwaha Mulungu anye wose nyo wanhu wenenenyhezi wa mu yisi, anye mono muwukamise wulajilize wakwe. Mwitumaje ze ling'ani, kanyhi mwinenenyheze nyo weneco hali Muwaha Mulungu, nha lunji mopona mwi'zuwa lyono Muwaha Mulungu, yalalajila likuwo lyakwe.

Wongomezwe we makungugo gono gayipilime Isilayeli

4 Hasina yunji mono kolosigala mwi'kaya lya Gaza. Na Ashikeloni yolowa wambuce. Ne wanhu wa Ashidodi wolowingwa mu mapango ge misi, ne wanhu wa Ekiloni wolowingwa ku wulawa mwi'kaya lyawo.
5 Anye nanye nyo Wafilisiti, woyi hee kuli'nye, anye nyo wanhu mono mwikaye mu mhwani. Hambi Muwaha Mulungu, nha yakondya kudumula nghani muli'nye. Mwene komongomezenyi wose, hamba hasina yunji muli'nye mono kolosigala.
6 Yisi yenyu ku wulawa ku mhwani, yolowa migunda yono yili mwazi, yolowa yina vibanda vye wadimi, hamonga ne mabululu ge zingholo.
7 Ne wanhu wa Yuda, wono wasigala, woloyisola yisi yenyu. Wolodima zimitugo zawo kuko no kugona mu zikaya za Ashikeloni. U Muwaha Mulungu wawo, kolowa hamonga nawo, na kanyhi kowamotesa.
8 Muwaha Mulungu we Mihanga yakutya “Nawahulika wanhu wa Mowabu na Amoni wakuwaliga no kuwezwajiza wanhu wangu, no kwitapa vyono woyisola yisi yawo.
9 Ninga mbeka, nha vyono ninha ane no Mulungu mumi, ane no Mulungu wa Isilayeli, nghwilahiza nha vyono, Mowabu na Amoni zolokongomezwa nha vyono Sodoma na Gomola zongomezwa. No mwino wologwa hanhu hose, no kongomezezwa lukulu cibitilila, ne mabalwe go golocindika mumo. Ne wanhu wangu wono wasigaye, woloyipumha, no kuyisola yisi yawo.”

10 Na vyo wolowa wanhu wa Mowabu na Amoni, wololipicizwa ku soko yo wiwoni wawo, hamonga ne zinyono zawo, na ku soko yo kuwaliga wanhu wo Muwaha Mulungu we Mihanga.
11 U Muwaha Mulungu, kolowogofya muno. Hambi nha koloyimala milungu yose ya mono yinze, ne makungugo gose golomuhemba mweneco du, wanhu na yisi yawo weneco.
12 Muwaha Mulungu kanyhi, kolowawulaga nhavivyo ne wanhu wa Kushi.
13 Kanyhi Muwaha Mulungu, kolokwitumamila vilungo vyakwe yayihodanje Ashuli. Mwene kololinoza likaya lya Ninawi liwe nyika ye 'tongo, kanyhi yiwe nyika yono yisina malenga.
14 Holowa hanhu hono matewa ge zimitugo, ne mawala gose ge zinimu, wowa wo wikalo wayo. Ne zinhuwi zolokwikala mu matongo gago, akuno zikulila ku ulawilila mu madilisha ge matongo. Ne mahowe nago, golowa kulila ha milango. Ne mabici go muhagata gono wazenjeye, yolowa nghani ya bwete du.
15 Azi zo zololijelela likaya lyono lina wiwoni wo kwiyitumbila vilungo vyalyo lyeneco, no kwihwesa vyono likaye lipolile. Ne wanhu wayo wakwihwesa vyono likaya lyawo lye 'waha kuciza makaya gose mono yinze yose. Na kumbe wo wambuce wa bwete, hambi nha holopituka hawe wikalo we zinimu za mu mbago! No munhu wo wose mono kokolela baho, kololihoweleza no kusinjisa mutwe wakwe.


Zefaniya 3

Wuling'anizwe wa Yelusalemi

1 Woyi hee! Yelusalemi! Hambi nha yokongomezwa. Hambi nha lye 'kaya lyono limemile wibavye. Ne walongola wawo, wo wanhu wabi, wakuwewonela wanhu wawo.
2 Lye 'kaya lyono si likumuhulika Muwaha Mulungu, hamba kubocela ze mejizo gakwe. Likali namwitumbila Muwaha Mulungu, hamba kulomba wutazi kuli Muwaha Mulungu.
3 Ne wawaha wayo wabuguci, wehwanile zisimba zono zikukoloma, ne Wahakimu wayo, nawo wehwanile maminzi ge camihe gono gadabuce, gono si gasigazaga hamba cinji, lono wela hakali mitondo.
4 Ne wawizi wayo si wehuwilwa, kanyhi wakonji. Wakohani nawo, wahatajila wavu i hanhu hono helile, kanyhi wakulipitula ne lilajilizo lyo Mulungu ku soko ye cambuzi cawo weneco.
5 Ninga Muwaha Mulungu, yali mwi'kaya, yakwituma ze ling'ani, si yakwituma zimbi ng'o. Nayo kawaletelaga wanhu wakwe ze ling'ani, nhondo zose. Ninga i wanhu wono wasina ling'ani, vyo wajendeleye du ku wituma zimbi, hamba kuwona cevu yaye.

6 Ninga Muwaha Mulungu yakutya, “Nagawusiza lukulu makungugo gose. Nagagwisanga makaya gawo, no kugaleka majinji gawo hamonga ne minala yawo vihodanjice.
7 Ne makaya gawo geza gali bwete, na mu zinzila zayo, mweza musina cinji, hasina hamba yunji mono yasigaye. Nane nghehwesa vyono, wanhu wangu wowa wena cogopo kuli'ne no kubocela mejizo gangu, no kuleka kusemwa, mejizo gono nawejiza. Ninga wakacenya musunho, no kwituma zimbi mu mikalile yawo.”
8 Ane nghutya, “Wunindilaje.” Vyo yakutya Muwaha Mulungu, “Wulilindile lizuwa lyono nokwinuka ho niwasitace makungugo. Nane nakondya kutemya vyono, nigakonghole i makungugo, hamonga no wutemi wose, ho wasume kuviwona i vilungo vye likuwo lyangu. Ne yinze yose yotakamizwa no moto we likuwo lyangu.

9 “Lulo nolowapitula i wanhu we makungugo niwapele nonga swanu, nawo wolohemba nene du nili wene, hamba si woloyihemba kanyhi milungu yinji. Langa wolohulika nene du.
10 Hamba kuwe kutali ku wulawa mu makolongo ga Kushi, ninga iwanhu wangu wono weyagaye ako na ako, wose wolondavizya vilavywa nene du.
11 Na mwi'pango lilyo, anye nyo wanhu wangu, molowa musina soko yo kuwona cevu, vyono mwali mwambedegala. Hambi 'ne nha nowawusa i wewoni wose, hamonga ne wevuni wose. Nanye lulo, si molombedegalila lukulu kanyhi mwi'tunda lyangu lyono lyelile.
12 Nane nolowaleka baho i wanhu wenenenyhezi ne waciwa, wono wokuza kulondola wutazi kuli'ne.
13 Ne wanhu wa Isilayeli wono wasigaye, si wolokwitendela vibi kanyhi munhu na muyagwe, hamba kwilonjela zo wulambi, hamba kuwa wakonji yaye. Wolowa walugutwe kanyhi wapolile, na holowa hasina yunji mono kolowogofya kanyhi.”

Lwimbo lwe nyemo

14 Ale, mwimbe ne nyemo kwe mazi mawaha 'nye

nyo wanhu wa Isilayeli.

Nagwe go Yelusalemi,

wusangalale kwe nhumbula yako yose.

15 Muwaha Mulungu kakondya kuwudumya

u wuling'anizwe wako,

kanyhi kakondya kuwawusa

ne walugu wako wose.

U Muwaha Mulungu,

u Mutemi wa Isilayeli,

yali hamonga nanye.

Holeka kusina soko kanyhi

yono yoleka muwe no woga.

16 Cipango cikuza,

lono woloyilonjela Yelusalemi wawe kutya,

“Ale, wulece kogopa 'gwe go likaya lya Sayuni!

Ne miwoko yako yilece kudejepa!”

17 Muwaha Mulungu wako,

yali hamonga nagwe,

ne vilungo vyakwe, vyokupela wusume.

Muwaha Mulungu,

kotuga wendezwe kuli'gwe,

na mu wendo wakwe,

kokupela wumi.

Kokwimbila no kukusangalalila

18 ne nyemo, yono yinha nyemo

ye wanhu wono wali mu sikukuu.

Kanyhi Muwaha Mulungu yakutya,

“Nakondya kuwuwusa u wogofye wo wongomezwe,

naciwusiza lukulu ne cevu cawo.”

19 Icipango cikuza!

Lono nolowalipiciza

wono wakumwiwonelenyi,

nolowaponya we vilema wose,

kanyhi nolowagomola

ku zi kwawo wose wono wali wasolwa

mu yisi yawo no kutegulwa kutali.

Nolopitula ne cevu cawo ciwe lukumyo,

ne yinze yose yolowakumya wene.

20 “Icipango cikuza!

Lono nolowagomola wanhu wenyu

wono weyagazwa,

wawuye ku zikaya,

nolomunozenyi lukumyo

no kumanyika muli yinze yose,

no kumunozenyi kanyhi mumoteswe

nha vyono ha mwamulizo.”

Vyo yakutya Muwaha Mulungu.


Hagayi 1

Wulajilize wo Muwaha Mulungu wo kuyizenga kanyhi Nyumba yo Mulungu

1 Mu mwaka we kejete wo wutemi wa Daliyo mu Pelisiya, mwi'zuwa lilongozi lyo mwezi wo mutandatu, Muwaha Mulungu yalonga mu nzila yo muwizi Hagayi. Yamulonjele Zelubabeli mwana wa Shelitiyeli u mulongola we yisi ya Yuda, hamonga no Mukohani Muwaha Yoshuwa mwana wa Yehozadaki.

2 Muwaha Mulungu we Mihanga yakamutya Hagayi, “Wanhu awa wakutya cipango aci co si cipango co kuyizenjela Nyumba yo Mulungu.”
3 Muwaha Mulungu kanyhi, yakawalonjela wanhu nghani ayi muli muwizi Hagayi yakatya,
4 “Nye nyo wanhu wangu, alo nhawulenyi, anye mwikaye mu zikaya zinzenje viswanu, lono Nyumba yangu yo wuhembelo yikaye mu wuhodanjice?
5 Ma, si mukuziwona zono zomutujenyi.”
6 Mulanje ta, anye mwahadika mbeyu nyinji, ninga mwadudula wucefu du, mukulya, ninga simukwiguta yaye, mukung'wa divayi, ninga hamba simukuca ng'o, mukuvwala myenda, ninga siyikukondya kumupenyi civuce. No munhu mono yakwituma milimo, u musahala wakwe, wukuwa nha wutajilwa mu mufuko wono wutoboce-toboce.
7 Muwaha Mulungu we Mihanga yakutya, Alu nhawule si mukusuma kumanya, ku sokoci zizino zikwijela?
8 Alu mubite mu matunda, mukateme zimbawo, muyizenje Nyumba yo Mulungu, holeka nane nokwendezwa, kanyhi ho nowa kuhembwa nha vyono nojeye kuhembwa.

9 “Mwali mwitumbiye vyono motuga nhwanga mbaha, ninga yipituka yiwa ndodo. Nanye mwali mweza kugomola nhwanga yenyu mu zikaya, nane nghayipemhelusa. Na ku sokoci nghazinoza zizo? Vyono Nyumba yangu yikaye mu wuhodanjice, akuno anye mukujendelela kwipiganza mu zikaya zenyu, munhu na kaya yakwe.
10 Na yiyi yo soko yono yikuleka mvula si yikutonya, hamba kusina cinji cono cikucindika.
11 Nane nghayimila mvula yilece kutonya mu yisi, na mu matunda gayo, na mu migunda yo wuhemba, na mu migunda ye zabibu, na mu migunda ye mibici yono yilelaga mikalo, muli vilimwa vyose vyono yisi yilavyaga, na muli wanhu, ne zinimu, na muli vyose vyono mukuhila kuviwilusa.”

Wanhu wakulihulika lilajilizo lyo Muwaha Mulungu

12 Hobaho Zelubabeli na Yoshuwa ne wanhu wose wono walawa ku wuhamywe ku Babiloni, waketuma nha vyono Muwaha Mulungu wawo yawalonjela wetume. Nawo wakamogopa no kumuhulika muwizi Hagayi, mutumwa wo Muwaha Mulungu.
13 Baho Hagayi yakawalonjela wanhu nghani yo Muwaha Mulungu, yakawatya, “Muwaha Mulungu yakutya, awu wo wihuwizo wangu, vyono ane nowa hamonga nanye.”
14 U Muwaha Mulungu yakaweza mitima wanhu wose wetume mulimo wo kuyizenga Nyumba yo Mulungu, Zelubabeli u mulongola we yisi ya Yuda, na Yoshuwa u Mukohani Muwaha, ne wanhu wose wono wawuya ku wulawa ku wuhamywe. Wakawa kwanza kuyizenga kanyhi Nyumba yo Muwaha Mulungu we Mihanga, u Mulungu wawo.
15 Mwi'zuwa lye makumi mejete na yine, lyo mwezi wo mutandatu, wo Mwaka we kejete, wo wuteme wakwe Daliyo.


Hagayi 2

U wuswanu we Nyumba 'mhya yo Mulungu

1 Mwi'zuwa lye makumi mejete na monga, lyo mwezi wo mupunghati, mu mwaka wuwo, Muwaha Mulungu yalonga kanyhi mu nzila yo muwizi Hagayi.
2 Yakamulonjela Hagayi, yalonje na Zelubabeli u mulongola we yisi ya Yuda, na kuli Yoshuwa Mukohani Muwaha, na kuli wanhu, yawalonjele yatye.
3 “Wulenyi, koyuli yunji muli'nye mono yakumukumbucila wuswanu we Nyumba yo Mulungu vyono wali winha? Alu ninga wulenyi, mukuyiwona yinha wule zuwali? Yidahile kwijela nha cinhu ca caka caka du.
4 Ninga hamba nhavivyo, yunji yalece kutukuwika mutima. Langa anye mwitumaje du mulimo muhidimbaye, hambi ane nha nili hamonga nanye.
5 Nanye lono mwawukaga ku wulawa Misili, ane nghamwihuwizenyi nha vyono cipango cose nowa hamonga nanye, sunga nalu ane nghali nili hamonga nanye. Holeka mulece kogopa.

6 “Hanyuma nosinjisa wulanga ne yinze, yisi ne lilenga.
7 Nane nogacicimya makungugo gose, no wugoli wawo wose, wolosolwa no kuletwa bahano, ne Nyumba yo Mulungu yolomemywa no wugoli.
8 Fweza zose na zahabu za mono yinze, nha zangu.
9 Nyumba 'mhya yo Mulungu, yolowa swanu muno muno kuciza yinongozi. Nane baho nolowapela wanhu wangu wumoteswe no mulamu.” Vyo yakutya Muwaha Mulungu we Mihanga.

I wanhu wose wavufywe

10 Mwi'zuwa lye makumi mejete na yine, lyo mwezi we licenda, mu mwaka we kejete wo wutemi wa Daliyo, u Muwaha Mulungu kanyhi yalonga kuli muwizi Hagayi.
11 Yakatya, “Wuwawuzaje ta Wakohani wulajilize vyono wukutya mu nghani ayino.
12 Hono munhu yunji yasole nyama yono yelile ku wulawa mu cikumbicilo, no kuyidinghula mwi'mhembo lyo mwenda wakwe. Na hono yaleceleze mwenda wakwe wupamize mukate, hamba ndigwa yono nhelece, hamba divayi, hamba mafuta ge mizeyituni, hamba ndigwa yo yose, wule! Ndigwa yiyo nayo yowa yanozwa yelile?”

Ne liwuzo lilyo lyali lyeza kuwuzwa kuli wakohani, nawo i wakohani wakatya, “Aa ng'o si yonozwa yelile.”
13 Hanyuma Hagayi kanyhi yakawawuza yakutya, “Ma, hono yiwe munhu yeyavufya ku soko yo kuwupamiza muvimba. Na hono yapamize cinhu co cose ca muli zindigwa zizo, wule, kowa yazitajila wavufywe zindigwa zizi?” Nawo i wakohani wakapitula wakatya, “Heya, kowa yavitajila wavufywe.”

14 Hobaho Hagayi yakawatya, “U Muwaha Mulungu yakutya, azi vyo zinha kuli wanhu we likungugo lili, na kuli vilimwa vyose vyono wakuvilima, na kuli vinhu vyose vyono wakundavizya mu cikumbicilo, vyose vyakondya kwavufywa.”

Muwaha Mulungu yakuwehuwiza wulugutwe wakwe

15 Muwaha Mulungu yakutya, “Ma, simwawona zono zejela kuli'nye?” Lono mwali mukali nanza kuyizenga kanyhi Nyumba yo Mulungu,
16 mwabita ku migunda kududula wuhemba, akuno mukulanjilila vyono motuga kilo magana mejete, ninga wono wali wuli baho, wali kilo yigana limonga du. Kanyhi mwabita ho muneje divayi lita yigana mu zinjilo, ninga mwatuga lita makumi mane du.
17 Nategula mbeho yono yanyaza, ne mvula ye mabwe, yikavihodanga vinhu vyose vyono mwahilaga kuviwilusa. Ninga hamba nhavivyo, si mwanena yaye.
18 Zuwali lye 'zuwa lye makumi mejete na yine, lya mu mwezi we licenda, ku wulawa lizuwa lyono musinji we Nyumba yo Mulungu wakondelecela. Alu mulanjilile cono cokwijela ku wulawa lulu sunga hanyuma yayo.
19 Hamba nha yiwe aluno musina wuhemba wono wusigaye mu madongha genyu, ne zizabibu, ne mikuyu ne mikomamanga, ne mizeyituni nayo si yikulela, ninga ku wulawa lulu, ane nomulugutizenyi.

Wihuwizo wo Muwaha Mulungu kuli Zelubabeli

20 Mwi'zuwa lilyo lye makumi mejete na yine, lyo mwezi, Muwaha Mulungu yamupela Hagayi nghani lwe kejete.
21 Yabite yakamulonjele Zelubabeli u mulongola we yisi ya Yuda yamutye, “Ane nowucicimya wulanga ne yisi,
22 kanyhi nowuwusa no wutemi wose, no kuvidumya vilungo vyayo. Noyibidusa mituka yawo yo wulugu, hamonga na wono wakuyijendya. Zifwalasi nazo zofwa, hamonga na wono wakuzijendela, wokwiwulaga weneco wose.
23 Mwi'zuwa lilyo, nokusola agwe Zelubabeli go mwitumami wangu, nokuhagula wuteme mwi'tagwa lyangu. Hambi nha yo gwegwe du mono nghuhaguye.” Vyo yakutya Muwaha Mulungu we Mihanga.


Zakaliya 1

Muwaha Mulungu yakuwacema wanhu wakwe wamuwuyile

1 Mu mwezi wo munana wo mwaka we kejete lono mutemi Daliyo yali yatemile Pelisiya. Muwaha Mulungu yakamulonjela muwizi Zekaliya, u mwana we cilume wa Belekiya kanyhi u mwizukulu kwa Ido yabite yakawalonjele wanhu yatye,
2 “Ane no Muwaha Mulungu wenyu, nali niwakoleywe yikuwo yiwaha muno i wasogo zenyu.
3 Ninga 'lu nghumutyenyi, mbuyilenyi, nane nomuwuyilenyi nye.”
4 Mulece kwihwana nhe wasogo zenyu wono katali i wawizi wawapela zinghani zangu ho wagalece metumo gawo mabi, hamonga no wubi wawo. Ninga wene siwahulika, hamba kumvumila 'ne yaye.
5 Alu i wasogo zenyu, hamonga ne wawizi wawalya wose, wakondya kufwa.
6 Nane nghawapela i wasogo zenyu suguzi hamonga no wulajiize, mu nzila ye wetumami wangu wawizi. Ninga wene wakalema kuzityatya, hodu nane nghawa kuwaleka, wakatuga wugaye wuwaha. Ninga kanyhi wakanena no kumanya vyono, Ane no Muwaha Mulungu, we Mihanga, nakondya kuwalipiciza nha vyono yiwanojeye, nha vyono nali nalamula niwatendela.

Wulajilwe wulongozi: Fwalasi

7 Ale, mu mwaka we kejete, wa mu wuteme wakwe mutemi Daliyo. Mwi'zuwa lye makumi mejete na yine, lya mu mwezi we likumi na monga ne cilo, (Mwezi wono wacemwaga Shebati) Muwaha yakangubulila.
8 Nghamuwona malayika wo Muwaha Mulungu, yali yali mucanyha ye fwalasi ndunghu, yali yemile behi ne mibici ye mihadasi mwi'lolo. Mu nyuma yakwe hali hozili fwalasi zinji ze liwala lidunghu, na ze liwala lye 'hali ne zinzelu.
9 Nghamuwuza nghatya, “Gwe Muwaha wangu, zifwalasi azi zikulajila nghanici?
10 Muwaha Mulungu kawatuma awa, ho waze wayilanje yinze.”

11 Nawo wakamulonjela malayika wakatya, “Cayipilima yinze yose, kanyhi cawona vyono yinze yose yitulile kanyhi yisina wutazi.”
12 Hobaho malayika yulya yakatya, “Gwe Muwaha Mulungu we Mihanga, wayikolelwa yikuwo Yelusalemi ne matumbi gose ga Yuda, sunga alu yafika myaka makumi mupunghati. Alu ho kojendelela sunga nili kuwawonela yikuwo, ho wuze wuwalajile lihewa lyako?”
13 Nayo Muwaha Mulungu yakamupitula malayika mu zinghani zono zina wutuzwe.
14 Hanyuma malayika yakanonjela niwalonjele wanhu vyono azi zo Muwaha Mulungu we Mihanga yakutya, “Nghuyiwonela lusungu no wendo Yelusalemi, likaya lyangu lyono lyelile.
15 Kanyhi nghuziwonela yikuwo zinghungugo zono zicehile kanyhi zina mulamu. Ku soko lono likuwo lyangu lyali lyapola so wanhu wangu, zinghungugo zizo, ho zikacila muno kuwagaza wanhu wangu no kuwetumya vibi.
16 Alu nawuya kanyhi ha Yelusalemi, ho ndajile zo lusungu lwangu mwi 'kaya. Ne Nyumba yangu yonozelezwa, ne likaya nalyo, lyozengwa kanyhi.”
17 Kanyhi malayika yakanonjela yakatya, nyanze nitye, “Muwaha Mulungu we Mihanga yakutya, makaya gakwe gose, gotuga wulugutwe, kowuyajila kanyhi kuyitaza Yelusalemi, no kuyiwala vyono lyo likaya lyakwe.”

Wulajilwe we kejete: Mahembe

18 Na mu wulajilwe we kejete, nghawona mahembe mane ga nghongolo.
19 Nghamuwuza kanyhi Malayika yu yulya mono calonganaga nayo nghamutya, “Mahembe gaga nhunizo yayo nyhici.”

Yakamhitula yakanyitya, “Aga gemile gakulajila i vilungo vye yinze, vyono vyaweyagaza wanhu wa ku Yuda, na Isilayeli, na Yelusalemi.”
20 Hanyuma Muwaha Mulungu yakandajila wetumami wane, wono wali webate ne zinyondo zawo.
21 Nghamuwuza kanyhi nghatya, “Alo wanhu awano, waza kunozaci?” Yakamhitula yakanyitya, “Waza ho wazitajile woga no kuzigwisa zinghugugo zono zayikandamiza yisi ya Yuda, sunga zikaweyagaziza wanhu wose wa Yuda ako na ako.”


Zakaliya 2

Wulajilwe we kadatu: Mulejehe wo kupimila

1 Kanyhi mu wulajilwe wangu wunji, nghawona munhu mono yali yebate mulejehe wo kupimila.
2 Nghamuwuza nghamutya, “Alo 'gwe wukubita hayi?” Yakamhitula yakanyitya, “Nghubita kuwupima Yelusalemi, ho manye uwutali no wugazi wayo.”
3 Hanyuma nghamuwona malayika yulya mono calonganaga nayo yakutela ha mwande, nayo malayika yunji yakaza viketang'anila nayo.
4 Malayika ayulya umulongozi, yakamulonjela muyagwe yakamutya, “Wumanyhe, wukamulonjele u muzelelo ayulya mono yena mulejehe wo kupimila, vyono ku Yelusalemi kolowa ko wali wanhu wenji, hamonga ne mitugo minji. Holeka ne likaya lyowiluka liwe yiwaha sunga lifute no kuwuzenjela majinji.
5 Muwaha Mulungu mweneco, yelahiza vyono, u mwene yo kolowa majinji go moto gono gololipilima likaya no, kulidima kanyhi mwene kolojendelela kwikala baho nhondo zose, hamonga no lukumyo lwakwe lose.”

I wahamywa wakucemwa wawuye ku Yelusalemi

6 Muwaha Mulungu yakalonga ne wanhu wakwe yakatya, “Naweyagaza anye wose mu malanga gose.
7 Ninga alu nyo wahamywa, muwuce lu ku Babiloni, muwuye ku Yelusalemi.
8 No munhu wo wose mono komusagalenyi anye, yamanye vyono yakusagala cinhu co wuguzi wukamu kuli'ne.” Holeka u Muwaha Mulungu we Mihanga kandeta nizilolose zizi kuli makungugo gono gawahamya i wanhu wakwe, nigatye nha vyono,
9 Muwaha Mulungu we Mihanga mweneco kolokwihoma na nyenye. Nanye molosolwa ne wanhu wono baho halulongozi, wali wo wetumami wenyu.

Na kolo zizi zakondya kwijela, nawo wose ho wolomanya vyono yo gwegwe Muwaha Mulungu mono wanhuma.
10 Muwaha Mulungu yakatya, “Ale mwimbe musangalale 'nye nyo wanhu wa Yelusalemi! Hambi nha nghuza kwikalana nanye!”
11 Na mu vilo vivyo makungugo menji golokuza kuli Muwaha Mulungu, nawo wowa wanhu wakwe. Nayo Muwaha Mulungu kolokwikala hamonga na nyenye. Nanye ho molomanya vyono mwene yo yanhuma kuli'nye.
12 Kanyhi Yuda yolowa yo sawo yakwe siwanulwe yo Muwaha Mulungu mu yisi yakwe yono yelile, nayo Yelusalemi yolowa lyo likaya lyono yalyendile muno.
13 Ale munyamale wose twiii, hamwande yo Muwaha Mulungu. Hambi nha yakuza yakulawilila mu wikalo wakwe zono welile.


Zakaliya 3

Wulajilwe we kane: Mukohani Muwaha Yoshuwa

1 Ale, mu wulajilwe wunji kanyhi, Muwaha Mulungu yakandajila Mukohani Muwaha Yoshuwa yali yemile ha mwande ya malayika wo Muwaha Mulungu. Baho behi na Yoshuwa, yakema Setani mono yali yewikanize ho wesumanize na Yoshuwa.
2 Malayika wo Muwaha Mulungu yakamutya Setani. “Ale Muwaha Mulungu yakutacile 'gwe Setani! Muwaha Mulungu mono yayendile Yelusalemi, kokulipiciza. Hambi mwene Yoshuwa na yenha cizinga cono cawuswa mu moto.”
3 Ale, Yoshuwa yali yemile baho ha mwande ya malayika yavwalile myenda yono yitipiye.
4 Malayika yakawalonjela wetumami wakwe wa ku wulanga, wono wali wemile ha mwande yakwe yakawatya, “Mumuwopolaje munhu ayu myenda yiyo yono yitipiye, yono yavwalile.” Hanyuma yakamulonjela Yoshuwa yakamutya, “Ale, nakondya kukuwuziza wubi wako, nokupela ne myenda mipya yo wuvwale.”

5 Yakawalajiliza wetumami wamuvwalize Yoshuwa ne mukumbo muswanu mu mutwe wakwe, nawo wakamuvwika. Hanyuma wakasola ne myenda mipya nayo wakamuvwaliza. Lulo malayika wo Muwaha Mulungu yali yemie baho yalanjiliye.
6 Hanyuma malayika yakamulonjela Yoshuwa nha vyono
7 Muwaha Mulungu we Mihanga yakutya, “Hono wuvumile no kwibata malajilizo gangu, no kwituma milimo yono nakupela witume, holeka kojendelela kuwa mulongola wa mu Nyumba yangu, hamonga ne mihali yayo. Nane nghwulika wulombe wako, nha vyono nghuwa kuwahuliciza i wamalayika wono wemile ha mwande yangu.
8 Wuhulicize 'gwe Yoshuwa, agwe yo gwegwe mono weza wuli Mukohani Muwaha. Nanye nyo wakohani wayagwe, i watyatyi wakwe, muhulicize, anye yo nyenye mono muli citanjilo ce ziswanu zose zono cikuzilanjilila. Nomulajila calinze u mwitumami wangu, mono kacemwaga Inhambi!
9 Nane nghuwika ha mwande ya Yoshuwa yibwe limonga, lyono lina wusu wuli mupunghati. Nokakata mandiko mucanyha yalyo, na mwi'zuwa limonga, nolowusiza lukulu u wubi wa mu yisi yiyi.
10 Ne lizuwa lilyo kolo lyeza kuza, nyenye wose molowalalika wekalani wayenyu waze muhanje nawo mu nyemo yo mulamu no wutule, i hanhu hono howa hapilimwe ne mizabibu yenyu hamonga ne mikuyu.”


Zakaliya 4

Wulajilwe we hano: Ciwicilo ce zitala

1 Malayika yuyulya mono calonganaga nayo yakaza kanyhi yakanyinusa kotya nha nali ngonile.
2 Yakambuza yakutya, “Alu wukuwona cici?” Nane nghamupitula nghamutya, “Nghuwona ciwicilo ce ziala cinozwe na zahabu. Kanyhi mucanyha, mo yili bakuli yono yina mafuta, a mu ciwicila ce zitala, mozili tala mupunghati, zono zina vitajililo vye mafuta mu zitala zizo.
3 Kanyhi ho yili ne mizeyituni myejete yili mu mhelo ye ciwicilo ce zitala, muzeyituni monga ku lubavu lumonga no muyagwe nawo ku lubavu luyagwe.”
4 Hanyuma nghamuwuza malayika yu yulya nghatya, “Alu i vinhu avi so cici vili baha”
5 Yakanyha, “Alu 'gwe siwuyimanyile nhunizo ye vinhu vivi?” Nane nghamutya, “Aa! Ng'o ye, simanyile muwaha.”

Wihuwizo wo Mulungu kuli Zelubabeli

6 Malayika yakanonjela nghamutegulile Zelubabeli nghani yono yikulawa kuli Muwaha Mulungu, yono yikutya, “Si kwe vilungo, hamba si ko wusume wako go mweneco, aa, ng'o! Langa ko muhe wangu.
7 Yakajendelela kulonga yakutya, ‘Wule, litunda lili lyokwimila? Aa ng'o! Agwe Zelubabeli, kolitenjelemula. Nagwe kokwanza wuzenji wupya we Nyumba yo Mulungu kolo wukulijeleka mwi'jinji libwe lye ndumilizo, wanhu wose wolozoza wakutya, 'ulungu wulilugutize! Mulungu wulilugutize!’ ”
8 Kanyhi yinghani yo Muwaha Mulungu yikanyiziza,
9 yikutya, “Zelubabeli yakondya kuwika musinji we Nyumba yo Mulungu, na mbeka koyikondeleza yikaya yiyi. Na kolo zizi zakondya kwijela ale, baho wanhu wose ho wokwihuwila vyono yo nene mono nakutegula kuli wene.
10 Aluno wakukalala lono wakuwona luzengo lukubita luli mhola mhola. Ninga luno wowona vyono zelubabeli yakulujendeleza luzengo lwe Nyumba yo Mulungu, nawo wosangalala muno muno.”

Malayika yakamhitula yakatya, “Zitala mupunghati, go meso mupunghati go Muwaha Mulungu gono gakusuma kuyiwona yinze yose.”
11 Hobaho nghamuwuza kanyhi nghatya, “Mibici myejete ye mizeyituni yono yili mu lubavu lwe ciwicilo ce zitala nhunizo yayo co cici.
12 Kanyhi i nhunizo ye manhambi mejete go mezeyituni gono gali mu lubavu lo kulume no kucekulu lwe vimilo vye zitala vye zahabu hamonga ne vibomba vyono vikutajila mafuta mu zitala?”
13 Ale, nayo yakambuza yakatya, “Alu 'gwe siwuzimanyile? Nghamupitula nghamutya, ng'o ye, simanyile 'gwe Muwaha.
14 Hanyuma ho yakanonjela yakatya, wo wanhu i wejete wono Mulungu yawahagula no kuwetila mafuta ho wamwitumamile Muwaha Mulungu we yinze yose.”


Zakaliya 5

Wulajilwe wo mutandatu Citabu cono ciguluce

1 Hobaho kanyhi nghenula meso, nghawa kuwona citabu ciguluce mucanyha.
2 Malayika yakawa kumbuza, alu wukuwona cici? Nghamupitula nghatya, nghuwona citabu ciguluce mucanyha, cono cina wutali wa mita yicenda no wugazi wayo mita yine na nusu.
3 Baho yakawa kunonjela yakatya, “Mu citabu cici mo wandicigwe wulijitwe wono wobita mu yisi yose, no lubavu luyagwe lwe citabu, lukutya vyono, i wahizi wose wa mu yisi yiyi, wowuswa mu yisi. No lubavu luyagwe nalo, lukutya vyono, na kuli munhu wo wose mono kokwilahiza ko wulambi, nayo kowingwa.
4 Zizi zo yakulonga u Muwaha Mulungu we Mihanga yakutya vyono, kowuleta wulijitwe, nawo wokwinjila mu zikaya ze wahizi wose, na mu zikaya za wose wono wakwilahiza ko wulambi ale wulijitwe wowa mu zikaya zawo no kuwaleka mu matongo.”

Wulajilwe wo mupunghati: Mucekulu, mono yali yali mu nhoto

5 Hobaho malayika yu yulya mono calonganaga, yakejela hamwande yangu kanyhi yakanyitya, “Wulanje! Ko cili cinhu cinji kanyhi cono cikuza!”
6 Nane nghamuwuza nghatya, “Cicici cene?” Nayo yakamhitula yakatya. Ayo nhoto yo yikulajila wubi we yisi yose.
7 Langa ta ne nhoto yiyo yali yina cigubiko we liwala lye buli. Nane lono nali nghali niyilanjile, hobaho cigubiko cayo cikenulwa na mugati yayo, mo yali munhu wa cicekulu yekaye.
8 Malayika yu yulya yakatya, “U mucekulu ayu yakulajila u wubi.” Hanyuma yakamugomoleza kanyhi mu nhoto, yakawa kuyigubika ne cigubiko cayo.
9 Nghenula meso nghalanga kucanyha, nghawawona we cicekulu wejete waguluce wakuza kono nali nimile wena mabawa gono gali vilungo muno kotya ga Yobwa. Wakayinula nhoto yiyilya wakawa kuguluka nayo.
10 Nghawa kumuwuza malayika nghatya, “Alu wawa wakuyitegula nhoto yiyino hayi?”
11 Nayo yakapitula yakatya, wakuyitegula ku Babiloni wakayizenjela nyumba kuko. Na kolo nyumba yiyo yikukondya, i nhoto yiyo ho yowikwa baho, i hanhu hono wowa kuyihembela.


Zakaliya 6

U wulajiliwe wo munana: Mikokoteni ye zifwalasi

1 Kanyhi nghenula meso gangu, nghawona magali mane go wulugu gakuza gakulawilila haciligati ye matunda mejete ga shaba.
2 Ligali lilongozi lyakwegwaga ne zifwalasi zindunghu, na lye kejete nalyo wakwegwaga ne zifwalasi zinhitu,
3 lye kadatu nalyo ne zifwalasi zinzelu, na lye kane, nalyo ne zifwalasi ze buli.
4 Hobaho nane nghamuwuza malayika yu yulya nghatya, “Gwe muwaha, magali gaga gena nhunizoci?”
5 Nayo yakamhitula yakatya, “I magali gaga zo mbeho yine za ku wulanga, nazo zizi zikulawa kuli Muwaha Mulungu yinze yi yino yose.”

6 Ligali lyono likukwegwa ne zifwalasi zi nhitu, likubita ku lubavu lwe sumuka ku Babiloni, nazo zi nzelu zidomile ku lubavu lwa ku mwezi, nazo ze buli zikubita ku yisi ya ku lubavu lwa kutakama.
7 Hobaho zaza kulawila ze liwala lidunghu, zikasaka kubita ako na ako zikayilingule yinze yose. Nayo malayika yakazilonjela yakatya, “Ale, mubite ako na ako, mukayilingule yinze yose!” Nazo zikabita kuyilingula.
8 Hobaho malayika yakanyhema, yakanonjela yakatya, “Zifwalasi zono zibitile ku lubavu lwe sumuka, sunga ku Babiloni, zakondya kulipoza likuwo lyo Muwaha Mulungu.”

Lilajilizo lyo kumuvwika Yoshuwa mukumbo

9 Baho u Muwaha Mulungu yakanonjela yakatya,
10 Ale, wusole i vipegwa vyono wokupela awalya wono walawa ku wuhamywe. Helidayi, na Tobiya, na Yedaya. Hanyuma wubite mbela mbela ku kaya ya Yosiya u mwana wa Zefaniya. Ne wanhu wawa wose, wo wakondya kuwuya ku wulawa ku wuhamywe ku Babiloni.
11 Wunoze mukumbo mu wulawa mu fweza ne zahabu, zono wakupelile, wumuvwice mu mutwe u mukohani muwaha Yoshuwa u mwana wa Yehozadaki.
12 Wumulonjele wutye, u Muwaha Mulungu we mihanga yakutya, “U munhu mono yakucemwa yinhambi yo kocindika baho kanyhi yo kozenga ne nyumba yo Mulungu no kumugomolela Muwaha lilumbo lyakwe.
13 U mwene yo kolizenga no kubocela lilumbo lyo mutemi, nayo kuwatema i wanhu wakwe. Nayo mukohani muwaha kolokwima he'goda lyakwe lyo wutemi. Nawo wokwitumana mulimo viswanu kwa mulamu, kanyhi wowa wehulicile.
14 No mukumbo wuwo, wolowa co cikumbucizo mu Nyumba yo Mulungu, so kuwapela lilumbo Helidayi, na Tobiya, na Yedaya na Yosiya.”
15 Ne wanhu wono wekaye kutali, wose wolokuza ho mwitaze nawo, ku wuzenga kanyhi Nyumba yo Muwaha Mulungu. Nayo Nyumba kolo yakondya, baho ho molomanya vyono u Muwaha Mulungu we mihanga yo yanhuma kuli 'nye. Na zizi zose zoficilicila, hono anye wose mugavumile no kugatyatya i malajilizo go Muwaha Mulungu, u Mulungu wenyu.


Zakaliya 7

Muwaha Mulungu si yakwendezwa no wuleka kulya wo wukoci

1 Kukawa mu mwaka we kane, wa mu vilo vyo mutemi Daliyo, mwi'zuwa lye kane, na mu mwezi we licenda, mwezi wono wucemwaga ciselevu u Muwaha Mulungu yakanonjela ane Zekaliya yakatya.
2 Wanhu wa ku Beteli wa wawatuma Shelezeleli na Legemumeleke, wanhu wawo, ku Nyumba yo Muwaha Mulugu we mihanga walombe wulugutizwe wo Muwaha Mulungu,
3 kanyhi wawuze kuli wakohani ne wawizi i liwuzo ali, watye, “Alu cijendelele kulila mu nzila yo kuleka kulya, mu mwezi we hano kusoko yo wongomezwe we Nyumba yo Mulungu, nha vyono cetuma mu myaka minji yono yipulute?”
4 Ayi yo nghani yo Muwaha Mulungu yono yanyiziza.
5 Yakanonjela kanyhi yakatya wuwalonjele wanhu wa mu yisi hamonga ne wakohani vyono, lono walekaga kulya, akuno wa kulila mu mwezi we hano na wo mupunghati mu myaka yi yilya yose makumi mupunghati, wule, si yali nzila yo kulajila cogopo ca kuli'ne.
6 Na lono walizaga wo kung'wa wali so wiyendeze wawo weneco du.
7 Zizi zo yalonda Muwaha Mulungu, mu milomo ye wawizi walongozi mu vipango vyono na Yelusalemi, likaya lyono lyelile, lyali likali lina no lukumyo, kanyhi limemile ne wanhu. Na lono wanhu wali wenji, wono wekalaga mu makaya, gono gali galipilime likaya, sunga na mu zi'si za kutakama, na mu mwalambalo wa mu matunda ga ku lubavu lwa ku mwezi.

Wu wula cihuliko, yo soko yo wuhamywe wuhamywe

8 Hobaho Muwaha Mulungu yakamulonjela Zekaliya yakatya,
9 “Ane nawapela i wanhu wangu malajilizo gaga, ku wulawa katali, nghawatya, ‘Ale, mulanjilile mwitume ze ling'ani, kanyhi mweze mwina wendo no lusungu, kuli munhu no muyagwe.
10 Mulece kuwawonela wafwile, hamba wana wono wasina walezi, hamba wajenzi wono mwikalane nawo, hamba munhu wo wose mono yali mu wanjile. Kanyhi mulece kuleta mahweso mabi go witamise munhu na muyagwe.’
11 Ninga i wanhu wangu wangu wakawa wali cibede siwakasaka hamba no kuhuliciza, wakadinda ne makutu gawo ho walece kuhulika,
12 wakakamufya ne zinhumbula zawo zikawa nghamu ku wuhulice. Na vyono si wasaka no kugahuliciza ne mafundo, gono nawapelela muli wawizi we katali, hodu, nane nghawakolelwa muno likuwo.
13 Alu vyono siwahuliciza zangu, holeka nane sinawapitula no wulombe wawo.
14 Na ku soko yiyo holeka nghawafwagula, no kuwawinjila ku zi'si zo wujenzi. Ne yisi ayi swanu, yikekala nyhiwa musina munhu mono yasigala yekale mumu.”


Zakaliya 8

Muwaha Mulungu yakwihuwiza nha vyono koyizenga kanyhi Yelusalemi

1 Muwaha Mulungu we mihanga, yakamulonjela Zekaliya yakatya,
2 “Alu, nendezwa kulitaza no kulizenga kanyhi likaya lya Yelusalemi, ku soko yo wendo wangu wuwaha kuli wanhu wayo, u wendo wono wamhela likuwo, ku soko ye walugu walyo.
3 Alu nowuya 'ne ku Yelusalemi, likaya lyangu lyono lyelile, niwe kwikala mumo. Likaya lyocemwa likaya lye mbeka. Ne litunda lyo Muwaha Mulungu we Mihanga, nalyo lyocemwa litunda lyono lyelile.
4 Kanyhi i wakombi we cilume na we cicekulu wono wakwikomajiza ne zinghome lono wakujenda, wolowa kuceha mu viwanza vye likaya.
5 Ne zinzila za mwi'kaya zolomema wana we cilume na we cicekulu, wolowa kwidawala mumo.”

6 Ne nghani yiyi kuli wanhu we zinghungugo zono zisigaye, wolowona kotya nha siyosumika, ninga kuli'ne yosumika du.
7 Ane nowawusa wanhu wangu ku wulawa ku yisi ya ku'cilima na ku yisi ya kumwezi.
8 Niwagomole wose wa ku wulawilila ku cilima sunga ko ku mwezi wawuye wekale mu Yelusalemi. Nawo wowa wanhu wangu, nane nowa Mulungu wawo, mono nowadimila mu mbeka na mu ling'ani.
9 U Muwaha Mulungu we mihanga yakutya, “Mwime mukamile mweze kuli vilungo! Hambi sunga nalu, nha mukuzihulika zinghani zono i wawizi wazilonga, lu lulya, lono wawicilwa u musinji so wuzenji kanyhi we Nyumba yangu.
10 Na mbeka hono zizi zali zikali nejela, hasina yunji mono yasuma kumuhumbiliza muyagwe hamba mutugo, kanyhi hali hasina mono yali yena mulamu kuli walugu wakwe. Vyono ane nghawaleka ho wagombane munhu na muyagwe.
11 Ninga 'lu nghuwanozeza zono zisimile wono wasigaye we nghungugo yiyi.
12 Wolohadika zimbeyu zawo ko mulamu. Ne mizabibu yawo yolela mikalo viswanu, nawo muhangha we yisi wololavya wuhemba, ne mvula yowa kutonya muno. No wulugutizwe wuwu nowapela i wanhu wa mu nghungugo yangu wono wasigaye.
13 Nye, nyo wanhu wa Yuda na Isilayeli! Ha mwamulizo, wajenzi welijitaga weneco wose wakatya, ‘Wongomezwe wono wawutuga wanhu wa Yuda na Isilayeli, ale, wukutuje na gwegwe.’ Ninga ane nomuponyenyi, sunga ne wajenzi wapitule ne mahweso gawo kanyhi, walongane munhu na muyagwe wawe kutya, ‘Ale, wubocele wulugutizwe, nha vyono wawubocela wanhu wa Yuda na Isilayeli. Holeka mwime mukamile kanyhi mulece kogopa.’ ”

14 U Muwaha Mulungu we Mihanga yakutya, “Lono walezi wenyu wanghalazaga, nawawikaniziza wongomezwe, hamba sinagakawaniza mahweso gangu yaye, langa najendelela du ne mahweso gago.
15 Ninga 'lu, nghwiwikaniza niwapele wulugutizwe wanhu wa Yelusalemi na Yuda. Holeka mulece kogopa.
16 Alu azi zo mokwituma. Mweze kulonga ze mbeka munhu na muyagwe. Namo mu mahakama, mweze kuling'aniza kwe ling'ani mu nzila yono yikuleta mulamu.
17 Mulece kwihwesa zimbi zo kwiyitamisa nyenye wose. Hamba kulavya wuhomelezi wo wulambi ko wilahize, hambi 'ne nha nizisulile zinghani zo wulambi na zo wukali, mu nzila yo kuwewonela wanhu.”

18 U Muwaha Mulungu we mihanga, yo yamupela zinghani zizi u muwizi Zekaliya.
19 Wikapise wo wuleka kulya, wa mu mwezi we kane na we 'hano na wo mupunghati, na we likumi zowa zo sikukuu ze nyemo mbaha no wusangalale kuli wanhu wa Yuda. Holeka mwende mbeka no mulamu.
20 Muwaha Mulungu we mihanga yakutya, “Vilo vyokuza, vyono i wanhu wololawa mu makaya ganji, nawo wokuza ku Yelusalemi.
21 Nawo wanhu we likaya linji, wolongana na we likaya linji, wotya, ‘Ase cikubita kumuhemba Muwaha Mulngu we mihanga, ho yacipela wulugutwe no wendezwe wakwe. Cibitenyi nanye cikamuhembe hamonga!’
22 Hobaho wanhu wenji hamonga ne zinghungugo zono zina vilungo zolokuza ku Yelusalemi kumuhemba Muwaha Mulungu we mihanga, wamulombe yawapele wulugutizwe wakwe.
23 Na mu vilo vivyo, wanhu yikumi we cijenzi, wolomuziza muyahudi monga wamutye, cikulomba ciwe hamonga nanye, hambi nha cihulika vyono u Mulungu yali hamonga nanye.”


Zakaliya 9

U wuling'anizwe we zinghungugo zono zipilime Yelusalemi

1 Ayi yo nghani yono yikulawa kuli Muwaha Mulungu. Muwaha Mulungu yakalavya lilajilizo lyo wulipicizwe we yisi ya Hadelaki, ne likaya lya Damesiki. Ninga wulipicizwe wuwo si wowa so zimhuga ze Waisilayeli du, langa hamonga ne likaya lya Siliya, likaya lyo Muwaha Mulungu.
2 Na Hamati yono yili behi na Hedelaki, hamonga ne makaya ga Tulo na Sidoni, hamba gawe gena mahala menji.
3 Nayo Tulo, yezenjela magomawakali gono galipilime likaya, no kukonghola fweza nyinji, hamonga na zahabu nyinji, kotya matope ga mu nzila.
4 Ninga lanje ta! U Muwaha Mulungu komuwusiza lukulu vivyo vyose. Nayo kolozigumila zi sawo zakwe mwi'lenga, ne likaya nalyo, lyoloticimizizwa lukulu.

5 Ne likaya lya Ashikeloni lyoloziwona zizi nalyo lyolokogopa. Nhavivyo ne likaya lya Gaza, lyoloziwona zizi, nalyo lyolowona wusungu wuwaha muno. Nayo Ekiloni hamonga no witumbilo wayo wose, nayo yolobenanjizwa. Nayo Gaza yolowula mutemi, Ashikeloni yololekwa mu wuciwa wuwaha muno.
6 Ne wanhu macotala, wolokwikala hamonga ku Ashidodi. Nayo Muwaha Mulungu yakutya, “Nowanyetya wawa i Wafilisiti wewoni.
7 Siwoloyilila lukulu kanyhi nyama yono yina ne sakami yayo, hamba kulya ndigwa yo yose yono yili mwiko kuyilya. Nawo wose wono wolosigala, wolojendelela kuwa wanhu wangu, nawo nolowehwaniciza ne mhuga ya mu lulelo lwe nyumba ya Yuda. Nayo Ekiloni yose, wolowa wanhu wangu kotya Wayebusi.
8 Nane noyilanjilila yisi yiyi, kanyhi nowika ne wasilikale wono woyidima ho wanji walece kukola mumo. Kanyhi hamba sinowakombola walugu hamonga ne wewonezi, ho wawewonele wanhu wangu. Hambi nha nakondya kuwona vyono, i wanhu wangu wakugazwa muno.”

U mutemi wo mulamu mono cikumulanjilila

9 Musecelele, musecelele nye nyo

wanhu wa ku Sayuni!

Muzoze muno muno so nyemo,

anye nyo wanhu a Yelusalemi!

Mulanje ta!

Mutemi wenyu yakumuzizenyi 'nye!

Yakuza yena nyemo mbaha ne mhonelo,

kanyhi mupolo,

yakuza yali mucanyha ye ndogowe,

nyana ye ndogowe.

10 Muwaha Mulungu yakutya,

“Nogawusa ne matuka go wulugu,

gono gakulawa ku Isilayeli,

niziwuse ne zifwalasi

zono zolawa ku Yelusalemi,

hamonga no wupinde

wono wukwitumamilwa mu wulugu,

vyose vyokongomezwa.

No mutemi wenyu,

koleta mulamu kuli zinghungugo zose.

Kanyhi kotema ku wulawilila kwi'lenga sunga

ko kwi'lenga na ku wulawilila kwi 'kolongo lya Efulata,

sunga ko kundumo ye yisi.”

Kuwagomola kanyhi wanhu wo Mulungu

11 U Muwaha Mulungu yakutya,

“Kusoko ye cilagane cangu na nyenye,

cono cawikwa

mu nzila ye sakami ye makumbiko.

Holeka nane nowawopolela wafungwa

no kuwawusa mwi'kombo

lyono lisina malenga,

likombo lyo wuhamywe.

12 Ale muwuye anye wose nyo wahamywa

mono alu mweza mwina witumbilo,

muwuye ku wikalo wenyu wono wina mulamu.

Alu nghumulonjelenyi vyono,

nomupelenyi wulugutwe kali kejete

ku soko magaziko genyu.

13 Nomwitumamila Yuda yawe kotya

wo wupinde wo musilikale,

na Isilayeli yawe kotya zo songa.

Nowetumamila wanhu wa

ku Sayuni wawe kotya wo mumaje,

wehome ne wanhu wo Wugiliki.”

14 Nayo Muwaha ho kokwilajila

mu wanhu wakwe koguma zi songa zakwe,

nazo zobita kotya limuli.

U Muwaha Mulungu yo kotowa ne ndulele.

Nayo kojenda ne mbeho

ye civulavumbi kuwulawilila ku takama ye yisi.

15 Kanyhi u Muwaha Mulungu

we mihanga yo kowakamisa ne wanhu wakwe,

nawo wowongomeza ne walugu wawo.

Kanyhi wolowa kuzoza kuko

ku wulugu kotya nhe wagalo 'jimbi

kanyhi wolopegwa vilungo

vyo kuyimwaga sakami ye walugu wawo;

sakami yiyo yolohuluma kotya sakami

ya ha wukumbicilo,

yono yimwajigwe ku wulawa

mu bakuli ha cikumbicilo.

16 Hobaho lizuwa lilyo lilaza kuwa lyafika,

u Muwaha Mulungu

ho kolowaponya wanhu wakwe,

nha vyono umudimi kaponyaga litewa lyakwe,

lono lyamanyhilwa ne lilimu.

Nawo wolong'alala mu yisi yakwe,

kotya nha vibwe vyo wihambo,

vya mu mukumbo wo wutemi.

17 Lanjenyi ta,

yisi yiyo yolowa swanu wule?

I wahinza ne wazelelo,

wolowa kuwiluka wali vilungo,

so wuhemba ne divayi vyono vili mumo.


Zakaliya 10

U Muwaha Mulungu yakuwehuwizia wukombozi

1 Ale mumulombaje Muwaha i mvula mu vilo vye cifuku. Hambi mwene nha yo Muwaha Mulungu mono kaciletelaga mvula ne mavunde, hamonga ne mahalavu, kanyhi yo kayinozaga ne migunda yetu yiwa yili dedede.
2 Hambi i wanhu wono wawuzaga kuli milungu yinji ye vihwani, no kwitoweleza cisangu, ne lipitulo lyono wakuwa kutuga nha lya wulambi, kanyhi lya wulele du. Wanji wakuwa kuzilolosa zi ndoto no kuzinoza kotya nha cinhu ca mbeka, kumbe wakumukonjenyi bwete du. No wutuzwe wono wakuwa kumulonjelenyi wa bwete du. Holeka hobaho, i wanhu wakupilima-pilima du, kotya nhe zingholo zono zajiliye. Wali mu magayo, hambi nha wasina mudimi.
3 U Muwaha Mulungu yakutya, “Nghuwawonela yikuwo, i wajenzi wose wono wawatemile wanhu wangu. Holeka nane nowalipiciza wose, hambi i wanhu wa Yuda, nha wangu. Nane no Muwaha Mulungu we mihanga, nowadima wanhu wangu. Kanyhi nowanoza wawe nha fwalasi zangu zo wulugu.
4 Na muli weneco, nowahagulila wono wowalongoza, i walongola hamonga ne vitung'ati wono wowatema i wanhu wangu.
5 Ne wanhu wa Yuda wowa no wusume, kotya nha wasilikale wono wakuwakanyanjila i walugu wawo, mu matope ga mu zi nzila za muwulugu. Kanyhi wowahoma, hambi Muwaha Mulungu nha yali hamonga nawo, kanyhi wowasumiza sunga walugu wawo i wajendela zifwalasi.

6 “Nowanoza wanhu wa Yuda wawe

ne vilungo kanyhi nowaponya wanhu wa Isilayeli.

Kanyhi nowawonela lusungu

no kuwagomola wose kono kaya yawo.

Wowa kotya nha wono si nawalema

ha mwamulizo yaye.

Ane yo nene Muwaha Mulungu,

Mulungu wawo, nowapitula no wulombe wawo.

7 Wanhu wa Isilayeli wowa

ne vilungo kotya wasilikale.

Kanyhi wowa wena nyemo,

kotya wanhu wono wang'weye divayi.

Ne wana wawo,

wolokumbucila zo wusume wuwu,

nawo wolowa wena nyemo

ku soko ya zose zono Muwaha Mulungu yazitumile.

8 Nowacema wanhu wangu

no kuwakongholela hamonga.

Nowakomboza kanyhi nowanoza wonjelezece

ho wawe wenji nha

vyono wali wenha ha mwamulizo.

9 Hambi nha naweyagaziza wose

mu makungugo ganji.

Hamba wawe nha wali kutali muno,

ninga wonghumbucila du.

I wene hamonga ne wana wawo,

wosigala no kuwuya wose hamonga.

10 Nolowagomola kono kaya,

ku wulawilila ku Misili na Ashuli,

no kuwawika wacehe mu yisi yawo,

kanyhi nolowawika

mu Gileyadi na mu Lebanoni.

Ne yisi yose yolowa yimemile wanhu.

11 Nawo kolo weza kukola mwi'lenga lyo wugaye.

Ane no Muwaha Mulungu,

nologatowa i mawingo ge malenga.

Ne visolo vye likolongo

lya Nile vyolonyala.

No wivuni we yisi ya Ashuli wolonyetywa.

Ne yisi ya Misili yono yili vilungo,

yolowula vilungo.

12 Nolowanoza i wanhu wangu wawe ne vilungo,

nawo wolowa kuhemba 'ne,

no kunyogopa nene.”

Vyo yakutya u Muwaha Mulungu.


Zakaliya 11

U wugwe wa wono wawewonelaga wayawo

1 Wudigule milango yako 'gwe!

Lebanoni,

u moto ho wutakamize mibici yako ye mikambala!

2 Wuzoze no kulila 'gwe go musonobali,

hambi u muhagata nha wagwiza,

i mibici yono yikamile

nha yakondya malika!

Muzoze kanyhi mulile 'nye

nyo mibici ye minghola ya Bashani,

hambi libago liwaha na lye vilungo,

nha lyatemangwa.

3 I watemi wako wakulila

ko wusungu wuwaha no kukalala,

hambi u lukumyo lwawo nha lwaduma,

wuhulicize ne mikolomo ye zisimba hambi

i mbago yono zikalaga ya

mu nhumbi ya Yoludani,

nha yahondanjika.

I wadimi wejete

4 U Muwaha Mulungu, u Mulungu wangu, yakanonjela yakatya, “Wudime litewa lye zingholo zono zowulagwa.
5 Hambi i wanya zingholo, nha wakuwa kuziwulaga du, kanyhi wasina wulipicizwe, langa wakuwa kuziguza nyama no kutya, ‘Yalumbizwe Muwaha Mulungu. Hambi ase nha cili wagoli!’ Hamba ne wadimi wawo we zingholo zizi, wakuwa wasina lusungu ne zingholo zizi.”
6 U Muwaha Mulungu yakatya, “Sinomuwonela lusungu kanyhi munhu wo wose mu yisi yiyi. Nene no Muwaha Mulungu, nowawika wanhu wose mu miwoko ye walongola wawo, ne walongola wawo wayihome yisi yiyi, nane hamba sinowaponya mu miwoko yawo yaye.”

7 Hobaho awalya wono wagulaga no kuguza zi ngholo wakunondola no kusola, ho niwe mudima zingholo zilya zono zategulwaga ho zikawulagwe. Baho nghetujila nghome monga, nghayicemela yitagwa “Ihewa” na ye kejete nghayicemela “Malunza.” Hobaho nghajendelela kulidima litewa lili.
8 Nghawa sina witumbilo kuli wadimi wadatu wa ha mwamulizo, wono wakasula muno ho baho nane nghawa kuwawusa wose mu mwezi monga.
9 Hanyuma nghalilonjela litewa nghatya, “Alu ne sinowa mudimi wenyu kanyhi, holeka lece zono zikufwa zifwe du, na zono zikongomezwa, zongomezwe du, na zono zisigaye nazo zokwiyilya zeneco zose.”
10 Hobaho nghawa kuyisola nghome yangu yono yikucemwa “Ihewa,” nghayibenanga ho mbene cilagane co Muwaha Mulungu kuli makungugo gose.
11 Hobaho cilagane cici cikawa cabeneka mwi'zuwa lilyo. Awalya wono wagulaga no kuguza zingholo, wali wananjiliye, nawo wakamanya vyono u Muwaha Mulungu yalongaga nawo mu nzila ya zizo zono nazitumaga.
